model_requirements.description: Grocery is a large-scale retail industry operating supermarkets, pharmacies, and fuel centers, offering fresh produce, private-label brands, and omnichannel shopping experiences with delivery and pickup services.

model.name: Grocery
model.description: Grocery is a large-scale retail industry operating supermarkets, pharmacies, and fuel centers, offering fresh produce, private-label brands, and omnichannel shopping experiences with delivery and pickup services.
model.core_business_processes: Merchandise Planning and Assortment Management, Store Operations and Replenishment, Supply Chain and Distribution Center Management, Omnichannel Order Fulfillment (Delivery and Pickup), Pharmacy Operations and Prescription Management, Fresh Produce and Perishable Inventory Management, Private-Label Brand Development and Sourcing, Customer Loyalty and Promotions Management, Fuel Center Operations and Pricing, Vendor and Supplier Relationship Management
model.data_domains: Customer, Product, Store, Supply Chain, Inventory, Order, Pharmacy, Promotions, Workforce, Finance, Vendor, Fuel Operations, Digital Commerce, Loyalty
model.common_business_jargons: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), UPC (Universal Product Code), PLU (Price Look-Up Code), BOGO (Buy One Get One), DSD (Direct Store Delivery), DC (Distribution Center), POS (Point of Sale), GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment), OOS (Out of Stock), Shrink (Inventory Loss from Theft or Spoilage or Damage), Planogram (Visual Merchandise Display Plan), Endcap (End-of-Aisle Display), Facing (Product Front on Shelf), CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering), WMS (Warehouse Management System), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), GTIN (Global Trade Item Number), GS1 (Global Standards Organization for Barcodes), FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), LMD (Last Mile Delivery), NPS (Net Promoter Score), CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value), EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization), COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), ASP (Average Selling Price), Comp Sales (Comparable Store Sales), Same-Store Sales (Revenue Comparison for Existing Locations), Private Label (Store-Owned Brand Products), CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods), SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children Program), EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer), HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points), SRP (Suggested Retail Price), TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), Ad Circular (Weekly Promotional Flyer), Gondola (Shelving Unit in Store Aisle), Backroom (Storage Area Behind Sales Floor), Pickup (Curbside or In-Store Order Collection), Click-and-Collect (Online Order with In-Store Pickup), OMS (Order Management System), TMS (Transportation Management System), RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), Cold Chain (Temperature-Controlled Supply Chain), Cross-Dock (Transfer Without Storage), Markdown (Price Reduction for Clearance), Category Captain (Lead Vendor for Category Management), Slotting Fee (Vendor Payment for Shelf Space), Fill Rate (Percentage of Orders Fulfilled Completely), Dwell Time (Customer Time Spent in Store)
model.operational_systems_of_records: SAP Retail (MM - Materials Management; FI - Financial Accounting; CO - Controlling; SD - Sales and Distribution; WM - Warehouse Management), Oracle Retail Merchandising System (Item Management; Price Management; Allocation; Replenishment), Kronos Workforce Central (Scheduling; Time and Attendance; Labor Analytics), Manhattan Associates WMS (Receiving; Putaway; Picking; Shipping; Inventory Control), Blue Yonder Demand Planning (Forecasting; Replenishment Planning; Allocation Optimization), NCR POS Systems (Transaction Processing; Payment Processing; Loyalty Integration), Salesforce Commerce Cloud (eCommerce Storefront; Order Management; Personalization), McKesson Pharmacy Systems (Prescription Management; Drug Inventory; Clinical Services; Compliance Reporting), JDA Transportation Management (Route Optimization; Carrier Management; Freight Audit), Workday HCM (Core HR; Payroll; Benefits Administration; Talent Management)
model.industry_governing_body: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) - food safety and labeling requirements, USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) - organic certification and meat/poultry inspection, DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) - controlled substance scheduling for pharmacy operations, State Boards of Pharmacy - pharmacy licensing and prescription dispensing regulations, FTC (Federal Trade Commission) - advertising and pricing practices, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) - workplace safety standards, EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) - refrigerant management and fuel center emissions, PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) - payment processing security, HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) - pharmacy patient data privacy, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - financial reporting and internal controls for publicly traded companies

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all grocery shopper identities, profiles, households, segments, and preferences. Manages B2C shoppers, B2B wholesale accounts, SNAP/WIC/EBT program participants, and pharmacy patients (non-PHI). Owns demographics, contact preferences, NPS scores, CLTV metrics, and segmentation data. Integrates with CRM platforms and supports personalization and targeted marketing.
domains.references: GS1 Party Standards, PCI DSS, CCPA/GDPR Consumer Privacy Standards

products.name: shopper
products.description: Core master entity representing every individual grocery shopper (B2C) known to Grocery. Serves as the single source of truth for shopper identity, capturing legal name, preferred name, date of birth, gender, primary language, registration channel (in-store, app, web), account status (active, suspended, closed), SNAP/WIC/EBT eligibility flags, loyalty enrollment status, CLTV tier, NPS score, acquisition source, and opt-in/opt-out flags for marketing communications. This is the golden record for all B2C customer identity data integrated from Salesforce CRM and NCR POS loyalty enrollment.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each grocery shopper record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key and golden record identifier for all B2C customer identity data integrated from Salesforce CRM and NCR POS loyalty enrollment.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: MARKETING: Preferred store format drives targeted campaigns and inventory allocation; shoppers often indicate format preference in loyalty app.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.delivery_route. Business justification: Preferred delivery route assignment for recurring grocery deliveries, used in route‑optimization and delivery‑performance reports.

attributes.name: personal_shopper_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Personal shopper program assigns a dedicated associate to a shopper; needed for service scheduling, performance tracking, and loyalty reporting.

attributes.name: preferred_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Category Preference Marketing Report needs each shopper's preferred category to target promotions; shoppers naturally have a preferred category, so a FK preferred_category_id → category.category_id is

attributes.name: preferred_pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Supports loyalty program's preferred pharmacy assignment for auto‑refill and targeted marketing.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla_policy. Business justification: Apply a shopper‑tier‑based SLA policy for order fulfillment guarantees; used in SLA compliance and compensation reporting.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shopper's most frequently visited or self-designated home store location. Used for store-level personalization, local ad circular targeting, pickup order routing, and store-level comp sales attribution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Store Management; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: account_closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shopper account was permanently closed or deactivated. Populated only when account_status = 'closed'. Used for GDPR right-to-erasure compliance tracking, retention policy enforcement, and churn analysis.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Internal Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shopper account. 'active' indicates a fully enrolled shopper; 'suspended' indicates a temporarily restricted account; 'closed' indicates a permanently deactivated account; 'pending_verification' indicates registration awaiting email or identity confirmation; 'merged' indicates the record was consolidated into another golden record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: acquisition_source
attributes.description: Marketing or operational source that drove the shopper's initial registration (e.g., 'weekly_ad_circular', 'referral', 'loyalty_kiosk', 'digital_coupon', 'fuel_center_promo'). Used for marketing attribution, campaign ROI analysis, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly_ad_circular|referral|loyalty_kiosk|digital_coupon|fuel_center_promo|organic_web|paid_search|social_media — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Attribution; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the shopper's primary residential address (street number and street name). Used for direct mail delivery, last-mile delivery (LMD) routing, and geographic segmentation analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the shopper's primary residential address (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address_line1 for complete delivery address resolution.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Date of birth of the shopper in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for age verification (alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy), birthday loyalty rewards, WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program eligibility, and demographic segmentation analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USDA WIC Program Regulations 7 CFR Part 246

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the shopper's primary residential address. Used for geographic market segmentation, delivery zone assignment, and local promotional targeting.

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: Segmentation tier assigned to the shopper based on their Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) score. Drives differentiated marketing investment, personalized offer depth, and service prioritization. Tiers are recalculated periodically by the analytics platform.
attributes.references: Internal Customer Analytics Standard; Salesforce CRM — Segmentation

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the shopper's primary residential address (e.g., 'USA'). Supports international shopper identification and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shopper record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer golden record store, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for the MASTER_PARTY role. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to this shopper in Salesforce CRM (Customer Relationship Management). Used to reconcile the golden record with the CRM source system for B2C identity resolution and personalization workflows.

attributes.name: direct_mail_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has opted in to receive physical direct mail communications such as weekly Ad Circulars, personalized coupons, and promotional mailers. True = opted in. Drives mailing list inclusion for print marketing campaigns.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising Practices; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: ebt_card_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Card on File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has an EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) card registered to their account for online SNAP ordering. True = EBT card on file, enabling SNAP-eligible online checkout per USDA online purchasing pilot requirements.
attributes.references: USDA FNS Online Purchasing Pilot; 7 CFR Part 278; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the shopper account. Used as the principal digital contact channel for order confirmations, promotional communications, loyalty program updates, and account recovery. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has opted in to receive marketing communications via email. True = opted in. Must be honored in all outbound email campaigns. Consent state is tracked per CAN-SPAM Act and GDPR Article 7 requirements.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the shopper as captured at registration. Used for identity verification, personalized communications, and loyalty program correspondence.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-reported gender identity of the shopper. Used for demographic segmentation, personalized product recommendations, and diversity analytics. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR and CCPA requirements.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this shopper to a household grouping entity. Multiple shoppers sharing a household are linked via this identifier for household-level analytics, shared loyalty benefits, and targeted household promotions. Resolved through identity matching in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Household Management; Internal Customer Analytics Standard

attributes.name: identity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper's identity has been verified through an identity confirmation process (e.g., email verification, phone OTP, or in-store ID check). True = identity confirmed. Used for fraud prevention, age-restricted purchase eligibility, and pharmacy patient linking.
attributes.references: Internal Fraud Prevention Standard; HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name of the shopper as captured at registration. Combined with first_name to form the full legal identity used in account management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper is currently enrolled in Grocery's loyalty rewards program. True = enrolled and eligible for points accrual, personalized offers, and loyalty pricing. False = not enrolled. Sourced from NCR POS loyalty integration.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration Module

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shopper enrolled in the loyalty rewards program. Used to calculate loyalty tenure, tier progression timelines, and anniversary benefit triggers.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration Module

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by the shopper, ranging from 0 to 10. Indicates likelihood to recommend Grocery to others. Used for customer satisfaction tracking, churn risk modeling, and service recovery prioritization.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company); Internal Customer Experience Standard

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey response was captured. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and determine eligibility for re-survey.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company); Internal Customer Experience Standard

attributes.name: pharmacy_patient
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper is also a registered pharmacy patient at a Grocery pharmacy location. True = pharmacy patient record exists (non-PHI flag only; clinical data is managed exclusively in McKesson Pharmacy Systems under HIPAA). Used for cross-domain identity linking without exposing protected health information.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Patient Management

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the shopper, stored in E.164 international format. Used for SMS marketing opt-ins, order pickup notifications, delivery alerts, and two-factor authentication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: pos_loyalty_code
attributes.description: Loyalty card or account identifier assigned by the NCR POS (Point of Sale) system at the time of in-store loyalty enrollment. Used to link POS transaction history to the shopper golden record.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration Module

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the shopper's primary residential address. Used for delivery zone mapping, trade area analysis, demographic append, and targeted ad circular distribution.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the shopper prefers to be addressed by in communications and personalized experiences (e.g., nickname or chosen name). May differ from legal first name. Supports personalization in Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: Preferred language of the shopper expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-TW'). Drives localization of digital communications, app content, and in-store signage preferences for omnichannel personalization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Module

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has enabled push notifications on the Grocery mobile app. True = push notifications enabled. Used for real-time order status updates, personalized offers, and pickup-ready alerts via Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization Module; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: registration_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the shopper originally registered their account. Supports acquisition source analytics, channel attribution, and omnichannel engagement strategy. Values align with Grocery's omnichannel touchpoints including NCR POS in-store enrollment and Salesforce Commerce Cloud digital channels.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — eCommerce Storefront; NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the shopper account was first created. Used for tenure calculations, cohort analysis, anniversary loyalty rewards, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) segmentation.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Marketing and analytics segment assigned to the shopper based on behavioral, demographic, and transactional data (e.g., 'health_conscious', 'value_seeker', 'organic_buyer', 'family_household', 'convenience_shopper'). Drives personalized offer targeting and assortment planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_conscious|value_seeker|organic_buyer|family_household|convenience_shopper|premium_shopper|deal_hunter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segmentation; Internal Customer Analytics Standard

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has opted in to receive marketing and transactional communications via SMS text message. True = opted in. Consent is required under TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) prior to any commercial SMS transmission.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: snap_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper has been identified as eligible to use SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) / EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) for qualifying purchases. True = SNAP-eligible. Used for EBT tender routing at POS and SNAP-compliant product filtering in digital commerce.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Program Regulations 7 CFR Part 271; FNS (Food and Nutrition Service) EBT Interoperability Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code of the shopper's primary residential address (e.g., 'CA', 'TX'). Used for state-level regulatory compliance (e.g., state WIC agency reporting, state pharmacy board jurisdiction), tax jurisdiction assignment, and regional marketing segmentation.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the shopper record in the Databricks Silver Layer, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wic_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Program Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper is enrolled in or eligible for the WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) federal nutrition program. True = WIC-eligible. Enables WIC-approved product filtering, WIC tender acceptance at POS, and compliance reporting to state WIC agencies.
attributes.references: USDA WIC Program Regulations 7 CFR Part 246; FNS WIC EBT Implementation Guide

products.name: wholesale_account
products.description: Master entity for B2B wholesale and institutional accounts served by Grocery (e.g., restaurants, food service operators, corporate cafeterias, school districts, hospitals). Captures legal business name, DBA name, business type (restaurant, caterer, institutional, corporate), tax ID (EIN), DUNS number, credit limit, payment terms (net-30, net-60, COD), assigned account manager, account tier (strategic, standard, small business), contract start/end dates, billing address, primary contact person, and annual revenue estimate. Distinct from the individual shopper entity — represents an organizational buyer rather than a person. Supports B2B order management, credit approval workflows, and wholesale pricing eligibility.

attributes.name: wholesale_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for wholesale_account

attributes.name: account_owner_shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.shopper. Business justification: Wholesale_account needs an in‑domain relationship to identify the owning shopper (account owner). Adding account_owner_shopper_id creates this link without affecting existing structure.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Grocery sales or account manager employee assigned to manage the relationship with this wholesale account. Used for territory management, performance reporting, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Sales Representative; Workday HCM

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Finance budgets are allocated to wholesale accounts for forecasting spend and tracking actuals against budgeted amounts.

attributes.name: dedicated_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: Wholesale accounts often have dedicated carrier contracts; needed for carrier billing, SLA compliance, and contract reporting.

attributes.name: edi_partner_profile_id
attributes.description: The EDI interchange partner identifier (ISA qualifier + ID) assigned to the wholesale account for electronic order and invoice exchange. Required when edi_capable_flag is True. Used to route EDI transactions in the SAP EDI subsystem.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; ANSI X12; SAP Retail SD - EDI Partner Profile

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.delivery_route. Business justification: Specific delivery routes are assigned to bulk‑shipment wholesale accounts; required for route scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables profitability analysis per wholesale account; profit_center links sales to internal profit reporting structures.

attributes.name: supply_supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier_contract. Business justification: Contract management: Supplier contracts are negotiated per wholesale account; linking enables contract compliance, SLA tracking, and account‑specific pricing.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wholesale account. Controls order eligibility, credit access, and system visibility. Active accounts may place orders; suspended accounts are blocked pending resolution; closed accounts are archived. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Master; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Segmentation tier assigned to the wholesale account based on revenue potential, purchase volume, and strategic importance. Determines service levels, dedicated account management, pricing tiers, and promotional eligibility. Values: strategic (top-tier, high-volume), standard (mid-market), small_business (emerging or low-volume).
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Hierarchy; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wholesale account by business type, indicating the nature of the organizational buyer. Drives pricing eligibility, product assortment access, and compliance requirements. Satisfies CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for MASTER_PARTY role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: restaurant|caterer|institutional|corporate|food_service|school_district|hospital|hotel — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management; SAP Retail SD

attributes.name: annual_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated annual gross revenue (in USD) of the wholesale account's business, sourced from credit applications, Dun & Bradstreet data, or account manager input. Used for account tier assignment, credit limit setting, and strategic segmentation.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet; SAP Retail SD - Customer Master

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the wholesale account's billing address. Used for invoice generation, tax jurisdiction determination, and accounts receivable correspondence.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Customer Master; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary street address line for the wholesale account's billing address (suite, floor, unit number, etc.). Supplements billing_address_line1 for complete address representation.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Customer Master; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City component of the wholesale account's billing address. Used for invoice generation, tax jurisdiction determination, and geographic segmentation of B2B accounts.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Customer Master; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the wholesale account's billing address (e.g., USA, CAN). Supports international wholesale accounts and cross-border tax compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP Retail FI - Customer Master

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the wholesale account's billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction mapping, delivery zone assignment, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; IRS Tax Jurisdiction

attributes.name: billing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the wholesale account's billing address (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Used for state tax compliance, sales tax nexus determination, and regional reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; IRS Tax Jurisdiction; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the wholesale supply agreement or master service contract expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null indicates an open-ended or evergreen contract. Used for renewal alerts, pricing expiry, and account review workflows.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Contract Management; FTC Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the wholesale supply agreement or master service contract between Grocery and the wholesale account becomes effective. Used for contract lifecycle management, pricing eligibility, and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Contract Management; FTC Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the wholesale account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, onboarding analytics, and data lineage. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP Retail SD - Customer Master

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wholesale account is currently on credit hold, blocking new order processing until outstanding balances are resolved or credit terms are renegotiated. Managed by the accounts receivable team in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Credit Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: The maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance (in USD) approved for the wholesale account by the credit department. Orders that would cause the balance to exceed this limit are blocked pending credit review. Managed in SAP FI credit management.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Credit Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit risk rating assigned to the wholesale account based on payment history, Dun & Bradstreet data, and financial review. Informs credit limit decisions and payment term negotiations.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet; SAP Retail FI - Credit Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or 'Doing Business As' (DBA) name under which the wholesale account operates, if different from the legal business name. Used for operational communications, order labels, and account management.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The preferred or contracted method by which wholesale orders are fulfilled and delivered to the account. DC delivery uses Grocery's Distribution Center (DC) fleet; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) uses vendor-direct routes; pickup indicates the account collects from a Grocery facility; third_party_carrier uses an external logistics provider.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management; SAP Retail SD - Shipping Conditions

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the wholesale account's business entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier onboarding, and B2B identity verification.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet GS1 Standards; SAP Retail SD - Customer Master

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wholesale account is set up to exchange orders, invoices, and advance ship notices via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI). EDI-capable accounts use automated order processing workflows, reducing manual entry.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP Retail SD - EDI Partner Profile

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: The federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) / Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS to the wholesale account. Required for tax reporting (1099 issuance), credit applications, and regulatory compliance. Format: XX-XXXXXXX.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SOX Financial Reporting; FTC Compliance

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent order placed by the wholesale account. Used for account activity monitoring, dormancy detection, and retention analytics. Updated by the order management system upon each new order.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Order History; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: legal_business_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the wholesale account as it appears on official business registration documents, contracts, and tax filings. Used for invoicing, credit agreements, and regulatory compliance. Satisfies IDENTITY_LABEL category for MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Master; FTC Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: The minimum order value (in USD) required for the wholesale account to place a valid order. Orders below this threshold are flagged or blocked. Used to ensure order profitability and logistics efficiency.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Order Conditions; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to record operational notes, special handling instructions, relationship context, or escalation history relevant to the wholesale account. Not used for structured analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Master Notes

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the wholesale account was formally onboarded and approved to begin placing orders with Grocery. Distinct from created_timestamp (system record creation); this reflects business approval completion.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Master; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms governing when invoices are due for the wholesale account. Drives accounts receivable aging, cash flow forecasting, and order release decisions. Common values: net_30 (payment due 30 days from invoice), net_60, net_90, cod (Cash on Delivery), prepaid.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI - Accounts Receivable; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_day
attributes.description: The preferred day of the week for wholesale order deliveries to the account, as agreed during onboarding or account setup. Used by the Transportation Management System (TMS) for route optimization and scheduling.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management (TMS); SAP Retail SD - Shipping Scheduling

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for the main business contact at the wholesale account. Used for order confirmations, invoices, promotional communications, and account management. Satisfies PRIMARY_CONTACT category for MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Customer Master; GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the wholesale account. Used for account communications, order confirmations, and relationship management. This is a business contact, not a personal consumer.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Contact Person; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number for the primary business contact at the wholesale account. Used for order inquiries, delivery coordination, and account management communications.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Contact Person; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: primary_contact_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the primary business contact at the wholesale account (e.g., Purchasing Manager, Executive Chef, Director of Operations). Used for targeted communications and account segmentation.

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic or organizational sales territory to which this wholesale account is assigned. Used for territory-based reporting, quota allocation, and account manager assignment.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Sales Territory Management

attributes.name: snap_wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wholesale account is authorized to purchase SNAP/WIC-eligible products for resale or institutional use under applicable federal program guidelines. Relevant for school districts, food banks, and institutional buyers.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Program Regulations; USDA WIC Program; FNS Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_exempt_certificate_number
attributes.description: The state-issued tax exemption or resale certificate number for the wholesale account. Required when tax_exempt_flag is True. Used for sales tax audit compliance and exemption documentation.
attributes.references: State Sales Tax Regulations; IRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wholesale account holds a valid tax exemption certificate (e.g., resale certificate, government entity, non-profit). When True, applicable sales taxes are suppressed on invoices. Requires a valid tax_exempt_certificate_number.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption; State Sales Tax Regulations; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the wholesale account record was most recently modified in the system. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP Retail SD - Change Documents

attributes.name: wholesale_price_group
attributes.description: Price group code assigned to the wholesale account that determines which wholesale pricing schedule or contract pricing tier applies when generating quotes and orders. Maps to pricing conditions in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD - Pricing Conditions; Oracle Retail Price Management

products.name: household
products.description: Represents a household grouping of one or more shoppers sharing a residence and loyalty account. Serves as the single source of truth for household composition and member associations — no other product in this domain stores household membership data. Captures household ID, primary shopper reference, household size, estimated annual grocery spend, household income band, home ownership status, residential zip code, and household lifecycle stage (single, couple, family with children, empty nester, senior). Owns all member associations including member role (primary, secondary, dependent), join and departure dates, and primary loyalty cardholder designation. Enables household composition tracking over time, multi-member loyalty accrual rules, household-level personalization, targeted promotions, and CLTV modeling. Integrates with Salesforce CRM household object.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the household record. Primary key for the household data product within the customer domain. Entity role: MASTER_PARTY — represents a household grouping that the business interacts with as a loyalty and marketing counterparty.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.delivery_route. Business justification: Household‑level default delivery route for scheduled deliveries, required for logistics planning and route scheduling.

attributes.name: merged_into_household_id
attributes.description: When a household record is consolidated (status = 'merged'), this field references the surviving household ID into which this record was merged. Enables data lineage tracking and prevents orphaned loyalty history. Null when the household has not been merged.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Household Merge Rules

attributes.name: primary_shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer record designated as the primary loyalty cardholder and decision-maker for this household. Used for personalization, targeted promotions, and CLTV modeling. The primary shopper holds the loyalty account in their name.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: REGIONAL LOYALTY: Household region is used for regional loyalty program eligibility and sales reporting per region.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla_policy. Business justification: Household‑level SLA policy defines delivery expectations; required for customer‑service KPI tracking and breach notifications.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location most frequently visited by this household, determined by transaction frequency analysis. Used for store-level personalization, localized ad circular targeting, and store trade area reporting.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Transaction Processing; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the household was first acquired as a loyalty member. Used for marketing attribution, channel ROI analysis, and acquisition cost modeling. Supports optimization of loyalty enrollment investment across channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_store|digital|direct_mail|referral|pharmacy|fuel_center|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — eCommerce Storefront; NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration; Internal Marketing Attribution

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: Household-level CLTV tier assignment based on estimated lifetime value scoring. Drives differentiated loyalty benefits, promotional investment levels, and personalization depth. Platinum represents highest-value households; untiered indicates insufficient data for classification.
attributes.references: Internal CLTV Model; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive marketing and promotional communications via email. Must be respected for all outbound email campaigns per CAN-SPAM Act and CCPA opt-out requirements.

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive physical direct mail communications, including weekly ad circulars and promotional mailers. Used for print campaign targeting and postal budget allocation.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; CCPA; Internal Marketing Preferences

attributes.name: communication_opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive marketing and promotional communications via SMS/text message. Must be respected per TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) consent requirements for automated text messaging.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_PARTY entity. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: crm_household_code
attributes.description: External household identifier assigned by Salesforce CRM. Used to correlate the lakehouse household record with the corresponding Salesforce CRM household object for bi-directional integration and data lineage.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; Personalization

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or channel through which this household record was first created. Used for data lineage, quality scoring, and source-system reconciliation. Values reflect the operational systems of record integrated into the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Framework; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: dietary_preference_flags
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of self-reported or inferred dietary preferences for the household (e.g., 'organic,gluten_free,kosher,vegan'). Used for personalized product recommendations, digital storefront filtering, and targeted promotions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|gluten_free|kosher|halal|vegan|vegetarian|dairy_free|nut_free|low_sodium — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Requirements 21 CFR Part 101; USDA Organic Certification; Internal Personalization Engine

attributes.name: digital_account_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household's loyalty account is linked to a digital account on the Salesforce Commerce Cloud eCommerce platform, enabling online ordering, digital coupons, and personalized web/app experiences.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — eCommerce Storefront; Personalization

attributes.name: ebt_card_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Card on File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has an EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) card registered for use in online/pickup/delivery orders. Required for omnichannel SNAP/WIC benefit redemption compliance per USDA online EBT pilot program requirements.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot; FNS EBT Regulations

attributes.name: estimated_annual_grocery_spend
attributes.description: Estimated total annual grocery expenditure for the household across all channels (in-store, pickup, delivery), expressed in USD. Derived from loyalty transaction history and third-party spend data. Used as a key input for CLTV modeling, tier assignment, and promotional investment prioritization. Not a calculated aggregate — represents a modeled estimate stored as a business attribute.
attributes.references: Internal CLTV Model; Salesforce CRM Household Object

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is enrolled in the fuel rewards program, enabling per-gallon discount accrual at Grocery fuel centers. Used for fuel center promotional targeting and cross-category basket-building incentives.
attributes.references: Internal Fuel Center Operations; NCR POS Systems — Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: home_ownership_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household owns or rents their primary residence. Used as a demographic segmentation variable for targeted promotions (e.g., home improvement, cleaning supplies) and CLTV modeling. Sourced from third-party demographic append or loyalty enrollment data.

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the household, typically derived from the primary shopper's surname (e.g., 'Smith Household'). Used in CRM displays, loyalty communications, and household-level reporting. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_PARTY entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Household Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the household record. 'active' indicates an engaged household with recent loyalty activity. 'inactive' indicates no transactions within the defined inactivity window. 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold (e.g., fraud review). 'merged' indicates the household was consolidated into another. 'deceased' indicates all primary members are deceased.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Household Object; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household by its primary relationship with the grocery business. Distinguishes B2C retail shoppers, B2B wholesale accounts, SNAP/WIC/EBT program participants, pharmacy patient households, and employee households. Drives eligibility rules, pricing tiers, and program enrollment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: b2c_shopper|b2b_wholesale|snap_wic_participant|pharmacy_patient|employee — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USDA SNAP/WIC Program Guidelines; FTC Pricing Practices

attributes.name: income_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual household income range, derived from third-party demographic data or self-reported during loyalty enrollment. Used for private-label brand targeting, SNAP/WIC eligibility modeling, and CLTV segmentation. Stored as a band rather than exact income to reduce sensitivity.
attributes.references: FTC Fair Credit Reporting Act; Internal Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: is_test_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household record is a test or synthetic record created for QA, UAT, or system integration testing purposes. Test households must be excluded from all production analytics, reporting, and marketing campaign execution.
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Standards; PCI DSS Testing Requirements

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase transaction recorded for any member of this household across all channels (in-store, pickup, delivery). Used for recency scoring in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, lapsed-shopper identification, and win-back campaign targeting.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems — Transaction Processing; Internal Loyalty Analytics

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the household's current life stage based on composition and demographics. Drives assortment recommendations, promotional targeting, and personalization strategies. Values: single (one adult), couple (two adults, no children), family_with_children, empty_nester (adults, children departed), senior (primary shopper 65+).
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization; Internal Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: loyalty_account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known loyalty program account number associated with this household. Serves as the primary business identifier printed on loyalty cards and referenced at NCR POS during transaction processing. Links household to loyalty accrual and redemption activity.

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was first enrolled in the grocery loyalty program. Marks the EFFECTIVE_FROM of the household's loyalty relationship. Used for tenure-based segmentation, anniversary promotions, and cohort analysis.

attributes.name: loyalty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household's loyalty program membership expires or is scheduled for review. Nullable for open-ended memberships. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for the loyalty relationship. Used for renewal campaigns and lapsed-member win-back programs.

attributes.name: member_count_adult
attributes.description: Number of adult members (age 18+) currently associated with this household. Used to differentiate adult-targeted promotions, alcohol/tobacco eligibility, and per-adult spend benchmarking from total household size.

attributes.name: member_count_child
attributes.description: Number of minor members (age under 18) currently associated with this household. Drives targeting for baby/toddler, school-age, and family product categories, as well as WIC program eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: USDA WIC Program Guidelines; Internal Household Composition Model

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) recorded for this household, on a scale of 0–10. Derived from post-transaction or periodic satisfaction surveys. Used to classify households as Promoters (9–10), Passives (7–8), or Detractors (0–6) for loyalty and service recovery programs.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this household. Used to determine survey recency, control re-survey frequency, and track NPS trend over time.

attributes.name: pharmacy_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more members of this household are active pharmacy patients at a Grocery-operated pharmacy location. Non-PHI flag used for household-level pharmacy service targeting and cross-sell of health/wellness products. No prescription or clinical data is stored in this product.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; McKesson Pharmacy Systems — Clinical Services

attributes.name: preferred_fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The household's predominant order fulfillment preference based on historical transaction patterns. Values: in_store (traditional shopping), pickup (click-and-collect / curbside), delivery (last-mile delivery), mixed (no dominant channel). Used for omnichannel personalization and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Order Management; Internal Omnichannel Strategy

attributes.name: private_label_affinity
attributes.description: Household-level affinity classification for Grocery's private-label brand products, based on the share of private-label SKUs in the household's purchase history. Used for private-label brand development targeting, promotional investment, and category management insights.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Item Management; Internal Private Label Strategy

attributes.name: residential_zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit (or ZIP+4) US postal code of the household's primary residence. Used for geographic segmentation, store trade area analysis, last-mile delivery (LMD) zone assignment, and targeted ad circular distribution. Not a full address — ZIP-level granularity balances utility with privacy.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Total number of individuals currently associated with this household, including primary, secondary, and dependent members. Used for basket size benchmarking, per-capita spend analysis, and product assortment planning. Updated dynamically as members join or depart.

attributes.name: snap_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has been identified as eligible for SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits. Used to enable EBT payment processing at POS, apply SNAP-eligible item filtering, and comply with USDA SNAP retailer authorization requirements.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Retailer Authorization Requirements; FNS Regulations 7 CFR Part 278

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the household record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform conventions.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: wic_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has been identified as eligible for WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits. Enables WIC-approved item filtering at POS and supports USDA WIC vendor compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USDA WIC Program Regulations; FNS Regulations 7 CFR Part 246

products.name: contact_info
products.description: Single source of truth for all contact details and physical/mailing addresses for shoppers and wholesale accounts. Owns phone numbers, email addresses, and postal addresses — no other product in this domain stores contact or address data. Supports multiple records per entity with contact type (email, mobile phone, home phone) and address type (home, billing, delivery, pickup, mailing). Captures full USPS-validated address normalization including address lines, city, state, zip code, county, country, latitude/longitude coordinates, and validation status (USPS-verified, unverified, invalid). Tracks is_primary flag, is_verified flag, verification date, opt-in status per communication channel (SMS, email, push notification), unsubscribe timestamp, is_default flag, and effective date range. Supports omnichannel communication preferences, CAN-SPAM/TCPA compliance, last-mile delivery routing, store assignment, and geographic segmentation.

attributes.name: contact_info_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contact information record in the Grocery customer domain. Serves as the primary key for the contact_info data product.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.shopper. Business justification: Contact_info stores shopper addresses; linking to shopper normalizes address data and removes redundant address columns from shopper.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Grocery store location most closely associated with this address record, derived from geographic proximity analysis. Used for store assignment, click-and-collect (pickup) routing, and localized promotional targeting (ad circular distribution).
attributes.references: SAP Retail — Store Master; Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Location

attributes.name: address_residential_indicator
attributes.description: USPS-derived classification indicating whether the address is a residential or commercial location. Impacts last-mile delivery (LMD) carrier surcharge calculations, delivery time window eligibility, and cold chain logistics planning.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; USPS Residential Delivery Indicator (RDI)

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose of the physical or mailing address captured in this record (e.g., home, billing, delivery, pickup, mailing). Null when the record represents a non-address contact type such as email or phone.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; SAP Retail SD — Partner Function Address

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. 'active' indicates the contact is valid and in use; 'bounced' indicates email hard-bounce or phone disconnection; 'suppressed' indicates the contact is on a suppression list for compliance reasons; 'pending_verification' indicates awaiting confirmation.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Contact Point Status

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the contact channel captured in this record (e.g., email, mobile phone, home phone, work phone, fax). Drives channel-specific communication routing and CAN-SPAM/TCPA compliance enforcement.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Contact Point Type

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact detail for non-address contact types: email address, mobile phone number, home phone number, work phone number, or fax number. Null when the record represents a physical address. Contains PII and must be handled per GDPR/CCPA requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name associated with the address. Used for local tax jurisdiction mapping, regulatory reporting, and geographic segmentation analytics.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; FIPS 6-4 — County Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this contact record was first created in the Grocery customer data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR/CCPA data subject request processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; ISO 8601

attributes.name: delivery_zone_code
attributes.description: Internal delivery zone identifier assigned to this address based on geographic proximity to fulfillment centers, micro-fulfillment centers (MFC), or store locations. Used by the Order Management System (OMS) and last-mile delivery (LMD) routing to determine delivery eligibility, time windows, and carrier assignment.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management — Zone Configuration; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Delivery Zone

attributes.name: dnc_registry_checked_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Do Not Call (DNC) Registry Checked Date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this phone contact record was checked against the FTC National Do Not Call (DNC) Registry. Required for TCPA compliance; phone numbers must be scrubbed against the DNC registry at least every 31 days before telemarketing calls.
attributes.references: FTC National Do Not Call Registry; TCPA 47 CFR Part 64.1200

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether all outbound communications to this contact record are suppressed regardless of opt-in status. Set when an entity is on a national Do Not Call (DNC) registry, has filed a legal complaint, or has requested complete communication cessation. Overrides all opt-in flags.
attributes.references: FTC National Do Not Call Registry; TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 21 — Right to Object

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this contact record is no longer active or valid. Null for currently active records. Supports bi-temporal modeling, address history retention, and regulatory data retention requirements.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD — Validity Period; GDPR Article 5(1)(e) — Storage Limitation; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contact record is considered active and valid for use in communications and fulfillment operations. Supports bi-temporal modeling and historical contact data management.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD — Validity Period; ISO 8601 — Date Representation

attributes.name: entity_ref
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent entity (shopper, wholesale account, or pharmacy patient) to whom this contact record belongs. Supports multiple contact records per entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Contact Object; SAP Retail SD — Customer Master

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the type of entity this contact record belongs to, enabling the contact_info product to serve B2C shoppers, B2B wholesale accounts, and pharmacy patients (non-PHI) within the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Account Type; SAP Retail SD — Customer Account Group

attributes.name: is_default_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address record is the default address for the entity. Used by the Order Management System (OMS) and omnichannel fulfillment to pre-populate delivery and billing addresses at checkout.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Default Address; SAP Retail SD — Ship-To Party

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact record is the primary contact of its type for the entity. Only one record per entity per contact_type should have is_primary = true. Used to determine the default channel for outbound communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Primary Contact Point; SAP Retail SD — Standard Communication

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact value (email or phone) or address has been verified through an active confirmation process (e.g., email click-through, SMS OTP, USPS validation). Drives communication eligibility and fraud risk scoring.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; GDPR Article 7 — Consent Verification

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) derived from USPS address normalization and geocoding. Supports last-mile delivery (LMD) route optimization, store assignment, and geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: WGS84 — World Geodetic System; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) derived from USPS address normalization and geocoding. Supports last-mile delivery (LMD) route optimization, store assignment, and geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: WGS84 — World Geodetic System; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: opt_in_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive marketing email communications on this email contact record. Required for CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliance. Null or false for non-email contact types.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 6 — Lawful Basis for Processing; CASL

attributes.name: opt_in_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity has opted in to receive push notifications through the Grocery mobile application or digital commerce platform. Supports omnichannel personalization and promotional targeting via Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; Apple APNS / Google FCM Consent Guidelines

attributes.name: opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive SMS/text message communications on this mobile phone contact record. Required for TCPA compliance. Null or false for non-mobile-phone contact types.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CTIA Messaging Principles and Best Practices

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag indicating the entity's preferred language for communications delivered to this contact (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN). Supports multilingual marketing, ad circular distribution, and omnichannel personalization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Contact Language Preference

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this contact record originated (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud for digital registrations, NCR POS for in-store capture, SAP Retail for wholesale accounts, McKesson for pharmacy patients). Supports data lineage and master data management reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NCR POS; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: source_system_contact_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this contact record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Contact Point ID, SAP partner address number). Supports cross-system reconciliation and master data management (MDM) deduplication.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD — Partner Address; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Contact Point ID

attributes.name: unsubscribe_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the entity unsubscribed or withdrew consent for communications on this contact record. Null if the entity has not unsubscribed. Required for CAN-SPAM 10-business-day honor period and GDPR right-to-withdraw-consent tracking.
attributes.references: CAN-SPAM Act Section 5(a)(3); GDPR Article 7(3) — Right to Withdraw Consent; TCPA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this contact record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: usps_delivery_point_code
attributes.description: Two-digit USPS Delivery Point Code appended to the ZIP+4 to form the full 11-digit delivery point barcode. Confirms precise deliverability and supports carrier route optimization for last-mile delivery (LMD).
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; USPS Delivery Point Validation (DPV)

attributes.name: usps_validation_status
attributes.description: Result of USPS address normalization and validation process. 'verified' indicates the address was confirmed deliverable by USPS; 'unverified' indicates validation has not been performed or was inconclusive; 'invalid' indicates the address failed USPS validation and is not deliverable.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; USPS Address Matching System (AMS)

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the contact value or address was last successfully verified. Used to assess verification currency and trigger re-verification workflows when verification has lapsed.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: USPS ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the address record. Supports delivery zone routing, geographic segmentation, store assignment, and SNAP/WIC/EBT program eligibility determination.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 — Postal Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4

products.name: segment
products.description: Defines named market segments used to classify shoppers for targeted marketing, personalization, and assortment decisions. Captures segment name, segment code, segment type (behavioral, demographic, value-based, lifecycle, dietary preference), description, creation date, owner team, active flag, and applicable channel (digital, in-store, all). Examples include: High-CLTV Loyalists, SNAP/EBT Shoppers, Organic Enthusiasts, Pharmacy Patients, Fuel Rewards Members. Reference entity managed by the CRM and marketing analytics teams.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a customer segment record in the Grocery CRM and marketing analytics platform. Primary key for the customer_segment reference entity.

attributes.name: ad_circular_responsive
attributes.description: Indicates whether shoppers in this segment are known to respond to weekly promotional ad circulars (print or digital). Used to prioritize segment inclusion in weekly ad circular targeting and Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) campaigns.
attributes.references: Internal Promotions Management Policy; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: applicable_channel
attributes.description: The shopping channel(s) to which this segment applies for targeting and personalization. 'digital' applies to Salesforce Commerce Cloud eCommerce and app experiences; 'in_store' applies to NCR POS loyalty and in-store promotions; 'all' applies across omnichannel touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Omnichannel Framework; NCR POS Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or username of the individual who formally approved this segment for activation. Supports governance audit trails and accountability for marketing targeting decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this segment definition was formally approved by the owning team or governance committee for use in live marketing and personalization activities. Null if the segment has not yet been approved.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Governance Policy; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: avg_basket_size_band
attributes.description: Categorical band representing the typical transaction basket size (number of items or spend level) for shoppers in this segment. Used for assortment planning, endcap and gondola placement decisions, and targeted upsell promotions.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: campaign_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when a customer qualifies for multiple segments simultaneously. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by the CRM and Salesforce Commerce Cloud personalization engine to determine which segment's offer or experience takes precedence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Personalization Engine; Internal CRM Governance Policy

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: The Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) tier associated with this segment, used to prioritize marketing investment and personalization depth. Platinum represents the highest-value shoppers; unclassified indicates segments not defined by CLTV criteria.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Analytics Framework; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and governance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: digital_engagement_score_band
attributes.description: Categorical band representing the digital engagement level of shoppers in this segment, derived from app usage, click-and-collect frequency, and eCommerce activity on Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Used to tailor digital vs. in-store communication strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Analytics; Internal Digital Commerce KPI Framework

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this segment expires or is scheduled to be deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal or campaign-specific segments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this segment became or is scheduled to become active for use in campaigns, personalization, and targeting. Supports time-bounded segment activation aligned with promotional calendars.

attributes.name: external_segment_code
attributes.description: The identifier for this segment as known in the originating external system (e.g., Salesforce CRM segment ID, NCR loyalty group code). Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration mapping during ETL and API synchronization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; NCR POS Systems; Internal Integration Standard

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this segment are eligible for Fuel Rewards program benefits, including per-gallon discounts at Grocery fuel centers. Used to target fuel-related promotions and cross-sell fuel center offers.
attributes.references: Internal Fuel Center Operations Policy; NCR POS Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope at which this segment is defined and applied. National segments apply across all Grocery markets; regional segments apply to specific trade areas; local and store_cluster segments apply to specific store groups for hyper-local targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Store Operations Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: is_pharmacy_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment targets pharmacy patients or customers with pharmacy-related behaviors (e.g., prescription refill frequency, OTC purchase patterns). Pharmacy segments must be handled in compliance with HIPAA privacy requirements for non-PHI customer data.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: is_regulatory_program
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is associated with a government-regulated assistance program such as SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women, Infants, and Children), or EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer). Regulatory program segments require special handling for compliance and reporting.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Program Regulations; USDA WIC Program Regulations; FTC

attributes.name: is_suppression_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is used as a suppression list to exclude customers from specific campaigns or communications (e.g., opt-out customers, recently converted customers, do-not-contact lists). Suppression segments are applied as exclusion filters in campaign execution.
attributes.references: FTC CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 21; Internal Marketing Compliance Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, cache invalidation in personalization engines, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: loyalty_program_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is linked to the Grocery loyalty program for targeted rewards, personalized offers, and NCR POS loyalty integration. Loyalty-linked segments receive differentiated promotional treatment at checkout.
