attributes.description: Composite score (0.00 to 100.00) measuring the shopper's engagement with Grocery's digital channels including the eCommerce storefront, mobile app, and click-and-collect services. Derived from Salesforce Commerce Cloud interaction data. Higher scores indicate stronger omnichannel engagement.
attributes.references: Internal Analytics Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: fuel_spend_trailing_12m
attributes.description: Total shopper spend in USD at Grocery fuel center locations over the trailing 12-month period. Used to assess fuel center contribution to overall CLTV and cross-category engagement.
attributes.references: Internal Analytics Standard; EPA Fuel Center Regulations

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance for the shopper as of the computation date. Sourced from the NCR POS loyalty integration. Used as a retention signal in the CLTV model.
attributes.references: Internal Loyalty Program Standard; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier of the CLTV predictive model used to compute the current cltv_estimate and associated metrics (e.g., '2.4.1'). Enables model lineage tracking, A/B comparison, and auditability of scoring changes.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_computation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the next scheduled CLTV pipeline run is expected to refresh this profile. Used for pipeline scheduling and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from the shopper, on a scale of 0 to 10. Segmented into Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), and Detractors (0-6). Incorporated into CLTV model as a loyalty signal.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Standard; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: nps_segment
attributes.description: Categorical NPS segment derived from the shopper's NPS score: 'promoter' (score 9-10), 'passive' (score 7-8), 'detractor' (score 0-6), 'unknown' (no survey response). Used for CRM segmentation and loyalty program targeting.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Standard; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: pharmacy_spend_trailing_12m
attributes.description: Total shopper spend in USD at Grocery pharmacy locations over the trailing 12-month period. Non-PHI financial metric only; no prescription or health data included. Used to assess cross-category value contribution to CLTV.
attributes.references: Internal Analytics Standard; HIPAA Privacy Rule (non-PHI financial data only)

attributes.name: pickup_order_count
attributes.description: Number of completed curbside pickup or click-and-collect orders placed by the shopper over the trailing 12-month period. Indicates omnichannel pickup engagement and is a key input to digital CLTV segmentation.
attributes.references: Internal OMS Analytics Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: predicted_churn_probability
attributes.description: Model-generated probability (0.0000 to 1.0000) that the shopper will churn (cease purchasing) within the next 90 days. Produced alongside the CLTV estimate by the analytics pipeline. Used for proactive retention targeting in CRM.

attributes.name: predicted_next_purchase_date
attributes.description: Model-predicted calendar date of the shopper's next expected purchase transaction. Used for personalized re-engagement campaigns and replenishment reminder targeting.
attributes.references: Internal ML Model Governance Standard; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: prior_cltv_tier
attributes.description: The CLTV tier assigned to the shopper in the immediately preceding computation cycle. Enables tier migration tracking, loyalty program upgrade/downgrade communications, and trend analysis.

attributes.name: private_label_spend_pct
attributes.description: Proportion of the shopper's trailing 12-month spend attributable to Grocery's private-label brand products, expressed as a decimal (0.0000 to 1.0000). Higher values indicate stronger private-label affinity and margin contribution.
attributes.references: Internal Merchandise Analytics Standard; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CLTV profile record. 'active' indicates the profile is current and in use for CRM targeting; 'inactive' indicates the shopper is no longer active; 'pending' indicates awaiting first computation; 'suppressed' indicates excluded from targeting per opt-out or compliance rules.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: promo_redemption_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of targeted promotional offers (TPR, BOGO, ad circular) redeemed by the shopper over the trailing 12-month period, expressed as a decimal (0.0000 to 1.0000). Indicates price sensitivity and promotional responsiveness for CRM targeting.
attributes.references: Internal Promotions Analytics Standard; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: recency_score
attributes.description: Number of days elapsed since the shopper's most recent completed purchase transaction across any channel. Lower values indicate higher recency and engagement. Key RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) input to the CLTV model.

attributes.name: snap_ebt_spend_trailing_12m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Spend Trailing 12 Months
attributes.description: Total spend in USD processed via SNAP/EBT Electronic Benefits Transfer payment method by the shopper over the trailing 12-month period. Used for government program participation analytics and CLTV segmentation. Non-PII financial aggregate.
attributes.references: Internal Analytics Standard; USDA SNAP Program Regulations; FTC

attributes.name: targeting_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper is currently eligible for CRM-driven targeted marketing based on their CLTV profile. Set to false if the shopper has opted out of marketing communications, is suppressed, or is flagged for compliance exclusion.
attributes.references: Internal CRM Standard; FTC Advertising Practices; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: tier_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shopper's CLTV tier last changed. Null if the shopper has never changed tiers. Used to trigger loyalty communications and track tier stability.

attributes.name: trailing_12m_spend
attributes.description: Total shopper spend in USD across all channels (in-store POS, digital commerce, pharmacy) over the trailing 12-month window ending on the profile computation date. Key input to CLTV model.
attributes.references: Internal Analytics Standard; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the CLTV profile record was most recently updated in the silver layer lakehouse, typically aligned with each pipeline computation cycle. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: visit_frequency
attributes.description: Average number of shopping visits per calendar month for the shopper over the trailing 12-month period, across all channels including in-store, pickup, and delivery. Used to assess engagement and predict churn.

products.name: identity_resolution
products.description: Tracks identity resolution and deduplication events that link or merge duplicate shopper records across source systems (NCR POS, Salesforce CRM, eCommerce platform, pharmacy system, mobile app). Captures source system A and B identifiers, resolution method (deterministic exact match on email/phone/loyalty ID, probabilistic fuzzy match on name+address, manual merge by data steward), match confidence score, resolution timestamp, resolved-by user or system, resolution status (merged, linked, flagged-for-review, rejected), and surviving record ID. Supports the golden record maintenance process, MDM audit trail, and data quality KPI reporting. Critical for ensuring a single view of the customer across all Grocery touchpoints.

attributes.name: identity_resolution_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each identity resolution or deduplication event record in the Grocery customer Master Data Management (MDM) system.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the household to which the surviving golden record belongs after resolution. Populated when the resolution event results in a merge that affects household membership. Supports household-level analytics and targeted marketing.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; Salesforce CRM Household Model

attributes.name: prior_resolution_identity_resolution_id
attributes.description: Reference to a previous identity_resolution_id that this event supersedes, reverses, or is related to (e.g., an UNMERGE event references the original MERGE event). Enables resolution event chaining for complete MDM audit trail and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: surviving_shopper_id
attributes.description: The shopper identifier designated as the golden record after a merge resolution. Null for linked or flagged-for-review resolutions where no merge has occurred. Supports the single view of the customer across all Grocery touchpoints.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; Salesforce CRM Golden Record Policy

attributes.name: address_similarity_score
attributes.description: Numeric similarity score (0.0000–1.0000) measuring the degree of address match between Side A and Side B records. Used in probabilistic resolution methods alongside name_similarity_score to evaluate name+address composite signals.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; USPS Address Standardization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identity resolution event record was first written to the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp, distinct from resolution_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: crm_contact_id_a
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce CRM Contact ID - Side A
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM contact identifier for the Side A record, as sourced from Salesforce Commerce Cloud or CRM platform. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation and to support CRM deduplication workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Internal MDM Governance Standard

attributes.name: crm_contact_id_b
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce CRM Contact ID - Side B
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM contact identifier for the Side B record. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation and to support downstream CRM merge/deduplication operations in Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Internal MDM Governance Standard

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Categorical data quality assessment assigned to this resolution event. CLEAN = no data quality concerns; SUSPECT_DUPLICATE = additional duplicates may exist; CONFLICTING_SIGNALS = identity signals contradict each other; INCOMPLETE_PROFILE = one or both records lack sufficient attributes for high-confidence matching; SYNTHETIC = test or synthetic record detected.
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Framework; ISO/IEC 25012 Data Quality

attributes.name: email_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the email addresses on Side A and Side B records matched (exact or normalized) during the resolution evaluation. Supports granular analysis of which identity signals contributed to the match decision.

attributes.name: gdpr_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Processing Basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 under which the identity resolution processing activity is conducted. Required for compliance with privacy regulations applicable to Grocery's customer data processing. NOT_APPLICABLE for non-EU shoppers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; FTC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: loyalty_id_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program identifiers (Point of Sale (POS) loyalty IDs) on Side A and Side B records matched during the resolution evaluation. Loyalty ID is a high-confidence deterministic signal in grocery retail identity resolution.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; NCR POS Loyalty Integration

attributes.name: match_confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric probability score between 0.0000 and 1.0000 representing the algorithm's confidence that Side A and Side B records belong to the same individual. Scores above the configured threshold trigger automatic merge; scores in the review band are flagged for manual review. Critical for data quality KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Quality

attributes.name: match_rule_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the matching rule set or ML model that was applied during this resolution event (e.g., 'RULE_SET_v2.3', 'ML_MODEL_v1.0.5'). Enables retrospective analysis of resolution quality across rule engine versions and supports model governance.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Quality

attributes.name: match_signal
attributes.description: The primary data attribute(s) that triggered the match between Side A and Side B records. Indicates which identity signal (e.g., email, phone, loyalty ID, name+address combination) drove the resolution decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EMAIL|PHONE|LOYALTY_ID|NAME_ADDRESS|EMAIL_PHONE|NAME_DOB|DEVICE_ID|PAYMENT_TOKEN — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: match_threshold
attributes.description: The configured confidence score threshold that was in effect at the time of this resolution event. Records the threshold value used to classify the match as auto-merge, review, or reject, enabling retrospective audit of threshold policy changes.

attributes.name: name_similarity_score
attributes.description: Numeric similarity score (0.0000–1.0000) measuring the degree of name match between Side A and Side B records, computed using fuzzy string matching algorithms (e.g., Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein). Used in probabilistic resolution methods.

attributes.name: phone_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the phone numbers on Side A and Side B records matched (exact or normalized) during the resolution evaluation. Supports granular signal-level analysis of match quality.

attributes.name: pos_loyalty_id_a
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Loyalty ID - Side A
attributes.description: The NCR Point of Sale (POS) loyalty program identifier associated with the Side A record. A high-confidence deterministic identity signal in grocery retail. Preserved for audit trail and cross-system identity traceability.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Internal MDM Governance Standard

attributes.name: pos_loyalty_id_b
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Loyalty ID - Side B
attributes.description: The NCR Point of Sale (POS) loyalty program identifier associated with the Side B record. Paired with pos_loyalty_id_a to evaluate loyalty ID match signal during deterministic resolution.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Internal MDM Governance Standard

attributes.name: resolution_batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch deduplication run or scheduled job that generated this resolution event. Groups all resolution events produced in the same processing cycle for operational monitoring, reprocessing, and data quality KPI reporting.

attributes.name: resolution_channel
attributes.description: The processing channel through which the resolution event was initiated. BATCH = overnight bulk deduplication run; REAL_TIME = triggered at point of customer interaction; MANUAL_UI = data steward action via MDM console; API = triggered by external system call; SCHEDULED = periodic reconciliation job.

attributes.name: resolution_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which a REJECTED or FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW resolution decision should be re-evaluated. Supports periodic re-review of borderline cases as new identity signals become available. Null for permanent decisions (MERGED, LINKED).

attributes.name: resolution_method
attributes.description: The algorithmic or procedural approach used to determine that two records represent the same shopper. DETERMINISTIC = exact match on email, phone, or loyalty ID; PROBABILISTIC = fuzzy match on name and address; MANUAL_MERGE = data steward decision; RULE_BASED = configurable business rules; ML_MODEL = machine learning classifier.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Quality

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the identity resolution event. MERGED = records combined into a single golden record; LINKED = records associated but kept separate; FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW = queued for manual data steward review; REJECTED = determined to be distinct individuals; PENDING = awaiting processing or review.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the identity resolution event was executed. Represents the principal business event time for this record. Used for MDM audit trail, data quality KPI trending, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The category of action taken during this resolution event. MERGE = two records collapsed into one golden record; LINK = records associated without merging; UNMERGE = previously merged records separated; UNLINK = previously linked records disassociated; RECLASSIFY = resolution status changed without structural change.

attributes.name: resolved_by_user
attributes.description: The username, service account name, or system process identifier that executed the resolution action. For manual merges, this is the data steward's user ID. For automated resolutions, this is the system or batch process name (e.g., 'MDM_AUTO_MERGE_JOB'). Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: review_decision
attributes.description: The outcome decision made by the data steward during manual review of a flagged resolution event. APPROVED = steward confirmed the match and authorized the action; REJECTED = steward determined records are distinct; ESCALATED = referred to senior steward or governance committee; DEFERRED = decision postponed pending additional information.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the data steward during manual review, documenting the rationale for their decision. Supports audit trail completeness and institutional knowledge for recurring edge cases in identity resolution.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: review_queue_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the data steward review queue or work item to which this resolution event was assigned when flagged for manual review. Null for automated resolutions that did not require human intervention. Supports workflow management and SLA tracking for MDM operations.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the data steward completed their manual review and recorded a review_decision. Null for automated resolutions. Used to calculate review SLA compliance and MDM operational KPIs.

attributes.name: reviewer_user
attributes.description: The username of the data steward or MDM analyst who reviewed and adjudicated this resolution event when it was flagged for manual review. Null for fully automated resolutions. Distinct from resolved_by_user which captures the executor.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: shopper_id_a
attributes.description: Internal shopper identifier for the first (source) record participating in the identity resolution event. Represents one of the two candidate duplicate records being evaluated or merged.

attributes.name: shopper_id_b
attributes.description: Internal shopper identifier for the second (candidate duplicate) record participating in the identity resolution event. Paired with shopper_id_a to form the resolution pair.

attributes.name: source_system_a
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated the Side A shopper record. Identifies which platform (e.g., NCR Point of Sale (POS), Salesforce CRM, eCommerce, McKesson Pharmacy, mobile app, loyalty system) contributed the first identity.
attributes.references: Internal System of Record Registry; NCR POS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: source_system_b
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated the Side B shopper record. Identifies which platform contributed the second (candidate duplicate) identity for comparison against Side A.
attributes.references: Internal System of Record Registry; NCR POS; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: source_system_id_a
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source System Native Identifier - Side A
attributes.description: The native identifier of the Side A record as it exists in its originating source system (e.g., NCR POS loyalty ID, Salesforce CRM contact ID, eCommerce account ID). Preserved for audit trail and cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy)

attributes.name: source_system_id_b
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source System Native Identifier - Side B
attributes.description: The native identifier of the Side B record as it exists in its originating source system. Preserved for audit trail and cross-system traceability alongside source_system_id_a.
attributes.references: Internal MDM Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this identity resolution event record was most recently modified in the Databricks Silver Layer (e.g., when a review decision was recorded or a status was updated). Supports incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Authoritative single source of truth for all shopper consent decisions, privacy preferences, communication suppressions, and opt-out state. No other product in this domain stores consent or suppression data. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing with CPG partners, personalization, analytics, direct mail), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent and withdrawal dates, consent source (app, web, in-store kiosk, call center), consent version (legal text version), and device/IP context. Owns the suppression list for shoppers excluded from specific communication types due to opt-out requests, legal holds, deceased status, or fraud flags — including suppression type (global opt-out, email, SMS, direct mail, third-party sharing), suppression reason codes, effective/expiry dates, and triggering source system. Supports CCPA, CAN-SPAM, and TCPA compliance for all outbound marketing and data sharing activities.

products.name: interaction

attributes.description: Date and time when the case was formally closed after customer confirmation or automatic closure policy. Distinct from resolution_timestamp — a case may be resolved but not yet closed pending customer acknowledgment.

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Type of compensation or goodwill gesture issued to the customer as part of case resolution. Drives compensation cost reporting and policy compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; FTC Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code of the coupon or store credit voucher issued to the customer as case compensation. Used to track redemption and prevent duplicate issuance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: coupon_value
attributes.description: Face value of any coupon or promotional voucher issued to the customer as part of case resolution. Expressed in USD. Null if no coupon was issued. Supports promotions liability and compensation cost reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; SAP Retail SD

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this case record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Distinct from open_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data lineage and pipeline audit trails.

attributes.name: crm_case_code
attributes.description: Native case record identifier from Salesforce CRM Service Cloud (the system of record). Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the operational CRM platform.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-resolution customer satisfaction rating provided by the shopper via survey (typically 1–5 scale). Null if the customer did not respond to the satisfaction survey. Used for agent performance evaluation and NPS correlation analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the case was escalated to a supervisor, specialist team, or higher support tier. Null if the case was never escalated. Used for escalation rate and time-to-escalate analytics.

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the assigned agent first responded to the customer after case creation. Used to measure First Response Time (FRT) against SLA targets and customer experience KPIs.

attributes.name: is_food_safety
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case involves a food safety concern (e.g., foreign object in food, illness report, temperature abuse, HACCP violation). When true, triggers mandatory escalation and regulatory notification workflows per FDA FSMA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); HACCP; USDA

attributes.name: is_pharmacy_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case involves a pharmacy inquiry, prescription issue, or drug-related concern. When true, the case is subject to HIPAA non-PHI handling protocols and routed to the pharmacy support team. No PHI is stored in this record.
attributes.references: HIPAA; State Boards of Pharmacy; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer service case was officially opened and entered into the system. Used for SLA calculation, aging reports, and volume trend analysis.

attributes.name: open_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the case was created in Salesforce Service Cloud. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used for SLA elapsed-time calculations and intraday volume reporting.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the case, influencing SLA targets and agent assignment. Critical cases include product recall concerns, food safety incidents, and pharmacy-related issues requiring immediate attention.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the product involved in the case as reported by the customer or agent. Captured independently of the UPC to handle cases where the product cannot be precisely identified by barcode.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: product_upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) or Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) of the specific product involved in the case (e.g., for product quality complaints, recall concerns, or pricing disputes). Null if no specific product is implicated.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; FDA Food Labeling; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official FDA or USDA recall reference number associated with the case, if the case is linked to a product recall event. Null for non-recall cases. Critical for regulatory traceability and recall response reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA FSIS; HACCP

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the refund issued to the customer as compensation for the case. Expressed in USD. Zero or null if no monetary refund was issued. Used for financial reconciliation and compensation cost tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; SAP Retail FI; SOX

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this case has been reopened after a prior resolution or closure. A non-zero value indicates the initial resolution was unsatisfactory. Used for first-contact resolution (FCR) rate analysis and quality assurance.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative entered by the agent describing the actions taken to resolve the case, the outcome, and any follow-up commitments made to the customer. Used for quality assurance reviews and agent coaching.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the case was marked as resolved by the assigned agent or automated workflow. Used to calculate total resolution time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the underlying root cause identified during case resolution. Used for trend analysis, supplier accountability, and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_quality|delivery_failure|pricing_error|inventory_oos|staff_conduct|system_error|vendor_issue|cold_chain_failure|shrink_related|pharmacy_dispensing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; HACCP; FDA

attributes.name: sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case exceeded its SLA due timestamp without resolution. Set to true when resolution_timestamp is null at sla_due_timestamp or when resolution occurred after the SLA deadline. Used for SLA compliance reporting and agent performance management.

attributes.name: sla_due_timestamp
attributes.description: Target deadline by which the case must be resolved per the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA) policy. Calculated from open_timestamp plus the SLA target hours for the assigned case type and priority.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Service Cloud; FTC Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: snap_wic_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Women Infants and Children (WIC) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case involves a SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children), or EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) transaction dispute or eligibility inquiry. Supports government program compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Program; USDA WIC Program; FNS Regulations

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short, free-text summary or title of the case as entered by the customer or agent. Used for case list views, search, and initial triage in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this case record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture (CDC), and data freshness monitoring.

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable history of status changes for shopper and wholesale account records. Captures the entity reference, previous status, new status, change reason (voluntary closure, fraud suspension, inactivity, reactivation, merge), change timestamp, changed-by user or system, and supporting notes. Provides a full audit trail of account lifecycle events for compliance, fraud investigation, and customer service escalation workflows.
products.reference: Account Status History / Account Lifecycle Audit

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each status change event record in the shopper and wholesale account lifecycle audit trail. Primary key of this immutable history table.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: crm_case_id
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM case or service ticket identifier associated with this status change when the change was triggered by a customer service interaction. Supports end-to-end traceability from customer complaint to account action for NPS and escalation analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — CRM Case Management

attributes.name: primary_status_associate_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the human user (associate, customer service representative, or administrator) who initiated the status change. Null when the change was triggered by an automated system process. Used for accountability and audit trail in compliance investigations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; OSHA — Workplace Safety Records; PCI DSS Requirement 10

attributes.name: primary_status_shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper or wholesale account record whose status changed. Links this history event to the customer master record in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Customer Account Object

attributes.name: reversed_event_status_history_id
attributes.description: When reversal_flag is True, references the status_history_id of the original status change event that this record reverses or corrects. Null for non-reversal records. Maintains the immutable append-only audit trail while enabling error correction traceability.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status change required managerial or compliance approval before being applied. Supports segregation-of-duties controls for high-risk transitions such as fraud suspensions and regulatory holds.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; PCI DSS Requirement 7 — Access Control

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the status change was approved by the designated approver. Null when approval_required is False or when the change is pending approval. Used for SLA tracking on approval workflows.

attributes.name: change_channel
attributes.description: The interaction channel through which the status change was initiated. Supports omnichannel analytics and helps identify whether closures or suspensions originate from self-service digital channels, call center interactions, or automated back-office processes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Omnichannel Order Management

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the business reason that triggered the status change. Used for compliance reporting, fraud investigation workflows, and customer service escalation routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_closure|fraud_suspension|inactivity|reactivation|merge|duplicate_detected|deceased|regulatory_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection; HIPAA Privacy Rule (for pharmacy patient records)

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status change beyond the standardized reason code. Supports customer service escalation notes, fraud investigation documentation, and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the status change event occurred in the operational system. This is the authoritative business event time, distinct from the record audit timestamp. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 — Data Accuracy

attributes.name: changed_by_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system or automated process that triggered the status change when no human user is responsible. Examples include the fraud detection engine, batch inactivity sweep, CRM automation, or account merge process. Null when changed_by_user_id is populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|ncr_pos|sap_retail|oracle_rms|mckesson|manual|batch_inactivity|fraud_engine|merge_process — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 10 — Audit Logging; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this status history record was first written to the Databricks Silver layer. Distinct from change_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data pipeline audit, SLA monitoring, and Silver layer lineage tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; PCI DSS Requirement 10 — Log Management

attributes.name: data_privacy_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under which this status change event and associated personal data is processed and retained. Required for GDPR compliance documentation. Particularly relevant for closure and erasure events where the legal basis for continued data retention must be established.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the new status becomes operationally effective. May differ from change_timestamp when status changes are scheduled in advance (e.g., a reactivation scheduled for a future date or a closure effective at end of billing period).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Price Management Effective Dating

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Discriminator identifying the type of customer entity whose status changed. Distinguishes between B2C shoppers, B2B wholesale accounts, pharmacy patients (non-PHI), and government program participants such as SNAP and WIC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shopper|wholesale_account|pharmacy_patient|snap_participant|wic_participant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System — Customer Classification

attributes.name: fraud_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this status change to an active fraud investigation case when the change_reason_code is fraud_suspension or regulatory_hold. Enables cross-referencing with the fraud management system for investigation workflows and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection; PCI DSS Requirement 12 — Incident Response

attributes.name: initiated_by_customer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change was voluntarily initiated by the customer (True) or was applied by the business or an automated system without customer request (False). Critical for distinguishing voluntary closures from fraud suspensions or inactivity-driven deactivations in compliance and NPS analysis.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Protection; GDPR Article 7 — Consent

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status applied as a result of this change event. Captures the to-state in the status transition pair. Together with previous_status, defines the complete transition vector for lifecycle analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|suspended|pending|closed|merged|fraud_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Pricing Practices; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Supplementary free-text notes entered by the associate or system at the time of the status change. May include customer service context, escalation details, or operational observations not captured by the structured reason code. Not intended for PHI or PCI data.

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer-facing notification (email, SMS, or push) was dispatched to inform the shopper of the status change. Supports compliance with consumer notification requirements and customer service follow-up tracking.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Notification Requirements; GDPR Article 34 — Communication of Data Breach

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the customer notification was dispatched following the status change. Null when notification_sent is False. Used for SLA compliance tracking on customer communication obligations.
attributes.references: FTC — Consumer Notification Requirements; GDPR Article 34

attributes.name: pharmacy_patient_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change affects a shopper who is also registered as a pharmacy patient (non-PHI flag only). When True, triggers a notification to the McKesson pharmacy system to review active prescription refill schedules and patient communication preferences.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule — Minimum Necessary Standard; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: previous_loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) loyalty tier held by the shopper immediately before the status change. Captured at the time of the event to preserve the historical tier context for loyalty program compliance, reactivation offers, and NPS analysis.

attributes.name: previous_segment
attributes.description: The marketing or behavioral shopper segment assigned to the account immediately before the status change. Preserved as a point-in-time snapshot to support segmentation drift analysis, reactivation campaign targeting, and churn modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Personalization and Segmentation

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The account lifecycle status immediately before this change event was applied. Captures the from-state in the status transition pair for audit and investigation purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|suspended|pending|closed|merged|fraud_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC — Advertising and Pricing Practices; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reactivation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is eligible for reactivation outreach following a closure or suspension event. Set to False for fraud suspensions, deceased records, or regulatory holds. Used by CRM and marketing automation to filter win-back campaign audiences.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — CRM Campaign Management; FTC — Advertising Practices

attributes.name: reactivation_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the account is no longer eligible for reactivation, typically driven by data retention policies or regulatory requirements. Null for accounts with no reactivation expiry. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure scheduling and loyalty win-back campaign timing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this status history record may be purged or anonymized in accordance with the applicable data retention policy. Driven by regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, SOX) and the nature of the status change event. Null for records with indefinite retention requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) — Storage Limitation; SOX Section 802 — Record Retention

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a reversal or correction of a previously applied status change. When True, the reversed_event_id field identifies the original event being corrected. Supports immutable audit trail integrity while allowing error correction.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; SAP Retail — Reversal Document Management

attributes.name: snap_program_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change affects the shopper's Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) eligibility or enrollment. Triggers downstream notification workflows to program administrators when True.
attributes.references: USDA — SNAP Program Regulations; FNS (Food and Nutrition Service) Compliance

attributes.name: source_event_ref
attributes.description: The native event or transaction identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce case ID, SAP change document number). Enables exact-match reconciliation between the Silver layer audit trail and the source system's own change log.
attributes.references: SAP Retail — Change Document Management; Salesforce CRM — Audit Trail

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status change event. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver layer and upstream operational systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_crm|ncr_pos|sap_retail|oracle_rms|mckesson|workday_hcm|manual_entry — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Retail — SD Sales and Distribution; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: wic_program_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change affects the shopper's Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) program enrollment or benefit access. Triggers downstream notification workflows to WIC program administrators when True.
attributes.references: USDA — WIC Program Regulations; FNS Compliance

products.name: personalized_promotion_assignment
products.description: Links shoppers to promotional campaigns they are targeted by, capturing deal specifics such as discount, validity period, redemption metrics, and targeting rationale. Each record represents a single personalized deal between one shopper and one promo campaign.. Existence Justification: In Grocery, each shopper can be targeted by multiple promotional campaigns, and each campaign can be offered to many shoppers. The marketing team creates and manages personalized deal records that capture discount percentages, validity dates, redemption counts, and targeting rationale, making the relationship an operational entity that is actively created, updated, and deleted.

attributes.name: personalized_promotion_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Personalized Promotion Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the personalized_promotion_assignment association

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Promo Campaign Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the promotional campaign master record

attributes.name: promotion_redemption_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Promotion Redemption Id
attributes.description: Identifier for the redemption transaction linked to this deal

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the shopper master record

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Store Location Id
attributes.description: Store where the deal is applicable or was redeemed

attributes.name: deal_code
attributes.description: Internal code representing the personalized deal

attributes.name: deal_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the personalized deal

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the deal (e.g., active, expired, cancelled)

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deal (e.g., discount, bundle, loyalty‑exclusive)

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered in the personalized deal

attributes.name: generation_source
attributes.description: Source system or process that generated the deal (e.g., marketing engine, manual entry)

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Shopper loyalty tier applicable to the deal

attributes.name: ml_model_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Ml Model Id
attributes.description: Identifier of the machine‑learning model used to target the shopper

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times the shopper has redeemed this specific deal

attributes.name: targeting_rationale
attributes.description: Business reason for targeting the shopper with this deal

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Valid From Date
attributes.description: Start date when the personalized deal becomes active

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Personalized Promotion Assignment - Valid Until Date
attributes.description: End date when the personalized deal expires

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative catalog of all sellable items including CPG products, private-label brands, fresh produce, pharmacy drug items, and fuel grades. Manages SKU, UPC, GTIN, PLU codes, product hierarchies, categories, attributes, nutritional information, and regulatory compliance flags. Supports planogram design, category management, and FDA labeling requirements.
domains.references: GS1 GTIN Standards, FDA Food Labeling Requirements

products.name: order_header
products.description: Master record for every customer purchase across all channels (in-store POS, online, click-and-collect, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery, and pharmacy Rx fills). Captures order number, channel type, register/lane (for POS), cashier (for POS), transaction type (sale, return, void, no-sale for POS), order date/time, order status lifecycle (placed, confirmed, in-fulfillment, ready, dispatched, delivered, cancelled), customer reference, store reference, total amounts, subtotal, tax, tender summary, change due (for POS), basket item count, loyalty card scanned flag, loyalty points earned, promo codes applied, special instructions, self-checkout flag, EBT/SNAP/WIC tender flag, source system (NCR POS / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / McKesson), payment method summary, and OMS order reference. Single source of truth for ALL customer purchase identity in the retail-grocery enterprise — encompasses both POS transactions and OMS-originated orders in one canonical entity. No separate POS transaction entity exists; channel-specific attributes are captured via channel type discriminator and nullable POS-specific fields.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for every customer purchase record across all channels (POS, online, click-and-collect, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery, pharmacy Rx fills). Primary key of the order_header entity and the single canonical identity for all customer transactions in the enterprise.

attributes.name: cashier_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce associate (cashier) who processed the POS transaction. Applicable only for in_store_pos channel type. Used for cashier performance reporting, void/return authorization auditing, and labor analytics. Null for self-checkout, online, and OMS orders.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Kronos Workforce Central; Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost center assignment enables internal cost allocation and budgeting reports per order, a standard practice in grocery chains.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Links each order to its fiscal period, enabling period‑based financial statements and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_week_fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail fiscal calendar week in which this order was placed. Enables alignment of sales reporting to the 4-5-4 retail fiscal calendar used for comp sales (comparable store sales) and same-store sales analysis. Derived from order_date at ingestion.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI; NRF 4-5-4 Retail Fiscal Calendar; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue GL account needed for GAAP sales reporting; each order must post revenue to a specific GL account, obvious to finance analysts.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer household entity for household-level purchase analytics, loyalty program household linking, and targeted promotions. Enables household basket analysis and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) calculations at the household level. Null for anonymous transactions.
attributes.references: CRM; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Customer Loyalty Program

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Identifies the corporate legal entity owning the store for consolidation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: REQUIRED: Loyalty reporting needs to tie each order to the shopper's membership to calculate points earned, tier changes, and generate the 'Points Earned per Order' report.

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: Order‑level reference to the tokenized payment method allows reporting of payment method usage per order and supports refunds to the original method.

attributes.name: order_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_channel. Business justification: Orders belong to a channel; replace the free‑text channel_type with a foreign key to order_channel for referential integrity and channel‑level analytics.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Business process: Org‑unit performance reporting requires linking each order to the responsible org unit for labor and cost allocation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit center linkage supports profitability analysis by store/region; required for P&L statements per profit center.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Required for Marketing ROI report linking each order to its originating campaign; replaces denormalized promo_code.

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_patient. Business justification: Orders containing prescriptions must be associated with the patient to satisfy HIPAA, claim reconciliation, and loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer/shopper who placed or completed this order. Nullable for anonymous in-store POS transactions where no loyalty card was scanned and no account was identified.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Required for cluster‑level sales performance reporting; each order must be attributed to its store cluster for weekly KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store or fulfillment location where the order originated or was fulfilled. Links to the store master for store-level reporting, comp sales, and same-store sales analysis.

attributes.name: age_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order contains age-restricted items (alcohol, tobacco, lottery tickets, certain medications) requiring cashier or delivery driver age verification at point of sale or delivery. Triggers age-check workflow in NCR POS or last-mile delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations; State Alcohol Beverage Control Laws; NCR POS Systems

attributes.name: bag_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee charged for single-use plastic or paper bags per applicable state and local bag fee ordinances. Required for regulatory compliance reporting in jurisdictions with mandatory bag fee laws (e.g., California, Illinois). Zero in jurisdictions without bag fee requirements.
attributes.references: State and Local Bag Fee Regulations; EPA Environmental Compliance; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: basket_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (SKUs) in the order basket. Used for basket size analytics, express lane eligibility (e.g., 15 items or fewer), and customer segmentation. Distinct from total unit quantity which counts individual units across all line items.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; Oracle Retail Merchandising

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the order was cancelled. Populated only when order_status = 'cancelled'. Used for cancellation root-cause analysis, OOS (Out of Stock) reporting, and fraud detection. Values: customer_request, out_of_stock, payment_failure, fraud_hold, store_closure, system_error.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; NCR POS Systems; Oracle Retail Replenishment

attributes.name: change_due_amount
attributes.description: Amount of cash change to be returned to the customer when cash tender exceeds the order total. Applicable only for in-store POS and self-checkout cash transactions. Null for non-cash or digital orders. Sourced from NCR POS cash management module.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order_header record was first written to the Silver layer data lakehouse. Distinct from order_timestamp (business event time) — this is the data capture audit timestamp used for data lineage, pipeline monitoring, and late-arriving data detection.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Defaults to USD for domestic US grocery operations. Required for multi-currency support in international or border-region store operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for last-mile delivery service. Applicable for online_delivery channel orders. May be zero for fee-waived orders (e.g., loyalty member benefit, promotional free delivery). Null for in-store POS, click-and-collect, and curbside pickup orders.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud; JDA Transportation Management; LMD Operations

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all discounts applied to the order, including promotional discounts (TPR — Temporary Price Reduction), loyalty discounts, coupon redemptions, and BOGO (Buy One Get One) savings. Stored as a positive value representing the reduction from subtotal.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD; Oracle Retail Price Management; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: ebt_snap_wic_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether any government assistance program tender (EBT — Electronic Benefits Transfer, SNAP — Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or WIC — Women Infants and Children) was used in this transaction. Required for USDA SNAP/WIC program compliance reporting and retailer authorization audits.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Program Requirements; USDA WIC Program Requirements; FNS Retailer Compliance

attributes.name: fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which the order is to be fulfilled — delivered to the customer, made available for pickup, or dispensed (for pharmacy Rx). Used for delivery slot management, SLA tracking, and fulfillment capacity planning. Null for immediate in-store POS transactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; JDA Transportation Management; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: fulfillment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the order was actually fulfilled — delivered, picked up by the customer, or dispensed. Used for on-time delivery rate (OTD) measurement, last-mile delivery (LMD) SLA compliance, and customer experience analytics. Null until fulfillment is confirmed.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; JDA Transportation Management; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: loyalty_card_scanned
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer loyalty card or loyalty account was identified and scanned/linked at the time of the transaction. True enables loyalty points accrual and personalized offer redemption. False indicates an anonymous transaction with no loyalty attribution.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud Loyalty Integration; CRM

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty reward points earned by the customer on this transaction based on the applicable loyalty program earning rules. Zero for anonymous transactions (loyalty_card_scanned = false) or transactions where no points were awarded (e.g., fuel-only purchases).
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems Loyalty Integration; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; CRM Loyalty Program Rules

attributes.name: oms_order_reference
attributes.description: External order reference number assigned by the OMS (Order Management System — Salesforce Commerce Cloud) for omnichannel orders. Enables cross-system order tracing between the Silver layer canonical model and the OMS source system. Null for pure in-store POS transactions not routed through OMS.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the order was placed or the POS transaction was initiated. Used for daily sales reporting, comp sales (comparable store sales), same-store sales analysis, and fiscal period alignment.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI; NCR POS Systems; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable order reference number presented to the customer on receipts, confirmation emails, and order tracking pages. Generated by the source system (NCR POS transaction number, Salesforce Commerce Cloud order number, or McKesson Rx order number). Unique within the source system.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the order. Tracks the order from initial placement through fulfillment to completion or cancellation. POS transactions typically transition directly to a terminal state (completed or voided). OMS-originated orders traverse the full lifecycle. Values: placed, confirmed, in_fulfillment, ready, dispatched, delivered, cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: placed|confirmed|in_fulfillment|ready|dispatched|delivered|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; NCR POS Systems; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the order was placed or the POS transaction was opened. The principal real-world business event timestamp. Used for intraday sales analytics, peak-hour staffing analysis, and order SLA measurement. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; SAP Retail SD

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument used to tender the order. For split-tender transactions, reflects the dominant or first payment method. Full tender breakdown is captured in the order_payment child entity. Values include EBT/SNAP for government assistance program transactions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|cash|ebt_snap|ebt_cash|gift_card|loyalty_points|mobile_pay|check — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; PCI DSS; USDA SNAP Program Requirements

attributes.name: pharmacy_rx_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order contains one or more pharmacy prescription (Rx) line items. When true, the order is subject to HIPAA privacy requirements, DEA controlled substance regulations, and State Board of Pharmacy dispensing rules. Drives downstream routing to McKesson Pharmacy Systems.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule; DEA Controlled Substances Act; State Boards of Pharmacy; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: POS register or checkout lane identifier within the store where the transaction was processed. Applicable only for in_store_pos and self_checkout channel types. Used for lane-level performance reporting, cashier assignment, and cash reconciliation. Null for OMS-originated orders.

attributes.name: self_checkout
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transaction was processed through a self-checkout (SCO) lane where the customer scanned and bagged their own items without cashier assistance. Used for self-checkout adoption analytics, shrink attribution, and labor efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this order record. Drives data lineage, reconciliation, and system-specific business rule application. Values: ncr_pos (in-store and self-checkout POS transactions), salesforce_commerce_cloud (online, delivery, click-and-collect, curbside orders), mckesson_pharmacy (pharmacy Rx fill orders).
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud; McKesson Pharmacy Systems; SOX Data Lineage

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing customer-provided delivery, pickup, or preparation instructions (e.g., 'Leave at front door', 'No substitutions', 'Call upon arrival'). Applicable for online delivery, click-and-collect, and curbside pickup orders. Null for in-store POS transactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; Last-Mile Delivery Operations

attributes.name: substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Customer preference indicating whether out-of-stock (OOS) items in the order may be substituted with comparable alternatives by the picker or fulfillment associate. Applicable for online delivery, click-and-collect, and curbside pickup orders. Null for in-store POS transactions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS; Oracle Retail Replenishment; OOS Management

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item extended prices before tax, discounts, and fees are applied. Represents the gross merchandise value (GMV) of the basket prior to adjustments. Used in COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax charged on the order, calculated based on applicable state and local tax rates for taxable items in the basket. Excludes tax-exempt items (e.g., qualifying grocery staples, SNAP/EBT-eligible items). Required for tax remittance reporting and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI; SOX Financial Reporting; State and Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tender_summary
attributes.description: Human-readable summary of payment tender types used in this transaction (e.g., 'Credit $45.20, Loyalty Points $5.00'). Provides a quick overview of how the order was paid without exposing sensitive payment details. Sourced from NCR POS tender records or Salesforce Commerce Cloud payment summary.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount due from the customer after applying subtotal, discounts, fees, and tax. Equals subtotal_amount minus discount_amount plus tax_amount plus any applicable fees (delivery, service). This is the amount tendered by the customer. Core metric for revenue reporting and EBITDA calculations.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI; SOX Financial Reporting; PCI DSS

attributes.name: total_unit_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (items) purchased across all line items in the order. Differs from basket_item_count which counts distinct SKUs. Used for average units per transaction (UPT) analytics and shrink analysis.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Oracle Retail Merchandising

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the POS or OMS transaction by its business purpose. Primarily relevant for in-store POS and self-checkout channels. Values: sale (standard purchase), return (merchandise returned for refund), void (transaction cancelled before tender completion), no_sale (cash drawer opened without a sale), exchange (item swap without net monetary change).
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; SAP Retail SD

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order_header record was last modified in the Silver layer. Tracks order status changes, payment updates, and post-transaction adjustments. Used for incremental data processing and change data capture (CDC) pipelines.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit

products.name: product_order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a customer order representing a single SKU/UPC purchased or requested across all channels (in-store POS scan, online cart, click-and-collect). Captures line sequence number, SKU/GTIN, PLU (for produce), UPC (for POS-scanned items), item description, ordered quantity, unit of measure, unit price, extended price, discount amount, promo applied flag, substitution flag, substitution SKU, line status (active, substituted, cancelled, out-of-stock, voided, returned), weight (for variable-weight/scale items), tax code, department code, tax amount, fulfillment method per line, void flag, return flag, TPR flag, BOGO flag, coupon applied reference, and scan method (handheld, belt scanner, self-checkout, manual key). Supports both fixed-weight CPG items and variable-weight fresh/deli items. Enables basket analytics, shrink analysis, and category performance reporting at the item level across all channels.
products.reference: OMS Order Line / SAP SD Sales Order Item

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order line item. Primary key for the order line product.

attributes.name: age_restricted_sale_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.age_restricted_sale. Business justification: Required for Age‑Restricted Sale compliance report linking each sold line to its verification record; auditors need to trace every age‑restricted SKU to the age_restricted_sale entry.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: Needed for planogram compliance analysis; linking each sold line to the specific assortment item enables tracking of plan execution vs actual sales.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_plan. Business justification: Supports assortment‑plan performance metrics; associating order lines with the originating assortment plan allows calculation of plan fulfillment rates.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.brand. Business justification: Enables brand performance analytics and promotional budgeting by linking each order line to its brand master.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.department. Business justification: Order line should be linked to the department responsible for the sold item to enable departmental sales reporting.

attributes.name: drug_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.drug_item. Business justification: Necessary for pharmacy order compliance, controlled‑substance tracking, and drug‑specific reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_fuel_grade. Business justification: Tracks fuel grade sales and satisfies regulatory reporting for fuel products sold at the pump.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Supports hierarchical assortment planning and category‑level sales reporting via the item hierarchy reference.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header that contains this line item. Links the line to its transaction header.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Order Line Po Line Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line. Business justification: Required for traceability report linking sold items to supplier purchase order lines for recall compliance.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescription. Business justification: Line‑level tracking of prescription items enables accurate inventory deduction, claim submission, and return processing in pharmacy operations.

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_change. Business justification: Price‑change impact analysis tracks which price_change event affected a line, supporting margin and revenue impact reporting.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Order Line Promo Offer Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: When a coupon or promo code is applied, the order line should reference the specific promo offer for audit and effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: Price audit report requires linking each order line to the exact retail_price record applied, enabling compliance checks of sold price versus current price.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for SKU‑level sales reporting and inventory allocation; order lines must reference the SKU master record.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Required for supplier performance reporting per line item; enables cost allocation and on‑time delivery metrics that retailers track for each SKU's supplier.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item requires age verification at point of sale. Includes alcohol, tobacco, and certain over-the-counter medications.
attributes.references: State Alcohol and Tobacco Control Regulations

attributes.name: bogo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was part of a Buy One Get One promotion. Used for basket analysis and promotional effectiveness reporting.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Manufacturer or store coupon code applied to this line item. Links to coupon campaign for redemption tracking and vendor chargeback.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system. Represents when the item was added to the cart or scanned at POS.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item from promotions, coupons, loyalty rewards, or temporary price reductions (TPR). Reduces the extended price.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for the line item calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, before discounts and taxes. Gross line amount.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which this specific line item will be fulfilled. Supports mixed-cart scenarios where different items in the same order have different fulfillment methods.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for international product identification. Encompasses UPC, EAN, and other GS1 identifiers.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product as it appears on the receipt and in order details. Includes brand, size, and variant information.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent order. Used for ordering and display purposes.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the order line item. Tracks the line through fulfillment stages from active order to final disposition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|substituted|cancelled|out_of_stock|voided|returned|picked|packed|delivered — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the customer for purchasing this line item. Used for customer lifetime value (CLTV) calculation and loyalty program analytics.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was last modified. Tracks updates to quantity, price, status, or other line attributes.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount for the line item after discounts and including taxes. This is the amount the customer pays for this line.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is certified organic by USDA or equivalent certification body. Used for organic category reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: Original SKU that was requested by the customer before substitution occurred. Null if no substitution was made.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
