attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a perishable product requiring cold chain management and FIFO inventory rotation. Includes fresh produce, meat, dairy, deli, bakery, and frozen items.

attributes.name: plu
attributes.description: Price Look-Up code used for fresh produce, deli, and bakery items that are not pre-packaged with barcodes. Typically 4-5 digit codes entered manually or via scale.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a store-owned private label brand product. Used for private label performance analysis and margin reporting.

attributes.name: promo_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotional discount was applied to this line item. True if any promotion, coupon, or loyalty discount was used.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Quantity of the item ordered by the customer. Supports fractional quantities for variable-weight items such as produce, meat, and deli products.

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item represents a product return. Used for return rate analysis and inventory restocking.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the item was returned. Examples include defective, expired, customer dissatisfaction, or wrong item delivered.

attributes.name: scan_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture the item at point of sale or during order picking. Indicates whether the item was scanned via handheld device, belt scanner, self-checkout, manually keyed, or captured via mobile app.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using SNAP Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT). Required for government program compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a substitution for an originally requested item that was out of stock or unavailable. Common in online and click-and-collect orders.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Sales tax amount calculated for this line item based on applicable tax jurisdiction and product tax code. Includes state, county, and municipal taxes.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code for the item determining applicable sales tax rates. Differentiates taxable, non-taxable, and reduced-rate items such as groceries, prepared foods, and SNAP-eligible products.

attributes.name: tpr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was sold at a temporary price reduction. Used for promotional markdown analysis and ad circular tracking.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity ordered. Indicates whether the item is sold by each, weight, volume, or pack. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|kg|oz|g|case|pack|dozen|gallon|liter|ml — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure before any discounts or promotions are applied. Base selling price for the item.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code scanned at Point of Sale (POS). Standard barcode identifier for CPG items.

attributes.name: void_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided during the transaction. Used for shrink analysis and cashier performance monitoring.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the line item was voided. Examples include customer changed mind, pricing error, damaged item, or cashier error.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight of the item for variable-weight products such as fresh produce, meat, deli, and seafood. Captured from scale at POS or during fulfillment picking.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual weight field. Typically pounds or kilograms depending on regional standards.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for government program compliance and reporting.

products.name: order_status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of every status transition for an order header throughout its lifecycle. Records the previous status, new status, transition timestamp, triggering system (OMS, TMS, WMS, POS), triggering event (customer action, store action, driver scan, system timeout), and operator/system actor. Enables SLA tracking, exception investigation, and omnichannel fulfillment performance reporting. Critical for customer service resolution and carrier dispute management.

attributes.name: order_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each status transition record in the order lifecycle. Primary key for the immutable audit trail.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the person or system account that triggered the status transition. May be an employee ID, customer ID, system service account, or driver ID depending on actor_type.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery carrier or logistics provider involved in this status transition. Applicable for delivery-related status changes (out_for_delivery, delivered). Null for non-delivery transitions.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header that experienced this status transition. Links this status event to the parent order entity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location (store, distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, pharmacy) where the status transition occurred. Null for system-automated transitions without physical location context.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: The application session or transaction identifier during which this status transition was recorded. Used for technical troubleshooting and audit trail correlation.

attributes.name: actor_type
attributes.description: The category of actor (person or system) that triggered the status transition. Examples: customer, store_associate, warehouse_picker, delivery_driver, system_automation, customer_service_rep, pharmacy_technician. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer|store_associate|warehouse_picker|delivery_driver|system_automation|customer_service_rep|pharmacy_technician — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this status history record was created in the data platform. Distinct from transition_timestamp, which represents the business event time. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the device (mobile scanner, POS terminal, handheld picker device) used to record this status transition. Used for device audit trails and operational troubleshooting.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes the order spent in the previous status before this transition. Calculated as the difference between this transition_timestamp and the prior transition_timestamp. Used for cycle time analysis and bottleneck identification.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The estimated date and time when the order is expected to reach final completion (delivered or ready for pickup), calculated at the time of this status transition. Updated with each transition to reflect current estimates.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying any exception or issue that occurred during this status transition. Examples: OUT_OF_STOCK, PAYMENT_DECLINED, ADDRESS_INVALID, WEATHER_DELAY, CUSTOMER_NOT_HOME. Null for normal transitions.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the exception or issue. Used for customer service investigation and root cause analysis. Null for normal transitions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The omnichannel fulfillment method for this order. Examples: in_store (traditional POS), curbside_pickup (click-and-collect), home_delivery (last-mile delivery), ship_to_home (parcel shipment), pharmacy_pickup, locker_pickup.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate where the status transition occurred, captured from mobile device or delivery scanner. Used for delivery verification and route optimization analysis. Null if geolocation not captured.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate where the status transition occurred, captured from mobile device or delivery scanner. Used for delivery verification and route optimization analysis. Null if geolocation not captured.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The status the order transitioned to. Captures the to-state in the status change event. This is the current status after the transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|allocated|picking|picked|packed|ready_for_pickup|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|refunded — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the actor at the time of status transition. Used for operational context, special instructions, or issue documentation. Null if no notes provided.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of this status transition. Examples: email, sms, push (mobile push notification), none (no notification sent).

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification (email, SMS, push notification) was sent for this status transition. True if notification was triggered, False otherwise.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status the order was in immediately before this transition. Captures the from-state in the status change event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|allocated|picking|picked|packed|ready_for_pickup|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|refunded — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status transition occurred within the SLA target window. True if transition_timestamp <= sla_target_timestamp, False otherwise. Critical for performance reporting and customer service.

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this status transition was expected to occur, based on the order's service level agreement. Used for SLA compliance tracking and exception reporting.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The unique transaction or event identifier from the source system (OMS, TMS, WMS, POS) that generated this status transition. Used for cross-system reconciliation and technical troubleshooting.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number or shipment identifier associated with this status transition. Used for carrier dispute management and delivery verification. Null for non-delivery transitions.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the status transition occurred. This is the business event timestamp for the status change, distinct from record creation time.

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: The specific business event or action that caused this status transition. Examples: customer_placed_order, payment_authorized, inventory_allocated, pick_started, pick_completed, pack_completed, customer_arrived (for pickup), driver_dispatched, driver_scanned, delivery_confirmed, customer_cancelled, system_timeout, exception_raised, refund_processed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_placed_order|payment_authorized|inventory_allocated|pick_started|pick_completed|pack_completed|customer_arrived|driver_dispatched|driver_scanned|delivery_confirmed|customer_cancelled|system_timeout|exception_raised|refund_processed — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: triggering_system
attributes.description: The source system that initiated or recorded this status transition. Examples: OMS (Order Management System), TMS (Transportation Management System), WMS (Warehouse Management System), POS (Point of Sale), ECOM (eCommerce platform), MOBILE (mobile app), PHARMACY (pharmacy system), MANUAL (manual override). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OMS|TMS|WMS|POS|ECOM|MOBILE|PHARMACY|MANUAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The system process or ETL job identifier that created this record in the data platform. Used for data lineage tracking and operational support.

products.name: delivery_order
products.description: Last-mile delivery order record managing the logistics leg of an online or OMS-originated order dispatched to a customer address. Captures delivery order number, linked order header, delivery address, scheduled delivery window (start/end), actual delivery timestamp, delivery status (scheduled, assigned, en-route, delivered, failed, returned), driver/carrier reference, vehicle reference, delivery zone, distance miles, delivery fee, tip amount, contactless delivery flag, delivery instructions, proof-of-delivery method (photo/signature/PIN), and TMS route reference. Integrates with JDA TMS.

attributes.name: delivery_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery order record. Primary key for the delivery order entity representing the last-mile logistics leg of an online or OMS-originated order.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver or delivery associate assigned to fulfill this delivery order. Links to workforce or driver master data.

attributes.name: contact_info_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_info. Business justification: Required for Delivery Address Verification report; each delivery order must reference a validated contact_info record for carrier compliance.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TMS route plan that includes this delivery. Links to JDA Transportation Management System route optimization.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header that originated this delivery. Links the delivery leg back to the original customer order.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the delivery was completed and goods were handed off to the customer or left at the delivery location. Null if delivery not yet completed.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the carrier or delivery service provider responsible for this delivery. May represent internal fleet or third-party carrier.

attributes.name: contactless_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested contactless delivery. When true, driver should leave items at the door and minimize direct contact.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery order record was first created in the system. Represents the moment the delivery leg was initiated from the order management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this delivery order record.

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount
attributes.description: The delivery service charge amount billed to the customer for this delivery. May be zero for free delivery promotions or loyalty members.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the driver at delivery time. May include delivery condition observations, customer interactions, or exception details.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the delivery order, used for tracking and customer communication. Typically formatted as DO- prefix followed by 10-digit sequence.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery order. Tracks progression from scheduling through final delivery or failure. Values: scheduled (delivery window assigned), assigned (driver allocated), en_route (in transit), out_for_delivery (final leg), delivered (completed successfully), failed (delivery attempt unsuccessful), returned (sent back to origin), cancelled (order cancelled before delivery). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|assigned|en_route|out_for_delivery|delivered|failed|returned|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_type
attributes.description: Classification of delivery service level. Defines the speed and method of delivery fulfillment.

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Total distance in miles from the fulfillment origin (store, MFC, or DC) to the delivery destination. Used for delivery fee calculation and route analytics.

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why a delivery attempt failed. Populated only when delivery_status is failed or returned. Used for root cause analysis and redelivery planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_not_home|address_not_found|access_denied|weather|vehicle_issue|refused|damaged|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this delivery order record. Tracks the last status change, address correction, or driver assignment.

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method used to capture proof that the delivery was completed. Values: signature (customer signed on device), photo (driver captured delivery photo), pin (customer provided PIN code), none (no proof captured for contactless).

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the stored proof of delivery artifact (signature image, photo, or PIN verification record). Used for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: reattempt_count
attributes.description: Number of delivery attempts made for this order. Increments with each failed delivery attempt. Used to trigger customer contact or return-to-sender workflows.

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who received the delivery. May differ from the order customer if delivery was accepted by household member or designee.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the delivery is scheduled to occur. Used for day-level delivery planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: scheduled_window_end_time
attributes.description: The ending timestamp of the scheduled delivery window communicated to the customer. Defines the latest time within the promised delivery window.

attributes.name: scheduled_window_start_time
attributes.description: The beginning timestamp of the scheduled delivery window communicated to the customer. Defines the earliest time the customer should expect delivery.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this delivery order record. Typically OMS (Order Management System), TMS (Transportation Management System), or eCommerce platform.

attributes.name: stop_sequence_number
attributes.description: The position of this delivery within the drivers route sequence. Used for route optimization and estimated time of arrival calculation.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery requires cold chain temperature control for perishable or frozen items. When true, vehicle must have refrigeration capability.

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Gratuity amount provided by the customer for the delivery driver. May be pre-tip at order time or post-delivery adjustment.

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the vehicle used to fulfill this delivery. May be license plate, fleet number, or vehicle asset tag.

products.name: pickup_appointment
products.description: Curbside or in-store click-and-collect pickup appointment record. Captures appointment ID, linked order header, store ID, pickup bay/slot, scheduled pickup window (date, start time, end time), actual arrival timestamp, actual pickup completion timestamp, appointment status (scheduled, arrived, dispensed, no-show, cancelled), vehicle description, parking spot number, associate who dispensed, and customer notification timestamps (ready SMS, reminder). Manages curbside slot capacity and SLA compliance for click-and-collect fulfillment.

attributes.name: pickup_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pickup appointment record. Primary key for curbside and click-and-collect appointment tracking.

attributes.name: dispensing_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate who fulfilled and dispensed the pickup order. Used for performance tracking and quality accountability.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header associated with this pickup appointment. Links the appointment to the customer's order for fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who scheduled the pickup appointment. Links appointment to customer profile for notification and service history.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the pickup appointment is scheduled. Identifies the fulfillment location for curbside or in-store pickup.

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the pickup appointment. Used for customer communication and associate reference during fulfillment.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pickup appointment. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation. Critical for SLA (Service Level Agreement) monitoring and operational workflow management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|confirmed|ready|arrived|in_progress|dispensed|completed|no_show|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of pickup method. Distinguishes between curbside delivery to vehicle, in-store pickup counter collection, or automated locker retrieval.

attributes.name: arrival_notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the customer sent an I'm here notification via mobile app or SMS. Alerts store associates that customer has arrived.

attributes.name: cancellation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the cancellation circumstances. Provides additional context beyond the reason code for customer service and operational review.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for appointment cancellation. Used for root cause analysis and service improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the appointment was cancelled by customer or system. Used for slot release and cancellation rate analytics.

attributes.name: contact_phone_number
attributes.description: The phone number to reach the customer upon arrival or for appointment coordination. Used for real-time communication during pickup process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the pickup appointment record was first created in the system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customer_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual timestamp when the customer arrived at the pickup location. Captured via mobile app check-in or associate entry. Critical for SLA (Service Level Agreement) measurement.

attributes.name: customer_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text feedback provided by the customer about their pickup experience. Captures qualitative insights for service improvement.

attributes.name: customer_rating
attributes.description: The customer satisfaction rating provided after pickup completion, typically on a 1-5 scale. Used for service quality measurement and associate performance evaluation.

attributes.name: dispensing_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the order was fully dispensed to the customer and the transaction completed. Used for calculating total service time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: dispensing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the associate began loading items into the customer's vehicle or handed over the order. Marks the beginning of the dispensing process.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the pickup appointment record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes to appointment details or status.

attributes.name: order_ready_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the order was fully picked, staged, and ready for customer pickup. Triggers customer notification that order is available.

attributes.name: parking_spot_number
attributes.description: The specific parking spot identifier where the customer parks for curbside pickup. May differ from bay number in stores with multiple spot configurations.

attributes.name: pickup_bay_number
attributes.description: The designated curbside bay or parking spot number assigned to this appointment. Used for directing customers to the correct location and managing bay capacity.

attributes.name: ready_notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the order-ready notification (SMS, email, or app push) was sent to the customer. Used for communication audit trail.

attributes.name: reminder_notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when a reminder notification was sent to the customer about their upcoming appointment. Used for proactive customer engagement tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the pickup appointment is scheduled. Used for day-level capacity planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The ending timestamp of the scheduled pickup window. Defines the latest time within the appointment slot for customer arrival.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The beginning timestamp of the scheduled pickup window. Defines when the customer can arrive for their appointment.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the appointment met the SLA target. True if wait time was within target, false if exceeded. Used for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target in Minutes
attributes.description: The target service time in minutes for this appointment type. Used for measuring performance against service commitments.

attributes.name: slot_capacity_used
attributes.description: The capacity units consumed by this appointment within the time slot. Used for managing concurrent appointment limits and preventing overbooking.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided special instructions for the pickup (e.g., trunk placement, contactless delivery, accessibility needs). Guides associate fulfillment behavior.

attributes.name: substitution_preference
attributes.description: Customer preference for handling out-of-stock items. Determines whether substitutions are allowed and if customer approval is required.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The temperature control requirement for this order. Determines staging location and handling procedures to maintain cold chain integrity for perishables.

attributes.name: total_bag_count
attributes.description: The total number of bags or containers prepared for this pickup. Helps associates verify complete order transfer to customer.

attributes.name: total_item_count
attributes.description: The total number of items in the order for this pickup appointment. Used for workload estimation and associate staffing decisions.

attributes.name: vehicle_description
attributes.description: Description of the customer's vehicle including make, model, and color. Helps associates identify the correct vehicle during curbside fulfillment.

attributes.name: vehicle_license_plate
attributes.description: The license plate number of the customer's vehicle. Used for positive identification during curbside pickup. Business-confidential customer information.

attributes.name: wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: The calculated wait time in minutes from customer arrival to dispensing completion. Key performance indicator for curbside service quality and SLA compliance.

products.name: order_fulfillment
products.description: Fulfillment execution record linking an order header to its physical pick-pack-ship workflow in the store backroom, MFC, or DC. Captures fulfillment ID, linked order header, fulfillment location type (store/MFC/DC), fulfillment location ID, assigned picker ID, pick start timestamp, pick complete timestamp, pack complete timestamp, staging area/bay, fulfillment status (queued, picking, picked, packed, staged, dispatched), total lines, total lines picked, substitution count, OOS line count, and WMS task reference. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS.
products.reference: WMS Pick Order / OMS Fulfillment Record

attributes.name: order_fulfillment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment execution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: batch_wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch wave if this fulfillment was part of a multi-order picking wave. Used in WMS optimization for efficient picking routes.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific store, MFC, DC, or pharmacy location executing this fulfillment.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Needed for fulfillment audit to associate each order fulfillment with the inbound shipment that supplied the inventory.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header being fulfilled. Links this fulfillment execution to the customer order.

attributes.name: pick_cart_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical picking cart or tote used by the picker. Used for equipment tracking and multi-order batch picking workflows.

attributes.name: primary_order_associate_id
attributes.description: Workforce associate assigned to pick this order. References the associate performing the physical picking task.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.shift. Business justification: Regulatory and labor reporting tracks which shift performed fulfillment; linking fulfillment to shift enables shift‑level productivity and compliance analysis.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Required for Pickup Fulfillment Assignment report: links each fulfillment record to the store that performed the pickup, enabling SLA monitoring and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: actual_fulfillment_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in minutes from pick start to dispatch. Used to measure picker productivity and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description if the fulfillment was cancelled. Examples: customer_request, inventory_unavailable, system_error, weather_delay. Populated only when fulfillment_status = cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment record was created in the system, typically when the order was released to the fulfillment queue.

attributes.name: dispatched_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the order was handed to the customer (curbside/in-store pickup) or to the delivery carrier for last-mile delivery.

attributes.name: fulfillment_location_type
attributes.description: Type of facility executing the fulfillment. Store = retail store backroom, MFC = Micro-Fulfillment Center, DC = Distribution Center, Pharmacy = pharmacy dispensing area.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the customer will receive the order. Curbside Pickup = customer collects at designated parking spot, In-Store Pickup = customer collects at service desk, Home Delivery = last-mile delivery to customer address, Locker Pickup = customer retrieves from automated locker.

attributes.name: fulfillment_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for this fulfillment execution, used for tracking and communication with pickers and customers.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current state of the fulfillment workflow. Queued = awaiting assignment, Assigned = picker assigned but not started, Picking = actively picking items, Picked = all items picked, Packing = items being packed, Packed = packing complete, Staged = ready for customer pickup or delivery dispatch, Dispatched = handed to carrier or customer, Cancelled = fulfillment aborted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: queued|assigned|picking|picked|packing|packed|staged|dispatched|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: oos_line_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines that could not be fulfilled due to out-of-stock conditions and no acceptable substitution. Impacts customer satisfaction and fill rate metrics.

attributes.name: pack_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when packing was completed and order is ready for staging or dispatch.

attributes.name: pack_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when packing of picked items began. Used for labor tracking and process efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of packages or bags this fulfillment was packed into. Used for customer communication and carrier handoff verification.

attributes.name: pick_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all items were picked (or picking was completed with substitutions/OOS). Marks transition to packing stage.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the picker began picking items for this order. Used for labor productivity tracking and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: picker_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the picker during fulfillment, such as item condition observations, substitution reasons, or customer communication notes.

attributes.name: quality_check_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment underwent a quality inspection before staging. True = quality check performed, False = no quality check. Used for high-value orders or training purposes.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes from order placement to fulfillment completion, based on the order type and fulfillment method. Used for performance monitoring and customer promise tracking.

attributes.name: staged_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the packed order was placed in the staging area or pickup bay, ready for customer collection or carrier pickup.

attributes.name: staging_area
attributes.description: Physical staging location identifier within the fulfillment facility (e.g., bay number, zone, cooler section) where the packed order is held for pickup or dispatch.

attributes.name: substitution_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines where a substitute item was picked due to the original item being out of stock or unavailable.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Primary temperature control zone required for this fulfillment. Ambient = room temperature, Refrigerated = cold chain 0-4°C, Frozen = frozen storage below 0°C. Critical for fresh produce and perishable inventory management.

attributes.name: total_lines
attributes.description: Total number of order line items in the original order that this fulfillment is responsible for picking.

attributes.name: total_lines_picked
attributes.description: Number of order lines successfully picked (including substitutions). Used to calculate fill rate and picker productivity.

attributes.name: total_units_picked
attributes.description: Total quantity of units picked across all lines, including substitutions. Used for labor productivity measurement (units per hour).

attributes.name: total_volume_liters
attributes.description: Total volume of the packed order in liters. Used for vehicle capacity planning and staging area space management.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the picked and packed order in kilograms. Used for shipping cost calculation and load planning for delivery vehicles.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fulfillment record. Used for audit trail and data freshness tracking.

attributes.name: wms_task_reference
attributes.description: External task or wave identifier from Manhattan Associates WMS that orchestrated this fulfillment execution. Used for integration and audit trail.

products.name: order_discount
products.description: Discount and promotion application record for each discount applied to an order header or order line. Captures discount ID, linked order header, linked order line (nullable for header-level discounts), promotion reference, coupon code, discount type (TPR, BOGO, digital coupon, loyalty reward, ad circular, markdown, employee discount, EBT discount), discount amount, discount percentage, promo stack sequence (for stacked promotions), and applied timestamp. Enables promotion redemption tracking and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: order_discount_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order discount record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Discount expense must be posted to a specific GL account for accurate discount expense reporting.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header to which this discount is applied. Links to the parent order transaction.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier from the source system (POS transaction number, eCommerce order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: primary_order_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate or cashier who processed this discount at the point of sale. Nullable for automated or online discounts.

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item to which this discount is applied. Nullable for header-level discounts that apply to the entire order rather than a specific line.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotion campaign or offer that generated this discount. Links to the promotion master data.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where this discount was applied, if applicable. Nullable for online-only transactions.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier funding this discount, if applicable. Nullable for store-funded or loyalty-funded discounts.

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount was applied to the order during the transaction or order processing workflow.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount required manager or supervisor approval before being applied. True if approval was required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount was approved by a manager or supervisor. Nullable if no approval was required.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which this discount was applied. In-store for POS (Point of Sale) transactions, online for eCommerce, mobile app for app-based orders, curbside pickup for click-and-collect, delivery for last-mile delivery orders, pharmacy for prescription fills.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: The specific coupon or promo code entered or scanned by the customer to activate this discount. Nullable if discount was automatically applied.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary value of the discount applied to the order or line item, in the transaction currency. Represents the reduction in price.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate of discount applied, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off). Nullable if discount is a fixed amount rather than percentage-based.

attributes.name: discount_reason_code
attributes.description: Internal code indicating the business reason or authorization basis for the discount. Used for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: discount_scope
attributes.description: The level at which this discount is applied. Order header applies to entire order, order line applies to specific line item, category applies to product category, SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) applies to specific product, basket applies to qualifying basket combinations.

attributes.name: discount_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the discount. Applied indicates successfully applied, reversed indicates discount was removed or refunded, pending indicates awaiting validation, expired indicates promotion period ended, invalid indicates discount failed validation rules.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discount mechanism applied. TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), BOGO (Buy One Get One), digital coupon, loyalty reward, ad circular promotion, markdown clearance, employee discount, EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) discount, vendor-funded promotion, or store-funded promotion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tpr|bogo|digital_coupon|loyalty_reward|ad_circular|markdown|employee_discount|ebt_discount|vendor_funded|store_funded — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: The final price after this discount was applied. Represents the net amount charged to the customer for this discount application.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding or absorbing the cost of this discount. Vendor-funded promotions are reimbursed by suppliers, store-funded are absorbed by the retailer.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer to obtain this discount. Nullable if discount is not loyalty-based.

attributes.name: max_discount_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum discount amount permitted by the promotion rules or system configuration. Used to enforce discount caps and prevent over-discounting.

attributes.name: min_purchase_required
attributes.description: The minimum purchase amount required to qualify for this discount. Nullable if no minimum threshold applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The original price of the item or order total before this discount was applied. Used for calculating discount impact and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the point-of-sale terminal or register where this discount was processed. Nullable for digital commerce transactions.

attributes.name: promo_stack_sequence
attributes.description: The order in which this discount was applied when multiple promotions are stacked on the same order or line. Lower numbers indicate earlier application in the discount calculation sequence.

attributes.name: promotion_end_date
attributes.description: The effective end date of the promotion period after which this discount is no longer valid.

attributes.name: promotion_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the promotion period during which this discount is valid.

attributes.name: quantity_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of items required to qualify for this discount (e.g., buy 3 get 1 free). Nullable if discount is not quantity-based.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or code indicating why this discount was reversed or removed from the order. Nullable if discount was not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount was reversed or removed. Nullable if discount was not reversed.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount can be combined with SNAP benefits. True if eligible for SNAP transactions, false otherwise.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this discount record (e.g., NCR POS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle Retail). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount is applied before tax calculation (pre-tax), after tax calculation (post-tax), or if the discounted amount is tax-exempt.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WIC (Women Infants and Children) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount can be combined with WIC benefits. True if eligible for WIC transactions, false otherwise.

products.name: order_payment
products.description: Payment tender record for each payment instrument applied to a customer order. Captures payment ID, linked order header, tender type (credit, debit, EBT/SNAP, WIC, mobile wallet, gift card, fuel reward, cash, check), card type (Visa/MC/Amex), last four digits, authorization code, authorization timestamp, settlement status, payment amount, change given, EBT balance remaining (for EBT tenders), and payment processor reference. Supports PCI DSS compliance and SNAP/WIC regulatory reporting. References order_header as the single parent — no dual-FK pattern.
products.reference: NCR POS Tender / OMS Payment Record

attributes.name: order_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment tender record. Primary key.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Tracks which bank account received the payment for reconciliation and cash‑management reporting.

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: Needed for fraud analysis: associate each order payment with the stored tokenized payment method used, enabling compliance and recurring‑payment tracking.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent order header. Links this payment tender to the customer order it settles.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Required for audit: link each order payment record to its underlying payment transaction for settlement reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor or card issuer confirming approval of the transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment authorization was received from the payment processor. Represents the real-world event time of payment approval.

attributes.name: avs_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by the Address Verification Service (AVS) indicating the match result between billing address provided and address on file with card issuer. Used for fraud detection and risk management.

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number from the check. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Stored for reference while maintaining compliance with financial data protection standards.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit American Bankers Association (ABA) routing number from the check. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Used for electronic check verification and processing.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standards; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code associated with the billing address for the payment instrument. Used for Address Verification Service (AVS) fraud checks. Applicable to card-based tenders.

attributes.name: card_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card number. Used for customer reference and dispute resolution while maintaining Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance by not storing full card number.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Card network brand for credit and debit card tenders. Applicable only when tender_type is credit_card or debit_card.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment card. Used for fraud detection and dispute resolution. Applicable to credit and debit card tenders.

attributes.name: change_given_amount
attributes.description: Amount of change returned to the customer when payment_amount exceeds the order balance. Applicable primarily to cash tenders. Null for non-cash tenders or when exact payment is tendered.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number from the paper check tendered. Applicable only when tender_type is check. Used for reconciliation and fraud detection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Supports multi-currency transactions in international operations.

attributes.name: cvv_response_code
attributes.description: Response code indicating whether the Card Verification Value (CVV) provided matched the value on file with the card issuer. Used for fraud detection. Applicable to card-not-present transactions.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Code returned by the payment processor indicating why the payment was declined. Examples include insufficient_funds, invalid_card, expired_card, fraud_suspected. Applicable when settlement_status is declined.

attributes.name: ebt_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) card after this transaction. Applicable only when tender_type is ebt_snap. Supports customer service inquiries and Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of fuel reward points applied as discount. Applicable only when tender_type is fuel_reward.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of fuel reward loyalty points redeemed as payment toward this order. Applicable only when tender_type is fuel_reward. Supports fuel center operations and loyalty program reporting.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the gift card after this transaction. Applicable only when tender_type is gift_card. Supports customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: gift_card_number
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized gift card number. Applicable only when tender_type is gift_card. Stored in compliance with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) tokenization requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; Internal Gift Card Policy

attributes.name: mobile_wallet_type
attributes.description: Type of mobile wallet used for payment. Applicable only when tender_type is mobile_wallet.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount applied from this payment tender toward the order total. For split-tender transactions, this represents the portion paid by this specific instrument. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the payment was captured. Point of Sale (POS) for in-store register transactions; ecommerce for web storefront; mobile_app for native app checkout; kiosk for self-service terminals; phone for call center orders; curbside_terminal for pickup payment devices.

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the payment gateway or processor that handled this transaction. Examples include First Data, Worldpay, Stripe, or internal processor identifiers.

attributes.name: payment_processor_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the external payment processor or gateway. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: payment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this payment tender within the order. Supports split-tender transactions where multiple payment instruments are applied to a single order.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for refund when settlement_status is refunded. Examples include customer_request, damaged_goods, pricing_error, order_cancellation. Used for refund analytics and fraud detection.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed. Applicable only when settlement_status is refunded.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current state of the payment in the settlement lifecycle. Authorized indicates approval but funds not yet captured; captured indicates funds reserved; settled indicates funds transferred to merchant account; voided indicates authorization cancelled before capture; refunded indicates funds returned to customer; declined indicates payment rejected; pending indicates awaiting processor response. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authorized|captured|settled|voided|refunded|declined|pending — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Payment Processor Standards; Internal Finance Policy

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the order total that qualifies for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payment. Applicable when tender_type is ebt_snap. Required for SNAP regulatory reporting and compliance audits.
attributes.references: SNAP Retailer Regulations; 7 CFR 274; USDA FNS Guidelines

attributes.name: tender_type
attributes.description: Type of payment instrument used. Distinguishes between credit card, debit card, Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), Women Infants and Children (WIC) voucher, mobile wallet (Apple Pay, Google Pay), gift card, fuel reward points, cash, or check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ebt_snap|wic|mobile_wallet|gift_card|fuel_reward|cash|check — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SNAP Retailer Regulations; WIC Program Guidelines

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Gratuity amount added by the customer for delivery or service. Applicable primarily to delivery and curbside pickup orders. Null when no tip is provided.

attributes.name: tokenized_payment_instrument
attributes.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliant token representing the payment instrument. Used for recurring payments and stored payment methods without retaining sensitive card data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3.2; Payment Tokenization Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment tender record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Portion of the order total that qualifies for Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. Applicable when tender_type is wic. Required for WIC program reporting.
attributes.references: WIC Program Guidelines; State WIC Agency Regulations

attributes.name: wic_voucher_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Voucher Number
attributes.description: Unique voucher or authorization number for Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. Applicable only when tender_type is wic. Required for WIC program reconciliation and state reporting.
attributes.references: WIC Program Guidelines; State WIC Agency Regulations

products.name: order_refund
products.description: Refund and return transaction record for orders where items are returned or credits are issued. Captures refund ID, linked original order header, refund type (full/partial/line-level), refund reason code (damaged, wrong item, OOS, customer dissatisfaction, spoilage), refund amount, refund method (original tender, store credit, gift card), refund status (requested, approved, processed, denied), approving associate ID, and refund timestamp. Supports shrink tracking and customer satisfaction management. References order_header as the single parent.

attributes.name: order_refund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refund transaction record. Primary key for the order_refund product.

attributes.name: approving_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the workforce associate who authorized and approved the refund transaction. Required for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Refunds are expense entries that require a GL account for proper accounting and audit trails.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the original order header for which this refund was issued. Links the refund back to the parent order transaction.

attributes.name: order_transaction_payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: External payment processor transaction identifier for the refund payment. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: primary_order_payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: External payment processor transaction identifier from the original order. Used to link refund back to original payment for reconciliation and chargeback prevention.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Financial reconciliation of refunds by campaign for GMROI calculations; promotion_code_reversed is a denormalized code.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the customer who requested the refund. May differ from the original order customer in cases of gift returns.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store location where the refund was processed. Applicable for in-store and curbside refunds.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund transaction (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Optional post-refund satisfaction rating provided by customer, typically on a scale of 1-5. Used to measure refund experience quality. Null if not collected.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the refund request was denied. Null if refund was approved. Used for customer communication and policy compliance.

attributes.name: exception_approval_level
attributes.description: Authorization level required to approve this refund if it was a policy exception. Null if no exception was needed.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned by fraud detection system, typically 0-100 where higher values indicate greater fraud likelihood. Null if fraud scoring not applied.

attributes.name: inventory_disposition
attributes.description: Action taken with the returned inventory. Restock returns item to sellable inventory, damage_out records shrink, donate sends to charity, dispose discards, vendor_return sends back to supplier.

attributes.name: is_fraudulent
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund was flagged as potentially fraudulent by fraud detection systems or manual review. Used for loss prevention analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_reversed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points deducted from customer account due to this refund. Zero if no loyalty points were earned on original purchase or if points not reversed.

attributes.name: original_payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used in the original order transaction. Captured to support original tender refund processing. SNAP = Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, WIC = Women Infants and Children Program, EBT = Electronic Benefits Transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|cash|check|gift_card|store_credit|ebt|snap|wic — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: policy_exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund required an exception to standard return policy (e.g., outside return window, no receipt, final sale item). Requires manager approval.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Original receipt number provided by customer to validate the purchase. Used for no-receipt return policy enforcement and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value being refunded to the customer, including product cost and applicable taxes. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: refund_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by an authorized associate or automated system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_channel
attributes.description: Business channel through which the refund was initiated. POS = Point of Sale for in-store refunds.

attributes.name: refund_denied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund request was denied. Null if refund was approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used to return funds to the customer. Original tender returns to the same payment method used for purchase. EBT = Electronic Benefits Transfer.

attributes.name: refund_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the associate processing the refund. May include additional context, customer comments, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the refund transaction. Used for customer communication and tracking. Format: RFN followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: refund_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund payment was successfully processed and funds were returned to the customer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for issuing the refund. Used for root cause analysis, shrink tracking, and operational improvement. OOS = Out of Stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged|wrong_item|oos|customer_dissatisfaction|spoilage|quality_issue|pricing_error|duplicate_charge|delivery_failure|expired_product — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: refund_requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer initiated the refund request. Represents the start of the refund lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the refund transaction. Tracks progression from initial request through final settlement or denial.

attributes.name: refund_subtotal
attributes.description: Refund amount before taxes. Represents the product cost portion of the refund.

attributes.name: refund_tax_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount representing sales tax or other applicable taxes being returned to the customer.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refund scope. Full refund returns entire order value, partial refund returns a portion of order value, line-level refund returns specific line items only.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to customer for processing the return, if applicable per store policy. Deducted from the refund amount. Zero if no restocking fee applies.

attributes.name: return_shipping_cost
attributes.description: Cost of shipping the returned items back to the retailer for online/delivery orders. May be absorbed by retailer or charged to customer depending on policy.

attributes.name: return_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days between original order date and refund request date. Used to enforce return policy time limits and analyze return patterns.

attributes.name: shrink_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this refund contributes to inventory shrink (loss from theft, spoilage, or damage). True if item cannot be restocked.

products.name: rx_order
products.description: Pharmacy prescription order record representing the purchase-event view of an Rx fill within the order domain. Captures Rx order ID, linked order header (for combined grocery+pharmacy orders), prescription number, patient reference, prescriber NPI, drug NDC code, drug name, quantity dispensed, days supply, fill type (new/refill/transfer), fill status (received, in-verification, filled, ready, dispensed, on-hold, cancelled), controlled substance schedule (DEA Schedule II-V flag), insurance claim reference, copay amount, and McKesson Rx system reference. This entity owns the ORDER-SIDE view of the Rx transaction (purchase event, payment, order status); the pharmacy domain owns the CLINICAL-SIDE (drug utilization review, patient counseling, clinical verification, controlled substance DEA reporting). Integrates with McKesson Pharmacy Systems.

attributes.name: rx_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy prescription order record. Primary key representing the purchase-event view of an Rx fill within the order domain.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed pharmacist who verified and dispensed the prescription.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header for combined grocery and pharmacy orders. Links the Rx order to the overall customer order transaction.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires each Rx order to be linked to the specific pharmacy location that dispensed it for state compliance and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: pharmacy_patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy patient record. Links the Rx order to the patient receiving the medication.

attributes.name: rx_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the insurance claim submitted for this prescription fill. Links to third-party payer adjudication.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the medication is a controlled substance requiring DEA reporting and special handling.

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Patient copayment amount in USD for this prescription fill after insurance adjudication.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this Rx order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: Number of days the dispensed medication is intended to last based on prescribed dosing instructions.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA classification schedule for controlled substances (II through V). Non-controlled medications are marked as Non_Controlled.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the prescription was delivered to the patient: in-store pickup, curbside pickup, home delivery, or mail order.

attributes.name: dispensed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was picked up or delivered to the patient.

attributes.name: dispensing_fee
attributes.description: Professional fee charged by the pharmacy for dispensing services in USD.

attributes.name: drug_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the medication dispensed (tablet, capsule, liquid, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|liquid|injection|cream|ointment|inhaler|patch|suppository|suspension|solution — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the medication dispensed to the patient.

attributes.name: drug_ndc_code
attributes.description: Eleven-digit National Drug Code identifying the specific drug product dispensed. FDA-assigned unique identifier for drugs.

attributes.name: drug_strength
attributes.description: Dosage strength of the medication (e.g., 500mg, 10mcg). Includes unit of measure.

attributes.name: fill_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which fill this is for the prescription (1 for initial fill, 2+ for refills).

attributes.name: fill_status
attributes.description: Current status of the prescription fill in the pharmacy workflow: received, in clinical verification, ready for patient pickup, dispensed to patient, on hold, cancelled, or returned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|in_verification|ready_for_pickup|dispensed|on_hold|cancelled|returned — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fill_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was filled and verified by the pharmacist.

attributes.name: fill_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prescription fill event: new prescription, refill of existing prescription, transfer from another pharmacy, transfer to another pharmacy, or partial fill.

attributes.name: insurance_bin_number
attributes.description: Six-digit Bank Identification Number identifying the patients insurance processor for electronic claims routing.

attributes.name: insurance_group_number
attributes.description: Group identifier for the patients insurance plan, typically employer or organization-specific.

attributes.name: insurance_paid_amount
attributes.description: Amount paid by insurance in USD for this prescription fill after adjudication.

attributes.name: insurance_pcn
attributes.description: Processor Control Number used by insurance plans to route claims to specific benefit plans.

attributes.name: mckesson_rx_system_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier from McKesson Pharmacy Systems for this prescription order record.

attributes.name: original_drug_ndc_code
attributes.description: NDC code of the originally prescribed drug if a generic substitution was made.

attributes.name: prescriber_name
attributes.description: Full name of the healthcare provider who prescribed the medication.

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier for the prescribing healthcare provider. Required for insurance claims and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: prescription_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the prescription is no longer valid for filling or refilling.

attributes.name: prescription_number
attributes.description: Unique prescription identifier assigned by the pharmacy system. Used for prescription tracking, refill management, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: prescription_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the prescription was received by the pharmacy (electronically, by phone, or in person).

attributes.name: prescription_written_date
attributes.description: Date the prescription was originally written by the prescriber.

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: Number of units of medication dispensed to the patient (e.g., number of tablets, milliliters of liquid).

attributes.name: refills_remaining
attributes.description: Number of authorized refills remaining on the prescription after this fill.

attributes.name: sig_code
attributes.description: Prescription directions for use (Sig) provided to the patient. Instructions on how to take the medication.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generic substitution was permitted by the prescriber for this prescription.

attributes.name: substitution_occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a generic substitution was actually made when filling this prescription.

attributes.name: total_price
attributes.description: Total price charged for the prescription fill in USD before insurance coverage.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this Rx order record was last modified in the system.

products.name: order_substitution
products.description: Item substitution record capturing instances where an ordered SKU was unavailable (OOS) and replaced with an alternative item during fulfillment. Captures substitution ID, linked order line, original SKU/GTIN, substitute SKU/GTIN, substitution reason (OOS, damaged, recalled), substitution type (auto-substituted by system, picker-selected, customer pre-approved), customer notification method (app/SMS/email), customer acceptance status (accepted, rejected, pending), price difference amount, and substitution timestamp. Supports OOS root cause analysis and customer experience improvement.

attributes.name: order_substitution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order substitution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store, distribution center, or micro-fulfillment center where the substitution occurred.

attributes.name: picker_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the store associate or picker who made the substitution decision during order fulfillment. Null for system-automated substitutions.

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the order line item that required substitution. Links to the specific line item in the order that was out of stock or unavailable.

attributes.name: brand_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item is from the same brand as the original item.

attributes.name: category_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item is from the same product category as the original item, supporting substitution quality analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this substitution record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_status
attributes.description: The customers response to the substitution offer. ACCEPTED=Customer explicitly accepted, REJECTED=Customer declined substitute, PENDING=Awaiting customer response, AUTO_ACCEPTED=Accepted per customer preferences, NOT_REQUIRED=No acceptance needed per business rules.

attributes.name: customer_feedback_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments provided by the customer regarding the substitution experience.

attributes.name: customer_notification_method
attributes.description: The channel used to notify the customer about the substitution. APP=Mobile app notification, SMS=Text message, EMAIL=Email notification, PHONE=Phone call, NONE=No notification sent.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was notified about the substitution. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: customer_response_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer provided their acceptance or rejection response. Null if no response received or not required.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer-provided rating (1-5 scale) of their satisfaction with the substitution. Null if customer has not provided feedback.

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when inventory levels were checked for the original item, capturing the point-in-time inventory state that led to the OOS condition.

attributes.name: notes
