attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about the substitution from store associates, customer service, or system processes.

attributes.name: original_gtin
attributes.description: The GTIN (UPC/EAN) of the originally ordered product that was unavailable. Supports 8, 12, 13, or 14 digit formats.

attributes.name: original_item_stock_level
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity of the original item at the fulfillment location at the time of substitution decision.

attributes.name: original_product_name
attributes.description: The display name of the originally ordered product for customer communication and reporting.

attributes.name: original_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the original item that was ordered before substitution.

attributes.name: original_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the originally ordered item that was unavailable and required substitution.

attributes.name: original_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price of the originally ordered item at the time of order placement.

attributes.name: price_difference_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the original item and substitute item (substitute price minus original price). Negative values indicate customer savings, positive values indicate upcharge.

attributes.name: price_protection_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether price protection was applied to ensure the customer was not charged more than the original item price, even if the substitute was more expensive.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount refunded to the customer related to this substitution. Null if no refund was issued.

attributes.name: refund_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a refund was issued to the customer due to substitution rejection or price difference.

attributes.name: size_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item has the same or comparable size/quantity as the original item.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this substitution record (e.g., OMS, WMS, POS).

attributes.name: substitute_gtin
attributes.description: The GTIN (UPC/EAN) of the substitute product provided. Supports 8, 12, 13, or 14 digit formats.

attributes.name: substitute_item_stock_level
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity of the substitute item at the fulfillment location at the time of substitution.

attributes.name: substitute_product_name
attributes.description: The display name of the substitute product provided to the customer.

attributes.name: substitute_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the substitute item provided to fulfill the order.

attributes.name: substitute_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the replacement item provided as a substitute.

attributes.name: substitute_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price of the substitute item at the time of substitution.

attributes.name: substitution_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer approval was required before proceeding with the substitution based on business rules and customer preferences.

attributes.name: substitution_number
attributes.description: Business-facing identifier for the substitution event, used for customer service and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: substitution_quality_score
attributes.description: A system-calculated score (0.00 to 5.00) representing the quality of the substitution match based on product attributes, category similarity, and customer preferences.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_code
attributes.description: The primary reason the original item required substitution. OOS=Out of Stock, DAMAGED=Product damaged, RECALLED=Product recalled, EXPIRED=Product expired or near expiration, QUALITY=Quality issue identified, DISCONTINUED=Product discontinued.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of why the substitution was necessary, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: substitution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the substitution decision was made and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: The method by which the substitution was determined. AUTO_SYSTEM=Automatically selected by system algorithm, PICKER_SELECTED=Chosen by store associate or picker during fulfillment, CUSTOMER_PREAPPROVED=Customer pre-authorized substitutions in preferences, CUSTOMER_REQUESTED=Customer specifically requested this substitute.

products.name: storefront
products.description: Master record for each digital storefront channel operated by Grocery, including web, mobile app (iOS, Android), and kiosk surfaces. Captures storefront identity, locale and language configuration, supported payment methods, feature flags and feature toggles, channel-specific branding, minimum order thresholds, accepted tender types (credit, EBT, SNAP, WIC, gift card), fulfillment method availability, loyalty integration settings, launch/sunset dates, age-verification requirements, SNAP/EBT acceptance configuration, maximum cart item count, and channel-specific SLA targets. Each storefront maps to a distinct omnichannel touchpoint and drives catalog syndication, personalization rules, runtime checkout behavior, and OMS routing logic via Salesforce Commerce Cloud. This is the single configuration master for all channel-level settings — no separate channel configuration entity exists.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital storefront channel. Primary key.

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the price book applied to this storefront. Determines pricing for products based on channel, region, or customer segment.

attributes.name: accepted_tender_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment tender types accepted on this storefront (e.g., 'credit_card,debit_card,ebt,snap,wic,gift_card,mobile_wallet'). Drives checkout payment options. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ebt|snap|wic|gift_card|mobile_wallet|cash|check — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: age_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether age verification is required for certain product categories (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy) on this storefront.
attributes.references: FDA, State Alcohol and Tobacco Control Regulations

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Application Programming Interface (API) Endpoint Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Base URL for the storefront API endpoint. Used by mobile apps and third-party integrations to interact with the storefront.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand identity displayed on this storefront (e.g., 'Grocery', 'Grocery Fresh', 'Grocery Pharmacy'). Supports multi-brand storefronts.

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product catalog syndicated to this storefront. Determines which SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) are available for purchase.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Type of digital channel this storefront represents. Determines device-specific behavior and feature availability.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary customer service email address for this storefront. Used for customer inquiries and support.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary customer service phone number for this storefront. Used for customer support and order inquiries.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Determines regulatory compliance, payment methods, and fulfillment options.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storefront record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Default currency for pricing and transactions on this storefront.

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront accepts EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) cards for payment.

attributes.name: fulfillment_methods_supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment methods available on this storefront (e.g., 'delivery,pickup,curbside,in_store'). Drives checkout fulfillment options.

attributes.name: guest_checkout_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can complete purchases without creating an account (guest checkout).

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, fr). Primary language for storefront content and customer communication.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storefront record was last updated.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the storefront was first made available to customers.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: ISO locale code for language and region (e.g., en_US, es_MX, fr_CA). Drives language, currency, and regional content.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific loyalty program integrated with this storefront (e.g., 'GROCERY_REWARDS', 'FUEL_POINTS'). Null if no loyalty integration.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_integrated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storefront is integrated with the customer loyalty program for points earning and redemption.

attributes.name: maximum_cart_item_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of distinct line items allowed in a single cart. Null if no limit applies.

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: Minimum subtotal required to place an order on this storefront. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether AI-driven personalization features (product recommendations, personalized promotions) are enabled on this storefront.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Operating system or platform for the storefront (e.g., iOS, Android, Web Desktop). Applicable primarily to mobile apps and platform-specific web experiences. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ios|android|web_desktop|web_mobile|windows|linux|macos — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: promotion_engine_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion engine is active on this storefront for applying discounts, coupons, and promotional offers.

attributes.name: search_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product search functionality is enabled on this storefront.

attributes.name: sla_target_delivery_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Delivery Hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours from order placement to delivery completion for delivery orders on this storefront. Null if delivery not supported.

attributes.name: sla_target_order_processing_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Order Processing Minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes from order placement to order fulfillment start for this storefront. Used for performance monitoring and customer expectations.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront accepts SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits as payment.

attributes.name: storefront_code
attributes.description: Business-readable unique code for the storefront channel (e.g., WEB_US, MOBILE_IOS, KIOSK_INSTORE). Used for external integrations and reporting.

attributes.name: storefront_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the storefront channel (e.g., 'Grocery Web USA', 'Grocery Mobile App iOS', 'In-Store Kiosk').

attributes.name: storefront_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storefront. Active storefronts are live and accepting orders; sunset storefronts are being phased out.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product substitutions are allowed by default for out-of-stock items on this storefront.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the storefront will be or was decommissioned. Null for active storefronts with no planned sunset.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction for this storefront. Determines sales tax calculation rules and rates.

attributes.name: theme_code
attributes.description: Visual theme or branding template applied to the storefront (e.g., 'default', 'holiday_2024', 'pharmacy_blue'). Controls UI/UX appearance.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for scheduling, promotions, and time-sensitive features.

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Public-facing URL for the storefront (e.g., https://www.grocery.com, https://m.grocery.com). Null for non-web channels like mobile apps.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storefront accepts WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) vouchers as payment.

products.name: catalog
products.description: Syndicated digital product catalog representing the online-available assortment for a specific storefront channel. Manages item eligibility for eCommerce, digital shelf presentation attributes (hero images, rich descriptions, nutritional callouts, allergen warnings), search boost scores, category navigation hierarchy, and availability windows. Each catalog is tied to a storefront and may differ by channel (e.g., kiosk catalog may exclude alcohol). Distinct from the physical product master in the product domain — this is the commerce-layer view of what is shoppable online.

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Primary key for catalog

attributes.name: primary_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary category this item belongs to in the digital catalog hierarchy. Used for navigation and merchandising.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Category Management

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront channel this catalog serves (e.g., web, mobile app, kiosk). Each catalog is tied to a specific storefront and may differ by channel.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product requires age verification for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain medications). Triggers age verification workflow at checkout.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: allergen_warnings
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allergen warnings (e.g., Contains: Milk, Eggs, Peanuts). Critical for customer safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: availability_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this item will no longer be available for online purchase. Used for limited-time offers and seasonal discontinuation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Lifecycle

attributes.name: availability_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this item becomes available for online purchase. Used for scheduled product launches and seasonal items.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Lifecycle

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name of the product. Used for filtering, faceted search, and brand-specific merchandising.

attributes.name: catalog_name
attributes.description: The primary display name of the product as shown on the digital storefront. Optimized for customer-facing presentation and search.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Product Catalog Standards

attributes.name: catalog_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the item in the digital catalog. Indicates whether the item is available for online shopping, temporarily unavailable, or removed from the digital assortment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: category_path
attributes.description: Hierarchical category path for navigation (e.g., Grocery > Dairy > Milk > Organic). Defines where the product appears in the digital storefront taxonomy.

attributes.name: channel_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is excluded from certain channels (e.g., kiosk catalog may exclude alcohol). True means channel-specific restrictions apply.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this catalog record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the display price (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: display_price
attributes.description: The price displayed to customers on the digital storefront. May differ from the base price due to promotions, channel-specific pricing, or personalized offers.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: excluded_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channel codes where this item is not available (e.g., KIOSK, MOBILE_APP). Used to enforce channel-specific assortment rules.

attributes.name: featured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is featured in promotional placements, homepage carousels, or special merchandising zones.

attributes.name: gluten_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified or labeled gluten-free. Used for dietary filtering and allergen management.

attributes.name: hero_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the primary product image displayed prominently on the product detail page and in featured placements.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Digital Asset Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this catalog record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization with source systems.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed rich product description displayed on the product detail page. May include HTML formatting, nutritional information, usage instructions, and ingredient lists.

attributes.name: merchandising_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank used to control the display order of products within a category. Lower numbers appear first. Used for strategic product placement.

attributes.name: minimum_age_required
attributes.description: The minimum age required to purchase this product (e.g., 18, 21). Null if no age restriction applies.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: new_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is marked as a new arrival. Used for New Items merchandising and filtering.

attributes.name: nutritional_callouts
attributes.description: Marketing callouts highlighting nutritional benefits (e.g., High Protein, Low Sodium, No Added Sugar). Used for merchandising and filtering.

attributes.name: online_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is currently available for purchase through the digital channel. True means the item can be added to cart and ordered online.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is certified organic. Important for customer filtering and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The size or quantity of the product package as displayed to customers (e.g., 12 oz, 1 gallon, 6-pack). Used for customer decision-making.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is perishable and requires temperature-controlled handling. Affects fulfillment method and delivery logistics.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a store-owned brand (private label) product. True for private label, false for national brands.

attributes.name: search_boost_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00-999.99) used to boost or demote this item in search results. Higher scores increase prominence in search rankings.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Search Ranking Algorithm

attributes.name: search_keywords
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of keywords and synonyms to improve product discoverability in site search. Includes common misspellings and alternate terms.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief product description used in search results, category listings, and mobile views. Typically 100-200 characters.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: The unique product identifier (Stock Keeping Unit) representing the item in the digital catalog. This is the commerce-layer view of what is shoppable online, distinct from the physical product master.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). Required for government assistance program compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system that provided this catalog data (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle Retail). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The required storage and handling temperature zone for the product. Critical for cold chain management and fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: thumbnail_image_url
attributes.description: URL of the thumbnail image used in search results, category grids, and cart views.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Digital Asset Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the product as sold online (e.g., each, pound, gallon). Important for pricing and quantity selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|oz|kg|g|gal|qt|pt|fl_oz|l|ml|dozen|case — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for government assistance program compliance.

products.name: web_session
products.description: Captures individual shopper browsing sessions across web and mobile app storefronts. Records session start/end timestamps, device type, browser/OS fingerprint, entry source (organic search, paid media, email campaign, loyalty app deep link, social), referring URL, geolocation, authenticated vs. guest status, pages visited count, product detail page views, and session outcome (converted, abandoned, bounced). Supports personalization, A/B test experiment assignment, conversion funnel analysis, and digital merchandising attribution. This is the commerce-owned session for shopping behavior — distinct from platform-level clickstream or security audit logs.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the web session. Primary key.

attributes.name: ab_test_experiment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test or multivariate experiment the session was assigned to for personalization and testing.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the order placed during this session, if conversion occurred. Null if no order was placed.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the authenticated shopper. Null for guest sessions.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred or selected store for click-and-collect or curbside pickup during the session. Null if no store selected.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Specific variant or treatment group assigned to the session within the A/B test experiment (e.g., control, variant_a, variant_b).

attributes.name: add_to_cart_count
attributes.description: Number of times items were added to the shopping cart during the session.

attributes.name: authentication_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session is authenticated (logged-in shopper), guest (identified but not logged in), or anonymous (no identification).

attributes.name: browser_name
attributes.description: Name of the web browser used (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version number of the browser used during the session.

attributes.name: cart_abandonment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session ended with items in the cart but no order placed (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session resulted in a completed order (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Unique fingerprint hash of the device based on browser and OS characteristics for tracking and fraud detection.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used for the session: desktop, mobile, tablet, smart TV, wearable, or other.

attributes.name: entry_source
attributes.description: Source channel through which the session was initiated (e.g., organic search, paid media, email campaign, loyalty app deep link, social media, direct).

attributes.name: entry_source_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the entry source: organic, paid, email, social, direct, referral, or affiliate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic|paid|email|social|direct|referral|affiliate — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: URL of the last page viewed before the session ended.

attributes.name: geolocation_city
attributes.description: City name derived from IP geolocation.

attributes.name: geolocation_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter country code derived from IP geolocation.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the session origin based on IP geolocation.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the session origin based on IP geolocation.

attributes.name: geolocation_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code derived from IP geolocation.

attributes.name: geolocation_state
attributes.description: State or province code derived from IP geolocation.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device initiating the session. May be IPv4 or IPv6.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: URL of the first page viewed in the session.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session record was last updated.

attributes.name: loyalty_app_session_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session originated from the loyalty mobile app (True) or web browser (False).

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux).

attributes.name: operating_system_version
attributes.description: Version number of the operating system.

attributes.name: pages_viewed_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages viewed during the session.

attributes.name: personalization_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment or persona assigned to the session for personalized content and merchandising.

attributes.name: product_detail_views_count
attributes.description: Number of product detail pages viewed during the session.

attributes.name: referring_url
attributes.description: Full URL of the referring page that directed the user to the site.

attributes.name: search_query_count
attributes.description: Number of search queries executed during the session.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the session in seconds from start to end.

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session ended or was terminated.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Business-readable session identifier or tracking number for customer service reference.

attributes.name: session_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the session: converted (order placed), abandoned (cart left), bounced (single page view), or browsing (multi-page without conversion).

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session was initiated. Principal business event timestamp for this session.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the session: active (in progress), completed (ended normally), abandoned (cart left without checkout), expired (timeout), bounced (single page view).

attributes.name: utm_campaign
attributes.description: UTM campaign parameter from the entry URL for campaign tracking.

attributes.name: utm_content
attributes.description: UTM content parameter from the entry URL for A/B test or ad variant tracking.

attributes.name: utm_medium
attributes.description: UTM medium parameter from the entry URL for campaign tracking.

attributes.name: utm_source
attributes.description: UTM source parameter from the entry URL for campaign tracking.

attributes.name: utm_term
attributes.description: UTM term parameter from the entry URL for paid search keyword tracking.

products.name: cart
products.description: Represents an active or abandoned digital shopping cart for a shopper session. Tracks cart creation timestamp, last modified timestamp, cart status (active, checked_out, abandoned, expired, merged), total item count, estimated subtotal, applied promo codes, selected fulfillment method (delivery, curbside pickup, in-store pickup, ship-to-home), scheduled fulfillment slot reference, and cart merge history for cross-device continuity. Supports cart recovery campaigns, abandonment analytics, and order conversion measurement within Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart. Primary key for the cart entity.

attributes.name: merged_from_cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous cart that was merged into this cart for cross-device continuity. Null if cart was not created from a merge.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper who owns this cart. Links to the customer domain shopper entity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center (DC), or micro-fulfillment center (MFC) selected for order fulfillment. Links to store domain.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital session during which this cart was created or modified. Used for cross-device continuity and session analytics.

attributes.name: abandonment_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a cart abandonment recovery notification (email, SMS, push) has been sent to the shopper. True if sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: abandonment_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart abandonment recovery notification was sent. Null if no notification sent. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: browser_type
attributes.description: Web browser or mobile app identifier used for the cart session (e.g., Chrome, Safari, iOS App). Used for technical support and analytics.

attributes.name: cart_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the cart, used for customer service and cart recovery campaigns.

attributes.name: cart_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shopping cart. Active indicates ongoing shopping session, checked_out indicates conversion to order, abandoned indicates cart left without checkout, expired indicates cart exceeded retention period, merged indicates cart combined with another session, saved indicates customer explicitly saved for later.

attributes.name: cart_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cart based on its intended purpose. Standard for regular shopping, wishlist for saved items, subscription for recurring orders, quick_reorder for repeat purchase carts.

attributes.name: checkout_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was converted to an order through checkout completion. Null for carts that have not been checked out. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created. Represents the start of the shopping session. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in the cart (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the delivery address (street number and name) for delivery fulfillment method. Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the delivery address (apartment, suite, unit) for delivery fulfillment method. Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: delivery_city
attributes.description: City name for the delivery address. Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the delivery address (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the delivery address. Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: delivery_state
attributes.description: State or province code for the delivery address (e.g., CA, TX, ON). Null for pickup methods.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to create or last modify the cart. Used for channel analytics and cross-device behavior tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_discount_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total discount amount applied to the cart from promotions, coupons, and loyalty rewards. Recalculated dynamically.

attributes.name: estimated_subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Estimated subtotal of all items in the cart before discounts, taxes, and fees. Recalculated dynamically as cart contents change.

attributes.name: estimated_tax_amount
attributes.description: Estimated sales tax amount for the cart based on selected fulfillment location and applicable tax jurisdictions. Final tax calculated at checkout.

attributes.name: estimated_total_amount
attributes.description: Estimated grand total for the cart including subtotal, discounts, taxes, and fees. Represents the expected checkout amount.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart will expire and be eligible for purging. Typically set based on business retention policy (e.g., 30 days from last modification). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: Selected method for order fulfillment. Delivery for last-mile delivery (LMD), curbside_pickup for Click-and-Collect curbside, in_store_pickup for in-store collection, ship_to_home for parcel shipping.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cart was last updated with item additions, removals, or quantity changes. Used for abandonment analytics and cart recovery timing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed and applied to this cart for discounts or rewards.

attributes.name: promo_codes_applied
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of promotion codes or coupon codes applied to the cart. Used for discount calculation and campaign tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: Date selected by the shopper for order fulfillment (delivery or pickup). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Order Management System (OMS)

attributes.name: scheduled_fulfillment_window_end
attributes.description: End time of the selected fulfillment time window (e.g., 12:00 PM for a 10:00-12:00 delivery slot). Format: HH:mm.

attributes.name: scheduled_fulfillment_window_start
attributes.description: Start time of the selected fulfillment time window (e.g., 10:00 AM for a 10:00-12:00 delivery slot). Format: HH:mm.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that created or owns this cart record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Mobile App, Kiosk).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for shopper to provide special instructions for fulfillment (e.g., gate code, ripe bananas, contactless delivery).

attributes.name: substitution_preference
attributes.description: Shopper preference for item substitutions when items are out of stock (OOS). Allow_all permits any substitute, allow_similar permits category-matched substitutes, contact_me requires shopper approval, no_substitutions rejects all substitutes.

attributes.name: total_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) in the cart. Does not account for quantity per SKU, only unique items.

attributes.name: total_unit_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all items in the cart, accounting for quantities of each SKU. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based items (e.g., produce, deli).

products.name: cart_item
products.description: Line-item level detail within a digital shopping cart. Captures the SKU/UPC added, quantity requested, unit price at time of add, substitution preference (allow/deny/specific), special instructions (e.g., ripeness preference for produce), item-level promo applied, and item add timestamp. Supports cart recovery, substitution workflows, and order conversion analytics.

attributes.name: cart_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each line item within a digital shopping cart. Primary key for the cart_item product.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shopping cart that contains this item. Links to the cart header entity.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotion applied to this cart item. Links to the promotion master for details on discount rules, funding source, and promotion terms.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique session identifier for the browsing session during which this item was added. Links cart activity to broader session behavior for journey analytics.

attributes.name: added_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the cart. Critical for cart abandonment analysis, session analytics, and time-in-cart metrics.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item requires age verification at checkout. Includes alcohol, tobacco, and certain over-the-counter medications.

attributes.name: bogo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is part of a buy-one-get-one promotion. Supports promotional compliance and basket analysis.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Product category code within the department hierarchy. Supports assortment planning and category management analytics.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Digital or manufacturer coupon code applied to this specific item. Captured for redemption tracking and vendor chargeback processing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this cart item. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Retail department code for merchandising classification. Used for category performance analysis and store layout optimization.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to add this item to cart. Enables device-specific user experience optimization and responsive design analytics.

attributes.name: estimated_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Estimated weight of this cart item in pounds. Used for delivery route planning, vehicle capacity planning, and shipping cost estimation for variable-weight items.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: Total price for this cart line calculated as quantity requested multiplied by unit price, before any item-level promotions or discounts are applied.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global trade item number assigned by GS1 for worldwide product identification. May be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on product type.

attributes.name: item_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to this specific cart item from promotions, coupons, or temporary price reductions. Reduces the extended price to arrive at net item amount.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current status of this item within the cart lifecycle. Tracks whether item is active in cart, removed by customer, saved for later purchase, unavailable, or substituted during fulfillment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cart item. Tracks quantity changes, substitution preference updates, or special instruction edits.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number indicating the order in which items were added to the cart. Used for display ordering and cart recovery workflows.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item qualifies for loyalty points accrual. Some categories like alcohol, tobacco, and pharmacy may be excluded from loyalty programs.

attributes.name: net_item_amount
attributes.description: Net amount for this cart line after item-level discounts are applied. Calculated as extended price minus item discount amount.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is certified organic. Supports customer preference tracking and organic category performance analysis.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is perishable and requires temperature-controlled handling. Drives fulfillment workflow and cold chain logistics.

attributes.name: plu
attributes.description: Price look-up code used primarily for fresh produce and bulk items sold by weight. Typically 4 or 5 digit codes assigned by the International Federation for Produce Standards.

attributes.name: preferred_substitute_sku
attributes.description: Specific SKU the customer has designated as an acceptable substitute if the original item is unavailable. Only populated when substitution preference is specific_only.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a store-owned private label brand. Used for private label penetration analysis and margin reporting.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable product name displayed to the customer in the digital cart. Captured at time of cart add to preserve the product description as shown to the shopper.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Quantity of the item requested by the customer. May be whole units for packaged goods or fractional for weighted items like produce or deli products.

attributes.name: recommendation_source
attributes.description: Source that led to this item being added to cart. Tracks effectiveness of recommendation engines, search, and merchandising strategies.

attributes.name: removed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item was removed from the cart by the customer. Used for cart abandonment analysis and product affinity modeling.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code identifying the specific product variant added to cart. Primary product identifier for inventory and merchandising systems.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using SNAP Electronic Benefits Transfer. Required for SNAP transaction processing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Digital channel through which this item was added to the cart. Supports omnichannel behavior analysis and channel-specific merchandising strategies.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text customer instructions for this specific item. Common for produce ripeness preferences, deli slicing thickness, bakery customization, or other item-specific requests.

attributes.name: substitution_preference
attributes.description: Customer preference for item substitution if the requested product is out of stock during fulfillment. Drives picker behavior and customer communication workflows.

attributes.name: tpr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is currently on temporary price reduction. Used for promotional analytics and margin analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity requested. Indicates whether item is sold by each, weight, volume, or other standard retail units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|oz|kg|g|gal|qt|pt|fl_oz|l|ml|dozen|case — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of measure at the time the item was added to cart. Captured to preserve pricing for cart recovery and price change analysis.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit universal product code barcode identifier. Standard retail product identifier used for scanning and product lookup.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is approved for purchase under the WIC program. Required for WIC voucher processing and state compliance reporting.

products.name: checkout_session
products.description: Records the checkout funnel event for a digital order, from cart submission through payment authorization. Captures checkout initiation timestamp, steps completed (address, fulfillment slot, payment), step abandonment point if applicable, applied loyalty points, coupon codes validated, EBT/SNAP tender flag, total before/after discounts, tax amount, and checkout completion status. Integrates with OMS for order routing.

attributes.name: checkout_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the checkout session. Primary key.

attributes.name: cart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopping cart that was submitted for checkout.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order header created from this checkout session upon completion. Links to the OMS (Order Management System) for order routing and fulfillment.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who initiated the checkout session.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Store location selected for pickup or fulfillment, if applicable.

attributes.name: abandoned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the checkout session was abandoned by the customer without completing the purchase.

attributes.name: abandonment_step
attributes.description: The checkout funnel step at which the customer abandoned the session, if applicable. Used for conversion funnel analysis.

attributes.name: browser_type
attributes.description: Web browser or mobile app version used during the checkout session.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Digital channel through which the checkout session was initiated (web storefront, mobile app, in-store kiosk, call center).

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the checkout session was successfully completed and order was placed.

attributes.name: coupon_codes_applied
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of coupon codes validated and applied during checkout.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this checkout session record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this checkout session.

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount
attributes.description: Delivery or service fee charged for order fulfillment, if applicable.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the customer to complete the checkout session.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied during checkout from promotions, coupons, and loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: ebt_snap_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EBT SNAP benefits were selected as a payment tender during checkout.

attributes.name: expired_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the checkout session expired due to inactivity timeout.

attributes.name: fulfillment_method
attributes.description: The fulfillment method selected by the customer during checkout (home delivery, in-store pickup, curbside pickup).

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer began the checkout process by submitting their cart. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this checkout session record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Loyalty card number entered or scanned during checkout for rewards and personalization.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned from this purchase, calculated during checkout.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the customer during this checkout session.

attributes.name: oms_order_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the Order Management System upon successful checkout completion and order routing.

attributes.name: payment_authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor upon successful payment validation.

attributes.name: payment_method_selected
attributes.description: Primary payment method selected by the customer during checkout. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ebt|gift_card|paypal|apple_pay|google_pay — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_processor_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the payment gateway or processor for this checkout transaction.

attributes.name: promo_codes_applied
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of promotional codes applied during checkout for discounts or offers.

attributes.name: selected_fulfillment_slot_end
attributes.description: End time of the delivery or pickup time slot selected by the customer.

attributes.name: selected_fulfillment_slot_start
attributes.description: Start time of the delivery or pickup time slot selected by the customer.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the checkout session in seconds, from initiation to completion or abandonment.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly unique identifier for the checkout session, used for customer service and tracking.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the checkout session. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or abandonment.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Total amount of items in the cart that are eligible for SNAP benefits payment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or platform that captured this checkout session (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, custom eCommerce platform).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions or notes provided by the customer for order fulfillment (e.g., delivery instructions, item preferences).

attributes.name: step_address_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the delivery/pickup address step in the checkout funnel.

attributes.name: step_fulfillment_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the fulfillment method and time slot selection step.

attributes.name: step_payment_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the payment information entry step.

attributes.name: step_review_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed the order review and confirmation step.

attributes.name: substitution_preference
attributes.description: Customer preference for item substitutions if ordered items are out of stock during fulfillment.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of all items in the cart before discounts, taxes, and fees are applied.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax calculated and applied to the order during checkout.

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Optional tip amount entered by the customer for delivery or pickup service.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount after all discounts, taxes, fees, and tips are applied. Net amount the customer will pay.

attributes.name: total_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items in the cart at checkout initiation.

attributes.name: total_unit_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all units across all items in the cart at checkout.

attributes.name: wic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether WIC benefits were selected as a payment tender during checkout.

products.name: product_order
products.description: Master record for an online order placed through any digital channel (web, mobile, kiosk). Captures order number, channel source, fulfillment type (click-and-collect, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery, ship-to-home), order status, placed timestamp, promised fulfillment window, store or MFC assigned for fulfillment, total amount, payment status, and OMS routing reference. SSOT for digital order identity within the commerce domain; physical execution is owned by the order and fulfillment domains.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), or Distribution Center (DC) assigned to fulfill this order.
attributes.references: Store and Facility Master Data Standard

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Needed for order‑level analytics and campaign performance dashboards; promo_code_applied is a denormalized string.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed this digital order.

attributes.name: age_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order contains age-restricted items (alcohol, tobacco, certain medications) requiring customer age verification at fulfillment.
attributes.references: FDA and State Alcohol Control Board Regulations

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for order cancellation.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: channel_source
attributes.description: The digital channel through which the customer placed the order (web storefront, mobile app, in-store kiosk, voice assistant, chatbot, or third-party marketplace).

attributes.name: contactless_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requested contactless delivery (leave at door, no signature required).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was first created in the database.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this order (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: customer_feedback_comments
attributes.description: Free-text customer feedback or comments about the order experience.

attributes.name: customer_rating
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating for the order experience on a scale of 1 to 5 stars.

attributes.name: delivery_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged for delivery or fulfillment service. Zero for in-store pickup orders.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the order including promotions, coupons, and loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The method by which the order will be fulfilled and delivered to the customer. Click-and-Collect refers to in-store pickup, curbside pickup is contactless vehicle-side handoff, last-mile delivery is same-day home delivery, ship-to-home is standard shipping, and locker pickup is automated pickup point.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was last updated.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Customer loyalty card number applied to this order for points accrual and member pricing.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Total loyalty program points earned by the customer for this order.

attributes.name: oms_order_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the Order Management System (OMS) used for routing and orchestration across fulfillment systems.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique order number displayed to customers and used for customer service inquiries. Generated by the Order Management System (OMS).

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the digital order in the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picking|packed|ready_for_pickup|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument type used for this order. EBT refers to Electronic Benefits Transfer for SNAP/WIC programs.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment processing for this order.
attributes.references: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

attributes.name: placed_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the customer submitted the order through the digital channel. This is the principal business event timestamp for the order lifecycle.

attributes.name: prescription_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order includes pharmacy prescription items requiring special handling and HIPAA compliance.

attributes.name: promised_fulfillment_date
attributes.description: The date promised to the customer for order fulfillment (pickup or delivery).

attributes.name: promised_window_end_time
attributes.description: The end of the time window promised to the customer for order pickup or delivery.

attributes.name: promised_window_start_time
attributes.description: The start of the time window promised to the customer for order pickup or delivery.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Total amount of SNAP-eligible items in the order that can be paid using Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that originated this order record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, custom eCommerce platform, mobile app backend).

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for customer-provided delivery or fulfillment instructions (e.g., gate code, preferred substitutions, contactless delivery preferences).

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has allowed product substitutions if ordered items are out of stock.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of all order line items before discounts, taxes, and fees.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax amount charged on the order.

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Optional gratuity amount provided by the customer for delivery or pickup service.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount charged to the customer including subtotal, taxes, fees, tips, minus discounts.

attributes.name: total_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct line items (SKUs) in the order.

attributes.name: total_unit_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of all units across all line items in the order (sum of quantities).

attributes.name: wic_eligible_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Amount
attributes.description: Total amount of WIC-eligible items in the order that can be paid using WIC vouchers or EBT.

products.name: fulfillment_slot
products.description: Scheduled time windows available for click-and-collect, curbside pickup, or last-mile delivery fulfillment at a given store or MFC. Captures slot date, start/end time, fulfillment type, location, total capacity (max orders), booked count, available capacity, cutoff time for new bookings, and slot status (open, full, closed, cancelled). Also manages individual slot reservations linking a checkout session or order to a specific slot, including reservation timestamp, reservation status (held, confirmed, released, expired), hold expiry timestamp, and release reason. Drives the slot selection UI in checkout and manages capacity contention during high-demand periods such as holidays and promotional events. This is the commerce-layer view of slot availability and reservation for the digital shopping experience; physical fulfillment execution is owned by the fulfillment domain.
products.reference: Pickup Slot / Delivery Window / Click-and-Collect Slot

attributes.name: fulfillment_slot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment slot. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operations user who performed the capacity override.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Store or MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center) where this fulfillment slot is available.

attributes.name: available_capacity
attributes.description: Remaining capacity available for new bookings, calculated as total_capacity minus booked_count minus reserved_count.

attributes.name: booked_count
attributes.description: Current number of confirmed orders assigned to this slot.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why this slot was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: capacity_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the slot capacity was manually adjusted by operations staff.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Digital commerce channel through which this slot is made available for booking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for slot fee amount.

attributes.name: cutoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Deadline timestamp after which new bookings for this slot are no longer accepted.

attributes.name: delivery_zone_code
attributes.description: Geographic zone or service area code for delivery slots, used for routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: Type of fulfillment service this slot supports: click-and-collect pickup, curbside pickup, last-mile delivery (LMD), or pharmacy prescription pickup.

attributes.name: holiday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot falls on a holiday or high-demand promotional period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was last updated.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for manual capacity override, if applicable.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Customer segment or priority level that has preferential access to this slot.

attributes.name: reserved_count
attributes.description: Number of slots currently held in reservation (not yet confirmed) during checkout sessions.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Service tier or speed commitment associated with this slot.

attributes.name: slot_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot was closed to new bookings, either due to reaching capacity or manual closure.

attributes.name: slot_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: slot_date
attributes.description: Calendar date for which this fulfillment slot is scheduled.

attributes.name: slot_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Length of the fulfillment window in minutes.

attributes.name: slot_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment slot window ends.

attributes.name: slot_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for booking this slot, if applicable.

attributes.name: slot_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions related to this slot.

attributes.name: slot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the slot, used in customer-facing displays and operational tracking.

attributes.name: slot_published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this slot was made visible and bookable to customers.

attributes.name: slot_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fulfillment slot window begins.

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment slot indicating availability for new bookings.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system that created or manages this slot record, such as OMS (Order Management System) or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

attributes.name: surge_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surge or dynamic pricing is applied to this slot due to high demand.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for this slot, relevant for perishable and frozen goods fulfillment.

attributes.name: total_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders that can be assigned to this slot.

products.name: slot_reservation
products.description: Transactional record linking a digital order or checkout session to a specific fulfillment slot. Captures reservation timestamp, reserved slot reference, shopper identity, order reference, reservation status (held, confirmed, released, expired), hold expiry timestamp, and release reason if applicable. Manages slot inventory contention during high-demand periods such as holiday or promotional events.

attributes.name: slot_reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the slot reservation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fulfillment_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific fulfillment slot being reserved.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order associated with this slot reservation.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper who made the reservation.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the fulfillment slot is located.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Digital session identifier linking the reservation to the customer's checkout session for analytics and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reservation was cancelled by the customer or system.

attributes.name: capacity_units_reserved
attributes.description: Number of capacity units consumed by this reservation within the slot's total capacity. Used for slot inventory management.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The digital channel through which the slot reservation was made.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reservation transitioned from held to confirmed status, typically after successful payment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the slot fee amount.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the device used to make the reservation, used for fraud detection and customer experience analytics.

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The method of order fulfillment associated with this slot reservation.

attributes.name: hold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The length of time in seconds that the slot was held before confirmation or expiration. Used for checkout flow optimization.

attributes.name: hold_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a held reservation will automatically expire if not confirmed. Used to manage slot inventory contention during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: holiday_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserved slot falls on a holiday or peak shopping period, used for capacity planning and pricing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this record was most recently updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer about the reservation status.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confirmation or reminder notification was sent to the customer for this reservation.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Customer priority level for slot allocation, used during high-demand periods to prioritize loyal or premium customers.

attributes.name: release_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason why the slot reservation was released or cancelled. Used for operational analytics and slot inventory optimization.

attributes.name: release_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the slot was released, providing additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the slot was released back to available inventory.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the slot reservation, used for customer communication and tracking.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the slot reservation. Held indicates temporary hold during checkout, confirmed indicates successful booking, released indicates slot returned to inventory, expired indicates hold timeout, cancelled indicates customer cancellation.

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the slot reservation was initially created. Principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: The speed or priority tier of the fulfillment service for this reservation.

attributes.name: slot_date
attributes.description: The calendar date of the reserved fulfillment slot.

attributes.name: slot_end_time
attributes.description: The ending time of the reserved fulfillment window.

attributes.name: slot_fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee charged for reserving this specific slot, if applicable. May vary based on demand, time, or service level.

attributes.name: slot_start_time
attributes.description: The beginning time of the reserved fulfillment window.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this slot reservation record, used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided notes or special requests related to the slot reservation and fulfillment.

attributes.name: surge_pricing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surge pricing was applied to this slot reservation due to high demand or holiday periods.

products.name: payment_event
products.description: Commerce-layer record of each payment authorization, capture, void, or refund event initiated through the digital shopping flow. Captures transaction type, amount, currency, tender type (credit, debit, EBT, SNAP, WIC, loyalty points, gift card), authorization code, processor response code, transaction timestamp, digital order reference, payment token reference (FK to payment domain), and settlement status. This product exists solely for checkout UX state management, order confirmation display, and digital channel conversion analytics. The payment domain is the authoritative SSOT for payment processing lifecycle, tokenization, PCI compliance, and settlement — commerce does not duplicate that responsibility.

attributes.name: payment_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_event

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original authorization transaction for capture, void, or refund events. Links related payment events in the transaction chain.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital commerce order that initiated this payment event. Links payment event to the order header in the digital shopping flow.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who initiated this payment. Links to the customer master for analytics and personalization.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront where this payment event occurred. Links to the commerce platform configuration.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer's digital session during which this payment event occurred. Used for conversion funnel analysis.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Approval code returned by the payment processor or issuing bank when the transaction is authorized. Used for settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: avs_response_code
attributes.description: Response code from the Address Verification System indicating whether the billing address provided matches the address on file with the card issuer.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Card network or brand for card-based payments (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover). Null for non-card tender types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment event record was first created in the commerce system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: cvv_response_code
attributes.description: Response code indicating whether the CVV/CVC security code provided matches the card issuer's records. Used for fraud prevention.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason the transaction was declined by the processor or issuer (insufficient funds, invalid card, fraud suspicion, etc.).

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the device used to initiate the payment. Used for fraud detection and device fingerprinting.

attributes.name: ebt_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) card after this transaction. Null for non-EBT transactions.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction was flagged as potentially fraudulent by automated fraud detection systems.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Risk score assigned by fraud detection system indicating the likelihood this transaction is fraudulent. Higher scores indicate higher risk.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance_remaining
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the gift card after this transaction. Null for non-gift-card tender types.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address of the device that initiated the payment transaction. Used for fraud detection and geolocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment event record was last updated. Tracks changes to transaction status or settlement information.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed as part of this payment transaction. Null if no points were used.

attributes.name: merchant_account_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the merchant account used to process this transaction. Multiple accounts may be used for different brands or regions.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Digital channel or interface through which the payment was initiated (web storefront, mobile app, mobile web, in-store kiosk, call center).

attributes.name: payment_gateway
