attributes.description: Name or identifier of the payment gateway or processor that handled this transaction (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Cybersource).

attributes.name: payment_token_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the tokenized payment instrument in the payment domain. The payment domain is the authoritative SSOT for tokenization and PCI compliance.

attributes.name: processor_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by the payment gateway or processor indicating the outcome of the transaction attempt (approved, declined, error codes).

attributes.name: processor_response_message
attributes.description: Human-readable message from the payment processor describing the transaction outcome or reason for decline.

attributes.name: processor_transaction_ref
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: retry_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which retry attempt this is for the same payment. First attempt is 1, subsequent retries increment.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the transaction was settled and funds were transferred. Null for unsettled transactions.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of funds settlement with the payment processor. Indicates whether the transaction has been finalized and funds transferred.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the transaction amount that qualifies for SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits. Null for non-SNAP transactions.

attributes.name: tender_type
attributes.description: Payment instrument type used for this transaction. Includes credit card, debit card, EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer), SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program), WIC (Women Infants and Children Program), loyalty points, or gift card.

attributes.name: three_d_secure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether 3D Secure authentication (Verified by Visa, Mastercard SecureCode) was used for this transaction. Enhances security and shifts liability.

attributes.name: three_d_secure_version
attributes.description: Version of 3D Secure protocol used (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 2.1). Null if 3D Secure was not used.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of this payment event. For authorizations and captures, this is the gross amount; for refunds, this is the amount being returned.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment transaction event in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from initiation through settlement or failure.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment event was initiated in the digital commerce flow. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of payment event: authorization (hold funds), capture (settle funds), void (cancel authorization), refund (return funds), partial_refund (return portion), or reversal (undo transaction).

attributes.name: wic_eligible_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the transaction amount that qualifies for WIC (Women Infants and Children Program) benefits. Null for non-WIC transactions.

products.name: search_query
products.description: Captures each product search event executed by a shopper on a digital storefront. Records query string, storefront, session reference, timestamp, result count returned, zero-results flag, applied filters (category, brand, dietary), sort order selected, and whether the shopper clicked a result or refined the query. Supports search relevance tuning, zero-result remediation, and digital merchandising decisions.
products.reference: Site Search Event / Digital Search Log

attributes.name: search_query_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each product search query event executed by a shopper on a digital storefront.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated shopper who executed the search. Null for guest users.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store selected by the shopper for fulfillment context, if applicable to the search session.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront where the search was executed.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shopper session during which the search was performed, enabling session-level analytics and journey tracking.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: The A/B test variant or experiment group assigned to this search event, enabling controlled testing of search algorithms and merchandising strategies.

attributes.name: added_to_cart_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the shopper added any product to their cart as a result of this search, measuring search conversion effectiveness.

attributes.name: autocomplete_suggestion
attributes.description: The autocomplete suggestion selected by the shopper, if applicable.

attributes.name: autocomplete_used_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the shopper selected a suggestion from the autocomplete dropdown rather than typing the full query.

attributes.name: clicked_position
attributes.description: The position (rank) of the clicked product in the search results list, used to measure relevance quality.

attributes.name: clicked_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the first product clicked by the shopper from the search results, if any.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this search query record was created in the system.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the shopper to perform the search.

attributes.name: filter_brand_applied
attributes.description: The brand filter applied by the shopper to narrow search results, if any.

attributes.name: filter_category_applied
attributes.description: The product category filter applied by the shopper to narrow search results, if any.

attributes.name: filter_dietary_applied
attributes.description: Dietary or nutritional filters applied by the shopper (e.g., organic, gluten-free, vegan, low-sodium) to narrow search results.

attributes.name: filter_price_max
attributes.description: The maximum price threshold applied by the shopper as a filter, if any.

attributes.name: filter_price_min
attributes.description: The minimum price threshold applied by the shopper as a filter, if any.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the search was executed, used for fraud detection and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: The locale or language setting of the shopper at the time of search (e.g., en-US, es-MX), affecting search relevance and merchandising.

attributes.name: normalized_query_string
attributes.description: The search query after normalization processing (lowercased, stemmed, stop-words removed) used for relevance matching and analytics.

attributes.name: personalization_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether personalized ranking or filtering was applied to the search results based on shopper profile or behavior.

attributes.name: query_refined_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the shopper refined or modified the search query after viewing initial results, signaling potential relevance issues.

attributes.name: query_string
attributes.description: The raw search text entered by the shopper, capturing the exact keywords or phrases used to find products.

attributes.name: refined_query_string
attributes.description: The subsequent search query entered by the shopper if they refined their original search.

attributes.name: result_clicked_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the shopper clicked on any product from the search results, measuring search effectiveness.

attributes.name: result_count
attributes.description: The total number of product results returned by the search engine for this query.

attributes.name: search_channel
attributes.description: The digital channel through which the search was executed (e.g., web browser, mobile app, mobile web, in-store kiosk).

attributes.name: search_engine_version
attributes.description: The version of the search engine or algorithm used to process this query, enabling A/B testing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: search_method
attributes.description: The method used by the shopper to initiate the search (e.g., text input, voice search, barcode scan, image search).

attributes.name: search_response_time_ms
attributes.description: The time in milliseconds taken by the search engine to return results, used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: search_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the shopper executed the search query.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: The sort order selected by the shopper to organize search results (e.g., relevance, price ascending, price descending, newest arrivals). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: relevance|price_low_to_high|price_high_to_low|newest|best_selling|customer_rating|alphabetical — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The source system or platform that captured this search event (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, custom eCommerce platform).

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The user agent string of the browser or application used to perform the search, providing device and browser details.

attributes.name: zero_results_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the search returned no results, critical for identifying search relevance gaps and merchandising opportunities.

products.name: product_recommendation
products.description: Operational record of a product recommendation presented to a shopper on a digital storefront, generated by the personalization engine. Captures recommendation context (homepage, PDP, cart, checkout), recommended SKU, recommendation algorithm/model version, display position, impression timestamp, click flag, add-to-cart flag, and conversion flag. Enables A/B testing of recommendation strategies and measurement of digital merchandising lift.

attributes.name: product_recommendation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product recommendation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category to which the recommended product belongs.

attributes.name: merchandising_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandising or promotional campaign associated with this recommendation, if applicable.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the order in which the recommended product was purchased, if conversion occurred.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shopper to whom the recommendation was presented.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the digital storefront where the recommendation was displayed.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital browsing session during which the recommendation was presented.

attributes.name: ab_test_variant
attributes.description: Identifier of the A/B test variant or experiment group to which this recommendation belongs, enabling testing of recommendation strategies.

attributes.name: add_to_cart_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper added the recommended product to their cart (True if added, False otherwise).

attributes.name: add_to_cart_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recommended product was added to the cart, if applicable.

attributes.name: algorithm
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the personalization algorithm or strategy used to generate the recommendation.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name of the recommended product.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The digital channel through which the recommendation was delivered to the shopper.

attributes.name: click_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper clicked on the recommended product (True if clicked, False otherwise).

attributes.name: click_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shopper clicked on the recommendation, if applicable.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: The page or context within the digital storefront where the recommendation was displayed.

attributes.name: control_group_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recommendation was part of a control group in an A/B test (True for control, False for treatment).

attributes.name: conversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shopper purchased the recommended product (True if purchased, False otherwise).

attributes.name: conversion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recommended product was purchased, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recommendation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the display price.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the shopper when the recommendation was presented.

attributes.name: display_position
attributes.description: The ordinal position where the recommendation was displayed on the page (1 for first position, 2 for second, etc.).

attributes.name: display_price
attributes.description: The price of the recommended product as displayed to the shopper at the time of the recommendation.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recommendation is no longer considered valid or relevant for tracking purposes.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the shoppers location at the time of the recommendation, if available.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the shoppers location at the time of the recommendation, if available.

attributes.name: impression_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the recommendation was displayed to the shopper.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the shopper at the time of the recommendation impression, used for fraud detection and analytics.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recommendation record was last updated.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the machine learning model or recommendation engine that generated this recommendation.

attributes.name: promotion_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a promotional discount was applied to the recommended product at the time of display.

attributes.name: recommendation_number
attributes.description: Business-friendly reference number for the recommendation event, used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: recommendation_source
attributes.description: The origin or system that generated the recommendation, distinguishing between automated and manual recommendations.

attributes.name: recommendation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recommendation indicating shopper interaction level.

attributes.name: recommendation_type
attributes.description: The category or methodology of the recommendation strategy employed.

attributes.name: recommended_product_name
attributes.description: The display name of the recommended product as shown to the shopper.

attributes.name: recommended_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the product that was recommended to the shopper.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Confidence or relevance score assigned by the recommendation engine, indicating predicted likelihood of shopper interest.

attributes.name: time_on_page_seconds
attributes.description: The number of seconds the shopper spent on the page where the recommendation was displayed.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: The browser or application user agent string captured at the time of the recommendation impression.

products.name: order_status_event
products.description: Immutable event log of each status transition for a digital order, supporting shopper notifications and operational SLA tracking. Captures event type (placed, confirmed, picking_started, ready_for_pickup, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, refund_initiated), event timestamp, triggered_by (system, associate, shopper), store or MFC location, and notification sent flag. Enables real-time order tracking in the shopper app and SLA breach detection.
products.reference: Order Status Event / Order Lifecycle Event

attributes.name: order_status_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order_status_event

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the specific actor (associate ID, shopper ID, system process ID, or carrier ID) who triggered this status transition.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery carrier or logistics provider associated with this status event. Applicable for delivery and shipping fulfillment channels.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital order that experienced this status transition. Links to the parent order header.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: The store, Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC), or Distribution Center (DC) where this status transition occurred.

attributes.name: web_session_id
attributes.description: The application session identifier during which this status transition was recorded. Used for technical troubleshooting and audit trails.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this event record was first created in the system. This is the system record creation time, distinct from the business event_timestamp.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the mobile device or terminal that recorded this status transition event. Used for audit and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes the order spent in the previous status before this transition. Used for operational efficiency analysis and bottleneck identification.

attributes.name: estimated_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The estimated date and time when the order will reach its final delivered or ready_for_pickup state. Updated dynamically as the order progresses.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the status transition event occurred in the order lifecycle. This is the business event time, not the system record creation time.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: The specific status transition type that occurred. Represents the new state the order moved into during this event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: placed|confirmed|picking_started|ready_for_pickup|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|refund_initiated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: The standardized code representing the type of exception that occurred during this status transition. Null if no exception occurred.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exception or issue that occurred during this status transition. Null if no exception occurred.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was associated with an operational exception or issue requiring attention.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The order fulfillment method associated with this status event. Indicates whether the order is for curbside pickup, last-mile delivery (LMD), or ship-to-home.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate where this status transition occurred. Captured from mobile devices for delivery events.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate where this status transition occurred. Captured from mobile devices for delivery events.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: The type of fulfillment location where this status transition occurred. MFC refers to Micro-Fulfillment Center, DC refers to Distribution Center.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The order status after this transition event. Matches the event_type in most cases.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text notes or comments recorded by the actor at the time of this status transition. Used for operational context and issue documentation.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the shopper of this status transition. Push refers to mobile app push notification.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification was successfully sent for this status transition event. Used for shopper app real-time tracking.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer notification was sent for this status event. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The order status immediately before this transition event. Null for the initial 'placed' event.

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred within the SLA target window. Used for operational SLA breach detection and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this status transition should have occurred to meet the service level agreement commitment to the customer.

attributes.name: sla_variance_minutes
attributes.description: The difference in minutes between the actual event timestamp and the SLA target timestamp. Negative values indicate early completion, positive values indicate SLA breach.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the operational system that generated this status event record. Examples include OMS (Order Management System), WMS (Warehouse Management System), TMS (Transportation Management System).

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The unique transaction or event identifier from the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number for shipment visibility. Applicable for out_for_delivery and delivered events.

attributes.name: triggered_by
attributes.description: The actor type that initiated this status transition. Indicates whether the event was automated or human-initiated.

products.name: channel_config
products.description: Configuration master for each digital channel (web, iOS app, Android app, kiosk), capturing feature toggles, supported fulfillment methods, minimum order amounts, accepted tender types, loyalty integration flags, age-verification requirements, SNAP/EBT acceptance flag, maximum cart item count, and channel-specific SLA targets. Drives runtime behavior of the Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront and OMS routing logic.

attributes.name: channel_config_id
attributes.description: Primary key for channel_config

attributes.name: catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital catalog assigned to this channel. Determines which products are available for browsing and purchase.

attributes.name: price_book_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the price book used for this channel. Determines pricing rules and promotional pricing logic.

attributes.name: storefront_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital storefront that this channel configuration applies to. Links to the storefront master data.

attributes.name: accepted_tender_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment tender types accepted on this channel (e.g., credit_card, debit_card, gift_card, paypal, apple_pay, google_pay, ebt, snap, wic).

attributes.name: age_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether age verification is required for purchases on this channel (e.g., for alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy items).

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url

attributes.description: Base API endpoint URL for this channel. Used by mobile apps and integrations to connect to backend services.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the digital channel (e.g., WEB_US, IOS_APP, ANDROID_APP, KIOSK).

attributes.name: channel_config_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the digital channel configuration.

attributes.name: channel_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the digital channel (e.g., Web Storefront, iOS Mobile App, Android Mobile App, In-Store Kiosk).

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the digital channel platform type.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Customer support email address for inquiries related to this channel.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Customer support phone number for inquiries related to this channel.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for pricing and transactions on this channel (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel accepts Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payments for government assistance programs.

attributes.name: feature_toggles
attributes.description: JSON or comma-separated list of feature flags and their enabled/disabled state for this channel (e.g., enable_voice_search=true, enable_ar_preview=false). Drives runtime behavior.

attributes.name: fulfillment_methods_supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment methods available on this channel (e.g., delivery, pickup, curbside, in_store, ship_to_home). Drives OMS routing logic.

attributes.name: guest_checkout_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers can complete purchases without creating an account (guest checkout) on this channel.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this channel configuration record was last updated.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the digital channel was first made available to customers.

attributes.name: locale_code
attributes.description: Locale identifier for language and regional formatting (e.g., en_US, es_MX, fr_CA). Drives localization behavior.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the loyalty program integrated with this channel. Null if no loyalty integration.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_integrated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loyalty program is integrated and active on this channel, allowing customers to earn and redeem points.

attributes.name: maximum_cart_item_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of distinct line items (SKUs) allowed in a single cart on this channel. Enforces cart size limits.

attributes.name: minimum_age_required
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to use this channel or purchase age-restricted items. Typically 18 or 21 depending on jurisdiction and product category.

attributes.name: minimum_order_amount
attributes.description: Minimum order subtotal required for checkout on this channel. Used to enforce order minimums for delivery or pickup.

attributes.name: personalization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether personalized product recommendations and content are enabled on this channel.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Operating system or platform on which the channel operates (iOS, Android, Web Desktop, Web Mobile, Windows, Linux).

attributes.name: promotion_engine_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion engine is active on this channel, allowing application of discounts, coupons, and promotional offers.

attributes.name: search_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product search functionality is enabled on this channel.

attributes.name: sla_target_delivery_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Delivery Hours
attributes.description: Target time in hours for order delivery from order placement to customer receipt for this channel. Used for service level commitments.

attributes.name: sla_target_order_processing_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Order Processing Minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for order processing from submission to fulfillment assignment for this channel. Used for performance monitoring.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel accepts SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payments.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product substitutions are allowed by default on this channel when items are out of stock during fulfillment.

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the digital channel will be or was decommissioned. Null for active channels with no planned sunset.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction code for calculating sales tax on transactions in this channel. Used for tax compliance.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the channel (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for scheduling and time display.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel accepts WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program vouchers or EBT.

products.name: product_item
products.description: Core master record and single source of truth for every sellable item in the Grocery catalog — CPG products, private-label brands, fresh produce, pharmacy drug items, and fuel grades. Stores the authoritative item description, brand reference, pack size, unit of measure, item status (active/discontinued/seasonal), item type (grocery/produce/pharmacy/fuel), temperature class (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), HACCP classification, FDA labeling flag, organic certification flag, USDA grade, private-label indicator, and source system reference. Extended by sku (identification codes and sellable units), drug_item (pharmacy attributes), fuel_grade (fuel center attributes), item_attribute (extensible regulatory/compliance flags), and nutritional_info (FDA nutrition/allergen data). Sourced from Oracle Retail Item Management and SAP MM Material Master.
products.reference: Oracle Retail Item Master / SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product item. Primary key for the product_item entity.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: FK to product.brand

attributes.name: created_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Item Master Data creation audit requires tracking which associate entered the new product_item; used in compliance and merchandising performance reports.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_fuel_grade. Business justification: Fuel grade is a product attribute for fuel items; FK enables lookup.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.item_hierarchy. Business justification: Product items belong to a hierarchy; linking provides parent classification.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Tracks which legal entity owns/liabilities for a product, needed for entity‑level financial reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: plu_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plu_code. Business justification: PLU codes are managed centrally; replace string with FK.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Sourcing teams designate a primary supplier per item for purchase order generation and cost negotiations.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item requires age verification at point-of-sale (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain pharmacy items).
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: allergen_information
attributes.description: List of major allergens contained in or potentially cross-contaminated with the product (e.g., milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish). Required for FDA labeling compliance.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of sellable units contained in one case. Used for warehouse receiving, putaway, and replenishment planning.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Unit cost paid to the supplier or manufacturer. Used for margin calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the item was manufactured or grown. Required for customs and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this item record was discontinued or became inactive. Null for currently active items.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this item record became active and available for ordering and sale.

attributes.name: fda_labeling_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Labeling Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item requires FDA-compliant nutrition facts labeling and ingredient disclosure.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number assigned by GS1 for international product identification. May be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on packaging level.

attributes.name: haccp_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Classification
attributes.description: HACCP risk classification for food safety management. Identifies critical control points for temperature, handling, and contamination prevention.

attributes.name: height_inches
attributes.description: Height dimension of the item package in inches. Used for planogram design and space allocation.

attributes.name: ingredient_statement
attributes.description: Complete list of ingredients in descending order by weight. Required for FDA-regulated food products.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Full business description of the sellable item as it appears in merchandising systems and customer-facing channels.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the item in the product catalog. Determines availability for ordering and replenishment.

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the item by department or operational area. Determines handling, storage, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: length_inches
attributes.description: Length dimension of the item package in inches. Used for planogram design and space allocation.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or supplier who produces the item. Used for vendor management and sourcing.

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this item. Typically 18 or 21 for age-restricted products.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic by USDA or equivalent certifying body.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Size or quantity of the product package (e.g., 12 oz, 1 gallon, 6-pack). Used for merchandising and pricing.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: Price Look-Up code used primarily for fresh produce and bulk items at point-of-sale. Typically 4 or 5 digits.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is a store-owned private-label brand product rather than a national CPG brand.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the item remains sellable from receipt date. Critical for perishable inventory management and shrink reduction.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal Stock Keeping Unit code used for inventory management, replenishment, and warehouse operations. Unique within the retailer's system.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is eligible for purchase using SNAP/EBT benefits.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this item master data originates (e.g., Oracle Retail, SAP MM).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this item in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: suggested_retail_price

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales tax applies to this item at point-of-sale. Tax treatment varies by jurisdiction and item category.

attributes.name: temperature_class

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for inventory tracking and ordering. Standard units include each, case, pound, ounce, gallon, liter, kilogram, gram. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pound|ounce|gallon|liter|kilogram|gram — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc

attributes.name: usda_grade

attributes.description: USDA quality grade for meat, poultry, dairy, and produce items (e.g., Prime, Choice, Select for beef; Grade A for eggs).

attributes.name: weight_pounds
attributes.description: Weight of the item in pounds. Used for shipping cost calculation and transportation planning.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WIC (Women Infants and Children Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is approved for purchase under the WIC program.

attributes.name: width_inches
attributes.description: Width dimension of the item package in inches. Used for planogram design and space allocation.

products.name: sku
products.description: Retailer-assigned Stock Keeping Unit representing a unique item-pack-location combination for inventory and sales tracking. Stores SKU code, parent item reference, retailer item number, vendor item number, case pack quantity, inner pack quantity, selling unit of measure, catch-weight flag, variable-weight flag, shelf life days, and SKU status (active/inactive/discontinued). Serves as the authoritative single source of truth for all item identification codes including UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, GTIN-14, GS1 DataBar barcodes (with barcode type, barcode value, GS1 company prefix, check digit, primary barcode flag, effective date range) and PLU codes (IFPS standard PLU, commodity type, variety, organic flag per 9-prefix convention, size/grade). Bridges the item master to store-level assortment, inventory positions, and POS transactions. Supports POS scanning, receiving, EDI transactions, manual PLU entry for produce and bulk items, and multi-barcode lookup for items with multiple packaging configurations. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System and IFPS.
products.reference: Oracle Retail SKU / SAP MM SKU

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Created By Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: SKU generation is performed by a merchandising associate; tracking creator supports audit of SKU assignments and error resolution.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent item master record in the product catalog. Links SKU to the base product definition.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: SKU master data includes a default supplier to streamline PO creation and inventory replenishment.

attributes.name: alcohol_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is an alcoholic beverage requiring age verification and special licensing. True for beer, wine, and spirits.

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode symbology used for this SKU. Determines scanning compatibility and data capacity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UPC-A|UPC-E|EAN-13|EAN-8|GTIN-14|GS1-128|GS1 DataBar — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of selling units contained in a case pack for receiving and distribution. Used for warehouse replenishment and DSD deliveries.

attributes.name: catch_weight_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is sold by variable weight with price calculated at time of sale. True for meat, seafood, deli, and produce items sold by weight.

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: Single-digit checksum calculated from the barcode to ensure scanning accuracy. Validates UPC, EAN, and GTIN integrity at POS and receiving.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Classification of produce or bulk commodity type per IFPS standards. Used for PLU assignment and produce category management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and new item tracking.

attributes.name: ean_code
attributes.description: 13-digit EAN-13 barcode identifier used internationally. Superset of UPC, used for global product identification and cross-border trade.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU is discontinued or removed from active assortment. Null for ongoing items. Used for markdown planning and inventory liquidation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU becomes active and available for sale. Used for new item introductions and seasonal assortment planning.

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to FDA labeling and safety regulations. True for food, beverage, dietary supplements, and OTC drugs.

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: GS1-assigned company prefix portion of the GTIN, identifying the brand owner or manufacturer. Used for barcode validation and supplier identification.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit GTIN identifier used for case and pallet level tracking in supply chain and distribution. Includes packaging hierarchy information.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage, or transportation. True for items with flammable, corrosive, or toxic components.

attributes.name: inner_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of selling units contained in an inner pack within a case. Used for shelf replenishment and inventory control.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is certified organic per USDA standards. True for products meeting organic certification requirements. Corresponds to PLU codes starting with 9.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: 4 or 5-digit PLU code used for fresh produce, bulk items, and variable-weight products. Follows IFPS standard. 5-digit codes starting with 9 indicate organic products.

attributes.name: primary_barcode_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is the primary identifier for POS scanning. True if this is the default barcode, False for alternate barcodes.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a store-owned brand product. True for private label, False for national brands and CPG products.

attributes.name: retailer_item_number
attributes.description: Internal item number assigned by the retailer for merchandising and procurement purposes. May differ from SKU code in multi-location or multi-pack scenarios.

attributes.name: selling_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for customer-facing sales transactions. Determines how the item is priced and sold at POS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EACH|POUND|OUNCE|KILOGRAM|GRAM|LITER|GALLON|CASE|PACK — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the product remains sellable from receipt date. Critical for perishable inventory management, markdown planning, and FIFO rotation.

attributes.name: size_grade
attributes.description: Size or grade classification for produce and fresh items. Examples: Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large, Grade A. Used for pricing and quality differentiation.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Retailer-assigned unique alphanumeric code representing a specific item-pack-location combination for inventory and sales tracking. This is the primary business identifier used across POS, WMS, and merchandising systems.

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU. Active items are available for sale and replenishment. Inactive items are temporarily unavailable. Discontinued items are permanently removed from assortment.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (EBT). True for qualifying food items per USDA guidelines.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage and transportation temperature zone for this SKU. Critical for cold chain management and warehouse slotting.

attributes.name: tobacco_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a tobacco product requiring age verification and regulatory compliance. True for cigarettes, cigars, and vaping products.

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC-A barcode identifier used for POS scanning and inventory tracking. Primary barcode for most CPG products in North America.

attributes.name: variable_weight_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has variable weight for inventory tracking purposes. True for items where each unit may have different weight.

attributes.name: variety
attributes.description: Specific variety or sub-type of the commodity. Examples: Gala apples, Roma tomatoes, Russet potatoes. Used for produce differentiation and customer selection.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: Supplier or manufacturer assigned item number used for ordering, receiving, and EDI transactions. Critical for cross-referencing purchase orders and invoices.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is approved for WIC program purchases. True for items meeting WIC nutritional and category requirements.

products.name: item_hierarchy
products.description: Product classification hierarchy defining the multi-level taxonomy used for category management, merchandise planning, and financial reporting. Stores each node in the hierarchy (department, category, subcategory, segment, subsegment) with node code, node name, hierarchy level number, parent node reference, category captain vendor, GMROI target, and space allocation percentage. Supports planogram design, assortment optimization, ad circular planning, and COGS roll-up by category. Sourced from Oracle Retail Merchandising System.

attributes.name: item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each node in the product classification hierarchy. Primary key.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: owner_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Item Hierarchy Owner Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Hierarchy ownership determines planogram and space allocation; associate owner is tracked for labor planning and audit.

attributes.name: parent_node_item_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent node in the hierarchy tree. Null for top-level department nodes. Enables recursive hierarchy traversal and roll-up calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead vendor responsible for category management, assortment recommendations, and planogram design for this hierarchy node. Typically assigned at category or subcategory level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: age_restriction_years
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase items in this hierarchy node. Applies to alcohol, tobacco, and other age-restricted products. Enforced at POS with ID verification.
attributes.references: State Alcohol and Tobacco Control Regulations

attributes.name: average_unit_retail_price
attributes.description: Average retail price per unit for items in this hierarchy node. Used in pricing strategy, competitive analysis, and ASP (Average Selling Price) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: dsd_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are typically delivered via DSD (Direct Store Delivery) rather than through DC (Distribution Center). Affects receiving processes and vendor management.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node was discontinued or retired. Null for active nodes. Used for historical reporting and category lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node became active and available for use in assortment planning, reporting, and SKU assignment. Supports temporal hierarchy analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: endcap_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are suitable for endcap (end-of-aisle display) placement. Used in planogram design and promotional space allocation.

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) Regulated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are subject to FDA (Food and Drug Administration) regulation for food safety, labeling, or nutritional information disclosure.

attributes.name: gmroi_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in merchandise planning and performance evaluation. Calculated as (Gross Margin / Average Inventory Cost) * 100.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy tree. Typically: 1=Department, 2=Category, 3=Subcategory, 4=Segment, 5=Subsegment. Supports drill-down navigation and roll-up aggregation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_name
attributes.description: Business name for the hierarchy level. Standard retail taxonomy labels used in category management and merchandise planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: leaf_node_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a leaf (has no children). True for lowest-level nodes that directly contain SKUs (Stock Keeping Units). Used to optimize query performance.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: minimum_facings
attributes.description: Minimum number of product facings (product fronts visible on shelf) required for items in this hierarchy node. Used in planogram compliance and shelf stocking guidelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this hierarchy node. Used for audit trail and accountability in category management changes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hierarchy node. Used in planograms, assortment planning, and financial reporting. Examples: DEPT01, CAT-DAIRY, SUBCAT-MILK.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_depth
attributes.description: Distance from root node (0 for root). Used for hierarchy traversal algorithms and display indentation in user interfaces.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hierarchy node including scope, product types included, and merchandising guidelines.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the hierarchy node. Examples: Fresh Produce, Dairy Products, Organic Milk, Private Label Snacks.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to current node using node codes separated by forward slashes. Example: DEPT01/CAT-DAIRY/SUBCAT-MILK. Supports fast ancestor queries and breadcrumb navigation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy node. Active nodes are used in assortment planning and reporting. Inactive nodes are retained for historical analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node require USDA organic certification. Drives supplier qualification, labeling requirements, and premium pricing strategies.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are perishable (fresh produce, dairy, meat, bakery). Drives cold chain requirements, FIFO (First In First Out) handling, and shrink management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node contains primarily private-label (store-owned brand) products. Used for brand mix analysis and margin optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: promotional_category_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is frequently featured in ad circulars, BOGO (Buy One Get One) promotions, and TPR (Temporary Price Reduction) campaigns. Used in promotional planning.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: replenishment_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard replenishment cycle in days for items in this hierarchy node. Used in CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering) and DC (Distribution Center) planning.

attributes.name: seasonality_pattern
attributes.description: Primary seasonality pattern for demand in this hierarchy node. Used in seasonal assortment planning, inventory forecasting, and promotional calendar development.

attributes.name: shrink_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Expected shrink (inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage) rate percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in inventory valuation, loss prevention planning, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Inventory Control

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are eligible for purchase using SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) or EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) benefits. Required for POS (Point of Sale) transaction processing.

attributes.name: space_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of total store shelf space allocated to this hierarchy node. Used in planogram design and space productivity analysis. Sum of all categories should equal 100% at store level.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_percentage
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this hierarchy node. Used in pricing decisions, vendor negotiations, and financial planning. Calculated as ((Retail Price - Cost) / Retail Price) * 100.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for storing and displaying items in this hierarchy node. Drives cold chain logistics, WMS (Warehouse Management System) slotting, and HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WIC (Women Infants and Children) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this hierarchy node are eligible for purchase using WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits. Required for POS transaction processing and state reporting.

products.name: upc_barcode
products.description: Universal Product Code and barcode registry for all items. Stores UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, GTIN-14, and GS1 DataBar codes associated with each SKU, including barcode type, barcode value, GS1 company prefix, check digit, primary barcode flag, and effective date range. Supports POS scanning, receiving, and EDI transactions. Enables multi-barcode lookup for items with multiple packaging configurations.

attributes.name: upc_barcode_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the UPC barcode record. Primary key for the barcode registry.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU that this barcode represents. Links barcode to the master product catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who provided this barcode. Used for DSD receiving and vendor barcode compliance tracking.

attributes.name: barcode_image_url
attributes.description: URL to the stored barcode image file used for label printing and visual verification. Supports planogram and shelf label generation.

attributes.name: barcode_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the barcode. Active barcodes are scannable at POS and receiving. Recalled barcodes trigger alerts.

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: The barcode symbology standard used for this code. Determines the encoding format and scanning requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UPC-A|UPC-E|EAN-13|EAN-8|GTIN-14|GS1-128|GS1 DataBar — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: barcode_value
attributes.description: The numeric barcode value as encoded in the barcode symbol. Supports UPC-A (12 digits), UPC-E (8 digits), EAN-13 (13 digits), and GTIN-14 (14 digits).

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: The calculated check digit at the end of the barcode used to validate barcode accuracy during scanning. Computed using GS1 modulo-10 algorithm.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this barcode record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date this barcode is discontinued and should no longer be accepted. Null for active barcodes with no planned discontinuation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date this barcode becomes active and scannable in POS and warehouse systems. Supports phased product launches and barcode transitions.

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: The GS1-assigned company prefix portion of the barcode that identifies the brand owner or manufacturer. Used for vendor identification and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The standardized Global Trade Item Number assigned by GS1. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14 depending on product packaging level.

attributes.name: is_age_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires age verification at POS (alcohol, tobacco, pharmacy items). Triggers ID check prompt.
attributes.references: FDA and State Alcohol Control Regulations

attributes.name: is_coupon_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is eligible for manufacturer or store coupon redemption. Used for POS coupon validation.

attributes.name: is_pharmacy_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is for a pharmacy prescription or over-the-counter drug item requiring special handling and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DEA and State Board of Pharmacy Regulations

attributes.name: is_primary_barcode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary barcode for the SKU. Used when a product has multiple barcodes for different packaging configurations.

attributes.name: is_snap_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using SNAP EBT benefits. Required for government program compliance.

attributes.name: is_store_brand
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode is for a private-label or store-owned brand product. Used for private label reporting and margin analysis.

attributes.name: is_variable_weight
attributes.description: Indicates whether this barcode includes embedded weight or price information for random-weight items like fresh produce and deli products.

attributes.name: is_wic_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Must match state WIC approved product lists.

attributes.name: item_reference
attributes.description: The item reference portion of the GTIN assigned by the brand owner to uniquely identify the product within their company prefix.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this barcode record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: last_scanned_date
attributes.description: The most recent date this barcode was scanned at POS or in warehouse operations. Used to identify inactive or obsolete barcodes.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: The FDA National Drug Code for pharmacy items. Used for prescription processing and drug inventory management. Null for non-pharmacy items.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: The packaging hierarchy level this barcode represents. Each represents consumer unit, Case represents distribution unit, Pallet represents logistics unit.

attributes.name: packaging_quantity
attributes.description: The number of consumer units contained in this packaging level. For Each level this is 1, for Case it represents units per case.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: The 4 or 5 digit PLU code used for fresh produce and bulk items that are not pre-packaged. Used at POS for manual entry when barcode is not available.

attributes.name: scan_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this barcode has been scanned across all POS and warehouse systems. Used for barcode usage analytics.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that provided this barcode data. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with vendor-provided barcode information.
attributes.value_regex: Oracle Retail|SAP MM|EDI|Vendor Portal|Manual Entry|GS1 Registry

products.name: plu_code
products.description: Price Look-Up code registry for fresh produce, bulk items, and variable-weight products not identified by UPC. Stores PLU code (IFPS standard), item description, commodity type, variety, organic flag (9-prefix convention), size/grade, and effective date. Used at POS for manual entry of produce and deli items. Sourced from IFPS (International Federation for Produce Standards) and store operations.

attributes.name: plu_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PLU code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary vendor or supplier for this item. Links to vendor master data for procurement and supply chain management.

attributes.name: allergen_info
attributes.description: Free-text field listing any allergens present in or associated with the item (e.g., 'Contains tree nuts', 'May contain traces of peanuts'). Required for FDA allergen labeling compliance and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: average_weight
attributes.description: The average weight per unit for items sold by each (e.g., average weight of one apple). Used for inventory estimation and yield calculations. Null for items sold strictly by weight.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: The product category code within the department (e.g., 'FRUIT', 'VEGETABLE', 'HERB', 'NUT'). Used for merchandising hierarchy and analytics.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The broad commodity category for the item (e.g., 'Apples', 'Bananas', 'Tomatoes', 'Nuts', 'Cheese'). Used for category management and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The current cost per unit of measure paid to the supplier. Used for margin calculation and GMROI analysis. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was grown or produced (e.g., 'USA', 'MEX', 'CHL'). Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this PLU code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the price (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'MXN'). Required for multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The store department code where this item is merchandised (e.g., 'PRODUCE', 'DELI', 'BAKERY', 'BULK'). Used for sales reporting and category management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this PLU code and its associated pricing became effective. Used for price change tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this PLU code or pricing is scheduled to expire or be replaced. Null if no expiration is planned. Used for seasonal item management and price change scheduling.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item carries Fair Trade certification. True if certified, False otherwise. Used for marketing, customer transparency, and ethical sourcing reporting.

attributes.name: gmo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is a genetically modified organism or contains GMO ingredients. True if GMO, False if non-GMO or GMO-free. Used for labeling compliance and customer transparency.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage for this item, calculated as (price - cost) / price * 100. Used for profitability analysis and category management. Business-confidential financial metric.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the product image used for digital signage, eCommerce, and mobile app display. Supports omnichannel customer experience.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the produce or bulk item (e.g., 'Fuji Apples', 'Organic Bananas', 'Bulk Almonds').

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this PLU code record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: locally_sourced_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is sourced from local farms or suppliers within a defined geographic radius. True if locally sourced, False otherwise. Used for marketing and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: nutritional_info
attributes.description: Free-text or structured field containing key nutritional facts (calories, fat, carbohydrates, protein, vitamins per serving). Used for customer information and FDA nutrition labeling compliance.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic. True if organic (typically PLU codes starting with 9), False otherwise. Used for pricing, labeling, and compliance with USDA organic certification requirements.

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: The 4-digit or 5-digit PLU code assigned to the item. 5-digit codes starting with 9 indicate organic products per IFPS convention. This is the externally-known unique identifier used at POS for manual entry.

attributes.name: plu_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PLU code. Active codes are available for sale; inactive codes are temporarily unavailable; discontinued codes are permanently removed; seasonal codes are available only during specific periods.

attributes.name: pos_display_name
attributes.description: The abbreviated or formatted name displayed on POS terminals and customer receipts. May differ from the full item description for space constraints.

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: The current selling price per unit of measure (e.g., price per pound, price per each). Used by POS systems to calculate transaction totals for variable-weight items.

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Free-text description of the seasonal availability window for this item (e.g., 'Summer only', 'Year-round', 'Fall harvest'). Used for assortment planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The typical shelf life of the item in days from receipt to expected spoilage or quality degradation. Used for inventory rotation, FIFO management, and shrink reduction. Critical for perishable produce management.

attributes.name: size_grade
attributes.description: The size or grade classification of the item (e.g., 'Small', 'Medium', 'Large', 'Extra Large', 'Grade A'). Used for pricing differentiation and customer selection.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grading Standards

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). True if eligible, False otherwise. Required for EBT transaction processing compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: storage_temperature_requirement
attributes.description: The required storage temperature zone for this item (ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for cold chain, frozen for sub-zero). Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Cold Chain Requirements

attributes.name: subcategory_code
attributes.description: The product subcategory code for finer classification (e.g., 'APPLE', 'CITRUS', 'LEAFY_GREEN'). Supports detailed category management and assortment planning.

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales tax applies to this item. True if taxable, False if tax-exempt. Tax treatment varies by jurisdiction and product type (e.g., fresh produce may be tax-exempt in some states).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the item is sold and priced (e.g., 'each' for individual items, 'pound' for weight-based pricing). Critical for POS transaction processing and pricing calculation.

attributes.name: variety
attributes.description: The specific variety or cultivar of the commodity (e.g., 'Fuji', 'Gala', 'Honeycrisp' for apples; 'Roma', 'Beefsteak' for tomatoes). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag

products.name: item_attribute
products.description: Extensible attribute store and single source of truth for item-level business, regulatory, and compliance attributes that vary by item type and cannot be anticipated at schema design time. Captures attribute name, attribute value, attribute data type, attribute group (regulatory, certification, physical, marketing, sustainability), unit of measure, certifying body, certification number, source system, effective date, and expiration date. Stores all regulatory compliance flags including SNAP/WIC/EBT eligibility, FDA bioengineered food disclosure, organic certification, non-GMO verification, gluten-free certification, kosher/halal certifications, fair-trade status, USDA grade designations, country of origin, and compliance status. Enables flexible attribute extension without schema changes. Note: structured nutritional facts and allergen declarations are owned by nutritional_info; this product handles all other regulatory flags and certifications. Sourced from vendor GS1 Sync data, certifying bodies, and regulatory agencies.
products.reference: FDA Nutrition Labeling / GS1 Product Attributes

attributes.name: item_attribute_id
attributes.description: Primary key for item_attribute

attributes.name: maintained_by_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Item Attribute Maintained By Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Attribute maintenance is performed by a data steward associate; needed for data quality metrics and compliance checks.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent item (SKU, UPC, PLU, or drug item) to which this attribute applies. Links to the item master catalog.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attribute record is currently active and should be used for business operations. Supports soft delete and historical tracking.

attributes.name: age_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item has age restrictions for purchase (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain medications). Triggers POS age verification prompts.
attributes.references: State and Federal Age Restriction Laws

attributes.name: attribute_data_type

attributes.name: attribute_group
attributes.description: Categorical grouping of the attribute for organizational and filtering purposes. Includes regulatory compliance, certifications, physical characteristics, marketing claims, sustainability, nutritional facts, allergen information, and safety warnings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulatory|certification|physical|marketing|sustainability|nutritional|allergen|safety — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: attribute_name
