attributes.name: attribute_source_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier or document number from the source system or certifying body that provided this attribute value. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: attribute_value
attributes.description: The value of the attribute stored as a string. May represent text, numeric, boolean, or date values depending on attribute_data_type. Supports regulatory flags, certifications, and compliance indicators.

attributes.name: bioengineered_disclosure_flag

attributes.name: certification_number

attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide; USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: certifying_body

attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide; USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the attribute with respect to regulatory or certification requirements. Tracks whether the item meets the declared standard.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA Regulations

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification (Schedule I through V) for pharmacy items. Null for non-controlled substances. Required for pharmacy compliance and inventory controls.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The country where the item was produced, manufactured, or grown. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance for certain food categories.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: dsd_item_flag

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_flag

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this attribute value expires or is no longer valid. Null for attributes with indefinite validity. Critical for certification renewals and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified fair trade by Fair Trade USA or equivalent certifying body. Supports sustainability and ethical sourcing claims.

attributes.name: gluten_free_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified gluten-free by a recognized certifying body (e.g., GFCO, NSF). Required for gluten-free labeling claims under FDA regulations.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified halal by a recognized Islamic certifying body. Supports dietary preference filtering and marketing.

attributes.name: hazard_classification

attributes.description: The HACCP hazard classification for the item (e.g., biological, chemical, physical). Used for food safety risk assessment and supply chain controls.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified kosher by a recognized rabbinical authority (e.g., OU, OK, Star-K). Supports dietary preference filtering and marketing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this attribute record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_verified_date

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_age

attributes.name: non_gmo_verified_flag

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag

attributes.name: planogram_required_flag

attributes.name: prescription_required_flag

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is a store-owned private label brand product. Used for category management, margin analysis, and promotional planning.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days the item remains safe and suitable for consumption or use under proper storage conditions. Used for inventory rotation (FIFO) and markdown planning.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code; Internal Inventory Management Standards

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). Required for POS system configuration and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service SNAP Regulations

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The required temperature control zone for storage and transportation of the item. Critical for cold chain compliance and perishable inventory management.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: usda_grade
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Grade
attributes.description: The USDA quality grade assigned to the item (e.g., Prime, Choice, Select for beef; Grade A for eggs and dairy). Applicable to meat, poultry, dairy, and produce items.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Grading Standards

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Program Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for POS system configuration and state WIC program compliance.
attributes.references: USDA Food and Nutrition Service WIC Regulations

products.name: nutritional_info
products.description: FDA-mandated food compliance record serving as the single source of truth for nutritional facts, allergen declarations, and ingredient data for all food and beverage items. Stores serving size, servings per container, calories, total fat, saturated fat, trans fat, cholesterol, sodium, total carbohydrates, dietary fiber, total sugars, added sugars, protein, vitamins and minerals (D, calcium, iron, potassium), percent daily values, FDA compliance status, ingredient list, allergen type (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame per FALCPA), allergen presence indicator (contains/may contain/free-from), allergen declaration source, allergen verification date, and regulatory compliance flag. Supports FDA Nutrition Facts labeling requirements, FALCPA allergen compliance, digital nutrition and allergen display on eCommerce storefronts, customer dietary filtering, recall management for allergen-related incidents, and bioengineered food disclosure. Sourced from vendor-supplied GS1 Sync data and certifying bodies.

attributes.name: nutritional_info_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the nutritional information record. Primary key.

attributes.name: entered_by_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nutritional Info Entered By Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Nutrition label data entry is done by a compliance associate; required for FDA reporting and label accuracy audits.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) this nutritional information applies to. Links to the authoritative product catalog.

attributes.name: added_sugars_g
attributes.description: Added sugars content per serving, measured in grams. Mandatory disclosure per updated FDA Nutrition Facts label requirements (2016 rule).

attributes.name: allergen_declaration_text
attributes.description: Full allergen declaration statement as it appears on the product label, including 'Contains' and 'May Contain' statements. Used for customer-facing allergen disclosure on eCommerce and in-store digital displays.

attributes.name: allergen_eggs
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains eggs or egg-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_fish
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains fish or fish-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_milk
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains milk or milk-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: allergen_peanuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains peanuts or peanut-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_sesame
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains sesame or sesame-derived ingredients. Added as the 9th major allergen per FASTER Act (2021).
attributes.references: FDA FASTER Act (Food Allergy Safety, Treatment, Education, and Research Act)

attributes.name: allergen_shellfish
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains crustacean shellfish or shellfish-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_soybeans
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains soybeans or soy-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_tree_nuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains tree nuts (almonds, walnuts, cashews, etc.) or tree nut-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: allergen_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when allergen information was last verified by the vendor or certifying body. Critical for recall management and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: allergen_wheat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains wheat or wheat-derived ingredients. Part of FALCPA major food allergen declaration.

attributes.name: bioengineered_food_disclosure
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product contains bioengineered (genetically modified) ingredients, as required by USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: calcium_mg
attributes.description: Calcium content per serving, measured in milligrams. Mandatory micronutrient disclosure per FDA regulations.

attributes.name: calories
attributes.description: Total calories per serving, expressed in kilocalories (kcal). Mandatory field for FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: cholesterol_mg
attributes.description: Cholesterol content per serving, measured in milligrams. Required nutrient on FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source of the nutritional information data (vendor-supplied via GS1 Sync, laboratory analysis, USDA nutrient database, manual entry). Used for data quality assessment and audit trails.

attributes.name: dietary_fiber_g
attributes.description: Dietary fiber content per serving, measured in grams. Sub-component of total carbohydrates on FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this nutritional information record becomes effective and should be used for labeling and customer disclosure. Supports product reformulation and label change management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this nutritional information record is no longer valid, typically due to product reformulation or discontinuation. Nullable for current active records.

attributes.name: fda_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the nutritional information and labeling with FDA regulations. Used for regulatory auditing and product launch approval.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the trade item globally. Used for supply chain and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: ingredient_list
attributes.description: Complete list of ingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, as required by FDA labeling regulations. Used for allergen identification and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: iron_mg
attributes.description: Iron content per serving, measured in milligrams. Mandatory micronutrient disclosure per FDA regulations.

attributes.name: potassium_mg
attributes.description: Potassium content per serving, measured in milligrams. Mandatory micronutrient disclosure per updated FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: protein_g
attributes.description: Protein content per serving, measured in grams. Required macronutrient on FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional information record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this nutritional information record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: saturated_fat_g
attributes.description: Saturated fat content per serving, measured in grams. Required sub-component of total fat on FDA Nutrition Facts label.

attributes.name: serving_size
attributes.description: The standardized serving size for this product as defined by FDA regulations, expressed in common household measures (e.g., 1 cup, 2 tablespoons, 1 slice) and metric weight or volume.

attributes.name: serving_size_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the serving size (grams, milliliters, ounces, cups, tablespoons, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g|mg|kg|ml|l|oz|lb|cup|tbsp|tsp|slice|piece|container — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: servings_per_container
attributes.description: Number of servings contained in the package. Required by FDA for Nutrition Facts labeling.

attributes.name: sodium_mg
attributes.description: Sodium content per serving, measured in milligrams. Critical for dietary management and FDA labeling compliance.

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_g
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content per serving, measured in grams. Includes dietary fiber, sugars, and other carbohydrates.

attributes.name: total_fat_g
attributes.description: Total fat content per serving, measured in grams. Includes saturated, trans, polyunsaturated, and monounsaturated fats.

attributes.name: total_sugars_g
attributes.description: Total sugars content per serving, measured in grams. Includes naturally occurring and added sugars.

attributes.name: trans_fat_g
attributes.description: Trans fat content per serving, measured in grams. Mandatory disclosure per FDA regulations due to health impact.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code identifying the product for which nutritional information is provided. Used for barcode scanning and product identification at point of sale.

attributes.name: vitamin_d_mcg
attributes.description: Vitamin D content per serving, measured in micrograms. Mandatory micronutrient disclosure per updated FDA Nutrition Facts label.

products.name: allergen_declaration
products.description: Allergen and dietary compliance declarations for food items per FDA FALCPA (Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act) requirements. Stores the item reference, allergen type (milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame), presence indicator (contains/may contain/free-from), declaration source, verification date, and regulatory compliance flag. attributes.name: allergen_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the allergen declaration record. Primary key for the allergen declaration entity.

attributes.name: entered_by_associate_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Allergen declarations are entered by a quality associate; essential for allergen compliance reporting and consumer safety alerts.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product item (SKU) to which this allergen declaration applies. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: Type of allergen declared per FDA FALCPA major food allergen categories: milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame (added 2023). attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of third-party certification organization that validated the allergen-free claim (e.g., GFCO for gluten-free, FARE for allergen-free certification).

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the allergen certification, after which re-certification or re-validation is required.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or registration number issued by the certification body for allergen-free or allergen-controlled product claims.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory compliance status of the allergen declaration against FDA FALCPA requirements and labeling standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cross_contact_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of allergen cross-contact risk during manufacturing, processing, or handling based on facility design, cleaning procedures, and production scheduling.

attributes.name: detection_limit_ppm
attributes.description: Laboratory test detection limit for allergen presence expressed in parts per million (ppm), used for quantitative allergen testing and threshold determination.

attributes.name: digital_display_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this allergen declaration should be displayed on digital commerce channels (website, mobile app) for customer dietary filtering.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this allergen declaration becomes effective and applicable to product labeling and customer communication.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this allergen declaration expires or is superseded by a new declaration, typically due to formulation changes or supplier changes.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number for the product. Standard barcode identifier used for supply chain and point-of-sale scanning.

attributes.name: ingredient_source
attributes.description: Specific ingredient or component that is the source of the allergen (e.g., 'whey protein concentrate' for milk allergen, 'soy lecithin' for soybean allergen).

attributes.name: label_statement
attributes.description: Exact allergen statement text that appears on the product label or packaging, formatted per FDA requirements (e.g., 'Contains: Milk, Eggs, Wheat').

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this allergen declaration record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allergen declaration record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the allergen declaration, including formulation changes, supplier communications, or regulatory guidance.

attributes.name: precautionary_statement
attributes.description: Optional precautionary allergen statement used when cross-contact risk exists (e.g., 'May contain traces of peanuts', 'Processed in a facility that also processes tree nuts').

attributes.name: presence_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates the level of allergen presence: contains (ingredient), may_contain (cross-contact risk), free_from (certified absent), processed_in_facility (shared equipment warning).

attributes.name: annual_sales_target_amount
