attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), USDA Organic Regulations, State Pharmacy Board Requirements

attributes.name: social_media_handle
attributes.description: The primary social media handle or username for this private-label brand (e.g., '@GroceryEssentials'). Used for digital marketing campaigns and customer engagement tracking.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Third-party sustainability or ethical sourcing certification held by this private-label brand. None indicates no certification; other values represent specific certifications (Rainforest Alliance, Fair Trade, Non-GMO Project, USDA Organic, Marine Stewardship Council, Forest Stewardship Council). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|rainforest_alliance|fair_trade|non_gmo_project|usda_organic|msc_certified|fsc_certified — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project, Fair Trade USA, Rainforest Alliance, MSC, FSC

attributes.name: target_category
attributes.description: The primary product category or department this private-label brand is designed to serve (e.g., 'Dairy', 'Bakery', 'Frozen Foods', 'Health & Beauty', 'Pharmacy OTC'). Used for category management and assortment planning.

attributes.name: target_margin_percentage
attributes.description: The target gross margin percentage for products under this private-label brand, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.50 for 35.5%). Used for pricing strategy, vendor negotiations, and profitability analysis. Confidential business metric.
attributes.references: GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) Analysis

products.name: brand
products.description: Brand master registry and single source of truth for all brands sold across Grocery stores — including CPG manufacturer brands, regional brands, and Grocery's private-label store-owned brand portfolio. Stores brand name, brand owner (manufacturer or Grocery private-label), brand type (national/regional/private-label/generic), brand tier (premium/standard/value/organic), parent company, GS1 company prefix, brand status, country of origin, brand logo asset reference, brand launch date, co-manufacturer vendor reference, quality standard tier, target category, brand positioning statement, and packaging specification reference. For private-label brands, additionally tracks brand development lifecycle, sourcing decisions, and category management strategy. Serves as the authoritative brand reference for item master, assortment planning, vendor relationship management, and private-label brand portfolio management. Sourced from merchandising, vendor management, and private-label development teams.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the brand. Primary key. Inferred role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: brand_category_captain_vendor_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor designated as the category captain for the category where this brand competes. The category captain provides market insights, planogram recommendations, and assortment guidance. Used for vendor collaboration and category management.

attributes.name: brand_co_manufacturer_vendor_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the co-manufacturer or contract manufacturer who produces private-label products under this brand on behalf of Grocery. Null for non-private-label brands. Used for private-label sourcing and quality management.

attributes.name: brand_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor or supplier who provides products under this brand. For CPG brands, this is the manufacturer. For private-label brands, this is the co-manufacturer or contract packer.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Brands are owned by legal entities; linking enables brand‑level profit and expense reporting.

attributes.name: manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Brand management is overseen by a specific associate; required for brand profitability reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: A comma-separated list of major food allergens that are present in products under this brand or manufactured in facilities that process these allergens. Used for FDA allergen labeling compliance and customer safety. Examples: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Internal short code or abbreviation used for the brand in merchandising systems, planograms, and reporting. Serves as a business identifier for operational use.

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: A detailed narrative description of the brand, its history, values, product range, and unique selling propositions. Used for eCommerce content, marketing materials, and internal training.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The official marketing name of the brand as it appears on product packaging and promotional materials. This is the primary human-readable identifier for the brand.

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the brand. Active brands are currently sold and replenished. Inactive brands are temporarily not available. Discontinued brands are permanently removed from assortment. Pending launch brands are approved but not yet in stores. Phasing out brands are being replaced. Seasonal brands are active only during specific periods.

attributes.name: brand_tier
attributes.description: Quality and pricing tier of the brand within its category. Premium brands command higher price points and emphasize quality. Standard brands are mainstream offerings. Value and economy brands compete on price. Organic brands meet USDA organic certification. Specialty brands target niche segments.

attributes.name: brand_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand by market scope and ownership model. National brands are widely distributed CPG manufacturer brands. Regional brands have limited geographic distribution. Private-label and store brands are owned by Grocery. Generic brands are unbranded commodity products. Exclusive brands are third-party brands sold only at Grocery.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The primary country where the brand is headquartered or where the majority of its products are manufactured. Represented as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Used for country-of-origin labeling compliance and sourcing analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this brand record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date when the brand was permanently discontinued and removed from the assortment. Null for active brands. Used for historical analysis and SKU rationalization reporting.

attributes.name: exclusive_to_grocery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this brand is sold exclusively at Grocery stores and not available through competing retailers. True for private-label brands and exclusive third-party brands. False for national and regional brands available at multiple retailers. Used for competitive differentiation analysis.

attributes.name: fair_trade_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is Fair Trade Certified by Fair Trade USA or another recognized fair trade certification body. True for certified brands. False otherwise. Used for ethical sourcing reporting and sustainability merchandising.

attributes.name: gluten_free_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is certified gluten-free by a recognized certification body such as GFCO (Gluten-Free Certification Organization) and meets FDA gluten-free labeling standards. True for certified brands. False otherwise. Used for allergen management and dietary preference merchandising.

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: The GS1-assigned company prefix that appears in the GTIN and UPC barcodes for all products under this brand. Used to identify the brand owner in global supply chain systems and for barcode validation.

attributes.name: halal_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is certified halal by a recognized halal certification body and meets Islamic dietary law requirements. True for certified brands. False otherwise. Used for religious dietary compliance and specialty merchandising.

attributes.name: kosher_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is certified kosher by a recognized kosher certification agency and authorized to display a kosher symbol. True for certified brands. False otherwise. Used for religious dietary compliance and specialty merchandising.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this brand record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this brand record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date when the brand was first introduced to the market or first carried by Grocery stores. Used for brand lifecycle analysis and new item introduction tracking.

attributes.name: logo_asset_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the digital asset management system location where the official brand logo and visual identity assets are stored. Used for planogram design, ad circular production, and eCommerce merchandising.

attributes.name: non_gmo_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is verified by the Non-GMO Project and authorized to display the Non-GMO Project Verified seal. True for verified brands. False otherwise. Used for product labeling and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand holds USDA organic certification and is authorized to use the USDA Organic seal on product packaging. True for certified organic brands. False otherwise. Used for regulatory compliance and organic category reporting.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: The legal entity that owns the intellectual property rights to the brand. For CPG brands, this is the manufacturer or parent company. For private-label brands, this is Grocery or its subsidiary. For licensed brands, this is the licensor.

attributes.name: packaging_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the master packaging specification document or system record that defines standard packaging formats, materials, labeling requirements, and sustainability attributes for products under this brand. Used for private-label development and vendor compliance.
attributes.references: Packaging Standards, FDA Food Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: parent_company
attributes.description: The ultimate parent corporation that owns the brand owner entity. Used to group brands by corporate family for vendor relationship management and category analysis. May be the same as brand owner for independent brands.

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: A concise statement describing the brands value proposition, target customer segment, and competitive differentiation. Used for merchandising strategy, marketing alignment, and private-label brand development. Example: Premium organic dairy products for health-conscious families.

attributes.name: private_label_development_stage
attributes.description: For private-label brands only, the current stage in the brand development lifecycle. Concept stage is initial ideation. Sourcing stage is vendor selection. Formulation stage is product development. Testing stage is quality validation. Approved stage is ready for launch. Launched stage is in-market. Mature stage is established. Null for non-private-label brands. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|sourcing|formulation|testing|approved|launched|mature — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quality_standard_tier
attributes.description: The quality assurance and certification level for the brand. Tier 1 represents highest quality standards with rigorous testing. Tier 2 is standard quality. Tier 3 is basic quality. Certified organic meets USDA organic standards. Non-GMO meets Non-GMO Project verification. Fair Trade meets Fair Trade USA certification.
attributes.references: USDA Organic Regulations, Non-GMO Project Standard, Fair Trade USA Standards

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: The name of any sustainability or environmental certification held by the brand, such as Rainforest Alliance, Marine Stewardship Council, Forest Stewardship Council, or B Corporation. Null if no sustainability certification. Used for ESG reporting and sustainable product merchandising. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rainforest_alliance|marine_stewardship_council|forest_stewardship_council|b_corporation|carbon_neutral|regenerative_organic|utz_certified — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_category
attributes.description: The primary product category or department where this brand is positioned. Used for category management, assortment planning, and category captain assignments. Examples include Dairy, Bakery, Frozen Foods, Health and Beauty, Pharmacy.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The official website URL for the brand where consumers can find product information, recipes, and brand story. Used for digital commerce integration and customer engagement.

products.name: item_cost
products.description: Landed cost record for each SKU-vendor combination capturing all cost components used in margin and COGS analysis. Stores base cost (unit cost from vendor), off-invoice allowances, billback allowances, scan-based trading allowances, freight cost, handling cost, slotting fee amortization, effective date range, cost type (standard/actual/contract/promotional), cost basis (case/each/weight), currency code, and cost source (EDI 832 price catalog, vendor contract, manual override). Supports gross margin calculation, GMROI analysis, promotional lift measurement, and dead net cost reporting. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing and Oracle Retail Price Management.
products.reference: Oracle Retail Cost Management / SAP MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: item_cost_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item cost record. Primary key for the item cost entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for cost accounting reports that allocate each SKU's cost to a specific cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Maps each item cost to the appropriate GL expense account for automatic posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: primary_item_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or employee who approved this cost record. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance for cost change authorization.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional event or campaign during which this promotional cost applies. Used to measure promotional lift and incremental margin impact.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this cost record applies. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier providing this item at the specified cost. Each SKU-vendor combination may have distinct cost structures.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was approved. Part of the audit trail for cost change management and financial controls.

attributes.name: base_unit_cost
attributes.description: The fundamental unit cost from the vendor before any allowances, discounts, or additional charges. This is the invoice line item cost per unit as stated by the supplier.

attributes.name: billback_allowance
attributes.description: Post-invoice allowance claimed back from the vendor after the sale or promotion period. Requires submission of proof-of-performance documentation. Expressed in the same currency and unit basis as base cost.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier of the vendor contract or purchase agreement under which this cost is defined. Links cost to legal or commercial terms.

attributes.name: cost_approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for this cost record. Indicates whether the cost has been reviewed and approved by procurement or finance before being applied to transactions.

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure on which the base unit cost is calculated. Indicates whether cost is per individual item (each), per case, per pallet, per unit weight, or per unit volume.

attributes.name: cost_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, explanations, or special conditions related to this cost record. May include reasons for manual overrides, contract clauses, or vendor negotiation details.

attributes.name: cost_source
attributes.description: Indicates the origin or method by which this cost was captured. EDI 832 is electronic price catalog from vendor; vendor contract is negotiated agreement; manual override is user-entered adjustment; system calculated is derived by ERP; purchase order is actual PO line cost.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost record. Active indicates the cost is in use; pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; expired indicates past effective end date; superseded indicates replaced by newer cost; suspended indicates temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost record indicating the costing methodology applied. Standard cost is the baseline expected cost; actual cost reflects real invoice amounts; contract cost is negotiated rate; promotional cost applies during vendor promotions; landed cost includes all acquisition expenses; average cost is weighted average over time.

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between standard cost and actual cost for this SKU-vendor combination. Positive variance indicates actual cost exceeded standard; negative indicates savings. Used for procurement performance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the cost is denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dead_net_cost
attributes.description: The final, fully-loaded cost per unit after applying all allowances, discounts, freight, handling, and amortized fees. This is the true cost used for gross margin and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost record expires or is superseded by a new cost record. Null indicates the cost is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost record becomes active and applicable for costing transactions. Supports time-based cost history and contract period tracking.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Effective Dating

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost allocated to this SKU for moving goods from vendor to distribution center or store. May be actual freight invoice or allocated based on weight/volume. Expressed per unit basis.

attributes.name: handling_cost
attributes.description: Warehouse or distribution center handling cost allocated to this SKU, including receiving, putaway, storage, and picking activities. Expressed per unit basis.

attributes.name: is_primary_vendor
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this vendor is the primary or preferred source for this SKU. True if primary; false if secondary or backup vendor.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this SKU was purchased from this vendor at this cost. Supports cost aging analysis and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between placing a purchase order and receiving the goods from this vendor for this SKU. Used for replenishment planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be ordered from the vendor to qualify for this cost. Expressed in the same unit of measure as cost basis.

attributes.name: off_invoice_allowance
attributes.description: Immediate discount or allowance deducted directly from the invoice at the time of purchase. Reduces the base unit cost before payment. Expressed in the same currency and unit basis as base cost.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the specific purchase order from which this actual cost was derived. Applicable when cost type is actual and sourced from a PO receipt.

attributes.name: scan_based_trading_allowance
attributes.description: Allowance applied under scan-based trading arrangements where the retailer pays the vendor only when the item is sold (scanned at POS). Reflects the discount or rebate negotiated under SBT terms.

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amortization
attributes.description: Amortized portion of the one-time slotting fee paid to secure shelf space for this SKU, allocated per unit over the expected sales volume or contract period. Contributes to total landed cost.

products.name: item_lifecycle_event
products.description: Audit trail of significant lifecycle state changes for items in the catalog. Captures event type (new item introduction, item discontinuation, item reactivation, reformulation, recall initiation, recall closure, regulatory hold, organic certification granted/revoked), event timestamp, triggered-by user or system, prior status, new status, reason code, and supporting notes. Enables traceability for FDA recall management, regulatory compliance reporting, and category management workflows.
products.reference: FDA Recall Management / Oracle Retail Item Lifecycle

attributes.name: item_lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item lifecycle event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category to which the item belonged at the time of this lifecycle event. Supports category management analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lifecycle events generate costs that need allocation to the responsible cost center for budgeting and analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Financial impact of lifecycle events (e.g., recalls) must be posted to a GL account for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: primary_item_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who initiated or approved the lifecycle event. Null if the event was triggered by an automated system process.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the item (SKU) in the product catalog that this lifecycle event pertains to.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier associated with the item at the time of this lifecycle event. Relevant for supplier-driven discontinuations, recalls, or quality issues.

attributes.name: affected_dc_count
attributes.description: Number of distribution centers impacted by this lifecycle event. Supports supply chain impact analysis.

attributes.name: affected_store_count
attributes.description: Number of stores impacted by this lifecycle event. Relevant for recalls, discontinuations, and new item introductions to track distribution scope.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event required formal approval from management or a governance committee before execution.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lifecycle event was formally approved. Null if no approval was required or approval is pending.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lifecycle event was triggered to maintain regulatory compliance (True) or for other business reasons (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lifecycle event record was first created in the data lakehouse. System audit field.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lifecycle event becomes effective for business operations. May differ from event_timestamp for planned future events.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the lifecycle event in USD, including inventory write-offs, recall costs, or lost sales. Used for financial planning and reporting.

attributes.name: estimated_inventory_units
attributes.description: Estimated quantity of inventory units affected by this lifecycle event across all locations at the time of the event. Used for recall scope and financial impact assessment.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lifecycle event occurred in the real world. This is the business event time, not the system record creation time.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of lifecycle event. Indicates the nature of the state change for the item (e.g., new item introduction, discontinuation, reactivation, reformulation, recall initiation, recall closure, regulatory hold, organic certification granted, organic certification revoked).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7 (Recalls), USDA Organic Certification Standards

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the item after this event was applied. Represents the target state of the transition.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments providing context, instructions, or follow-up actions related to the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer or stakeholder notifications were sent for this lifecycle event (e.g., recall notices, discontinuation alerts to vendors).

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when notifications were sent to customers, vendors, or regulatory agencies regarding this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the item immediately before this event occurred. Supports audit trail and state transition analysis.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the lifecycle event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: low_sales|supplier_discontinuation|regulatory_violation|quality_issue|seasonal_rotation|product_refresh|contamination|labeling_error|allergen_mislabel|expired_certification|voluntary_recall|mandatory_recall|market_expansion|assortment_optimization — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context and details about why the lifecycle event was triggered. Complements the reason code with narrative detail.

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: FDA recall classification indicating the severity of the health hazard. Class I: dangerous or defective products that could cause serious health problems or death. Class II: products that might cause temporary health problem or slight threat of serious nature. Class III: products unlikely to cause adverse health reaction but violate FDA labeling or manufacturing regulations. Populated only for recall events.

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official recall identification number assigned by the FDA, USDA, or internal recall management system. Populated only for recall-related events.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory agency associated with this lifecycle event (e.g., FDA for food recalls, DEA for controlled substance holds, USDA for organic certification changes).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this lifecycle event was captured (e.g., Oracle Retail Merchandising System, SAP MM, McKesson Pharmacy Systems).

attributes.name: source_system_event_ref
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the lifecycle event in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: supporting_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to supporting documentation for the lifecycle event (e.g., FDA recall notice, supplier discontinuation letter, reformulation specification sheet).

attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the system that triggered the lifecycle event if it was automated (e.g., Oracle Retail Merchandising System, SAP MM, Blue Yonder Demand Planning). Null if manually triggered by a user.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this lifecycle event record was last modified in the data lakehouse. System audit field.

products.name: drug_item
products.description: Pharmacy drug item master extending the core item record with pharmacy-specific attributes. Stores NDC (National Drug Code), drug name (brand and generic), active ingredient, strength, dosage form, route of administration, DEA schedule (I–V or non-scheduled), controlled substance flag, OTC vs Rx flag, therapeutic class, drug interaction group, storage temperature requirement, expiration tracking method, and McKesson drug database reference. Supports McKesson Pharmacy Systems drug inventory and prescription dispensing workflows.
products.reference: NDC / DEA Schedule / McKesson Drug Database

attributes.name: drug_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy drug item record. Primary key for the drug item master.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_item. Business justification: Drug items extend core product items; FK creates proper inheritance.

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: Primary active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) responsible for the therapeutic effect. May include multiple ingredients separated by semicolons for combination drugs.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Proprietary brand name of the drug product as marketed by the manufacturer (e.g., Lipitor, Advil).

attributes.name: controlled_substance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as a controlled substance requiring special handling, documentation, and security per DEA regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the drug item record was first created in the pharmacy system.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance classification (I through V) indicating abuse potential and regulatory restrictions. Non-scheduled indicates the drug is not a controlled substance.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date the drug was discontinued by the manufacturer or removed from the pharmacy formulary. Null for active drugs.

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form in which the drug is manufactured and dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, liquid, injection). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|liquid|injection|cream|ointment|gel|patch|inhaler|suppository|powder|suspension|solution|spray|drops|lozenge — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drug_interaction_group
attributes.description: Classification code or group identifier used by pharmacy systems to screen for potential drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and adverse reactions.

attributes.name: drug_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drug item in the pharmacy inventory system. Active items are available for dispensing, discontinued items are no longer stocked, recalled items have FDA safety alerts, back-ordered items are temporarily unavailable, restricted items require special authorization.

attributes.name: expiration_tracking_method
attributes.description: Method used to track and manage drug expiration dates in inventory. Lot-based tracks by manufacturing lot, unit-based tracks individual units, FIFO (First In First Out) dispenses oldest stock first, FEFO (First Expired First Out) dispenses nearest expiration first.

attributes.name: fda_approval_date
attributes.description: Date the drug received FDA approval for marketing and distribution in the United States.

attributes.name: formulary_status
attributes.description: Insurance formulary classification indicating coverage tier and restrictions (preferred, non-preferred, excluded, or requiring prior authorization).

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: Non-proprietary generic name of the drug using the United States Adopted Name (USAN) or International Nonproprietary Name (INN) convention (e.g., atorvastatin, ibuprofen).

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the drug product for supply chain and inventory management. 14-digit format.

attributes.name: hazardous_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug is classified as hazardous per NIOSH guidelines, requiring special handling, personal protective equipment, and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the drug item record was last modified in the pharmacy system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with McKesson Pharmacy Systems.

attributes.name: manufacturer_labeler_code
attributes.description: FDA-assigned 5-digit labeler code identifying the manufacturer or distributor. First segment of the NDC.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical company that manufactures or markets the drug product.

attributes.name: mckesson_drug_code
attributes.description: McKesson proprietary drug identifier used for ordering, inventory management, and integration with McKesson Pharmacy Systems drug database.

attributes.name: multi_source_code
attributes.description: FDA Orange Book code indicating generic availability. Y = generic available, N = no generic available, O = original brand with generic equivalents.

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: FDA-assigned National Drug Code uniquely identifying the drug product, labeler, and package size. Standard 11-digit format with hyphens (5-4-2, 5-3-2, or 4-4-2 configuration).

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: Quantity and unit of measure for the drug package (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 mL, 1 vial). Represents the dispensing unit size.

attributes.name: prescription_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug requires a valid prescription (Rx) or is available over-the-counter (OTC). True for prescription drugs, False for OTC drugs.

attributes.name: refrigeration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug must be stored under refrigerated conditions (2-8°C) to maintain stability and efficacy.

attributes.name: repackaged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug has been repackaged from bulk containers into smaller dispensing units by a repackager rather than the original manufacturer.

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: Method by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, topical, intravenous, intramuscular). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|topical|intravenous|intramuscular|subcutaneous|inhalation|rectal|ophthalmic|otic|nasal|transdermal|sublingual|buccal — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: storage_temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition to maintain drug stability and efficacy. Room temperature (15-25°C), refrigerated (2-8°C), frozen (<0°C), or controlled room temperature (20-25°C).

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Concentration or potency of the active ingredient, including unit of measure (e.g., 10 mg, 500 mg/5 mL, 0.5%).

attributes.name: therapeutic_class
attributes.description: Pharmacological or therapeutic category indicating the drug's primary clinical use (e.g., antihypertensive, antibiotic, analgesic, antidiabetic).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for inventory tracking and dispensing (e.g., each, tablet, capsule, mL, gram). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|tablet|capsule|ml|gram|vial|bottle|box|tube|patch|inhaler — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier used for point-of-sale scanning and inventory tracking of OTC pharmacy items.

products.name: fuel_grade
products.description: Fuel grade master defining the types of fuel sold at Grocery fuel centers. Stores fuel grade code, fuel grade name (Regular Unleaded, Mid-Grade, Premium, Diesel, E85), octane rating, ethanol blend percentage, EPA fuel type classification, pump display label, price tier, and active status. Supports fuel center pump configuration, EPA emissions compliance reporting, and fuel pricing management. Referenced by fuel inventory and fuel pricing domains.
products.reference: EPA Fuel Type Classification / ASTM Fuel Standards

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel grade master record. Primary key for the fuel grade entity.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel.fuel_grade. Business justification: Required for fuel pricing and EPA compliance reports that join product fuel grade definitions with master fuel grade data; grocery analysts expect this direct reference.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Fuel procurement contracts require linking each fuel grade to its supplying vendor for pricing, compliance, and inventory management.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel grade is currently available for sale at fuel centers. False for discontinued or seasonally unavailable grades.

attributes.name: base_price_differential
attributes.description: Standard price increment above the base fuel grade (typically Regular Unleaded) in dollars per gallon. Used for automated pricing calculations and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: biodiesel_blend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of biodiesel content in diesel fuel blends (e.g., 5.00 for B5, 20.00 for B20). Zero for non-diesel fuels. Required for EPA renewable fuel standard reporting.

attributes.name: carbon_intensity_score
attributes.description: Lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions in grams of CO2 equivalent per megajoule of energy (gCO2e/MJ). Used for Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) compliance in California and other jurisdictions.

attributes.name: cetane_number
attributes.description: Measure of diesel fuel ignition quality and combustion speed. Higher cetane numbers indicate better ignition properties. Typically 40-55 for diesel fuels. Null for gasoline products.

attributes.name: cold_filter_plugging_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Lowest temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at which diesel fuel will flow through a standardized filtration device. Critical for winter operability. Applicable to diesel grades only.
attributes.references: ASTM D6371 Cold Filter Plugging Point Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel grade master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel grade was discontinued or when the specification version was superseded. Null for currently active grades. Used for historical analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel grade became available for sale or when the current specification version became effective. Used for historical tracking and seasonal blend transitions.

attributes.name: epa_fuel_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Fuel Type Code
attributes.description: EPA-assigned code for fuel type classification used in emissions compliance reporting and fuel economy labeling. Maps to EPA fuel type taxonomy.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Economy Guide and 40 CFR Part 600

attributes.name: ethanol_blend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ethanol content in the fuel blend (e.g., 10.00 for E10, 85.00 for E85). Zero for pure gasoline or diesel. Required for EPA renewable fuel standard reporting.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at which the fuel emits sufficient vapor to ignite. Critical for fire safety protocols and storage requirements.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fuel grade (e.g., REG, MID, PREM, DSL, E85). Used for system integration and pump configuration.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: fuel_grade_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the fuel grade (e.g., Regular Unleaded, Mid-Grade, Premium, Diesel, E85 Flex Fuel). Used for customer-facing displays and reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the fuel product type. Aligns with EPA fuel type taxonomy for emissions reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit GS1 Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the fuel grade product for supply chain and inventory management. Used for cross-enterprise product identification.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: Department of Transportation (DOT) hazardous materials classification for the fuel grade. Required for transportation, storage, and safety compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel grade master record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: octane_rating
attributes.description: Octane number indicating the fuel's resistance to knocking or pinging during combustion. Typically 87 for Regular, 89 for Mid-Grade, 91-93 for Premium. Null for diesel and non-gasoline fuels.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of fuel grade pricing from lowest to highest (e.g., 1 for Regular, 2 for Mid-Grade, 3 for Premium). Used for pricing strategy and margin management.

attributes.name: pump_button_color
attributes.description: Standard color coding for fuel grade selection buttons on dispensers (e.g., green for Regular, yellow for Mid-Grade, red for Premium, black for Diesel). Supports consistent customer experience across fuel centers.
attributes.references: Industry Standard Fuel Dispenser Color Coding

attributes.name: pump_display_label
attributes.description: Customer-facing label text displayed on fuel pump dispensers and signage. Includes grade name, octane rating, and ethanol content per FTC labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FTC Fuel Rating Rule 16 CFR Part 306

attributes.name: reformulated_gasoline_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fuel meets EPA reformulated gasoline (RFG) requirements for ozone non-attainment areas. True for RFG-compliant fuels sold in designated metropolitan areas.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 Subpart D Reformulated Gasoline

attributes.name: renewable_fuel_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fuel grade qualifies as a renewable fuel under EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS). True for ethanol blends, biodiesel, and other renewable fuels.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) 40 CFR Part 80

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of fuel density to water density at standard temperature. Used for volume-to-weight conversions in inventory reconciliation and delivery verification.
attributes.references: ASTM D4052 Density and Relative Density Standards

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Sulfur concentration in parts per million. EPA regulations mandate ultra-low sulfur diesel (ULSD) at 15 ppm maximum. Required for emissions compliance reporting.

attributes.name: summer_blend_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fuel grade is formulated for warm weather with lower Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) to reduce evaporative emissions. Seasonal blend used from June through September.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 Subpart C Volatility Standards

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1202 for diesel). Required for shipping documentation and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code for the fuel grade. Used for Point of Sale (POS) transaction processing and inventory tracking at fuel centers.

attributes.name: wholesale_product_code
attributes.description: Supplier or terminal product code used for wholesale fuel procurement and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transactions. Links to vendor catalog and supply chain systems.
attributes.references: EDI 810 Invoice and 850 Purchase Order Standards

attributes.name: winter_blend_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the fuel grade is formulated for cold weather performance with higher Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP). Seasonal blend used from November through March in most regions.
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 Gasoline Seasonal Volatility Standards

products.name: item_substitution
products.description: Approved item substitution relationships defining which items can replace others during out-of-stock (OOS) scenarios in eCommerce order picking, CAO (Computer Assisted Ordering) replenishment, and in-store fulfillment. Stores primary item, substitute item, substitution type (equivalent/upgrade/downgrade), priority rank, channel applicability (in-store/online/pickup/delivery), customer consent required flag, size-match tolerance, brand-match preference, and effective date range. Critical for omnichannel order fulfillment SLA compliance and customer satisfaction. Sourced from category management and eCommerce fulfillment teams.
products.reference: Oracle Retail Replenishment / OMS Substitution Rules

attributes.name: item_substitution_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item substitution relationship record.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the category manager or merchandising manager who approved this substitution relationship.

attributes.name: primary_product_item_id
attributes.description: The original item that is out of stock or unavailable. References the item master catalog.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: allergen_match_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substitute item must have the same allergen profile as the primary item. Critical for food safety and customer health. True enforces allergen matching; False allows different allergen profiles.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this substitution relationship in the governance workflow. Draft indicates initial creation; pending_review awaits category manager approval; approved is active; rejected was denied; suspended is temporarily inactive; expired has passed its effective end date.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this substitution relationship was approved by the authorized user.

attributes.name: auto_substitute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this substitution can be applied automatically by the Order Management System (OMS) or Computer Assisted Ordering (CAO) system without manual intervention. True enables automatic substitution; False requires manual review.

attributes.name: brand_match_preference
attributes.description: Indicates the brand matching requirement for substitution: exact (same brand only), private_label (store-owned brand preferred), national_brand (Consumer Packaged Goods brand preferred), or any (brand agnostic).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: category_match_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substitute item must belong to the same product category as the primary item. True enforces category matching; False allows cross-category substitution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Category Management

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which fulfillment channels this substitution rule applies to: all channels, in-store only, online only, pickup (click-and-collect), delivery (last mile delivery), or curbside pickup.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud - Omnichannel Order Fulfillment

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this substitution relationship record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of times customers accepted this substitution when offered (accepted substitutions divided by total offers). Used to measure customer satisfaction and optimize substitution rules.

attributes.name: customer_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether explicit customer approval is required before making this substitution. True means the customer must approve the substitute before fulfillment; False means the substitution can be made automatically.
attributes.references: FTC Fair Packaging and Labeling Act

attributes.name: dietary_restriction_match_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the substitute item must match dietary restrictions of the primary item (e.g., organic, gluten-free, kosher, halal, vegan). True enforces dietary attribute matching; False allows different dietary profiles.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this substitution relationship expires and should no longer be used. Null indicates an open-ended relationship with no expiration.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this substitution relationship becomes active and can be used for order fulfillment and replenishment decisions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: last_used_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this substitution was most recently applied in an order fulfillment or replenishment transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this substitution relationship record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for category managers to document special instructions, business rationale, customer communication guidelines, or other relevant information about this substitution relationship.

attributes.name: pharmacy_therapeutic_equivalent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specific to pharmacy items indicating whether the substitute drug is therapeutically equivalent to the primary drug per FDA Orange Book standards. True means the substitute has the same active ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route of administration.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book - Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations

attributes.name: prescription_required_match_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator for pharmacy items indicating whether the substitute must have the same prescription requirement status as the primary item (both Rx or both OTC). True enforces matching; False allows substitution between prescription and over-the-counter items.

attributes.name: price_variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable percentage difference in price between the primary item and substitute item. Positive values allow higher-priced substitutes; negative values allow lower-priced substitutes. For example, 15.00 means the substitute can cost up to 15% more.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the order of preference when multiple substitutes exist for the same primary item. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = first choice, 2 = second choice, etc.).

attributes.name: size_match_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage variance in product size or quantity between the primary item and substitute item. For example, 10.00 means the substitute can be up to 10% larger or smaller than the original item.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or process that created this substitution rule: merchandising system, eCommerce platform, Computer Assisted Ordering (CAO), manual entry by category manager, or category management tool.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the primary business reason for establishing this substitution relationship: out-of-stock (OOS), discontinued item, seasonal availability, product recall, quality issue, pricing strategy, or promotional campaign. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oos|discontinued|seasonal|recall|quality|pricing|promotion — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Classification of the substitution relationship indicating whether the substitute is an equivalent product, an upgrade (higher quality or price), a downgrade (lower quality or price), similar product, alternative brand, or generic equivalent.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of how many times this substitution has been applied in actual order fulfillment or replenishment transactions. Used for effectiveness tracking and optimization.

products.name: item_vendor
products.description: Association between items and their approved vendors/suppliers, capturing the sourcing relationship. Stores vendor reference, item reference, vendor item number, vendor UPC, primary vendor flag, vendor lead time days, minimum order quantity, order multiple, EDI transaction set supported, DSD indicator, and effective date range. Supports purchase order creation, replenishment planning, and vendor performance management. Sourced from SAP MM Purchasing Info Record and Oracle Retail.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchasing Info Record / Oracle Retail Vendor Item

attributes.name: item_vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item-vendor association record.

attributes.name: procurement_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Item Vendor Procurement Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Procurement ownership of vendor contracts is assigned to an associate; needed for spend analysis and supplier performance dashboards.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the item (SKU) in this vendor relationship.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier providing this item.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master supply agreement or contract governing this item-vendor relationship. Links to vendor contract management system.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the vendor cost (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where this item is manufactured or grown by this vendor. Required for customs, labeling, and country-of-origin marketing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Country Codes, FDA Food Labeling

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item-vendor relationship record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dsd_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor delivers directly to stores, bypassing the distribution center. Common for bread, dairy, snacks, and beverages.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set_supported
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Transaction Set Supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDI transaction sets supported by this vendor for this item (e.g., 850 Purchase Order, 856 Advance Ship Notice, 810 Invoice). Blank if vendor does not support EDI.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this item-vendor relationship expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended relationship.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this item-vendor relationship becomes active and can be used for purchase order creation.

attributes.name: item_vendor_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this item-vendor sourcing relationship. Blocked status prevents new purchase orders; discontinued indicates vendor no longer supplies this item.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor cost was last updated in the system. Used for cost change tracking and margin analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this item-vendor relationship record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_purchase_order_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase order placed with this vendor for this item. Used for vendor activity analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt from this vendor for this item at any distribution center or store. Used for vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The smallest quantity that can be ordered from this vendor for this item, expressed in the vendor's unit of measure.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The quantity increment in which this item must be ordered (e.g., case pack size, pallet quantity). Orders must be in multiples of this value.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the primary or preferred source for this item. Used in automated replenishment and purchase order generation.

attributes.name: promotional_allowance_percent
attributes.description: Standard promotional discount percentage offered by this vendor for this item during promotional periods. Used in temporary price reduction (TPR) planning.

attributes.name: return_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a return merchandise authorization (RMA) is required from this vendor before returning defective or unsold items.

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time or recurring fee paid by the vendor for shelf space allocation for this item. Common in new item introductions and category resets.

attributes.name: vendor_cost
attributes.description: The current negotiated cost per vendor unit of measure. Used for purchase order pricing and gross margin calculations. Subject to contract terms and promotional allowances.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The vendor's internal catalog or part number for this item, used in purchase orders and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order submission to expected delivery at the distribution center or store. Critical for replenishment planning and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: vendor_pack_size
attributes.description: Number of consumer units (eaches) contained in the vendor's shipping unit (case or pallet). Used for unit conversion between vendor ordering and store selling units.

attributes.name: vendor_quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality certifications held by the vendor for this item (e.g., USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project, Fair Trade, HACCP, SQF). Pipe-separated list if multiple certifications apply.

attributes.name: vendor_reliability_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating for this vendor on this item, based on fill rate, on-time delivery, and quality metrics. Used in vendor selection and category captain decisions.

attributes.name: vendor_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure used by the vendor for ordering and invoicing this item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|pound|kilogram|liter|gallon|dozen|box — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_upc
attributes.description: The UPC or GTIN assigned by the vendor for this item, may differ from retailer's UPC in case of private label or vendor-specific packaging.

products.name: recall
products.description: Product recall and market withdrawal record managing the end-to-end recall lifecycle per FDA 21 CFR Part 7 and USDA FSIS directives. Stores recall number (FDA/USDA/manufacturer-assigned), recall classification (Class I life-threatening / Class II reversible health risk / Class III no health risk), recall type (voluntary/mandatory/market withdrawal), initiating agency (FDA/USDA/CPSC/DEA), affected item references, affected lot/batch numbers, affected production date range, distribution scope, recall reason, health hazard evaluation summary, recall status (initiated/in-progress/store-notified/product-removed/completed/closed), store notification timestamp, consumer notification method, and disposition instructions (destroy/return-to-vendor/hold). Supports FDA recall compliance, store operations pull-from-shelf execution, customer notification for loyalty-matched purchases, and regulatory reporting.
products.reference: FDA Recall Classification / USDA FSIS Recall

attributes.name: recall_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product recall record. Primary key.

attributes.name: initiated_by_associate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recall Initiated By Associate Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Recall process requires identifying the associate who initiated the recall; essential for incident investigation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_item. Business justification: Recalls are tied to the specific product affected; FK provides direct association.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Recall management reports must identify the responsible supplier for regulatory notifications and corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: affected_gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit GTIN of the affected product. Global standard identifier for supply chain and distribution tracking.

attributes.name: affected_lot_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of affected lot or batch numbers. Used to identify specific production runs subject to recall.

attributes.name: affected_product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the affected product including brand name, product name, package size, and any distinguishing characteristics to aid in identification.

attributes.name: affected_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes where the recalled product was distributed. Used for targeted store notification and consumer alerts.

attributes.name: affected_upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode of the affected product. Used for POS system identification and automated inventory removal.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: FDA recall classification indicating severity of health risk. Class I: life-threatening or serious injury risk. Class II: temporary or reversible adverse health consequences. Class III: unlikely to cause adverse health consequences.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory agency officially closed the recall case. Indicates successful completion of all regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: completed_date
attributes.description: Date when all recall activities (store removal, consumer notification, disposition) were completed. Precedes regulatory closure.

attributes.name: consumer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when consumers were notified of the recall through public communication channels.

attributes.name: consumer_notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify consumers of the recall. Multiple methods may be used; this field captures the primary notification channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Press Release|Email|SMS|In-Store Signage|Website|Social Media|Loyalty App — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: disposition_instructions
attributes.description: Instructions for handling recalled product. Destroy: dispose of product. Return to Vendor: ship back to supplier. Hold for Inspection: quarantine pending agency review. Dispose per HACCP: follow food safety protocols.
attributes.value_regex: Destroy|Return to Vendor|Hold for Inspection|Dispose per HACCP

attributes.name: distribution_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of product distribution. Indicates whether the recall affects national, regional, state-level, or local distribution.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Estimated total financial impact of the recall including product cost, disposal costs, labor, and potential liability. Measured in USD. Business-confidential financial data.

attributes.name: fda_enforcement_report_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official FDA enforcement report for this recall. Provides access to the public regulatory record.

attributes.name: health_hazard_evaluation
attributes.description: FDA health hazard evaluation summary describing the potential health risk to consumers, including severity, likelihood of occurrence, and affected populations.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date the recall was officially initiated by the agency or manufacturer. Marks the start of the recall lifecycle.

attributes.name: initiating_agency
attributes.description: Regulatory agency or entity that initiated the recall. FDA: food/drug/cosmetic. USDA: meat/poultry. CPSC: consumer product safety. DEA: controlled substances. Manufacturer: voluntary firm-initiated.

attributes.name: internal_case_number
attributes.description: Internal case tracking number assigned by the retailer for recall management and cross-functional coordination across supply chain, store operations, and legal teams.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recall record was last modified in the data platform. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: loyalty_matched_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty program purchase history was used to identify and directly notify customers who purchased the recalled product.

attributes.name: manufacturer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the manufacturer contact person. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: manufacturer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer contact person responsible for coordinating the recall. Used for vendor communication and coordination.

attributes.name: manufacturer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the manufacturer contact person. Business-confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: product_removed_date
attributes.description: Date when the recalled product was physically removed from store shelves and inventory. Marks completion of store-level recall execution.

attributes.name: production_date_end
attributes.description: End date of the production date range for affected items. Defines the latest production date of recalled products.

attributes.name: production_date_start
attributes.description: Start date of the production date range for affected items. Defines the earliest production date of recalled products.

attributes.name: quantity_recalled
attributes.description: Total quantity of product units subject to recall. Measured in units appropriate to the product (cases, pounds, bottles, etc.).

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity recalled field. Defines how the recalled quantity is measured.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for the recall, including the specific defect, contamination, mislabeling, or health hazard that triggered the action.

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Official recall number assigned by the initiating agency (FDA, USDA, CPSC, DEA, or manufacturer). Serves as the external business identifier for regulatory reporting and cross-agency coordination.

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall. Tracks progression from initiation through store notification, product removal, completion, and regulatory closure.

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Type of recall action. Voluntary: firm-initiated removal. Mandatory: agency-ordered removal. Market Withdrawal: removal of product not subject to FDA enforcement action.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this recall record (e.g., Oracle Retail, SAP, Manual Entry).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this recall record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: store_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when store operations were notified of the recall. Critical for tracking compliance with pull-from-shelf execution timelines.

products.name: item_regulatory_flag
products.description: Regulatory compliance flags and certifications associated with items. Stores flag type (SNAP-eligible, WIC-approved, EBT-eligible, organic-certified, non-GMO, gluten-free-certified, kosher, halal, fair-trade, USDA-grade, FDA-bioengineered-disclosure), certifying body, certification number, effective date, expiration date, and compliance status. Supports EBT/SNAP/WIC transaction eligibility at POS, FDA bioengineered food disclosure compliance, and digital channel filtering.
products.reference: USDA Organic / FDA Bioengineered Disclosure / SNAP Eligibility

attributes.name: item_regulatory_flag_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item regulatory flag record. Primary key.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product item to which this regulatory flag applies.

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing audit trail information, compliance review findings, or historical changes to the regulatory flag status.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, FDA Compliance Policy Guides

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or approval number issued by the certifying body for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or government agency that issued the certification or approval (e.g., USDA, FDA, State Board of Pharmacy, third-party certifier).
attributes.references: FDA, USDA, DEA, State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the regulatory compliance flag indicating whether the certification or approval is active, expired, suspended, pending, revoked, or under review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: digital_channel_display_flag

attributes.name: disclosure_statement

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: flag_type

attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Guide, USDA Organic Regulations, State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: label_disclosure_required_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory flag record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.references: FDA Compliance Policy Guides, USDA Organic Regulations

attributes.name: pos_eligibility_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_url

attributes.name: verification_date
