attributes.references: FDA Compliance Policy Guides, USDA Organic Regulations

products.name: item_packaging
products.description: Packaging specification record for each item defining the physical packaging hierarchy and dimensions. Stores packaging level (each/inner pack/case/pallet/display shipper), GTIN per level, unit quantity per level, gross weight, net weight, length, width, height, volume, packaging material type, recyclable flag, deposit amount (bottle deposit), and Ti-Hi (pallet configuration: tiers x height). Supports WMS receiving, DC slotting, transportation planning, and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: item_packaging_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item packaging specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product item for which this packaging specification applies. Links to the authoritative product catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or manufacturer who provides this packaged item. Used for vendor performance tracking and supply chain management.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this packaging specification record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The refundable deposit amount charged for returnable containers such as bottles and cans, measured in USD. Applicable in states with bottle bill legislation. Null for non-deposit items.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this packaging specification is no longer valid for use. Null indicates currently active with no planned end date. Supports time-variant packaging changes and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this packaging specification becomes active and valid for use in the supply chain. Supports time-variant packaging changes and historical tracking.

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the packaging level including product and all packaging materials, measured in pounds. Used for freight calculations and warehouse capacity planning.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The GS1 Global Trade Item Number assigned to this specific packaging level. GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 (case/pallet) format. Used for scanning, EDI transactions, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and transportation compliance per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: height_inches
attributes.description: The vertical dimension of the packaging unit measured in inches. Used for warehouse slotting, transportation planning, and planogram design.

attributes.name: hi
attributes.description: The number of layers stacked vertically on a pallet in the Ti-Hi pallet configuration. Used for warehouse receiving, DC slotting, and transportation planning. Null for non-pallet packaging levels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this packaging specification record was most recently updated in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: length_inches
attributes.description: The longest dimension of the packaging unit measured in inches. Used for warehouse slotting, transportation planning, and planogram design.

attributes.name: max_stack_height
attributes.description: The maximum number of units that can be safely stacked vertically. Used for warehouse safety compliance and space planning. Null if not stackable.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: Weight of the product contents only, excluding packaging materials, measured in pounds. Used for nutritional labeling and FDA compliance.

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of packaging in the distribution chain. Each represents the consumer unit, inner pack is a sub-case grouping, case is the standard shipping unit, pallet is the warehouse unit, display shipper is a retail-ready merchandising unit, and master case is an outer shipping container.

attributes.name: packaging_material_type
attributes.description: The primary material composition of the packaging at this level. Used for sustainability reporting, recycling programs, and environmental compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corrugated_cardboard|plastic|glass|metal|wood|composite|flexible_film — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: packaging_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this packaging specification. Active indicates current use in supply chain, inactive indicates temporarily out of use, discontinued indicates permanently retired, pending approval indicates awaiting vendor or regulatory approval, seasonal indicates used only during specific periods.

attributes.name: recyclable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the packaging material is recyclable through standard municipal recycling programs. Supports sustainability reporting and consumer labeling requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system of record from which this packaging specification was sourced (e.g., SAP MM, Oracle Retail, Manhattan WMS). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this packaging record in the source operational system. Used for data reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level can be safely stacked on top of identical units during storage and transportation. Used for warehouse space optimization and load planning.

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for this packaged item. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and international trade compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this packaging level requires temperature-controlled storage and transportation (cold chain). Applicable to perishables, frozen foods, and pharmacy items.

attributes.name: ti
attributes.description: The number of cases per layer on a pallet in the Ti-Hi pallet configuration. Used for warehouse receiving, DC slotting, and transportation planning. Null for non-pallet packaging levels.

attributes.name: unit_quantity
attributes.description: The number of base units (each) contained within this packaging level. For example, a case may contain 24 eaches, a pallet may contain 60 cases.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC barcode for this packaging level, primarily used at point-of-sale in North America. Subset of GTIN-12.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: The suppliers internal item identifier for this packaging configuration. Used for purchase orders, EDI transactions, and cross-reference with vendor catalogs.

attributes.name: volume_cubic_feet
attributes.description: The total cubic volume of the packaging unit measured in cubic feet. Calculated from length, width, and height. Used for warehouse capacity planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: width_inches
attributes.description: The width dimension of the packaging unit measured in inches. Used for warehouse slotting, transportation planning, and planogram design.

products.name: ab_test_experiment
products.description: Master record for A/B and multivariate test experiments run on digital storefronts. Captures experiment name, hypothesis, variant definitions, traffic allocation percentages, target metric (conversion rate, AOV, click-through), start/end dates, storefront scope, status (draft, running, paused, concluded), and winning variant determination. Supports data-driven optimization of the digital shopping experience including recommendation algorithms, search ranking, checkout flows, and promotional placements.

attributes.name: ab_test_experiment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for the A/B test experiment.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal user who created the experiment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal user who last modified the experiment.

attributes.name: ab_test_experiment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the experiment.

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of sales channels (e.g., online, mobile, in‑store) included in the experiment.

attributes.name: confidence_threshold

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the experiment record was created.

attributes.name: customer_segment_scope
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of customer segment identifiers targeted by the experiment.

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: experiment_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code for the experiment.

attributes.name: experiment_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the experiment.

attributes.name: experiment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the experiment is a simple A/B test or a multivariate test.

attributes.name: hypothesis
attributes.description: Statement of the hypothesis being tested.

attributes.name: is_statistically_significant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the result met the confidence threshold.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form notes or comments about the experiment.

attributes.name: product_scope
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of product SKUs or categories targeted by the experiment.

attributes.name: result_metric_confidence_interval
attributes.description: Confidence interval for the result metric value (e.g., 95% CI).

attributes.name: result_metric_value
attributes.description: Observed value of the target metric for the winning variant.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the experiment is scheduled to start.

attributes.name: statistical_test
attributes.description: Statistical test applied to determine significance of results.

attributes.name: storefront_scope
attributes.description: Comma‑separated list of storefront identifiers where the experiment is applied.

attributes.name: target_metric
attributes.description: Primary metric used to evaluate experiment performance.

attributes.name: target_metric_goal
attributes.description: Goal value for the target metric (e.g., 0.05 for a 5% conversion lift).

attributes.name: traffic_allocation
attributes.description: JSON string mapping variant identifiers to traffic allocation percentages.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the experiment record.

attributes.name: variant_count
attributes.description: Number of variants defined in the experiment, including the control.

attributes.name: variant_definitions
attributes.description: JSON string describing each variant's configuration (e.g., UI changes, pricing adjustments).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the experiment definition, incremented on each change.

attributes.name: winner_determined_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the winning variant was identified.

attributes.name: winning_variant_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the variant determined as the winner after experiment conclusion.

attributes.name: iterated_from_ab_test_experiment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Iterated From Ab Test Experiment Id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on ab_test_experiment (iterated_from_ab_test_experiment_id)

products.name: product_assortment
products.description: This association product represents the assortment relationship between product_item and store_location. It captures the period a product is available at a specific store.. Existence Justification: Each product_item can be stocked at many store_location records, and each store_location carries many product_item records. The business actively manages the assortment of items per store, tracking when a product becomes available and when it is removed using effective start and end dates.

attributes.name: product_assortment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the assortment association

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product_item

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store_location

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the product is removed from the store

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the product becomes available at the store

products.name: promo_sku_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of promotional offers to SKUs. It captures per‑SKU offer terms such as quantity limits, discount overrides, and placement priorities, enabling the business to manage and query which items participate in each promotion.. Existence Justification: In Grocery, marketing teams actively create and maintain a list of which SKUs are eligible for each promotional offer, and a single SKU can participate in multiple offers over time. Conversely, each promotional offer can include many SKUs. The association carries its own attributes such as required quantity and discount overrides, making it an operational entity.

attributes.description: Primary key for the promo_sku_assignment association

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Promo Sku Assignment - Promo Offer Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotional offer

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to SKU

attributes.description: Specific monetary discount applied to this SKU within the offer

attributes.name: discount_override_percentage
attributes.description: Specific percentage discount applied to this SKU within the offer

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Number of facings allocated to the SKU for the promotion

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of the SKU eligible for the offer

attributes.name: planogram_placement_code
attributes.description: Code indicating shelf placement rules for the SKU under this offer

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Order in which the SKU is considered when multiple offers compete

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of the SKU that must be purchased for the offer to apply

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a substitute SKU may be used if the primary SKU is out of stock

products.name: inventory_allocation
products.description: Represents the placement of a SKU in a specific storage location, capturing quantities, lot, expiration, and temperature information that belong to the SKU‑location relationship.. Existence Justification: A SKU can be stocked in many physical storage locations across stores and distribution centers, and each storage location can hold many different SKUs. The business actively manages this placement, tracking on‑hand, reserved, and available quantities, lot numbers, expiration dates, and temperature per SKU‑location pair.

attributes.description: Lot or batch identifier for traceability

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Units reserved for pending orders at the location

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Recorded temperature of the location for the SKU

products.name: product_order_line2
products.description: This association product represents the line items linking product_item and order_header. It captures quantity, unit price, discount, tax, net amount, and line status for each product in an order.. Existence Justification: An order can contain many product items and a single product item can appear in many orders. Each occurrence is recorded as an order line that stores quantity, pricing, discounts, tax, net amount, and line status. Business users create, update, and delete these order lines as part of the order fulfillment process.

attributes.name: product_order_line2_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital order line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category hierarchy node for this item, enabling category-level sales analysis and assortment planning.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order header that contains this line item. Links this line to the overall order transaction.

attributes.name: picker_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate or picker who selected and prepared this line item for fulfillment. Used for performance tracking and quality accountability.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center, or micro-fulfillment center from which this line item was picked and fulfilled.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this product has age restrictions requiring customer age verification at the time of delivery or pickup, such as alcohol or tobacco products.

attributes.name: bogo_flag

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: The specific coupon code applied to this line item for discount purposes. Used for tracking coupon redemption and promotional campaign performance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this order line record was first created in the order management system, representing when the customer added this item to their digital cart and confirmed the order.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which this line item is priced and billed.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The retail department or category code to which this product belongs, used for merchandising analytics, inventory management, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of discounts applied to this line item, including promotional discounts, coupons, temporary price reductions, and loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: extended_price
attributes.description: The total price for this line item calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, before discounts and taxes. Represents the gross line amount.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number that uniquely identifies the product internationally. Can be 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits depending on product type and packaging level.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the order, used for ordering and display purposes. Determines the sequence in which items appear on the order.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment status of this individual line item within the order lifecycle. Tracks the line from order confirmation through final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picking|picked|packed|shipped|delivered|cancelled|refunded — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount for this line item after applying all discounts and adding taxes. This is the amount the customer pays for this specific line.

attributes.name: organic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is certified organic according to USDA organic standards. Important for customer preference tracking and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: perishable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is perishable and requires special handling, temperature control, or expedited fulfillment to maintain quality and food safety.

attributes.name: picked_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this line item was physically picked from inventory by the fulfillment associate. Critical for fulfillment SLA tracking and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: picker_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the store associate or picker regarding this line item, such as product condition, substitution rationale, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is a store-owned private label brand rather than a national or regional consumer packaged goods brand.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the product as displayed to the customer during order placement and in order confirmation communications.

attributes.name: quantity_confirmed
attributes.description: The actual quantity of the item that was confirmed for fulfillment after inventory validation. May differ from quantity ordered due to stock availability or picking accuracy.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of the item that the customer originally requested in their order. This is the initial order quantity before any substitutions or out-of-stock adjustments.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit code that uniquely identifies the product within the retailer's inventory system. Primary product identifier for internal operations.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (formerly food stamps). Critical for government assistance program compliance.

attributes.name: substituted_product_name
attributes.description: The name of the substitute product provided to the customer. Used for customer communication and order accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: substituted_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the substitute product that was provided when the original item was unavailable. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: substitution_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why a substitution was made, such as out-of-stock, product discontinued, or quality concerns.

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents the original item ordered, a substituted item, an out-of-stock item, or a substitution that the customer declined.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total sales tax amount calculated and applied to this line item based on the product tax code and delivery location tax jurisdiction.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The required storage and handling temperature zone for this product: ambient (room temperature), refrigerated (cold chain), or frozen. Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.

attributes.name: tpr_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this line item was sold at a temporary promotional price reduction at the time of order placement.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the product quantity is measured, such as each, pound, kilogram, gallon, or liter. Critical for accurate pricing and inventory management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|lb|oz|kg|g|gal|qt|pt|l|ml|dozen|case — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per single unit of the product at the time of order placement, before any line-level discounts or promotions are applied.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code barcode identifier used for point-of-sale scanning and product identification across retail systems.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: The actual weight of the item picked and fulfilled, particularly important for variable-weight items like produce, meat, and deli products sold by weight.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the actual weight field, such as pounds, ounces, kilograms, or grams.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is eligible for purchase using WIC program benefits. Required for WIC program compliance and reporting.

products.name: pick_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a SKU to a picking wave in the fulfillment process, capturing quantities, status, and responsible associate for each allocation.. Existence Justification: In Grocery fulfillment, a SKU can be allocated to many picking waves over time, and each wave contains many SKUs. The allocation is managed through pick‑assignment records that capture quantities, status, and responsible associate, and these records are created, updated, and deleted by operations staff.

attributes.name: pick_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the pick_assignment association

attributes.name: assigned_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate responsible for the pick

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Wave

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity actually picked for the SKU in the wave

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority assigned to the pick within the wave

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Planned quantity of the SKU to be picked in the wave

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pick task (e.g., planned, in‑progress, completed)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantities (e.g., each, case)

products.name: line_item
products.description: Represents the association between a product_item and a payment_transaction. Each record captures the quantity of the product sold, the unit price, discounts, taxes and total price for that line in the transaction.. Existence Justification: Each payment transaction can include multiple product items, and each product item can be sold in many different payment transactions over time. The link between them is captured as a line‑item record that stores quantity, price and discount information, which is created, updated, and deleted by the sales and inventory processes.

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the line_item association

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the payment transaction containing the line

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the product_item being sold

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount applied to this line item

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the product sold in this line

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item

attributes.name: total_price
attributes.description: Final total price for this line after discounts and taxes

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of the product at the time of sale

domains.name: store
domains.description: Physical retail locations including supermarkets, pharmacies, fuel centers, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs). Manages store profiles, layouts, departments, gondolas, endcaps, backrooms, operating hours, formats, service capabilities, and regional hierarchy. Supports store clustering, comp sales performance tracking, and site selection.
domains.references: GS1 GLN (Global Location Number), OSHA Workplace Standards

products.name: store_location
products.description: Master record for every physical retail location operated by Grocery, including supermarkets, pharmacies, fuel centers, and micro-fulfillment centers (MFCs). Captures store number, banner name, format type (superstore, neighborhood market, express), ownership type (owned/leased), gross and selling square footage, opening date, remodel date, closure date, operational status, primary phone number, email, and emergency contact information. This is the SSOT for store identity across the enterprise and the anchor entity for all store-domain relationships. Every cross-domain reference to a physical store resolves to this product.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical retail location. Primary key for the store_location entity. This is the single source of truth (SSOT) for store identity across the enterprise and the anchor entity for all store-domain relationships.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Cash handling and bank reconciliation require each store to reference its dedicated bank account.

attributes.name: banner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.banner. Business justification: Store locations have a textual banner_name; adding store_location.banner_id FK creates a proper reference to the banner master table, enables consistent reporting, and removes the redundant banner_nam

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Store‑level expense reporting requires linking each store to its primary cost center for P&L and budget variance analysis.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.dc_facility. Business justification: REQUIRED: Store replenishment planning needs the primary DC assignment to calculate inbound logistics; experts expect a dc_facility_id on each store for routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.district. Business justification: Each store belongs to a district; adding district_id creates the hierarchical link without redundancy.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Store format is a master reference; replace string format_type with FK to store_format for consistency and normalization.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_gateway. Business justification: Required for POS settlement reporting: each store is assigned a payment gateway that processes its transactions, needed for daily settlement batch generation and compliance audits.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Daily sales posting uses a default GL account per store; linking enables automated journal entry generation.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Tax and regulatory filings require each store to be linked to its legal entity for jurisdictional compliance.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Pricing zone assignment per store drives zone‑specific price strategies; required for Price Zone Performance Report and zone‑based price optimization.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability dashboards aggregate sales by profit center; each store must be assigned to a profit center for store‑wide profit reporting.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.program_config. Business justification: Required for store‑level loyalty program settings used in earn‑rate calculations, store‑specific promotions, and compliance reporting; a store manager configures the program per store.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.region. Business justification: Allows direct regional performance reporting and inventory allocation per store without traversing district hierarchy.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: REQUIRED: Assortment planning assigns each store to a store cluster for category mix, planogram templates, and performance reporting; linking store_location to store_cluster enables cluster‑based asso

attributes.name: accepts_snap_ebt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is authorized to accept SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits via EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer). Impacts payment processing, regulatory compliance, and customer accessibility.

attributes.name: accepts_wic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store is authorized to accept WIC (Women, Infants, and Children) program benefits. Impacts product assortment, POS configuration, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the store location. Used for customer navigation, delivery routing, and regulatory reporting. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building identifier, or cross-street. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: backroom_square_footage
attributes.description: Square footage of storage and receiving areas behind the sales floor. Used for inventory capacity planning, replenishment strategy, and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the store is located. Used for geographic analysis, market segmentation, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date this store location permanently ceased operations. Null for active stores. Used for historical analysis, lease obligation tracking, and asset disposition planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for international operations, currency handling, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store location record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for store-level communication. Used for customer inquiries, vendor coordination, and internal communications. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 emergency contact number for the store location. Used for after-hours incidents, security alerts, and facility emergencies. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: gross_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building square footage including sales floor, backroom, offices, restrooms, and mechanical spaces. Used for facility management, lease agreements, and property tax calculations.

attributes.name: has_bakery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes an in-store bakery. Impacts food safety compliance, production scheduling, and fresh product assortment.

attributes.name: has_deli
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a deli department with prepared foods. Impacts food safety compliance (HACCP), staffing, and merchandising strategy.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, HACCP

attributes.name: has_floral
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a floral department. Impacts perishable inventory management, vendor relationships, and seasonal merchandising.

attributes.name: has_fuel_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location includes a fuel center. Impacts environmental compliance (EPA), pricing strategy, and loyalty program integration.

attributes.name: has_meat_department
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a full-service meat department with butchers. Impacts USDA compliance, cold chain management, and staffing.

attributes.name: has_organic_section
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a dedicated organic and natural foods section. Impacts merchandising strategy, vendor relationships, and customer segmentation.

attributes.name: has_pharmacy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store location includes a licensed pharmacy department. Impacts regulatory compliance (DEA, State Boards of Pharmacy, HIPAA), staffing requirements, and service offerings.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, HIPAA

attributes.name: has_seafood
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store includes a fresh seafood department. Impacts cold chain management, HACCP compliance, and specialized staffing requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, HACCP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store location record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit trails.

attributes.name: last_remodel_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent major remodel or renovation. Used to track capital investment cycles, assess store modernization status, and plan future remodel schedules.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the store location. Used for mapping, proximity analysis, delivery routing, and trade area modeling.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the store location. Used for mapping, proximity analysis, delivery routing, and trade area modeling.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: The date this store location first opened for business. Used for calculating store maturity, comp sales eligibility (typically requires 12+ months of operation), and anniversary planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the store location. Determines whether the store is open for business, undergoing changes, or closed. Critical for inventory allocation, workforce scheduling, and customer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|temporarily_closed|permanently_closed|under_construction|under_remodel|pre_opening|seasonal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the store location. Impacts financial reporting, capital expenditure planning, and operational control.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer parking spaces available at this location. Impacts site selection, customer convenience, and omnichannel pickup capacity.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary customer-facing phone number for the store. Used for customer inquiries, order status, and pharmacy consultations. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or postal code for the store location. Used for delivery zone mapping, demographic analysis, and trade area definition. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: primary_store_manager_associate_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.associate

attributes.name: selling_square_footage
attributes.description: Square footage of customer-accessible sales floor area. Excludes backroom, offices, and non-selling spaces. Used for sales productivity metrics (sales per square foot), space planning, and merchandising allocation.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code (e.g., CA, TX, ON). Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory compliance, and regional reporting.

attributes.name: store_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the store location, often including neighborhood or landmark identifiers (e.g., 'Downtown Main Street', 'Riverside Plaza'). Used for customer communication and internal reference.

attributes.name: store_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the store location. Used in all customer-facing communications, signage, and operational systems. Typically a 4-6 digit numeric code assigned sequentially or by region.

attributes.name: supports_curbside_pickup
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store offers curbside pickup service for online orders (click-and-collect). Impacts omnichannel fulfillment strategy, parking allocation, and staffing.

attributes.name: supports_home_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store serves as a fulfillment center for home delivery orders. Impacts last mile delivery (LMD) operations, inventory allocation, and order management system (OMS) integration.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the store location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago). Used for scheduling, reporting, and operational coordination across regions.

products.name: format
products.description: Reference classification of store formats used across the Grocery banner portfolio (e.g., Superstore 100K+ sqft, Neighborhood Market 40-60K sqft, Express/Convenience 10-15K sqft, Warehouse Club, Fuel-Only). Defines format-level attributes such as typical square footage range, standard department count and mix, default service capability set, planogram template family, typical SKU count range, and staffing model template. Used for store clustering, comp sales grouping, assortment planning, new store capital budgeting, and format conversion analysis.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store format. Primary key.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target_max
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue target for stores of this format, in USD. Used for comp sales performance tracking and store clustering.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target_min
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue target for stores of this format, in USD. Used for comp sales performance tracking and store clustering.

attributes.name: bakery_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format include an in-store bakery department.

attributes.name: capital_investment_typical
attributes.description: Typical total capital investment required to build or convert a store to this format, in USD. Used for new store budgeting and format conversion ROI analysis.

attributes.name: checkout_lane_count_max

attributes.name: checkout_lane_count_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of POS (Point of Sale) checkout lanes in stores of this format.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: deli_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format include a deli department with prepared foods and sliced meats.

attributes.name: department_count_max

attributes.name: department_count_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of merchandise departments typically found in stores of this format.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: endcap_count_typical

attributes.name: format_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the store format type used for strategic segmentation and portfolio analysis.

attributes.name: format_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the store format (e.g., SS for Superstore, NM for Neighborhood Market, EXP for Express). Used as a business identifier in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: format_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the store format including its purpose, target customer segment, and key differentiators.

attributes.name: format_name

attributes.name: fresh_produce_included

attributes.name: headcount_typical

attributes.name: home_delivery_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format support last-mile delivery (LMD) services to customer homes.

attributes.name: meat_seafood_included

attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format include fresh meat and seafood departments with butcher services.

attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format include or are co-located with a Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC) for automated online order fulfillment.

attributes.name: online_pickup_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format support click-and-collect online order pickup services (curbside or in-store).

attributes.name: operating_hours_typical
attributes.description: Typical daily operating hours for stores of this format (e.g., 6am-11pm, 24/7). Used for labor scheduling and customer communication.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of customer parking spaces typically provided for stores of this format.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of customer parking spaces required for stores of this format, used for site selection and zoning compliance.

attributes.name: pharmacy_included

attributes.name: self_checkout_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether stores of this format typically include self-checkout capabilities.

attributes.name: selling_area_percentage

attributes.name: sku_count_max

attributes.name: sku_count_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of unique SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) typically carried in stores of this format. Used for assortment planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: sku_count_typical
attributes.description: Typical or average number of unique SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) carried in stores of this format. Used as the baseline for assortment planning.

attributes.name: square_footage_max
attributes.description: Maximum total retail square footage for stores in this format, measured in square feet. Used for site selection and capital planning.

attributes.description: Minimum total retail square footage for stores in this format, measured in square feet. Used for site selection and capital planning.

attributes.name: square_footage_typical
attributes.description: Typical or average retail square footage for stores in this format, measured in square feet. Used as the baseline for new store planning and format conversion analysis.

attributes.name: staffing_model_template
attributes.description: Identifier for the workforce staffing model template used for stores of this format, defining typical headcount, roles, and scheduling patterns.

products.name: region

attributes.name: region_id
