attributes.description: Primary time zone for the region's operations (e.g., EST, CST, MST, PST).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this region record was last modified.

attributes.name: workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees (full-time and part-time) assigned to stores and facilities within this region.

products.name: district
products.description: Organizational hierarchy node below region, grouping a set of stores (typically 8-15) under a District Manager. Captures district code, district name, district manager employee reference, parent region reference, store count, geographic coverage description, performance tier classification, and active status. Used for operational oversight, labor scheduling aggregation, shrink accountability, weekly sales performance benchmarking, and district manager performance evaluation.

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the district organizational hierarchy node. Primary key.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary DC (Distribution Center) that services the majority of stores in this district. Used for supply chain planning and replenishment routing.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent region in the organizational hierarchy. Districts roll up to regions for executive oversight and strategic planning.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the district office or administrative location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, or building information for the district office. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_sales_target
attributes.description: Planned annual sales revenue target for the district in USD. Used for budget planning, performance evaluation, and incentive compensation calculations.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the district office is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the district office location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this district record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the district, used in operational reporting and external communications. Typically alphanumeric format assigned by corporate planning.

attributes.name: district_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the district, often reflecting geographic coverage or regional designation (e.g., 'Metro Atlanta District', 'Northern California District').

attributes.name: district_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the district. Active districts have full operational authority; inactive districts are closed or suspended; consolidating districts are merging with others; restructuring districts are undergoing boundary or leadership changes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the current district configuration will end or ended. Null for currently active configurations. Used for temporal hierarchy management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the current district configuration became effective. Used for time-based hierarchy queries and historical analysis of organizational changes.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for district-level communication and operational correspondence.

attributes.name: established_date
attributes.description: Date when the district was officially established in the organizational hierarchy. Used for tenure analysis and historical reporting.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic area covered by this district, including cities, counties, or regional boundaries. Used for territory planning and market analysis.

attributes.name: labor_budget_hours
attributes.description: Total budgeted labor hours per week across all stores in the district. Used for workforce planning, scheduling optimization, and labor cost management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special considerations, or operational context about the district. Used for qualitative information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Classification of district performance based on composite metrics including Comp Sales (Comparable Store Sales), Shrink (Inventory Loss), GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment), and NPS (Net Promoter Score). Used for resource allocation and incentive compensation.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the district office or district manager. Used for operational communication and escalation.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code (ZIP code in USA) for the district office location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: shrink_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target shrink rate as a percentage of sales for the district. Shrink represents inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage. District managers are accountable for maintaining shrink below this threshold.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the district office location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Total number of active stores currently assigned to this district. Typically ranges from 8 to 15 stores per district for effective span of control.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Primary time zone for the district, used for scheduling, reporting cutoffs, and operational coordination. Follows IANA time zone database naming convention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: America/New_York|America/Chicago|America/Denver|America/Los_Angeles|America/Phoenix|America/Anchorage|Pacific/Honolulu — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Aggregate selling square footage across all stores in the district. Used for productivity analysis, sales per square foot benchmarking, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the user who last modified this district record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this district record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness monitoring.

products.name: department
products.description: Operational department within a store such as Produce, Bakery, Deli, Pharmacy, Floral, Frozen Foods, or General Merchandise. Captures department number, name, type classification (perishable, center-store, service), assigned manager, allocated square footage, gondola count, endcap count, cooler door count, planogram family, shrink budget target, HACCP classification, and backroom storage zone configuration (capacity, cooler/freezer flags, FIFO lane count). Supports labor scheduling, category performance reporting, replenishment planning, food safety compliance, and fixture inventory tracking.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the department. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee assigned as the department manager responsible for operations, staffing, and performance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Department‑level expense allocation uses a dedicated cost center for detailed cost tracking.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store where this department is located.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the lead vendor designated as category captain for this department, responsible for category management insights and assortment recommendations.

attributes.name: backroom_capacity_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Total storage capacity in cubic feet allocated to this department in the backroom area.

attributes.name: backroom_cooler_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department has dedicated refrigerated storage in the backroom for cold chain inventory management.

attributes.name: backroom_freezer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the department has dedicated frozen storage in the backroom for frozen product inventory management.

attributes.name: backroom_storage_zone
attributes.description: Designated backroom storage area identifier assigned to this department for inventory staging and replenishment.

attributes.name: cooler_door_count
attributes.description: Number of refrigerated display doors allocated to this department for temperature-controlled products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this department record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the department (e.g., Produce, Bakery, Deli, Pharmacy, Frozen Foods, General Merchandise).

attributes.name: department_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the department, typically a 2-4 digit code used in store operations and reporting.

attributes.name: department_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the department within the store.

attributes.name: department_type
attributes.description: Classification of the department based on operational characteristics: perishable (fresh produce, meat, dairy), center_store (shelf-stable goods), service (deli, bakery, floral), pharmacy (prescription and OTC medications), fuel (fuel center operations).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this department configuration ceased to be effective, null for currently active departments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this department configuration became effective in the store.

attributes.name: endcap_count
attributes.description: Number of end-of-aisle display positions (endcaps) allocated to this department for promotional merchandise.

attributes.name: fifo_lane_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Lane Count
attributes.description: Number of FIFO rotation lanes configured in the backroom storage zone to ensure proper inventory rotation and minimize spoilage.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code assigned to this department for financial accounting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: gondola_count
attributes.description: Number of gondola shelving units allocated to this department for product display.

attributes.name: haccp_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Classification
attributes.description: HACCP food safety classification indicating whether the department handles critical control point products requiring enhanced food safety monitoring and documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP Principles

attributes.name: labor_standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Standard weekly labor hours allocated to this department based on sales volume and operational complexity, used for workforce scheduling and labor budgeting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this department record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this department carries USDA organic certified products requiring special handling and segregation.

attributes.name: planogram_family
attributes.description: Planogram template family or category assigned to this department for visual merchandise display planning and fixture layout standardization.

attributes.name: pos_department_code
attributes.description: Department code used in POS transaction processing and sales reporting systems for revenue attribution.

attributes.name: private_label_focus_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this department has a strategic focus on private label (store-owned brand) product assortment and merchandising.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code assigned to this department for profitability analysis and management reporting.

attributes.name: replenishment_method
attributes.description: Primary inventory replenishment method used for this department: CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering), manual ordering, DSD (Direct Store Delivery), or cross-dock distribution.

attributes.name: shrink_budget_target_percent
attributes.description: Target shrink rate (inventory loss from theft, spoilage, or damage) expressed as a percentage of sales, used for loss prevention planning and performance evaluation.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this department are generally eligible for purchase using SNAP/EBT benefits.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total sales floor area allocated to this department in square feet, used for space productivity analysis and planogram planning.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Primary temperature control zone classification for products in this department, critical for cold chain compliance and food safety.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this department are generally eligible for purchase using WIC benefits.

products.name: operating_hours
products.description: Scheduled and actual operating hours for each store location by day of week and date, including holiday overrides. Captures open time, close time, pharmacy hours, fuel center hours, pickup window hours, and special event hours. Supports omnichannel order fulfillment slot availability, customer-facing store locator, and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: operating_hours_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operating hours record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location to which these operating hours apply. Links to the store master data.

attributes.name: bakery_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store bakery department closes for fresh baked goods service. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if bakery is not available at this location.

attributes.name: bakery_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store bakery department opens for fresh baked goods service. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if bakery is not available at this location.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: The reason for store closure when is_closed is True. Holiday for recognized holidays, weather for severe weather events, emergency for unplanned incidents, renovation for planned maintenance, staffing for labor shortages, inventory for physical inventory counts, special_event for community events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: holiday|weather|emergency|renovation|staffing|inventory|special_event — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this operating hours record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_service_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the customer service desk closes for returns, money orders, lottery, and other services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if customer service desk is not staffed separately.

attributes.name: customer_service_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the customer service desk opens for returns, money orders, lottery, and other services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if customer service desk is not staffed separately.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: The day of the week for recurring weekly operating hours schedules. Used in conjunction with or independently from effective_date for standard weekly patterns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deli_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store deli department closes for fresh food service. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if deli is not available at this location.

attributes.name: deli_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store deli department opens for fresh food service. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if deli is not available at this location.

attributes.name: delivery_cutoff_time
attributes.description: The latest time by which same-day or next-day delivery orders must be placed for fulfillment from this store location. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Supports last mile delivery (LMD) operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date for which these operating hours are effective. Used for date-specific overrides such as holidays or special events.

attributes.name: fuel_center_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the fuel center closes for customer fueling. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates fuel center is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: fuel_center_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the fuel center opens for customer fueling. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates fuel center is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: holiday_name
attributes.description: The name of the holiday when schedule_type is holiday. Examples include Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years Day, Independence Day. Used for customer communication and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: is_24_hour_store
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store operates 24 hours per day. True if store never closes, False if store has defined open and close times.

attributes.name: is_closed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store is completely closed on this date or day of week. True if closed all day, False if open for any period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this operating hours record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about these operating hours. May include reasons for changes, special instructions, or customer communication details.

attributes.name: online_ordering_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether online ordering for pickup or delivery is available during these operating hours. True if omnichannel order fulfillment is active, False if disabled.

attributes.name: operating_hours_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this operating hours record. Active indicates currently in effect, inactive for historical records, pending for future scheduled changes, superseded when replaced by a newer record.

attributes.name: pharmacy_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store pharmacy closes for prescription services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates pharmacy is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_lunch_break_end
attributes.description: The end time of the pharmacy lunch break closure period. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Required by some State Boards of Pharmacy for single-pharmacist locations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_lunch_break_start
attributes.description: The start time of the pharmacy lunch break closure period. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Required by some State Boards of Pharmacy for single-pharmacist locations.

attributes.name: pharmacy_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the in-store pharmacy opens for prescription services. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates pharmacy is closed or not available at this location.

attributes.name: pickup_window_end_time
attributes.description: The latest time when curbside or in-store pickup orders can be collected by customers. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Supports omnichannel click-and-collect fulfillment slot availability.

attributes.name: pickup_window_start_time
attributes.description: The earliest time when curbside or in-store pickup orders can be collected by customers. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Supports omnichannel click-and-collect fulfillment slot availability.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for resolving conflicts when multiple operating hours records apply to the same store and date. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Date-specific overrides typically have priority 1, standard weekly schedules have priority 10.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when these operating hours were published to customer-facing channels. Used for audit trail and customer communication tracking.

attributes.name: published_to_website
attributes.description: Indicates whether these operating hours have been published to the customer-facing store locator and website. True if visible to customers, False if internal only.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operating hours schedule. Standard represents normal weekly hours, holiday represents holiday overrides, special_event for promotional events, temporary for short-term changes, seasonal for recurring seasonal adjustments, emergency for unplanned closures or modifications.

attributes.name: senior_hours_end_time
attributes.description: The end time for dedicated senior citizen and vulnerable population shopping hours. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if no senior hours are offered.

attributes.name: senior_hours_start_time
attributes.description: The start time for dedicated senior citizen and vulnerable population shopping hours. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null if no senior hours are offered.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this operating hours data. Examples include Oracle Retail, SAP Retail, or proprietary store management systems.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: The name of the special event when schedule_type is special_event. Examples include Grand Opening, Anniversary Sale, Community Day. Used for promotional planning and extended hours justification.

attributes.name: store_close_time
attributes.description: The time when the main store closes to customer shopping. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates store is closed for the day.

attributes.name: store_open_time
attributes.description: The time when the main store opens for customer shopping. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation. Null indicates store is closed for the day.

products.name: service_capability
products.description: Catalog of service capabilities available at a store location, such as Curbside Pickup, Home Delivery, Click-and-Collect, Pharmacy Drive-Through, Coinstar, Western Union, Starbucks Kiosk, Sushi Bar, Floral Custom Orders, EBT/SNAP/WIC acceptance, lottery sales, money orders, and bottle return. Each record defines the capability type, activation status, capacity limits (e.g., max concurrent pickup orders), staffing requirements, equipment dependencies, and effective date range. Enables omnichannel order routing, customer-facing store locator feature display, labor planning, and site selection analysis.

attributes.name: service_capability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service capability record. Primary key.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where this service capability is offered.

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the service capability at this store location. Active means the service is currently available to customers.

attributes.name: average_fulfillment_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes required to fulfill a customer order or transaction using this service capability. Used for customer communication and capacity planning.

attributes.name: capability_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the service capability to support filtering and reporting.

attributes.name: capability_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of service capability (e.g., CURBSIDE_PICKUP, HOME_DELIVERY, PHARMACY_DRIVE_THRU, COINSTAR, WESTERN_UNION, STARBUCKS_KIOSK, SUSHI_BAR, FLORAL_CUSTOM, EBT_SNAP_WIC, LOTTERY, MONEY_ORDER, BOTTLE_RETURN).

attributes.name: capability_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service capability, including what it offers and any special conditions or limitations.

attributes.name: capability_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service capability for customer-facing display and internal reference.

attributes.name: capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum concurrent capacity for this service capability (e.g., maximum number of pickup orders that can be processed simultaneously, number of drive-thru lanes, kiosk stations). Null if no specific limit applies.

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity limit (e.g., orders per hour, concurrent customers, transaction slots).

attributes.name: compliance_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff must complete specific compliance training or certification to operate this service capability (e.g., HIPAA training for pharmacy, food safety certification for food service).
attributes.references: HIPAA, FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, State Health Departments

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability should be displayed to customers in store locator tools, mobile apps, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: daily_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of service transactions or orders that can be fulfilled in a single day. Used for omnichannel order routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: display_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority for ordering service capabilities in customer-facing displays. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service capability was or will be discontinued at the store location. Null indicates the service is ongoing with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this service capability became or will become available at the store location.

attributes.name: equipment_description
attributes.description: Description of the specialized equipment or infrastructure required to support this service capability, including make, model, or configuration details.

attributes.name: equipment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized equipment or infrastructure is required to deliver this service capability (e.g., refrigerated pickup lockers, drive-thru window, kiosk hardware).

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment or infrastructure for this service capability was installed at the store location.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent maintenance or inspection was performed on the equipment or infrastructure supporting this service capability.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capability record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory license or permit expires and must be renewed to continue offering this service capability.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, State Lottery Commissions, State Banking Regulators

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Regulatory license or permit number authorizing the store to offer this service capability. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, State Lottery Commissions, State Banking Regulators

attributes.name: license_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory license or permit is required to offer this service capability (e.g., pharmacy license, lottery license, money transmitter license).
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy, State Lottery Commissions, State Banking Regulators

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next scheduled maintenance or inspection is due for the equipment or infrastructure supporting this service capability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about this service capability, including special instructions, known issues, or temporary conditions.

attributes.name: omnichannel_routing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability is integrated with the Order Management System (OMS) for automated omnichannel order routing and fulfillment assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: oms_capability_code
attributes.description: Code used by the Order Management System to identify and route orders to this service capability. Must match OMS configuration.

attributes.name: operating_hours_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the operating hours for this service capability if different from store hours (e.g., Pharmacy: Mon-Fri 9am-9pm, Sat 9am-6pm, Sun 10am-6pm).

attributes.name: operating_hours_same_as_store_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Hours Same as Store Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability operates during the same hours as the store itself, or has different operating hours.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue from this service capability that is shared with a vendor partner. Confidential business information used for financial reporting and vendor management.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service capability typically ends each year. Null if not seasonal.

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service capability is offered seasonally rather than year-round (e.g., holiday gift wrapping, seasonal outdoor plant sales).

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service capability typically begins each year. Null if not seasonal.

attributes.name: sla_target_time_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Time in Minutes
attributes.description: Target service level agreement time in minutes for fulfilling customer orders or transactions using this service capability. Used for performance monitoring and customer expectations.

attributes.name: staffing_requirement_fte
attributes.description: Number of full-time equivalent employees required to operate this service capability during standard operating hours. Used for labor planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: vendor_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party vendor or partner that provides or supports this service capability (e.g., Coinstar, Western Union, Starbucks, Instacart). Null if operated directly by the retailer.

products.name: mfc_profile
products.description: Master profile for a Micro-Fulfillment Center (MFC) co-located with or adjacent to a store. Captures MFC ID, associated store location, MFC type (automated/manual), total tote capacity, daily order throughput capacity, temperature zone configuration (ambient, chilled, frozen), WMS system integration reference, activation date, and operational status. Supports omnichannel fulfillment routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: mfc_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the micro-fulfillment center profile record. Primary key.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail store location with which this MFC is co-located or adjacent. Links the MFC to its parent store for operational and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Robotics vendor contracts are managed per fulfillment center; linking enables tracking of vendor performance, costs, and compliance for each store's MFC.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the MFC became operational and began fulfilling customer orders. Used for capacity planning and performance tracking.

attributes.name: ambient_zone_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC has an ambient temperature zone for storing shelf-stable products (dry goods, canned items, non-perishables).

attributes.name: average_inventory_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Rolling average percentage of inventory records that match physical counts during cycle counts. Key metric for operational excellence.

attributes.name: average_order_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: Rolling average percentage of orders fulfilled without errors (wrong items, missing items, damaged items). Critical customer satisfaction metric.

attributes.name: average_order_fulfillment_time_minutes
attributes.description: Mean time in minutes from order receipt to order ready for pickup or dispatch. Critical SLA metric for omnichannel fulfillment.

attributes.name: average_pick_time_seconds
attributes.description: Mean time in seconds to pick a single item from inventory. Key performance indicator for MFC efficiency and throughput modeling.

attributes.name: chilled_zone_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC has a refrigerated zone for storing chilled products (dairy, fresh produce, deli items) typically maintained at 32-40°F.

attributes.name: cold_chain_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC has automated temperature monitoring systems for chilled and frozen zones to ensure cold chain integrity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MFC profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: daily_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of customer orders the MFC can fulfill in a 24-hour period under normal operating conditions. Used for order routing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the MFC ceased operations, if applicable. Null for active MFCs. Used for historical analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: food_safety_inspection_score
attributes.description: Numerical score from the most recent food safety inspection, typically on a 0-100 scale. Higher scores indicate better compliance.

attributes.name: frozen_zone_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC has a frozen storage zone for frozen foods, ice cream, and other products requiring temperatures at or below 0°F.

attributes.name: fulfillment_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment services supported by this MFC (e.g., curbside pickup, home delivery, ship-from-store, same-day delivery). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: curbside_pickup|home_delivery|ship_from_store|same_day_delivery|next_day_delivery|scheduled_delivery|locker_pickup — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: haccp_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC has achieved HACCP certification for food safety management, required for facilities handling perishable foods.
attributes.references: FDA HACCP Principles and Application Guidelines

attributes.name: last_food_safety_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent food safety inspection by regulatory authorities (FDA, USDA, or state health department). Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MFC profile record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: mfc_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the MFC, used in operational systems and reporting. Format: MFC followed by 6 digits.

attributes.name: mfc_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the MFC, typically including geographic or store reference for easy identification by operations teams.

attributes.name: mfc_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MFC based on its operational model: automated (fully robotic picking and packing), semi-automated (hybrid human and robotic), or manual (human-only fulfillment).

attributes.name: number_of_packing_stations
attributes.description: Count of workstations where picked orders are packed into bags or boxes for customer delivery or pickup. Used for labor planning.

attributes.name: number_of_picking_stations
attributes.description: Count of workstations where associates or robots pick items into customer orders. Key metric for throughput capacity planning.

attributes.name: number_of_robots
attributes.description: Total count of robotic units (picking robots, transport robots, sorting robots) deployed in the MFC. Zero for manual facilities.

attributes.name: oms_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC is integrated with the enterprise Order Management System for real-time order routing and fulfillment orchestration.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time for MFC operations in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for order routing and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time for MFC operations in 24-hour HH:MM format. Used for order routing and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MFC indicating whether it is actively fulfilling orders, temporarily offline, being built, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: peak_hourly_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the MFC can process in a single hour during peak demand periods. Critical for real-time order routing decisions.

attributes.name: picking_square_footage
attributes.description: Floor area dedicated to order picking operations in square feet. Used for productivity analysis and space utilization metrics.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC uses RFID technology for inventory tracking and order accuracy verification.

attributes.name: robotics_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the robotics or automation technology provider for automated or semi-automated MFCs (e.g., AutoStore, Dematic, Ocado). Null for manual MFCs.

attributes.name: sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique SKUs stocked in the MFC at any given time. Indicates assortment breadth and inventory complexity.

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total floor area of the MFC facility in square feet, including all operational zones, staging areas, and support spaces.

attributes.name: total_tote_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of totes (storage containers) that the MFC can hold at any given time. Key metric for inventory capacity planning.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MFC operates continuously 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. True for round-the-clock facilities.

attributes.name: wms_instance_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific WMS instance or tenant serving this MFC. Used for technical integration and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: wms_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the WMS platform integrated with this MFC (e.g., Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM). Used for system integration and support.

products.name: remodel_project
products.description: Tracks store remodel, expansion, or refresh projects including project ID, store location, project type (full remodel, department refresh, technology upgrade, ADA compliance), planned start date, planned completion date, actual completion date, capital budget, contractor reference, and project status. Supports capital planning, store closure scheduling, and comp sales exclusion flagging during remodel periods.

attributes.name: remodel_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store remodel, expansion, or refresh project.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location undergoing remodel or expansion.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when remodel project was completed and store resumed normal operations.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total actual expenditure incurred on the remodel project in USD. Tracked for budget variance analysis and capital planning accuracy.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when remodel construction or implementation activities commenced.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the remodel project was formally approved by executive leadership or capital planning committee.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the remodel project was cancelled or terminated before completion.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the remodel project was cancelled (e.g., budget constraints, store closure decision, market conditions, permitting issues).

attributes.name: capital_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved capital budget allocated for the remodel project in USD. Includes construction, equipment, fixtures, and technology costs.

attributes.name: closure_end_date
attributes.description: Date when store reopens to customers after remodel-related closure period.

attributes.name: closure_start_date
attributes.description: Date when store closure begins if full closure is required for the remodel project.

attributes.name: comp_sales_exclusion_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) Exclusion End Date
attributes.description: Date when the store is reintroduced into comp sales calculations after remodel completion and stabilization period.

attributes.name: comp_sales_exclusion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) Exclusion Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this store should be excluded from comp sales (same-store sales) calculations during the remodel period due to operational disruption. True means exclude from comp sales reporting; false means include in comp sales.

attributes.name: comp_sales_exclusion_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) Exclusion Start Date
attributes.description: Date when the store begins to be excluded from comp sales calculations due to remodel disruption.

attributes.name: contractor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary general contractor or construction firm responsible for executing the remodel project.

attributes.name: contractor_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or contract identifier for the contractor agreement associated with this remodel project.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this remodel project record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: departments_impacted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store departments affected by the remodel project (e.g., produce, deli, bakery, pharmacy, fuel center, front end).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the remodel project is planned and budgeted (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: inspection_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when final building inspection was completed and approved by local authorities, allowing store to resume operations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this remodel project record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the remodel project for internal tracking and communication.

attributes.name: payback_period_months
attributes.description: Expected number of months for the remodel investment to be recovered through incremental sales and margin improvements.

attributes.name: permit_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the building permit was issued by local authorities for the remodel project.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Local government building permit number issued for the remodel construction work.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for remodel project to be completed and store to resume normal operations.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for remodel project to begin construction or implementation activities.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Relative priority ranking of this remodel project within the annual capital plan portfolio. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal project manager or construction manager responsible for overseeing the remodel project.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the remodel project for business communication and reporting.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique project number for tracking and reference in capital planning systems.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the remodel project. Planning indicates initial scoping and budgeting; approved means capital budget has been authorized; in_progress indicates active construction; on_hold reflects temporary suspension; completed means project is finished and store is operational; cancelled indicates project was terminated before completion.

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the remodel project scope. Full remodel includes complete store renovation; department refresh targets specific departments (produce, pharmacy, deli); technology upgrade focuses on POS, self-checkout, or digital signage; ADA compliance addresses accessibility requirements; expansion adds square footage; format conversion changes store format (e.g., conventional to fresh format).

attributes.name: roi_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target return on investment percentage for the remodel project, used in capital planning and project approval decisions.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the remodel project scope, including specific work to be performed, fixtures to be replaced, technology to be installed, and layout changes.

attributes.name: square_footage_after
attributes.description: Total retail square footage of the store after the remodel or expansion project is completed.

attributes.name: square_footage_before
attributes.description: Total retail square footage of the store before the remodel or expansion project.

attributes.name: store_closure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the store must be fully closed to customers during the remodel period. True means full closure; false means store remains open with partial operations.

products.name: site_selection
products.description: Site selection evaluation record for candidate new store locations in the real estate pipeline. Captures site ID, candidate address and coordinates, target store format, trade area demographics (population, median income, household density), estimated annual sales volume, proximity to existing stores and competitors, cannibalization risk score, lease/purchase terms summary, zoning and permitting status, environmental assessment status, approval stage, and decision date. Supports real estate strategy, new store opening pipeline management, and capital allocation decisions.
products.reference: Site Selection / Real Estate Pipeline — Retail Expansion

attributes.name: site_selection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the site selection evaluation record. Primary key for the site selection entity.

attributes.name: format_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_format. Business justification: Site selection records need to specify the intended store format; FK provides this relationship.

attributes.name: annual_lease_cost
attributes.description: Estimated annual lease cost in US dollars including base rent and common area maintenance (CAM). Null if the site is a purchase.

attributes.name: approval_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the site selection approval workflow. Tracks progression through the capital allocation and real estate decision process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_review|feasibility_study|due_diligence|executive_review|approved|rejected|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: candidate_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the candidate site location.

attributes.name: candidate_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information for the candidate site.

attributes.name: candidate_city
attributes.description: City name for the candidate site location.

attributes.name: candidate_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the candidate site location.

attributes.name: candidate_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the candidate site location.

attributes.name: candidate_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the candidate site location.

attributes.name: cannibalization_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing the estimated risk that the new store will negatively impact sales at existing nearby stores. Higher scores indicate greater cannibalization risk.

attributes.name: competitor_count_within_trade_area
attributes.description: Number of direct competitor stores within the defined trade area. Used for competitive intensity assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the site selection record was first created in the system. Used for pipeline tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the final go/no-go decision was made for the candidate site. Null if still under evaluation.

attributes.name: decision_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision outcome for the site selection evaluation. Approved sites move to the store opening pipeline.

attributes.name: distance_to_nearest_competitor_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the candidate site to the nearest competitor store. Used for competitive positioning analysis.

attributes.name: distance_to_nearest_own_store_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the candidate site to the nearest existing company-owned store. Used to assess cannibalization risk and market coverage gaps.

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of Phase I and Phase II environmental site assessments. Required for EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) compliance and risk mitigation, particularly for fuel center sites.

attributes.name: environmental_issues_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental concerns or contamination were identified during site assessment. True if issues exist that require remediation or further investigation.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_sales_volume
attributes.description: Projected annual sales revenue in US dollars for the candidate location based on trade area analysis and comparable store performance. Used for ROI (Return on Investment) and capital allocation decisions.

attributes.name: estimated_build_out_cost
attributes.description: Projected cost in US dollars for construction, fixtures, equipment, and store build-out. Used for total capital investment calculation.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing qualitative observations, risks, opportunities, and strategic considerations for the site evaluation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the site selection record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the candidate site in decimal degrees. Used for proximity analysis and trade area mapping.

attributes.name: lease_or_purchase_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site will be leased, purchased, or developed as a build-to-suit arrangement. Impacts capital requirements and financial modeling.

attributes.name: lease_term_years
attributes.description: Length of the proposed lease term in years. Null if the site is a purchase. Used for lease obligation tracking and financial planning.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the candidate site in decimal degrees. Used for proximity analysis and trade area mapping.

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: Geographic market or region designation for the candidate site. Used for regional portfolio planning and market penetration analysis.

attributes.name: parking_spaces_count
attributes.description: Number of available parking spaces at the candidate site. Critical for customer convenience and local zoning compliance.

attributes.name: permitting_status
attributes.description: Current status of building and operational permits required for store opening. Includes construction, occupancy, and health department permits.

attributes.name: planned_square_footage
attributes.description: Total planned retail and operational square footage for the candidate store location.

attributes.name: projected_opening_date
attributes.description: Target date for store opening if the site is approved. Used for capital planning and operational readiness scheduling.

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Proposed purchase price in US dollars for the site and property. Null if the site is a lease.

attributes.name: real_estate_broker
attributes.description: Name of the real estate broker or firm representing the site opportunity. Used for vendor relationship tracking.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the candidate site in the real estate pipeline. Used for tracking and reference across real estate and capital planning systems.

attributes.name: target_store_format
attributes.description: Planned store format type for the candidate location. Determines size, assortment, and service capabilities. MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center) represents automated fulfillment facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: supermarket|hypermarket|neighborhood_market|express|pharmacy|fuel_center|mfc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: trade_area_household_density
attributes.description: Number of households per square mile within the trade area. Indicates market density and potential customer base.

attributes.name: trade_area_median_income
attributes.description: Median household income in US dollars within the trade area. Key demographic indicator for assortment planning and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: trade_area_population
attributes.description: Total population count within the defined trade area radius for the candidate site. Used for demand forecasting and market sizing.

attributes.name: traffic_count_daily
attributes.description: Average daily vehicle traffic count on the primary road adjacent to the candidate site. Key visibility and accessibility metric.

attributes.name: zoning_status
attributes.description: Current status of zoning approval for the intended retail use. Critical gate for site viability and timeline planning.

products.name: location_event
products.description: Record of significant operational events at a store location such as grand openings, temporary closures (weather, emergency, remodel), power outages, refrigeration failures, health department inspections, OSHA visits, fire marshal inspections, bomb threats, active shooter lockdowns, or special community events. Captures event type, start datetime, end datetime, duration, impact severity (critical/major/minor), affected departments, estimated sales impact, root cause category, resolution notes, and follow-up action items. Supports operational continuity planning, insurance claims, comp sales adjustment flagging, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: location_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for location_event

attributes.name: primary_location_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who initially reported or logged the event. Links to employee master data.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the event occurred. Links to the store master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external vendor or contractor involved in the event response or resolution (e.g., HVAC repair company, security firm, cleaning service). Null if no external vendor was involved.

attributes.name: affected_departments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store departments impacted by the event (e.g., Produce, Meat, Deli, Pharmacy, Bakery, Frozen Foods, Dairy). Used to assess scope of operational disruption.

attributes.name: comp_sales_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event should trigger an adjustment to comparable store sales (comp sales) reporting. True if the event significantly impacted sales and should be excluded from comp sales calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this event record was first created in the system. Represents the initial logging of the event.

attributes.name: customer_communication_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer-facing communication was issued regarding the event (e.g., store closure notice, service disruption alert). True if communication was sent.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the event in minutes, calculated from start to end timestamp. Used for operational impact analysis and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_sales_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact on store sales revenue in US dollars due to the event. Used for insurance claims, comp sales adjustments, and financial reporting. Negative values indicate lost revenue.

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the event type for reporting and analysis purposes. Operational events affect store operations, regulatory events involve compliance inspections, safety events involve hazards, emergency events require immediate response, promotional events are customer-facing, and maintenance events involve planned repairs.

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the store event ended or is scheduled to end. Null if the event is ongoing or end time is not yet determined.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique event number assigned to this location event for tracking and reference purposes. Format: EVT-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the store event began or is scheduled to begin. Represents the actual or planned start of the event occurrence.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the store event. Tracks progression from initial scheduling through resolution and closure.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the store event. Indicates the nature of the operational event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grand_opening|temporary_closure|power_outage|refrigeration_failure|health_inspection|osha_visit|fire_marshal_inspection|bomb_threat|active_shooter_lockdown|community_event|remodel|weather_closure|emergency_closure|equipment_failure|pest_control|security_incident — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: follow_up_action_items
attributes.description: List of follow-up actions, preventive measures, or corrective tasks identified as a result of the event. Used for continuous improvement and risk mitigation.

attributes.name: impact_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the event impact on store operations. Critical events cause complete store closure or major safety hazards, major events significantly disrupt operations, minor events have limited impact, and informational events are for record-keeping only.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of a regulatory inspection event. Passed indicates full compliance, failed indicates violations found, conditional indicates minor issues requiring follow-up, and pending indicates results not yet finalized.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: Reference number for any insurance claim filed as a result of the event. Used to track financial recovery and claim status.

attributes.name: media_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event received media attention or press coverage. True if the event was reported in news media or social media.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or observations about the event that do not fit into other structured fields. Used for supplementary context and documentation.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required notifications were sent to corporate headquarters, regional management, or regulatory agencies. True if notifications were completed per protocol.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event notification was sent to relevant stakeholders. Used for compliance tracking and response time analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory or governing body involved in the event (e.g., FDA, USDA, DEA, State Board of Pharmacy, OSHA, EPA, Fire Marshal, Health Department). Applicable for inspection and compliance events.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing how the event was resolved, actions taken, and final outcome. Captures the response and remediation activities performed.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the underlying cause of the event. Used for trend analysis and preventive action planning.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause of the event. Provides context for understanding why the event occurred and what factors contributed.

attributes.name: store_closure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event resulted in a complete store closure. True if the store was closed to customers during the event, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this event record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: violation_count
attributes.description: Number of violations or deficiencies identified during a regulatory inspection event. Zero indicates no violations found.

attributes.name: violation_details
attributes.description: Detailed description of violations or deficiencies identified during a regulatory inspection, including citation codes and corrective action requirements.

products.name: health_inspection
products.description: Record of food safety and health department inspections conducted at a store location. Captures inspection ID, inspection date, inspecting agency (local health department, FDA, USDA), inspection type (routine, follow-up, complaint-driven), overall score, critical violation count, non-critical violation count, HACCP compliance status, corrective action plan, and re-inspection date. Supports FDA/USDA regulatory compliance and HACCP program management.
products.reference: Food Safety Inspection Record — FDA/USDA/HACCP Compliance

attributes.name: health_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the health inspection record. Primary key for the health inspection entity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the health inspection was conducted.

attributes.name: closure_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the store or department was permitted to reopen after corrective actions were verified and approved by the inspecting agency.

attributes.name: closure_ordered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspecting agency ordered immediate closure of the store or specific departments due to critical food safety violations posing imminent health hazard. True indicates closure ordered, False indicates no closure.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Emergency Powers

attributes.name: closure_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the store or department closure became effective due to health violations.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which all corrective actions must be completed to address violations identified during the inspection.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions required to address violations, including specific steps, responsible parties, and timelines for remediation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective actions are required to address violations identified during the inspection. True indicates corrective actions needed, False indicates no actions required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the health inspection record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of critical violations identified during the inspection. Critical violations are food safety issues that pose immediate risk to public health (e.g., improper food temperatures, cross-contamination, inadequate handwashing).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 5, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: cross_contamination_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for preventing cross-contamination between raw and ready-to-eat foods, proper separation of food preparation areas, and equipment sanitation.

attributes.name: departments_inspected
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store departments included in the inspection scope (e.g., Deli, Bakery, Meat, Seafood, Produce, Pharmacy, Prepared Foods, Grocery).

attributes.name: facility_maintenance_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for physical facility maintenance including floors, walls, ceilings, lighting, ventilation, and equipment condition.

attributes.name: food_temperature_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for proper food storage and holding temperatures. Critical for preventing bacterial growth and foodborne illness.

attributes.name: haccp_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Status of compliance with HACCP food safety management system principles. HACCP is a systematic preventive approach to food safety addressing biological, chemical, and physical hazards. Compliant indicates full adherence, non-compliant indicates violations, not-applicable indicates HACCP not required for this location, partial indicates some HACCP elements in place.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-2, HACCP Principles

attributes.name: handwashing_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for proper handwashing facilities, employee hand hygiene practices, and personal cleanliness standards.

attributes.name: inspecting_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency or health department that conducted the inspection (e.g., County Health Department, FDA, USDA).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, USDA FSIS Regulations

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the health inspection was conducted at the store location.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the inspection in minutes, from start to completion.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique inspection number assigned by the inspecting agency or internal tracking system.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: inspection_report_url
attributes.description: URL link to the full inspection report document stored in the document management system or public health department website.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the health inspection. Scheduled indicates future inspection, in-progress indicates active inspection, completed indicates inspection finished, passed indicates no critical violations, failed indicates critical violations found, pending-review indicates awaiting final determination, cancelled indicates inspection did not occur. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in-progress|completed|passed|failed|pending-review|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, Internal Compliance Standards

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of health inspection conducted. Routine inspections are scheduled periodic reviews, follow-up inspections verify corrective actions, complaint-driven inspections respond to customer or employee reports, pre-opening inspections occur before new store launch, special inspections address specific concerns, and reinspections verify compliance after violations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: inspector_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or badge number of the health inspector assigned by the inspecting agency.

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the health inspector who conducted the inspection.

attributes.name: letter_grade
attributes.description: Letter grade assigned to the inspection based on overall score, if applicable in the jurisdiction (A=excellent, B=good, C=satisfactory, D=marginal, F=failing).

attributes.name: non_critical_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of non-critical violations identified during the inspection. Non-critical violations are food safety issues that do not pose immediate risk but require correction (e.g., minor equipment maintenance, documentation gaps).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments from the inspector or store management regarding the inspection, violations, or corrective actions.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the inspection representing overall food safety compliance. Scoring scale varies by jurisdiction (e.g., 0-100 scale where higher is better, or deduction-based scoring).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Scoring Standards

attributes.name: pest_control_compliance
attributes.description: Compliance status for pest prevention and control measures, including evidence of rodents, insects, or other pests.

attributes.name: posted_at_store
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspection results or grade card has been posted at the store location as required by local regulations. True indicates posted, False indicates not posted.

attributes.name: public_disclosure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the inspection results are subject to public disclosure or posting requirements per local health department regulations. True indicates public disclosure required, False indicates confidential.
attributes.references: State Health Department Public Records Laws

attributes.name: reinspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for follow-up reinspection to verify that corrective actions have been completed and violations have been resolved.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code Section 8-4, State Health Department Standards

attributes.name: reinspection_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a follow-up reinspection is required to verify corrective actions have been completed. True indicates reinspection needed, False indicates no reinspection required.

attributes.name: score_scale
attributes.description: Description of the scoring scale used for the overall score (e.g., 0-100 scale, A-F letter grade, pass/fail, deduction-based).

attributes.name: total_violation_count
attributes.description: Total number of violations (critical and non-critical combined) identified during the inspection.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the health inspection record was last modified in the system.

products.name: lease
products.description: Real estate lease record for store locations that are leased rather than owned. Captures lease ID, store location, landlord entity name, lease commencement date, lease expiration date, renewal option terms, base rent amount, CAM (Common Area Maintenance) charges, rent escalation schedule, co-tenancy clauses, exclusivity provisions, and lease status. Supports real estate portfolio management, SOX financial disclosure, and capital vs. operating lease classification.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Real-time and historical stock positions across all stores, distribution centers, and MFCs. Manages on-hand quantities, reserved stock, FIFO/LIFO rotation tracking, shrink records (theft, spoilage, damage), OOS monitoring, cycle counts, cold chain temperature compliance, and CAO replenishment signals. Integrates with WMS, SAP MM, and ERP systems.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Real-time and near-real-time on-hand stock position for every SKU at every location (store, DC, MFC). Captures on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, available-to-sell quantity, in-transit quantity, on-order quantity, and comprehensive OOS tracking: OOS status flag, OOS start timestamp, OOS end timestamp (when restocked), OOS duration in hours, root cause category (supplier OOS, DC OOS, store receiving delay, shrink, demand spike), estimated lost sales value, and OOS detection method (POS scan failure, CAO signal, manual audit). This is the authoritative SSOT for current inventory levels and out-of-stock events across the enterprise, fed by SAP MM goods movements and Manhattan WMS inventory control. Supports OOS monitoring and alerting, CAO replenishment signal generation, omnichannel availability checks, and store operations performance measurement.

products.name: goods_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event — receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments (including cycle-count corrections, damage write-offs, donation dispositions, and recall removals), returns, and write-offs — across all locations. Each record captures movement type (GR, GI, transfer, adjustment, cycle-count-correction), quantity, unit of measure, originating document reference, posting timestamp, and for adjustments: reason code, approving manager, adjustment value at cost, and supporting documentation reference. Sourced from SAP MM material documents and Manhattan WMS transactions. Provides the full audit trail for stock position changes, supports FIFO/LIFO rotation tracking, and serves as the controlled, auditable record for all inventory quantity changes including authorized corrections. This is the single source of truth for all inventory quantity change events.

products.name: shrink_record
products.description: Operational record of inventory shrink events and loss-mitigation dispositions. Captures shrink cause (theft known/unknown, spoilage, damage, administrative error, vendor short-ship), quantity lost, estimated cost of shrink, shrink category, responsible department, and disposition method and outcome — including markdowns (clearance, near-expiry, seasonal, damage markdowns with original price, markdown price, markdown percentage, effective/expiry dates), donations, and disposal. For markdown dispositions: tracks quantity marked down, sell-through outcome, and recovered value. Supports GMROI analysis, loss prevention programs, HACCP compliance for perishable spoilage, shrink reduction programs, and perishable inventory management. Sourced from store shrink entry workflows in SAP MM and Oracle Retail.

products.name: oos_event
products.description: Out-of-Stock (OOS) event records capturing when a SKU at a specific location transitions to zero available-to-sell quantity. products.name: receiving_record

products.name: pick
products.description: This association captures each pick event linking a stock_position to an order_line. It records the quantity taken from a specific inventory location and the time of the pick, enabling audit of inventory consumption per order line.. Existence Justification: An order_line can be fulfilled from multiple stock_position records (different locations or batches) and each stock_position can serve many order_line records across orders. The picking process records the quantity taken and the timestamp for each stock_position‑order_line pair, creating a distinct record for every pick.
