products.name: order_delivery_route
products.description: Optimized delivery route plan and its constituent stops, generated by JDA TMS for a batch of delivery orders assigned to a single driver/vehicle for a given dispatch window. At route level: captures route ID, dispatch date, vehicle ID, driver reference, total planned stops, total planned miles, total planned duration, actual start/end timestamps, route status (planned, in-progress, completed, partial), and carrier/fleet type. At stop level (embedded detail): captures stop sequence, linked delivery order, planned/actual arrival and departure times, stop status (pending, completed, failed, skipped), failure reason code, proof-of-delivery reference, and dwell time in minutes. Enables route efficiency analysis, stop-level SLA tracking, driver performance, failed delivery root cause analysis, route resequencing, and LMD cost management. Stop-level detail is modeled within this entity as route and stops share a lifecycle and are always managed together.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain shipments. Null if cold_chain_required_flag is false.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain shipments. Null if cold_chain_required_flag is false.

attributes.name: total_order_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the purchase order including all line items, before taxes and freight charges. Sum of (ordered_quantity × unit_cost) across all lines.

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: Grand total value of the purchase order including line items, taxes, and freight. Used for budget tracking and three-way match validation.

attributes.name: vendor_acknowledgment_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the purchase order via EDI 855 or other communication method.

attributes.name: vendor_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when vendor acknowledgment was received. Used to measure vendor responsiveness and confirm order acceptance.

products.name: po_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each SKU/item on a purchase order. Captures ordered quantity, unit of measure, agreed cost per unit, SRP, GTIN/UPC, item description, pack size, case pack quantity, allowances, line status, and confirmed ship date. Each line maps to a single SKU and is the atomic unit for receiving reconciliation and invoice matching in SAP MM.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line product.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order Line Item

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the purchasing employee who created or is responsible for this PO line.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the merchandise category or commodity group for this item. Used for spend analysis and category management.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the SKU being ordered on this line. Links to the product master for item details.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the distribution center, store, or facility where this line will be received.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supplier providing this item. Denormalized from header for line-level vendor analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: PO line must reference the exact vendor catalog item for pricing, compliance, and traceability; experts expect a vendor_item_id FK.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total promotional allowances, rebates, or discounts applied to this line. Reduces net cost to retailer.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Category of allowance applied to this line. Determines accounting treatment and vendor settlement process.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of individual units (eaches) contained in one case. Used for converting between case and each quantities.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: Vendor-confirmed date when this line item will be delivered to the destination. Used for receiving dock scheduling.

attributes.name: confirmed_ship_date
attributes.description: Vendor-confirmed date when this line item will ship. Received via EDI 855 PO acknowledgment or vendor portal.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which this line item expense is allocated. Used for departmental P&L and budget tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line was originally created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Logistics method for delivering this line. Warehouse=DC receiving, DSD=Direct Store Delivery, Cross-Dock=no storage, Drop-Ship=vendor to customer.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total line cost calculated as ordered quantity multiplied by unit cost. Base amount before allowances and freight.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Freight or transportation charges allocated to this line item. May be actual or estimated based on shipment method.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for posting the cost of this line item. Determines financial statement classification.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 standard global trade item number for the product. May be GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 format.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, labeling, and transportation compliance.

attributes.name: invoiced_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the vendor for this line. Used for three-way match reconciliation (PO, receipt, invoice).

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the item being ordered. Captured at time of PO creation for reference and receiving verification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line was last updated. Tracks most recent change for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order. Used for ordering and referencing specific line items on the PO document.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line. Tracks progression from creation through receiving and closure.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions for this line item. May include receiving instructions, quality requirements, or vendor communications.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the item ordered on this line. Expressed in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is USDA organic certified. Used for merchandising, labeling, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Consumer-facing pack size description (e.g., 12 oz, 1 gallon, 500g). Used for merchandising and shelf labeling.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a store-owned private label brand versus a national brand CPG product.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity received to date for this line. Updated as goods receipts are posted in the WMS.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the retailer requests delivery of this line item. Used for supply planning and vendor scheduling.

attributes.name: srp
attributes.description: Vendor's suggested retail price for the item. Used as a reference for pricing decisions and margin analysis.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or rate code applicable to this line item. Used for sales tax calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature control zone for this item during transportation and storage. Critical for cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Agreed cost per unit of measure from the vendor. Used for invoice matching and COGS calculation. Excludes allowances and discounts.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram, GAL=Gallon, LTR=Liter, DZ=Dozen, BX=Box. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|GAL|LTR|DZ|BX — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode identifier for the item. Used for scanning at receiving and point-of-sale.

products.name: inbound_shipment
products.description: Tracks vendor-initiated shipments (ASN — Advance Ship Notice) from origin to DC or store, encompassing both shipment-level details (carrier, BOL, trailer, origin, destination, scheduled/actual arrival, temperature requirement, status) and line-level detail (SKU, shipped quantity, lot number, expiration date, country of origin, HACCP compliance, pallet configuration). Integrates with JDA TMS and Manhattan Associates WMS for receiving reconciliation.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound shipment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for delivering this shipment.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination location (DC or store) where the shipment is to be received.

attributes.name: food_safety_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_inspection. Business justification: Required: Inbound shipment inspection report needed for food safety compliance; experts expect each inbound shipment to be linked to a food safety inspection record.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order that authorized this shipment from the vendor.

attributes.name: receiving_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: DC receipt process logs which associate performed receipt for labor tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier originating this shipment.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the origin location (vendor facility, supplier DC, or cross-dock) from which the shipment departed.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the shipment arrived at the destination dock and was checked in.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment departed from the origin location.

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Vendor-provided advance ship notice number transmitted via EDI 856 to notify the DC or store of the pending shipment.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Carrier-issued bill of lading number serving as the legal document for the shipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inbound shipment record was first created in the system (typically when ASN was received).

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment is designated for cross-dock operations (transfer without storage).

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Type of destination facility receiving the shipment: Distribution Center, Store, Cross-Dock, or Micro-Fulfillment Center.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any receiving discrepancies, damages, or quality issues identified during inspection.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost for this shipment in USD.

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment terms defining who pays for transportation: Prepaid (vendor pays), Collect (buyer pays), Third-Party, FOB-Origin, or FOB-Destination.

attributes.name: haccp_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment met all HACCP food safety requirements during transit and receiving.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inbound shipment record was last modified.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for receiving and putaway: Standard (normal flow), High (expedited), Urgent (same-day), Critical (immediate).

attributes.name: receiving_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiving process was completed and all items were putaway or staged.

attributes.name: receiving_discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any discrepancies (quantity variance, damage, quality issues) were identified during receiving.

attributes.name: receiving_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiving process began (unloading and inspection started).

attributes.name: rfid_tracked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment was tracked using RFID technology for real-time visibility.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date the shipment is scheduled to arrive at the destination location.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp for the shipment arrival at the destination dock, used for dock scheduling and labor planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date the shipment was scheduled to depart from the origin location.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the trailer to ensure shipment integrity during transit.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inbound shipment: Planned (ASN received), In-Transit (departed origin), Arrived (at destination dock), Receiving (being unloaded), Received (fully processed), or Cancelled.

attributes.name: shipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment method: Standard warehouse delivery, Direct Store Delivery (DSD), Cross-Dock transfer, Emergency replenishment, or Inter-facility Transfer.

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment maintained required temperature throughout transit (True) or experienced temperature excursions (False).

attributes.name: temperature_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled shipments to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: temperature_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled shipments to maintain product integrity.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Cold chain temperature requirement for this shipment: Ambient (room temperature), Refrigerated (33-40°F), Frozen (0°F or below), or Controlled (specific range).

attributes.name: total_case_count
attributes.description: Total number of cases (cartons) included in this shipment across all line items.

attributes.name: total_cube_ft
attributes.description: Total volume of the shipment in cubic feet, used for capacity planning and freight optimization.

attributes.name: total_pallet_count
attributes.description: Total number of pallets included in this shipment.

attributes.name: total_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) included in this shipment across all SKUs.

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in pounds, including packaging.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the trailer or container used to transport the shipment.

products.name: shipment_line
products.description: Line-level detail for each SKU within an inbound shipment (ASN line). Captures GTIN/UPC, item description, shipped quantity, unit of measure, pack size, lot number, expiration date, country of origin, HACCP compliance flag, temperature zone, and pallet/layer configuration. Used for receiving reconciliation against PO lines in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: shipment_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for shipment_line

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order line that this shipment line fulfills. Used for receiving reconciliation in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent inbound shipment (ASN header) that contains this line item.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU being shipped. Links to the product master for item details.

attributes.name: cases_per_layer
attributes.description: Number of cases in each layer of the pallet. Used for pallet configuration and receiving verification.

attributes.name: cases_per_pallet
attributes.description: Number of cases stacked on each pallet. Standard pallet configuration for this SKU.

attributes.name: catch_weight_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a catch-weight product (variable weight, such as meat or produce). True if catch weight, False otherwise.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or grown. Required for customs and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shipment line record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is designated for cross-dock operations (transfer without storage). True if cross-dock, False otherwise.

attributes.name: cube_per_unit
attributes.description: Cubic volume of one unit. Used for warehouse space allocation and transportation planning.

attributes.name: cube_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for cubic volume (cubic feet, cubic meters, cubic inches).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit cost and extended cost.

attributes.name: damage_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units damaged during shipment or receiving. Used for shrink tracking and vendor claims.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is part of a direct store delivery (bypassing DC). True if DSD, False if DC delivery.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-by date. Critical for perishable inventory management and FIFO rotation.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this line (unit cost × shipped quantity). Used for invoice reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 standard global trade item number (UPC/EAN) for the product. Used for barcode scanning and item identification.

attributes.name: haccp_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment line meets HACCP food safety standards. True if compliant, False otherwise.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product being shipped. Includes brand, size, and key attributes.

attributes.name: layers_per_pallet
attributes.description: Number of layers (tiers) of cases on each pallet. Used for pallet building and warehouse stacking.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the shipment. Used for ordering and identification of individual line items.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer lot or batch number for traceability. Critical for recalls and quality control, especially for perishables and pharmacy items.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the product was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation and quality tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shipment line record was last updated.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is USDA organic certified. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of individual units (eaches) contained in one case or pack. Used for case-to-each conversion.

attributes.name: pallet_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pallet containing this line item. Used for warehouse putaway and RFID tracking.

attributes.name: pallet_quantity
attributes.description: Number of pallets for this line item. Used for warehouse space planning and cross-dock operations.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of quality inspection for this line. Required for perishables, pharmacy items, and high-value goods.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and verified at the DC or store. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage or discrepancies.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item was physically received and verified at the DC or store.

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: Current status of the receiving process for this line item in Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier for automated tracking and inventory visibility. Used for real-time supply chain monitoring.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the item shipped by the vendor. Used for receiving reconciliation against ordered quantity.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage temperature zone for the product. Critical for cold chain logistics and HACCP compliance.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit paid to the vendor. Used for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity (each, case, pallet, layer, inner pack, weight, volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|layer|inner_pack|pound|kilogram|liter|gallon — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code for the item. Standard barcode identifier used in North American retail.

attributes.name: weight_per_unit
attributes.description: Weight of one unit in the specified unit of measure. Used for freight calculation and warehouse capacity planning.

attributes.name: weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for weight (pounds, kilograms, ounces, grams).

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Records the physical receipt of merchandise at a DC or store against a purchase order or inbound shipment, encompassing both receipt-level details (date/time, dock door, receiver, temperature, GR document number) and item-level detail (received/accepted/rejected quantities by SKU, rejection reason, lot number, expiration date, putaway assignment). Captures OS&D (overage/shortage/damage) at both aggregate and item level. Sourced from SAP MM MIGO and Manhattan Associates WMS.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO / GR Document)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center (DC) or store where the goods were physically received.

attributes.name: food_safety_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_inspection. Business justification: Required: Goods receipt must be validated by a food safety inspection; the link enables traceability of inspection outcomes to receipt transactions.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment or advanced ship notice (ASN) associated with this receipt.

attributes.name: primary_goods_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or store employee who performed the physical receipt and inspection.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt is recorded.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the goods were received.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The bill of lading number provided by the carrier, serving as the shipping document and receipt for the goods in transit.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider that delivered the shipment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt is part of a cross-dock operation where goods are transferred directly from inbound to outbound without storage (True) or follows standard receiving and putaway (False).

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: The physical dock door or receiving bay where the shipment was unloaded.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt is a direct store delivery from a vendor bypassing the distribution center (True) or a standard DC receipt (False).

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known goods receipt document number generated by the ERP or WMS system (e.g., SAP MIGO document number).

attributes.name: inspection_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quality inspection has been completed (True) or is still pending (False).

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt requires formal quality inspection before acceptance into inventory (True) or can be received without inspection (False).

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the quality inspection: PASSED (all items accepted), FAILED (all items rejected), PARTIAL (some accepted, some rejected), PENDING (inspection not yet complete), NOT_REQUIRED (no inspection needed).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this goods receipt record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: osd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt contains any overage, shortage, or damage discrepancies (True) or was received as expected (False).

attributes.name: osd_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature and details of any overage, shortage, or damage issues identified during receipt.

attributes.name: osd_type
attributes.description: Classification of the OS&D discrepancy: OVERAGE (more received than ordered), SHORTAGE (less received than ordered), DAMAGE (damaged goods), MULTIPLE (combination of issues), NONE (no discrepancy).

attributes.name: packing_slip_number
attributes.description: The packing slip or delivery note number provided by the vendor, listing the contents of the shipment.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory and financial ledgers.

attributes.name: putaway_status
attributes.description: Current status of the putaway process for moving received goods from the receiving area to storage locations: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, BLOCKED.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the goods were physically received at the location.

attributes.name: receipt_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the receiving personnel regarding any special conditions, observations, or issues during the receipt process.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt: DRAFT (not yet started), IN_PROGRESS (receiving in process), COMPLETED (physically received but not posted), POSTED (posted to inventory), CANCELLED (receipt cancelled).

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods receipt transaction was initiated or completed.

attributes.name: receipt_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receipt transaction: PO (purchase order receipt), DSD (direct store delivery), RETURN (vendor return), TRANSFER (inter-location transfer), CROSS_DOCK (cross-dock operation), SAMPLE (vendor sample).

attributes.name: rfid_scanned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags were scanned during the receipt process for automated item tracking (True) or manual receipt was performed (False).

attributes.name: seal_intact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the security seal was found intact upon receipt (True) or broken/missing (False).

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: The security seal number affixed to the trailer or container, verified at receipt to ensure shipment integrity.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this goods receipt transaction: SAP_MM (SAP Materials Management), MANHATTAN_WMS (Manhattan Associates WMS), ORACLE_RETAIL (Oracle Retail), MANUAL (manual entry).

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt
attributes.description: The measured temperature (in Celsius) of the shipment at the time of receipt, critical for cold chain compliance and perishable goods.

attributes.name: temperature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment temperature was within the acceptable range per cold chain requirements (True) or out of compliance (False).

attributes.name: total_accepted_quantity
attributes.description: The aggregate quantity of all items accepted into inventory after quality inspection, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: total_received_quantity
attributes.description: The aggregate quantity of all items physically received in this goods receipt transaction, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: total_rejected_quantity
attributes.description: The aggregate quantity of all items rejected due to damage, quality issues, or discrepancies, summed across all line items.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: The trailer or container identification number used for the inbound shipment.

products.name: goods_receipt_line
products.description: Line-level detail for each SKU received in a goods receipt event. Captures received quantity by UOM, accepted vs. rejected quantity, rejection reason code, lot number, expiration date, storage location assignment, putaway task reference, and unit cost at receipt. Enables item-level receiving accuracy tracking and shrink attribution.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt line item. Primary key for line-level receiving detail.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who physically received and counted this line. Supports accountability and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: REQUIRED: Goods receipt analysis by category supports quality and compliance reporting across stores.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Needed for Cost of Goods Received posting, tying each receipt line to the cost_price record for accurate financial and margin reporting.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent goods receipt header document. Links this line to the overall receiving event.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order line that this receipt fulfills. Enables PO-to-receipt reconciliation.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Target store for cross-dock shipment. Populated when goods are received at DC for immediate transfer to store.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: Goods receipt validation requires linking received items to the vendor's catalog entry; a vendor_item_id FK is essential for quality and audit.

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity accepted into inventory after quality inspection. Represents units available for putaway and sale.

attributes.name: asn_line_number
attributes.description: Line number from the vendor's advance shipping notice. Links physical receipt to pre-notification for cross-dock and receiving planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this goods receipt line record was first created. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is designated for cross-dock operations (transfer without storage). Drives expedited handling workflow.

attributes.name: cube_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the received quantity. Essential for warehouse space utilization and transportation planning.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for cost amounts. Supports multi-currency procurement and financial reporting.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receipt bypassed the DC and was delivered directly to store by vendor. Identifies DSD workflow.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or consumed. Essential for perishable inventory management and shrink prevention.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this line (accepted quantity multiplied by unit cost). Represents inventory value added by this receipt line.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global standard identifier for trade items. Supports international supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this record was last updated. Tracks data change history for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the goods receipt document. Determines ordering of line items.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's batch or lot identifier for traceability. Critical for recalls, FIFO rotation, and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the product was manufactured or produced. Supports shelf-life calculations and quality tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded during receiving. Captures exceptions, damage details, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity originally ordered on the purchase order for this line item. Baseline for receipt variance analysis.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets received for this line item. Supports dock-to-stock efficiency tracking and handling resource planning.

attributes.name: putaway_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when putaway task was completed and goods were placed in storage location. Marks end of receiving-to-stock cycle.

attributes.name: putaway_task_number
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse task created to move received goods to storage. Links receiving to putaway execution.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line requires quality inspection before acceptance. Determines routing to QC hold area.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of quality inspection process. Determines whether goods are accepted into inventory or rejected.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity physically received and counted during the receiving process. Includes both accepted and rejected units.

attributes.name: received_temperature
attributes.description: Actual temperature of the product at time of receipt in Celsius. Critical for cold chain validation and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line was physically received and recorded in the system. Primary business event timestamp for receiving cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: Current processing state of this receipt line. Tracks workflow progression from dock to putaway completion.

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity rejected during receiving due to quality issues, damage, or discrepancies. Triggers vendor return or disposal workflow.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why units were rejected. Enables root cause analysis of receiving issues and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique RFID tag identifier attached to the received goods. Enables automated tracking and real-time inventory visibility.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal product identifier for the item being received. Primary product reference for inventory management.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse location where the received goods are assigned for putaway. Determines physical placement in DC or backroom.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage temperature classification for cold chain compliance. Determines handling and storage requirements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the received quantity is expressed. Determines how inventory is counted and tracked.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Standard barcode identifier scanned during receiving. Used for automated item identification and verification.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the received quantity in kilograms. Used for freight reconciliation and capacity planning.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Store or DC replenishment orders generated by Blue Yonder CAO/demand planning or manually by buyers, encompassing both order-level details (type, source, destination, trigger, status) and line-level detail (SKU, ordered quantity, suggested vs. override quantity, fill rate, line status). Covers auto-replenishment, manual, and emergency order types. Distinct from purchase orders — these are internal DC-to-store transfer orders.
products.reference: Blue Yonder Replenishment Order / SAP SD Transfer Order

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order. Primary key for internal DC-to-store or DC-to-DC transfer orders generated by Blue Yonder CAO/demand planning or manually by buyers.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier assigned to deliver the order. May be internal fleet or third-party carrier.

attributes.name: destination_location_store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store or DC receiving the replenishment inventory. Can be a retail store, MFC, or downstream DC.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: REQUIRED: Replenishment execution assigns a fulfillment node (DC) for picking/shipping; node performance reports depend on this link.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Pharmacy inventory replenishment orders require linking to the pharmacy location for stock planning, fill‑rate analysis, and regulatory audit.

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the buyer or planner who created or approved the replenishment order. Applicable for manual and override orders.

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or warehouse from which inventory is being transferred. Typically a DC in the supply chain network.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Needed for Promotional Replenishment Planning process that creates replenishment orders based on active promo campaigns.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shipment that includes this replenishment order. Multiple orders may be consolidated into a single shipment for transportation efficiency.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation route assigned for delivery. Used for multi-stop route optimization and last-mile delivery planning.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the order was received at the destination location. Used to measure delivery SLA performance and calculate fill rate timing.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the order was shipped from the source DC. Used to measure on-time shipment performance and calculate actual transit time.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order requires management approval before fulfillment. True for high-value orders, emergency orders, or orders exceeding allocation thresholds.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was approved. Used for approval cycle time analysis and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for order cancellation. Populated only when order_status is cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order contains perishable items requiring temperature-controlled transportation and storage. True if any line item requires refrigeration or freezing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and order age analysis.

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is eligible for cross-dock operations, where inventory is transferred directly from inbound to outbound without intermediate storage. Used for flow-through optimization.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination location. Store represents retail locations, DC represents distribution centers, MFC represents micro-fulfillment centers for omnichannel orders.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity that was successfully shipped, calculated as (total_shipped_quantity / total_ordered_quantity) * 100. Key supply chain KPI for measuring DC fulfillment performance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, exceptions, or context about the replenishment order. Used for communication between buyers, planners, and fulfillment teams.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date when the replenishment order was created in the system. Represents the business event timestamp for order initiation.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the replenishment order, used for tracking and communication across supply chain systems.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order in the fulfillment workflow. Tracks progression from creation through delivery and enables exception management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|allocated|picking|packed|shipped|in_transit|received|cancelled — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order based on trigger and business purpose. Auto-replenishment orders are system-generated based on CAO algorithms, manual orders are buyer-initiated, emergency orders address stockouts, seasonal orders support seasonal demand, promotional orders support ad circulars, and new store orders support store openings.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for order fulfillment and transportation routing. Critical priority is used for emergency stockout situations, high priority for fast-moving SKUs, normal for standard replenishment, low for slow-moving items.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger
attributes.description: The business rule or algorithm that initiated the replenishment order. CAO forecast uses demand planning algorithms, min-max threshold triggers when inventory falls below reorder point, safety stock maintains buffer inventory, manual override is buyer-initiated, promotional event supports ad circulars, seasonal demand addresses seasonal patterns.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the destination location requires the replenishment inventory to arrive. Used for transportation planning and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order is tracked using RFID technology for real-time visibility and automated receiving. True if RFID tags are applied at case or pallet level.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the order to be shipped from the source DC. Calculated based on requested delivery date and transit time.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling requirements such as fragile items, hazardous materials, or delivery time windows. Communicated to warehouse and transportation teams.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature control classification for the order. Ambient for shelf-stable products, refrigerated for fresh produce and dairy, frozen for frozen foods, multi-temp for mixed orders requiring multiple temperature zones.

attributes.name: total_cube_volume
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the order in cubic feet or cubic meters. Used for trailer utilization optimization and cross-dock planning.

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct SKU line items included in the replenishment order. Used for picking complexity assessment and labor planning.

attributes.name: total_ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items in the replenishment order, measured in eaches or cases depending on line-level unit of measure. Used for capacity planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: total_pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets required to ship the order. Used for transportation capacity planning and dock scheduling.

attributes.name: total_received_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items received at the destination location. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage, loss, or receiving discrepancies.

attributes.name: total_shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Aggregate quantity of all line items actually shipped from the source DC. May differ from ordered quantity due to inventory availability or allocation adjustments.

attributes.name: total_weight
attributes.description: Total weight of the order in pounds or kilograms. Used for transportation cost calculation and carrier selection.

products.name: replenishment_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each SKU on a replenishment order. Captures SKU, ordered quantity, unit of measure, pack size, suggested order quantity from Blue Yonder, override quantity, override reason, fill rate at fulfillment, and line status. Enables replenishment accuracy analysis and OOS root-cause investigation.

attributes.name: replenishment_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: REQUIRED: Replenishment planning reports need each line tied to a product category for category‑level forecasting and allocation.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the distribution center receiving this replenishment line. Used when replenishing DC inventory rather than store inventory.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent replenishment order header. Links this line to its parent order.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.retail_price. Business justification: Required for Replenishment Pricing Snapshot report, linking each replenishment line to the exact retail price used for margin analysis.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the store receiving this replenishment line. The target location for inventory delivery.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the vendor supplying this item. Links to the vendor master for supplier information.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment was received at the destination. Used for on-time delivery metrics and inventory availability.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment departed from the source location. Used for lead time analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why this replenishment line was cancelled. Used for root-cause analysis of order cancellations.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment line was cancelled. Null if the line has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost amounts. Typically USD for domestic operations.

attributes.name: extended_cost
attributes.description: Total cost for this line. Calculated as ordered_quantity * unit_cost. Used for purchase order valuation.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered quantity that was fulfilled. Calculated as (shipped_quantity / ordered_quantity) * 100. Key metric for supplier performance.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number for the product. 14-digit GTIN used for global supply chain identification.

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line requires temperature-controlled cold chain logistics for perishable or frozen products.

attributes.name: is_cross_dock
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line is processed through cross-dock operations without storage at the distribution center.

attributes.name: is_dsd
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line is fulfilled via Direct Store Delivery from vendor to store, bypassing the distribution center.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this replenishment line record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the replenishment order. Used for ordering and referencing specific lines.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment line. Tracks progression from creation through fulfillment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|ordered|shipped|received|cancelled|backordered — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity ordered for this line. May differ from suggested quantity due to manual overrides or business rules.

attributes.name: override_quantity
attributes.description: Manual override quantity if the user changed the suggested order quantity. Null if no override was applied.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the suggested quantity was overridden. Used for root-cause analysis of forecast accuracy issues.

attributes.name: override_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the reason for quantity override. Provides additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of eaches per case or inner pack. Used to convert between different units of measure.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority level for this replenishment line. Determines processing and shipping urgency for out-of-stock situations.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product being replenished. Includes brand, size, and key attributes.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received at the destination location. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage or discrepancies.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the replenishment is requested to arrive at the destination. Used for planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier for tracking this shipment through the supply chain. Used for real-time visibility and inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for shipment from the source location. Used for transportation planning and coordination.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped by the vendor or distribution center. May differ from ordered quantity due to availability constraints.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the product being replenished. The unique item identifier used across the retail system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System that originated this replenishment line. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: suggested_order_quantity
attributes.description: System-calculated recommended order quantity from Blue Yonder Demand Planning. The optimal quantity based on forecasting algorithms.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required temperature zone for storage and transportation. Critical for cold chain compliance and product quality.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit for this replenishment line. Used for inventory valuation and cost of goods sold calculations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Defines whether quantity is in eaches, cases, pallets, or other packaging units.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Universal Product Code barcode identifier for the item. Standard 12-digit UPC-A format used for scanning and identification.

products.name: dc_transfer
products.description: Records inter-DC and DC-to-store stock transfer movements including cross-dock flow-through and store-to-store rebalancing operations. Captures transfer type (cross-dock, pick-and-ship, store-to-store, DC-to-DC), origin location, destination location, transfer date, carrier, trailer number, total pallets, total cases, transfer reason (allocation, rebalancing, emergency, recall, seasonal), priority level, and transfer status (planned, picking, loaded, in-transit, delivered, confirmed). Managed in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP WM. Enables inventory movement visibility and network optimization.
products.reference: SAP WM Transfer Order / Manhattan WMS Transfer

attributes.name: dc_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the distribution center transfer transaction. Primary key for the dc_transfer product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for moving the shipment between origin and destination.

attributes.name: created_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Transfer requests are initiated by an associate; needed for labor cost allocation and audit trail.

attributes.name: destination_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the target facility to which inventory is being transferred. Can reference a distribution center or store location.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.delivery_route. Business justification: REQUIRED: DC transfer is scheduled as a delivery route; route KPI dashboards need the transfer‑to‑route association.

attributes.name: load_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the consolidated load or shipment that includes this transfer. Multiple transfers may be combined into a single load for transportation efficiency.

attributes.name: origin_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source facility from which inventory is being transferred. Can reference a distribution center or store location.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse picking wave that generated this transfer. Used to group transfers for efficient picking and loading operations.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual arrival date at the destination location when the shipment was received. Null until delivery occurs.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual departure date from the origin location when the shipment left the facility. Null until shipment departs.

attributes.name: actual_transit_hours
attributes.description: Actual duration in hours from departure to arrival. Used for carrier performance analysis and transit time optimization. Null until delivery complete.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the transfer was confirmed as received and put away at the destination location. Marks completion of the transfer lifecycle. Null until confirmation occurs.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Receiving Confirmation Standard

attributes.name: contains_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicator whether the transfer shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and carrier certification per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the transfer record was first created in the warehouse management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: damage_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether product damage was reported during receiving inspection. Triggers claims process and carrier performance review.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Receiving Quality Standard

attributes.name: destination_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination facility. DC is distribution center, store is retail location, MFC is micro-fulfillment center, cross-dock is flow-through facility.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Planned duration in hours for the shipment to travel from origin to destination. Used for delivery date calculation and carrier performance measurement.

attributes.name: freight_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total transportation cost for the transfer shipment in US dollars. Includes carrier charges, fuel surcharges, and accessorial fees. Used for supply chain cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the transfer record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional transfer instructions, special handling requirements, or operational comments. Used for communication between origin, carrier, and destination.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether the transfer was delivered by the scheduled delivery date. Used for carrier scorecard and supply chain performance metrics.

attributes.name: origin_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the origin facility. DC is distribution center, store is retail location, MFC is micro-fulfillment center, cross-dock is flow-through facility.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency classification for the transfer affecting processing sequence and transportation mode selection. Standard is normal flow, expedited is accelerated, urgent is same-day target, critical is immediate action required.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order if the transfer is fulfilling a store replenishment order or allocation. Links transfer to demand planning.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicator whether the transfer shipment uses RFID tags for automated tracking and receiving. Enables real-time visibility and reduces manual scanning.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned arrival date at the destination location. Used for receiving planning and labor scheduling.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned departure date from the origin location. Used for transportation planning and carrier scheduling.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal identifier applied to the trailer to ensure shipment integrity during transit. Verified at receiving to detect tampering.

attributes.name: shortage_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether quantity shortages were identified during receiving verification. Triggers inventory reconciliation and carrier investigation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Receiving Quality Standard

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Cold chain requirement for the transfer shipment. Ambient is room temperature, refrigerated is 32-40F, frozen is below 0F, multi-temp contains mixed zones. Critical for perishable inventory compliance.

attributes.name: total_cases
attributes.description: Total number of cases or cartons included in the transfer shipment. Used for detailed inventory tracking and receiving verification.

attributes.name: total_cube_cf
attributes.description: Total volume of the transfer shipment in cubic feet. Used for trailer utilization optimization and space planning.

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets included in the transfer shipment. Used for capacity planning and receiving resource allocation.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of individual units or eaches included in the transfer shipment. Represents the most granular inventory count.

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the transfer shipment in pounds. Used for freight costing, carrier capacity planning, and compliance with weight restrictions.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the trailer or container used for the transfer shipment. Used for tracking and yard management.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: The business date when the transfer transaction was initiated or scheduled. This is the principal event date for the transfer, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: transfer_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the transfer transaction, used for tracking and reference across systems and with carriers.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Transfer Document Standard

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the transfer. Allocation is planned distribution, rebalancing is inventory optimization, emergency is urgent replenishment, recall is product withdrawal, seasonal is assortment change, promotion is event-driven, new-store is initial stocking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: allocation|rebalancing|emergency|recall|seasonal|promotion|new-store — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning Transfer Classification

attributes.name: transfer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transfer transaction. Planned indicates scheduled but not started, picking indicates warehouse fulfillment in progress, loaded indicates staged on carrier, in-transit indicates shipment en route, delivered indicates arrival at destination, confirmed indicates receiving complete, cancelled indicates transaction voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|picking|loaded|in-transit|delivered|confirmed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Transfer Workflow States

attributes.name: transfer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transfer operation indicating the movement pattern and handling requirements. Cross-dock indicates flow-through without storage, pick-and-ship is standard DC fulfillment, store-to-store is lateral rebalancing, dc-to-dc is network redistribution, emergency is expedited replenishment, recall is product withdrawal.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Transfer Type Classification

products.name: direct_store_delivery
products.description: Direct Store Delivery records for vendor-delivered merchandise bypassing the DC network. Captures DSD vendor, delivery date/time, store location, delivery route number, driver name, total SKUs, total cases, invoice number, payment method (check, EFT, credit), receiving associate, temperature compliance flag, product category (bread, snacks, beverages, dairy), and DSD status (scheduled, delivered, reconciled, disputed). Common for bread, snack, and beverage vendors. Integrates with POS for immediate inventory and cost update.

attributes.name: direct_store_delivery_id
attributes.description: Primary key for direct_store_delivery

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: REQUIRED: DSD delivery performance dashboards aggregate metrics by category, so each delivery must reference its category.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: DSD deliveries must be tied to a specific pharmacy location for inventory tracking, compliance reporting, and POS integration.

attributes.name: receiving_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the store associate who received and verified the DSD delivery. Used for accountability and training purposes.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the vendor delivering merchandise directly to the store, bypassing the distribution center network. Common DSD vendors include bread, snack, and beverage suppliers.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the DSD delivery was received at the store. Used for on-time delivery performance measurement and vendor compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DSD delivery record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the DSD delivery transaction. Supports multi-currency operations for international vendors.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DSD delivery transaction, typically assigned by the vendor or receiving system. Used for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DSD delivery transaction. Tracks progression from scheduling through final reconciliation or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the DSD delivery invoice. Includes promotional allowances, volume discounts, and vendor rebates.

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any quantity or quality discrepancies identified during DSD delivery receipt. Used for vendor dispute resolution and claims processing.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a discrepancy was identified between the delivered quantity and the invoice quantity. Triggers dispute resolution workflow.

attributes.name: driver_license_number
attributes.description: Driver's license number for the delivery driver. Captured for security verification and compliance with store access policies.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the delivery driver who executed the DSD delivery. Used for accountability, quality tracking, and security verification.

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount for the DSD delivery before any adjustments or discounts. Represents the vendor's billed amount for the merchandise delivered.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number associated with the DSD delivery. Used for accounts payable processing and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DSD delivery record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount due for the DSD delivery after applying taxes, discounts, and adjustments. Represents the final payment obligation to the vendor.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used to settle the DSD delivery invoice. Common methods include check, electronic funds transfer (EFT), credit terms, cash on delivery (COD), or vendor account.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms for the DSD delivery, such as net 30, net 60, or 2/10 net 30. Defines the payment due date and any early payment discounts.

attributes.name: pos_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSD delivery has been integrated with the POS system for immediate inventory and cost updates. Critical for real-time inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: pos_integration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DSD delivery was integrated with the POS system. Used for inventory accuracy tracking and system reconciliation.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSD delivery passed quality inspection at the time of receipt. Used for vendor performance tracking and product quality assurance.

attributes.name: quality_issue_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any quality issues identified during DSD delivery receipt. Includes details on damaged goods, expired products, or specification non-compliance.

attributes.name: receiving_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the receiving associate during DSD delivery receipt. Includes observations, special handling instructions, or operational comments.

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DSD delivery was fully reconciled between received quantities, invoice amounts, and POS integration. Marks completion of the DSD workflow.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned route identifier for the delivery driver's scheduled stops. Used for delivery sequencing and driver performance tracking.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the DSD delivery to arrive at the store location. Used for store labor planning and receiving dock scheduling.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_time
attributes.description: Planned timestamp for the DSD delivery arrival, including time of day. Enables precise receiving dock coordination and labor allocation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the DSD delivery invoice. Used for sales tax reconciliation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: temperature_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSD delivery met required temperature control standards for cold chain products. Critical for food safety compliance and quality assurance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP

attributes.name: temperature_reading
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading (in Fahrenheit) recorded at the time of DSD delivery receipt. Used for cold chain compliance verification and quality control.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP

attributes.name: total_case_count
attributes.description: Total number of cases delivered in the DSD transaction. Used for receiving dock capacity planning and inventory volume tracking.

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct SKUs included in the DSD delivery. Used for receiving complexity assessment and labor planning.

attributes.name: total_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) delivered across all SKUs in the DSD delivery. Used for detailed inventory tracking and shrink analysis.

attributes.name: vendor_delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Vendor-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the DSD delivery. Used for cross-reference and dispute resolution.

products.name: transport_route
products.description: Master record for DC-to-store and inter-DC transportation routes and their execution, encompassing route definition (origin DC, stop sequence, mileage, carrier, trailer type, capacity, frequency), individual stop details (stop location, arrival window, pallet/case count, special handling), and load plan execution (trailer assignment, departure time, load sequence, temperature zones, dispatch status). Managed in JDA TMS. Enables route optimization, freight cost allocation, and carrier performance tracking.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transportation route. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier or logistics provider responsible for executing this route. Links to vendor or carrier master data.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or facility where the route originates. Links to the facility or warehouse master data.

attributes.name: planner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Route planning is assigned to a specific associate; needed for accountability and performance reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Required: Certain transport routes require regulatory filings (e.g., hazardous material permits); linking routes to filings supports compliance reporting.

attributes.name: backhaul_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes backhaul operations, where the trailer picks up goods from vendors or stores on the return trip to the DC. True if backhaul is planned; false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the JDA TMS system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route supports cross-dock operations, where goods are transferred directly from inbound to outbound trailers without intermediate storage. True if cross-dock is allowed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration was or will be retired or replaced. Null for currently active routes. Used for route lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this route configuration became or will become active. Used for route lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Expected total time to complete the route including driving time, stop time, and rest breaks, measured in hours. Used for scheduling and on-time delivery tracking.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of trailer capacity utilization for this route, used for load optimization and efficiency tracking. Represents the percentage of orders fulfilled completely on each route execution.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Operations Reference (SCOR) Model - Perfect Order Fulfillment

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: Fuel surcharge rate applied to this route, typically expressed as a percentage or per-mile amount. Adjusted periodically based on diesel fuel price indices.
