attributes.references: DOE Energy Information Administration (EIA) diesel fuel price index

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether GPS tracking is enabled for real-time location monitoring of the trailer or truck on this route. True if GPS devices are installed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is certified and equipped to transport hazardous materials. True if carrier and equipment meet DOT HAZMAT requirements; false otherwise.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (HMR); EPA hazardous waste transport rules

attributes.name: last_executed_date
attributes.description: Date when this route was most recently executed. Used for route utilization analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was last updated in the JDA TMS system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, instructions, or comments about the route. May include driver instructions, seasonal considerations, or operational alerts.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance for this route, used for carrier performance evaluation and SLA compliance. Typically 95-98% for grocery retail.

attributes.name: operating_days
attributes.description: Days of the week on which this route operates, typically stored as comma-separated day codes (e.g., MON,WED,FRI) or day-of-week flags.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID technology is used to track shipments on this route. True if RFID tags are applied to pallets or cases for real-time visibility; false otherwise.

attributes.name: route_cost_fixed
attributes.description: Fixed cost component for executing this route, independent of distance or load. Includes dispatch fees, administrative overhead, and minimum carrier charges.

attributes.name: route_cost_per_mile
attributes.description: Standard cost per mile for this route, used for freight cost allocation and budgeting. Includes fuel, driver wages, maintenance, and carrier fees.

attributes.name: route_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this route is executed. Daily routes run every day; weekly routes run on specific days; bi-weekly routes run every two weeks; monthly routes run once per month; on-demand routes are triggered by need; seasonal routes operate during specific periods.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the route, typically indicating origin and destination or geographic coverage.

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the route, used in operational communications and dispatch systems. Managed in JDA TMS.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) for route identification

attributes.name: route_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is subject to dynamic optimization algorithms in JDA TMS. True if stop sequence and timing can be adjusted by the system; false if route is fixed.

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the route. Active routes are in regular operation; inactive routes are temporarily not in use; suspended routes are on hold pending review; planned routes are designed but not yet operational; archived routes are historical records.

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route based on its operational purpose. DC-to-store routes deliver from distribution center to retail locations; inter-DC routes transfer between distribution centers; DSD (Direct Store Delivery) routes bypass DC; cross-dock routes involve immediate transfer without storage; backhaul routes return empty trailers or pick up vendor goods; milk-run routes serve multiple stops in sequence.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Standard time of day when the route is scheduled to depart from the origin DC, stored as HH:MM format (e.g., 06:00 for 6 AM departure). Used for dispatch planning and driver scheduling.

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special handling, loading, or delivery requirements for this route (e.g., liftgate required, inside delivery, appointment required, security escort).

attributes.name: stop_count
attributes.description: Total number of delivery or pickup stops on this route, excluding the origin DC. Used for route complexity assessment and driver workload planning.

attributes.name: temperature_max_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled routes. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Critical Control Points

attributes.name: temperature_min_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Fahrenheit for temperature-controlled routes. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Critical Control Points

attributes.name: temperature_zone_required
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for this route. Ambient for room temperature; refrigerated for 32-40°F; frozen for below 0°F; multi-temp for trailers with multiple zones; controlled for specific temperature ranges. Critical for cold chain compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) cold chain requirements; HACCP temperature control standards

attributes.name: total_route_distance_miles
attributes.description: Total distance of the route from origin to final destination, including all intermediate stops, measured in miles. Used for freight cost calculation and driver scheduling.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_cases
attributes.description: Maximum number of cases that can be loaded on the trailer for this route, used when shipments are measured in case count rather than pallets.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Volumetric capacity of the trailer in cubic feet, used for cube optimization and load planning.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Maximum number of standard pallets that can be loaded on the trailer for this route. Typically 26-28 pallets for a 53-foot trailer.

attributes.name: trailer_capacity_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the trailer in pounds, constrained by DOT regulations and vehicle specifications. Typically 40,000-45,000 lbs for a loaded trailer.
attributes.references: DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) weight limits

attributes.name: trailer_type
attributes.description: Type of trailer equipment required for this route. Dry van for ambient goods; refrigerated for cold chain; flatbed for oversized items; tanker for liquids; intermodal for rail/truck combination; multi-temp for mixed temperature zones.

products.name: route_stop
products.description: Individual stop details within a transport route, representing each store or DC on a delivery run. Captures stop sequence number, stop location (store or DC), scheduled arrival window, scheduled departure time, estimated unload time, pallet count for stop, cases for stop, special handling instructions (e.g., pharmacy drop, fuel center delivery), and stop status. Managed in JDA TMS.

attributes.name: route_stop_id
attributes.description: Primary key for route_stop

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center if this stop is at a DC. Null for non-DC stops.

attributes.name: driver_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Each stop is executed by a driver associate; link required for driver scheduling and safety audits.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Route stops flagged for pharmacy deliveries require explicit pharmacy location linkage for routing optimization and performance metrics.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent transport route to which this stop belongs.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle arrived at this stop. Null if stop not yet reached.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle departed from this stop. Null if stop not yet completed.

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number or reference for the scheduled appointment at this stop. Null if no appointment required.

attributes.name: case_count
attributes.description: Number of cases (cartons) to be delivered or picked up at this stop.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop involves temperature-controlled (refrigerated or frozen) cargo requiring cold chain logistics (True = cold chain required, False = ambient).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route stop record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Specific dock door or bay number at the stop location where unloading should occur.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop is a Direct Store Delivery (DSD) from vendor directly to store, bypassing the DC (True = DSD, False = standard DC-to-store delivery).

attributes.name: estimated_unload_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to unload cargo at this stop, based on volume and handling requirements.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the stop failed or was skipped (e.g., location closed, refused delivery, access denied, weather delay). Null if stop completed successfully.

attributes.name: fuel_center_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop includes fuel delivery to a fuel center or gas station (True = fuel delivery, False = no fuel).

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop involves hazardous materials requiring special handling and regulatory compliance (True = HAZMAT present, False = no HAZMAT).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route stop record was last updated.

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets to be delivered or picked up at this stop.

attributes.name: pharmacy_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop includes pharmacy prescription or pharmaceutical inventory delivery requiring DEA compliance (True = pharmacy delivery, False = general merchandise).

attributes.name: requires_appointment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stop requires a pre-scheduled appointment for delivery or pickup (True = appointment required, False = no appointment needed).

attributes.name: rfid_scan_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Scan Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID scanning is required at this stop for inventory tracking and verification (True = RFID scan required, False = no RFID requirement).

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_date
attributes.description: Planned date the vehicle is scheduled to arrive at this stop.

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time_end
attributes.description: End of the scheduled arrival time window for this stop (latest acceptable arrival time).

attributes.name: scheduled_arrival_time_start
attributes.description: Start of the scheduled arrival time window for this stop (earliest acceptable arrival time).

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_time
attributes.description: Planned time the vehicle is scheduled to depart from this stop after completing unload/load activities.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text instructions for special handling requirements at this stop (e.g., pharmacy drop, fuel center delivery, refrigerated unload, rear dock only, appointment required).

attributes.name: stop_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the stop location.

attributes.name: stop_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, building, dock door) for the stop location.

attributes.name: stop_city
attributes.description: City name of the stop location.

attributes.name: stop_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the stop location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: stop_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the stop location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: stop_location_type
attributes.description: Type of facility at this stop: store (retail location), DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), vendor (supplier location), cross_dock (transfer facility), or return_center (reverse logistics facility).

attributes.name: stop_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the stop location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: stop_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the stop location.

attributes.name: stop_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this stop within the route (1 = first stop, 2 = second stop, etc.).

attributes.name: stop_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code of the stop location.

attributes.name: stop_status
attributes.description: Current status of this route stop in its lifecycle: scheduled (planned but not started), in_transit (vehicle en route), arrived (vehicle at location), unloading (active unload), completed (stop finished successfully), skipped (stop bypassed), or failed (stop could not be completed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_transit|arrived|unloading|completed|skipped|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management - Stop Status Tracking

attributes.name: stop_type
attributes.description: Nature of the stop activity: delivery (drop-off only), pickup (pick-up only), or delivery_and_pickup (both activities at this stop).

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control zone for cargo at this stop: ambient (no temperature control), refrigerated (33-40°F), frozen (0°F or below), or multi_temp (multiple zones).

attributes.name: total_cube_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Total volume in cubic feet of all cargo for this stop.

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight in pounds of all cargo for this stop.

products.name: load_plan
products.description: Trailer load plan generated by JDA TMS for each outbound DC shipment. Captures load plan number, assigned route, trailer number, carrier SCAC, driver assignment, planned departure date/time, total pallets, total weight, total cube, temperature zones loaded (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), load sequence, and load plan status (planned, loaded, dispatched, delivered). Enables freight audit and carrier performance tracking.

attributes.name: load_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trailer load plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver assigned to transport this load.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center originating this outbound shipment.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned transportation route for this load plan.

attributes.name: accessorial_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total accessorial charges (detention, lumper fees, fuel surcharge, etc.) for this load in USD.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the trailer arrived at the destination, used for delivery performance measurement and receiving coordination.

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the trailer departed from the distribution center, used for on-time performance tracking and freight audit.

attributes.name: ambient_pallets
attributes.description: Number of pallets containing ambient temperature products (dry goods) loaded on this trailer.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of lading document associated with this shipment, serving as the legal contract between shipper and carrier.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the transportation carrier assigned to this load plan.

attributes.name: carrier_scac
attributes.description: Four-letter code uniquely identifying the carrier responsible for transporting this load, as defined by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this load plan record was first created in the transportation management system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this load was assembled using cross-dock operations (transfer without storage) for fast-moving inventory.

attributes.name: dispatched_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the load plan was officially dispatched and the driver was authorized to depart, marking the transition from loading to in-transit status.

attributes.name: dock_door_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the dock door assigned for loading this trailer at the distribution center.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the driver assigned to this load plan, used for dispatch and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total freight transportation charge for this load in USD, used for carrier payment and freight cost allocation.

attributes.name: frozen_pallets
attributes.description: Number of pallets containing frozen products requiring frozen temperature control (typically 0°F or below).

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this load contains hazardous materials requiring special handling and DOT placarding per 49 CFR regulations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this load plan record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: load_plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the load plan, externally visible and used for tracking and communication with carriers and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: load_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the load plan indicating its progress through the outbound fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|loading|loaded|dispatched|in_transit|delivered|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: load_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order number for this load plan within the daily dispatch schedule, used for dock door assignment and loading prioritization.

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Classification of the load based on transportation mode and delivery pattern (FTL, LTL, dedicated route, or pool distribution).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special instructions, delivery requirements, or operational notes related to this load plan.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the trailer is expected to arrive at the destination store or facility.

attributes.name: planned_departure_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the trailer is planned to depart from the distribution center.

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when the trailer is planned to depart from the distribution center, used for dock scheduling and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned progressive number used for shipment tracking and freight bill matching in the freight audit process.

attributes.name: refrigerated_pallets
attributes.description: Number of pallets containing refrigerated products requiring cold chain temperature control (typically 32-40°F).

attributes.name: rfid_tracked_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this load contains RFID-tagged pallets or cases for real-time inventory visibility and automated receiving.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the security seal applied to the trailer door after loading, used for tamper detection and cargo security verification.

attributes.name: stop_count
attributes.description: Total number of delivery stops on this route, used for multi-stop route optimization and driver scheduling.

attributes.name: temperature_zone_type
attributes.description: Primary temperature control zone classification for this load, indicating whether the trailer is single-zone or multi-temperature equipped.

attributes.name: total_cube_cf
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the load in cubic feet, used for trailer utilization analysis and capacity optimization.

attributes.name: total_freight_cost
attributes.description: Total combined freight and accessorial cost for this load in USD, used for freight spend analysis and carrier performance evaluation.

attributes.name: total_miles
attributes.description: Total planned mileage for this route, used for fuel cost estimation and driver compensation calculation.

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets loaded onto the trailer for this shipment, used for capacity planning and load verification.

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Total weight of the load in pounds, used for freight rating, carrier billing, and DOT compliance verification.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the trailer assigned to this load plan, used for equipment tracking and yard management.

products.name: vendor_lead_time
products.description: Operational lead time parameters by vendor-item-location combination used by Blue Yonder demand planning to calculate reorder points and safety stock. Captures vendor ID, item/SKU, destination DC or store, order-to-ship days, ship-to-receipt days, total lead time days, minimum order quantity, order multiple, case pack size, effective/expiration dates, lead time tier (standard, expedited, emergency), and seasonal adjustment factors. Drives automated replenishment calculations and PO timing. Distinct from vendor master (vendor domain) — this is supply-chain operational planning data.
products.reference: Blue Yonder Supplier Lead Time / Oracle Retail Replenishment Attributes

attributes.name: vendor_lead_time_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor lead time record. Primary key for this operational planning parameter.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last updated this lead time parameter. Supports accountability and audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX - Internal Controls for Data Changes

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary carrier used for this vendor-item-destination lane. Links to carrier master for routing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Internal item identifier linking to the product master. References the specific product for which lead time applies.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination DC, store, or MFC receiving the shipment. Determines where the lead time applies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Location Master

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor supplying the item. Links to the vendor master in the vendor domain.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Vendor Master

attributes.name: case_pack_size
attributes.description: Number of units per case pack from the vendor. Defines the vendor shipping unit for this item.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Pack Hierarchy

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature-controlled logistics are required for this vendor-item combination. True for perishable items requiring refrigeration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time record was first created in the system. Establishes the origin point for this parameter configuration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Audit Trail

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor-item can bypass DC storage and be cross-docked directly to stores. True enables flow-through distribution.

attributes.name: destination_type
attributes.description: Type of destination location for the shipment. DC = Distribution Center, MFC = Micro-Fulfillment Center.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time parameter becomes active. Start of the validity period for this lead time configuration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Temporal Parameter Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this lead time parameter expires. End of the validity period. Null indicates no expiration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Temporal Parameter Management

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining responsibility for shipping costs and risk transfer. Examples: FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lead time record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Audit Trail

attributes.name: lead_time_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this lead time parameter. Active = in use for replenishment calculations, Inactive = not currently used, Suspended = temporarily disabled, Under Review = being evaluated for changes.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Parameter Lifecycle

attributes.name: lead_time_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier for the lead time. Standard = normal replenishment, Expedited = faster service, Emergency = urgent fulfillment, DSD = Direct Store Delivery bypass DC.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Service Level Definitions

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days
attributes.description: Standard deviation of lead time in days. Measures consistency of vendor delivery performance. Used to calculate safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Calculation

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units that must be ordered from the vendor for this item. Vendor-imposed constraint on order size.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Vendor Item Attributes

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments or special instructions related to this vendor lead time configuration. Used for context that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: Order quantity must be a multiple of this value. Ensures orders align with vendor case pack or pallet configurations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Vendor Item Attributes

attributes.name: order_to_ship_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order placement to vendor shipment departure. Vendor processing time component of total lead time.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Lead Time Parameters

attributes.name: reorder_point_units
attributes.description: Inventory level in units that triggers automatic replenishment. Calculated from lead time, demand forecast, and safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Policy

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID tags are used to track shipments from this vendor for this item. Enables real-time supply chain visibility.

attributes.name: safety_stock_days
attributes.description: Number of days of safety stock coverage calculated based on lead time and variability. Buffer inventory to protect against stockouts.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Policy

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base lead time during seasonal periods. Values >1.0 extend lead time, <1.0 reduce it. Used for holiday or peak season adjustments.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_period_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the seasonal period for which the adjustment factor applies. Examples: HOLIDAY, SUMMER, BACKTOSCHOOL.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonal Calendar

attributes.name: ship_to_receipt_days
attributes.description: Number of days from vendor shipment departure to receipt at destination location. Transit time component of total lead time.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management - Transit Time Standards

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the item. The specific product code for which lead time is tracked.
attributes.references: GS1 - Global Trade Item Number Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system that provided this lead time data. Examples: BYDP (Blue Yonder Demand Planning), ORMS (Oracle Retail Merchandising System), MANUAL.

attributes.name: total_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total end-to-end lead time from PO placement to receipt at destination. Sum of order-to-ship and ship-to-receipt days. Used to calculate reorder points.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Replenishment Calculation

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for shipments from this vendor to the destination. Impacts transit time and cost.

attributes.name: vendor_fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of orders fulfilled completely by the vendor for this item. Historical performance metric used to adjust lead time parameters.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Vendor Performance Metrics

products.name: demand_forecast
products.description: Demand and supply forecasts generated by Blue Yonder Demand Planning at the item-location-week level. Captures forecast period, item/SKU, location (store or DC), baseline forecast units, promotional lift units, total forecast units, forecast confidence score, forecast method (statistical, ML, manual override), last updated timestamp, and planner ID. Used to drive replenishment orders and DC allocation. Operational planning data — not an analytics aggregate.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Primary key for demand_forecast

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the demand planner responsible for reviewing and approving this forecast. Links to the workforce or employee master data.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) being forecasted. Links to the item master data.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards

attributes.name: promotional_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional event or campaign driving the promotional lift in this forecast period. Links to the promotions master data.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or DC (Distribution Center) for which the forecast is generated. Supports both store-level and DC-level forecasting.

attributes.name: baseline_forecast_units
attributes.description: The baseline demand forecast in units, excluding promotional lift. Represents normal demand patterns based on historical trends and seasonality.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Baseline Forecast

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A score between 0 and 1 indicating the quality of input data used for forecast generation. Factors include completeness of historical sales, POS (Point of Sale) data accuracy, and inventory data reliability.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Data Quality Assessment

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: The coefficient of variation for historical demand, measuring demand volatility. Higher values indicate more variable demand patterns requiring higher safety stock.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Demand Variability Analysis

attributes.name: forecast_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was approved by the demand planner and released for use in replenishment planning.

attributes.name: forecast_bias_percentage
attributes.description: The historical forecast bias as a percentage, indicating systematic over-forecasting (positive) or under-forecasting (negative). Used for forecast accuracy monitoring.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: forecast_confidence_score
attributes.description: A confidence score between 0 and 1 indicating the reliability of the forecast. Higher scores indicate greater confidence based on historical accuracy and data quality.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was initially generated by the Blue Yonder Demand Planning system.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_weeks
attributes.description: The number of weeks into the future this forecast covers from the period start date. Typical horizons range from 4 to 52 weeks.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Planning Horizon

attributes.name: forecast_lower_bound_units
attributes.description: The lower bound of the forecast confidence interval in units, representing the pessimistic scenario for demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Confidence Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_method
attributes.description: The method used to generate the forecast. Statistical methods include time series models, machine learning uses advanced algorithms, manual override indicates planner adjustments, hybrid combines multiple methods, and consensus represents collaborative planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecasting Methods

attributes.name: forecast_model_name
attributes.description: The specific forecasting model or algorithm used to generate the forecast (e.g., ARIMA, exponential smoothing, neural network, ensemble model).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Model Configuration

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the forecast period. Typically represents the end of a week for weekly forecasts.

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the forecast period. Typically represents the beginning of a week for weekly forecasts.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the forecast. Draft forecasts are under review, approved forecasts are validated by planners, published forecasts are released to replenishment systems, superseded forecasts are replaced by newer versions, and rejected forecasts are not used.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Workflow

attributes.name: forecast_upper_bound_units
attributes.description: The upper bound of the forecast confidence interval in units, representing the optimistic scenario for demand.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Confidence Intervals

attributes.name: forecast_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the forecast for the same item-location-period combination. Increments with each revision to support forecast history and audit trails.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Version Control

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the forecast was last modified, either by system recalculation or manual planner override.

attributes.name: mean_absolute_percentage_error
attributes.description: The Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) for this item-location combination, measuring historical forecast accuracy. Lower values indicate better accuracy.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecast Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: new_product_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this forecast is for a new product introduction with limited or no historical sales data. True indicates a new product.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - New Item Forecasting

attributes.name: override_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the planner explaining the rationale for manual forecast overrides or adjustments.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Override Management

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code when a planner manually overrides the system-generated forecast. Captures business context for forecast adjustments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promotion|stockout|weather|seasonality|new_product|discontinuation|market_trend|competitive_action|supply_constraint|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Override Management

attributes.name: promotional_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental demand units expected from promotional activities such as BOGO (Buy One Get One), TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), or ad circular features.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Promotional Lift

attributes.name: safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The recommended safety stock level in units to buffer against forecast variability and supply chain uncertainty. Used in replenishment calculations.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Safety Stock Calculation

attributes.name: seasonal_index
attributes.description: The seasonal index applied to the forecast for this period, representing the expected demand variation due to seasonality. A value of 1.0 represents average demand, above 1.0 indicates peak season, below 1.0 indicates off-season.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Seasonality Modeling

attributes.name: total_forecast_units
attributes.description: The total demand forecast in units, combining baseline forecast and promotional lift. This is the primary forecast value used for replenishment planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Total Forecast

attributes.name: trend_factor
attributes.description: The trend factor applied to the forecast, representing the expected growth or decline in demand over time. Positive values indicate growth, negative values indicate decline.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Trend Analysis

products.name: allocation_plan
products.description: DC-to-store allocation plans generated by Blue Yonder Allocation Optimization for constrained or promotional inventory, encompassing both plan-level details (item, source DC, allocation type, method, status) and store-level allocation detail (destination store, allocated quantity, min/max, store tier, override, fulfillment status). Enables equitable distribution of limited supply and store-level fill rate measurement.
products.reference: Blue Yonder Allocation Plan / Oracle Retail Allocation

attributes.name: allocation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the allocation plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise buyer or planner responsible for this allocation plan.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category or department for this allocated item.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center from which inventory will be allocated to stores.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Reference to the visual merchandise display plan (planogram) that defines shelf placement and facing count for this allocated item.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) or product being allocated across stores.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional event driving this allocation, if applicable (e.g., BOGO, TPR, ad circular feature).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: actual_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of store orders completely fulfilled after allocation execution, calculated post-completion for performance measurement.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: ISO week identifier for the ad circular promotional flyer period this allocation supports (format: YYYY-Www).

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm or strategy used to distribute inventory: proportional to store size, store tier-based, historical sales-based, forecast-driven, manual override by category captain, or equal distribution.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the merchandise planner or buyer providing context, special instructions, or business rationale for this allocation plan.

attributes.name: allocation_strategy_code
attributes.description: System code representing the specific allocation algorithm configuration used by Blue Yonder.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Category of allocation plan indicating the business driver: promotional (BOGO, TPR), constrained supply, seasonal launch, new item introduction, standard replenishment, or ad circular support.

attributes.name: allocation_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for allocated quantities: each (individual units), case (vendor case pack), pallet (full pallet), or inner pack (intermediate pack size).

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated item requires temperature-controlled logistics (fresh produce, frozen, dairy, meat, pharmacy).

attributes.name: constrained_supply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is for limited or constrained inventory requiring equitable distribution across stores.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether allocated inventory can be cross-docked (transferred without storage) at the DC for faster store delivery.

attributes.name: endcap_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation includes inventory for end-of-aisle promotional displays (endcaps) in addition to regular shelf stock.

attributes.name: fifo_enforcement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FIFO (First In First Out) Enforcement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FIFO inventory rotation must be enforced during allocation fulfillment to manage perishable goods and expiration dates.

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of store orders that should be completely fulfilled by this allocation plan, used to measure allocation effectiveness.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation plan record was last modified, tracking changes through the plan lifecycle.

attributes.name: max_store_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity each store can receive based on shelf capacity, backroom space, or planogram facing constraints.

attributes.name: min_store_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity each store should receive to maintain shelf presence and avoid out-of-stock (OOS) conditions.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual overrides applied to system-generated allocation recommendations, documenting planner judgment.

attributes.name: plan_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the allocation plan was approved by the merchandise planner or category manager.

attributes.name: plan_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when all store allocations in the plan were fulfilled and the plan was marked complete.

attributes.name: plan_created_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation plan was initially created in the Blue Yonder system.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the allocation plan, typically generated by Blue Yonder Allocation Optimization system.

attributes.name: plan_released_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the allocation plan was released to the warehouse management system for fulfillment execution.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation plan: draft (being created), approved (ready for execution), released (sent to WMS), in progress (actively fulfilling), completed (all stores fulfilled), or cancelled.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority for fulfilling this allocation plan, affecting warehouse picking and shipping sequence.

attributes.name: rfid_tracked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated item is tracked using RFID technology for real-time inventory visibility and shrink reduction.

attributes.name: seasonal_event
attributes.description: Seasonal or holiday event associated with this allocation (e.g., Thanksgiving, Back to School, Summer BBQ).

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of stores included in this allocation plan.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for allocated inventory: ambient (room temp), refrigerated (33-40°F), frozen (0°F or below), or controlled room temperature (pharmacy).

attributes.name: total_allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of units allocated across all stores in this plan.

attributes.name: total_available_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the item available at the source DC at the time the allocation plan was created.

products.name: allocation_detail
products.description: Store-level line items within an allocation plan specifying the exact quantity allocated to each store. Captures allocation plan reference, destination store, allocated quantity, minimum allocation, maximum allocation, store tier, override quantity, override reason, and fulfillment status. Enables store-level allocation tracking and fill rate measurement.

attributes.name: allocation_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the allocation detail line item. Primary key for store-level allocation records.

attributes.name: allocation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent allocation plan that this detail line belongs to. Links to the header-level allocation strategy.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: User who approved this allocation detail for release. Captures accountability for allocation decisions.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Distribution center or warehouse from which this allocation will be fulfilled. Identifies the origin facility for the shipment.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment that fulfilled this allocation detail. Links allocation planning to physical shipment execution.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Product being allocated to the store. References the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) in the allocation.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Destination store receiving the allocated inventory. Identifies the specific retail location for this allocation line.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the allocation was received at the destination store. Used to measure on-time delivery performance.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the allocation was shipped from the distribution center. Used to measure on-time shipment performance.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Calculated quantity allocated to this store based on allocation rules and store tier. Represents the system-recommended allocation amount.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm used to calculate the allocated quantity for this store. Defines the business rule applied during allocation planning.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this allocation detail line. Tracks progression from planning through fulfillment.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation detail was approved for fulfillment. Marks the transition from planning to execution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation detail record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the final allocated quantity that was successfully received at the store. Calculated as (received_quantity / final_allocated_quantity) * 100. Key metric for allocation effectiveness.

attributes.name: final_allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Final quantity to be shipped to the store. Equals override_quantity if present, otherwise equals allocated_quantity. Used for fulfillment execution.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Status of physical fulfillment for this allocation line. Indicates whether the allocated quantity has been picked, shipped, and received at the store.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this allocation detail record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the allocation plan. Orders allocation detail records within the parent plan.

attributes.name: maximum_allocation_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be allocated to this store based on shelf capacity, backroom space, or inventory policy. Ceiling constraint for allocation.

attributes.name: minimum_allocation_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be allocated to this store to meet presentation standards or planogram requirements. Floor constraint for allocation.

attributes.name: override_quantity
attributes.description: Manual override quantity entered by planner or merchandiser. Replaces the system-calculated allocated quantity when business judgment requires adjustment.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the allocation was manually overridden. Captures business justification for deviating from system recommendation.

attributes.name: override_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for the allocation override. Provides additional context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of units per case or pack. Used to convert case quantities to eaches for inventory tracking.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_date
attributes.description: Expected date for the allocation to arrive at the destination store. Used for store labor planning and receiving dock scheduling.

attributes.name: planned_ship_date
attributes.description: Target date for shipping this allocation from the distribution center. Used for transportation planning and store receiving scheduling.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Fulfillment priority for this allocation detail. CRITICAL=immediate need (OOS recovery), HIGH=promotional support, NORMAL=standard replenishment, LOW=backfill.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and confirmed at the destination store. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage or discrepancies.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped from the distribution center to the store. May differ from final allocated quantity due to inventory availability.

attributes.name: store_tier
attributes.description: Performance tier classification of the destination store. Used to prioritize allocation quantities based on store sales volume and strategic importance (A=highest, F=lowest).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for allocated quantities. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, LB=Pound, KG=Kilogram.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between final allocated quantity and received quantity. Positive values indicate over-shipment, negative values indicate under-shipment.

products.name: dc_facility
products.description: Master record for Distribution Centers and Micro-Fulfillment Centers (MFCs) in the Grocery supply network. Captures DC code, DC name, address, facility type (full-service DC, cross-dock, MFC, cold storage), total square footage, dock door count, refrigerated capacity (cubic feet), frozen capacity, ambient capacity, WMS system instance, SAP plant code, operating hours, and facility status. Distinct from store master (owned by store domain).
products.reference: Manhattan Associates WMS Facility / SAP MM Plant

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the distribution center or micro-fulfillment center facility.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the distribution center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: ambient_capacity_cubic_ft
attributes.description: Total cubic feet of ambient (room temperature) storage capacity for non-perishable inventory.

attributes.name: average_daily_outbound_volume
attributes.description: Average number of cases or pallets shipped outbound per day for store replenishment and customer fulfillment.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the distribution center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center was permanently closed or decommissioned. Null for active facilities.

attributes.name: cold_chain_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified for cold chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply chain operations for perishable goods.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the distribution center location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center facility record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_dock_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility supports cross-dock operations (transfer of goods from inbound to outbound without storage).

attributes.name: dc_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the distribution center used across operational systems and reporting. Typically a short alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: dc_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the distribution center or micro-fulfillment center facility.

attributes.name: dock_door_count
attributes.description: Total number of dock doors available for inbound receiving and outbound shipping operations.

attributes.name: dsd_receiving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this distribution center receives DSD shipments directly from vendors for consolidation and redistribution to stores.

attributes.name: erp_location_code
attributes.description: Location identifier in the enterprise ERP system (SAP, Oracle) used for financial posting and inventory accounting.

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the distribution center facility in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution center by operational model: full-service DC (receiving, storage, picking, shipping), cross-dock (transfer without storage), MFC (micro-fulfillment center for last-mile delivery), cold storage (refrigerated/frozen only), ambient-only, or perishable-focused.

attributes.name: frozen_capacity_cubic_ft
attributes.description: Total cubic feet of frozen storage capacity for frozen goods inventory (typically 0°F or below).

attributes.name: haccp_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility maintains HACCP certification for food safety and hazard prevention in handling perishable and food products.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center facility record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution center for routing and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution center for routing and logistics optimization.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center facility first became operational and began receiving and shipping inventory.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays (Monday-Friday) in format HH:MM-HH:MM (e.g., 06:00-22:00). Used for scheduling inbound shipments and outbound loads.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends (Saturday-Sunday) in format HH:MM-HH:MM. May differ from weekday hours or be closed.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified for handling and storing USDA organic products with required segregation and handling protocols.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the distribution center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the distribution center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: primary_service_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area primarily served by this distribution center (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West Coast).

attributes.name: refrigerated_capacity_cubic_ft
attributes.description: Total cubic feet of refrigerated storage capacity for temperature-controlled perishable inventory (typically 32-40°F).

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility is equipped with RFID infrastructure for automated inventory tracking and shipment verification.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP ERP plant code assigned to this distribution center for materials management and logistics execution in SAP MM/WM modules.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for the distribution center location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: store_count_served
attributes.description: Number of retail store locations actively served by this distribution center for replenishment.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the distribution center location used for scheduling and operational hours (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago).

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building square footage of the distribution center facility including all storage, operational, and administrative areas.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the distribution center operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week for continuous receiving and shipping.

attributes.name: wms_system_instance
attributes.description: Identifier for the WMS system instance deployed at this distribution center. References Manhattan Associates WMS or other warehouse management platform.

products.name: supply_supplier_contract
products.description: Supply-chain-specific vendor contracts governing purchase terms, fill rate SLAs, lead times, EDI requirements, and compliance obligations. Encompasses contract terms (type, effective dates, minimum fill rate, on-time SLA, EDI compliance) and compliance enforcement including vendor chargebacks for non-compliance events (late shipments, short fills, mislabeling, EDI errors, HACCP violations). Captures chargeback amounts, dispute status, and resolution. Distinct from vendor master (vendor domain) — this is the operational supply agreement and its enforcement.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement / Oracle Retail Supplier Agreement

attributes.name: supply_supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier contract. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_supply_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement buyer or category manager responsible for negotiating and managing this contract.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Store‑level supplier contract compliance reports require linking each contract to the specific store it governs; this FK enables per‑store contract performance tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor master record. Links to the vendor who is party to this supply agreement.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated allowance or discount percentage applied to invoice amounts. May represent volume rebates, promotional allowances, or early payment discounts.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract automatically renews for another term if neither party provides termination notice by the renewal deadline.

attributes.name: category_captain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor serves as the category captain, providing category management insights, planogram recommendations, and assortment optimization guidance.

attributes.name: chargeback_policy
attributes.description: Detailed policy governing vendor chargebacks for non-compliance events including late shipments, short fills, mislabeling, EDI errors, and HACCP violations. Defines chargeback amounts, dispute process, and resolution timelines.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature-controlled logistics (cold chain) are required for all shipments under this contract. Enforced for perishable goods, frozen foods, and pharmacy products.

attributes.name: contract_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the signed contract document stored in the document management system. Provides audit trail and legal reference.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the supplier contract for easy identification and reference.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the supplier contract. Used in procurement documents, EDI transactions, and vendor communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier contract. Active contracts govern current procurement operations. Suspended contracts are temporarily inactive. Expired contracts have passed their end date. Terminated contracts were ended early.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contract governing the procurement relationship. Blanket PO for recurring orders, spot buy for one-time purchases, DSD for Direct Store Delivery agreements, private label for store-owned brand sourcing, consignment for vendor-owned inventory.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was first created in the system. Audit trail for contract lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: cross_dock_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipments under this contract are eligible for cross-dock operations (transfer without DC storage). Requires vendor to meet strict ASN accuracy and delivery window compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_process
attributes.description: Agreed process for resolving contract disputes including escalation paths, mediation requirements, and arbitration clauses. May reference specific legal jurisdictions.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract governs Direct Store Delivery operations, where vendor delivers directly to stores bypassing the DC. Common for bread, beverages, snacks, and magazines.

attributes.name: edi_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI transaction compliance is mandatory under this contract. True means vendor must submit ASN (856), invoices (810), and other documents via EDI. False allows manual or alternative submission methods.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required EDI transaction set codes (e.g., 850 for PO, 856 for ASN, 810 for Invoice, 997 for Functional Acknowledgment). Defines the EDI compliance scope.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms expire. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal or termination workflows as the date approaches.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract terms become binding and procurement operations under this agreement may begin.

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment and liability terms. FOB Origin means buyer pays freight and assumes risk at vendor location. FOB Destination means vendor pays freight and assumes risk until delivery. Prepaid means vendor pays and may bill back. Collect means buyer pays carrier directly.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction whose laws govern contract interpretation and enforcement. Typically the state or country where the retailer is headquartered.

attributes.name: haccp_compliance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor must maintain HACCP certification and provide HACCP documentation for shipments. Critical for fresh produce, meat, dairy, and perishable goods suppliers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract record was last updated. Tracks amendments, status changes, and data corrections.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order submission to expected delivery at DC or store. Used in demand planning and replenishment forecasting.

attributes.name: minimum_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: Contractually required fill rate percentage. Vendor must fulfill at least this percentage of ordered quantity to avoid chargeback penalties. Monitored against actual shipment performance.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required per purchase order under this contract. Used in CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering) and replenishment planning systems.

attributes.name: minimum_order_value
attributes.description: Minimum monetary value required per purchase order to meet contract terms. Enforced in procurement systems to avoid order rejection.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional contract terms, special conditions, or operational notes not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_sla_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On-Time Delivery Service Level Agreement (SLA) Percentage
attributes.description: Contractually required on-time delivery percentage. Vendor must meet scheduled delivery windows at least this percentage of the time to avoid penalties. Tracked via TMS and WMS receiving timestamps.

attributes.name: organic_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor must maintain USDA Organic certification for products supplied under this contract. Enforced for organic private-label and branded organic SKUs.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Negotiated payment terms governing invoice settlement. Examples: Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days, otherwise net 30).

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract governs sourcing of private-label (store-owned brand) products. Private-label contracts often include exclusivity clauses and quality control requirements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming shipments under this contract require mandatory quality inspection at receiving before putaway. Common for fresh produce, meat, and private-label goods.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before contract expiration that renewal or termination notice must be provided. Triggers workflow alerts in procurement systems.

attributes.name: return_policy
attributes.description: Terms governing product returns, including acceptable reasons (damage, expiration, overstock), timeframes, and restocking fees. Critical for managing shrink and vendor chargebacks.

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendor must apply RFID tags to pallets or cases for automated tracking through the supply chain. Supports inventory visibility and shrink reduction initiatives.

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time or recurring fee paid by vendor for shelf space allocation and new item introduction. Common in category captain and promotional agreements.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to terminate the contract before its natural expiration. Protects both parties from abrupt supply disruption.

products.name: vendor_chargeback
products.description: Vendor chargeback records issued by Grocery to suppliers for non-compliance events such as late shipments, short fills, mislabeled cases, EDI errors, or HACCP violations. Captures chargeback number, vendor ID, PO reference, chargeback type (fill rate, on-time, labeling, EDI, food safety), violation date, chargeback amount, supporting documentation reference, dispute flag, dispute reason, and chargeback status (issued, disputed, resolved, written-off).
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Chargeback / EDI 812 Credit/Debit Adjustment

attributes.name: vendor_chargeback_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vendor_chargeback

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Required: Chargebacks are often issued as remediation for audit findings; the FK ties each chargeback to the originating audit finding.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: REQUIRED: Chargebacks are frequently carrier‑related; linking enables carrier performance and dispute analytics.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Product category associated with the chargeback, used for category-level vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment that triggered the chargeback, if applicable.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.pharmacy_location. Business justification: Chargebacks related to pharmacy items need pharmacy location association for financial reconciliation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the buyer or procurement specialist responsible for the vendor relationship and chargeback issuance.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order associated with the chargeback event.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific SKU involved in the chargeback event, if applicable to a single item.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center or store where the non-compliance event was detected.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor being charged back for non-compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the chargeback was approved for issuance to the vendor.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the chargeback assessed against the vendor for the non-compliance event.

attributes.name: chargeback_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the chargeback document, used for vendor communication and dispute tracking.

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback: issued (sent to vendor), disputed (vendor contested), under review (internal or vendor investigation), resolved (accepted and closed), written off (uncollectible), or cancelled (voided).

attributes.name: chargeback_type
attributes.description: Category of non-compliance that triggered the chargeback: fill rate (incomplete order), on-time delivery (late shipment), labeling (mislabeled cases), EDI error (electronic data interchange failure), food safety (HACCP violation), quality (product defect), packaging (damaged or incorrect packaging), or short fill (quantity discrepancy). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fill_rate|on_time_delivery|labeling|edi_error|food_safety|quality|packaging|short_fill — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Standards, FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with the chargeback for internal cost allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the chargeback record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the chargeback amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor submitted a formal dispute of the chargeback.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has formally disputed the chargeback (True if disputed, False otherwise).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Vendor-provided explanation or justification for disputing the chargeback, including supporting evidence references.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes documenting the investigation, negotiation, and final resolution of the dispute.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the vendor must respond or remit payment for the chargeback.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the chargeback recovery is posted for financial accounting.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the chargeback was formally issued to the vendor.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the chargeback record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, investigation details, or special handling instructions for the chargeback.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the vendor remitted payment or credit for the chargeback: credit memo (vendor-issued credit), check, wire transfer, deduction (from future invoice), or offset (against payable).

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when payment or credit was received from the vendor for the chargeback.

attributes.name: payment_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment or credit has been received from the vendor for the chargeback (True if received, False otherwise).

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a repeat non-compliance event for the same vendor and violation type within a defined period (True if recurring, False otherwise).

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the chargeback was resolved, either through vendor acceptance, dispute settlement, or write-off.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated the chargeback record (e.g., SAP MM, Oracle Retail, Manhattan WMS).

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to supporting documentation for the chargeback (e.g., inspection reports, photos, EDI logs, temperature logs, BOL discrepancies).

attributes.name: vendor_performance_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chargeback impacts the vendor's performance scorecard or compliance rating (True if impacts, False otherwise).

attributes.name: violation_date
attributes.description: Date when the non-compliance event occurred (e.g., late delivery date, inspection failure date, EDI transmission failure date).
