attributes.description: Date when the approved prior authorization expires and can no longer be used for prescription fills.

attributes.name: formulary_exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prior authorization is for a non-formulary drug requiring an exception.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to the prior authorization request, review, and decision.

attributes.name: pa_number
attributes.description: External prior authorization reference number assigned by the payer or pharmacy system.

attributes.name: pa_status
attributes.description: Current status of the prior authorization request in its lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|denied|cancelled|expired|appealed|under_review — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the payer representative who processed the prior authorization request.

attributes.name: payer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the payer representative who processed the prior authorization request.

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date when the prior authorization request was submitted to the payer.

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the prior authorization request was submitted to the payer.

attributes.name: step_therapy_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer requires step therapy (trial of alternative medications) before approving this drug.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Method used to submit the prior authorization request to the payer.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prior authorization record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: urgency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prior authorization request was marked as urgent or expedited.

products.name: prescriber
products.description: Master record for licensed prescribers (physicians, NPs, PAs, dentists) who write prescriptions filled at Grocery pharmacies. Captures NPI (National Provider Identifier), DEA registration number, DEA schedules authorized, prescriber name, specialty, practice address, state license number, license expiration date, e-prescribing (eRx) capability flag, and preferred contact method. Used for Rx validation, DEA compliance, and prescriber relationship management.

attributes.name: prescriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prescriber record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accepts_generic_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber generally accepts generic drug substitutions unless explicitly marked Dispense As Written (DAW).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prescriber record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credential
attributes.description: Primary professional credential or degree of the prescriber (e.g., MD for Medical Doctor, DO for Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine, NP for Nurse Practitioner, PA for Physician Assistant, DDS for Doctor of Dental Surgery). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MD|DO|NP|PA|DDS|DMD|DPM|OD|PharmD|DVM — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Board of Medicine Licensing Standards

attributes.name: dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number assigned to prescribers authorized to prescribe controlled substances. Format: two letters followed by seven digits.

attributes.name: dea_schedule_ii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is authorized to prescribe Schedule II controlled substances (high potential for abuse, accepted medical use with severe restrictions).
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act Schedule II

attributes.name: dea_schedule_iii_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is authorized to prescribe Schedule III controlled substances (moderate to low potential for physical and psychological dependence).
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act Schedule III

attributes.name: dea_schedule_iv_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is authorized to prescribe Schedule IV controlled substances (low potential for abuse and low risk of dependence).
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act Schedule IV

attributes.name: dea_schedule_v_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is authorized to prescribe Schedule V controlled substances (lower potential for abuse than Schedule IV).
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act Schedule V

attributes.name: erx_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber is enabled for electronic prescribing (eRx) and can transmit prescriptions electronically to pharmacies.

attributes.name: erx_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the electronic prescribing system or platform used by the prescriber (e.g., Surescripts, DrFirst).

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the prescriber as registered with licensing authorities.

attributes.name: first_prescription_date
attributes.description: Date the prescriber wrote their first prescription filled at a Grocery pharmacy.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the prescriber record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the prescriber as registered with licensing authorities.

attributes.name: last_prescription_date
attributes.description: Date the prescriber most recently wrote a prescription filled at a Grocery pharmacy.

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the state medical license expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: license_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the state medical license was originally issued to the prescriber.

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current status of the prescriber's state medical license.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the prescriber.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about the prescriber, including special instructions, preferences, or relationship management details.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique identification number issued by the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES) to healthcare providers in the United States. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: practice_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the prescriber's practice location.

attributes.name: practice_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, building) of the prescriber's practice location.

attributes.name: practice_city
attributes.description: City where the prescriber's practice is located.

attributes.name: practice_email
attributes.description: Email address for the prescriber's practice, used for non-PHI communications.

attributes.name: practice_fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the prescriber's practice, used for prescription transmission and prior authorization communications.

attributes.name: practice_name
attributes.description: Name of the medical practice, clinic, hospital, or healthcare organization where the prescriber practices.

attributes.name: practice_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the prescriber's practice (10-digit format without formatting).

attributes.name: practice_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or ZIP+4 code of the prescriber's practice location.

attributes.name: practice_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the prescriber's practice is located.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Prescriber's preferred method of contact for pharmacy communications (e.g., clarifications, prior authorizations, refill requests).

attributes.name: prescriber_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the prescriber in the pharmacy system.

attributes.name: relationship_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the prescriber's relationship strength with Grocery pharmacies based on prescription volume and engagement (tier_1 = high volume, tier_2 = medium volume, tier_3 = low volume).

attributes.name: specialty
attributes.description: Primary medical specialty or practice area of the prescriber (e.g., Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Pediatrics, Psychiatry, Dentistry).

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued medical license number authorizing the prescriber to practice medicine in the jurisdiction.

attributes.name: state_license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code indicating the jurisdiction that issued the medical license.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Name suffix or professional designation (e.g., Jr, Sr, II, III, MD, DO, NP, PA, DDS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Jr|Sr|II|III|IV|MD|DO|PharmD|NP|PA|DDS|DMD — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: Ten-digit alphanumeric code that classifies the prescriber's type, classification, and specialization. Used in HIPAA transactions.
attributes.references: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Health Care Provider Taxonomy

products.name: controlled_substance_log
products.description: DEA-mandated transactional log tracking all controlled substance (Schedule II–V) dispensing, receiving, returns, and destruction events at the pharmacy. Captures transaction type (dispense, receive, return, destroy, theft/loss), DEA schedule, drug NDC, quantity in/out, running balance, transaction date, pharmacist NPI, DEA Form reference (222, 41, 106), and biennial inventory reconciliation flag. Critical for DEA compliance reporting and State Board of Pharmacy audits.
products.reference: DEA 21 CFR Part 1304 / DEA Form 222 / ARCOS Reporting

attributes.name: controlled_substance_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each controlled substance transaction log entry. Primary key for the controlled substance log.

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: Controlled substance log should reference drug master for consistency.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pharmacy store location where the controlled substance transaction occurred.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prescription record for dispense transactions. Null for non-dispense transactions (receive, destroy, theft/loss).

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the patient receiving the controlled substance for dispense transactions. Null for non-dispense transactions. Protected under HIPAA.

attributes.name: biennial_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is part of the DEA-mandated biennial (every two years) physical inventory count of all controlled substances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this controlled substance log record was first created in the data warehouse. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: dea_form_number
attributes.description: Unique DEA form number or serial number for Form 222, 41, or 106 submissions. Null for routine dispense transactions.

attributes.name: dea_form_type
attributes.description: DEA form reference for controlled substance transactions: Form 222 (Schedule II order), Form 41 (destruction), Form 106 (theft or loss report). Null for routine dispense transactions.

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule classification: Schedule II (high abuse potential, accepted medical use), III (moderate abuse potential), IV (low abuse potential), or V (lowest abuse potential).

attributes.name: destruction_method
attributes.description: Method used to destroy the controlled substance (e.g., reverse distributor, on-site incineration, authorized collector). Required for destroy transactions and DEA Form 41 reporting.

attributes.name: destruction_witness_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized witness present during controlled substance destruction. Required for DEA Form 41 compliance.

attributes.name: distributor_dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number of the distributor or manufacturer for receive transactions.

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: Name of the wholesale distributor or manufacturer for receive transactions. Null for dispense, destroy, theft/loss transactions.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned expiration date of the controlled substance lot. Critical for inventory management and patient safety.

attributes.name: inventory_reconciliation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is an inventory adjustment or reconciliation entry to correct discrepancies identified during physical counts or audits.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Distributor invoice or packing slip number for receive transactions. Null for dispense, destroy, theft/loss transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this controlled substance log record was last updated in the data warehouse. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency notified of the theft or loss incident.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether local law enforcement was notified of the theft or loss incident. Required for DEA Form 106 compliance.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer lot or batch number of the controlled substance for traceability and recall purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the controlled substance transaction for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: pharmacist_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued pharmacist license number of the pharmacist who processed the transaction.

attributes.name: pharmacist_name
attributes.description: Full name of the pharmacist who processed and verified the controlled substance transaction.

attributes.name: pharmacist_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the pharmacist who processed the controlled substance transaction.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: prescriber_dea_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number of the prescriber authorized to prescribe controlled substances. Required for Schedule II-V dispense transactions.

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier of the prescriber for dispense transactions. Null for non-dispense transactions.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: quantity_in
attributes.description: Quantity of controlled substance units added to inventory (for receive, return-to-stock transactions). Null for dispense, destroy, theft/loss transactions.

attributes.name: quantity_out
attributes.description: Quantity of controlled substance units removed from inventory (for dispense, destroy, theft/loss transactions). Null for receive transactions.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the controlled substance quantity (e.g., tablet, capsule, mL, gram, patch).

attributes.name: running_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative on-hand inventory balance of the controlled substance after this transaction. Critical for perpetual inventory tracking and DEA audit reconciliation.

attributes.name: rx_number
attributes.description: Pharmacy-assigned prescription number for dispense transactions. Null for non-dispense transactions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the pharmacy management system that originated this controlled substance log entry (e.g., McKesson Pharmacy Systems).

attributes.name: theft_loss_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the circumstances surrounding theft or loss of controlled substances. Required for DEA Form 106 reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the controlled substance transaction occurred. Critical for DEA compliance reporting and biennial inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the controlled substance transaction was recorded in the pharmacy system.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of controlled substance transaction: dispense (prescription fill), receive (inventory receipt from distributor), return (patient or distributor return), destroy (disposal), theft_loss (inventory loss event), or adjustment (inventory correction).

products.name: patient_medication_profile
products.description: Consolidated medication history and adherence management record for a pharmacy patient, capturing all active and historical medications including Rx fills, OTC medications self-reported, and medication adherence metrics (PDC — Proportion of Days Covered, MPR — Medication Possession Ratio). Tracks therapy start/stop dates, prescriber, indication, and Medication Synchronization (MedSync) program enrollment including sync date (target monthly pickup day), enrolled medications, program status (active, paused, cancelled), assigned pharmacy technician, and estimated annual fill count. Supports MTM (Medication Therapy Management) services, Star Ratings compliance for Medicare Part D, patient retention through adherence programs, and pharmacy workflow planning.
products.reference: McKesson Medication History / CMS Star Ratings MTM

attributes.name: patient_medication_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the patient medication profile record.

attributes.name: primary_patient_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacist assigned as the primary care provider for this patient for MTM (Medication Therapy Management) services.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D MTM program requirements

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy patient for whom this medication profile is maintained.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary pharmacy store location where the patient typically fills prescriptions.

attributes.name: active_medication_count
attributes.description: Total number of active medications currently prescribed to the patient.
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Star Ratings medication adherence metrics

attributes.name: adherence_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification for medication non-adherence based on PDC scores and fill patterns.
attributes.references: Pharmacy Quality Alliance (PQA) adherence measure specifications

attributes.name: allergy_alerts_count
attributes.description: Number of documented drug allergies or adverse reactions on file for this patient.

attributes.name: auto_refill_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has opted into automatic prescription refill services.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy auto-refill program regulations

attributes.name: chronic_medication_count
attributes.description: Number of chronic maintenance medications the patient is taking (e.g., for diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol).
attributes.references: Medicare Part D Star Ratings medication adherence metrics

attributes.name: controlled_substance_count
attributes.description: Number of active controlled substance prescriptions (DEA Schedule II-V) in the patient's profile.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act 21 CFR Part 1300

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the patient medication profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_preference
attributes.description: Patient's preferred method for receiving filled prescriptions.

attributes.name: drug_interaction_alerts_count
attributes.description: Number of active drug-drug interaction alerts flagged in the patient's current medication profile.

attributes.name: estimated_annual_fill_count
attributes.description: Projected number of prescription fills for this patient over a 12-month period, used for pharmacy workflow planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: hipaa_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date when the patient signed the HIPAA authorization form. Null if no consent on file.

attributes.name: hipaa_consent_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) Consent On File
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed HIPAA authorization form is on file allowing disclosure of protected health information.

attributes.name: last_adherence_calculation_date
attributes.description: Date when adherence metrics (PDC, MPR) were last calculated for this patient.
attributes.references: Pharmacy Quality Alliance (PQA) adherence measure specifications

attributes.name: last_fill_date

attributes.name: pdc_hypertension

attributes.name: profile_notes

attributes.name: profile_status

products.name: clinical_service
products.description: Master record for pharmacy-administered clinical services offered at Grocery pharmacy locations. Captures service type (immunization, MTM consultation, health screening, point-of-care testing, smoking cessation, diabetes management), service name, CPT billing code, duration, required pharmacist certification, reimbursable flag, payer coverage, and service availability by store. Supports clinical services program management and revenue tracking.
products.reference: CPT Clinical Service Codes / CMS Immunization Billing

attributes.name: clinical_service_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy clinical service record. Primary key.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pharmacy store location where this service is offered. Null if service is available at all pharmacy locations. Used for store-specific service availability.

attributes.name: adverse_event_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse events from this service must be reported to FDA VAERS or other regulatory bodies. True for immunizations and high-risk procedures.

attributes.name: age_restriction_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum patient age in years eligible to receive this service. Null if no maximum age restriction. Used for patient eligibility screening.

attributes.name: age_restriction_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum patient age in years eligible to receive this service. Null if no minimum age restriction. Used for patient eligibility screening.

attributes.name: appointment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patients must schedule an appointment for this service. False for walk-in services. True for services requiring preparation or extended time.

attributes.name: clinical_protocol_document_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the clinical protocol or standard operating procedure document governing administration of this service. Used for pharmacist training and compliance.

attributes.name: commercial_insurance_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service is typically covered by commercial insurance plans. Actual coverage varies by payer and plan.

attributes.name: consent_form_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed patient consent form is required before administering this service. True for services with clinical risk or HIPAA implications.

attributes.name: consent_form_template_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the consent form template document used for this service. Null if no consent required.

attributes.name: cpt_code
attributes.description: Five-digit CPT billing code used for insurance reimbursement and revenue tracking. Assigned by the American Medical Association for standardized medical procedure coding.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this clinical service record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: hcpcs_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Code
attributes.description: HCPCS Level II code for services and supplies not covered by CPT codes. Used for Medicare and Medicaid billing.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this clinical service record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this clinical service record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: liability_insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether additional professional liability insurance coverage is required for pharmacists administering this service. True for high-risk clinical services.

attributes.name: medicaid_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service is covered under state Medicaid programs. Coverage may vary by state.

attributes.name: medicare_covered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service is covered under Medicare Part B or Part D. Used for patient eligibility determination and billing.

attributes.name: ndc_code
attributes.description: NDC for vaccine or medication administered as part of the clinical service. Applicable for immunizations and injectable medications. Format: 5-4-2 segments.

attributes.name: online_scheduling_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether patients can schedule this service through the online portal or mobile app. Used for digital commerce integration.

attributes.name: patient_out_of_pocket_amount
attributes.description: Typical patient copay or self-pay amount in USD for this service. Used for patient communication and point-of-sale transactions.

attributes.name: pharmacist_certification_required
attributes.description: Specific certification or credential required for the pharmacist to administer this service (e.g., Immunization Certification, Diabetes Care Specialist, MTM Certificate, Tobacco Cessation Specialist). Null if no special certification required beyond RPh license.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: pharmacist_training_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education hours required for pharmacist to be qualified to provide this service. Used for workforce training planning.

attributes.name: quality_measure_tracked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service is tracked for quality measures and clinical outcomes reporting. True for services with CMS quality reporting requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: State Board of Pharmacy or DEA approval number authorizing the pharmacy to provide this clinical service. Required for controlled services. Null if no special approval required.

attributes.name: reimbursable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service is eligible for insurance reimbursement. True if billable to insurance payers, False if patient self-pay only.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service ends. Null if not a seasonal service. Used for inventory and staffing planning.

attributes.name: seasonal_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service is offered seasonally (e.g., flu shots in fall/winter). True for seasonal services, False for year-round services.

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal service becomes available. Null if not a seasonal service. Used for inventory and staffing planning.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: Internal unique code identifying the clinical service offering. Used for operational tracking and service catalog management.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the clinical service, including what is provided, patient benefits, and clinical outcomes. Used for patient communication and marketing materials.

attributes.name: service_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this clinical service was discontinued or retired. Null if service is still active. Used for historical reporting.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Expected duration of the clinical service appointment in minutes. Used for scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: service_launch_date
attributes.description: Date when this clinical service was first introduced and made available to patients. Used for service lifecycle tracking and performance analysis.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the clinical service (e.g., Influenza Vaccination, Medication Therapy Management Consultation, Blood Pressure Screening).
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems Clinical Services Module

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the clinical service offering. Active services are available for scheduling. Inactive services are not offered. Suspended services are temporarily unavailable. Pending approval services are awaiting clinical or regulatory approval. Discontinued services are permanently retired.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Category of clinical service offered. Immunization includes vaccines and injections. MTM includes comprehensive medication reviews. Health screening includes blood pressure, cholesterol, glucose testing. Point-of-care testing includes rapid diagnostic tests. Smoking cessation includes counseling programs. Chronic disease management includes diabetes, hypertension, asthma programs.

attributes.name: standard_reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Average reimbursement amount in USD for this service across all payers. Used for revenue forecasting and financial planning. Null if not reimbursable.

products.name: clinical_service_encounter
products.description: Transactional record for each patient encounter where a clinical pharmacy service was delivered. Captures encounter date, service type, administering pharmacist NPI (validated against workforce domain pharmacist credential records), patient consent obtained flag, clinical outcome documented, vaccine lot number and expiration (for immunizations), VIS (Vaccine Information Statement) provided flag, billing CPT code, reimbursement amount, adverse event documentation, and VAERS (Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System) report flag. Supports immunization registry reporting (state IIS integration), clinical billing, and pharmacy quality metrics. Pharmacist credential and license validation is a cross-domain dependency on the workforce domain.
products.reference: CPT Encounter Billing / CDC Immunization Registry / VAERS

attributes.name: clinical_service_encounter_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the clinical service encounter record. Primary key.

attributes.name: clinical_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.clinical_service. Business justification: An encounter records the delivery of a specific clinical service; linking to clinical_service provides service definition and pricing.

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy store location where the clinical service was delivered.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated prescription record if the clinical service was related to a prescription (e.g., medication therapy management). Nullable for services not tied to a specific prescription.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems Prescription Management Module

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Reference to the patient who received the clinical service. Links to pharmacy patient master data.

attributes.name: administering_pharmacist_license_number
attributes.description: State pharmacy license number of the administering pharmacist. Required for regulatory compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: administering_pharmacist_name
attributes.description: Full name of the pharmacist who delivered the clinical service. Used for documentation and patient communication.
attributes.references: State Board of Pharmacy Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: administering_pharmacist_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the pharmacist who administered or delivered the clinical service. Validated against workforce domain pharmacist credential records for license and certification compliance.

attributes.name: adverse_event_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the adverse event or reaction experienced by the patient. Used for clinical review and safety reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: adverse_event_documented_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse event or reaction was documented following the clinical service. Triggers quality review and potential VAERS reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: adverse_event_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the documented adverse event. Used for risk assessment and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: billing_cpt_code
attributes.description: CPT code used for billing and reimbursement of the clinical service. Maps the service to standardized healthcare procedure codes for insurance claims.

attributes.name: billing_cpt_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the CPT code used for billing. Provides clarity for billing and audit purposes.

attributes.name: clinical_outcome_documented_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinical outcome of the service was documented in the patient record. Used for quality assurance and clinical governance.

attributes.name: clinical_outcome_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the clinical outcome, patient response, and any follow-up recommendations. Supports continuity of care and quality improvement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the clinical service encounter record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: encounter_date
attributes.description: The date on which the clinical service encounter occurred. Primary business event date for reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: encounter_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the clinical service encounter, externally visible and used for tracking and reference.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems Clinical Services Module

attributes.name: encounter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the clinical service encounter. Tracks the encounter from scheduling through completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: McKesson Pharmacy Systems Clinical Services Module

attributes.name: encounter_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the clinical service encounter was initiated. Used for detailed scheduling and workflow analysis.

attributes.name: iis_report_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the immunization encounter was reported to the state Immunization Information System registry. Required for public health surveillance.

attributes.name: iis_report_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the immunization data was transmitted to the state IIS registry. Used for compliance tracking.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number submitted to the insurance payer for reimbursement of the clinical service. Used for claim tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the clinical service encounter record was last updated. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: patient_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which patient consent was obtained for the clinical service. Nullable if consent was not required or not obtained.

attributes.name: patient_consent_obtained_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed patient consent was obtained prior to delivering the clinical service. Required for HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation.

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Type of payer responsible for reimbursement of the clinical service. Used for revenue analysis and payer mix reporting.

attributes.name: reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount reimbursed or expected to be reimbursed for the clinical service by the payer. Used for revenue recognition and financial reporting.

attributes.name: reimbursement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the reimbursement amount. Typically USD for US-based operations.

attributes.name: service_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subtype or specific variant of the clinical service (e.g., flu vaccine, COVID-19 vaccine, comprehensive medication review). Provides granular classification.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of clinical pharmacy service delivered during the encounter. Categorizes the service for billing, quality metrics, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: vaccine_administered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the clinical service involved vaccine administration (immunization). Used to filter immunization encounters for registry reporting.

attributes.name: vaccine_dose_number
attributes.description: Sequential dose number in a multi-dose vaccine series (e.g., 1 for first dose, 2 for second dose). Used for immunization schedule tracking.

attributes.name: vaccine_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vaccine lot administered. Ensures compliance with product safety and efficacy standards.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Storage and Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: vaccine_lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer lot number of the vaccine administered. Required for traceability, adverse event reporting, and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: vaccine_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical manufacturer of the vaccine administered. Required for adverse event reporting and supply chain tracking.

attributes.name: vaccine_name
attributes.description: Brand or generic name of the vaccine administered. Used for patient communication and clinical documentation.

attributes.name: vaccine_ndc
attributes.description: National Drug Code of the vaccine product administered. Required for immunization registry reporting and inventory tracking. Nullable for non-immunization services.

attributes.name: vaccine_route_of_administration
attributes.description: Anatomical route by which the vaccine was administered. Required for clinical documentation and immunization registry reporting.

attributes.name: vaccine_site_of_administration
attributes.description: Specific anatomical site where the vaccine was administered (e.g., left deltoid, right thigh). Used for clinical documentation.

attributes.name: vaers_report_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) Report Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an adverse event report was submitted to the FDA VAERS system. Required for serious adverse events following immunization.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: vaers_report_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) Report ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by VAERS for the submitted adverse event report. Used for tracking and follow-up.
attributes.references: FDA Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS)

attributes.name: vis_provided_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CDC Vaccine Information Statement was provided to the patient or guardian prior to vaccine administration. Federally mandated for all vaccines covered by the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program.
attributes.references: National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act 42 USC 300aa-26

attributes.name: vis_publication_date
attributes.description: Publication date of the VIS document provided to the patient. Required for federal compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act 42 USC 300aa-26

products.name: pharmacy_location
products.description: Master record for each Grocery pharmacy location capturing pharmacy-specific regulatory credentials and operational configuration distinct from the store domain's general location profile. Includes pharmacy NPI, DEA registration number and expiration, State Board of Pharmacy license number and expiration, pharmacy director name and NPI, pharmacist-in-charge designation, operating hours, pharmacy type (full-service, drive-through, 24-hour, specialty), dispensing system identifier (McKesson integration endpoint), CLIA waiver number (for point-of-care testing), controlled substance vault certification status, and maximum prescription volume capacity. Supports DEA registration renewal tracking, State Board inspection readiness, and pharmacy network adequacy reporting.
products.reference: DEA Registration / State Board of Pharmacy License / NPI Registry

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy location. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for financial reporting of pharmacy operating expenses per cost center; profit & loss statements allocate pharmacy costs to the appropriate cost center.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Needed for consolidating pharmacy financial results under the correct legal entity for statutory reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: Pharmacy aisles use planograms; this FK enables compliance tracking, planogram version control, and automated replenishment for pharmacy shelves.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Required for Pharmacy Pricing Zone assignment used in daily price calculation reports and regulatory price compliance per location.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Store Promotion Planning assigns campaigns to specific pharmacy locations, supporting localized marketing calendars and performance reporting.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Cluster‑wide assortment planning includes pharmacy sites; linking location to its store cluster supports cluster inventory allocation and space planning reports.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent retail store location where this pharmacy is housed. Links pharmacy to the broader store operations.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier_site. Business justification: LOGISTICS: Map each store to its primary supplier site to optimize delivery routing, lead‑time monitoring, and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the pharmacy location. Required for regulatory filings, DEA registration, and state board documentation.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building identifier, or floor. Optional field for additional location detail.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the pharmacy is located. Required for regulatory filings and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: clia_waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the CLIA waiver certificate. CLIA certificates must be renewed every two years. Null if no waiver held.

attributes.name: clia_waiver_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Waiver Number
attributes.description: CLIA waiver certificate number authorizing the pharmacy to perform point-of-care testing such as flu tests, strep tests, and blood glucose monitoring. Null if no waiver held.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy location permanently ceased operations. Null for active pharmacies. Used for historical analysis and patient transfer tracking.

attributes.name: controlled_substance_vault_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy has a DEA-compliant controlled substance storage vault that meets security and access control requirements. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the pharmacy location. Determines applicable national regulatory framework.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy location record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: dea_registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the DEA registration. DEA registrations must be renewed every three years. Critical for compliance tracking and renewal planning.

attributes.name: dea_registration_number
attributes.description: DEA registration number authorizing the pharmacy to dispense controlled substances. Format: two letters followed by seven digits.

attributes.name: dispensing_system_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pharmacy dispensing system endpoint. Used for McKesson system integration and prescription routing.

attributes.name: drive_through_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy location offers drive-through prescription pickup service. True if available, False otherwise.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the pharmacy location. Used for business communication, regulatory correspondence, and vendor coordination.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for receiving prescriptions from prescribers and processing prior authorizations. Critical for HIPAA-compliant prescription transmission.

attributes.name: immunization_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy location is certified to administer immunizations and vaccinations. True if certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_state_board_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent state board of pharmacy inspection. Used for compliance tracking and inspection readiness planning.

attributes.name: max_prescription_volume_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of prescriptions this pharmacy location can safely process per day based on staffing, equipment, and physical capacity. Used for workload balancing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: mckesson_site_code
attributes.description: McKesson system site identifier for this pharmacy location. Used for inventory management, ordering, and claims processing integration.

attributes.name: next_state_board_inspection_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next State Board Inspection Due Date
attributes.description: Expected or scheduled date for the next state board of pharmacy inspection. Used for proactive compliance preparation.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS for healthcare billing and identification. Required for pharmacy claims processing.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the pharmacy location first opened for business and began dispensing prescriptions. Used for tenure analysis and historical reporting.

attributes.name: operating_hours_saturday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for Saturday. Format: HH:MM-HH:MM. May differ from weekday hours.

attributes.name: operating_hours_sunday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for Sunday. Format: HH:MM-HH:MM. May differ from weekday and Saturday hours.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for Monday through Friday. Format: HH:MM-HH:MM (e.g., 09:00-21:00). Used for customer communication and staffing planning.

attributes.name: pharmacist_in_charge_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued pharmacist license number for the pharmacist-in-charge. Required for state board reporting and inspection documentation.

attributes.name: pharmacist_in_charge_name
attributes.description: Full name of the licensed pharmacist designated as pharmacist-in-charge responsible for day-to-day operations and regulatory compliance at this location.

attributes.name: pharmacy_director_name
attributes.description: Full name of the licensed pharmacist designated as the pharmacy director responsible for overall pharmacy operations and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: pharmacy_director_npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier of the pharmacy director. Required for regulatory filings and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: pharmacy_name
attributes.description: Business name of the pharmacy location as registered with state authorities and displayed to customers.

attributes.name: pharmacy_number
attributes.description: Internal business identifier for the pharmacy location used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: pharmacy_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the pharmacy location in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: pharmacy_type
attributes.description: Classification of pharmacy service model and capabilities offered at this location.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the pharmacy location. Used for patient inquiries, prescription transfers, and prescriber communication.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or postal code for the pharmacy location. Used for geographic analysis, network adequacy reporting, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: state_board_license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the state pharmacy license. Renewal frequency varies by state. Critical for operational compliance and inspection readiness.

attributes.name: state_board_license_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Board of Pharmacy License Number
attributes.description: State-issued pharmacy license number required to operate and dispense prescriptions. Format varies by state jurisdiction.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the pharmacy is located. Determines applicable state board jurisdiction and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. True if 24-hour operation, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy location record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.description: Date when the patient or prescriber was enrolled in the REMS program.

attributes.name: enrollment_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the REMS enrollment expires and must be renewed to continue dispensing authorization.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the REMS enrollment was initiated (pharmacy, prescriber, patient, or transfer from another pharmacy).

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the REMS enrollment. Active indicates compliant and authorized to dispense; inactive, suspended, or expired indicates non-compliance or lapsed enrollment.

attributes.name: last_compliance_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance verification or monitoring activity (e.g., pregnancy test, lab result, clinical assessment).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the REMS enrollment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_compliance_check_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next required compliance check or monitoring activity is due.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the REMS enrollment, compliance issues, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: patient_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date when the patient signed the REMS acknowledgment and informed consent form.

attributes.name: patient_acknowledgment_signed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has signed the required REMS acknowledgment and informed consent form.

attributes.name: patient_education_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the patient has completed required REMS education and counseling about medication risks and safe use.

attributes.name: patient_education_date
attributes.description: Date when the patient completed required REMS education and counseling.

attributes.name: prescriber_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the prescriber completed REMS certification training.

attributes.name: prescriber_certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the prescriber REMS certification expires and must be renewed.

attributes.name: prescriber_certification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prescriber has completed required REMS training and certification to prescribe the high-risk medication.

attributes.name: prescriber_npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier of the prescriber enrolled in the REMS program.

attributes.name: program_administrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization or entity that administers the REMS program on behalf of the drug manufacturer.

attributes.name: program_administrator_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the REMS program administrator for enrollment support and compliance inquiries.

attributes.name: program_administrator_website
attributes.description: Website URL for the REMS program administrator where enrollment forms, training materials, and compliance resources are available.

attributes.name: rems_coordinator_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Coordinator Name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmacy staff member or REMS coordinator responsible for managing this enrollment.

attributes.name: rems_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program Code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the REMS program assigned by FDA or program administrator.

attributes.name: rems_program_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program Name
attributes.description: Official name of the FDA-mandated REMS program (e.g., iPLEDGE for isotretinoin, Clozapine REMS, TIRF REMS Access for fentanyl products).

attributes.name: required_monitoring_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required patient monitoring activities (e.g., lab tests, pregnancy tests, clinical assessments) as mandated by the REMS program.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary risk category that necessitates REMS enrollment (e.g., teratogenic risk, addiction potential, serious adverse events, restricted distribution).

attributes.name: transfer_source_pharmacy_ncpdp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transfer Source Pharmacy National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Number
attributes.description: Seven-digit NCPDP number of the pharmacy from which the REMS enrollment was transferred, if applicable.

products.name: pharmacy_supplier_contract
products.description: This association represents the contractual relationship between a pharmacy location and a supplier. Each record stores the lead time and status specific to that pharmacy‑supplier pairing, enabling the business to manage and query supply agreements.. Existence Justification: Each pharmacy location can enter into contracts with multiple suppliers, and each supplier can serve many pharmacy locations. The contract captures operational details such as lead time and contract status, and it is actively created, updated, and terminated by business users. This relationship is therefore a true many‑to‑many business entity.

attributes.name: pharmacy_supplier_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Supplier Contract - Pharmacy Supplier Contract Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the pharmacy_supplier_contract association

attributes.name: pharmacy_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pharmacy Supplier Contract - Pharmacy Location Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the pharmacy location

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current status of the contract (e.g., Active, Pending, Expired)

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Agreed delivery lead time for this pharmacy‑supplier contract

products.name: payer

attributes.name: payer_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payer

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the payer's mailing address, if applicable.

attributes.name: cap_amount

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: claim_submission_method

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for payer communications.

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the contractual agreement with the payer.

attributes.name: country
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO country code of the payer's primary location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payer record was first created.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code used for reimbursements.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free‑form description or notes about the payer.

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the payer relationship ends or is scheduled to terminate; null if open‑ended.

attributes.name: external_payer_code
