attributes.name: is_excluded_from_reporting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payer is excluded from regulatory reporting aggregates.

attributes.name: is_preferred
attributes.description: Indicates if this payer is designated as a preferred network for contracts.

attributes.name: last_claim_submission_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent claim submitted to this payer.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name as registered with regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Legal name of the payer organization.

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the payer's network or group affiliation.

attributes.name: npi_number
attributes.description: NPI assigned to the payer when applicable (e.g., health plan).

attributes.name: payer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payer entity.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms agreed with the payer.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the payer's address.

attributes.name: reimbursement_rate
attributes.description: Standard percentage rate applied to claim amounts for this payer.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the payer.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: State or province component of the payer's address.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payer record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the payer record.

attributes.name: parent_payer_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payer (parent_payer_id)

domains.name: promotion
domains.description: Marketing campaigns, weekly ad circulars, BOGO offers, TPRs, digital coupons, personalized deals, and loyalty reward promotions. Manages promotion planning, calendars, offer eligibility rules, execution, redemption tracking, markdown optimization, and GMROI analysis. Supports slotting fee negotiations and post-promotion performance measurement.

products.name: promo_campaign
products.description: Master record for a promotional marketing campaign. Captures campaign identity, type (weekly ad circular, digital, in-store event, seasonal, vendor-sponsored), planning horizon, budget allocation, sponsoring vendor/CPG partner, campaign objectives (trial, frequency, basket size, loyalty acquisition), target channel (in-store, digital, omnichannel), approval workflow status, and lifecycle state (draft, approved, active, completed, cancelled). Top-level organizing entity for all promotional activity. Source of truth for campaign planning, budget management, and post-promotion performance measurement.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional campaign. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Primary merchandise category targeted by this campaign for assortment focus and performance measurement.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Needed for Promotion Budget vs Actual report; campaigns are budgeted to cost centers to track spend versus allocated budget.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for Promotion Expense GL Mapping report; each campaign must post its costs to a specific GL account for monthly financial close.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Campaign‑pricing zone assignment report used to allocate promotional budgets per pricing zone.

attributes.name: primary_promo_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who provided final approval for the campaign to proceed to execution.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Required: Campaigns must be linked to a compliance program to ensure advertising and health claim regulations are met.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Link campaigns to their planning calendar; child (promo_campaign) gets FK to parent (promo_calendar). No existing reverse link, resolves silo for promo_calendar.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: REQUIRED: Campaign Store‑Cluster Targeting report needs campaign.store_cluster_id to map each promo campaign to the store clusters it targets.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) vendor or supplier sponsoring or co-funding the campaign.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Customer segment the campaign is designed to reach, used for personalized offer eligibility and targeting.

attributes.name: vendor_category_captain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_category_captain. Business justification: Campaign approval authority resides with category captain; linking enables audit of captain approvals.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: ISO week identifier for the weekly ad circular publication associated with this campaign (format: YYYY-Www).

attributes.name: approval_workflow_status
attributes.description: Current state of the campaign in the multi-stage approval process across merchandising, finance, and legal functions.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign received final approval and was authorized for execution.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total allocated budget for the campaign in USD, covering markdowns, vendor funding, and execution costs.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the campaign, used in marketing materials, ad circulars, and system integrations.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotional campaign for internal reference and reporting.

attributes.name: campaign_objective
attributes.description: Primary business goal the campaign is designed to achieve, driving offer design and performance measurement.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotional campaign in the approval and execution workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|completed|cancelled|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional campaign by execution format and channel strategy.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the campaign was cancelled or suspended before completion, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign was cancelled or suspended.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the campaign ends and offers are no longer available for redemption.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the campaign becomes active and offers are available for customer redemption.

attributes.name: expected_incremental_sales
attributes.description: Projected incremental revenue in USD attributed to the campaign, above baseline sales without promotion.

attributes.name: expected_redemption_count
attributes.description: Forecasted number of offer redemptions expected during the campaign period, used for budget planning and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: is_digital_coupon_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the campaign includes digital coupons that customers can clip and redeem via mobile app or online account.

attributes.name: is_loyalty_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether campaign offers are available exclusively to loyalty program members.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the campaign record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: legal_disclaimer
attributes.description: Legal terms, conditions, and disclaimers required for campaign advertising and offer redemption compliance.

attributes.name: planning_start_date
attributes.description: Date when campaign planning and design activities commenced.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the campaign strategy, target audience, key offers, and expected business outcomes.

attributes.name: promotion_mechanics
attributes.description: Description of the offer structure and redemption rules, such as Buy One Get One (BOGO), Temporary Price Reduction (TPR), or multi-buy thresholds.

attributes.name: target_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales and fulfillment channel where the campaign will be executed and offers redeemed.

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment ratio for the campaign, measuring profitability of promotional spend.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_amount
attributes.description: Amount in USD contributed by the vendor partner toward campaign costs, including slotting fees and markdown support.

products.name: promo_offer
products.description: Atomic unit of promotional value delivered to shoppers within a campaign. Captures offer mechanics (BOGO, TPR, percent-off, dollar-off, mix-and-match, bundle, loyalty reward, digital coupon, personalized deal), discount calculation rules, minimum purchase thresholds, maximum redemption limits, offer validity window, eligible channels (in-store, app, web, kiosk), stackability rules, funding source (vendor-funded vs. grocer-funded), activation requirements (auto-apply vs. clip-required), personalization targeting (ML model, rule-based, mass), delivery channel for targeted offers, digital coupon attributes (barcode/QR code, clip status, clip timestamp, coupon code, issuing channel, CPG manufacturer funding), personalization metadata (generation source, targeting rationale, customer/household linkage, deal acceptance/redemption outcome, behavioral signal inputs). Each campaign contains multiple offers targeting different SKUs, customer segments, or channels. Single Source of Truth for ALL promotional offer types including digital coupons, personalized deals, loyalty rewards, and mass offers — no other product in this domain models offer-level promotional value.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional offer. Primary key for the promo_offer product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: REQUIRED: Offer Category Targeting analysis uses promo_offer.category_id to associate each offer with the category it discounts.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel.fuel_grade. Business justification: Defines the specific fuel grade (e.g., diesel) a promo offer applies to, supporting grade‑specific discount pricing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Required: Each offer must reference the specific compliance obligation (e.g., age‑restriction, labeling) it must satisfy.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Offer zone‑specific pricing ensures correct discount application across regional price zones.

attributes.name: primary_promo_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this promotional offer record.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign that contains this offer.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) vendor or supplier funding or co-funding this offer. Null for grocer-funded offers.

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer segment this offer is targeted to. Null for mass offers or individual personalization.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Offer funding and rebate terms are governed by trade agreements; linking enables agreement compliance reporting.

attributes.name: activation_requirement
attributes.description: Action required by the customer to activate the offer. Auto-apply (no action), clip-required (digital coupon clipping), loyalty-required (loyalty program membership), or code-entry (manual coupon code input).

attributes.name: clip_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer must explicitly clip or activate this digital coupon before redemption. True if clipping required, False if auto-applied.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional offer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel used to deliver this offer to targeted customers.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or QR code value for digital coupon redemption at Point of Sale (POS). Null for non-digital-coupon offers.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_format
attributes.description: Barcode format standard used for digital coupon encoding. Null for non-digital-coupon offers.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Method by which the discount value is calculated and applied.

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. Interpretation depends on discount_type (percentage points for percentage, dollar amount for fixed_amount).

attributes.name: eligible_channel
attributes.description: Sales channel where this offer can be redeemed. Supports omnichannel promotion strategy.

attributes.name: exclusion_rules
attributes.description: Business rules defining products, categories, or conditions that are explicitly excluded from this offer.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity responsible for funding the promotional discount. Vendor-funded (trade promotion), grocer-funded (markdown), or co-funded (shared investment).

attributes.name: gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment ratio for this promotional offer. Used for post-promotion performance measurement and optimization.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points awarded to the customer upon redemption of this offer. Null if no points are earned.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_required
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points required to redeem this offer. Null if not a points-based loyalty reward.

attributes.name: manufacturer_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a manufacturer-issued coupon funded by the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) vendor. True for manufacturer coupons, False for retailer coupons.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total dollar discount that can be applied per transaction. Null if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount of qualifying items required to activate the offer. Null if no minimum threshold applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of qualifying items required to activate the offer. Null if no quantity threshold applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional offer record was last modified.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code for the promotional offer. Used for tracking, redemption, and customer communication.

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotional offer including terms, conditions, and value proposition.

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotional offer displayed to customers.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional offer.

attributes.name: offer_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification indicating the delivery and targeting mechanism of the offer.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional offer mechanics. BOGO (Buy One Get One), TPR (Temporary Price Reduction), percent-off, dollar-off, mix-and-match, or bundle.

attributes.name: personalization_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the machine learning model or rule set used to generate this personalized offer. Null for mass offers.

attributes.name: personalization_type
attributes.description: Method used to target and personalize this offer. ML model (machine learning recommendation), rule-based (business rule segmentation), mass (broadcast to all), or segment-targeted (predefined customer segment).

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority used to resolve conflicts when multiple offers apply to the same item. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer or household can redeem this offer during its validity period. Null for unlimited redemptions.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this offer can be applied within a single transaction. Null for unlimited applications per transaction.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers in the same transaction. True if stackable, False if mutually exclusive.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the use and redemption of this promotional offer.
attributes.references: FTC Section 5 Unfair or Deceptive Acts or Practices

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date when the offer becomes active and eligible for redemption.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date when the offer expires and is no longer eligible for redemption.

products.name: promo_calendar
products.description: Promotional planning calendar that organizes all campaigns and offers across time. Tracks weekly ad circular cycles, promotional periods, blackout dates, holiday event windows, and overlap constraints. Supports merchandise planning and assortment management by providing a structured view of promotional cadence across store zones, categories, and channels. Enables conflict detection between simultaneous promotions and coordination with vendor slotting commitments.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional calendar entry. Primary key for the promotional calendar planning entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary product category that this promotional calendar entry focuses on (e.g., Fresh Produce, Dairy, Meat, Bakery). Nullable if promotion spans multiple categories.

attributes.name: planning_owner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Planning Owner report requires linking each promo calendar to the associate responsible for its planning, enabling accountability and schedule tracking.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or zone that this promotional calendar entry applies to. Store clusters group stores by geography, demographics, or performance characteristics for targeted promotional planning. Nullable if promotion applies to all stores.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Calendar budgeting and supplier‑funded promotions need supplier attribution for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: ad_circular_print_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry will be featured in the printed weekly ad circular flyer. True means print ad placement is planned; False means digital-only or in-store signage only.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: The week number within the fiscal year that this promotional calendar entry corresponds to, used for weekly ad circular planning and coordination. Aligns with retail fiscal calendar conventions.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional calendar entry received executive or merchandising leadership approval to proceed. Nullable if still in draft or planning status.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or manager who approved this promotional calendar entry. Used for governance and audit trail purposes. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calendar entry represents a blackout period during which no new promotions should be scheduled. True means this is a blackout period (e.g., inventory count week, system maintenance); False means normal promotional activity is allowed.

attributes.name: calendar_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the promotional calendar in operational systems and reports (e.g., 'Q4-2024-HOL', 'SP-FRESH-01').

attributes.name: calendar_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the promotional calendar period (e.g., 'Q4 Holiday Campaign 2024', 'Spring Fresh Produce Event').

attributes.name: calendar_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotional calendar entry. Draft indicates initial planning; planned means dates are set but not approved; approved indicates executive sign-off; active means promotion is currently running; completed means promotion has ended; cancelled indicates promotion was terminated before completion.

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional calendar entry by its business purpose and funding model. Weekly ad circular represents recurring weekly promotional cycles; seasonal event covers spring, summer, fall, winter campaigns; holiday promotion targets specific holidays; category event focuses on specific product categories; vendor funded indicates supplier-sponsored promotions; markdown clearance represents end-of-season or overstock price reductions.

attributes.name: conflict_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any promotional conflicts detected with other calendar entries (overlapping dates, same category, same store cluster) and how they were resolved. Used for planning coordination and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional calendar entry was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and planning timeline analysis.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry includes digital coupon offers that customers can clip via mobile app or website. True means digital coupons are part of the promotion; False means no digital coupon component.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period ends. This is the last day that promotional pricing and offers are valid. Nullable for open-ended promotions.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: The estimated total budget allocated for this promotional calendar entry, including markdown costs, advertising spend, and vendor co-op funding. Expressed in the retailer's reporting currency (typically USD).

attributes.name: event_theme
attributes.description: The marketing theme or creative concept for the promotional period (e.g., 'Back to School', 'Summer BBQ', 'Holiday Feast', 'Fresh Start January'). Used for merchandising and marketing alignment.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) to which this promotional calendar entry belongs, used for quarterly promotional planning and performance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this promotional calendar entry belongs, following the retailer's fiscal calendar (e.g., 2024, 2025).

attributes.name: loyalty_exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry is exclusive to loyalty program members. True means only loyalty cardholders can access the promotional pricing; False means promotion is available to all customers.

attributes.name: merchandising_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from merchandising team regarding assortment planning, display requirements, inventory positioning, or special handling instructions for this promotional calendar entry.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this promotional calendar entry. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotional calendar entry was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: overlap_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry can overlap with other promotions in the same category or store cluster. True allows concurrent promotions; False enforces exclusivity to prevent promotional conflicts and margin erosion.

attributes.name: slotting_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry is tied to a contractual slotting fee commitment with a vendor. True means vendor has paid for guaranteed promotional placement during this period; False means no slotting commitment exists.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional period begins. This is the first day that promotional pricing, offers, or ad circular content becomes effective in stores and digital channels.

attributes.name: target_channel
attributes.description: The primary sales channel where this promotional calendar entry will be executed. In-store represents physical retail locations; online represents eCommerce website; mobile app represents mobile application; omnichannel indicates promotion spans all channels.

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: The target Gross Margin Return on Investment ratio for this promotional calendar entry. GMROI measures the profitability of inventory investment and is a key performance metric for promotional effectiveness in retail. Calculated as gross margin dollars divided by average inventory cost.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional calendar entry includes vendor-funded promotional support (slotting fees, co-op advertising, markdown allowances). True means vendor is contributing funding; False means retailer-funded only.

products.name: ad_circular
products.description: Weekly or periodic printed and digital advertising circular that communicates promotional offers to shoppers. Captures circular edition number, effective date range, distribution zone, page count, item placements with page/position coordinates, endcap and gondola feature assignments, digital vs. print format flags, circulation reach, production deadline, and proof approval status. Links to specific offers featured in each circular. Core artifact for weekly promotional execution in retail-grocery — the primary vehicle for communicating TPRs and BOGO offers to price-sensitive shoppers.

attributes.name: ad_circular_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad circular. Primary key.

attributes.name: designer_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Design accountability report tracks which associate designed each ad circular, linking circular to designer associate for performance metrics.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Associate each ad circular with its planning calendar; child (ad_circular) gets FK to parent (promo_calendar). Removes redundant week number column.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Ad circular funding source tracking for supplier‑funded circulars required for marketing spend reporting.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Enables linking each ad circular to the targeted customer segment for segment performance reporting and media spend allocation.

attributes.name: bogo_offers_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Buy One Get One (BOGO) Offers Count
attributes.description: Number of Buy One Get One (BOGO) promotional offers included in this circular.

attributes.name: circular_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the circular (e.g., 'Spring Savings Event', 'Weekly Deals March 15-21').

attributes.name: circular_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the circular edition, typically a sequential number or code used for tracking and reference (e.g., 'WK2401', 'C-2024-15').

attributes.name: circular_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the circular from planning through execution to expiration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_production|published|active|expired|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: circular_type
attributes.description: Classification of the circular based on frequency and purpose (weekly standard circular, seasonal promotion, holiday special, etc.).

attributes.name: cover_page_headline
attributes.description: Primary headline or promotional message displayed on the cover page of the circular.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad circular record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this circular includes digital coupon offers that customers can clip and redeem online or via mobile app.

attributes.name: digital_platform
attributes.description: Digital platform or technology used to publish and distribute the online version of the circular (e.g., 'Salesforce Commerce Cloud', 'Mobile App', 'Email Campaign').

attributes.name: digital_reach_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique digital viewers or impressions for the online version of the circular.

attributes.name: distribution_zone
attributes.description: Geographic zone or market area where this circular is distributed (e.g., 'Northeast Region', 'Metro Atlanta', 'Zone 5').

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular expires and promotional offers are no longer valid.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular becomes active and promotional offers are valid for customer redemption.

attributes.name: endcap_feature_count
attributes.description: Number of endcap (end-of-aisle display) features promoted in this circular.

attributes.name: estimated_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated marketing and production budget allocated for this circular in USD, including print costs, digital advertising, and promotional funding.

attributes.name: estimated_gmroi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Target
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) ratio for this circular, representing expected gross margin dollars returned per dollar of inventory investment.

attributes.name: featured_category
attributes.description: Primary product category or department featured prominently in this circular (e.g., 'Fresh Produce', 'Meat & Seafood', 'Private Label').

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Distribution format of the circular indicating whether it is available in print, digital, or both channels.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Primary language of the circular content using 3-letter ISO 639-2 language codes (ENG=English, SPA=Spanish, FRA=French, CHI=Chinese).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ad circular record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: loyalty_exclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this circular contains offers exclusive to loyalty program members.

attributes.name: merchandiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the merchandising manager or team responsible for selecting offers and planning the circular content.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this circular edition.

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the printed or digital circular.

attributes.name: print_circulation_quantity
attributes.description: Number of physical copies printed and distributed for this circular edition.

attributes.name: print_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external printing vendor or service provider used for physical circular production.

attributes.name: production_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final deadline for completing circular production and sending to print or digital publishing.

attributes.name: proof_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the final proof of the circular was approved by merchandising and marketing teams.

attributes.name: proof_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the circular proof during the review and approval workflow.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the circular was published and made available to customers (print distribution or digital release).

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary customer segment or demographic group targeted by this circular (e.g., 'Value Shoppers', 'Organic Enthusiasts', 'Family Households').

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Marketing theme or campaign message for the circular (e.g., 'Back to School', 'Summer BBQ', 'Holiday Feast').

attributes.name: total_offers_count
attributes.description: Total number of promotional offers and SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) featured in this circular.

attributes.name: tpr_offers_count
attributes.description: Number of Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) offers included in this circular.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether promotional offers in this circular are partially or fully funded by vendor slotting fees or trade allowances.

products.name: offer_item
products.description: Association entity linking promotional offers to specific sellable items (SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, PLU codes) eligible for the promotion. Captures included and excluded items, required purchase quantities, qualifying item roles (buy item vs. get item in BOGO, trigger item vs. reward item in mix-and-match), item-level discount overrides, and planogram placement context. Enables precise eligibility determination at POS, self-checkout, and digital checkout. Supports complex multi-item promotions where different items play different mechanical roles.

attributes.name: offer_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the offer item association record.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this offer item association. Supports audit trail and SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) compliance for promotional pricing controls.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this offer item association. Supports audit trail and change tracking for promotional pricing.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: REQUIRED: Offer Placement Planning process links each offer_item to a specific planogram for shelf‑space allocation.

attributes.name: primary_offer_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sellable item (product, SKU) that is eligible for this promotional offer.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent promotional offer that this item is associated with.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or group where this promotional item is active. Enables localized promotions tailored to regional preferences and competitive dynamics.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier, manufacturer) funding or co-funding this promotional item. Used for vendor-funded promotion tracking and chargeback processing.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: Offer items must reference the exact vendor SKU to manage funding, cost, and inventory; required for vendor item performance tracking.

attributes.name: ad_circular_featured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is featured in the weekly promotional flyer (ad circular). True if the item appears in print or digital advertising materials.

attributes.name: age_restriction_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether age verification is required at POS for this promotional item (alcohol, tobacco, restricted medications). Ensures compliance with state and federal age-restricted product regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations 21 CFR 1140; State Alcohol Control Laws

attributes.name: channel_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies which sales channels this promotional item is valid for. Supports omnichannel promotion strategy with channel-specific offers for POS, eCommerce, mobile app, curbside pickup, and delivery.

attributes.name: cost_override_amount
attributes.description: Special cost basis for this item during the promotion period, typically negotiated with vendors for promotional pricing. Used for accurate GMROI and margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offer item association record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and promotion planning analysis.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is eligible for digital coupon stacking on top of the base promotional offer. Enables omnichannel personalized deal combinations.

attributes.name: discount_override_amount
attributes.description: Item-specific discount amount that overrides the offer-level discount for this particular SKU. Enables variable discounts within a single promotional campaign.

attributes.name: discount_override_percentage
attributes.description: Item-specific discount percentage that overrides the offer-level discount rate for this SKU. Allows differentiated markdown rates within the same promotion.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this item is no longer eligible for the promotional offer. Used for promotion calendar management and automatic expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this item becomes eligible for the promotional offer. Supports phased rollout and time-limited flash promotions.

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Number of product fronts on shelf required for this promotional item. Ensures adequate visibility and stock availability during the promotion period.

attributes.name: inclusion_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether this item is included in the promotion, explicitly excluded, required for eligibility, or optional within a multi-item offer.

attributes.name: item_identifier_type
attributes.description: Type of item identifier used for promotion eligibility determination. SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for internal codes, UPC (Universal Product Code) for standard barcodes, GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) for GS1 standards, PLU (Price Look-Up Code) for produce, EAN for European Article Numbers, ISBN for books.

attributes.name: item_identifier_value
attributes.description: The actual identifier value (SKU code, UPC barcode, GTIN number, PLU code) used to match this item to the promotion at POS and digital checkout.

attributes.name: item_role
attributes.description: Mechanical role this item plays in the promotion structure. Buy item vs get item in BOGO (Buy One Get One) offers, trigger item vs reward item in mix-and-match promotions, qualifying item for threshold-based offers, or bundle component in multi-item packages.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to loyalty reward points earned on this item during the promotion. For example, 2.0 means double points, 3.0 means triple points.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of this item eligible for the promotional discount within a single transaction. Used to cap BOGO offers and prevent abuse.

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required to purchase this promotional item. Typically 18 for tobacco, 21 for alcohol in most US states.
attributes.references: FDA Tobacco Regulations 21 CFR 1140; State Alcohol Control Laws

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this offer item association record was last modified. Tracks changes to promotion eligibility, discount overrides, and item roles.

attributes.name: offer_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this offer item association. Active means the item is currently eligible for the promotion, pending means scheduled for future activation, expired means the effective period has ended, suspended means temporarily disabled, cancelled means permanently removed from the offer.

attributes.name: planogram_placement_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the visual merchandise display plan location where this promotional item should be placed (endcap, gondola, front-of-store, checkout lane). Supports execution of promotional planograms.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Ranking used to determine which promotion applies when an item qualifies for multiple overlapping offers. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for required and maximum quantities. Each for discrete items, weight units for produce and bulk goods, volume units for liquids, case or pack for wholesale quantities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|case|pack — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum purchase quantity of this item required to qualify for the promotional offer. Supports fractional quantities for weight-based items (e.g., 2.5 lbs of produce).

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional item is eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits (EBT - Electronic Benefits Transfer). Required for compliance with USDA SNAP regulations.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this offer item association (Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP SD Sales and Distribution, proprietary promotion engine). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether item substitution is permitted if the promoted item is out of stock (OOS). Relevant for online order fulfillment and click-and-collect services.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotional discount for this item is funded by the vendor (manufacturer) rather than the retailer. Used for slotting fee negotiations and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: WIC (Women Infants and Children Program) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional item is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for compliance with USDA WIC program regulations.

products.name: offer_eligibility_rule
products.description: Business rules governing customer eligibility for promotional offers. Captures rule type (loyalty member only, new customer, geographic zone, household segment, purchase history threshold, SNAP/EBT eligible, WIC eligible), rule logic expressions, customer segment targeting criteria, minimum loyalty tier requirements, and exclusion conditions. Supports personalized deal targeting and compliance with program-specific restrictions such as WIC and SNAP regulations.

attributes.name: offer_eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the offer eligibility rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_offer_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created the eligibility rule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_offer_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer segment that this rule targets. Used for household segmentation and personalized deal targeting.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional offer that this eligibility rule governs.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or group where the offer is valid. Used to target specific store formats, market types, or performance tiers.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Eligibility rules reference loyalty tier thresholds; FK enables tier‑based rule enforcement and reporting.

attributes.name: channel_restriction
attributes.description: Sales channel or fulfillment method where the offer is valid. Restricts eligibility to specific shopping channels such as in-store, online, mobile app, curbside pickup, or delivery.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing regulatory compliance considerations, legal restrictions, or program-specific requirements (e.g., SNAP, WIC, age verification) associated with the rule.
attributes.references: FTC Fair Trade Practices; SNAP/WIC Program Regulations; FDA Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility rule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the eligibility rule expires and is no longer enforced. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the eligibility rule becomes active and begins to be enforced for offer qualification.

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the eligibility rule is evaluated or refreshed. Determines whether qualification is checked in real-time at transaction, on a batch schedule, or on-demand.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Business rationale or explanation for why certain customers or segments are excluded from the offer. Provides transparency for compliance and customer service purposes.

attributes.name: geographic_zone_code
attributes.description: Code representing the geographic zone, region, or market where the offer is valid. Used to restrict offers to specific trading areas, ZIP codes, or store clusters.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eligibility rule record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: maximum_age_years
attributes.description: Maximum age in years for customer eligibility. Used for youth-targeted promotions or senior discount programs with upper age limits.

attributes.name: minimum_age_years
attributes.description: Minimum age in years required for a customer to qualify for the offer. Used for age-restricted products such as alcohol, tobacco, or pharmacy items.
attributes.references: FDA Age Verification Requirements; State Alcohol and Tobacco Laws

attributes.name: minimum_loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The minimum loyalty program tier or level required for a customer to qualify for the offer. Examples include Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, or program-specific tier names.

attributes.name: new_customer_definition_days
attributes.description: Number of days since first transaction or account creation that defines a customer as 'new' for eligibility purposes. Typically ranges from 30 to 90 days.

attributes.name: new_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer is restricted to new customers only. Used for customer acquisition campaigns and first-time shopper incentives.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple eligibility rules apply to the same offer. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: purchase_history_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum cumulative purchase amount required in the customer's transaction history to qualify for the offer. Used for spend-based eligibility rules.

attributes.name: purchase_history_threshold_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the lookback period for evaluating purchase history thresholds. Defines the time window over which customer spending or transaction counts are assessed.

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the eligibility rule, including business context, intended audience, and any special conditions or exceptions.

attributes.name: rule_logic_expression
attributes.description: Structured expression or formula defining the eligibility logic. May contain conditional operators, attribute references, and threshold values that are evaluated to determine customer qualification.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the eligibility rule, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the eligibility rule. Indicates whether the rule is actively enforced, temporarily suspended, in draft state, or expired.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Category of eligibility rule that determines the nature of the restriction or qualification. Defines whether the rule is based on loyalty membership, customer newness, geography, household segmentation, purchase history, government assistance program eligibility (SNAP/EBT, WIC), loyalty tier, age, or sales channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: loyalty_member_only|new_customer|geographic_zone|household_segment|purchase_history_threshold|snap_ebt_eligible|wic_eligible|minimum_loyalty_tier|age_restriction|channel_restriction — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Fair Trade Practices; SNAP/WIC Program Regulations

attributes.name: rule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the eligibility rule. Incremented with each modification to support rule history tracking and rollback capabilities.

attributes.name: snap_ebt_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer is available to customers using SNAP or EBT payment methods. Ensures compliance with federal nutrition assistance program regulations.
attributes.references: USDA SNAP Regulations; EBT Program Guidelines

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer is available to customers using WIC benefits. Ensures compliance with WIC program restrictions and approved product lists.

products.name: digital_coupon
products.description: Digital coupon issued through the grocer's mobile app, website, or loyalty platform. Captures coupon code, barcode/QR code, face value, discount type, issuing channel (app clip, email, web), clip status, clip timestamp, expiration date, maximum redemption count, CPG manufacturer funding flag, and personalization source (targeted vs. mass). Distinct from paper coupons and in-store TPRs — digital coupons require explicit customer clip/activation before redemption.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the digital coupon. Primary key for the digital coupon entity.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category to which this digital coupon applies. Used for category-level coupon offers rather than Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)-specific offers.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broader marketing or promotional campaign to which this digital coupon belongs. Links coupon to campaign planning and performance measurement.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Required: Digital coupons often need a regulatory filing record for advertising disclosures and audit trails.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer segment targeted by this personalized digital coupon offer. Null for mass-distribution coupons.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.shopper. Business justification: Required for tracking which shopper clips each digital coupon, used in loyalty analytics and regulatory reporting of coupon usage.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) manufacturer or vendor funding the coupon offer. Null if retailer-funded.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: GS1-compliant barcode number for Point of Sale (POS) scanning. Typically UPC (Universal Product Code) or EAN format for digital coupon redemption.

attributes.name: clip_status
attributes.description: Current activation and usage status of the digital coupon: available for clipping, clipped by customer, redeemed at Point of Sale (POS), or expired without redemption.

attributes.name: clip_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer activated or clipped the digital coupon to their loyalty account. Null if coupon has not been clipped.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the digital coupon offer. Used for tracking and redemption validation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the digital coupon record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and coupon lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_redemption_count
attributes.description: Current cumulative number of times this digital coupon has been redeemed across all customers. Used to enforce total redemption limits.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the digital coupon offer including terms, conditions, eligible products, and redemption instructions.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount mechanism applied by the coupon: percentage off, dollar amount off, Buy One Get One (BOGO), fixed price, or free item.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the digital coupon becomes valid and available for customer clipping and redemption.

attributes.name: eligible_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) identifiers eligible for this digital coupon offer. Null if coupon applies to entire category or store-wide.

attributes.name: eligible_store_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store identifiers where this digital coupon can be redeemed. Null if coupon is valid at all locations or online only.

attributes.name: excluded_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) identifiers explicitly excluded from this digital coupon offer despite category or store-wide eligibility.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the digital coupon expires and can no longer be clipped or redeemed. After this date, the coupon is invalid.

attributes.name: face_value
attributes.description: Monetary value or percentage discount amount displayed on the coupon. For percentage discounts, represents the percentage; for dollar discounts, represents the dollar amount.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) of the promotional image or graphic associated with the digital coupon for display in mobile app, website, and email.

attributes.name: issuing_channel
attributes.description: Digital channel through which the coupon was originally issued or made available to customers: mobile app, website, email campaign, SMS, loyalty portal, or social media.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the digital coupon record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases made using this digital coupon are still eligible for loyalty program points accrual. True if points can be earned, false if coupon disqualifies points.

attributes.name: manufacturer_funded_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) Manufacturer Funded Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the coupon discount is funded by a Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) manufacturer or vendor rather than by the retailer. True if manufacturer-funded, false if retailer-funded.

attributes.name: maximum_discount_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be discounted when redeeming this coupon. Applies primarily to percentage-based offers to cap total discount.

attributes.name: maximum_redemption_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this digital coupon during the offer period. Null indicates unlimited redemptions per customer.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction subtotal required to qualify for coupon redemption. Null if no minimum purchase requirement exists.

attributes.name: personalization_source
attributes.description: Method by which the coupon was personalized or targeted: mass distribution to all customers, targeted based on segment, behavioral analysis, demographic profile, or predictive Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) modeling.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Display priority ranking for the digital coupon when multiple offers are available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for customer presentation.

attributes.name: qr_code
attributes.description: Quick Response code data payload for mobile app or self-checkout scanning. Encodes coupon identifier and validation data.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this digital coupon can be combined or stacked with other coupons, promotions, or Temporary Price Reductions (TPR) in a single transaction. True if stackable, false if exclusive.

attributes.name: store_eligibility_type
attributes.description: Defines which store locations or channels are eligible for coupon redemption: all stores, specific store list, store cluster, online orders only, or in-store purchases only.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the use, redemption, and restrictions of the digital coupon. Required for regulatory compliance and customer transparency.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Customer-facing title or headline of the digital coupon offer displayed in mobile app, website, and loyalty platform.

attributes.name: total_redemption_limit
attributes.description: Total number of redemptions allowed across all customers before the coupon offer is exhausted. Null indicates no aggregate limit.

products.name: promotion_redemption
products.description: Transactional record of a promotional offer being redeemed at POS, self-checkout, or digital checkout. Captures redemption timestamp, transaction/order reference, store or fulfillment channel, offer redeemed (including digital coupon clips and personalized deal acceptances), discount amount applied, customer loyalty account, payment method used (including EBT/SNAP/WIC), item-level redemption detail, and redemption validation status (approved, rejected, partially applied). Core transactional entity for post-promotion performance measurement, vendor funding reconciliation, and coupon clearing house settlement.

attributes.name: promotion_redemption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion redemption transaction. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cashier or associate who processed the transaction at POS. Null for self-checkout and digital channels.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.membership. Business justification: Needed for Redemption‑Member reporting linking each redemption to the member for ROI and engagement analysis.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Point of Sale (POS) transaction or order in which this promotion was redeemed.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the omnichannel order (delivery or pickup) if redemption occurred in digital checkout. Null for in-store POS transactions.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional offer that was redeemed. Links to the promotion master entity.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.shift. Business justification: Shift‑level sales analysis requires linking each redemption to the shift during which it occurred, enabling labor productivity reporting.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who redeemed the promotion. Links to loyalty account or shopper profile.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: REQUIRED: Redemption by Store‑Cluster performance report needs promotion_redemption.store_cluster_id to aggregate redemptions at the cluster level.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical store location where the redemption occurred. Null for pure digital fulfillment.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who funded or co-funded the promotion. Used for vendor funding reconciliation and slotting fee settlement.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: Week identifier for the weekly ad circular in which this promotion was featured. Format: YYYY-WW. Used for ad circular performance measurement.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the promotion was redeemed: POS (Point of Sale), self-checkout kiosk, online web storefront, mobile app, curbside pickup, or in-store pickup.

attributes.name: clearing_house_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the coupon redemption was submitted to the clearing house for vendor reimbursement. Null if not yet submitted.

attributes.name: clearing_house_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this manufacturer coupon redemption has been submitted to the coupon clearing house for reimbursement. True if submitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: coupon_code
attributes.description: Unique coupon code or barcode scanned at redemption. Used for digital coupon clips, manufacturer coupons, and personalized deal codes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount amount (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: digital_coupon_clip_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer clipped or activated the digital coupon in the mobile app or website. Null for non-digital offers.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of discount applied to the transaction as a result of this promotion redemption. Expressed in local currency.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied if the promotion was percentage-based (e.g., 20% off). Null for fixed-amount discounts.

attributes.name: ebt_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the redeemed item was eligible for EBT/SNAP/WIC payment. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: Final unit price after the promotional discount was applied. Used for net revenue and margin calculation.

attributes.name: item_quantity

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: loyalty_account_number

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed

attributes.name: original_price

attributes.name: personalized_deal_flag

attributes.name: promotion_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the promotional offer period. Used to validate redemption timing and identify expired offer redemption attempts.

attributes.name: promotion_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the promotional offer period. Used to validate redemption timing and measure promotion lifecycle performance.

attributes.name: redemption_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the redemption event. Used for daily aggregation and ad circular performance reporting.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp

attributes.name: register_number

attributes.name: reimbursement_status

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: retailer_funded_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the discount amount funded by the retailer. Used for internal cost allocation and GMROI analysis.

attributes.name: sku

attributes.name: upc

attributes.name: validation_status

attributes.name: vendor_funded_amount

products.name: tpr_event
products.description: Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) event record capturing a time-bound price reduction applied to specific SKUs at store or zone level. Tracks TPR start and end dates, original SRP, TPR price, discount depth percentage, store zone applicability, category, vendor funding flag, and whether the TPR is featured in the ad circular or endcap display. Distinct from digital coupons and loyalty offers — TPRs are shelf-level price changes applied automatically at POS without customer action.

attributes.name: tpr_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the TPR event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category for reporting and analysis of TPR performance by category.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Required: Temporary price‑reduction events must be tied to compliance obligations governing price advertising.

attributes.name: primary_tpr_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this TPR event. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent promotional campaign that this TPR event is part of, if applicable. Null for standalone TPRs.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that is subject to this temporary price reduction.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number Standards

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific store where this TPR is applied. Null if TPR applies to a zone or all stores.

attributes.name: store_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store zone (geographic or cluster grouping) where this TPR applies. Used when TPR is applied at zone level rather than individual store.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/supplier associated with this SKU, used for tracking vendor-funded TPRs and slotting fee negotiations.

attributes.name: tertiary_tpr_created_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this TPR event record in the system.

attributes.name: ad_circular_week
attributes.description: The ad circular week identifier (format YYYY-Wnn) when this TPR is featured in the promotional flyer. Null if not featured in ad circular.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TPR requires management approval before activation, typically based on discount depth thresholds or margin impact.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this TPR event was approved for execution. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why this TPR event was cancelled before completion. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this TPR event was cancelled. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this TPR event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this TPR event record.

attributes.name: discount_depth_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount from original SRP, calculated as ((original_srp_amount - tpr_price_amount) / original_srp_amount) * 100. Key metric for TPR performance analysis.

attributes.name: display_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific in-store display location for this TPR (e.g., endcap number, gondola aisle, front-end display). Null if standard shelf location.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the temporary price reduction ends and pricing reverts to standard SRP. Inclusive end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the temporary price reduction becomes active at point of sale. TPR pricing is applied automatically at POS starting this date.

attributes.name: expected_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted total revenue expected from this TPR event, calculated as expected_unit_sales * tpr_price_amount.

attributes.name: expected_unit_sales
attributes.description: Forecasted number of units expected to sell during the TPR period, used for inventory planning and performance measurement.

attributes.name: is_ad_circular_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TPR is featured in the weekly ad circular promotional flyer. True = featured in ad; False = in-store only TPR.

attributes.name: is_endcap_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TPR SKU is featured on an endcap (end-of-aisle display) for increased visibility. True = endcap placement; False = standard shelf location.

attributes.name: is_vendor_funded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor/supplier is providing funding or allowances to support this TPR. True = vendor-funded; False = retailer-funded markdown.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this TPR event record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: markdown_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code for the temporary price reduction. Seasonal = seasonal promotion; Clearance = inventory clearance; Competitive = competitive response; Vendor_funded = vendor trade spend; Category_driver = traffic driver; New_item_intro = new product launch support; Overstock = excess inventory liquidation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seasonal|clearance|competitive|vendor_funded|category_driver|new_item_intro|overstock — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units per transaction eligible for TPR pricing, used to limit exposure on deep discounts. Null if no limit.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units customer must purchase to receive the TPR price. Typically 1 for standard TPRs; may be higher for multi-buy offers. Null if no minimum.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, instructions, or context about this TPR event. Used for internal communication and documentation.

attributes.name: original_srp_amount
attributes.description: The standard suggested retail price of the SKU before the temporary price reduction is applied. Used as baseline for discount depth calculation.

attributes.name: pos_activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the TPR price was successfully activated in POS systems and began applying at checkout.

attributes.name: pos_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of TPR price transmission to POS systems. Pending = awaiting transmission; Transmitted = sent to POS; Active = confirmed active at POS; Failed = transmission error; Reverted = price reverted to SRP.

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: Target GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) ratio for this TPR event, used to evaluate promotional profitability. Calculated as gross_margin / average_inventory_cost.

attributes.name: tpr_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the TPR event, used for external reference and reporting. Typically follows format TPR-XXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: tpr_price_amount
attributes.description: The reduced price at which the SKU is sold during the TPR period. This is the shelf price automatically applied at POS without customer action.

attributes.name: tpr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the TPR event. Planned = scheduled but not yet approved; Approved = ready for execution; Active = currently in effect at POS; Completed = ended normally; Cancelled = terminated before completion; Suspended = temporarily paused.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of vendor funding or allowances provided to support this TPR. Null if not vendor-funded.

products.name: vendor_funding

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dispute_reason

products.name: funding_claim
products.description: Transactional claim submitted to a vendor for reimbursement of promotional funding. Captures claim reference number, vendor identifier, funding agreement reference, claim period, claimed units sold, claimed discount amount, supporting redemption evidence, submission date, vendor acknowledgment status, and payment received date. Supports EDI-based vendor claim processing and accounts receivable reconciliation for promotional funding.

attributes.name: funding_claim_id

attributes.name: primary_funding_associate_id

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign for which vendor funding reimbursement is being claimed. Links claim to specific marketing initiative.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor (supplier or manufacturer) from whom promotional funding reimbursement is being claimed. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional funding agreement or contract that authorizes this reimbursement claim. Defines terms, rates, and eligible promotional activities.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar difference between claimed funding amount and approved funding amount. Positive values indicate vendor reductions; negative values indicate vendor increases.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: approved_funding_amount

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp

attributes.name: claim_period_end_date

attributes.name: claim_period_start_date

attributes.name: claim_reference_number

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the funding claim in the vendor reimbursement workflow. Tracks progression from draft through payment or rejection.
