attributes.description: Priority ranking of this personalized deal relative to other deals for the same customer. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for display and redemption sequencing.

attributes.name: redeemed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this personalized deal was redeemed at point of sale or online checkout. Null if not yet redeemed.

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times this personalized deal has been redeemed by the customer or household to date. Incremented at each redemption.

attributes.name: redemption_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this personalized deal can be redeemed by the targeted customer or household. Null if unlimited.

attributes.name: targeting_rationale
attributes.description: Business reason or logic for why this deal was targeted to this customer or household. May include segment, purchase history pattern, or behavioral signal summary.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the validity window for this personalized deal. Customer can redeem the deal on or after this date.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: End date of the validity window for this personalized deal. Customer must redeem the deal on or before this date.

attributes.name: viewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer first viewed this personalized deal in the app, email, or kiosk. Null if not yet viewed.

products.name: promo_zone
products.description: Geographic or store-cluster zone definition used to scope promotional pricing and offer applicability. Captures zone name, zone type (pricing zone, ad zone, distribution zone), store membership, geographic region, competitive market classification, and zone manager. Enables zone-level TPR and SRP management, ensuring promotions are applied consistently across stores within the same competitive market cluster.

attributes.name: promo_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional zone. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this promotional zone definition. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this promotional zone record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary distribution center that services stores in this promotional zone. Used for coordinating promotional inventory allocation and DSD planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this promotional zone record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: parent_zone_promo_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent promotional zone if this zone is part of a hierarchical zone structure (e.g., sub-zones within a regional zone). Null for top-level zones.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Align promotional zones with pricing zones for consistent regional pricing strategy.

attributes.name: zone_manager_associate_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.associate

attributes.name: ad_circular_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether printed ad circulars are distributed to stores in this zone. True if ad circulars are distributed; false if zone is digital-only or does not receive circulars.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this promotional zone definition. Draft zones are being configured; pending zones await merchandising approval; approved zones are active; rejected zones require revision.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional zone was approved for use in promotion planning. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: average_household_income
attributes.description: Average household income in the geographic area covered by this promotional zone, in USD. Used for demographic-based promotion targeting and price sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau - American Community Survey

attributes.name: competitive_market_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the competitive intensity and market maturity within this promotional zone. Used to tailor promotional strategies and pricing aggressiveness to local market conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional zone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: digital_coupon_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether digital coupons are enabled for stores in this promotional zone. True if digital coupons are available; false otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional zone definition expires or expired. Null for open-ended zones.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional zone definition became or will become active for promotion planning and pricing.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this promotional zone definition was created or last revised. Used for year-over-year zone performance analysis.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area that this promotional zone covers (e.g., 'Pacific Northwest', 'Mid-Atlantic', 'Gulf Coast'). Used for regional promotion planning and competitive analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotional zone record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty program promotions and personalized offers are enabled for stores in this zone. True if loyalty features are active; false otherwise.

attributes.name: markdown_strategy
attributes.description: Markdown and clearance pricing strategy for this zone. Aggressive zones markdown faster to clear inventory; conservative zones preserve margin and markdown more slowly.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes for merchandising and pricing teams regarding this promotional zone, including historical performance insights, competitive intelligence, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: population_density
attributes.description: Population density classification of the geographic area covered by this zone. Urban zones have high density and different promotional needs than rural zones.

attributes.name: price_zone_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for this zone, reflecting the overall price positioning strategy. Premium zones have higher SRP; value/discount zones have lower SRP to match local market conditions and competitive pressure.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management - Price Zone Tier

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: Primary language spoken in this promotional zone, using ISO 639-3 three-letter language codes (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish). Used for ad circular and digital coupon localization.

attributes.name: promo_zone_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotional zone, including its purpose, geographic boundaries, store membership criteria, and any special considerations for promotion planning.

attributes.name: snap_ebt_participation_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) / Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Participation Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of transactions in this zone that use SNAP/EBT payment methods. Used to tailor promotional strategies to customer demographics and ensure compliance with SNAP-eligible product promotions.

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of stores currently assigned to this promotional zone. Used for zone sizing and promotion budget allocation.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for this promotional zone (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for coordinating promotion start/end times and ad circular release timing.

attributes.name: tpr_frequency_target
attributes.description: Target frequency of TPR promotions for this zone. High-frequency zones run more frequent promotions; low-frequency zones focus on EDLP (Every Day Low Price) strategies.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone is eligible for vendor-funded promotional programs and slotting fee negotiations. True if vendor funding is allowed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the promotional zone, used in operational systems and reporting. Typically alphanumeric, 3-10 characters.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Price Management - Zone Code

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the promotional zone (e.g., 'Northeast Metro', 'Southern Rural', 'West Coast Urban').

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional zone. Active zones are in use for promotion planning and execution; inactive zones are no longer used; pending zones are awaiting approval; suspended zones are temporarily disabled; archived zones are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional zone by its primary business purpose: pricing zone (SRP/TPR management), ad zone (circular distribution), distribution zone (DC coverage), competitive market zone (market-based pricing), fulfillment zone (delivery/pickup), or regional zone (geographic grouping).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Zone Type

products.name: promo_performance
products.description: Post-promotion performance measurement record capturing actual results versus planned targets for a completed promotional campaign, offer, or TPR event. Tracks incremental units sold, baseline units (pre-promo), lift percentage, total discount cost, vendor funding recovered, net margin impact, GMROI, redemption count, redemption rate, cannibalization effect on adjacent SKUs, and halo effect on complementary categories. Supports post-promotion analysis, vendor funding reconciliation, and future campaign planning optimization. Granularity is one record per campaign-offer-zone combination measured.

attributes.name: promo_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion performance measurement record.

attributes.name: primary_promo_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who conducted the post-promotion performance measurement.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports Profit Center Promotion Impact analysis; performance metrics are rolled up to profit centers for P&L attribution.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional campaign that was executed and measured.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific promotional offer within the campaign that was measured.

attributes.name: promo_zone_id
attributes.description: Geographic or store cluster zone where the promotion was executed and measured.

attributes.name: actual_units_sold
attributes.description: Total actual units sold during the promotion period including baseline and incremental.

attributes.name: analyst_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and commentary from the analyst conducting the post-promotion performance analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_units
attributes.description: Forecasted baseline units that would have been sold without the promotion based on pre-promotion trends.

attributes.name: cannibalization_effect
attributes.description: Negative revenue impact on adjacent or substitute SKUs due to the promotion, measured as revenue decline in related products.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold for units sold during the promotion period.

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of promotion demand that was fulfilled without stockouts, calculated as fulfilled_units divided by total_demand_units.

attributes.name: gmroi
attributes.description: Gross margin return on investment ratio measuring profitability of the promotion, calculated as gross_margin divided by inventory investment.

attributes.name: gross_margin
attributes.description: Gross margin dollars calculated as net_revenue minus cost_of_goods_sold.

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated during the promotion period before discounts.

attributes.name: halo_effect
attributes.description: Positive revenue impact on complementary categories or products driven by the promotion, measured as incremental revenue in related products.

attributes.name: incremental_units_sold
attributes.description: Total incremental units sold during the promotion period above baseline forecast.

attributes.name: inventory_investment
attributes.description: Total inventory investment at cost for the promoted SKUs during the promotion period.

attributes.name: lift_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage lift in unit sales versus baseline, calculated as (incremental_units / baseline_units) * 100.

attributes.name: measured_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance measurement was completed and recorded.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the post-promotion measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the post-promotion measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the post-promotion performance measurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: net_discount_cost
attributes.description: Net discount cost after vendor funding recovery, calculated as total_discount_cost minus vendor_funding_recovered.

attributes.name: net_margin_impact
attributes.description: Net margin impact of the promotion after accounting for all costs including discounts and vendor funding.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: Total net revenue after applying all promotional discounts.

attributes.name: out_of_stock_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the promoted SKU was out of stock during the promotion period.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative performance rating assigned to the promotion based on achievement versus targets.

attributes.name: planned_units_target
attributes.description: Original planned target for total units to be sold during the promotion.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of vendor funding reconciliation process for this promotion performance record.

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Total number of promotion redemptions or coupon clips during the measurement period.

attributes.name: redemption_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of targeted customers who redeemed the offer, calculated as redemption_count divided by target audience size.

attributes.name: repeat_purchase_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who made repeat purchases of the promoted SKU during the measurement period.

attributes.name: roi
attributes.description: Overall return on investment for the promotion, calculated as net_margin_impact divided by total promotion cost.

attributes.name: target_gmroi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI)
attributes.description: Original planned target GMROI for the promotion.

attributes.name: total_discount_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of discounts provided to customers during the promotion period.

attributes.name: unique_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of unique customers who participated in the promotion.

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance measurement was validated and approved.

attributes.name: variance_to_plan_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual and planned units, calculated as (variance_to_plan_units / planned_units_target) * 100.

attributes.name: variance_to_plan_units
attributes.description: Variance between actual units sold and planned units target, calculated as actual_units_sold minus planned_units_target.

attributes.name: vendor_funding_recovered
attributes.description: Total vendor funding amount recovered or received to offset promotion costs.

products.name: promotional_event
products.description: Master reference table for promotional_event. Referenced by promotional_event_id.

attributes.name: promotional_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for promotional_event

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store or location where the promotion is active.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary budget allocated for the promotion (gross amount before discounts).

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary distribution channel through which the promotion is delivered to customers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the promotional event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary values.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the promotion, its purpose, and any special notes.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of discounts offered by the promotion (adjustment component).

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Free‑text description of the rules that determine customer eligibility (e.g., spend threshold, product purchase).

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the promotion expires or is terminated.

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the promotion for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the promotion used in marketing materials and internal reporting.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Category of the promotion (e.g., circular, digital coupon, buy‑one‑get‑one, temporary price reduction, loyalty reward, slotting fee incentive).

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region covered by the promotion.

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promotion is exclusive (true) or can be combined with other offers (false).

attributes.name: is_personalized
attributes.description: True if the promotion is targeted to individual customers based on behavior or loyalty status.

attributes.name: marketing_budget_category
attributes.description: Category of the budget line supporting the promotion.

attributes.name: net_savings
attributes.description: Net monetary savings after applying discounts (budget minus discount).

attributes.name: party_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal or external party responsible for creating/owning the promotion (e.g., marketing team, vendor).

attributes.name: product_sku
attributes.description: SKU of the product(s) to which the promotion applies.

attributes.name: promotional_tactic
attributes.description: Strategic tactic used in the promotion (e.g., price discount, BOGO, rebate, gift with purchase).

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Number of times the promotion has been redeemed by customers.

attributes.name: redemption_value_total
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary value of all redemptions for the promotion.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the promotion becomes effective for customers.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotion.

attributes.name: target_customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment(s) eligible for the promotion.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the promotional event record.

attributes.name: parent_promotional_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on promotional_event (parent_promotional_event_id)

domains.name: vendor
domains.description: Supplier and vendor master data including CPG manufacturers, produce growers, DSD distributors, private-label co-manufacturers, and category captain designations. Manages vendor profiles, contracts, EDI partner profiles, slotting agreements, performance scorecards (fill rate, on-time delivery), and compliance tracking.
domains.references: GS1 Party Standards, GS1 GLN, EDI X12 Standards

products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all vendor and supplier entities including CPG manufacturers, produce growers, DSD distributors, private-label co-manufacturers, and specialty suppliers. Captures legal entity name, DUNS number, tax ID, headquarters address, business type, ownership structure, minority/diversity certification status, EDI capability flag, GTIN prefix, GS1 GLN, payment terms, currency, lead time, vendor tier classification, and active status. This is the Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for vendor identity across the retail-grocery enterprise. Supports produce-specific attributes (growing region, GAP certification, organic acreage, seasonal availability) for agricultural suppliers.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier entity. Primary key for the supplier master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns supplier‑related expenses to a designated cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: default_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AP system defaults payable postings to a supplier‑specific GL account for expense classification and audit trail.

attributes.name: procurement_manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Assign internal buyer to each supplier for PO approval workflow; essential for supplier performance tracking and contract compliance.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Required for Supplier Compliance Program Enrollment report; suppliers are enrolled in multiple compliance programs (food safety, organic).

attributes.name: business_type
attributes.description: Primary business classification of the supplier indicating their role in the supply chain. CPG Manufacturer produces consumer packaged goods, Produce Grower supplies fresh produce, DSD Distributor delivers directly to stores, Private Label Co-Manufacturer produces store-brand products, Specialty Supplier provides niche products, Service Provider offers non-product services.

attributes.name: category_captain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is designated as a category captain, providing category management insights, planogram recommendations, and market intelligence for their product category.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for transactions with this supplier (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Used for invoice processing and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the supplier operates if different from legal name. Used for marketing and operational purposes.

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier delivers products directly to retail stores bypassing the distribution center. Common for bread, beverages, and snacks.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet to identify business entities globally. Used for credit assessment and supplier verification.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has EDI capability for electronic exchange of purchase orders, invoices, and advance ship notices. Critical for automated supply chain operations.

attributes.name: edi_partner_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier in the EDI network. Used for routing EDI transactions through value-added networks (VANs).

attributes.name: gap_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the produce supplier holds USDA GAP certification for food safety practices. Required for fresh produce suppliers.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the supplier's legal entity and physical locations. Used for EDI transactions and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: growing_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region where produce is grown (e.g., California Central Valley, Florida, Mexico). Applicable to produce growers for sourcing and traceability.

attributes.name: gtin_prefix
attributes.description: GS1 company prefix assigned to the supplier for generating GTINs/UPCs for their products. Used for product identification and barcode generation.

attributes.name: haccp_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has HACCP certification for food safety management. Required for suppliers of perishable and high-risk food products.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the supplier's headquarters street address. Used for correspondence, legal notices, and supplier verification.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the supplier's headquarters street address (suite, floor, building). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the supplier's headquarters is located. Used for geographic analysis and supplier diversity reporting.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the supplier's headquarters location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Used for international trade compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the supplier's headquarters address. Format: XXXXX or XXXXX-XXXX for US addresses.

attributes.name: headquarters_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the supplier's headquarters is located. Used for tax jurisdiction and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier performance review or business review. Used to track review cadence and ensure regular supplier evaluation.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from purchase order submission to delivery at distribution center. Used for replenishment planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the supplier entity as registered with government authorities. Used for contracts, tax reporting, and legal documentation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, State Business Registration Standards

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for purchase orders. May be expressed in units, cases, or pallets depending on supplier terms.

attributes.name: minority_owned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise (MBE). Used for diversity sourcing initiatives and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier performance review or business review. Used for proactive relationship management and compliance with review policies.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was first onboarded and approved for purchasing. Used for supplier tenure analysis and relationship lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: organic_acreage
attributes.description: Total acreage of certified organic farmland operated by the produce supplier. Used for capacity planning and organic sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds USDA organic certification for produce or products. Required for suppliers of organic products.

attributes.name: ownership_structure
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the supplier entity. Impacts contract terms, liability, and financial stability assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_corporation|private_corporation|partnership|sole_proprietorship|cooperative|llc|nonprofit — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms negotiated with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines when payment is due and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the supplier. Used for purchase orders, invoices, and operational communication.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the supplier organization. Used for operational communication and relationship management.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact at the supplier. Used for urgent communication and issue resolution.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Phone Number Standard

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier manufactures private-label (store-brand) products for the retailer. Used for private label sourcing and brand management.

attributes.name: seasonal_availability
attributes.description: Description of seasonal availability windows for produce suppliers (e.g., May-September for berries, Year-round for greenhouse tomatoes). Used for seasonal assortment planning.

attributes.name: small_business_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier qualifies as a small business under SBA size standards. Used for procurement preferences and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) Size Standards

attributes.name: supplier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier relationship. Active suppliers are approved for purchasing. Inactive suppliers are not currently used but remain in system. Suspended suppliers have temporary holds due to performance or compliance issues. Pending Approval suppliers are undergoing onboarding. Terminated suppliers have ended relationships. Blocked suppliers are prohibited from use due to serious violations.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax ID used for tax reporting and compliance. Format: XX-XXXXXXX.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier relationship was terminated or contract ended. Null for active suppliers. Used for historical analysis and supplier lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vendor_tier
attributes.description: Internal classification of supplier based on strategic importance, volume, performance, and relationship strength. Tier 1 Strategic suppliers are critical partners with highest volume and performance. Tier 2 Preferred suppliers meet performance standards. Tier 3 Approved suppliers are qualified but lower volume. Tier 4 Conditional suppliers are on probation or limited use.

attributes.name: veteran_owned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a veteran-owned business. Used for diversity sourcing initiatives and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs Verification

attributes.name: woman_owned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a woman-owned business enterprise (WBE). Used for diversity sourcing initiatives and compliance reporting.

products.name: supplier_contact
products.description: Individual contacts associated with a supplier organization, including account managers, EDI coordinators, compliance officers, quality assurance leads, and category management representatives. Captures contact name, title, functional role type, phone, email, preferred communication channel, escalation priority, and active status. Supports multi-contact relationships per supplier across different functional roles, enabling automated routing of POs, compliance notices, and quality incident notifications to the correct counterpart.

attributes.name: supplier_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier organization this contact belongs to. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier contact record. Active contacts are included in automated routing and communications.

attributes.name: compliance_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact should receive compliance-related notices including regulatory updates, audit requests, and certification renewals.

attributes.name: contact_first_name
attributes.description: First name of the supplier contact person.

attributes.name: contact_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the supplier contact person, combining first and last name.

attributes.name: contact_last_name
attributes.description: Last name of the supplier contact person.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier contact record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or division within the supplier organization where the contact works.

attributes.name: edi_qualified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is qualified and authorized to handle EDI transactions and technical integrations.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact's authorization ended or will end. Null for currently active contacts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact became active and authorized to represent the supplier in business transactions.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the supplier contact. Used for automated routing of purchase orders, compliance notices, and quality incident notifications.

attributes.name: escalation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for escalating issues to this contact. Primary contacts are reached first, followed by secondary and tertiary contacts.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the supplier contact, used for formal document transmission when required.

attributes.name: functional_role_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the contact's functional role within the supplier relationship. Determines routing of communications such as POs, compliance notices, and quality incident notifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: account_manager|edi_coordinator|compliance_officer|quality_assurance_lead|category_management_representative|logistics_coordinator|sales_representative|technical_support|billing_specialist|customer_service|operations_manager — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the contact within the supplier organization.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Preferred language for business communications with this contact.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent business communication or interaction with this contact.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this supplier contact record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the supplier contact, used for urgent communications and escalations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about the contact, including special handling instructions, communication preferences, or relationship history.

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Physical office location or site where the contact is based.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the supplier contact.

attributes.name: po_approval_authority_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has authority to approve and acknowledge purchase orders on behalf of the supplier.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel

products.name: edi_partner_profile
products.description: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) configuration and partnership profile for each supplier enabled for electronic transactions. Captures EDI standard (ANSI X12, EDIFACT), ISA/GS identifiers, supported transaction sets (850 PO, 855 PO Acknowledgment, 856 ASN, 810 Invoice, 832 Price Catalog), communication protocol (AS2, SFTP, VAN), test vs. production status, and EDI coordinator contact. Critical for automated PO-to-invoice workflows with CPG and DSD suppliers.

attributes.name: edi_partner_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Partner Profile ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EDI partner profile record. Primary key.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor master record for which this EDI profile is configured. Links EDI configuration to the vendor entity.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDI partner profile is currently active and enabled for message transmission. False if partnership is suspended or terminated.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Method used to authenticate and authorize EDI message transmission. Certificate-based authentication is common for AS2; SSH keys for SFTP.

attributes.name: certificate_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the trading partner's digital certificate. Critical for proactive renewal to avoid EDI transmission failures.

attributes.name: certificate_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used for AS2 encryption and signing. Used to validate partner identity and message integrity.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Transport protocol used for EDI message exchange. AS2 provides secure, encrypted transmission over the internet; SFTP/FTPS are file-based; VAN is a third-party value-added network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AS2|SFTP|FTPS|VAN|HTTP|HTTPS|API — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_validation_level
attributes.description: Level of EDI message validation applied before transmission. Basic checks syntax only; Standard validates against X12 rules; Strict enforces trading partner-specific business rules.

attributes.name: connection_endpoint
attributes.description: URL, IP address, or hostname used to connect to the trading partner's EDI system. May be an AS2 URL, SFTP server address, or VAN mailbox identifier.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDI partner profile record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: edi_coordinator_email
attributes.description: Email address of the EDI coordinator for technical communication regarding EDI transmission issues, testing, and configuration changes.

attributes.name: edi_coordinator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary EDI technical contact at the supplier organization responsible for EDI setup, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

attributes.name: edi_coordinator_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the EDI coordinator for urgent technical support and escalation of EDI transmission failures.

attributes.name: edi_partner_name
attributes.description: Business name of the EDI trading partner as registered in the EDI network or VAN directory.

attributes.name: edi_standard
attributes.description: The EDI messaging standard used for electronic transactions with this partner. ANSI X12 is predominant in North America; EDIFACT is common in Europe and international trade.
attributes.references: ANSI ASC X12 Standards; UN/EDIFACT Standards

attributes.name: edi_version
attributes.description: Version of the EDI standard in use (e.g., 4010, 5010 for ANSI X12; D96A, D01B for EDIFACT). Critical for message parsing and compliance.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 Version Release; UN/EDIFACT Directory

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this EDI partner profile configuration was deactivated or superseded. Null for currently active profiles.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this EDI partner profile configuration became effective and available for use in production EDI processing.

attributes.name: functional_ack_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trading partner requires 997 Functional Acknowledgment for every EDI transaction received. True if acknowledgment is mandatory per trading partner agreement.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date when the EDI partnership transitioned from test to production status and began processing live business transactions.

attributes.name: gs_receiver_code
attributes.description: GS03 Application Receiver Code used in ANSI X12 functional group header. Identifies the receiving application or division within Grocery.

attributes.name: gs_sender_code
attributes.description: GS02 Application Sender Code used in ANSI X12 functional group header. Identifies the sending application or division within the trading partner organization.

attributes.name: inbound_832_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier sends 832 Price/Sales Catalog transactions to Grocery. True if supplier provides electronic price updates for item master synchronization.

attributes.name: inbound_850_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Grocery sends 850 Purchase Order transactions to this supplier via EDI. True if automated PO transmission is active.

attributes.name: isa_receiver_qualifier
attributes.description: ISA07 Interchange Receiver ID Qualifier. Defines the type of receiver identifier used by Grocery in the EDI interchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|08|09|12|14|16|20|27|28|29|30|33|ZZ — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: isa_sender_qualifier
attributes.description: ISA05 Interchange Sender ID Qualifier. Defines the type of sender identifier (e.g., 01=DUNS, 12=Phone, 14=UPC, ZZ=Mutually Defined). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|08|09|12|14|16|20|27|28|29|30|33|ZZ — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDI partner profile record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking configuration changes and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_successful_transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful EDI message transmission to or from this partner. Used for monitoring partnership health and detecting transmission failures.

attributes.name: message_retry_count
attributes.description: Number of automatic retry attempts for failed EDI transmissions before manual intervention is required. Typically 3-5 retries.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional EDI configuration notes, special handling instructions, known issues, or trading partner-specific requirements not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: outbound_810_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier sends 810 Invoice transactions to Grocery via EDI. True if electronic invoicing is active for automated accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: outbound_855_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outbound 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment (PO Ack) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier sends 855 PO Acknowledgment transactions back to Grocery. True if supplier confirms orders electronically.

attributes.name: outbound_856_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outbound 856 Advance Ship Notice (ASN) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier sends 856 Advance Ship Notice transactions to Grocery. True if supplier provides electronic shipment notifications for warehouse receiving automation.

attributes.name: retry_interval_minutes
attributes.description: Time interval in minutes between automatic retry attempts for failed EDI transmissions. Common values are 15, 30, or 60 minutes.

attributes.name: supported_transaction_sets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDI transaction set codes supported by this partner (e.g., 850=Purchase Order, 855=PO Acknowledgment, 856=Advance Ship Notice, 810=Invoice, 832=Price/Sales Catalog, 846=Inventory Inquiry, 997=Functional Acknowledgment). Defines the scope of automated document exchange.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for deactivating this EDI partnership (e.g., Supplier Contract Ended, Migrated to API, Technical Issues, Supplier Out of Business). Null for active profiles.

attributes.name: test_production_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the EDI partnership. Test indicates initial setup and validation phase; Production indicates live transaction processing; Certification indicates formal compliance testing.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone used by the trading partner for EDI transmission scheduling and timestamp interpretation (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Critical for coordinating batch windows.

attributes.name: transmission_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency of EDI message transmission for this partner. Real-time for immediate PO transmission; Daily for batch invoice processing; On-demand for ad-hoc transactions.

attributes.name: transmission_time_window
attributes.description: Scheduled time window for batch EDI transmissions (e.g., 02:00-04:00 UTC). Null for real-time or on-demand transmission patterns.

attributes.name: van_mailbox_code
attributes.description: Unique mailbox identifier assigned by the VAN provider for this trading partner. Used for message routing within the VAN network.

attributes.name: van_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party VAN service provider used for EDI message routing and translation (e.g., SPS Commerce, TrueCommerce, Cleo). Null if direct AS2/SFTP connection is used.

products.name: vendor_category_captain
products.description: Designation records identifying which CPG vendor serves as category captain for a given product category or subcategory within Grocery's category management program. Captures category code, designated vendor, appointment effective date, term end/review date, scope of responsibilities (planogram design, assortment recommendations, promotional calendar planning, competitive insights), performance evaluation criteria, data sharing agreements, conflict-of-interest disclosures, and current active/inactive status. This is a regulated vendor role in grocery retail requiring FTC compliance documentation — distinct from general vendor contracts because it involves access to competitor sales data and carries specific antitrust disclosure obligations. Supports category management governance and enables audit trail for FTC compliance on category captain arrangements.
products.reference: Category Captain Program / Oracle Retail Category Management
