attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor item cross-reference record. Primary key.

attributes.name: buyer_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: BUYER ASSIGNMENT: Tracks which associate is responsible for purchasing each vendor item, used in order allocation and cost analysis reports.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Links each vendor‑supplied item to the GL account used for inventory valuation and COGS posting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to Grocery's internal SKU master. This is the authoritative product identifier used across stores, DCs, and systems.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor providing this item. Links to the supplier master data.

attributes.name: case_cube_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Volume of one case in cubic feet. Used for warehouse space allocation and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of consumer units (eaches) contained in one vendor case. Used for ordering and receiving calculations.

attributes.name: case_weight_pounds
attributes.description: Weight of one case in pounds. Used for freight cost calculation and warehouse capacity planning.

attributes.name: cases_per_pallet
attributes.description: Total number of cases on a full pallet (TI × HI). Used for full-pallet ordering and DC receiving.

attributes.name: catch_weight_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is sold by variable weight (e.g., fresh meat, produce) requiring scale-based pricing at receiving.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for vendor cost amount. Used for international supplier cost management.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the product is manufactured or grown. Required for customs, labeling, and consumer transparency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor item record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for discontinuing this vendor item relationship (e.g., vendor exit, product reformulation, cost issues).

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is delivered directly to stores by the vendor, bypassing the DC. Used for receiving and inventory planning.

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic ordering and invoicing via EDI is enabled for this vendor item. Used for automated procurement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor item relationship ended or will end. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor item relationship became active and available for ordering.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1 global trade item number (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, or GTIN-14) assigned by the manufacturer. Used for global product identification.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard, DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: inner_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of consumer units contained in one inner pack within a case. Used for shelf-ready packaging and merchandising.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor cost was last updated. Used for cost change tracking and margin analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor item record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality audits.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor item was last ordered via purchase order. Used for vendor performance analysis and item rationalization.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from purchase order submission to expected delivery at DC or store. Used for replenishment planning and safety stock calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered from the vendor, expressed in the unit of measure. Used in replenishment planning.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: order_multiple_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity increment required for orders above the minimum (e.g., must order in multiples of 10 cases). Used in CAO systems.

attributes.name: organic_certification_number
attributes.description: USDA organic certification number or equivalent certifying body identifier. Required for organic product verification.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic by USDA or equivalent certifying body. Used for merchandising and labeling compliance.

attributes.name: pallet_hi
attributes.description: Number of layers stacked on a pallet (HI dimension). Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: pallet_ti
attributes.description: Number of cases per layer on a pallet (TI dimension). Used for warehouse space planning and transportation optimization.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the primary source for this SKU. Used in automated replenishment and PO generation.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is a Grocery private-label brand product manufactured by a co-manufacturer.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days from manufacture or receipt date until the product expires or is no longer saleable. Used for FIFO inventory management and markdown planning.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Required storage and transportation temperature zone for this item. Critical for cold chain management and HACCP compliance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for ordering and inventory tracking (each, case, pallet, weight, volume). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|pound|kilogram|liter|gallon|ounce — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit UPC barcode identifier for the item. Used at point of sale and for inventory tracking.

attributes.name: vendor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Current cost per unit of measure charged by the vendor. Used for cost management, margin analysis, and PO pricing.

attributes.name: vendor_item_description
attributes.description: Vendor's description of the item as it appears on their catalog or invoice. Used for receiving verification and reconciliation.

attributes.name: vendor_item_number
attributes.description: Supplier's unique part number or item code for this product. Used in purchase orders and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: vendor_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor item relationship. Controls whether the item can be ordered from this supplier.

products.name: cost_schedule
products.description: Vendor cost and pricing schedule defining the wholesale cost (COGS) for each vendor item over a defined effective period. Captures vendor item, cost type (base cost, promotional cost, bracket pricing tier), effective start and end dates, unit cost, case cost, allowance type, bill-back vs. off-invoice designation, and currency. Supports COGS calculation, GMROI analysis, and margin management across the merchandise planning process.
products.reference: Oracle Retail Cost Management / SAP Retail MM Purchasing Info Record

attributes.name: cost_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor cost schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: COST SCHEDULE MAINTENANCE: Captures which associate created/updated a cost schedule, required for change‑control audit.

attributes.name: promotion_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional event or TPR (Temporary Price Reduction) campaign associated with this cost schedule, if applicable.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor providing the item at this cost.

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_item. Business justification: Cost schedule rows belong to a specific vendor item; linking via vendor_item_id eliminates redundant item identifiers.

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the vendor allowance or discount per unit or case, depending on allowance type.

attributes.name: allowance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the base cost, if the allowance is expressed as a percentage rather than a fixed amount.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: The mechanism by which vendor allowances or discounts are applied: off-invoice (deducted at purchase), bill-back (claimed after sale), scan-based (paid on scan), accrual (accumulated over time), lump-sum (one-time payment), or none.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this cost schedule: approved (ready for use), pending approval, rejected, or under review by category management or finance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the category manager, buyer, or finance approver who authorized this cost schedule.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule was approved for use in COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.

attributes.name: bracket_max_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum quantity threshold for this bracket pricing tier. Null indicates no upper limit for the tier.

attributes.name: bracket_min_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity threshold for this bracket pricing tier. Quantities at or above this level qualify for the tier cost.

attributes.name: bracket_tier
attributes.description: The volume tier or bracket level for bracket pricing schedules (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3). Used when cost varies by purchase volume.

attributes.name: case_cost
attributes.description: The wholesale cost per case or pack. Typically used for DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DC (Distribution Center) ordering.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: The vendor contract or agreement number under which this cost schedule is defined. Links to master vendor contract.

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure on which the cost is based: per unit (each), per case, per pallet, per weight (lb/kg), or per volume (gallon/liter).

attributes.name: cost_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for the most recent cost change (e.g., vendor price increase, commodity cost fluctuation, contract renegotiation, promotional pricing).

attributes.name: cost_source
attributes.description: The origin or method by which this cost schedule was captured: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) invoice, manual entry, contract upload, vendor portal, or price file import.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the cost schedule: active (in use), pending (future effective), expired (past end date), superseded (replaced by newer schedule), or cancelled.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost schedule entry: base cost (standard wholesale), promotional cost (temporary reduction), bracket pricing (volume tier), contract cost (negotiated rate), spot cost (one-time purchase), or rebate-adjusted cost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: dsd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is delivered via DSD (Direct Store Delivery) rather than through the DC (Distribution Center). True if DSD, False if warehouse-supplied.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost schedule expires. Null indicates an open-ended schedule.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost schedule becomes active and applicable for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation.

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The allocated freight or transportation cost per unit, if freight is included in the landed cost calculation.

attributes.name: last_cost_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent change to the cost values in this schedule. Used for cost variance tracking and audit.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Change History

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity (in units or cases) that must be ordered to qualify for this cost schedule.

attributes.name: net_cost
attributes.description: The final net cost per unit after all allowances, discounts, and adjustments are applied. This is the true COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) for margin calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this cost schedule, including special terms, conditions, or exceptions negotiated with the vendor.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms negotiated with the vendor for this cost schedule (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, COD). Impacts cash flow and working capital.
attributes.references: SAP FI Vendor Master Payment Terms

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost schedule applies to a private-label (store-owned brand) item. True if private label, False if national brand or CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods).

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The wholesale cost per single unit (each) of the item. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) calculation.

attributes.name: units_per_case
attributes.description: The number of individual units (eaches) contained in one case or pack. Used to reconcile unit cost and case cost.

products.name: trade_allowance
products.description: Vendor trade promotion allowances, rebates, and bill-back programs negotiated with CPG suppliers. Captures allowance type (off-invoice, bill-back, scan allowance, performance rebate), promotion period, qualifying SKUs or categories, allowance rate or amount, accrual method, payment trigger (scan, purchase, performance), and settlement status. Supports accounts payable deduction management and promotional funding reconciliation.
products.reference: CPG Trade Promotion / SAP Retail SD Rebate Agreement

attributes.name: trade_allowance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade allowance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Allowance transactions must post to a designated GL account to track promotional spend.

attributes.name: primary_trade_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this trade allowance record in the system.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CPG supplier or vendor providing the trade allowance.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.trade_agreement. Business justification: Trade allowance is granted under a specific trade agreement; linking via trade_agreement_id removes the need for a free‑text contract reference.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Defines when the allowance is accrued: at time of purchase from supplier, at time of sale to customer, based on POS scan data, or based on performance metrics achievement.

attributes.name: accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of allowance accrued to date under this agreement, based on qualifying purchases or sales.

attributes.name: allowance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allowance amount (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: allowance_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the trade allowance agreement, typically provided by the supplier or generated internally for tracking.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_type
attributes.description: Defines how the allowance value is calculated: percentage of purchase price, fixed dollar amount per unit sold, fixed amount per case, or lump sum payment.

attributes.name: allowance_rate_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the allowance rate. Interpretation depends on allowance_rate_type (e.g., 5.00 for 5% or $5.00 per unit).

attributes.name: allowance_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of products covered by the allowance: specific SKUs, entire category, brand family, or all products from the supplier.

attributes.name: allowance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade allowance agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|active|pending_approval|approved|in_settlement|settled|expired|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade allowance mechanism: off-invoice (deducted at purchase), bill-back (claimed after purchase), scan-based (triggered by POS scan data), performance rebate (based on sales targets), volume rebate (based on purchase volume), or slotting allowance (for shelf space).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this trade allowance agreement was approved.

attributes.name: category_captain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allowance is part of a category captain arrangement where the supplier has strategic partnership status.

attributes.name: claim_submission_deadline_date
attributes.description: The final date by which bill-back or rebate claims must be submitted to the supplier for this allowance.

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount claimed from the supplier for this allowance through bill-back or rebate submissions.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for managing and tracking this trade allowance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this trade allowance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of allowance claims that are currently in dispute with the supplier.

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: EDI transaction set identifier used for electronic exchange of allowance data with the supplier (e.g., 867 for Product Transfer and Resale Report, 880 for Grocery Products Invoice).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this trade allowance record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Cap on the total allowance amount that can be earned or claimed under this agreement. Nullable if no cap applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value of qualifying products that must be purchased to trigger the allowance. Nullable if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity of qualifying products that must be purchased to trigger the allowance. Nullable if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing additional details, special terms, or exceptions related to this trade allowance agreement.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount actually paid or credited by the supplier for this allowance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the supplier pays or credits the allowance: deduction from invoice, check payment, electronic funds transfer, credit memo, or offset against payables.

attributes.name: payment_trigger
attributes.description: Event that triggers payment or settlement of the allowance: automatic deduction from invoice, retailer claim submission, supplier verification of performance, or end of promotion period.

attributes.name: performance_actual_value
attributes.description: Actual achieved value for the performance metric, used to calculate earned allowance amount.

attributes.name: performance_metric_type
attributes.description: Type of performance metric used to determine eligibility for performance-based rebates. Applicable when allowance_type is performance_rebate.

attributes.name: performance_target_value
attributes.description: Target value for the performance metric that must be achieved to earn the full allowance. Applicable for performance-based allowances.

attributes.name: promotion_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade allowance promotion period ends. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: promotion_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade allowance promotion period begins and qualifying purchases or sales become eligible.

attributes.name: promotional_event_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the promotional event or campaign associated with this trade allowance (e.g., Back to School, Holiday Promotion).

attributes.name: qualifying_brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name that qualifies for this allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is brand.

attributes.name: qualifying_category_code
attributes.description: Product category code that qualifies for this allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is category.

attributes.name: qualifying_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers or UPC codes that qualify for this trade allowance. Populated when allowance_scope is sku_specific.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the allowance settlement process with the supplier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|accruing|claim_submitted|under_review|approved|paid|disputed|rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: performance_scorecard
products.description: Periodic vendor performance scorecard capturing key supply chain KPIs for each supplier across a measurement period. Captures fill rate percentage, on-time delivery rate, order accuracy rate, invoice accuracy rate, case fill rate, OOS incidents attributed to vendor, OTIF (On-Time In-Full) score, shrink contribution, recall incidents, and overall composite score. Drives vendor tier classification and contract renegotiation decisions.

attributes.name: performance_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_scorecard

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (category manager or procurement analyst) who finalized and approved this scorecard.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Scorecard metrics are evaluated against the cost center responsible for supplier performance.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor being evaluated in this scorecard period.

attributes.name: action_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to submit a corrective action plan based on this scorecard performance. True if action plan required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: asn_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) Accuracy Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ASN transmissions that accurately matched the physical delivery contents during the measurement period.

attributes.name: case_fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered cases that were successfully delivered by the vendor during the measurement period. Measures fulfillment at case level rather than unit level.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Overall weighted performance score combining all KPI metrics into a single vendor performance rating for the measurement period. Drives vendor tier classification and contract decisions.

attributes.name: contract_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor met all contractual performance obligations during the measurement period. True if compliant, False if any contract terms were violated.

attributes.name: contract_renegotiation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this scorecard performance triggers contract renegotiation or review. True if renegotiation recommended, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: edi_compliance_rate_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Compliance Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transactions successfully transmitted via EDI without errors or manual intervention during the measurement period. Measures vendor technical integration quality.

attributes.name: fill_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ordered units that were successfully delivered by the vendor during the measurement period. Key supply chain KPI measuring vendor ability to fulfill complete orders.

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: Date when this scorecard was finalized and approved for official use in vendor management decisions.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices submitted without pricing errors, quantity discrepancies, or other billing issues during the measurement period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scorecard record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lead_time_adherence_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered within the agreed lead time window during the measurement period.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency or type of measurement period for this scorecard (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual).

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of deliveries that arrived on or before the scheduled delivery date during the measurement period.

attributes.name: oos_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-stock incidents at store or DC level attributed to this vendor during the measurement period. Tracks vendor-caused stockouts.

attributes.name: order_accuracy_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of orders delivered with correct SKUs, quantities, and specifications without errors during the measurement period.

attributes.name: otif_score_percentage
attributes.description: Composite percentage measuring orders delivered both on-time AND in-full during the measurement period. Industry-standard vendor performance metric combining timeliness and completeness.

attributes.name: performance_improvement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor composite score improved compared to the previous measurement period. True if improved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: quality_defect_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of delivered units or cases that failed quality inspection or were rejected during the measurement period.

attributes.name: recall_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of product recall incidents initiated by or involving this vendor during the measurement period. Critical quality and compliance metric.

attributes.name: reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the category manager or procurement analyst reviewing this scorecard. Captures qualitative context and action items.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the measurement period for this performance scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the measurement period for this performance scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this performance scorecard record. Tracks approval and dispute resolution lifecycle.

attributes.name: shrink_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of inventory shrink (loss from theft, spoilage, or damage) attributed to this vendor during the measurement period. Tracks vendor-caused inventory loss.

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of cases successfully delivered by this vendor during the measurement period. Numerator for case fill rate calculations.

attributes.name: total_cases_ordered
attributes.description: Total number of cases ordered from this vendor during the measurement period. Denominator for case fill rate calculations.

attributes.name: total_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders placed with this vendor during the measurement period. Provides context for rate-based metrics.

attributes.name: total_order_value_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of all purchase orders placed with this vendor during the measurement period. Provides spend context for performance evaluation.

attributes.name: total_units_delivered
attributes.description: Total number of units successfully delivered by this vendor during the measurement period. Numerator for fill rate calculations.

attributes.name: total_units_ordered
attributes.description: Total number of units ordered from this vendor during the measurement period. Denominator for fill rate calculations.

attributes.name: vendor_tier_classification
attributes.description: Vendor performance tier assigned based on composite score and KPI thresholds. Determines contract terms, payment terms, and strategic partnership status.

products.name: compliance_requirement
products.description: Vendor compliance requirements and certification obligations that suppliers must meet to do business with Grocery. Captures requirement type (food safety, HACCP, organic certification, USDA inspection, FDA registration, DEA Schedule II-V for pharmacy vendors, GFSI certification, insurance certificate, COA requirements), applicable vendor categories, effective date, renewal frequency, version number, supersession reference (links to prior version when regulatory changes occur), regulatory change effective date, grace period for transition, and documentation submission requirements. Supports version-controlled regulatory change management — when FDA or USDA updates requirements, a new version is created with the prior version marked superseded, enabling audit trail of which requirement version each vendor was certified against.
products.reference: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act / USDA Organic / GFSI Standards

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: superseded_requirement_compliance_requirement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this compliance requirement that this version replaces. Null for initial versions. Enables traceability of regulatory change history and vendor certification lineage.

attributes.name: applicable_vendor_category
attributes.description: Vendor categories or supplier types to which this compliance requirement applies (e.g., CPG Manufacturers, Produce Growers, DSD Distributors, Private-Label Co-Manufacturers, Pharmacy Vendors, Meat and Poultry Suppliers). Pipe-separated list for multiple categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cpg_manufacturer|produce_grower|dsd_distributor|private_label_comanufacturer|pharmacy_vendor|meat_poultry_supplier|dairy_supplier|bakery_supplier|seafood_supplier — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required audits or inspections for this compliance requirement. For example, 12 for annual audits, 24 for biennial. Null if no periodic audit is required.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements, USDA Organic Inspection Requirements 7 CFR 205.403

attributes.name: category_captain_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors designated as Category Captains are exempt from this compliance requirement (True) or must comply like all other vendors (False). Used for strategic vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party certification or accreditation body authorized to issue certificates for this compliance requirement (e.g., USDA Accredited Certifying Agent, GFSI Recognized Certification Body, State Board of Pharmacy). Null if certification is issued directly by the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: USDA Accredited Certifying Agents List, GFSI Recognized Certification Bodies, State Pharmacy Board Directories

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance requirement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and compliance history tracking.

attributes.name: documentation_submission_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must submit supporting documentation (certificates, inspection reports, insurance policies, COA) to demonstrate compliance with this requirement (True) or if self-attestation is sufficient (False).

attributes.name: documentation_type
attributes.description: Type of documentation that vendors must submit to satisfy this compliance requirement (e.g., Certificate of Analysis, HACCP Plan, Organic Certificate, DEA Registration Certificate, Insurance Certificate of Liability, Third-Party Audit Report, FDA Facility Registration Number). Null if no documentation is required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 117, USDA 7 CFR 205, DEA 21 CFR 1301, GFSI Audit Requirements

attributes.name: edi_integration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors must have EDI capability to exchange compliance documentation and certification status electronically (True) or if manual submission is acceptable (False).
attributes.references: Internal EDI Standards, GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance requirement version becomes enforceable for vendor certification and onboarding. Vendors must meet this requirement for contracts starting on or after this date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance requirement version is no longer valid or enforceable. Null for requirements with indefinite validity. Typically populated when a requirement is superseded or retired.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the regulatory change effective date during which vendors are allowed to transition to the new requirement without penalty. Null if no grace period is granted.
attributes.references: Internal Vendor Transition Policy, FDA Compliance Policy Guides

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_minimum_amount
attributes.description: Minimum insurance coverage amount (in USD) required for insurance certificate compliance requirements (e.g., General Liability, Product Liability, Workers Compensation). Null if this requirement is not insurance-related.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage required for insurance certificate compliance requirements. Null if this requirement is not insurance-related.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, certification organization, or internal department that mandates this compliance requirement (e.g., FDA, USDA, DEA, State Board of Pharmacy, GFSI, Internal Quality Assurance).
attributes.references: FDA, USDA, DEA, State Pharmacy Boards, GFSI, EPA, OSHA, FTC

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance requirement record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this compliance requirement was last reviewed by the owner department to confirm continued relevance and accuracy. Used to ensure requirements remain current with regulatory changes.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance requirement is mandatory (True) or optional/recommended (False) for the applicable vendor categories. Mandatory requirements block vendor onboarding if not met.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this compliance requirement. Used to trigger proactive review workflows and ensure requirements are kept up-to-date.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or clarifications regarding this compliance requirement. May include transition guidance, vendor communication templates, or links to training materials.

attributes.name: notification_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days in advance that vendors must be notified before a new or updated compliance requirement becomes effective. Used to ensure vendors have adequate time to achieve compliance.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Internal department or business unit responsible for managing and enforcing this compliance requirement (e.g., Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacy Compliance, Vendor Management, Legal).

attributes.name: penalty_for_noncompliance
attributes.description: Description of the consequences for vendors who fail to meet this compliance requirement (e.g., Vendor Onboarding Blocked, Contract Suspension, Immediate Termination, Financial Penalty, Corrective Action Plan Required, Regulatory Reporting to FDA/USDA).
attributes.references: Internal Vendor Compliance Policy, FDA Warning Letter Procedures, USDA Enforcement Actions

attributes.name: regulatory_change_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the underlying regulatory change (e.g., FDA rule update, USDA policy revision) officially took effect. May differ from internal effective_date if a grace period is granted. Null if this is not a regulatory-driven change.
attributes.references: Federal Register Publication Dates, State Regulatory Bulletins

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The overarching regulatory framework or legal statute under which this requirement is mandated (e.g., FDA Food Safety Modernization Act, USDA Organic Regulations 7 CFR Part 205, DEA Controlled Substances Act 21 CFR Part 1300, HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 160).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA, USDA 7 CFR 205, DEA 21 CFR 1300, HIPAA 45 CFR 160, SOX Public Company Accounting Reform Act

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required renewals or recertifications for this compliance requirement. For example, 12 for annual renewal, 36 for triennial. Null if no periodic renewal is required.
attributes.references: FDA Registration Renewal Requirements, USDA Organic Certification Renewal, DEA Registration Renewal 21 CFR 1301.13

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the compliance requirement (e.g., FDA_HACCP_2023, USDA_ORGANIC_CERT, DEA_SCHED_II). Used for external reference and system integration.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), USDA Organic Regulations 7 CFR Part 205, DEA 21 CFR Part 1300

attributes.name: requirement_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the compliance requirement (e.g., Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points Certification, Organic Producer Certification, DEA Schedule II Controlled Substance Registration).
attributes.references: FDA FSMA, USDA Organic Program, DEA Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance requirement. Active requirements are enforced; superseded requirements have been replaced by newer versions; pending requirements are scheduled for future activation; retired requirements are no longer applicable; suspended requirements are temporarily not enforced.

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Category of compliance requirement that classifies the regulatory or business obligation. Determines applicable vendor categories and enforcement procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_safety|haccp|organic_certification|usda_inspection|fda_registration|dea_schedule|gfsi_certification|insurance_certificate|coa_requirement|environmental_compliance|labor_compliance|quality_standard — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR, USDA 7 CFR, DEA 21 CFR 1300, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements, EPA 40 CFR, OSHA 29 CFR

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Business risk classification for noncompliance with this requirement. Critical: poses immediate health/safety/legal risk (e.g., DEA Schedule II noncompliance, HACCP failure). High: significant operational or reputational risk. Medium: moderate risk. Low: minimal risk.

attributes.name: standard_reference_document
attributes.description: Citation or URL to the official regulatory standard, guidance document, or internal policy that defines this compliance requirement (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 117, USDA 7 CFR Part 205.400, DEA Practitioner Manual, Internal SOP-COMP-001).
attributes.references: FDA Code of Federal Regulations, USDA Code of Federal Regulations, DEA Regulations, Internal Policy Repository

attributes.name: vendor_self_certification_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vendors are allowed to self-certify compliance with this requirement (True) or if third-party verification is mandatory (False).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the compliance requirement (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented when regulatory changes or business policy updates necessitate a new version. Supports audit trail of requirement evolution.

products.name: compliance_record
products.description: Vendor compliance certification and documentation records tracking whether each supplier has met required compliance obligations. Captures vendor, compliance requirement type, certification body, certificate number, issue date, expiration date, document attachment reference, verification status (submitted, verified, expired, non-compliant), and last audit date. Supports regulatory reporting for FDA, USDA, and DEA compliance programs.
products.reference: FDA FSMA Supplier Verification / USDA Organic Certification

attributes.name: compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor compliance certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_id

attributes.name: reviewer_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: COMPLIANCE REVIEW: Links internal compliance reviewer to each record for audit trails and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor entity that this compliance record pertains to. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the compliance certification is set up for automatic renewal by the vendor or certification body. True if auto-renewal is enabled; false if manual renewal is required.

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: The operational impact on the vendor relationship if this compliance requirement is not met. No impact indicates the requirement is informational only; restricted ordering indicates purchase orders may be limited to compliant product categories; suspended ordering indicates all new orders are blocked until compliance is restored; terminated relationship indicates the vendor will be deactivated.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the certification body to this specific compliance certificate or license. Used for verification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory agency, third-party auditor, or certification organization that issued or verified the compliance certification. Examples include FDA, USDA, DEA, state boards of pharmacy, NSF International, SGS, Bureau Veritas, or industry-specific certification bodies.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17065 Conformity Assessment; FDA Regulations; USDA Regulations; DEA Regulations

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context related to the compliance record, including special conditions, exemptions, or historical compliance issues. Used for internal communication and audit documentation.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_type
attributes.description: The category or type of compliance obligation that this record tracks. attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA Organic Foods Production Act; DEA Controlled Substances Act; State Pharmacy Board Regulations; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: compliance_scope
attributes.description: A textual description of the scope of the compliance certification, including specific product categories, facility locations, or operational processes covered by the certification. For example, 'Fresh produce handling at Distribution Center 101' or 'Organic certification for private-label dairy products'.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the vendor must complete corrective actions to remediate non-compliance issues. Used for escalation and vendor performance scorecarding.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: A description of the corrective actions required or planned to address non-compliance issues, including remediation steps, responsible parties, and target completion dates. Used for vendor performance management and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_attachment_reference
attributes.description: A URI, file path, or document management system reference pointing to the scanned or digital copy of the compliance certificate, audit report, or supporting documentation. Used for audit trail and regulatory inspection purposes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance certificate or license expires and must be renewed. Null if the certification has no expiration (perpetual until revoked).

attributes.name: facility_location
attributes.description: The physical location (facility name, address, or site identifier) of the vendor facility or operation that is covered by this compliance certification. Relevant for multi-site vendors where certifications may be facility-specific.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after expiration during which the vendor is allowed to continue operations while renewing the certification. Zero or null indicates no grace period is permitted.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance certificate or license was originally issued by the certification body.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent audit, inspection, or verification activity conducted by the certification body or internal compliance team to validate the vendors adherence to the compliance requirement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this compliance record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance audit or re-certification inspection. Used for proactive compliance management and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: A detailed explanation of the reason for non-compliance status, including specific deficiencies identified during audit, missing documentation, expired certifications not renewed, or regulatory violations. Null if the record is compliant.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent expiration or renewal notification was sent to the vendor. Used for tracking communication and escalation timelines.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an expiration or renewal notification has been sent to the vendor contact for this compliance record. True if notification has been sent; false otherwise. Used for compliance workflow tracking.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The product category or merchandise classification that this compliance certification applies to. Examples include fresh produce, meat and poultry, seafood, dairy, bakery, pharmacy, private-label CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods), or DSD (Direct Store Delivery) items.

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: The specific regulatory program or framework under which this compliance requirement falls. Examples include FDA FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act), USDA Organic Program, DEA Controlled Substance Registration, State Pharmacy Board Licensing, or EPA refrigerant management.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA Organic Foods Production Act; DEA Controlled Substances Act; EPA Clean Air Act Section 608

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed risk level associated with this compliance requirement for the vendor, based on product category, regulatory impact, and business criticality. Low indicates minimal regulatory or business risk; medium indicates moderate risk requiring periodic monitoring; high indicates significant risk requiring frequent oversight; critical indicates severe risk requiring immediate attention and continuous monitoring.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal compliance team verified and approved the compliance documentation as meeting requirements.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The current state of the compliance record in the verification workflow. Submitted indicates the vendor has provided documentation; pending review indicates internal review is in progress; verified indicates the certification has been validated and is current; expired indicates the certification has passed its expiration date; non-compliant indicates the vendor failed to meet requirements; revoked indicates the certification was withdrawn by the issuing body.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the internal compliance officer, quality assurance manager, or procurement specialist who verified and approved the compliance documentation. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: private_label_spec
products.description: Product specifications and formulation requirements for private-label items manufactured by co-manufacturing vendors. Captures Grocery private-label brand, item description, formulation version, ingredient list, nutritional panel requirements, packaging specifications, label compliance requirements (FDA nutrition facts, USDA organic seal), quality standards, shelf life requirements, and approved co-manufacturer assignments. This entity owns the vendor-side manufacturing specification (formulation, ingredients, packaging, quality standards) while the product domain owns the sellable item attributes (retail UPC, price, category assignment, planogram placement). Supports private-label brand development, co-manufacturer qualification, and sourcing decisions.

products.name: quality_incident

Feeds into vendor scorecard, compliance tracking, and supports FDA Reportable Food Registry submissions when required.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.description: Customer loyalty program management including membership enrollment, tier management, points accrual and redemption, personalized reward offers, and gamification. Tracks engagement metrics, NPS contribution, program ROI, dwell time patterns, and household purchase behavior. Integrates with CRM, promotion, and fuel reward systems.

products.name: membership
products.description: Core master record for a customer's loyalty program enrollment. Captures membership number (card number), current tier assignment, enrollment date, program type (standard, premium, household, pharmacy rewards), enrollment channel (in-store, digital, pharmacy, fuel center), opt-in preferences (email, SMS, push, mail), referral source, current program standing (active, suspended, closed), lifetime value classification, last activity date, and digital wallet linkage status. This is the authoritative SSOT for loyalty membership identity within the loyalty domain, referencing the customer SSOT in the customer domain via FK. One membership per customer per program.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Primary key for membership

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: ENROLLMENT_TRACKING: Loyalty enrollment reports require the associate who performed the member sign‑up to attribute enrollment volume and compliance; the associate_id FK enables this.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Loyalty program cost allocation uses a cost center to budget and report program expenses per member.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household group this membership belongs to, if the member is part of a household loyalty account where multiple members share points and benefits. Null for individual memberships.

attributes.name: membership_preferred_store_store_location_id
attributes.description: The store location the member shops at most frequently, determined by transaction history. Used for localized offers and store-specific promotions.

attributes.name: membership_store_location_id
attributes.description: The store location where the customer enrolled, if enrollment occurred in-store. Null for digital enrollments. Used for store-level enrollment performance tracking.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.program_config. Business justification: Membership participates in a specific loyalty program configuration; link to program_config for governance.

attributes.name: referring_member_membership_id
attributes.description: The membership ID of the existing member who referred this customer, if enrollment came through the member referral program. Null for non-referred enrollments. Used for referral reward attribution.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns this loyalty membership. Links to the customer SSOT in the customer domain.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.tier. Business justification: Membership belongs to a tier; replace string tier with foreign key for referential integrity.

attributes.name: annual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total purchase amount by the member in the current calendar or program year. Used for tier qualification thresholds and high-value member identification. Resets annually.

attributes.name: annual_visit_count
attributes.description: Total number of shopping trips or transactions by the member in the current calendar or program year. Used for frequency-based tier qualification and engagement scoring. Resets annually.

attributes.name: cltv_classification
attributes.description: Segmentation of the member based on their predicted or actual customer lifetime value. High value members receive premium treatment and exclusive offers. At-risk members are targeted for retention campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this membership record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_linked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the membership card has been added to a digital wallet (Apple Wallet, Google Pay) for contactless loyalty identification at POS.

attributes.name: direct_mail_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive physical mail communications including ad circulars and exclusive member offers.

attributes.name: email_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive promotional emails and loyalty program communications via email.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for channel attribution analysis and enrollment campaign effectiveness measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_store|online|mobile_app|pharmacy|fuel_center|call_center|partner — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate membership tenure and anniversary-based rewards.

attributes.name: gamification_level
attributes.description: The current level or rank the member has achieved in the loyalty program gamification system through completing challenges, missions, or milestones. Higher levels unlock exclusive badges and rewards.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: The most recent date the member earned or redeemed points through any transaction. Used for churn prediction and reactivation targeting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this membership record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The most recent date the member made a purchase that earned loyalty points. Used for recency-based segmentation and lapsed member identification.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all loyalty points earned since enrollment, including redeemed and expired points. Used for tier qualification and lifetime value analysis.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all loyalty points redeemed since enrollment. Used for redemption rate analysis and program liability calculation.

attributes.name: membership_number
attributes.description: The externally-known loyalty card number or membership identifier presented at POS and used for points accrual and redemption. This is the business identifier for the membership.

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the membership. Active memberships can earn and redeem points. Inactive memberships have no recent activity. Suspended memberships are temporarily blocked due to policy violations. Closed memberships are permanently terminated. Pending activation memberships are enrolled but not yet verified.

attributes.name: next_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled points expiration event. Null if no points are scheduled to expire. Used for proactive member communication.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recent Net Promoter Score provided by the member through loyalty surveys. Scale of 0-10 where 9-10 are promoters, 7-8 are passives, 0-6 are detractors. Used for satisfaction tracking and churn prediction.

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date the member last completed an NPS survey. Used to determine survey recency and eligibility for follow-up surveys.

attributes.name: points_balance
attributes.description: Current available loyalty points balance that can be redeemed for rewards, discounts, or merchandise. Updated in real-time with each transaction and redemption.

attributes.name: points_expiring_soon
attributes.description: Number of points scheduled to expire within the next 30 days. Used for expiration reminder campaigns and breakage forecasting.

attributes.name: primary_household_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member is the primary account holder for a household loyalty membership. Primary members have administrative privileges to add or remove household members.

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive push notifications through the mobile app for personalized offers and program updates.

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: The source or campaign that led to the member enrollment. Examples: member referral program, social media campaign, in-store promotion, partner co-marketing. Used for acquisition cost analysis and campaign ROI measurement.

attributes.name: sms_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has opted in to receive promotional text messages and loyalty alerts via SMS.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: status_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the current status became effective. Used for status history tracking and reactivation eligibility determination.

attributes.name: status_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason or code explaining the current membership status. Examples: voluntary closure, fraud suspension, inactivity timeout, duplicate account merge, deceased member.

attributes.name: tier_effective_date
attributes.description: The date the customer achieved their current tier level. Used for tier anniversary calculations and tier retention analysis.

attributes.name: tier_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date the current tier expires if tier qualification thresholds are not maintained. Null for lifetime tiers. Used for tier retention campaigns and downgrade warnings.

products.name: tier
products.description: Reference master defining the loyalty program tier structure (e.g., Member, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Captures tier name, tier code, minimum points threshold, maximum points threshold, tier benefits summary, upgrade/downgrade rules, evaluation period, and tier rank order. Drives tier assignment logic and benefit eligibility across the loyalty program.

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty program tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_fuel_grade. Business justification: Business process: Tier discounts are defined per fuel grade; linking tier to product_fuel_grade enables accurate pricing and reporting of fuel discount per gallon.

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount
attributes.description: Annual membership fee in USD required to maintain this tier. Zero for free tiers; positive amount for premium tiers. Used in billing and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: benefits_summary
attributes.description: Comprehensive text description of all benefits and privileges associated with this tier. Used in customer communications, marketing materials, and mobile app displays.

attributes.name: birthday_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to members of this tier on their birthday. Used for gamification and customer engagement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this tier (e.g., USD, CAD). Supports multi-currency loyalty programs.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric order in which this tier should be displayed in user interfaces and reports. Used for consistent presentation across channels.

attributes.name: downgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Business rule description explaining conditions under which customers are downgraded from this tier to a lower tier. Includes minimum points requirements and grace periods.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier configuration is no longer active for new assignments. Null for currently active tiers. Supports tier retirement and program evolution.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this tier configuration becomes active and available for customer assignment. Supports time-based tier launches and program changes.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days over which points are accumulated and evaluated for tier qualification (e.g., 365 for annual evaluation, 90 for quarterly). Defines the rolling window for tier assignment calculations.

attributes.name: exclusive_offers_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive exclusive promotional offers and early access to sales. True if exclusive offers are a tier benefit; false otherwise.

attributes.name: free_delivery_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier are eligible for free delivery on online orders. True if free delivery is a tier benefit; false otherwise.

attributes.name: fuel_discount_cents_per_gallon
attributes.description: Fuel discount in cents per gallon offered to members of this tier at participating fuel centers. Integrates with fuel operations pricing systems.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days customers retain this tier status after falling below the minimum points threshold before being downgraded. Provides buffer period for customers to re-qualify.

attributes.name: icon_url
attributes.description: URL path to the tier icon image used in digital channels (mobile app, website, email). Supports visual tier recognition in customer-facing applications.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: marketing_color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used to represent this tier in marketing materials, mobile apps, and customer communications (e.g., #FFD700 for Gold). Ensures consistent brand presentation.

attributes.name: maximum_points_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of loyalty points for this tier. Customers earning more than this threshold during the evaluation period qualify for the next higher tier. Null for the highest tier.

attributes.name: minimum_points_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum number of loyalty points required to qualify for this tier. Customers must earn at least this many points during the evaluation period to achieve or maintain this tier.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this tier record. Supports audit trail and accountability for tier configuration changes.

attributes.name: points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earned by members of this tier (e.g., 1.0 for base tier, 1.5 for Silver, 2.0 for Gold). Used to calculate accelerated points accrual for higher tiers.

attributes.name: priority_customer_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this tier receive priority customer service (e.g., dedicated phone line, faster response times). True if priority service is a tier benefit; false otherwise.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier (e.g., MEMBER, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM). Used as business identifier in external systems and customer communications.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the loyalty tier (e.g., Member, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Used in customer-facing applications and marketing materials.

attributes.name: tier_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank order of the tier within the loyalty program hierarchy. Lower numbers indicate higher status (e.g., 1=Platinum, 2=Gold, 3=Silver, 4=Member). Used for tier comparison and upgrade/downgrade logic.

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tier. Active tiers are available for customer assignment; inactive tiers are no longer offered but may have existing members; deprecated tiers are being phased out; pending tiers are scheduled for future launch.

attributes.name: upgrade_rule_description
attributes.description: Business rule description explaining how customers qualify for upgrade to this tier from a lower tier. Includes points thresholds, evaluation periods, and any additional criteria.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this tier configuration. Incremented with each modification to support change history and rollback capabilities.

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points
attributes.description: Number of bonus loyalty points awarded to customers when they first achieve this tier. Used to incentivize tier upgrades.

products.name: tier_history
products.description: Transactional record of every tier change event for a loyalty member. Captures previous tier, new tier, effective date, expiry date, reason code (earned upgrade, annual reset, manual adjustment, demotion), points balance at time of change, and the triggering transaction reference. Enables tier progression analytics and member lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: tier_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each tier change event in the loyalty program. Primary key for the tier history transactional record.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the customer service representative or administrator who performed the manual tier adjustment. Null for automated tier changes.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program member who experienced this tier change event.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the omnichannel order that triggered this tier change event, if applicable. Null for in-store or system-initiated tier changes.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Tier changes are often triggered by cumulative spend on payment transactions; linking supports tier‑evaluation reports and automated tier upgrades.

attributes.name: points_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Point of Sale (POS) transaction that triggered this tier change event, if applicable. Null for system-initiated or manual tier changes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the new tier status became active and the member began receiving benefits associated with the new tier level.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the tier change was applied in the loyalty system, used for real-time benefit activation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the qualification period used to evaluate tier eligibility for this change event.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the qualification period used to evaluate tier eligibility for this change event (e.g., program year start, rolling 12-month window start).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the new tier status is scheduled to expire, typically aligned with program year-end or qualification period end. Null for indefinite tier assignments.

attributes.name: is_manual_adjustment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this tier change was manually adjusted by customer service or loyalty program administrators rather than automatically triggered by system rules.

attributes.name: manual_adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for manual tier adjustments, including customer service case reference, goodwill gesture context, or system error correction details. Null for automated tier changes.

attributes.name: new_tier_code
attributes.description: The loyalty tier code the member transitioned to as a result of this change event (e.g., BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM).

attributes.name: new_tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the new loyalty tier for reporting and customer communication.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the member of the tier change: email, SMS (text message), app_push (mobile app notification), in_store (receipt or kiosk), or mail (postal).

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a tier change notification (email, SMS, app push) was successfully sent to the member.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tier change notification was sent to the member through Customer Relationship Management (CRM) or loyalty communication channels.

attributes.name: points_balance_at_change
attributes.description: The total loyalty points balance the member held at the exact moment of the tier change event, used for tier progression analytics and member lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: previous_tier_code
attributes.description: The loyalty tier code the member held immediately before this change event (e.g., BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM).

attributes.name: previous_tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the previous loyalty tier for reporting and customer communication.

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The loyalty program year during which this tier change occurred, used for annual tier reset and year-over-year progression analytics.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative spend amount that qualified the member for this tier change, measured over the qualification period. Null for non-spend-based tier changes.

attributes.name: qualifying_transaction_count
attributes.description: The number of qualifying transactions completed during the evaluation period that contributed to this tier change. Null for non-transaction-based tier changes.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier history record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tier history record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer, used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this tier change record (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, NCR POS Systems, custom loyalty platform).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this tier change record in the source operational system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tier_benefits_activated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all tier-specific benefits (discounts, free delivery, exclusive offers) have been successfully activated in the members profile.

attributes.name: tier_change_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for this tier change event, used for customer service inquiries and audit trails.

attributes.name: tier_change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the tier change occurred (e.g., EARNED_UPGRADE for qualifying spend threshold, ANNUAL_RESET for program year rollover, MANUAL_ADJ for customer service adjustment, DEMOTION for inactivity, PROMO_BOOST for promotional tier grant).

attributes.name: tier_change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business reason for the tier change, including any special circumstances or promotional context.

attributes.name: tier_change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this tier change record: active (currently in effect), expired (tier period ended), reversed (change was rolled back), or pending (scheduled but not yet effective).

attributes.name: tier_change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tier movement direction: upgrade (tier improvement), downgrade (tier reduction), lateral (same tier level but different program), initial_enrollment (first tier assignment), or reset (annual program reset).

attributes.name: welcome_bonus_points
attributes.description: Bonus loyalty points awarded to the member as a welcome gift upon achieving the new tier level. Zero or null if no bonus was granted.

products.name: points_account
products.description: Master ledger account tracking the current balance for each loyalty membership across all loyalty currencies (points and fuel cents-per-gallon). Captures account type (points, fuel reward), total earned, redeemed, expired, pending (not yet confirmed), available balance, lifetime earned, maximum redemption limits (e.g., max gallons for fuel), earn period windows, and last activity date. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for a members loyalty currency position, supporting real-time balance inquiries at POS, digital channels, and fuel center pumps.

attributes.name: points_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty points account. Primary key for the points account ledger.

attributes.name: loyalty_membership_id
