attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership that owns this points account. Each membership may have multiple accounts (points, fuel rewards).

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique account number displayed to members on statements, mobile app, and at POS. Human-readable identifier for customer service interactions.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the points account. Active accounts allow earn and redemption; suspended accounts block transactions pending review; frozen accounts prevent redemptions but allow earning; closed accounts are permanently inactive.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of loyalty currency tracked in this account. Points accounts track standard loyalty points; fuel reward accounts track cents-per-gallon discounts; bonus and promotional accounts track time-limited currencies.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the points account was activated and became eligible for earning and redemption. May differ from creation date if account required verification or approval.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Current balance of loyalty currency available for immediate redemption. Excludes pending and expired amounts. This is the authoritative SSOT for real-time balance inquiries at POS, digital channels, and fuel pumps.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the points account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts. Closed accounts cannot be reopened; members must create new accounts.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for account closure. Used for churn analysis, compliance reporting, and member service quality tracking. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the points account record was first created in the system. Used for account age analysis, audit trails, and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Code representing the loyalty currency unit. PTS=points, FPG=fuel points per gallon, CPG=cents per gallon, USD=cashback dollars. Aligns with program currency definitions.

attributes.name: earn_multiplier
attributes.description: Current earning rate multiplier applied to this account. Base rate is 1.0; tier upgrades or promotions may increase to 1.5x, 2.0x, etc. Applied to all qualifying purchases.

attributes.name: earn_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current earning period window. Points earned during this period may have specific expiration rules or tier qualification impact.

attributes.name: earn_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current earning period window. Used for time-bound promotions, seasonal campaigns, and rolling expiration calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_policy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the expiration policy applied to this account. References program rules for time-based expiration, rolling windows, or activity-based extension. Used for automated expiration processing.

attributes.name: external_account_code
attributes.description: Account identifier from the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data integration, and troubleshooting. May differ from the lakehouse primary key.

attributes.name: fraud_hold_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fraud hold was placed on the account. Used for hold duration tracking and compliance with fraud investigation timelines. Null if no hold is active.

attributes.name: fraud_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is under fraud review hold. When true, all earn and redemption transactions are blocked pending investigation. Set by fraud detection systems.

attributes.name: is_combinable
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty currency from this account can be combined with other payment methods or loyalty currencies in a single transaction. Used for POS redemption logic.

attributes.name: is_transferable
attributes.description: Indicates whether loyalty currency in this account can be transferred to another member or household account. Typically false for standard points, may be true for family pooling programs.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent account activity of any type (earn, redemption, adjustment, inquiry). Used for dormancy rules, account closure policies, and member lifecycle management.

attributes.name: last_earn_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent loyalty currency earning transaction. Used for inactivity tracking, dormancy detection, and member re-engagement campaigns.

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent loyalty currency redemption transaction. Used for engagement analysis, redemption velocity tracking, and member behavior segmentation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this points account record. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: lifetime_adjusted
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount of loyalty currency adjusted due to corrections, reversals, goodwill credits, or fraud chargebacks. Can be positive or negative. Used for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: lifetime_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount of loyalty currency earned since account inception. Never decreases. Used for tier qualification, member recognition, and lifetime value analytics.

attributes.name: lifetime_expired
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount of loyalty currency that has expired due to inactivity or time-based expiration policies. Used for breakage analysis and program liability management.

attributes.name: lifetime_redeemed
attributes.description: Total cumulative amount of loyalty currency redeemed since account inception. Never decreases. Used for program ROI analysis and member engagement metrics.

attributes.name: max_redemption_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum amount of loyalty currency that can be redeemed within a 24-hour period. Used for fraud prevention and program liability management.

attributes.name: max_redemption_per_transaction
attributes.description: Maximum amount of loyalty currency that can be redeemed in a single transaction. For fuel rewards, this typically represents maximum gallons eligible for discount (e.g., 20 gallons). Enforced at POS and fuel pump.

attributes.name: next_expiration_amount
attributes.description: Amount of loyalty currency scheduled to expire on the next expiration date. Used for proactive member engagement campaigns to encourage redemption before expiration.

attributes.name: next_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the next batch of loyalty currency is scheduled to expire. Used for member communication, expiration alerts, and breakage forecasting. Null if no expiration policy applies.

attributes.name: pending_balance
attributes.description: Balance of loyalty currency earned but not yet confirmed or posted to available balance. Typically represents transactions awaiting settlement, return windows, or fraud review periods.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that created and maintains this points account. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and system migration tracking.

attributes.name: year_to_date_earned
attributes.description: Total loyalty currency earned in the current calendar year. Resets to zero on January 1. Used for annual tier qualification and member performance tracking.

attributes.name: year_to_date_redeemed
attributes.description: Total loyalty currency redeemed in the current calendar year. Resets to zero on January 1. Used for redemption velocity analysis and program engagement metrics.

products.name: points_transaction
products.description: Granular transactional ledger recording every loyalty currency movement — accrual, redemption, adjustment, expiry, transfer, or bonus — against a loyalty account. This is the single authoritative SSOT for all loyalty value exchanges including point-for-discount redemptions, free item claims, fuel cents-per-gallon usage, pharmacy reward fulfillment, and all reward redemption events. Supports both points and fuel reward currencies. Captures transaction type (earn, redeem, expire, adjust, transfer, bonus), currency type (points, fuel cents-per-gallon), amount, transaction timestamp, source channel (POS, eCommerce, pharmacy, fuel center pump), gallons dispensed (fuel redemptions), redemption method and fulfillment status (for redeem transactions), redemption type detail (points-for-discount, free item, fuel cents-per-gallon, pharmacy copay reduction), originating order or receipt reference, promotion reference, partner reference, store location, and running balance after transaction. Provides complete audit trail for financial reconciliation, SOX compliance evidence, and ASC 606 breakage analysis inputs. Integrates with NCR POS loyalty module and fuel center systems.

attributes.name: points_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty points transaction. Primary key for the points transaction ledger.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or customer service representative who processed this transaction. Populated for manual adjustments, customer service interventions, and call center transactions. Null for automated system transactions. Used for SOX compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: Points earned per transaction are often SKU‑specific; linking to assortment_item supports points‑earned‑by‑SKU reporting for loyalty program analytics.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Required for points‑fraud audit reports linking specific points transactions to audit findings.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel.fuel_center. Business justification: Required for loyalty points transaction fuel discount reporting per fuel center, enabling the Loyalty Discount Utilization Report used by program managers.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_fuel_grade. Business justification: Business process: Fuel purchase points and discount amounts depend on the fuel grade bought; linking transaction to product_fuel_grade allows correct points accrual and audit.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounting process posts each points transaction to a GL account for expense/revenue recognition; required for financial statements.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership account that owns this transaction.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: Required for Points‑Earned per Transaction report, linking each points transaction to its originating payment transaction for audit and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescription. Business justification: Needed to attribute earned points to the specific prescription fill for audit, tier‑based discounts, and points‑earned reporting.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order or purchase transaction that triggered this points movement. Populated for earn and redeem transactions tied to a specific order. Null for non-purchase transactions (expire, adjust, bonus).

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional campaign or offer that triggered this points movement. Used for bonus points, promotional earn multipliers, and targeted reward offers. Null for standard earn/redeem transactions.

attributes.name: related_transaction_points_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to another points transaction that this transaction is related to. Used for reversal transactions (points to the original transaction being reversed), transfer transactions (links sender and receiver transactions), and adjustment transactions (links to the transaction being corrected). Null for standalone transactions.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the transaction occurred. Populated for POS, pharmacy, and fuel center transactions. Null for eCommerce and partner transactions.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external partner or coalition program involved in this transaction. Used for co-branded loyalty programs, airline miles transfers, and third-party reward integrations. Null for internal Grocery loyalty transactions.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.wave. Business justification: Needed for Operational Efficiency Analysis tying points earned to the specific picking wave that fulfilled the order, used in performance dashboards.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Quantity of loyalty currency moved in this transaction. Positive for accruals (earn, bonus, transfer-in), negative for deductions (redeem, expire, adjust-down, transfer-out). For points currency this is the point count; for fuel currency this is cents-per-gallon discount value.

attributes.name: batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the batch processing job that created this transaction record. Used for bulk operations such as nightly expiration processing, monthly tier bonus awards, and partner point transfers. Null for real-time individual transactions. Supports operational troubleshooting and reprocessing scenarios.

attributes.name: breakage_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is eligible for breakage revenue recognition under ASC 606. True for earned points that may expire unused, allowing the company to recognize a portion of deferred revenue as breakage. False for redeemed, expired, or adjusted points. Used in financial reporting and actuarial breakage analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was first created in the loyalty system. Distinct from transaction_timestamp which represents the business event time. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and troubleshooting data latency issues. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Type of loyalty currency involved in this transaction. Points are the primary loyalty currency; fuel cents-per-gallon represents fuel discount rewards earned through the loyalty program.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty currency from this transaction will expire if not used. Populated for earn and bonus transactions based on program expiration policy (e.g., points expire 12 months from earn date). Used to calculate points-expiring-soon alerts and ASC 606 breakage analysis. Null for redeem, expire, and adjust transactions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fuel_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of fuel discount applied at the pump, calculated as gallons dispensed multiplied by cents-per-gallon reward rate. Used for financial reconciliation and revenue recognition. Populated only for fuel redemptions. Null for all other transaction types.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current state of the reward fulfillment for redeem transactions. Pending indicates redemption request received but not yet processed, fulfilled indicates reward successfully delivered, failed indicates technical or business rule failure, reversed indicates redemption was cancelled and points restored, cancelled indicates customer or system cancelled before fulfillment. Null for non-redemption transactions.

attributes.name: gallons_dispensed
attributes.description: Number of gallons of fuel dispensed for fuel redemption transactions. Used to calculate the total dollar discount applied (gallons × cents-per-gallon). Populated only for fuel center redemptions. Null for all other transaction types.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transaction record was last updated. Used to track changes to fulfillment status, corrections to transaction details, and audit trail for SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why this transaction occurred. Used primarily for adjust, expire, reversal, and bonus transactions. Examples: ADJ-001 (customer service goodwill), EXP-POLICY (standard expiration), REV-RETURN (order return), BONUS-TIER (tier anniversary bonus). Supports audit trail and customer service inquiry.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the transaction reason, providing additional context beyond the reason code. Used for customer service notes, adjustment justifications, and audit documentation. Particularly important for manual adjustments and reversals.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Receipt or transaction number from the Point of Sale (POS) system or eCommerce order confirmation. Used for customer service lookup and reconciliation with financial systems.

attributes.name: redemption_method
attributes.description: How the redemption was triggered. Automatic redemptions apply rewards without customer action (e.g., auto-apply fuel discount), manual redemptions require cashier or customer service intervention, customer-initiated redemptions are explicitly requested by the member (e.g., selecting reward in mobile app), system-initiated redemptions are triggered by business rules (e.g., expiring points converted to charity donation). Populated only for redeem transactions.

attributes.name: redemption_type
attributes.description: Specific method of reward redemption for redeem transactions. Points-for-discount applies points as basket discount at checkout, free item claims a specific product reward, fuel cents-per-gallon applies fuel discount at pump, pharmacy copay reduction lowers prescription cost, charity donation converts points to charitable contribution, partner transfer moves points to external program. Null for non-redemption transactions.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previous transaction. True for reversal transactions that cancel or correct prior points movements (e.g., order return, redemption cancellation). False for all original transactions. Used to filter reversals from financial reporting and customer lifetime value calculations.

attributes.name: running_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative balance of loyalty currency in the membership account after this transaction is applied. Provides point-in-time snapshot for audit trail and customer service inquiry. Calculated as prior balance plus/minus transaction amount.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel or system where the transaction originated. POS (Point of Sale) for in-store purchases, eCommerce for online orders, pharmacy for prescription fulfillment, fuel center for fuel pump transactions, mobile app for app-based activities, call center for customer service adjustments, partner API for third-party integrations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pos|ecommerce|pharmacy|fuel_center|mobile_app|call_center|partner_api — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this transaction record. Examples: NCR-POS-LOYALTY, SFCC-ECOMMERCE, MCKESSON-PHARMACY, FUEL-CENTER-SYSTEM, CRM-MANUAL-ADJUST. Used for data lineage, troubleshooting, and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this transaction in the originating source system. Used for end-to-end traceability, reconciliation with source systems, and troubleshooting data quality issues. Enables lookup of original transaction details in NCR POS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or other source systems.

attributes.name: tax_impact_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of tax impact associated with this loyalty transaction. Used for financial accounting when loyalty redemptions affect taxable sales (e.g., fuel discount reduces taxable fuel revenue). Supports ASC 606 revenue recognition and tax compliance reporting. Null for transactions with no tax impact.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, IRS Tax Compliance

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number for customer service reference and audit trail. Externally visible identifier for this points movement.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loyalty currency movement occurred in the source system. This is the business event time, not the ETL load time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of loyalty currency movement: earn (points accrual from purchase or activity), redeem (points used for reward), expire (points removed due to expiration policy), adjust (manual correction by customer service), transfer (points moved between accounts), bonus (promotional or tier bonus points), reversal (cancellation of prior transaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|expire|adjust|transfer|bonus|reversal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: reward_offer
products.description: Master catalog of personalized and program-wide reward offers available to loyalty members. Captures offer name, offer type (points multiplier, free item, discount, fuel reward, pharmacy reward, sweepstakes entry), earn or redemption mechanics, minimum spend threshold, eligible SKU or category scope, offer start and end dates, maximum redemptions per member, and targeting segment criteria. Distinct from promotion domain offers — these are loyalty-program-specific rewards tied to membership status.

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty reward offer. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Offer redemption costs are charged against a predefined budget; required for offer ROI and budget variance reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_fuel_grade. Business justification: Business process: Fuel‑related reward offers apply to specific fuel grades; the FK identifies the grade for eligibility checks and reporting.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this offer to a broader marketing campaign or promotional initiative. Null if standalone offer.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Supplier‑sponsored reward offers need a supplier reference to manage budgets, compliance, and performance metrics per supplier.

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether offer is automatically applied at checkout when conditions are met (True) or requires manual activation (False).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Finance cost center code responsible for funding this reward offer for budget tracking and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reward offer record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_redemption_count
attributes.description: Running total of redemptions that have occurred for this offer across all members.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount applied when offer is redeemed. BOGO = Buy One Get One. Null if not a discount offer.

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount (percentage or dollar amount depending on discount_type). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: eligible_channel_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of purchase channels where offer can be redeemed (e.g., in-store, online, mobile app, pickup, delivery).

attributes.name: eligible_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific SKU codes eligible for this offer. Null if offer applies to categories or all products.

attributes.name: eligible_tier_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of loyalty membership tiers eligible for this offer (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum). Null if available to all tiers.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the reward offer expires and is no longer available for activation or redemption.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_per_redemption
attributes.description: Projected financial cost to the business for each redemption of this offer including discounts, points liability, and operational costs.

attributes.name: excluded_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU codes explicitly excluded from this offer even if they fall within eligible categories.

attributes.name: fuel_reward_cents_per_gallon
attributes.description: Discount amount in cents per gallon applied at fuel centers when offer is redeemed. Null if not a fuel reward offer.

attributes.name: gamification_badge_name
attributes.description: Name of digital badge or achievement unlocked when offer is completed. Null if not part of gamification program.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reward offer record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: max_redemptions_per_member
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single member can redeem this offer during its validity period. Null for unlimited.

attributes.name: max_redemptions_total
attributes.description: Maximum total number of redemptions allowed across all members for this offer. Null for unlimited.

attributes.name: mechanics_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the offer is for earning points, redeeming points, or a combination of both.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualifying items that must be purchased to activate the offer. Null if no quantity requirement.

attributes.name: minimum_spend_amount
attributes.description: Minimum purchase amount required to qualify for the reward offer. Null if no minimum required.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the reward offer for tracking and redemption purposes.

attributes.name: offer_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reward offer including terms, conditions, and member benefits.

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the reward offer displayed to loyalty members.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reward offer indicating availability to members.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Category of reward offer defining the benefit mechanism provided to the member.

attributes.name: personalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer was generated through personalized recommendation engine (True) or is a program-wide offer (False).

attributes.name: pharmacy_reward_description
attributes.description: Description of pharmacy-specific reward benefit (e.g., discount on prescriptions, health screening credit). Null if not a pharmacy offer.

attributes.name: points_award_amount
attributes.description: Fixed number of bonus points awarded when offer conditions are met. Null if offer uses multiplier instead.

attributes.name: points_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base points earning rate for qualifying purchases (e.g., 2.0 for double points, 3.0 for triple points). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: redemption_end_date
attributes.description: Final date by which activated offers must be redeemed. May extend beyond offer end_date.

attributes.name: redemption_start_date
attributes.description: Date when members can begin redeeming this offer. May differ from activation date for earn-then-redeem mechanics.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers or promotions (True) or is mutually exclusive (False).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the reward offer becomes active and available to qualifying members.

attributes.name: sweepstakes_entry_count
attributes.description: Number of sweepstakes entries awarded when offer conditions are met. Null if not a sweepstakes offer.

attributes.name: target_roi_percentage
attributes.description: Target return on investment percentage for this offer based on incremental revenue and customer lifetime value impact.

attributes.name: targeting_segment_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining which member segments are eligible for this offer (e.g., tier, spend level, purchase behavior, demographics).

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the reward offer including restrictions, exclusions, and member obligations.

products.name: member_offer
products.description: Association record linking a specific reward offer to a specific loyalty member, representing a personalized offer assignment. Captures assignment date, activation status (loaded, activated, redeemed, expired), activation channel, redemption date, redemption transaction reference, and offer source (targeted, self-selected, tier benefit). Enables tracking of which members have which offers loaded to their card.

attributes.name: member_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the member offer assignment record. Primary key for this association entity linking a loyalty member to a specific reward offer.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: Targeted offer assignment process uses member_offer to apply offers to specific SKUs; linking to assortment_item enables SKU‑level offer performance tracking.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership record. Identifies which member this offer is assigned to.

attributes.name: points_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Point of Sale (POS) transaction where the offer was redeemed. Links the offer redemption to the specific purchase event.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that generated this offer assignment. Null if the offer was not part of a campaign. Enables campaign-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reward offer definition. Identifies which offer has been assigned to this member.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Store location where the offer was redeemed. Enables store-level redemption analytics and location-based offer performance tracking.

attributes.name: activation_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the member activated the offer. Tracks which touchpoint the member used to clip or engage with the offer.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the member activated or clipped the offer. Null if the offer has not been activated yet. Represents member engagement with the offer.

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the member activated the offer. Used for detailed engagement tracking and time-to-activation analytics.

attributes.name: assignment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the offer was assigned to the member. Indicates the touchpoint where the offer was delivered or made available.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the offer was assigned to the member. Represents when the offer became available for this member to view or activate.

attributes.name: assignment_source
attributes.description: Source or method by which the offer was assigned. Distinguishes between targeted offers pushed by the system, offers selected by the member, tier-based automatic benefits, and other assignment mechanisms.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the offer was assigned to the member. Used for detailed tracking and sequencing of offer assignments.

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer is automatically applied at Point of Sale (POS) without requiring member activation. True for automatic offers, false for clip-to-card offers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this member offer assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of the discount applied when the offer was redeemed. Null if not redeemed or if the offer is points-based rather than discount-based. Represents actual savings to the member.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this member offer assignment expires. After this date, the member can no longer redeem the offer. May differ from the base offer expiration if member-specific extensions apply.

attributes.name: first_view_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the member first viewed this offer. Null if the member has not viewed the offer. Used to calculate time-to-activation and engagement velocity.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this member offer assignment record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in this record.

attributes.name: last_view_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the member most recently viewed this offer. Tracks ongoing member interest and re-engagement patterns.

attributes.name: member_offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the member offer assignment. Tracks progression from loaded to card, through activation, redemption, or expiration.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Channel used to notify the member about this offer. Null or none if no notification was sent. Enables channel effectiveness comparison.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a notification was sent to the member about this offer assignment. True if notification was sent, false otherwise.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the notification about this offer was sent to the member. Null if no notification was sent. Supports notification effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: personalization_score
attributes.description: Algorithmic score representing how well this offer matches the member's predicted preferences and purchase behavior. Higher scores indicate better personalization. Used for offer targeting optimization.

attributes.name: points_awarded
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points awarded to the member upon redemption of this offer. Null if the offer has not been redeemed or if the offer does not award points.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this offer relative to other offers assigned to the same member. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for offer display ordering and conflict resolution.

attributes.name: redemption_date
attributes.description: Date when the member redeemed the offer through a qualifying purchase. Null if the offer has not been redeemed yet.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the offer was redeemed. Matches the transaction timestamp for the qualifying purchase.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the offer was revoked or removed from the member's account. Null if the offer has not been revoked. Used for fraud prevention or policy violations.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the offer was revoked from the member. Null if not revoked. Supports compliance and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers in the same transaction. True if stackable, false if mutually exclusive.

attributes.name: targeting_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment or cohort used to target this offer to the member. Identifies the segmentation strategy that resulted in this assignment.

attributes.name: view_count
attributes.description: Number of times the member viewed this offer in digital channels. Used to measure offer visibility and member interest before activation.

products.name: loyalty_redemption
products.description: Transactional record capturing each loyalty reward redemption event — when a member uses points or a reward offer at checkout. Captures redemption type (points-for-discount, free item, fuel cents-per-gallon, pharmacy copay reduction), redemption amount (points or dollar value), redemption channel (in-store POS, online, fuel center, pharmacy), store location, transaction timestamp, and fulfillment status. Integrates with NCR POS and Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS.

attributes.name: loyalty_redemption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty reward redemption transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the cashier who processed the in-store redemption. Null for online/self-service redemptions.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: Redemption Impact Report requires tying each redemption to the exact assortment_item for margin and inventory analysis.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fuel center location where fuel discount was redeemed. Null for non-fuel redemptions.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty membership that performed this redemption.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the omnichannel order (delivery or pickup) where the redemption was applied. Null for in-store POS transactions.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: External transaction identifier from the Point of Sale (POS) or Order Management System (OMS) where the redemption occurred. Links to NCR POS or Salesforce Commerce Cloud transaction.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmacy prescription where copay reduction was applied. Null for non-pharmacy redemptions. Contains protected health information.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that generated the redeemed offer. Null for standard points redemptions.

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific personalized reward offer or promotion that was redeemed. Null if redemption was a standard points-for-discount conversion.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the redemption occurred. Null for online-only redemptions.

attributes.name: basket_total_after_redemption
attributes.description: Total transaction amount after the loyalty redemption discount was applied.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: basket_total_amount
attributes.description: Total transaction amount before the loyalty redemption discount was applied. Provides context for redemption impact.
attributes.references: NCR POS Systems; Salesforce Commerce Cloud

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface where the redemption occurred: in-store POS, online web, mobile app, fuel center, pharmacy, or curbside pickup.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was first created in the loyalty system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the redemption value amount.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used to process the redemption: POS terminal, web browser, mobile app, in-store kiosk, or fuel pump interface.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the redeemed offer or reward. Null for non-expiring points redemptions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the redemption failed or was reversed. Null for successful redemptions.

attributes.name: fuel_discount_per_gallon
attributes.description: Cents-per-gallon discount applied to fuel purchase. Null for non-fuel redemptions.

attributes.name: fuel_gallons_purchased
attributes.description: Number of gallons of fuel purchased when fuel discount was applied. Null for non-fuel redemptions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the redemption fulfillment: completed (successfully applied), pending (awaiting confirmation), failed (could not be applied), reversed (refunded/cancelled), or expired (offer expired before use).

attributes.name: gamification_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption was part of a gamification event or challenge (True) or a standard redemption (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was last updated (e.g., status change, reversal). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: nps_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption event qualifies the member for a Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey (True/False).

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.description: Member's loyalty points balance immediately after this redemption was processed.

attributes.name: points_balance_before
attributes.description: Member's loyalty points balance immediately before this redemption was processed.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty points deducted from the member's balance for this redemption. Zero if redemption was a non-points reward (e.g., free item offer).

attributes.name: redemption_source
attributes.description: How the redemption was initiated: member-initiated (customer selected), auto-applied (system automatically applied best offer), cashier-applied (store associate applied), or system-triggered (rule-based application).

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loyalty reward was redeemed at checkout. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: redemption_type
attributes.description: Category of loyalty reward redeemed: points-for-discount (points converted to dollar discount), free item (product reward), fuel cents-per-gallon (fuel center discount), pharmacy copay reduction (prescription discount), percentage off, or dollar off.

attributes.name: register_number
attributes.description: Point of Sale (POS) register or terminal number where the redemption was processed. Null for online redemptions.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for reversing the redemption (e.g., transaction void, return, system error). Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the redemption was reversed (points restored, discount removed). Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier of the product associated with the redemption (for free item or product-specific discount redemptions). Null for non-product redemptions.

attributes.name: tier_at_redemption
attributes.description: Loyalty tier code of the member at the time of redemption. Captured for historical analysis of tier-based redemption behavior.

attributes.name: value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the redemption in local currency (dollar discount applied, fuel savings, copay reduction, or retail value of free item).

products.name: household_member
products.description: Association record linking individual loyalty memberships to a household unit. Captures membership role within household (primary, secondary, dependent), join date, leave date, relationship type (spouse, child, parent, roommate), points pooling participation flag, pooling contribution percentage, spending authority level, communication preference override, benefit sharing tier, and household-level offer eligibility override. Enables household-level analytics, shared benefit management, and pooled points governance.

attributes.name: household_member_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the household member association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household unit to which this member belongs.

attributes.name: primary_household_membership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual loyalty membership record associated with this household member.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location this household member most frequently shops at. Used for localized offers and inventory planning.

attributes.name: annual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount spent by this household member in the current calendar year. Used for member value segmentation and household contribution analysis.

attributes.name: annual_visit_count
attributes.description: Total number of shopping visits or transactions by this household member in the current calendar year. Used for engagement and frequency analysis.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this household member association was approved. Null if approval is pending or not required.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status for this household member association. Pending members await primary member approval, rejected members were denied, revoked members had approval withdrawn, and approved members are active.

attributes.name: benefit_sharing_tier
attributes.description: Level of household benefits this member is eligible to receive. Full tier receives all household benefits, partial receives select benefits, restricted has limited access, and none receives no shared benefits.

attributes.name: card_number
attributes.description: Physical or virtual loyalty card number assigned to this household member for POS (Point of Sale) identification. May be shared across household or unique per member depending on program rules.

attributes.name: communication_preference_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member inherits household communication preferences, has custom individual preferences, or suppresses all household communications. Enables personalized communication strategies within households.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household member record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: digital_wallet_linked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member has linked their individual digital wallet to the household loyalty account for seamless point accrual and redemption at POS (Point of Sale).

attributes.name: email_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member has opted in to receive email communications about household loyalty benefits and offers. Only applies when communication_preference_override is custom.

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member can access and redeem household fuel rewards at fuel centers. Enables household-level fuel discount pooling and redemption tracking.

attributes.name: household_member_status
attributes.description: Current status of this household member association. Active members participate in household benefits, inactive members have left, suspended members are temporarily blocked, and pending members await approval.

attributes.name: invitation_accepted_date
attributes.description: Date when this member accepted the household invitation. Null if invitation is pending or was declined.

attributes.name: invitation_code
attributes.description: Unique code used to invite this member to join the household. Tracks invitation source and enables secure household joining workflows.

attributes.name: invitation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the household invitation was sent to this member. Used to track invitation response time and follow-up campaigns.

attributes.name: join_date
attributes.description: Date when this member was added to the household. Used to track household growth and member tenure.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this household member record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent purchase or loyalty activity by this household member. Used to track member engagement and identify inactive members.

attributes.name: leave_date
attributes.description: Date when this member left or was removed from the household. Null if the member is currently active in the household.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_contributed
attributes.description: Total loyalty points this member has contributed to the household pool since joining. Used for household contribution analytics and member value assessment.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total loyalty points this member has redeemed from the household pool since joining. Used to track member redemption behavior and benefit utilization.

attributes.name: member_role
attributes.description: Role of this member within the household loyalty structure. Primary members have full administrative rights, secondary members have shared benefits, dependents have limited access, and authorized users can transact on behalf of the household.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes about this household member association. May include special circumstances, restrictions, or customer service history relevant to household management.

attributes.name: offer_eligibility_override
attributes.description: Override flag for household-level offer eligibility. Inherit uses household rules, eligible forces inclusion in household offers, ineligible excludes this member from household offers. Used for compliance or member preference scenarios.

attributes.name: pharmacy_benefits_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member can access household pharmacy loyalty benefits such as prescription discounts or health rewards. Subject to HIPAA privacy rules and state pharmacy regulations.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR 164.502, State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: points_pooling_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this member participates in household-level points pooling. When true, points earned by this member contribute to the shared household balance.

attributes.name: pooling_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of points earned by this member that are contributed to the household pool. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Enables partial pooling scenarios where members retain some individual points.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship this member has to the primary household member. Used for household composition analytics and targeted family offers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|partner|child|parent|sibling|roommate|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sms_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household member has opted in to receive SMS text messages about household loyalty benefits and offers. Only applies when communication_preference_override is custom.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: spending_authority_level
attributes.description: Level of authority this member has to redeem household points or use household benefits. Full authority allows unrestricted redemption, limited requires approval thresholds, view-only can see but not transact, and none has no access.

attributes.name: spending_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar value or points this member can redeem per transaction or per period without additional approval. Null indicates no limit. Used for dependent and secondary member governance.

products.name: gamification_challenge
products.description: Master catalog of gamification challenges and missions available within the loyalty program. Captures challenge name, challenge type (streak, milestone, category exploration, spend threshold, visit frequency), required actions, points or reward upon completion, challenge duration, eligible member tiers, maximum completions per member, and challenge status (active, upcoming, expired). Supports engagement-driven loyalty mechanics beyond simple earn/burn.

attributes.name: gamification_challenge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gamification challenge. Primary key for the gamification challenge entity.

attributes.name: auto_enroll_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether eligible members are automatically enrolled in this challenge (true) or must opt-in manually (false).

attributes.name: badge_icon_url
attributes.description: URL to the badge or achievement icon awarded to members upon challenge completion, displayed in their profile.

attributes.name: category_filter

products.name: engagement_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all non-purchase loyalty engagement activities including digital interactions, in-store visits, and survey responses. Covers app downloads, profile completions, survey responses (including NPS with score/classification/verbatim), referrals, social shares, pharmacy consultation check-ins, click-and-collect first use, store visit check-ins with dwell time and department tracking, and campaign-triggered engagements. Captures event type, event timestamp, channel, detection method (card scan, app, beacon, Wi-Fi), points awarded, dwell time (for visits), NPS score (for surveys), and engagement campaign reference. Supports dwell time analytics and NPS contribution tracking.

products.name: program_config
products.description: Reference master storing the complete configuration and business rules for each loyalty program as structured rule sets. Captures program identity (name, version, launch date, status), earn rule sets (base earn rates by category, private-label multipliers, channel bonuses, tier-based rate tables, bonus stacking priority), expiry rule sets (rolling inactivity windows, fixed calendar expiry dates, tier-based extensions, grace periods, notification lead days), redemption parameters (minimum threshold, points-to-dollar conversion rates, fuel cents-per-gallon caps, maximum single-redemption limits), welcome/referral/birthday bonus definitions, tier evaluation frequency and method, and multi-program support (standard grocery, pharmacy rewards, fuel rewards club). Organized as one record per program with nested structured rule objects — not a flat attribute blob. Supports program versioning for A/B testing and phased rollouts.

attributes.name: case_type

attributes.name: comments

attributes.references: Currency code for monetary equivalents, if applicable

attributes.name: dispute_number

attributes.name: fraud_category

attributes.name: fraud_dispute_status

attributes.name: fraud_severity

attributes.name: hold_end_date

attributes.name: is_fraud_hold

attributes.name: points_adjusted_amount

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.name: resolution_notes

attributes.name: sla_met_flag

attributes.name: source_record_reference

products.name: offer_category
products.description: This association represents the eligibility mapping between a loyalty reward offer and a merchandise category. Each row links one reward_offer to one category and records the store scope for which the offer is valid.. Existence Justification: Loyalty teams actively define reward offers and assign them to one or more merchandise categories. A single category can be targeted by many offers, and each offer can apply to multiple categories, requiring a managed mapping that is updated as offers are created or retired.

attributes.name: offer_category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the offer_category association

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to category

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reward_offer

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Store where this reward offer is applicable for the linked category

attributes.name: eligible_category_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product category codes eligible for this offer. Null if offer applies to specific SKUs or all products. [Moved from reward_offer: List of categories an offer applies to belongs to the relationship, not to the offer itself]

attributes.name: eligible_store_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of store IDs where offer is valid. Null if valid at all locations. [Moved from reward_offer: List of stores an offer applies to belongs to the relationship]

products.name: offer_tender_eligibility
products.description: Associative product that links reward_offer to tender_type, capturing eligibility and discount specifics for each offer‑tender pair. Each record represents a business‑managed configuration that determines which loyalty offers apply to which payment tender types.. Existence Justification: Reward offers are configured to be eligible for one or more tender types, and each tender type can have multiple reward offers applied. The business actively creates, updates, and deletes these eligibility mappings as part of the loyalty program configuration. The mapping carries its own attributes such as eligibility flag and discount value, making it a true many‑to‑many relationship.

attributes.name: offer_tender_eligibility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Offer Tender Eligibility - Offer Tender Eligibility Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the offer_tender_eligibility association

attributes.name: reward_offer_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Offer Tender Eligibility - Reward Offer Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reward_offer

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Offer Tender Eligibility - Tender Type Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tender_type

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Discount amount or percentage specific to the offer‑tender combination

attributes.name: eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reward_offer is applicable to the tender_type

products.name: survey
products.description: Master reference table for survey. Referenced by survey_id.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Primary key for survey

attributes.name: average_completion_time_minutes
attributes.description: Typical time respondents spend completing the survey, measured in minutes.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data sensitivity classification for the survey content.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the survey record was first created.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which the survey is delivered to respondents.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Full textual description of the survey purpose and scope.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the survey becomes active for respondents.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which the survey is no longer active (nullable for open‑ended surveys).

attributes.name: is_anonymous
attributes.description: Indicates whether respondent identities are collected anonymously.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether participation in the survey is required for the target audience.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language code of the survey content.

attributes.name: last_run_date
attributes.description: Date when the survey was most recently executed.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Internal department responsible for the survey's creation and maintenance.

attributes.name: question_count
attributes.description: Total number of questions included in the survey.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the survey definition.

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Category of respondents the survey targets.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the specific customer segment or employee group the survey is intended for.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the survey used in reporting and UI.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the survey record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version of the survey definition for change tracking.

attributes.name: revised_from_survey_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on survey (revised_from_survey_id)

domains.name: fuel
domains.description: Fuel center operations including pump management, fuel inventory and tank levels, fuel grade pricing, EPA emissions compliance, RFID fleet card transactions, delivery schedules, and loyalty-linked fuel discount redemptions. Manages price change events, volume sales, and equipment maintenance schedules. Integrates with POS and loyalty systems.
domains.references: EPA Fuel Center Emissions Standards, PCI DSS, OSHA Safety

products.name: center
products.description: Master record for each fuel center location operated by Grocery, including physical site address, number of pump islands, canopy configuration, fuel grades offered, operating hours, EPA facility ID (UST registration number), state petroleum license number, and FK to the parent store location. Serves as the SSOT for fuel center identity, site-level attributes, regulatory registration references, and the anchor entity for all fuel domain operations.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel center location. Primary key for the fuel center master record. Serves as the anchor for all fuel domain operations and relationships.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating fuel center operating expenses to the cost center in budgeting and expense reporting.

attributes.name: default_fuel_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.carrier. Business justification: Fuel procurement contracts assign a primary carrier per fuel center; this FK supports carrier performance and contract compliance reporting.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Store Operations Dashboard combines fuel and grocery metrics; linking fuel_center to its fulfillment node enables unified reporting of sales, inventory, and labor.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Posts fuel center sales revenue to the appropriate GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Maps each fuel center to its legal entity for corporate tax filing and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Required for Fuel Center Manager staffing report; each center has a manager associate for labor budgeting and compliance.

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_rule. Business justification: Each fuel center is assigned a primary pricing rule that governs fuel price calculations and compliance, needed for rule‑driven price updates.

attributes.name: pricing_price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Zone‑based fuel pricing strategy requires each fuel center to be linked to a price zone for consistent pricing across locations.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables profit‑center revenue reporting for each fuel center in profit‑and‑loss statements.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Required for the 'Fuel Center Compliance Assignment' process that maps each center to its EPA/state compliance program for reporting and audits.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Associates a fuel discount campaign with a particular fuel center for campaign performance analysis and localized marketing.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.store_cluster. Business justification: Cluster-level fuel pricing and promotion planning report aggregates fuel_center data by store cluster, requiring direct FK to store_cluster.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent store location that operates this fuel center. Links fuel center operations to the primary retail store entity.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Fuel center tracks primary fuel supplier for contract management and compliance reporting, a standard practice in grocery fuel operations.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the fuel center location. First line of the physical site address including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information for the fuel center location. Optional field for suite, building, or additional location details.

attributes.name: alternative_fuel_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether alternative fuels such as E85, biodiesel, or compressed natural gas are available at this fuel center. True if any alternative fuel is offered.

attributes.name: canopy_configuration
attributes.description: Physical canopy structure configuration covering the fuel dispensing area. Describes the overhead shelter arrangement for customer protection.

attributes.name: car_wash_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a car wash facility is available at this fuel center location. True if car wash services are offered.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the fuel center is located. Part of the complete physical address for the facility.

attributes.name: convenience_store_attached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a convenience store or retail shop is physically attached to the fuel center. True if convenience store is present.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the fuel center location. Identifies the country where the facility operates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel center record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: diesel_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether diesel fuel is available at this fuel center. True if diesel is offered, false otherwise.

attributes.name: dispenser_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual fuel dispensers (pumps) at the fuel center. Represents the maximum number of vehicles that can fuel simultaneously.

attributes.name: facility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the fuel center facility. Indicates whether the location is actively serving customers or in a non-operational state.

attributes.name: fuel_center_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the fuel center. Externally-known alphanumeric code used in operational systems, reporting, and vendor communications. Format: FC followed by 6 digits.

attributes.name: fuel_center_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation of the fuel center location. Human-readable identifier used for operational reference and customer communication.

attributes.name: fuel_grades_offered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel grades available at this fuel center. Examples: Regular 87, Mid-Grade 89, Premium 91, Diesel, E85. Defines the product mix for pricing and inventory management.

attributes.name: last_equipment_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive maintenance performed on fuel dispensing equipment. Used for equipment lifecycle management and reliability tracking.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or safety inspection conducted at the fuel center. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel center record was last updated in the system. Used for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fuel center location. Used for mapping, routing, and proximity analysis. Decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fuel center location. Used for mapping, routing, and proximity analysis. Decimal degrees format.

attributes.name: loyalty_discount_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel center participates in the loyalty program fuel discount redemption. True if loyalty-linked fuel discounts are available at this location.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required regulatory or safety inspection. Used for compliance planning and operational scheduling.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel center first opened for business operations. Used for lifecycle tracking and performance analysis.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the fuel center on weekdays (Monday through Friday). Format: HH:MM-HH:MM or 24/7 for continuous operation.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the fuel center on weekends (Saturday and Sunday). Format: HH:MM-HH:MM or 24/7 for continuous operation.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fuel center location. Used for operational communication and customer inquiries.

attributes.name: pos_integration_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: POS (Point of Sale) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel center is integrated with the store POS system for payment processing and transaction reconciliation. True if POS integration is active.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the fuel center location. Five-digit or ZIP+4 format for US locations.

attributes.name: premium_fuel_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premium grade fuel is available at this fuel center. True if premium fuel is offered, false otherwise.

attributes.name: pump_island_count
attributes.description: Total number of pump islands at the fuel center. Each island typically contains multiple dispensers. Used for capacity planning and operational analysis.

attributes.name: rfid_fleet_card_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) Fleet Card Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel center supports RFID-enabled fleet card transactions for commercial customers. True if RFID fleet card processing is available.

attributes.name: state_petroleum_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued license number authorizing the fuel center to sell petroleum products. Required for regulatory compliance and operational authorization.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the fuel center location. ISO 3166-2 standard subdivision code.

attributes.name: tank_count
attributes.description: Total number of underground storage tanks at the fuel center. Used for inventory management, compliance tracking, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: total_storage_capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Total fuel storage capacity across all underground tanks at the fuel center, measured in gallons. Represents maximum inventory holding capacity.

attributes.name: twenty_four_hour_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fuel center operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. True for continuous operation, false for limited hours.

attributes.name: ust_registration_number
attributes.description: Underground Storage Tank registration number issued by state or federal authorities. Required for environmental compliance and tank monitoring.

products.name: pump
products.description: Master record for each individual fuel dispenser (pump) at a fuel center, capturing pump number, manufacturer, model, serial number, installation date, certified measurement accuracy, payment terminal type (RFID/EMV/NFC), operational status, and last calibration date. Supports equipment lifecycle management and EPA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: pump_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel dispenser pump. Primary key for the pump master record.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fuel center location where this pump is installed.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: ASSET MANAGEMENT: Pump equipment warranty and maintenance contracts require linking each pump to its equipment supplier.

attributes.name: ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump meets ADA accessibility requirements for customers with disabilities, including reach range, controls placement, and signage.
attributes.references: ADA Title III Public Accommodations Standards

attributes.name: certified_accuracy
attributes.description: Certified measurement accuracy of the fuel dispenser meter as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.9995 represents 99.95% accuracy). Must meet EPA and state weights and measures standards.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Dispenser Accuracy Standards; State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pump master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel dispenser was permanently removed from service and decommissioned. Null for active pumps.

attributes.name: decommission_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for decommissioning the fuel dispenser, such as equipment failure, technology upgrade, fuel center closure, or regulatory non-compliance.

attributes.name: emergency_shutoff_type
attributes.description: Type of emergency fuel shutoff mechanism installed on the pump. Manual requires physical button activation. Automatic triggers on impact or fire detection. Both provides redundant safety systems.
attributes.references: OSHA Workplace Safety Standards; NFPA 30A Fuel Dispensing Standards

attributes.name: epa_certification_number
attributes.description: EPA-issued certification number for the fuel dispenser equipment, verifying compliance with federal emissions and vapor recovery standards.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; EPA Vapor Recovery Standards

attributes.name: fleet_card_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump supports RFID fleet card transactions for commercial fleet customers.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_capacity
attributes.description: Number of different fuel grades (octane levels or fuel types) that this pump can dispense. Common values are 3 (regular, mid-grade, premium) or 4 (including diesel).

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel dispenser was installed and commissioned at the fuel center location.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel dispenser meter was last calibrated and certified by a licensed technician. Required for EPA compliance and state weights and measures regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Dispenser Accuracy Standards; State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance was performed on the fuel dispenser.

attributes.name: loyalty_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump supports loyalty program integration for fuel discount redemptions and rewards point accrual at the pump.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the fuel dispenser equipment.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for the fuel dispenser unit.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required calibration and certification of the fuel dispenser meter. Typically required annually or per state regulation.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Dispenser Accuracy Standards; State Weights and Measures Regulations

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service on the fuel dispenser.

attributes.name: nozzle_count
