attributes.description: Number of fuel nozzles (hoses) available on this dispenser unit. Typically ranges from 1 to 8 nozzles per pump.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fuel dispenser. Active indicates the pump is available for customer use. Maintenance indicates temporary unavailability for servicing. Out of service indicates equipment failure. Decommissioned indicates permanent removal from service.

attributes.name: payment_terminal_type
attributes.description: Type of payment technology supported by the pump terminal. RFID supports Radio Frequency Identification fleet cards. EMV supports chip-based credit/debit cards. NFC supports contactless mobile payments. Magnetic stripe supports legacy swipe cards. Hybrid supports multiple technologies.

attributes.name: pos_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump is integrated with the store POS system for real-time transaction processing and inventory management.

attributes.name: prepay_only_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump is configured to require prepayment before fuel dispensing, typically enabled during high-risk hours to prevent drive-offs.

attributes.name: pump_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the pump, typically displayed on the dispenser unit for customer reference. Unique within a fuel center.

attributes.name: remote_shutoff_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump can be remotely disabled from the fuel center control console or store POS system in emergency situations.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific dispenser unit. Used for warranty tracking and equipment lifecycle management.

attributes.name: state_certification_number
attributes.description: State weights and measures certification number for the fuel dispenser meter accuracy, issued by the state regulatory authority.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pump master record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: vapor_recovery_system
attributes.description: Type of EPA-mandated vapor recovery system installed on the pump. Stage 1 captures vapors during fuel delivery to underground tanks. Stage 2 captures vapors during customer fueling. Required for EPA emissions compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; EPA Vapor Recovery Standards

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty coverage for the fuel dispenser equipment expires.

products.name: grade
products.description: Reference catalog of all fuel grades and product types offered across fuel centers, including grade name (Regular Unleaded, Mid-Grade, Premium, Diesel, E85, DEF), octane rating, ethanol blend percentage, product code, applicable regulatory classification, and whether the grade qualifies for loyalty fuel discount redemption.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel grade. Primary key for the fuel grade reference catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: QUALITY & Sourcing: Each fuel grade is sourced from a specific supplier; linking enables quality certification and rebate calculations.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: Measure of how heavy or light a petroleum liquid is compared to water. Higher API gravity indicates lighter, less dense fuel. Typical range: 30-45 for gasoline, 30-42 for diesel. Used for inventory volume-to-weight conversions and quality control.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 9.1 (Hydrometer Test Method for Density)

attributes.name: biodiesel_blend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of biodiesel (fatty acid methyl esters) blended into diesel fuel. Common blends include B5 (5%), B10 (10%), B20 (20%). Null for gasoline and non-diesel products.

attributes.name: carbon_intensity_score
attributes.description: Lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions intensity measured in grams of CO2 equivalent per megajoule of energy. Used for Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) compliance in California and other jurisdictions. Lower scores indicate cleaner fuels.
attributes.references: California LCFS Regulation (17 CCR § 95480-95503); EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting

attributes.name: cetane_number
attributes.description: Measure of the combustion quality of diesel fuel during compression ignition. Higher cetane numbers indicate shorter ignition delay and better combustion. Typical range: 40-55. Null for gasoline and non-diesel products.
attributes.references: ASTM D613 (Cetane Number of Diesel Fuel Oil)

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code used for visual identification of the fuel grade on pump displays, signage, and digital interfaces. Standardized colors help customers quickly identify fuel types (e.g., green for diesel, yellow for mid-grade).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel grade record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Integer value controlling the display order of fuel grades on pump interfaces, POS screens, and customer-facing applications. Lower values appear first. Typically ordered by octane rating or customer preference (e.g., 1=Regular, 2=Mid-Grade, 3=Premium).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this fuel grade was discontinued or became unavailable for sale. Null for currently active grades. Used for historical analysis and regulatory reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this fuel grade became available for sale across fuel centers. Used for historical tracking and seasonal blend transitions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: energy_content_btu_per_gallon
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Content (BTU - British Thermal Unit per Gallon)
attributes.description: Energy content of the fuel measured in British Thermal Units per gallon. Gasoline typically 115,000-125,000 BTU/gal; diesel typically 130,000-138,000 BTU/gal; E85 approximately 81,000 BTU/gal. Used for energy equivalency calculations and fleet efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Economy Guide; DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center

attributes.name: epa_fuel_category
attributes.description: EPA regulatory classification of the fuel product for emissions compliance and reporting. Categories include conventional gasoline, reformulated gasoline (RFG), ULSD, renewable diesel, and alternative fuels. Used for environmental compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Fuel Quality Standards (40 CFR Part 80)

attributes.name: ethanol_blend_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ethanol blended into the gasoline product. Standard unleaded typically contains up to 10% (E10); E85 contains 51-83% ethanol. Null for diesel and non-ethanol products.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the fuel will ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for storage and handling. Gasoline typically -45°F; diesel typically 125-180°F.
attributes.references: ASTM D93 (Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup Tester)

attributes.name: fleet_card_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this fuel grade is available for purchase using RFID-enabled fleet cards and commercial fuel cards. True if accepted for fleet transactions; False if restricted to retail consumer purchases only.

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fuel grade within the system (e.g., REG87, MID89, PREM93, DSL, E85, DEF). Used for operational lookup and integration with POS and pricing systems.

attributes.name: grade_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fuel grade including key characteristics, intended use, performance benefits, and any special handling or regulatory notes. Used for customer communication, training materials, and internal documentation.

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the fuel grade as displayed to customers and used in reporting (e.g., Regular Unleaded, Mid-Grade, Premium, Diesel, E85 Flex Fuel, Diesel Exhaust Fluid).

attributes.name: grade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fuel grade. Active grades are available for sale; inactive grades are temporarily unavailable; discontinued grades are permanently retired; seasonal grades are available only during specific periods (e.g., winter blends).

attributes.name: grade_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the fuel product type. Gasoline includes unleaded grades; diesel includes standard and bio-diesel blends; alternative fuel includes E85, CNG, electric; additive includes DEF and other supplemental products.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number used for supply chain and EDI transactions. Provides globally unique identification for fuel products across trading partners and distribution channels.

attributes.name: hazmat_classification
attributes.description: Department of Transportation hazardous materials classification code for the fuel grade. Used for transportation, storage, and emergency response planning. Example: UN1203 for gasoline, UN1202 for diesel fuel.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180)

attributes.name: loyalty_discount_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether purchases of this fuel grade qualify for loyalty program fuel discount redemptions. Typically True for standard gasoline and diesel grades; may be False for premium or specialty fuels depending on program rules.

attributes.name: octane_rating
attributes.description: The octane number representing the fuel's resistance to knocking or pinging during combustion. Typical values: 87 (Regular), 89 (Mid-Grade), 91-93 (Premium). Null for non-gasoline products such as diesel or DEF.
attributes.references: ASTM D2699 and D2700 (Research and Motor Octane Number)

attributes.name: reformulated_gasoline_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fuel grade is reformulated gasoline designed to reduce smog-forming and toxic air pollutants. RFG is required in certain metropolitan areas with severe ozone pollution. True if RFG; False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPA Reformulated Gasoline Program (40 CFR Part 80 Subpart D)

attributes.name: renewable_identification_number
attributes.description: 38-character unique identifier assigned to batches of renewable fuel under the EPA Renewable Fuel Standard. Used to track and trade renewable fuel credits for compliance with federal mandates. Null for non-renewable fuels.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program (40 CFR Part 80 Subpart M)

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Sulfur content measured in parts per million. EPA Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (ULSD) standard requires maximum 15 ppm. Gasoline typically contains less than 10 ppm under Tier 3 standards. Critical for emissions compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Tier 3 Gasoline Sulfur Standards; EPA ULSD Requirements (40 CFR 80)

attributes.name: supplier_product_code
attributes.description: Product code or SKU used by the primary fuel supplier or refiner to identify this grade in purchase orders, invoices, and EDI transactions. Facilitates supply chain integration and vendor reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable federal and state excise tax category for the fuel grade. Different grades and blends may have different tax rates (e.g., gasoline vs diesel vs alternative fuels). Used for tax calculation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 510 (Excise Taxes); State Fuel Tax Regulations

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code used for point-of-sale scanning and inventory tracking. Aligns with GS1 standards for retail fuel products sold in packaged form or tracked via loyalty systems.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel grade record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for change tracking and data synchronization. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: winter_blend_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the fuel grade is formulated as a winter blend with higher Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) to improve cold-weather starting and performance. True if winter blend; False if summer blend or year-round formulation.
attributes.references: EPA Volatility Standards (40 CFR Part 80 Subpart C)

products.name: tank
products.description: Master record for each underground storage tank (UST) at a fuel center, including tank number, capacity in gallons, fuel grade stored, tank material and lining type, installation date, EPA UST registration number, leak detection method, last tightness test date, and current operational status. Critical for EPA UST compliance and Cold Chain integrity.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underground storage tank (UST). Primary key.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fuel center location where this tank is installed.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: COMPLIANCE: Tank ownership/manufacturer tracking is needed for EPA compliance, inspections, and service agreements.

attributes.name: capacity_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the tank measured in gallons. Critical for inventory management and refill scheduling.

attributes.name: cathodic_protection_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent cathodic protection system test. Required every three years for tanks with cathodic protection per EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - Cathodic Protection Testing

attributes.name: corrosion_protection_type
attributes.description: Method of corrosion protection applied to the tank (e.g., cathodic protection, protective coating, inherently non-corrosive material). EPA requires corrosion protection for steel tanks.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart B - Corrosion Protection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tank record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Current fuel volume in the tank measured in gallons. Updated by automatic tank gauging systems. Used for inventory management and reorder triggers.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the tank was permanently removed from service and decommissioned per EPA closure requirements. Null for active tanks.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart G - Out-of-Service UST Systems and Closure

attributes.name: decommission_method
attributes.description: Method used to decommission the tank (e.g., removed from ground, filled in place with inert material). EPA requires proper closure procedures.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart G - Closure Requirements

attributes.name: epa_ust_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Underground Storage Tank (UST) Registration Number
attributes.description: Official EPA registration number for this underground storage tank, required for federal compliance tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - Underground Storage Tanks

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: Type of fuel grade stored in this tank (e.g., regular unleaded, premium, diesel). Determines pricing and customer selection at pump.

attributes.name: high_level_alarm_threshold_gallons
attributes.business_glossary_term: High Level Alarm Threshold in Gallons
attributes.description: Fuel volume level that triggers a high-level alarm during delivery to prevent overfill. Typically set at 90-95% of capacity.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the tank was originally installed at the fuel center. Used to track tank age and plan replacement schedules per EPA guidelines.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - UST Installation Requirements

attributes.name: last_cleaning_date
attributes.description: Date when the tank was last cleaned and inspected internally. Periodic cleaning removes sediment and water accumulation that can cause fuel quality issues.

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent fuel delivery to this tank. Used for inventory reconciliation and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: last_delivery_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Volume of fuel delivered during the most recent delivery. Used for inventory reconciliation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or internal inspection of the tank and associated equipment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tank record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_tightness_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent precision tightness test performed on the tank to verify structural integrity and absence of leaks. EPA requires periodic testing.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - Tightness Testing Requirements

attributes.name: leak_detection_method
attributes.description: EPA-approved method used to detect leaks from this tank (e.g., automatic tank gauging, vapor monitoring, interstitial monitoring). Required for EPA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart D - Release Detection

attributes.name: lining_type
attributes.description: Type of protective lining installed inside the tank to prevent corrosion and leakage (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane). Critical for EPA compliance and leak prevention.

attributes.name: low_level_alarm_threshold_gallons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Low Level Alarm Threshold in Gallons
attributes.description: Fuel volume level that triggers a low-level alarm. Set above reorder threshold to provide early warning of potential stockout.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the tank. Used for warranty tracking and technical support.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: Primary construction material of the tank shell (e.g., steel, fiberglass, composite). Impacts corrosion risk and maintenance requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - UST Technical Standards

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for this tank type. Used for parts ordering and technical specifications.

attributes.name: next_cleaning_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next tank cleaning. Typically performed every 3-5 years depending on fuel quality and contamination risk.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection. Critical for maintaining EPA compliance and avoiding penalties.

attributes.name: next_tightness_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required tightness test. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 - Tightness Testing Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, maintenance history, or special handling instructions for this tank.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the tank. Active tanks are in use; inactive tanks are installed but not currently dispensing; out-of-service tanks require repair; decommissioned tanks have been permanently removed from service.

attributes.name: overfill_prevention_device
attributes.description: Type of overfill prevention equipment installed on the tank (e.g., automatic shutoff, high-level alarm). EPA requires overfill prevention for all USTs.

attributes.name: reorder_threshold_gallons
attributes.description: Minimum fuel volume that triggers a reorder or delivery request. Set based on daily sales velocity and delivery lead time to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: secondary_containment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tank has secondary containment (double-walled construction or external containment system). Reduces environmental risk and may lower insurance premiums.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer. Used for warranty claims and equipment tracking.

attributes.name: spill_prevention_device
attributes.description: Type of spill prevention equipment installed at the fill pipe (e.g., catchment basin, spill bucket). EPA requires spill prevention for all USTs.

attributes.name: tank_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the tank, typically a sequential number assigned at the fuel center (e.g., Tank 1, Tank 2). Used for operational reference and signage.

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tank is equipped with temperature monitoring sensors. Temperature data is used for volume compensation and leak detection.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty expires. Used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.

attributes.name: water_detection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tank is equipped with water detection sensors at the bottom. Water accumulation can cause fuel quality issues and microbial growth.

products.name: tank_level_reading
products.description: Time-series transactional records of tank inventory level readings captured by automatic tank gauges (ATG), including timestamp, tank identifier, gross volume in gallons, net volume (temperature-corrected), water level, ullage (available capacity), and reading source (ATG automated vs. manual dip stick). Supports inventory reconciliation, reorder triggering, and EPA leak detection compliance.

attributes.name: tank_level_reading_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tank level reading record. Primary key for this event log entity.

attributes.name: inventory_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inventory reconciliation period to which this reading belongs. Links to daily or shift-level reconciliation cycles.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the fuel center and tank are located.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel storage tank from which this reading was captured. Links to the fuel tank master resource.

attributes.name: alarm_status
attributes.description: Alarm or alert status reported by the ATG system at the time of reading. Indicates operational issues requiring attention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: normal|low_level|high_level|water_detected|leak_suspected|sensor_fault|overfill_warning — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA UST Regulations 40 CFR Part 280 - Release Detection

attributes.name: atg_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATG device or sensor that captured this reading. Used for equipment maintenance tracking and data quality auditing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reading record was first inserted into the data system. Distinct from reading_timestamp which is the business event time.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assessment flag indicating the reliability of this reading. Suspect or invalid readings are excluded from compliance reporting and inventory calculations.

attributes.name: delivery_in_progress_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fuel delivery was in progress at the time of this reading. True if delivery active; False otherwise. Used to exclude readings during delivery from leak detection calculations.

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: Grade or type of fuel stored in the tank at the time of reading. Octane rating for gasoline or fuel type designation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular_87|midgrade_89|premium_91|premium_93|diesel|e85|e15 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 - Standard Specification for Automotive Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: fuel_height_inches
attributes.description: Height of fuel in the tank measured in inches from the tank bottom. Raw measurement used in conjunction with tank strapping tables to calculate volume.

attributes.name: fuel_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Temperature of the fuel in the tank measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Used for temperature correction calculations to derive net volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: gross_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Total volume of fuel in the tank measured in gallons, not adjusted for temperature. Raw measurement from the ATG probe.

attributes.name: leak_detection_status
attributes.description: Result of the automatic leak detection test performed by the ATG system. EPA requires continuous leak detection monitoring for underground storage tanks.
attributes.references: EPA UST Regulations 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart D - Release Detection

attributes.name: net_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Temperature-corrected volume of fuel in the tank measured in gallons. Adjusted to standard temperature (60°F) for accurate inventory accounting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by operators or technicians regarding this reading. May include context for alarms, manual interventions, or unusual conditions.

attributes.name: reading_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this reading within the day or shift for the specific tank. Used to order readings chronologically and detect missing observations.

attributes.name: reading_source
attributes.description: Source or method by which the tank level reading was obtained. ATG automated readings are continuous; manual dipstick readings are performed during inspections or system failures.

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tank level reading was captured by the ATG system or manual measurement. Primary business event timestamp for this observation.

attributes.name: ullage_gallons
attributes.description: Available capacity remaining in the tank measured in gallons. Calculated as tank capacity minus current gross volume. Used to determine reorder timing and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: variance_gallons
attributes.description: Calculated variance between expected inventory level and actual measured level in gallons. Used for inventory reconciliation and shrink analysis. Positive variance indicates gain; negative indicates loss.

attributes.name: water_level_inches
attributes.description: Height of water detected at the bottom of the tank measured in inches. Water accumulation indicates contamination risk and must be monitored for EPA compliance and product quality.
attributes.references: EPA UST Regulations 40 CFR Part 280 - Release Detection

products.name: price
products.description: Current and historical fuel price records per fuel grade per fuel center, serving as the single source of truth for all pricing and price change event history. Each record captures street price, cost per gallon, margin, effective date/time, expiration date/time, and price zone assignment. Price change audit trail includes prior price, new price, price change reason code (competitive response, rack movement, promotional, manual override), change trigger source (automated competitive feed, rack index threshold, manager decision), approving manager, POS synchronization confirmation status and timestamp. Supports pricing compliance audits, margin analysis, competitive response tracking, and regulatory price-posting requirements.

attributes.name: price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel price record. Primary key for the fuel_price product.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager who approved this price change. Required for manual overrides and discretionary pricing decisions. Supports audit trail and accountability for pricing decisions.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center location where this price applies. Links to the fuel center master data.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Price changes affect GL entries for cost of goods sold and margin calculations.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: FK to fuel.fuel_grade

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_rule. Business justification: Fuel price records must reference the specific pricing rule used to generate the price for audit and optimization reporting.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: FK to pricing.price_zone

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign associated with this price record. Links to promotion master data for campaign tracking and ROI analysis. Null for non-promotional pricing.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: PRICING NEGOTIATION: Fuel price records must reference the supplying vendor for price negotiations, audit trails, and regulatory price filing.

attributes.name: change_amount
attributes.description: Net change in street price per gallon (current price minus prior price). Positive values indicate price increases, negative values indicate decreases.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for the price change event. Competitive response to nearby stations, rack price index threshold breach, promotional campaign, manual manager override, scheduled adjustment, or cost recovery action.

attributes.name: change_trigger_source
attributes.description: System or process that initiated the price change. Automated competitive pricing feed, rack index threshold alert, manual manager decision, centralized pricing system recommendation, or promotional calendar event.

attributes.name: competitor_price_reference
attributes.description: Reference price from competitive intelligence feed representing nearby competitor pricing. Used to justify competitive response price changes and maintain market positioning.

attributes.name: cost_per_gallon
attributes.description: Wholesale cost per gallon paid to the supplier or based on rack pricing. Used for margin calculation and profitability analysis. Business-confidential pricing data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price record was first created in the system. Distinct from effective timestamp; represents data capture time for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. USD for United States Dollar. Supports potential future international expansion.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel price becomes active and is displayed on signage and charged at the pump. Supports intraday price changes in response to competitive moves or rack price fluctuations.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fuel price is superseded by a new price record. Null for the current active price. Enables complete price history reconstruction and temporal queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this price record was last updated. Tracks corrections, adjustments, or status changes after initial creation. Supports data quality audit and change tracking.

attributes.name: loyalty_discount_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fuel grade and price point is eligible for loyalty program fuel discount redemptions. True allows loyalty members to apply cents-per-gallon discounts earned through grocery purchases.

attributes.name: margin_per_gallon
attributes.description: Gross profit margin per gallon calculated as street price minus cost per gallon. Key metric for fuel center profitability and pricing strategy effectiveness.

attributes.name: max_loyalty_discount_cents
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Loyalty Discount Cents Per Gallon
attributes.description: Maximum cents-per-gallon discount that can be applied through loyalty program redemption for this fuel grade. Caps the discount to protect margin floors and prevent negative pricing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments explaining the business context for this price change. Used by pricing managers to document competitive intelligence, market conditions, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: pos_sync_status
attributes.description: Status of price synchronization to the fuel center POS system and pump controllers. Confirmed indicates successful deployment, failed indicates synchronization error requiring intervention.

attributes.name: pos_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price change was successfully synchronized to the POS system and pump controllers. Critical for reconciling price effective time with actual system deployment.

attributes.name: prior_street_price
attributes.description: Previous street price per gallon before this price change event. Used for price change magnitude analysis and competitive response tracking.

attributes.name: promotional_price_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price is part of a temporary promotional campaign. True for limited-time offers, grand opening specials, or competitive market entry pricing.

attributes.name: rack_price_index
attributes.description: Wholesale terminal rack price index at the time of this price record. Used as a benchmark for cost-based pricing strategies and margin protection rules.

attributes.name: regulatory_posting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change requires regulatory notification or public posting under state fuel pricing transparency laws. True triggers compliance workflow for jurisdictions with price-posting requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_posting_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the price change was reported to regulatory authorities or posted to public transparency portals. Required for compliance audit trail in regulated jurisdictions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or pricing platform that generated this price record. Examples include Oracle Retail Price Management, proprietary pricing engine, or manual entry system identifier.

attributes.name: street_price
attributes.description: Customer-facing retail price per gallon displayed on the fuel center sign and charged at the pump. This is the base price before any loyalty discounts or promotions.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for price changes within the same fuel center and fuel grade. Increments with each price change event to support complete audit trail and change frequency analysis.

products.name: price_change_event
products.description: Transactional record of every fuel price change event at a fuel center, capturing the prior price, new price, fuel grade, effective timestamp, change trigger (competitive response, rack price movement, promotional, manual override), approving manager, and POS synchronization confirmation status. Provides a full audit trail for pricing compliance and margin analysis.

attributes.name: price_change_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel price change event. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or authorized personnel who approved this price change. Required for audit trail and compliance with pricing authorization policies.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center location where the price change occurred.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel grade (regular, mid-grade, premium, diesel) affected by this price change.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign associated with this price change, if the change was triggered by a marketing promotion or loyalty fuel discount program.

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason or trigger that initiated this price change event. Competitive response indicates reaction to competitor pricing, rack price movement indicates wholesale cost changes, promotional indicates marketing campaign, manual override indicates manager discretion, scheduled adjustment indicates planned periodic changes, cost recovery indicates margin protection.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: The name of the competitor whose pricing was referenced for this price change, if applicable.

attributes.name: competitor_reference_price
attributes.description: The competitor fuel price that was used as a reference or benchmark for this price change decision, if applicable. Used for competitive positioning analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Typically USD for US-based grocery retail fuel operations.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the new fuel price became effective at the pump. This is the principal business event timestamp for the price change.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or sequence number for the price change event, used for audit and reference purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change event record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: loyalty_discount_applied
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price change includes or is related to a loyalty program fuel discount redemption structure.

attributes.name: margin_per_gallon
attributes.description: The calculated gross margin per gallon (new_price minus rack_price minus taxes and fees). Critical metric for profitability analysis and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: new_price
attributes.description: The new fuel price per gallon that became effective with this price change event.

attributes.name: pos_sync_status
attributes.description: Confirmation status indicating whether the price change has been successfully synchronized to the fuel center POS system and pump controllers. Critical for ensuring price accuracy at transaction time.

attributes.name: pos_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was successfully synchronized to the POS system. Used to measure synchronization lag and ensure pricing integrity.

attributes.name: price_change_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between the new price and prior price (new_price minus prior_price). Positive values indicate price increase, negative values indicate price decrease.

attributes.name: price_change_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments from the approving manager or pricing analyst explaining the rationale, context, or special circumstances for this price change.

attributes.name: price_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in price calculated as ((new_price - prior_price) / prior_price) * 100. Used for margin and competitive analysis.

attributes.name: price_sign_update_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fuel center price sign was updated to display the new price.

attributes.name: price_sign_updated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the physical or digital price sign at the fuel center has been updated to reflect the new price. Required for customer transparency and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: prior_price
attributes.description: The fuel price per gallon that was in effect immediately before this price change event.

attributes.name: rack_price
attributes.description: The wholesale terminal or rack price for this fuel grade at the time of the price change. Used for margin analysis and cost-based pricing decisions.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price change was reviewed for compliance with state and federal fuel pricing regulations, including price gouging laws and EPA requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act, State Fuel Pricing Regulations

products.name: fuel_transaction
products.description: Core transactional record for every fuel dispensing event at a pump, capturing transaction date and time, pump number, fuel grade, gallons dispensed, unit price, gross sale amount, payment method (credit/debit/fleet card/EBT/cash), loyalty card number, fuel discount applied (cents-per-gallon), net amount charged, and POS transaction reference. Primary source for volume sales reporting and loyalty redemption reconciliation.

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each fuel dispensing transaction event. Primary key for the fuel transaction record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocates transaction revenue to the cost center for expense tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each fuel sale must be posted to a GL account for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: FK to fuel.fuel_grade

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.household. Business justification: Needed for household‑level fuel rewards program: aggregate fuel spend per household to determine eligibility, tier status, and regulatory reporting of SNAP/EBT usage.

attributes.name: method_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_method. Business justification: REQUIRED: Link fuel sale to stored payment method for refunds, tokenization, and loyalty reward calculations.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: REQUIRED: Integrated POS transaction linking fuel sale to grocery order for combined loyalty points, sales reporting, and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payment.payment_transaction. Business justification: REQUIRED: Reconcile each fuel sale with its POS payment record for daily financial reporting and settlement.

attributes.name: primary_fuel_associate_id
attributes.description: Driver identifier captured during fleet card transaction. Used for driver-level fuel consumption reporting and expense allocation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Links each fuel sale to a profit center for profitability analysis.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Required for tracking which promo offer discounts a fuel transaction used, enabling redemption reporting and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.shopper. Business justification: Required for loyalty and CLTV reporting: each fuel purchase must be linked to the shopper who made it to calculate rewards, churn risk, and compliance with fuel discount regulations.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the fuel center is located. Links to the store master data.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Payment authorization code received from payment processor. Used for payment reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: carwash_bundled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a carwash service was bundled with this fuel purchase. Used for cross-sell analytics and bundled promotion tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this transaction record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: epa_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction requires inclusion in EPA emissions compliance reporting. Used for regulatory reporting and environmental compliance tracking.

attributes.name: federal_excise_tax
attributes.description: Federal excise tax amount collected on this fuel transaction. Required for IRS Form 720 quarterly federal excise tax reporting.

attributes.name: fleet_card_number
attributes.description: Fleet card number used for commercial vehicle fuel purchases. Supports RFID fleet card transaction processing and fleet account reconciliation.

attributes.name: fuel_discount_cents_per_gallon
attributes.description: Discount amount in cents per gallon applied through loyalty program redemption. Used for loyalty-linked fuel discount reconciliation and program cost tracking.

attributes.name: gallons_dispensed
attributes.description: Volume of fuel dispensed in gallons. Primary measure for volume sales reporting, inventory depletion, and tank level management.
attributes.references: NIST Handbook 44 - Specifications, Tolerances, and Other Technical Requirements for Weighing and Measuring Devices

attributes.name: gross_sale_amount
attributes.description: Total sale amount before any discounts or loyalty redemptions are applied. Calculated as gallons dispensed multiplied by unit price.

attributes.name: local_excise_tax
attributes.description: Local or municipal excise tax amount collected on this fuel transaction where applicable.

attributes.name: loyalty_card_number
attributes.description: Customer loyalty card number used for this transaction. Links to customer loyalty profile for discount redemption and points accrual tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this transaction record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_amount_charged
attributes.description: Final amount charged to the customer after all discounts are applied. This is the revenue recognized for the transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used for the transaction. Distinguishes between credit card, debit card, fleet card, Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT), cash, and mobile payment methods.

attributes.name: pos_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this fuel transaction to the corresponding POS system transaction record for payment reconciliation and receipt generation.

attributes.name: prepay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this was a prepay transaction where payment was authorized before fuel dispensing. Used for fraud prevention and payment processing workflow.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional campaign code applied to this transaction. Used for tracking effectiveness of fuel pricing promotions and temporary price reductions.

attributes.name: pump_number
attributes.description: Physical pump identifier at the fuel center where fuel was dispensed. Used for equipment tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Unique receipt number printed for the customer. Used for customer service inquiries and transaction lookup.

attributes.name: state_excise_tax
attributes.description: State excise tax amount collected on this fuel transaction. Required for state-level fuel tax reporting and remittance.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount included in the transaction. Includes federal, state, and local fuel excise taxes for regulatory reporting and remittance.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Payment terminal identifier where the transaction was processed. Used for terminal reconciliation and equipment tracking.

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of discount applied to this transaction. Calculated as fuel discount cents per gallon multiplied by gallons dispensed.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fuel transaction in its lifecycle. Tracks whether transaction was successfully completed, voided, refunded, or failed.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel dispensing transaction occurred at the pump. Primary business event timestamp for volume sales reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per gallon at the time of transaction. Reflects current fuel grade pricing including any temporary price reductions or promotional pricing.

attributes.name: vehicle_identification_number
attributes.description: Vehicle identification number for fleet card transactions. Standard 17-character VIN used for fleet vehicle tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3779 - Road vehicles - Vehicle identification number (VIN)

attributes.name: vehicle_odometer_reading
attributes.description: Odometer reading captured at time of fleet card transaction. Used for fleet management reporting and mileage tracking.

products.name: fleet_card_account
products.description: Master record for RFID fleet card accounts and all associated individual fleet cards used by commercial fleet customers at fuel centers. Account level: account number, fleet operator name, card program type (proprietary/WEX/Voyager/Mastercard Fleet), credit limit, billing cycle, discount tier, and account status. Card level: card number, vehicle ID or driver ID, card issue and expiration dates, PIN status, authorized fuel grades, per-fill volume cap, daily/weekly transaction limits, and card status (active/suspended/lost/expired). Serves as the SSOT for fleet card program management including account setup, card issuance lifecycle, RFID-based pump authorization, per-vehicle and per-driver fueling controls, fleet billing reconciliation, and card suspension/replacement workflows.

attributes.name: fleet_card_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet card account. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Account manager associate oversees fleet card accounts; required for account audit and billing responsibility reports.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel.fuel_center. Business justification: Fleet card accounts are managed per fuel center; linking provides clear ownership and reporting.

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: Date when the fleet card account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique account number assigned to the fleet operator for billing and identification purposes.

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: Date when the fleet card account was first opened and activated for use.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fleet card account indicating whether it is operational, suspended, or closed.

attributes.name: active_cards_count
attributes.description: Current count of active fleet cards under this account that are authorized for transactions.

attributes.name: authorized_fuel_grades
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel grades (regular, mid-grade, premium, diesel) that cards under this account are authorized to purchase. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|mid_grade|premium|diesel|e85|biodiesel|cng — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fleet card account contract automatically renews upon expiration.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address for invoice delivery and account correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (suite, unit, building number).

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1-31) when the billing cycle closes and invoices are generated for this fleet account.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the billing address.

attributes.name: card_program_type
attributes.description: Type of fleet card program under which this account operates (proprietary store-branded, WEX, Voyager, Mastercard Fleet, Visa Fleet, Fleet One).

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current fleet card contract or agreement expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet card account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit limit extended to the fleet account for fuel purchases and related transactions.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this account (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: daily_transaction_limit_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of fuel transactions allowed per card per day under this account.

attributes.name: daily_volume_limit_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum total fuel volume (in gallons) that can be purchased per card per day under this account.

attributes.name: discount_rate_per_gallon
attributes.description: Per-gallon discount rate (in currency units) applied to fuel purchases for this fleet account.

attributes.name: discount_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier or discount level assigned to the fleet account based on volume commitments or negotiated contracts.

attributes.name: fleet_operator_name
attributes.description: Legal or business name of the commercial fleet operator or company holding this account.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fleet card account record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent fuel transaction processed under this fleet account.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_linked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fleet account is linked to the retailer's loyalty program for additional fuel discount redemptions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal notes, special instructions, or account-specific comments related to this fleet account.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is due (e.g., Net 30, Net 15).

attributes.name: per_fill_volume_cap_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum fuel volume (in gallons) allowed for a single transaction per card under this account.

attributes.name: pin_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required for all card transactions under this account for enhanced security.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact for account communications, billing notifications, and support.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person for this fleet account (fleet manager or account administrator).

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the fleet account contact person.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fleet cards under this account use RFID technology for contactless pump authorization.

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax ID for the fleet operator, used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: total_cards_issued
attributes.description: Total number of individual fleet cards issued under this account across all vehicles and drivers.

attributes.name: weekly_spending_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total spending allowed per card per week under this account.

products.name: fleet_card
products.description: Individual RFID fleet card record linked to a fleet card account, capturing card number, vehicle ID or driver ID associated with the card, card issue date, expiration date, PIN status, authorized fuel grades, per-fill volume cap, and card status (active/suspended/lost/expired). Enables per-vehicle or per-driver fueling controls and transaction attribution.

attributes.name: fleet_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet card record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver or employee associated with this fleet card. Used for driver-specific cards to track fuel purchases per individual. Nullable for vehicle-specific cards.

attributes.name: fleet_card_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fleet card account that this individual card belongs to. Links to the fleet_card_account product.

attributes.name: authorized_fuel_grades
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel grades that this fleet card is authorized to purchase (e.g., regular, mid-grade, premium, diesel). Used to enforce fuel type restrictions at the pump.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when the fleet card was permanently cancelled and removed from service. Nullable if the card is still active or suspended.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the fleet card was cancelled (e.g., vehicle sold, driver terminated, account closed). Nullable if card is not cancelled.

attributes.name: card_format
attributes.description: The physical format and technology of the fleet card: magnetic stripe, chip (EMV), RFID, contactless (NFC), or hybrid (multiple technologies).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 7816 - Smart Card Standards, EMV Payment Standards

attributes.name: card_number
attributes.description: The unique RFID fleet card number embossed or encoded on the physical card. Used for transaction authorization at fuel pumps.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: card_replacement_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this fleet card was issued as a replacement for a previous card. Tracks the history of card reissuance events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lost|stolen|damaged|expired|compromised|upgrade|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fleet card indicating whether it is active and authorized for use, or inactive due to suspension, loss, theft, expiration, or cancellation.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fleet card indicating its intended use: vehicle-specific, driver-specific, universal (any vehicle/driver), temporary, emergency, or contractor card.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fleet card record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: daily_spend_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that can be spent per day using this fleet card. Used for budget control and fraud prevention. Nullable if no limit is set.

attributes.name: daily_transaction_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of fuel transactions allowed per day using this fleet card. Used to detect and prevent fraudulent activity. Nullable if no limit is set.

attributes.name: day_of_week_restrictions
attributes.description: Days of the week when this fleet card is authorized for use (e.g., Monday-Friday for weekday-only vehicles). Formatted as comma-separated day names or codes. Nullable if no day restrictions apply.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the fleet card expires and is no longer valid for transactions. Cards must be renewed or replaced before this date.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the fleet card was issued and activated for use.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fleet card record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: loyalty_discount_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transactions using this fleet card are eligible for loyalty-linked fuel discount redemptions. True if eligible, false if excluded from loyalty programs.

attributes.name: merchant_category_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of merchant category codes (MCC) where this fleet card is authorized or restricted. Used to limit card usage to fuel purchases only or allow additional categories like maintenance.

attributes.name: odometer_prompt_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver must enter the vehicle odometer reading at the pump when using this fleet card. True if odometer entry is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: per_fill_volume_cap_gallons
attributes.description: Maximum number of gallons that can be purchased in a single transaction using this fleet card. Used to prevent fraud and enforce fueling limits. Nullable if no cap is set.

attributes.name: pin_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required for transactions using this fleet card. True if PIN authentication is enabled, false if card can be used without PIN.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: pin_last_changed_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: PIN (Personal Identification Number) Last Changed Date
attributes.description: The date when the PIN for this fleet card was last changed or reset. Used for security auditing and PIN rotation policy enforcement.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: replaced_card_number
attributes.description: The card number of the previous fleet card that this card replaces. Used to maintain card replacement history and link transactions across card generations. Nullable if this is the original card.
attributes.references: PCI DSS - Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: rfid_technology_type
attributes.description: The type of RFID technology used in the fleet card: passive (no battery, powered by reader), active (battery-powered), or semi-passive (battery-assisted passive).

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date when the fleet card was suspended. Nullable if the card has never been suspended or is currently active.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the fleet card was suspended (e.g., suspected fraud, policy violation, vehicle out of service). Nullable if card is not suspended.

attributes.name: time_of_day_restrictions
attributes.description: Time windows when this fleet card is authorized for use (e.g., 06:00-22:00 for day-shift drivers). Formatted as comma-separated time ranges. Nullable if no time restrictions apply.

attributes.name: vehicle_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle associated with this fleet card. Used for vehicle-specific cards to track fuel consumption per vehicle. Nullable for driver-specific or universal cards.

products.name: loyalty_fuel_redemption
products.description: Transactional record of loyalty-linked fuel discount redemptions at the pump, capturing redemption date and time, loyalty member identifier, fuel transaction reference, discount rate (cents-per-gallon), total gallons discounted, total discount dollar value, redemption source (loyalty points, promotional offer, partner reward), and post-redemption points balance impact. Links fuel domain to the loyalty domain for program reconciliation.

attributes.name: loyalty_fuel_redemption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the loyalty fuel redemption transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Point of Sale (POS) fuel transaction at the pump where the discount was applied.

attributes.name: membership_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the loyalty program member who redeemed the fuel discount.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: REQUIRED: Tie fuel loyalty redemption to the overall order to reflect total loyalty activity in order‑level reports and customer satisfaction metrics.

attributes.name: program_config_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external partner loyalty program (e.g., airline miles, credit card rewards) if the discount originated from a partner reward. Null if internal loyalty only.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the promotional campaign or offer that enabled this fuel discount. Null if not part of a specific promotion.

attributes.name: pump_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific fuel pump where the redemption was processed.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the fuel center is located and the redemption occurred.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the loyalty discount was activated or redeemed (at-pump, mobile app, kiosk, cashier-assisted).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the discount amount. Typically USD for US-based grocery retail operations.

attributes.name: discount_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date by which the fuel discount offer must be redeemed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if no expiration.

attributes.name: discount_rate_cents_per_gallon
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to the fuel purchase, expressed in cents per gallon (e.g., 10 cents off per gallon).

attributes.name: fleet_card_number_masked
attributes.description: Masked fleet card number used for the transaction (e.g., last 4 digits only). Applicable for fleet card transactions tracked via Radio Frequency Identification (RFID).

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: The grade or type of fuel purchased (e.g., regular, midgrade, premium, diesel) to which the discount was applied.

attributes.name: gallons_discounted
attributes.description: Total number of gallons of fuel to which the loyalty discount was applied during this transaction.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Loyalty program tier or membership level of the customer at the time of redemption (e.g., silver, gold, platinum). May influence discount eligibility or rate.

attributes.name: max_discount_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of discount allowed per transaction based on loyalty program rules or promotional terms. Used to cap total discount.

attributes.name: max_gallons_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of gallons eligible for discount per transaction based on loyalty program rules or promotional terms.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used for the fuel transaction (credit card, debit card, fleet card, mobile payment, cash). Distinct from redemption source.

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.description: Loyalty member's points balance immediately after this fuel discount redemption.

attributes.name: points_balance_before
attributes.description: Loyalty member's points balance immediately before this fuel discount redemption.

attributes.name: points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed to obtain this fuel discount. Null if discount source is not loyalty points.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or pump controller that processed the redemption transaction.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the fuel redemption transaction was reconciled with the loyalty program system. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the redemption record in the loyalty program reconciliation process (reconciled with loyalty system, pending, discrepancy identified, adjusted).

attributes.name: redemption_source
attributes.description: Source or origin of the fuel discount being redeemed (e.g., loyalty points accumulated, promotional offer, partner reward program, credit card linked discount).

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fuel discount redemption transaction in its lifecycle (completed, pending, reversed, failed, expired).

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the loyalty fuel discount was redeemed at the pump. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for reversing or voiding the fuel discount redemption, if applicable. Null if redemption was not reversed.

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar value of the fuel discount redeemed in this transaction (calculated as discount rate × gallons discounted).

attributes.name: transaction_receipt_number
attributes.description: Receipt or confirmation number printed for the customer at the pump, linking the fuel purchase to the loyalty redemption.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this redemption record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX

products.name: delivery
products.description: Complete lifecycle record of fuel replenishment from planning through delivery receipt for each fuel center. Schedule phase: scheduled delivery date/time window, fuel grade, estimated gallons ordered, distributor/carrier assignment, reorder trigger (ATG-automated CAO vs manual), order status, and confirmation reference. Delivery execution phase: actual delivery date/time, carrier/distributor name, bill of lading number, gross gallons delivered, net gallons (temperature-corrected), delivery ticket number, pre-delivery and post-delivery tank levels, driver signature confirmation, and variance from scheduled quantity. Serves as the SSOT for the entire fuel replenishment lifecycle from order placement through receipt confirmation, supporting supply planning, fuel availability management, inventory reconciliation, and shrink analysis.
products.reference: Fuel Bulk Delivery / Bill of Lading

attributes.name: delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel delivery record. Primary key for the fuel delivery lifecycle from order placement through receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier delivering the fuel. May be the same as distributor or a third-party logistics provider.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center receiving the delivery. Links to the fuel center location where fuel is being replenished.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns fuel delivery expense to the cost center responsible for inventory replenishment.

attributes.name: driver_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Needed for driver performance, safety incident, and EPA reporting; delivery driver is an associate employee.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Delivery costs are posted to a GL account for cost of goods sold.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Fuel procurement uses purchase orders; linking deliveries to orders enables spend reporting and order‑to‑receipt reconciliation.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel distributor or supplier fulfilling the delivery. Links to the vendor providing the fuel.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier_site. Business justification: TRACEABILITY: Delivery manifests record the exact supplier site of origin for tax, traceability, and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underground storage tank receiving the fuel delivery. Links to the specific tank within the fuel center.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the fuel delivery occurred. Used for reconciliation and variance analysis against scheduled date.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the fuel delivery was completed. Marks the end of the physical fuel transfer and receipt confirmation.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the fuel delivery began. Marks the start of the physical fuel transfer process.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of lading number for the fuel shipment. Legal document issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 373 - Receipts and Bills of Lading

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the fuel delivery in USD. Includes fuel product cost and may include transportation charges.

attributes.name: cost_per_gallon
attributes.description: Unit cost per gallon of fuel delivered in USD. Used for inventory valuation and margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fuel delivery record was first created in the system. Marks the beginning of the delivery lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fuel delivery. Tracks the delivery from scheduling through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_transit|arrived|in_progress|completed|cancelled|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: Name of the fuel distributor or supplier company. Business name of the vendor fulfilling the delivery.

attributes.name: driver_signature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver signature was captured electronically or on paper at delivery completion. Used for proof of delivery validation.

attributes.name: epa_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether EPA emissions and environmental compliance was verified for the delivery. Tracks adherence to underground storage tank regulations.

attributes.name: estimated_gallons_ordered
attributes.description: Estimated volume of fuel ordered in gallons. Represents the planned quantity at the time of order placement.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Separate freight or transportation charge for the delivery in USD. May be itemized separately from fuel product cost.

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: Grade or type of fuel being delivered. Indicates octane rating for gasoline or fuel type classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular_87|midgrade_89|premium_91|premium_93|diesel|e85|e15 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 - Standard Specification for Automotive Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: gross_gallons_delivered
attributes.description: Gross volume of fuel delivered in gallons before temperature correction. Raw measurement from the delivery truck meter.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number for the fuel delivery. Links the delivery to accounts payable for payment processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fuel delivery record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any delivery attribute.

attributes.name: net_gallons_delivered
attributes.description: Net volume of fuel delivered in gallons after temperature correction to 60°F. Temperature-adjusted volume used for inventory and billing.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the delivery. Captures exceptions, issues, or special circumstances during delivery execution.

attributes.name: order_confirmation_reference
attributes.description: Confirmation reference number from the fuel order placement system. Links the delivery to the original replenishment order.

attributes.name: post_delivery_tank_level_gallons
