attributes.description: Fuel tank level in gallons after the delivery was completed. Final measurement from Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system used for reconciliation and shrink analysis.

attributes.name: pre_delivery_tank_level_gallons
attributes.description: Fuel tank level in gallons before the delivery began. Baseline measurement from Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system used for reconciliation.

attributes.name: quality_test_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered fuel passed quality testing at receipt. Used for quality assurance and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 - Standard Specification for Automotive Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: reorder_trigger_type
attributes.description: Method that triggered the fuel replenishment order. Indicates whether order was automated via Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system, Computer-Assisted Ordering (CAO), or manually placed.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the fuel delivery. Used for supply planning and fuel availability management.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_end_time
attributes.description: End of the scheduled delivery time window. Defines the latest expected time for delivery completion.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_start_time
attributes.description: Beginning of the scheduled delivery time window. Precise timestamp for when the delivery is expected to begin.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Temperature of the fuel at the time of delivery in degrees Fahrenheit. Used for temperature correction calculations to determine net gallons.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: External delivery ticket number issued by the carrier or distributor. Serves as the business identifier for the delivery transaction.

attributes.name: truck_number
attributes.description: Identification number of the delivery truck or tanker. Vehicle identifier for tracking and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: variance_gallons
attributes.description: Difference between estimated gallons ordered and net gallons delivered. Used for supply planning accuracy analysis and shrink detection.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between estimated and actual delivery quantity. Calculated as (variance_gallons / estimated_gallons_ordered) * 100.

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Master schedule of planned fuel deliveries for each fuel center, capturing scheduled delivery date and time window, fuel grade, estimated gallons ordered, distributor/carrier assignment, reorder trigger (ATG-automated CAO vs. manual), order status, and confirmation reference. Supports supply planning and ensures fuel availability to prevent out-of-stock (OOS) conditions at the pump.
products.reference: Fuel Delivery Schedule / CAO Replenishment Order

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel delivery schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier responsible for delivering the fuel shipment.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center location receiving the delivery.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent store location associated with the fuel center.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel distributor or vendor assigned to fulfill this delivery.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific underground storage tank at the fuel center that will receive this delivery.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the fuel delivery was completed, if applicable.

attributes.name: actual_gallons_delivered
attributes.description: The actual volume of fuel in gallons that was delivered, recorded upon completion.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The bill of lading number issued by the carrier for this fuel shipment, serving as a receipt and contract.

attributes.name: cancelled_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code if the delivery schedule was cancelled (e.g., supplier issue, weather, tank maintenance).

attributes.name: confirmation_reference
attributes.description: External confirmation number or reference code provided by the distributor or carrier for this scheduled delivery.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the on-site contact person at the fuel center for coordinating the delivery.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the on-site contact person for delivery coordination.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or automated process that created this delivery schedule record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the delivery cost (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: current_tank_level_gallons
attributes.description: The current fuel inventory level in gallons in the target tank at the time the delivery was scheduled.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions or notes for the carrier regarding site access, safety protocols, or delivery procedures.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Name of the driver who delivered the fuel shipment.

attributes.name: epa_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery meets EPA environmental and emissions compliance requirements (True/False).

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The estimated total cost in USD for this fuel delivery, including product and transportation charges.

attributes.name: estimated_gallons
attributes.description: The estimated volume of fuel in gallons ordered for this delivery.

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: The grade or type of fuel scheduled for delivery (e.g., Regular, Premium, Diesel).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user or automated process that last modified this delivery schedule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery schedule record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fuel order associated with this delivery schedule.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery schedule (e.g., Scheduled, Confirmed, In Transit, Delivered, Cancelled, Delayed).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The urgency or priority level assigned to this delivery to prevent out-of-stock (OOS) conditions.

attributes.name: quality_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or quality assurance reference number confirming the fuel meets EPA and industry standards.

attributes.name: reorder_threshold_gallons
attributes.description: The inventory level in gallons at which a reorder is automatically triggered to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: reorder_trigger_type
attributes.description: The method that triggered the reorder: ATG (Automatic Tank Gauge) automated, CAO (Computer-Assisted Ordering) automated, manual, or emergency.

attributes.name: rescheduled_from_date
attributes.description: The original scheduled delivery date if this delivery was rescheduled from a prior date.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which the fuel delivery is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The end of the scheduled delivery time window, including date and time.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The beginning of the scheduled delivery time window, including date and time.

attributes.name: temperature_at_delivery
attributes.description: The fuel temperature in degrees Fahrenheit recorded at the time of delivery, used for volume correction calculations.

attributes.name: unit_price_per_gallon
attributes.description: The contracted or estimated price per gallon in USD for the fuel being delivered.

attributes.name: variance_gallons
attributes.description: The difference in gallons between the estimated and actual delivered quantities (actual minus estimated).

attributes.name: vehicle_number
attributes.description: Identifier or license plate number of the delivery vehicle (tanker truck) used for this shipment.

products.name: inventory_reconciliation
products.description: Periodic fuel inventory reconciliation record comparing book inventory (opening stock + deliveries - sales) against physical ATG readings to compute variance (shrink/overage) per tank per fuel grade, capturing reconciliation period, opening volume, total deliveries, total dispensed volume, closing book volume, ATG physical volume, variance in gallons, variance percentage, and reconciliation status. Supports EPA leak detection compliance and shrink management.

attributes.name: inventory_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel inventory reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved or closed the reconciliation record. Links to workforce associate master data for audit trail.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fiscal period to which this reconciliation belongs. Links to fiscal calendar for financial reporting and period-over-period analysis.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the fuel center and tank are located.

attributes.name: tank_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel storage tank being reconciled. Links to the fuel tank master data.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reconciliation was approved or closed. Part of audit trail for compliance and internal controls.

attributes.name: atg_physical_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Physical inventory volume in gallons measured by the Automatic Tank Gauge (ATG) system at the end of the reconciliation period. Represents actual measured inventory in the tank.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 (ATG requirements for leak detection)

attributes.name: atg_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the ATG system or device that provided the physical volume reading. Used for equipment tracking and calibration audit trails.

attributes.name: average_tank_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Average fuel temperature in the tank during the reconciliation period measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Used for temperature compensation calculations and thermal expansion adjustments.

attributes.name: closing_book_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Calculated book inventory volume in gallons at the end of the reconciliation period. Formula: opening_book_volume + total_deliveries - total_dispensed. Represents theoretical ending inventory.

attributes.name: cost_of_variance_amount
attributes.description: Financial impact of the inventory variance calculated by multiplying variance volume by the weighted average cost per gallon for the period. Used for shrink cost reporting and Profit and Loss (P&L) impact analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost of variance amount. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: delivery_count
attributes.description: Number of fuel delivery transactions received during the reconciliation period. Used to validate delivery volume totals and identify delivery frequency patterns.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_code
attributes.description: Code representing the fuel grade or product type stored in the tank (e.g., Regular 87, Premium 93, Diesel). Standardized fuel product classification.
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 (gasoline grades), ASTM D975 (diesel fuel grades)

attributes.name: investigation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting investigation findings, root cause analysis, corrective actions taken, and resolution details for variances requiring investigation.

attributes.name: investigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the variance requires formal investigation by operations or compliance teams. True triggers investigation workflow and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was last updated. Part of audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: leak_detection_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this reconciliation meets EPA Underground Storage Tank (UST) leak detection compliance requirements. True indicates compliance, False indicates potential leak or non-compliance requiring immediate action.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 Subpart D (leak detection requirements)

attributes.name: opening_book_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Book inventory volume in gallons at the start of the reconciliation period. Represents the theoretical starting inventory based on prior period closing balance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the inventory reconciliation. Manual indicates human-performed reconciliation, automated indicates system-generated reconciliation, hybrid indicates combination of both.

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the inventory reconciliation period. Defines the close of the measurement window for this reconciliation cycle.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 (UST leak detection requirements)

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the inventory reconciliation period. Defines the beginning of the measurement window for this reconciliation cycle.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 280 (UST leak detection requirements)

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inventory reconciliation record. Tracks approval workflow and investigation state.

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the physical inventory reconciliation was performed and recorded. Primary business event timestamp for this reconciliation.

attributes.name: shrink_category
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory variance into business-defined shrink categories based on variance magnitude and direction. Used for shrink management reporting and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: temperature_compensation_applied_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether temperature compensation was applied to volume measurements to adjust for thermal expansion/contraction of fuel. True indicates volumes are temperature-corrected to standard conditions.

attributes.name: total_deliveries_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Total volume of fuel delivered to the tank during the reconciliation period in gallons. Sum of all delivery receipts for this tank and fuel grade.

attributes.name: total_dispensed_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Total volume of fuel dispensed from the tank during the reconciliation period in gallons. Sum of all Point of Sale (POS) transactions for this tank and fuel grade.

attributes.name: transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of Point of Sale (POS) fuel dispensing transactions during the reconciliation period. Used to validate dispensed volume totals and assess transaction activity.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Inventory variance expressed as a percentage of closing book volume. Formula: (variance_volume / closing_book_volume) * 100. Used to assess materiality of variance and trigger investigation thresholds.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_exceeded_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the variance exceeds the acceptable threshold defined by business policy or EPA leak detection requirements. True indicates variance requires investigation.

attributes.name: variance_volume_gallons
attributes.description: Inventory variance in gallons between book and physical inventory. Formula: atg_physical_volume - closing_book_volume. Positive values indicate overage (gain), negative values indicate shrink (loss).

attributes.name: water_level_inches
attributes.description: Water level detected at the bottom of the tank measured in inches. Water accumulation can indicate tank integrity issues or contamination. Part of EPA compliance monitoring.

products.name: pump_maintenance
products.description: Transactional record of all maintenance activities performed on fuel dispensers, including maintenance type (preventive/corrective/calibration/inspection), work order number, maintenance date, technician or vendor performing work, issue description, resolution, parts replaced, downtime duration, and return-to-service timestamp. Supports equipment lifecycle management and regulatory calibration compliance.

attributes.name: pump_maintenance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pump maintenance record. Primary key for the pump maintenance transaction.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technician or associate who performed the maintenance work. May be internal staff or vendor technician.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center location where the pump is installed.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links pump maintenance expenses to the cost center that owns the pump.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Maintenance costs are recorded in a GL account for expense tracking.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Maintenance work orders are driven by specific compliance obligations (e.g., calibration, leak detection) tracked in compliance_obligation.

attributes.name: pump_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel dispenser pump that received maintenance. Links to the pump master resource.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external vendor or service provider who performed the maintenance, if applicable. Null for internal maintenance.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the maintenance work was completed and the pump was ready for return to service.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the maintenance work actually began. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: calibration_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the calibration authority or weights and measures inspector, if calibration was performed.

attributes.name: calibration_performed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether pump calibration was performed during this maintenance activity. Critical for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: downtime_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that the pump was out of service due to this maintenance activity. Critical for availability tracking and revenue impact analysis.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the failure or issue type (e.g., mechanical failure, electrical fault, calibration drift, leak detection). Used for root cause analysis and equipment reliability tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pump passed inspection during this maintenance activity. False indicates failure requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: issue_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the problem, defect, or reason for maintenance. For preventive maintenance, describes the scheduled service performed.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost for the maintenance activity, in USD. Includes internal labor or vendor service fees.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: maintenance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the maintenance work order.

attributes.name: maintenance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity: preventive (scheduled routine), corrective (repair), calibration (accuracy adjustment), inspection (regulatory check), emergency (unplanned critical), or compliance (regulatory requirement).
attributes.references: EPA Underground Storage Tank Regulations, State Weights and Measures

attributes.name: next_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the next preventive maintenance or inspection is scheduled for this pump, based on maintenance intervals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments from the technician regarding the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: parts_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of parts and materials used in the maintenance activity, in USD.

attributes.name: parts_replaced
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of parts and components replaced during the maintenance activity. Used for inventory tracking and warranty management.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification of the maintenance work order. Critical indicates immediate safety or compliance issue.

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions taken, repairs completed, and final resolution of the maintenance activity.

attributes.name: return_to_service_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pump was officially returned to operational service and made available for customer transactions.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the issue requiring maintenance. Used for preventive maintenance planning and equipment lifecycle management.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance activity was originally scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: total_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the maintenance activity including parts, labor, and any additional fees, in USD.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance activity is covered under manufacturer or vendor warranty.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_number
attributes.description: Warranty claim reference number if this maintenance is being claimed under warranty.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known work order number assigned to this maintenance activity. Used for tracking and vendor billing.

products.name: epa_compliance_report
products.description: Comprehensive regulatory compliance and environmental incident record capturing all EPA-mandated reporting for underground storage tank (UST) operations at fuel centers. Compliance reporting: reporting period, compliance category (leak detection, release reporting, spill/overfill prevention, corrosion protection, financial responsibility), compliance status, inspection findings, corrective action required, submission date, regulatory agency reference number, and next due date. Environmental incidents: incident date/time, incident type (fuel spill, tank leak, vapor release, soil/groundwater contamination), volume released, affected media (soil/groundwater/surface water), immediate response actions, regulatory notification date, remediation plan reference, remediation status, and incident closure date. Serves as the single source of truth for all EPA UST program compliance, state environmental agency requirements, release reporting obligations, and environmental incident management from detection through remediation closure.

attributes.name: epa_compliance_report_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Compliance Report ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EPA compliance report record.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel center location where this compliance report or incident occurred.

attributes.name: affected_media
attributes.description: Environmental medium impacted by the incident: soil for subsurface contamination, groundwater for aquifer pollution, surface water for waterway impact, air for vapor emissions, or multiple media for incidents affecting more than one medium. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: compliance_category
attributes.description: EPA-mandated compliance category: leak detection for Underground Storage Tank (UST) monitoring systems, release reporting for fuel discharge events, spill/overfill prevention for equipment safeguards, corrosion protection for tank integrity, financial responsibility for liability coverage, or operator training for certification requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance report or incident: compliant for meeting all requirements, non-compliant for violations identified, pending review for submissions under agency evaluation, corrective action required for mandated remediation, remediation in progress for active cleanup, or closed for completed incidents.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions or remediation measures required by the regulatory agency, including equipment repairs, system upgrades, soil excavation, groundwater treatment, or monitoring well installation. Null if no corrective action required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which corrective action or remediation must be completed as mandated by the regulatory agency. Null if no corrective action required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action or remediation is mandated by the regulatory agency. True if action is required, False if no action needed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance report record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: estimated_remediation_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of remediation and corrective actions in USD, including cleanup, equipment replacement, monitoring, and regulatory compliance expenses. Null if no remediation required or cost not yet estimated.

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: Type of fuel product involved in the incident or compliance report: regular unleaded, mid-grade, premium, diesel, E85 ethanol blend, or biodiesel.

attributes.name: immediate_response_actions
attributes.description: Description of immediate containment, cleanup, and safety actions taken upon discovery of the incident, including emergency shutdowns, spill containment, and site securing. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: incident_closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory agency formally closed the incident or compliance case, indicating all corrective actions completed and remediation verified. Null for open incidents or routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the environmental incident or compliance violation occurred. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: incident_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the environmental incident or compliance violation was detected. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of environmental incident: fuel spill for surface discharge, tank leak for Underground Storage Tank (UST) breach, vapor release for airborne emissions, soil contamination for subsurface pollution, groundwater contamination for aquifer impact, or surface water contamination for waterway pollution. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory inspection or compliance audit was conducted. Null for incident reports without formal inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_findings
attributes.description: Summary of findings from regulatory inspection or compliance audit, including violations identified, equipment deficiencies, and procedural gaps. Null for reports without formal inspection.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: Insurance claim reference number for financial responsibility coverage related to the incident or remediation. Null if no insurance claim filed.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance report record was last modified, reflecting updates to compliance status, remediation progress, or regulatory actions.

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next compliance report, follow-up submission, or remediation status update is due to the regulatory agency. Null for closed incidents or one-time reports.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency overseeing this compliance report or incident, typically EPA regional office or state environmental agency with delegated Underground Storage Tank (UST) program authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory agency was formally notified of the incident or compliance issue, as required by EPA 24-hour release reporting requirements. Null for routine compliance reports.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number or case identifier assigned by the regulatory agency for tracking this compliance report, incident, or enforcement action.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the formal remediation plan submitted to the regulatory agency, linking to detailed cleanup strategy and timeline. Null if no remediation plan required.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation activities: not started for approved plans awaiting execution, in progress for active cleanup, monitoring for post-cleanup observation, completed for finished remediation awaiting verification, or verified closed for agency-approved closure. Null if no remediation required.

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the compliance report or incident, used for external regulatory reference and tracking.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the EPA report: compliance reporting for routine submissions, environmental incident for release events, inspection finding for regulatory audit results, corrective action for required remediation, or remediation status for ongoing cleanup tracking.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the compliance reporting period covered by this report.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the compliance reporting period covered by this report.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name of the legal entity or party responsible for the Underground Storage Tank (UST) system and compliance obligations, typically the fuel center operator or corporate owner.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance report or incident notification was submitted to the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: tank_number
attributes.description: Physical tank number or designation at the fuel center involved in the incident or compliance report.

attributes.name: ust_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific Underground Storage Tank system involved in the incident or compliance report, linking to tank registration and equipment records.

attributes.name: volume_released_gallons
attributes.description: Quantity of fuel or petroleum product released during the incident, measured in gallons. Null for routine compliance reports or incidents where volume cannot be determined.

products.name: environmental_incident
products.description: Record of environmental incidents at fuel centers including fuel spills, tank leaks, vapor release events, and soil/groundwater contamination reports, capturing incident date and time, incident type, volume released, affected media (soil/groundwater/surface water), immediate response actions taken, regulatory notification date, remediation plan reference, and incident closure date. Required for EPA release reporting and state environmental agency notifications.
products.reference: EPA UST Release Report / Environmental Incident

attributes.name: environmental_incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the environmental incident record. Primary key.

attributes.name: center_id
