attributes.name: reported_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate who reported the environmental incident.

attributes.name: affected_media
attributes.description: Environmental media impacted by the release (soil, groundwater, surface water, air). Determines scope of remediation and regulatory notification requirements.

attributes.name: cause_category
attributes.description: Root cause category of the environmental incident. Used for trend analysis and preventive maintenance planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|corrosion|overfill|delivery_error|vandalism|natural_disaster|operator_error|unknown — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause and circumstances leading to the environmental incident.

attributes.name: closure_approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or official who approved the incident closure.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the environmental incident was officially closed by regulatory authorities, indicating all remediation and monitoring requirements have been satisfied.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this environmental incident record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discovery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the environmental incident was discovered by personnel or monitoring systems.

attributes.name: emergency_responder_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether local emergency responders (fire department, hazmat team) were notified of the incident.

attributes.name: emergency_responder_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when emergency responders were notified of the environmental incident.

attributes.name: epa_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the EPA was notified of the environmental incident. Must be within 24 hours of discovery for reportable releases.

attributes.name: epa_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EPA was notified of the environmental release as required by federal regulations.

attributes.name: fuel_grade_released
attributes.description: Type of fuel grade involved in the release. Determines environmental impact assessment and remediation approach.

attributes.name: immediate_response_actions
attributes.description: Description of immediate containment and response actions taken at the time of incident discovery, including emergency shutoff, spill containment, and site securing.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the environmental incident, used for regulatory reporting and internal tracking.

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the environmental incident in the response and remediation workflow.

attributes.name: incident_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the environmental incident occurred or was first detected. Principal business event timestamp for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental incident type. Determines regulatory reporting requirements and remediation protocols.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: Insurance claim number associated with the environmental incident for cost recovery purposes.

attributes.name: monitoring_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual end date for post-remediation environmental monitoring activities.

attributes.name: monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing environmental monitoring is required following remediation completion.

attributes.name: nrc_report_number
attributes.description: National Response Center report number assigned when the incident was reported to the federal hotline for oil and hazardous substance releases.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of regulatory penalties or fines assessed for the environmental incident, in USD.

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory penalties or fines were assessed against the company for the environmental incident.

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when remediation activities were completed and site restoration was achieved.

attributes.name: remediation_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the environmental remediation contractor engaged to perform cleanup and restoration activities.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the approved remediation plan addressing the environmental contamination.

attributes.name: remediation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when active remediation activities commenced at the incident site.

attributes.name: source_equipment_code
attributes.description: Identifier or serial number of the specific equipment unit that was the source of the release.

attributes.name: source_equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel center equipment that was the source of the environmental release. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: underground_storage_tank|dispenser|piping|vent_system|delivery_connection|spill_bucket|overfill_prevention — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: state_agency_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the state environmental agency was notified of the environmental incident.

attributes.name: state_agency_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state environmental agency was notified of the environmental release as required by state regulations.

attributes.name: total_remediation_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for environmental remediation, monitoring, and regulatory compliance activities related to the incident, in USD.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this environmental incident record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: volume_released
attributes.description: Estimated or measured volume of fuel or hazardous material released during the incident, in gallons. Critical for EPA release reporting thresholds.

products.name: competitor_fuel_price
products.description: Transactional record of all external fuel pricing intelligence including observed competitor street prices and wholesale rack/index prices (OPIS, Platts, DTN). Captures observation date and time, source type (competitor survey, automated feed, rack index, spot market, contract terminal price), source identifier (competitor site name or index/terminal name), fuel grade, observed price per gallon, price basis (terminal/spot/contract), geographic market, distributor source, and the Grocery fuel center being benchmarked. Serves as the single source of truth for all external pricing data — both competitive intelligence and cost-basis rack/wholesale prices — driving street price decisions, margin calculations, cost-of-goods determination, and automated price change triggers.
products.reference: Competitive Fuel Price Survey / OPIS Rack Price

attributes.name: competitor_fuel_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each competitor fuel price observation record.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: The Grocery fuel center location being benchmarked against competitor or wholesale pricing.

attributes.name: competitive_position
attributes.description: The calculated competitive pricing position of the Grocery fuel center relative to this observation: below_market (Grocery price is lower), at_market (prices are equal within tolerance), above_market (Grocery price is higher).

attributes.name: competitor_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the competitor fuel center. Enables distance calculations and competitive radius mapping.

attributes.name: competitor_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the competitor fuel center. Enables distance calculations and competitive radius mapping.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: The brand or business name of the competitor fuel retailer whose street price is being observed. Null for wholesale/rack price sources.

attributes.name: competitor_site_address
attributes.description: The street address of the competitor fuel center location. Used for geographic proximity analysis and market segmentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competitor fuel price record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the observed price. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A calculated quality score (0.00 to 1.00) for this price observation based on source reliability, observation recency, and data completeness. Used to weight pricing decisions.

attributes.name: distance_to_fuel_center_miles
attributes.description: The calculated distance in miles from the competitor site to the benchmarked Grocery fuel center. Used for competitive radius analysis.

attributes.name: distributor_source
attributes.description: The fuel distributor or supplier name associated with the wholesale rack or terminal price. Null for competitor street price observations.

attributes.name: fuel_grade
attributes.description: The specific fuel product grade being priced: regular unleaded (87 octane), midgrade (89 octane), premium (91-93 octane), diesel, E85 (85% ethanol blend), or E15 (15% ethanol blend).

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The regional market or metropolitan area identifier for this pricing observation. Used to segment pricing intelligence by local market dynamics.

attributes.name: index_provider
attributes.description: The third-party pricing index or data provider name for wholesale rack prices: OPIS (Oil Price Information Service), Platts, or DTN (Data Transmission Network).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the price observation, including context such as promotional signage, payment method restrictions, or unusual market conditions.

attributes.name: observation_method
attributes.description: The method by which the price data was collected: manual field survey, automated web scraping, API data feed, email report from provider, or phone call to terminal.

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the competitor price or wholesale rack price was observed or recorded.

attributes.name: observed_price_per_gallon
attributes.description: The fuel price per gallon observed at the competitor site or reported by the wholesale index/terminal. Expressed in USD per gallon with three decimal precision.

attributes.name: observer_name
attributes.description: The name of the person or system that recorded the competitor price observation. Used for data quality auditing and manual survey accountability.

attributes.name: price_basis
attributes.description: The pricing level being captured: street_retail (consumer pump price at competitor), terminal_rack (wholesale terminal rack price), spot_market (commodity spot market price), or contract (negotiated supplier contract price).

attributes.name: price_change_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this observation triggered an automated price change recommendation or alert based on competitive pricing rules and thresholds.

attributes.name: price_differential_cents
attributes.description: The calculated price difference in cents per gallon between the observed competitor/wholesale price and the current Grocery fuel center price for the same grade. Positive values indicate Grocery is more expensive.

attributes.name: source_identifier
attributes.description: The specific name or code of the pricing source: competitor site name and location for surveys, data provider name for automated feeds, terminal or index name for rack/wholesale prices.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: The category of pricing intelligence source: competitor survey (manual street price observation), automated feed (third-party data provider), rack index (OPIS/Platts/DTN terminal rack price), spot market (real-time commodity market price), or contract terminal price (negotiated supplier terminal price).

attributes.name: terminal_name
attributes.description: The specific fuel terminal or distribution point name for wholesale rack prices. Null for competitor street price observations.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The validation status of the price observation: verified (confirmed accurate), unverified (not yet validated), flagged (requires review due to anomaly), rejected (determined to be erroneous).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price observation was verified or reviewed by a pricing analyst or automated validation process.

products.name: rack_price
products.description: Reference record of wholesale petroleum rack prices from petroleum distributors and spot market indices (OPIS, Platts), capturing effective date, fuel grade, rack price per gallon, price basis (terminal/spot/contract), distributor or index source, and applicable geographic market. Used as the cost basis for fuel margin calculation and street price setting decisions.

attributes.name: rack_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rack price record.

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the fuel grade (regular, mid-grade, premium, diesel) to which this rack price applies.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status for this rack price record, supporting workflow controls for price changes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the manager or system user who approved this rack price for use in pricing decisions.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rack price record was approved for use.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: The contract or agreement number under which this rack price is provided, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_term_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the contract term for negotiated rack pricing agreements.

attributes.name: contract_term_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the contract term for negotiated rack pricing agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rack price record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rack price (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The method or channel by which this rack price data was received: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), API, Manual entry, Email, or FTP.

attributes.name: distributor_code
attributes.description: The internal or industry-standard code identifying the petroleum distributor.

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: The name of the petroleum distributor or supplier providing this rack price.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rack price becomes effective for pricing and margin calculations.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when this rack price becomes effective, supporting intraday price changes.

attributes.name: environmental_fee_per_gallon
attributes.description: Environmental or regulatory fees per gallon (e.g., underground storage tank fees, emissions fees) applicable to this rack price.
attributes.references: EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), State Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rack price expires and is superseded by a new price, nullable for open-ended pricing.

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_gallon
attributes.description: The freight or transportation cost per gallon from the terminal to the fuel center, used to calculate delivered cost.

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The applicable geographic market or region for this rack price (e.g., Gulf Coast, Midwest, West Coast).

attributes.name: index_source
attributes.description: The published market index source for the rack price (e.g., OPIS, Platts, DTN, Argus) or Internal for proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: OPIS (Oil Price Information Service), Platts, DTN, Argus Media

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this rack price record, capturing context, exceptions, or special conditions.

attributes.name: per_gallon
attributes.description: The wholesale petroleum rack price per gallon from the distributor or spot market index, serving as the cost basis for fuel margin calculation.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: A multiplier or adjustment factor applied to the base rack price for volume discounts, loyalty programs, or contract terms.

attributes.name: price_basis
attributes.description: The basis or source type for the rack price: terminal (local terminal rack), spot (spot market), contract (negotiated contract), or index (published index).

attributes.name: price_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or trigger for this rack price change (e.g., market volatility, contract renewal, seasonal adjustment, regulatory change).

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this rack price record: active (in use), pending (scheduled future), expired (past effective period), superseded (replaced by newer price), or cancelled.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: The classification of the price: wholesale (distributor rack), retail_reference (suggested retail), cost_plus (cost plus markup), or market_index (published index).

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rack price was published or announced by the distributor or index source.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rack price record was received or ingested into the system from the distributor or index feed.

attributes.name: tax_per_gallon
attributes.description: The applicable federal, state, and local excise tax per gallon included in or added to the rack price.

attributes.name: terminal_city
attributes.description: The city where the petroleum terminal is located.

attributes.name: terminal_location
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the petroleum terminal or distribution point where this rack price applies.

attributes.name: terminal_state_province_code
attributes.description: The state or province code where the petroleum terminal is located.

attributes.name: total_delivered_cost_per_gallon
attributes.description: The total delivered cost per gallon including rack price, freight, taxes, and fees, representing the true cost basis for margin calculation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rack price record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: volume_tier
attributes.description: The volume tier or bracket that qualifies for this rack price (e.g., 0-10000 gallons, 10001-50000 gallons), supporting tiered pricing structures.

products.name: tax
products.description: Master and transactional record of fuel excise taxes, state motor fuel taxes, UST fees, environmental surcharges, and inspection fees applicable per fuel grade per jurisdiction. Captures tax type, rate per gallon, effective date, jurisdiction (federal/state/county/city), remittance frequency, filing deadline, and tax-exempt transaction handling rules. Critical for fuel tax remittance reporting to state revenue departments and IRS excise tax filings.

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for each fuel tax record.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel.fuel_center. Business justification: Fuel tax rules apply to specific fuel centers; linking tax to center enables compliance reporting and eliminates silo.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns fuel tax expense to the cost center responsible for the fuel operation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax liabilities are posted to a dedicated GL account for tax reporting.

attributes.name: applicability
attributes.description: Specifies whether the tax applies at the point of sale, during delivery, or both.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Result of internal audit of the tax record.

attributes.name: audit_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent audit was performed.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Internal code representing the tax category for reporting and accounting purposes.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax record complies with current regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tax rate becomes effective.

attributes.name: exempt_reason_code
attributes.description: Code representing the reason for tax exemption (e.g., SNAP, EBT).

attributes.name: exempt_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exemption reason.

attributes.name: exempt_transaction_flag
attributes.description: True if the tax does not apply to the transaction under the exemption rules.

attributes.name: exemption_rule_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of rules that qualify a transaction for tax exemption.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tax rate expires or is superseded; null if indefinite.

attributes.name: filing_deadline_day
attributes.description: Day of the month by which the tax filing must be submitted.

attributes.name: id_number
attributes.description: Government‑issued identifier for the tax (e.g., state tax ID).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the jurisdiction (e.g., state abbreviation, FIPS county code).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Level of government imposing the tax: federal, state, county, or city.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the jurisdiction imposing the tax.

attributes.name: last_effective_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the effective date or rate was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or remarks about the tax record.

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 currency code for the tax rate (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: rate_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the tax rate became effective.

attributes.name: rate_per_gallon
attributes.description: Monetary amount of tax charged per gallon of fuel, expressed in the applicable currency.

attributes.name: remittance_account
attributes.description: Internal finance account used for remitting the tax to the authority.

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: How often the tax must be remitted to the governing authority.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that supplied the tax data (e.g., SAP FI, Oracle Retail).

attributes.name: tax_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax record.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax, such as excise, environmental surcharge, underground storage tank (UST) fee, or other applicable tax.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the tax record.

attributes.name: superseded_tax_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tax (superseded_tax_id)

products.name: fuel_pricing
products.description: Represents the pricing relationship between a fuel_center and a fuel_grade. Each record captures the price, cost, margin and the effective time period for a specific grade at a specific center.. Existence Justification: Fuel centers sell multiple fuel grades and each fuel grade is offered at multiple fuel centers. The business actively manages pricing for each center‑grade combination, tracking street price, cost, margin, and effective dates.

attributes.name: fuel_pricing_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the FuelPricing association

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel_center

attributes.name: grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fuel_grade

attributes.name: cost_per_gallon
attributes.description: Wholesale cost per gallon for the center

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing becomes effective

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing expires

attributes.name: margin_per_gallon
attributes.description: Margin earned per gallon (price minus cost)

attributes.name: street_price
attributes.description: Retail price per gallon at the pump

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Employee lifecycle management including hiring, scheduling, time and attendance, labor analytics, payroll, benefits, and talent development. Manages store associates, pharmacists, DC workers, and corporate staff. Tracks OSHA safety incidents, certifications, and labor compliance. Integrates with Kronos Workforce Central and Workday HCM systems.
domains.references: OSHA Workplace Safety Standards, FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act), Internal HR Policies

products.name: associate
products.description: Master record for all Grocery employees including store associates, pharmacists, DC workers, and corporate staff. Serves as the single source of truth for employee identity, employment status, job classification, compensation band and history (current and prior rates with effective dates), hire date, termination date, work location, FLSA classification (exempt/non-exempt), union membership status, EEO category, disciplinary action history (verbal/written warnings, suspensions, terminations with dates and reasons for progressive discipline documentation), and emergency contact information. Supports pay equity audits, wrongful termination defense, and associate self-service inquiries. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR module.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each Grocery employee (associate). Serves as the primary key and enterprise-wide reference for all workforce-related records across Workday HCM, Kronos Workforce Central, and downstream analytics systems.

attributes.name: manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Associate ID of the direct manager (supervisor) of this associate, enabling the organizational hierarchy to be traversed. Used for approval workflows, performance reviews, and org chart reporting in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the primary work location (store, distribution center, pharmacy, fuel center, or corporate office) where the associate is assigned. Used for scheduling, OSHA incident reporting, and same-store sales labor analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: compensation_band
attributes.description: The compensation grade or band assigned to the associate's job code (e.g., Band 1, Band 2, Grade A, Grade B). Defines the salary range minimum and maximum for the role. Used for pay equity analysis, merit increase eligibility, and internal mobility decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Equal Pay Act; EEOC

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center code to which the associate's labor costs are charged. Enables granular labor cost reporting by store, department, or function. Critical for EBITDA analysis and store-level P&L reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO (Controlling); SOX; Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the associate. Required for age verification (e.g., alcohol/tobacco sales eligibility), benefits eligibility determination, and compliance with child labor laws under FLSA. Stored per CCPA and GDPR data minimization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; FLSA; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code to which the associate is assigned (e.g., Produce, Pharmacy, Distribution Center, Corporate Finance). Sourced from Workday HCM organizational hierarchy and used for labor cost allocation in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: disability_status
attributes.description: Self-reported disability status of the associate per Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and ADA requirements. Required for OFCCP Section 503 affirmative action reporting. Classified as confidential. Collected voluntarily.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: eeo_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 job category assigned to the associate per EEOC reporting requirements. Required for annual EEO-1 Component 1 filing submitted to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. Classified as confidential to protect workforce demographic data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exec_senior_mgr|first_mid_mgr|professionals|technicians|sales_workers|admin_support|craft_workers|operatives|laborers|service_workers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Report; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the associate's designated emergency contact person. Used by store management and HR in the event of a workplace injury, OSHA incident, or medical emergency. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the associate's designated emergency contact. Used by store management and HR in the event of a workplace injury, OSHA incident, or medical emergency.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known employee badge number used on store floors, scheduling systems (Kronos Workforce Central), and payroll. Printed on associate ID badges and referenced in HR correspondence.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the associate's employment at Grocery. Drives access control, payroll processing eligibility, benefits enrollment windows, and workforce analytics. 'on_leave' covers FMLA, medical, and personal leave. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|on_leave|terminated|suspended|retired|pending_hire — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; FMLA; FLSA

attributes.name: ethnicity
attributes.description: Self-reported race/ethnicity of the associate per EEOC EEO-1 categories. Required for annual EEO-1 Component 1 filing. Classified as confidential. Collected voluntarily. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_latino|white|black_african_american|asian|native_hawaiian_pacific_islander|american_indian_alaska_native|two_or_more_races — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Report; Title VII; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the associate as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for payroll, benefits administration, associate self-service, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Non-exempt associates are entitled to overtime pay at 1.5x for hours worked beyond 40 per week. Critical for payroll compliance and wage-and-hour litigation defense.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Self-reported gender of the associate. Collected for EEO-1 reporting, pay equity analysis, and diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) analytics. Classified as confidential. Collected voluntarily per EEOC guidelines.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Report; Title VII; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The official date the associate was hired by Grocery. Used to calculate tenure, benefits eligibility waiting periods, vesting schedules, and service anniversary milestones. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; ERISA; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: is_rehire_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether a terminated associate is eligible for rehire at Grocery. Set by HR during the offboarding process based on termination reason and disciplinary history. Used to screen applicants in the recruiting workflow.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code from the Workday HCM job catalog. Used for compensation benchmarking, EEO-1 reporting, labor cost allocation to cost centers, and integration with Kronos Workforce Central for scheduling rule assignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; EEOC EEO-1 Report

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the associate as defined in Workday HCM job catalog (e.g., Store Associate, Pharmacist, Distribution Center Picker, Department Manager, Corporate Analyst). Used in org charts, compliance reporting, and associate self-service.

attributes.name: last_disciplinary_action_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent disciplinary action taken against the associate (verbal warning, written warning, suspension, or termination). Used to track progressive discipline timelines and support wrongful termination defense. Null if no disciplinary history.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; NLRA; EEOC

attributes.name: last_disciplinary_action_type
attributes.description: Type of the most recent disciplinary action in the associate's progressive discipline record. Used alongside last_disciplinary_action_date to determine the next step in the progressive discipline process. Null if no disciplinary history.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; NLRA; EEOC

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal surname of the associate as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for payroll, benefits administration, associate self-service, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Primary mobile phone number for the associate. Used for shift notifications, emergency contact, two-factor authentication for Workday self-service, and Kronos scheduling alerts.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: national_id_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the associate's Social Security Number (SSN). Stored as a partial identifier for identity verification in associate self-service and payroll inquiries. Full SSN is stored only in the Workday HCM source system under PCI/PII controls and is NOT replicated to the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; IRS Publication 15; SOX; CCPA

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: Current compensation rate for the associate. For hourly associates, this is the hourly wage in USD. For salaried associates, this is the annual salary in USD. Used for payroll processing, pay equity audits, and compensation band analysis. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SOX; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); Equal Pay Act

attributes.name: pay_rate_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current pay_rate became effective. Used to track compensation history, calculate retroactive pay adjustments, and support pay equity audit trails. Together with pay_rate, forms the current compensation record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; Equal Pay Act; SOX

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is compensated on an hourly, salaried, or commission basis. Drives payroll calculation logic in Workday HCM Payroll and determines overtime eligibility in conjunction with FLSA classification.

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: Personal email address of the associate used for pre-hire communications, offboarding notifications, and W-2 delivery after separation. Stored per CCPA and GDPR data minimization principles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the associate prefers to be called in the workplace, which may differ from their legal name. Used on scheduling displays, store communications, and associate self-service portals to support an inclusive work environment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; EEOC Guidelines

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the associate record was first created in the Workday HCM system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per Grocery data standards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; SOX; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the associate record in the source Workday HCM system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; SOX; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: rehire_date
attributes.description: Date the associate was rehired following a prior termination. When populated, tenure calculations and benefits eligibility may use this date instead of the original hire date per Grocery's rehire policy. Null for associates who have never been rehired.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The effective date on which the associate's employment ended. Null for currently active associates. Used for final pay calculations, benefits termination, COBRA notification timelines, and wrongful termination defense documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; COBRA; WARN Act; SOX

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the associate's separation from Grocery. Used for turnover analytics, unemployment insurance claims, and wrongful termination defense. Null for active associates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|involuntary|retirement|layoff|job_abandonment|end_of_contract|deceased — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; WARN Act; EEOC

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific labor union or collective bargaining unit the associate belongs to (e.g., UFCW Local 400). Null for non-union associates. Used to apply the correct CBA rules in scheduling and payroll.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; NLRA; LMRA

attributes.name: union_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is a member of a labor union. Drives application of collective bargaining agreement (CBA) rules for scheduling, overtime, pay rates, and grievance procedures. Critical for labor relations compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); LMRA (Labor Management Relations Act)

attributes.name: veteran_status
attributes.description: Self-reported veteran status of the associate per VEVRAA (Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act) requirements. Required for VETS-4212 federal contractor reporting. Classified as confidential. Collected voluntarily.
attributes.references: VEVRAA; VETS-4212 Report; OFCCP; Workday HCM Core HR

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Company-issued email address for the associate. Primary channel for HR communications, benefits enrollment notifications, scheduling alerts, and associate self-service access via Workday.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: The unique worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM Core HR module. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the Workday source system. Distinct from the internal associate_id surrogate key.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the associate's employment arrangement. Determines benefits eligibility thresholds (ACA 30-hour rule), overtime rules, and scheduling constraints in Kronos Workforce Central. Seasonal workers are tracked separately for peak-period labor analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; ACA Section 4980H; FLSA

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized headcount positions and standardized job profile definitions within the Grocery organization. Represents approved job slots tied to a cost center, store, DC, or corporate department. At the position level: tracks position title, job code, department, FTE allocation, budgeted headcount, filled/vacant status, reporting hierarchy (supervisor position), and effective dates. As the job profile template: defines job family, job level, FLSA classification (exempt/non-exempt), pay grade range (min/mid/max), required certifications (pharmacy license, food handler card, forklift, DEA handler), union eligibility by bargaining unit, competency framework, physical requirements, minimum qualifications, and career ladder progression. Serves as the single source of truth for both structural headcount planning and standardized role definitions used for associate assignments and recruiting requisitions. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an authorized headcount position or job profile definition within the Grocery organization. Primary key for this entity. Sourced from Workday HCM Position Management.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Labor cost allocation reports require each position to be tied to a cost center for expense roll‑up and budgeting.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Supports Position Staffing Allocation process, linking each position to its fulfillment node for headcount budgeting.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: A Position represents a specific headcount slot that must be tied to a Job Profile defining its duties, pay grade, and qualifications. Adding Position.job_profile_id creates the required 1:N relations

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Positions are organized within the organizational hierarchy. Linking Position.org_unit_id to Org_Unit provides clear reporting and budgeting context without creating a cycle, as Org_Unit does not refe

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical location (store, Distribution Center (DC), pharmacy, fuel center, or corporate office) where this position is assigned. Supports store-level headcount planning and labor scheduling in Kronos Workforce Central.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: supervisor_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the parent position in the reporting hierarchy. Defines the organizational reporting chain (e.g., Store Associate reports to Department Manager position). Enables org chart generation and span-of-control analytics.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific union bargaining unit associated with this position (e.g., UFCW Local 400 for store associates, Teamsters for DC drivers). Applicable only when union_eligible is true. Governs wage rates, scheduling rules, and grievance procedures.
attributes.references: NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); UFCW (United Food and Commercial Workers) Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: budgeted_headcount
attributes.description: Number of approved headcount slots authorized for this position definition within the associated cost center or department. Supports annual headcount planning and variance reporting against actual filled positions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; SAP CO (Controlling)

attributes.name: career_ladder_next_position_code
attributes.description: Job code of the next position in the defined career progression path for this role. Supports internal mobility programs, succession planning, and associate development conversations. Sourced from Workday HCM career framework.

attributes.name: competency_profile_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the standardized competency framework profile assigned to this position, defining required skills, behaviors, and performance expectations. Used in performance reviews and talent assessments in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational department to which this position belongs (e.g., store department, pharmacy, DC operations, corporate finance). Aligns with SAP CO cost center hierarchy and Workday HCM supervisory organization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Management; SAP CO (Controlling)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this position is no longer active (eliminated or restructured). Null for currently active positions. Supports bi-temporal workforce planning and position lifecycle history.

attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central Scheduling; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: The standard daily closing or end time for this organizational unit in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used for labor scheduling in Kronos Workforce Central and store operations planning. Applicable to store departments and DC functional areas with defined operating windows.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: The standard daily opening or start time for this organizational unit in HH:MM (24-hour) format. Used for labor scheduling in Kronos Workforce Central and store operations planning. Applicable to store departments and DC functional areas with defined operating windows.

attributes.name: org_unit_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the organizational unit's business purpose, scope of operations, and key responsibilities. Provides context for business users beyond the unit name and type classification. Sourced from Workday HCM Org Management.

attributes.name: org_unit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the organizational unit (e.g., 'Produce Department', 'Pharmacy', 'Fuel Center', 'Distribution Center - Atlanta', 'Corporate Finance'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the organizational unit within the enterprise hierarchy. 'active' indicates the unit is currently operational; 'inactive' indicates it has been decommissioned; 'pending' indicates it is being set up; 'dissolved' indicates it has been permanently closed; 'on_hold' indicates temporarily suspended operations. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: osha_establishment_number
attributes.description: The OSHA establishment identifier assigned to this organizational unit for workplace safety incident reporting (OSHA 300 Log). Required for OSHA 29 CFR 1904 recordkeeping compliance. Applicable to store departments, DC functional areas, and fuel centers with distinct safety profiles.

attributes.name: planogram_zone
attributes.description: The planogram zone designation for store department organizational units, indicating the physical area of the store floor (e.g., 'Zone A - Perimeter', 'Zone B - Center Aisle', 'Endcap Row 3'). Used for merchandise planning, assortment management, and labor allocation to specific store zones.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System; Workday HCM Org Management

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the geographic or operational region to which this organizational unit belongs. Used for regional labor analytics, comp sales reporting, and district management. Aligns with Grocery's internal regional hierarchy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; SAP Retail SD

attributes.name: sap_org_unit_code
attributes.description: The organizational unit code as defined in SAP HCM or SAP CO for cross-system reconciliation. Used to map Workday HCM org units to SAP cost objects for financial posting and ERP integration.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling; SAP FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: The physical floor area in square feet allocated to this organizational unit within the store or distribution center. Used for labor productivity analysis (sales per square foot), planogram planning, and facility management. Applicable to store departments and DC functional areas.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard scheduled labor hours per week for this organizational unit as defined in Kronos Workforce Central. Used as the baseline for labor scheduling, overtime calculation, and labor budget variance analysis. Reflects the operational capacity of the unit.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central Scheduling; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) applicable to associates in this organizational unit. Grocery retail commonly involves UFCW (United Food and Commercial Workers) and Teamsters agreements. Drives labor compliance, scheduling rules, and payroll processing.
attributes.references: NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: unit_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification of the organizational unit within its type. For store departments, identifies specialty areas such as Fresh Produce, Deli, Bakery, Pharmacy, Fuel Center, Floral, Meat, Seafood, or General Merchandise. For DC functional areas, identifies Receiving, Putaway, Picking, Shipping, or Cold Chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fresh_produce|deli|bakery|pharmacy|fuel_center|floral|meat|seafood|general_merchandise|receiving|putaway|picking|shipping|cold_chain|hr|finance|it|marketing|operations — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the organizational unit indicating its role in the enterprise hierarchy. Segments the population into store departments (e.g., Produce, Deli, Pharmacy, Fuel), DC functional areas, corporate divisions, cost centers, regions, and districts. Serves as the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; SAP CO Controlling

attributes.name: workday_org_unit_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the organizational unit in Workday HCM. Used for cross-system integration with SAP CO (Controlling) cost center mapping and Kronos Workforce Central labor allocation. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Org Management; SAP CO Controlling

products.name: shift
products.description: Scheduled work shifts for store associates, DC workers, and pharmacy staff generated by Kronos Workforce Central. Captures shift date, start time, end time, scheduled hours, shift type (open/mid/close/overnight), department assignment, store or DC location, and schedule status (published/draft/approved). Core operational entity for labor scheduling and store coverage planning.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a scheduled work shift record in Kronos Workforce Central. Primary key for the shift entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Shift‑level labor cost tracking (overtime, premium pay) is allocated to cost centers for detailed expense analysis.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department within the store or DC to which this shift is assigned (e.g., Produce, Pharmacy, Bakery, Front End, Receiving).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling; SAP Retail - Organizational Management

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.node. Business justification: Enables Shift Scheduling in fulfillment centers, used by Kronos to schedule associates per node.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job position or role associated with this shift (e.g., Cashier, Stock Associate, Pharmacist, DC Picker). Sourced from Workday HCM position management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling

attributes.name: shift_approved_by_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor employee record who approved this shift in Kronos. Supports management accountability and schedule audit trails.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal Controls

attributes.name: shift_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assigned to this shift. Links to the workforce employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling

attributes.name: shift_original_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee originally assigned to this shift before a swap or reassignment occurred. Populated only when a shift swap or coverage change has taken place.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, Distribution Center (DC), pharmacy, or fuel center where this shift is scheduled to be worked.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling; SAP Retail - Organizational Management

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee acknowledged or confirmed this shift in Kronos. Populated only when employee_acknowledgement is True.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Predictive Scheduling Laws (Fair Workweek)

attributes.name: advance_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in advance the shift was published to the employee prior to the shift date. Used to monitor compliance with predictive scheduling and fair workweek regulations.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Predictive Scheduling Laws (Fair Workweek); FTC (Federal Trade Commission) - Advertising and Pricing Practices

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift was approved by a manager or supervisor in Kronos. Marks the transition from draft or pending state to approved status in the scheduling workflow.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for shift cancellation when schedule_status is cancelled. Used for labor analytics, predictive scheduling compliance reporting, and workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_show|voluntary|manager_cancelled|low_volume|weather|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Predictive Scheduling Laws (Fair Workweek)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift record was first created in Kronos Workforce Central. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has acknowledged or confirmed receipt of this scheduled shift via Kronos self-service or mobile app. Supports predictive scheduling compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Predictive Scheduling Laws (Fair Workweek)

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift falls on a company-designated holiday, triggering holiday pay rules and premium pay calculations in Kronos and Workday HCM payroll.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Time and Attendance; Workday HCM - Payroll

attributes.name: is_on_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is designated as an on-call shift, where the employee may be required to report to work on short notice based on operational demand.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: is_open_shift
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is an open (unassigned) shift available for employees to claim or pick up. Open shifts are published to eligible employees for voluntary coverage in Kronos.

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is expected to result in overtime hours based on the employee's weekly scheduled hours at the time of scheduling. Used for proactive overtime management and labor budget control.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Analytics; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: kronos_shift_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique shift identifier as assigned by Kronos Workforce Central. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability between the lakehouse and the system of record.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Human-readable name or code assigned to the shift template in Kronos (e.g., 'AM-6-2', 'PM-2-10', 'PHARM-OPEN'). Used by store managers for quick identification and schedule communication.

attributes.name: labor_category
attributes.description: Classification of the labor type for this shift used in labor cost accounting and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis. Determines how labor hours are allocated to cost centers in SAP Retail CO.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Analytics; SAP Retail CO - Controlling; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift record was most recently updated in Kronos Workforce Central. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the work location where the shift is performed. Distinguishes between retail store, Distribution Center (DC), pharmacy, fuel center, and corporate office assignments for labor analytics segmentation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling; SAP Retail - Organizational Management

attributes.name: meal_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled unpaid meal break duration in minutes for this shift. Used to calculate net paid hours and ensure compliance with state labor law meal break requirements.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Time and Attendance; OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); State Labor Laws

attributes.name: minimum_rest_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours of rest required between this shift and the preceding shift for the same employee, as defined by company policy or applicable labor regulations. Used to flag clopening shifts (close followed by open).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); State Labor Laws

attributes.name: pay_rule_code
attributes.description: The Kronos pay rule applied to this shift, governing how hours are calculated for payroll purposes (e.g., regular, overtime, holiday, premium). Drives downstream payroll processing in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift was published and made visible to the assigned employee in Kronos. Used to measure schedule advance notice compliance with predictive scheduling laws.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Predictive Scheduling Laws (Fair Workweek)

attributes.name: rest_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled paid rest break duration in minutes for this shift. Used to ensure compliance with state labor law rest break requirements and accurate paid hours calculation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Time and Attendance; OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); State Labor Laws

attributes.name: schedule_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the scheduling week (typically Sunday) to which this shift belongs. Used for weekly hour aggregation, overtime threshold monitoring, and schedule period reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned date and time the employee is scheduled to end their shift, including timezone offset. For overnight shifts, this timestamp will fall on the following calendar date.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee is scheduled to work for this shift, calculated as the difference between scheduled end time and scheduled start time. Used for weekly hour tracking, overtime monitoring, and labor budget compliance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Analytics; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned date and time the employee is scheduled to begin their shift, including timezone offset. Used for store coverage planning and labor cost forecasting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the shift is scheduled to occur. For overnight shifts spanning midnight, this is the date the shift begins. Used for daily labor planning and store coverage analysis.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; OSHA Recordkeeping Standards

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift based on its time-of-day position within the store operating day. Open shifts cover store opening, mid shifts cover peak daytime hours, close shifts cover store closing, overnight shifts span midnight, and split shifts have a significant unpaid break between two work segments.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system that created or last updated this shift record. Kronos Workforce Central is the primary system of record; Workday HCM may contribute position data; manual indicates direct data entry.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling Module; Workday HCM - Core HR

attributes.name: swap_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a shift swap has been requested or processed for this shift. Tracks the lifecycle of employee-initiated shift exchanges managed through Kronos self-service.

attributes.name: workload_budget_hours
attributes.description: The budgeted labor hours allocated to this shift based on the store's labor model and forecasted customer demand from Blue Yonder Demand Planning. Used for variance analysis between scheduled and budgeted hours.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Analytics; Blue Yonder Demand Planning - Forecasting

products.name: schedule
products.description: Labor schedules and individual shift assignments for store associates, DC workers, and pharmacy staff generated by Kronos Workforce Central. At the schedule level: captures schedule period (weekly/bi-weekly), total scheduled hours, labor budget hours, schedule status (draft/published/approved), store/department coverage targets, and schedule owner (manager). At the shift level (line items): captures shift date, start/end times, scheduled hours, shift type (open/mid/close/overnight), department assignment, break rules, assigned associate, shift swap status, and call-off/replacement tracking. Supports labor coverage planning, schedule adherence measurement, labor budget vs. actual analysis, union seniority-based shift bidding, and Kronos auto-scheduler output.

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the labor schedule record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the Kronos Workforce Central scheduling system.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Scheduling tools assign planned labor hours to cost centers to support labor budgeting and variance reporting.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store department or work area covered by this schedule (e.g., Produce, Pharmacy, Deli, DC Receiving). Drives department-level labor coverage targets.

attributes.name: schedule_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store manager or department manager who owns and is accountable for this schedule. Used for approval workflow and labor accountability reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Object; Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Owner

attributes.name: schedule_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate, pharmacist, DC worker, or corporate staff member assigned to this shift. Links to the workforce employee master for seniority, role, and wage data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Worker Object; Kronos Workforce Central — Employee Assignment

attributes.name: schedule_replacement_employee_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate who covered this shift in the event of a call-off or swap. Populated only when call_off_flag is True or shift_swap_status is completed. Supports coverage gap resolution tracking.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an individual shift assignment within the schedule. Represents a single associate's scheduled work block on a specific date. Acts as the line-item primary key within the schedule.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or facility location for which this schedule was generated. Covers supermarkets, pharmacies, distribution centers, and fuel centers.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule was formally approved by the store director or authorized manager. Marks the schedule as finalized for operational execution.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Approval Workflow; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Internal Controls

attributes.name: auto_scheduled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule was generated by the Kronos auto-scheduler engine (True) or manually built by a manager (False). Used to measure auto-scheduler adoption and quality.

attributes.name: break_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled unpaid break time in minutes for this shift. Includes meal breaks and rest periods as required by state labor law and collective bargaining agreements. Used for net hours calculation.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) — Rest Period Requirements; State Labor Laws — Meal Break Mandates

attributes.name: call_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned associate called off (was absent) for this scheduled shift (True) or worked as scheduled (False). Drives call-off rate reporting and attendance policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Absence Management; Workday HCM — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of required labor coverage positions that must be filled for each operating hour in the schedule period. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 = 95%). Supports store operations and replenishment coverage planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule record was first created in Kronos Workforce Central. Serves as the audit trail anchor for schedule lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Audit Trail; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Record Keeping

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Kronos/Workday job code identifying the role or position the associate is scheduled to perform during this shift (e.g., CASHIER, PRODUCE_CLERK, PHARMACIST, DC_PICKER). Drives wage rate application and skill-based scheduling.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Job Profile; Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Category

attributes.name: kronos_schedule_code
attributes.description: Native schedule identifier assigned by Kronos Workforce Central. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the source scheduling system.

attributes.name: labor_budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved labor cost budget in USD for this schedule period and department. Derived from labor budget hours multiplied by blended wage rates. Used for financial labor cost control and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO — Cost Center Budget; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Financial Controls

attributes.name: labor_budget_hours
attributes.description: Approved labor budget expressed in hours for this schedule period and department, sourced from the store's labor model. Enables budget vs. scheduled vs. actual labor variance analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Labor Budget; SAP CO — Cost Center Planning

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the schedule header record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Audit Trail; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Record Keeping

attributes.name: locked_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule was locked for payroll processing. After this point, no further shift modifications are permitted without a payroll adjustment workflow.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Payroll Lock; Workday HCM — Payroll Processing

attributes.name: minor_work_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift was scheduled subject to minor labor law restrictions (True), applicable to associates under 18 years of age. Ensures compliance with FLSA child labor provisions and state minor work permit requirements.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Child Labor Provisions; State Minor Labor Laws

attributes.name: overtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is projected to contribute to overtime hours for the associate (True) based on weekly hours accumulation at schedule build time. Used for proactive overtime cost management.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Overtime Threshold; Kronos Workforce Central — Overtime Alerts

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled paid break time in minutes for this shift (e.g., 15-minute paid rest breaks). Distinct from unpaid meal breaks. Included in total compensable hours per FLSA and CBA requirements.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Compensable Time; Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA)

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the schedule period. Defines the closing boundary of the scheduling window. Must be 6 days after period_start_date for weekly or 13 days after for bi-weekly schedules.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Period; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Workweek Definition

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the schedule period. Combined with period_end_date defines the full scheduling window for labor coverage planning.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Period; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Workweek Definition

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the schedule covers a weekly (7-day) or bi-weekly (14-day) labor period. Aligns with the store's payroll cycle configuration in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Pay Period Configuration; Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Period

attributes.name: predictive_scheduling_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance notice provided to the associate before this shift, measured from published_timestamp to shift_date. Used to verify compliance with predictive scheduling ordinances (e.g., Fair Workweek laws) in applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: Fair Workweek / Predictive Scheduling Ordinances (City/State); OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration)

attributes.name: premium_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift qualifies for premium pay (True), such as holiday pay, weekend differential, or predictive scheduling penalty pay for late-notice schedule changes. Triggers payroll premium calculation in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Payroll Premium Rules; Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) — Premium Pay Provisions

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule was published and made visible to associates. Supports advance notice compliance measurement (many CBAs require 7–14 days advance notice).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Workflow; Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) — Advance Notice Requirements

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the schedule, typically formatted as STORE-DEPT-PERIOD (e.g., STR001-PROD-2024W23). Used in operational communications and printed schedule reports.

attributes.name: schedule_source
attributes.description: Identifies the origination method of this schedule or shift. Kronos_auto: generated by Kronos auto-scheduler. Manager_manual: manually entered by manager. Self_service: associate-initiated via self-service portal. Imported: loaded from external system.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Schedule Source Tracking

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the schedule. Draft: initial build by manager or Kronos auto-scheduler. Published: released to associates. Approved: authorized by store director. Locked: finalized for payroll processing. Cancelled: voided schedule.

attributes.name: scheduled_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of distinct associates assigned at least one shift within this schedule period. Used for coverage planning and minimum staffing compliance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Staffing Analytics; OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) — Minimum Staffing

attributes.name: scheduled_shift_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours scheduled for this individual shift, net of unpaid break time. Used for daily labor hour tracking, overtime risk flagging, and payroll pre-calculation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Shift Duration; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Hours Worked

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end date and time for the shift. Combined with shift_start_time determines scheduled shift duration. Used for overtime pre-screening and labor cost projection.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Shift End Time; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start date and time for the shift. Includes timezone context for multi-timezone store operations. Used for schedule adherence and time-and-attendance comparison.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Shift Start Time; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: total_scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all shift hours across all associates assigned to this schedule for the period. Used for labor budget vs. actual analysis and schedule adherence measurement.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: union_seniority_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether union seniority-based shift bidding rules were applied during schedule generation (True) or not (False). Required for union contract compliance and grievance defense.
attributes.references: Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) — Seniority Bidding Rules; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act)

attributes.name: workday_pay_period_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding pay period in Workday HCM to which this schedule's labor hours will be applied. Enables reconciliation between scheduled hours and payroll processing.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Individual clock-in/clock-out records captured by Kronos Workforce Central time clocks and mobile punch devices.
