Tracks punch-in timestamp, punch-out timestamp, actual hours worked, break duration, meal period compliance, overtime hours, pay code (regular/OT/holiday/sick), approval status, and exception flags (missed punch, early/late). Foundation for payroll processing and labor law compliance.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual time entry record (clock-in/clock-out event) captured by Kronos Workforce Central or mobile punch device.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center to which the labor hours and associated costs for this time entry are allocated for financial reporting and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: primary_time_associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee associated with this time entry. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Core HR; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled shift that this time entry is associated with, enabling variance analysis between scheduled and actual hours worked.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the store, distribution center, pharmacy, or fuel center location where the employee clocked in. Supports labor cost allocation by location.
attributes.references: SAP Retail — Organizational Management; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee actually worked during this time entry, calculated as the difference between punch-out and punch-in minus approved break durations. Foundation for payroll computation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Manager approval status for this time entry. Unapproved entries cannot be processed for payroll. Supports dual-control compliance and SOX internal controls for labor cost authorization.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404; FLSA

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manager approved or rejected this time entry. Provides audit trail for payroll authorization and labor compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes of all rest breaks taken during this time entry. Used for meal and rest period compliance tracking under applicable state labor laws (e.g., California IWC Wage Orders).
attributes.references: OSHA; California IWC Wage Orders; State Labor Laws; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was first created in the Kronos Workforce Central system, whether by automatic punch capture or manual entry.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Store or facility department code where the employee worked during this time entry (e.g., produce, pharmacy, deli, DC receiving). Supports department-level labor cost allocation and scheduling analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Retail — CO (Controlling); Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours qualifying for double-time pay rate, applicable in states such as California where hours beyond 12 in a day or 8 on the seventh consecutive day trigger double-time compensation.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 510; State Labor Laws; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: edit_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the manager when manually creating or modifying a time entry. Required for audit trail integrity and SOX internal controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the time entry record. Pending entries await manager review; approved entries are eligible for payroll processing; locked entries have been submitted to payroll; voided entries are cancelled.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Kronos exception code identifying the specific type of time entry exception flagged by the system (e.g., missed punch, unscheduled overtime, consecutive day violation). Used for exception-based management reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MISSED_PUNCH|UNSCHEDULED_OT|CONSEC_DAY|EARLY_IN|LATE_IN|EARLY_OUT|LATE_OUT|MEAL_VIOLATION|REST_VIOLATION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: is_early_punch_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee clocked in earlier than the scheduled start time, beyond the configured grace period. Used for schedule adherence monitoring and unauthorized overtime prevention.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA

attributes.name: is_early_punch_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee clocked out earlier than the scheduled end time, beyond the configured grace period. Supports schedule adherence and store coverage gap analysis.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: is_late_punch_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee clocked in later than the scheduled start time, beyond the configured grace period. Used for attendance management, coaching, and store operations reliability reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: is_late_punch_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee clocked out later than the scheduled end time, beyond the configured grace period. Used to identify unauthorized overtime and schedule overrun situations.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA

attributes.name: is_manual_edit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry was manually created or edited by a manager or HR administrator, as opposed to being captured automatically by a time clock or mobile device. Manual entries require heightened audit scrutiny.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA

attributes.name: is_missed_punch
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has a missing punch-in or punch-out record. Missed punches require manager correction before payroll processing and are tracked for compliance and exception reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Kronos/Workday job code identifying the role or position the employee was performing during this time entry (e.g., cashier, stocker, pharmacist, DC picker). Enables labor cost analysis by job function.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics; Workday HCM — Core HR

attributes.name: kronos_entry_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by Kronos Workforce Central to this time entry record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: labor_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the employee's labor category for this time entry. Used for workforce analytics, labor budget reporting, and GMROI-related labor cost analysis.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics; Workday HCM — Talent Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was most recently updated, including manager edits, approval actions, or system corrections. Supports audit trail and change detection.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: meal_period_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes of the unpaid meal period taken during this shift. Tracked separately from rest breaks for compliance with meal period mandates (e.g., 30-minute unpaid meal after 5 hours worked).
attributes.references: FLSA; California Labor Code Section 512; State Labor Laws; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: meal_period_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a meal period compliance violation occurred for this time entry (e.g., meal period not taken within required timeframe). Triggers premium pay obligation under California Labor Code and similar state laws.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 226.7; State Labor Laws; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: meal_period_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee formally waived their meal period for this shift, as permitted under applicable state labor law for shifts of 6 hours or less. Required for meal period compliance documentation.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 512; State Labor Laws; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week) that qualify for overtime pay under FLSA or applicable state labor law. Used for payroll and labor cost management.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); Kronos Workforce Central — Labor Analytics

attributes.name: pay_code
attributes.description: Kronos pay code classifying the type of compensation applicable to this time entry. Drives payroll rate calculation in Workday HCM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REG|OT|DT|HOL|SICK|VAC|PTO|BEREAVEMENT|JURY|TRAINING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; Workday HCM — Payroll

attributes.name: pay_period_code
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll pay period within which this time entry falls, used for payroll processing and labor cost aggregation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: payroll_export_status
attributes.description: Status of this time entry's export to the Workday HCM payroll system. Tracks whether the record has been successfully transmitted for payroll processing or if an error occurred during the interface.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Payroll; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: payroll_export_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry was successfully exported to the Workday HCM payroll system for processing. Null if not yet exported.
attributes.references: Workday HCM — Payroll; Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: punch_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the employee clocked in, as recorded by the Kronos time clock or mobile punch device. This is the principal real-world event time for the start of the work period.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: punch_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the employee clocked out, as recorded by the Kronos time clock or mobile punch device. Null if the employee has not yet punched out or if a missed punch exception exists.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: punch_source
attributes.description: The device or method used to record the punch-in and punch-out. Supports audit integrity and exception analysis; manual entries require additional approval scrutiny.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; OSHA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: rest_break_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether a rest break compliance violation occurred for this time entry (e.g., required 10-minute rest break not provided). Triggers premium pay obligation under applicable state labor laws.
attributes.references: California IWC Wage Orders; State Labor Laws; OSHA; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the employee was originally scheduled to work for this shift, as defined in Kronos scheduling. Enables variance analysis between planned and actual labor.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work shift began. Used for daily labor reporting, scheduling variance, and compliance with daily overtime rules under applicable state labor laws.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central — Time and Attendance; FLSA; State Labor Laws

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Payroll processing records from Workday HCM Payroll capturing each payroll cycle execution and associate-level pay detail. At the run level: tracks pay period start/end dates, pay frequency (weekly/bi-weekly), run type (regular/off-cycle/correction), run status, total gross pay, total net pay, total tax withholdings, total deductions, employee count processed, and payroll completion timestamp. At the associate level: tracks individual gross earnings by pay code (regular/OT/holiday/premium), tax withholdings (federal/state/local/FICA), pre-tax deductions (401k/HSA/FSA/medical), post-tax deductions (garnishments/union dues/Roth), net pay, direct deposit allocations, and YTD accumulators. Supports SOX financial controls, payroll audit, W-2 reconciliation, garnishment compliance, and associate pay inquiry resolution.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payroll run record in the Workday HCM Payroll system. Serves as the primary key for the payroll_run data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary SAP CO cost center associated with this payroll run for labor cost allocation. Enables EBITDA analysis and store-level labor cost reporting. Individual associate-level cost center splits may vary.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company code in SAP FI) under which this payroll run is processed. Determines tax jurisdiction, employer identification number (EIN), and GL posting rules for SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI Financial Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; IRS EIN

attributes.name: pay_calendar_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM pay calendar that governs the schedule of this payroll run, including pay period dates, check dates, and processing deadlines. Determines the annual payroll schedule for the associated pay group.

attributes.name: pay_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM pay group that defines the population of associates included in this payroll run (e.g., store hourly, pharmacy salaried, DC associates, corporate staff). Determines pay frequency, pay calendar, and processing rules.

attributes.name: primary_payroll_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM user (payroll administrator) who initiated and submitted this payroll run for processing. Required for SOX segregation of duties controls and payroll audit trail.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: prior_run_payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preceding payroll run that this run corrects or supersedes. Populated only for run_type = correction or off_cycle. Enables audit trail linking between original and corrected payroll runs for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll run received final approval in Workday HCM before processing. Captures the approval event in the payroll lifecycle for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: associate_count
attributes.description: Total number of associates included and processed in this payroll run. Used for payroll audit validation, headcount reconciliation, and detecting anomalies (e.g., unexpected count changes between runs).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which associates receive payment via direct deposit or physical check. This is the principal business event date for the payroll run and is used for GL posting dates in SAP FI and tax deposit timing per IRS schedules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; SAP FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was first created in Workday HCM. Serves as the audit record creation timestamp for SOX internal controls and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll run (e.g., USD). Grocery operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-entity reporting and potential international expansion.

attributes.name: direct_deposit_file_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the ACH (Automated Clearing House) NACHA-format direct deposit file generated for this payroll run and transmitted to the bank. Used for payment reconciliation and resolving associate pay inquiry cases.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number generated when payroll journal entries are posted to the General Ledger. Provides the cross-reference between Workday HCM payroll records and SAP FI accounting documents for SOX audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Financial Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which payroll journal entries are posted to the SAP FI General Ledger. May differ from check_date due to accounting period cutoffs. Critical for period-end close, EBITDA reporting, and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI Financial Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: is_final
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run has been finalized and locked in Workday HCM, preventing further modifications. Final runs trigger GL posting to SAP FI and ACH direct deposit file generation. Non-final runs are still in preview or correction mode.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_off_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run is an off-cycle run executed outside the standard pay calendar schedule (e.g., termination pay, correction payments, bonus disbursements). Off-cycle runs require additional SOX approval controls.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run record was most recently modified in Workday HCM or the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks the latest state change for audit trail completeness and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which associates are paid for this payroll run. Determines the pay period cadence and aligns with Workday HCM pay group configurations. Common frequencies include weekly for hourly store associates and bi-weekly for salaried staff.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the closing boundary of the earnings window. Must align with Kronos Workforce Central time and attendance cutoff for accurate hours capture.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Kronos Workforce Central; FLSA

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the beginning of the earnings window for all associates included in the run. Used for W-2 reconciliation and labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; FLSA

attributes.name: processing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when Workday HCM completed the payroll calculation and finalized the run. Marks the principal business event completion time. Used for payroll SLA compliance and downstream GL posting scheduling in SAP FI.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when Workday HCM began executing the payroll calculation engine for this run. Used for SLA monitoring of payroll processing windows and operational performance tracking.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the payroll run as assigned by Workday HCM (e.g., PR-2024-001). Used for audit trails, SOX financial controls, and payroll reconciliation references.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run within the Workday HCM processing workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or cancellation. Supports SOX audit controls and payroll operations monitoring.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run indicating whether it is a standard scheduled run, an off-cycle adjustment, a correction to a prior run, a supplemental payment, or a bonus payout. Drives processing rules and GL posting in SAP FI.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar tax year (e.g., 2024) to which this payroll run belongs. Determines applicable tax rates, wage bases, and W-2 reporting period. Essential for year-end W-2 reconciliation and IRS Form 941 annual filing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS W-2; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: total_check_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount disbursed via physical payroll checks for associates not enrolled in direct deposit. Together with total_direct_deposit_amount, reconciles to total_net_pay. Supports treasury and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP FI

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate of all pre-tax and post-tax deductions across all associates in this payroll run, including 401(k), HSA, FSA, medical premiums, garnishments, union dues, and Roth contributions. Supports benefits reconciliation and garnishment compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Section 125; ERISA; Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) garnishment limits

attributes.name: total_direct_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount transmitted via ACH direct deposit for this payroll run. Should reconcile to total_net_pay minus any physical check amounts. Used for bank reconciliation and treasury cash management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: total_employer_taxes
attributes.description: Aggregate employer-side tax obligations for this payroll run, including employer FICA (Social Security and Medicare match), federal unemployment tax (FUTA), and state unemployment insurance (SUI). Required for accurate labor cost accounting and IRS Form 941 filing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Form 941; FUTA (26 U.S.C. § 3301); SUTA

attributes.name: total_garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all court-ordered wage garnishments, child support withholdings, and creditor garnishments deducted across all associates in this payroll run. Required for garnishment compliance reporting and remittance to issuing agencies per Consumer Credit Protection Act limits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) Title III; IRS Tax Levy

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: Sum of all gross earnings for all associates included in this payroll run before any tax withholdings or deductions. Includes regular pay, overtime, holiday pay, and premium pay. Key metric for SOX financial controls and payroll audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: Total amount disbursed to all associates after all tax withholdings and deductions. Equals total_gross_pay minus total_tax_withholdings minus total_deductions. Primary cash outflow figure for treasury and GL posting in SAP FI.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP FI; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: total_posttax_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate of all post-tax deductions across all associates in this payroll run, including Roth 401(k) contributions, union dues, and voluntary post-tax benefit elections. Does not reduce taxable wages but reduces net pay.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Section 402A (Roth); NLRA (union dues)

attributes.name: total_pretax_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate of all pre-tax benefit deductions across all associates in this payroll run, including 401(k) contributions, HSA contributions, FSA contributions, and medical/dental/vision premiums under Section 125 cafeteria plans. Reduces taxable wages for W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Section 125; IRS Section 401(k); IRS Section 223 (HSA)

attributes.name: total_tax_withholdings
attributes.description: Aggregate of all federal, state, local, and FICA (Social Security and Medicare) tax withholdings across all associates in this payroll run. Used for IRS tax deposit scheduling and W-2 reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; FICA (26 U.S.C. § 3101)

attributes.name: workday_run_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this payroll run in the Workday HCM source system. Enables cross-reference between the Databricks Silver Layer record and the operational system of record for audit, reconciliation, and support inquiry resolution.

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay for all associates in this pay group from the start of the tax year through this payroll run. Used for W-2 reconciliation, Social Security wage base tracking, and annual compensation reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS W-2 Reporting; Social Security Administration wage base

attributes.name: ytd_tax_withholdings
attributes.description: Cumulative tax withholdings for all associates in this pay group from the start of the tax year through this payroll run. Critical for W-2 Box 2 (federal income tax withheld) reconciliation and IRS Form 941 quarterly reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS W-2; IRS Form 941

products.name: workforce_benefit_enrollment
products.description: Associate benefit plan enrollments managed through Workday HCM Benefits Administration. Tracks benefit plan type (medical/dental/vision/401k/FSA/HSA/life insurance/disability), plan name, coverage tier (employee only/employee+spouse/family), enrollment effective date, termination date, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, enrollment source (open enrollment/qualifying life event/new hire), dependent information, ACA coverage indicator, and ACA affordability safe harbor method. Supports ACA 1095-C reporting, benefits cost analysis, and open enrollment administration.

attributes.name: workforce_benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each benefit enrollment record in the Workday HCM Benefits Administration module. Serves as the primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate enrolled in the benefit plan. Links to the workforce employee master record in Workday HCM. Covers store associates, pharmacists, distribution center workers, and corporate staff.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan in which the associate is enrolled. Links to the benefit plan master record maintained in Workday HCM Benefits Administration.

attributes.name: open_enrollment_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open enrollment period during which this enrollment was submitted. Populated for enrollments sourced from open enrollment events; null for qualifying life event or new hire enrollments. Supports open enrollment administration and participation rate analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ERISA Section 702

attributes.name: aca_affordability_safe_harbor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Affordability Safe Harbor Method
attributes.description: The IRS-approved safe harbor method used to determine whether the employee's required contribution for self-only coverage is affordable under ACA Section 4980H(b). Drives 1095-C Line 16 coding. W2 uses Box 1 wages; rate_of_pay uses hourly rate; federal_poverty_line uses FPL threshold.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H(b); IRS Form 1095-C Line 16; 26 CFR 54.4980H-5; IRS Rev. Proc. 2014-37

attributes.name: aca_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit enrollment constitutes minimum essential coverage (MEC) under the Affordable Care Act. True means the plan qualifies as ACA-compliant MEC. Drives 1095-C Line 14 offer-of-coverage code determination and employer shared responsibility payment (ESRP) calculations.
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C; IRS Publication 974; 26 CFR 54.4980H-4

attributes.name: aca_minimum_value_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Minimum Value Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrolled health plan meets the ACA minimum value standard (covers at least 60% of total allowed costs). Required for 1095-C reporting and employer shared responsibility compliance under ACA Section 4980H(b).
attributes.references: ACA Section 4980H(b); IRS Form 1095-C Line 14; 26 CFR 54.4980H-5; IRS Notice 2012-31

attributes.name: aca_offer_of_coverage_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Offer of Coverage Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code for 1095-C Line 14 indicating the type of health coverage offered to the employee and their dependents/spouse. Codes 1A-1F correspond to specific offer scenarios defined by the IRS for employer shared responsibility reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Line 14; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Instructions for Forms 1094-C and 1095-C

attributes.name: aca_safe_harbor_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affordable Care Act (ACA) Safe Harbor Code
attributes.description: IRS-defined code for 1095-C Line 16 indicating the applicable safe harbor or relief provision for each month. Codes 2A-2F correspond to specific relief scenarios (e.g., 2C = enrolled in coverage, 2F = W-2 safe harbor). Required for ACA employer shared responsibility reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C Line 16; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Instructions for Forms 1094-C and 1095-C

attributes.name: annual_employee_contribution
attributes.description: Total annualized employee contribution amount for the benefit plan, calculated as the per-pay-period contribution multiplied by the number of pay periods. Used directly in ACA affordability safe harbor calculations (W-2, Rate of Pay, Federal Poverty Line methods) for 1095-C Line 16 coding.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1095-C; ACA Section 4980H(b); IRS Rev. Proc. 2014-37; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: annual_employer_contribution
attributes.description: Total annualized employer contribution amount for the benefit plan. Used in total benefits cost analysis, EBITDA reporting, and financial planning. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; SOX Section 302; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: carrier_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or member ID number issued by the insurance carrier or benefit provider upon enrollment confirmation. Used for carrier reconciliation, EDI 834 transaction matching, and associate ID card issuance tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set; ASC X12 Standard

attributes.name: carrier_enrollment_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enrollment data was transmitted to the insurance carrier via EDI 834 or carrier feed. Used for carrier reconciliation, enrollment lag analysis, and compliance with carrier enrollment submission deadlines.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set; ASC X12 Standard

attributes.name: cobra_election_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Date
attributes.description: Date on which the associate elected COBRA continuation coverage following termination of active enrollment. Nullable; populated only when COBRA is elected. Used for COBRA compliance tracking and carrier notification.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); DOL COBRA Regulations; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of this enrollment. Drives COBRA election notice generation and compliance tracking under 29 U.S.C. § 1161. Applicable to medical, dental, and vision plan types.
attributes.references: COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); DOL COBRA Regulations; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Coverage level selected by the associate, determining the scope of dependents covered and the applicable premium contribution rates. Drives both employee and employer contribution calculations and ACA affordability analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit enrollment record was first created in Workday HCM Benefits Administration. Establishes the audit trail origin for the enrollment lifecycle and supports ERISA record retention compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ERISA Section 107; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents enrolled under this benefit plan enrollment. Used to validate coverage tier selection, support ACA dependent coverage reporting on 1095-C Part III, and drive carrier enrollment file generation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Form 1095-C Part III; ACA Section 1001

attributes.name: disability_benefit_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disability plan enrollment is for short-term disability (STD) or long-term disability (LTD) coverage. Applicable only when plan_type is 'disability'. Drives benefit duration, elimination period, and OSHA/FMLA integration for leave management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; OSHA; FMLA (29 U.S.C. § 2601); ERISA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage becomes active for the associate. Determines the start of the coverage period for ACA 1095-C reporting, carrier billing, and payroll deduction initiation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Form 1095-C; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period pre-tax payroll deduction amount contributed by the associate toward the benefit plan premium. Used in benefits cost analysis, payroll reconciliation, and ACA affordability safe harbor calculations. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H(b); SOX Section 302

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Per-pay-period amount contributed by Grocery toward the associate's benefit plan premium. Used in total compensation reporting, benefits cost analysis, EBITDA impact modeling, and ACA minimum value determination. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: employer_match_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of the associate's eligible compensation that Grocery matches in the 401(k) plan, up to the match cap. Applicable only when plan_type is '401k'. Used in total compensation reporting and ERISA plan administration. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 3.00 = 3%).
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; IRS Publication 560; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the associate's benefit enrollment was confirmed and finalized in Workday HCM Benefits Administration. Distinct from the effective_date (when coverage starts). Used for enrollment audit trails and open enrollment completion tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ERISA Section 104

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the benefit enrollment event, generated by Workday HCM Benefits Administration. Used for cross-system reconciliation with payroll, carrier feeds, and ACA reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: The event or process that triggered the benefit enrollment or change. Drives eligibility validation rules, enrollment window enforcement, and ACA special enrollment period tracking in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ACA Section 1311; ERISA Section 701; IRS Notice 2014-55

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the benefit enrollment record. Active indicates coverage is in force; terminated indicates coverage has ended; pending indicates awaiting carrier confirmation; waived indicates the associate declined coverage; suspended indicates coverage is temporarily paused.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: fsa_annual_election_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Annual Election Amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount elected by the associate for a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) plan. Applicable only when plan_type is 'FSA'. Subject to IRS annual contribution limits. Used in payroll deduction scheduling and benefits cost analysis. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969; IRS Section 125; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: hsa_annual_election_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Savings Account (HSA) Annual Election Amount
attributes.description: Annual dollar amount elected by the associate for a Health Savings Account (HSA). Applicable only when plan_type is 'HSA'. Subject to IRS annual contribution limits (self-only vs. family). Used in payroll deduction scheduling and ACA HDHP compliance tracking. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 969; IRS Section 223; ACA; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this benefit enrollment record in Workday HCM. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail maintenance, and downstream data pipeline incremental load processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; SOX Section 302; ERISA Section 107

attributes.name: life_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Face value of the life insurance coverage elected by the associate. Applicable only when plan_type is 'life_insurance'. May be a flat amount or a multiple of annual salary. Used in benefits cost analysis and imputed income calculations for IRS Section 79 compliance. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Section 79; IRS Publication 15-B; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: payroll_deduction_code
attributes.description: Payroll system deduction code associated with this benefit enrollment, used to route the employee contribution to the correct benefit deduction bucket in SAP Payroll or Workday Payroll. Ensures accurate pre-tax and post-tax deduction classification.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP FI Payroll Integration; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the specific benefit plan as defined in Workday HCM (e.g., 'Grocery PPO Gold 2024', 'Grocery HSA Bronze 2024'). Used in associate-facing communications, open enrollment portals, and benefits cost analysis reporting.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan in which the associate is enrolled. Drives ACA reporting obligations, payroll deduction codes, and carrier EDI file routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|FSA|HSA|life_insurance|disability — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal plan year (e.g., 2024) to which this enrollment applies. Used to segment benefit enrollments by open enrollment cycle, support year-over-year benefits cost analysis, and align with ACA 1095-C reporting periods.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Form 1095-C; ACA Section 4980H

attributes.name: pre_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee contribution for this benefit plan is deducted on a pre-tax basis under IRS Section 125 (Cafeteria Plan). True for pre-tax deductions (medical, dental, vision, FSA, HSA); False for post-tax deductions (certain life insurance, disability). Drives payroll tax calculation.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125; IRS Publication 15-B; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_type
attributes.description: Specific type of qualifying life event (QLE) that triggered a mid-year enrollment change outside of open enrollment. Populated only when enrollment_source is 'qualifying_life_event'. Required for ERISA and ACA special enrollment period compliance documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death|loss_of_coverage|relocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA Section 701; ACA Section 1311; IRS Notice 2014-55; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of the associate's eligible compensation contributed to the 401(k) or retirement plan per pay period. Applicable only when plan_type is '401k'. Used in payroll deduction calculations, employer match determination, and ERISA compliance reporting. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 6.00 = 6%).
attributes.references: IRS Section 401(k); ERISA; IRS Publication 560; Workday HCM Benefits Administration

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage ends for the associate. Nullable for active enrollments. Populated upon voluntary termination, qualifying life event, employment separation, or plan year end. Used in ACA 1095-C line-level reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; IRS Form 1095-C; ACA Section 4980H; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161)

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the associate for declining (waiving) benefit coverage. Populated only when enrollment_status is 'waived'. Used for ACA reporting, benefits participation analysis, and workforce analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: covered_by_spouse|covered_by_parent|covered_by_other_employer|medicare|medicaid|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; ACA Section 4980H; IRS Form 1095-C

attributes.name: workday_enrollment_event_code
attributes.description: Source system event identifier from Workday HCM Benefits Administration corresponding to the enrollment business process event. Used for source system traceability, audit reconciliation, and support case resolution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; SOX Section 302

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Associate leave of absence and time-off requests managed in Workday HCM. Captures leave type (FMLA/ADA/personal/vacation/sick/bereavement/jury duty/military), request date, leave start date, leave end date, approved hours, leave status (pending/approved/denied/cancelled), FMLA eligibility flag, intermittent leave indicator, return-to-work date, and manager approval details. Supports FMLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each leave of absence or time-off request record in Workday HCM. Serves as the primary key for the leave_request data product.

attributes.name: leave_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company leave plan or policy under which this request is processed (e.g., FMLA plan, state-specific paid leave plan, company PTO plan). Determines eligibility rules, accrual rates, and pay continuation rules.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's position at the time of the leave request. Used for workforce planning, backfill scheduling, and labor compliance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_leave_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate (store, pharmacy, distribution center, or corporate) who submitted the leave request. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center, pharmacy, or corporate location where the employee is assigned. Supports store-level labor planning and absence reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_hr_business_partner_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR Business Partner assigned to review and process this leave request. Supports HR workload tracking, escalation routing, and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: ada_accommodation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request is associated with an ADA reasonable accommodation determination. Triggers separate ADA interactive process documentation requirements and legal review workflows.
attributes.references: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Title I; EEOC Enforcement Guidance; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manager or HR representative formally approved the leave request in Workday HCM. Used for SLA tracking of approval turnaround time and audit trail.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Absence Management; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - internal controls

attributes.name: approved_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours approved for the leave request. Used for intermittent FMLA tracking, partial-day absences, and payroll deduction calculations. Particularly important for part-time associates and intermittent leave scenarios.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) - 480-hour annual entitlement; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: benefits_continuation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's group health benefits are continued during the leave period. FMLA requires maintenance of group health coverage on the same terms as if the employee had continued working.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.209; Workday HCM - Benefits Administration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the Workday HCM system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver Layer lakehouse record.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - internal controls; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided when a leave request is denied. Required for legal defensibility, employee communication, and HR audit purposes. Populated only when request_status is 'denied'.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); EEOC; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: fmla_designation_notice_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Designation Notice Date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer provided the FMLA Designation Notice (WH-382) to the employee, confirming whether the leave is designated as FMLA-qualifying. Must be provided within 5 business days of receiving sufficient information. Critical for FMLA compliance.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.300; DOL Form WH-382

attributes.name: fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria at the time of the leave request: employed for at least 12 months, worked 1,250 hours in the past 12 months, and works at a location with 50+ employees within 75 miles. Critical for FMLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: fmla_hours_remaining
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Remaining
attributes.description: Remaining FMLA entitlement hours available to the employee in the current 12-month FMLA period after accounting for this request. Supports real-time FMLA balance visibility for HR and managers.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Used
attributes.description: Number of hours counted against the employee's annual FMLA entitlement (maximum 480 hours per 12-month period) for this specific leave request. Critical for FMLA compliance tracking and preventing entitlement overuse.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fmla_qualifying
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Qualifying Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specific leave reason qualifies under FMLA provisions (serious health condition, childbirth/adoption, military family leave, etc.). Distinct from fmla_eligible which tracks employee eligibility; this tracks whether the leave reason itself qualifies.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fmla_rights_notice_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Rights Notice Date
attributes.description: Date on which the employer provided the FMLA Notice of Eligibility and Rights (WH-381) to the employee. Must be provided within 5 business days of the leave request. Tracks compliance with DOL notice requirements.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.300; DOL Form WH-381

attributes.name: intermittent_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently (in separate blocks of time or by reducing the normal work schedule) rather than as a single continuous absence. Intermittent FMLA requires separate tracking of each absence episode against the annual entitlement.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.202; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: kronos_schedule_adjusted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's schedule in Kronos Workforce Central has been updated to reflect the approved leave period. Supports store operations and labor planning by confirming scheduling system synchronization.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the leave request record in Workday HCM. Tracks status changes, approval actions, date amendments, and certification updates for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - internal controls; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: leave_balance_hours_used
attributes.description: Number of hours deducted from the employee's applicable leave accrual balance (PTO, sick, vacation) for this request. Used for accrual balance reconciliation and FMLA entitlement tracking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Absence Management; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: leave_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the employee's leave of absence as requested or approved. Nullable for open-ended leaves pending medical certification. Used for return-to-work planning and FMLA entitlement balance calculations.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: leave_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason provided by the employee for the leave request (e.g., serious health condition, childbirth, military deployment, family care). Sensitive business data used for FMLA and ADA compliance determination. Stored as free text or coded reason from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); HIPAA; ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date on which the employee's approved leave of absence begins. Used for payroll processing, scheduling, and FMLA entitlement period tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave request indicating the legal or policy basis for the absence. Drives eligibility rules, pay treatment, and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|ADA|personal|vacation|sick|bereavement|jury_duty|military — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); USERRA (Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: medical_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the medical certification was received from the healthcare provider. Used to verify timely submission within the 15-calendar-day FMLA requirement and to track certification expiration.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.305

attributes.name: medical_certification_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certification from a healthcare provider has been received and accepted. Tracks compliance with the 15-calendar-day FMLA certification submission deadline.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.305; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a healthcare provider's medical certification is required to support this leave request. Required for FMLA serious health condition leaves and ADA accommodation requests.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) 29 CFR Part 825.305; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: military_leave_type
attributes.description: Specifies the category of military service for leaves classified as military type. Determines USERRA reinstatement rights, pay differential obligations, and benefits continuation requirements. Null or 'none' for non-military leaves.
attributes.references: USERRA (Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is associated with an OSHA-recordable workplace injury or illness. When true, triggers OSHA 300 log entry requirements and workers' compensation reporting workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) 29 CFR Part 1904; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: paid_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is fully or partially paid under company policy or applicable state law. Drives payroll processing rules in Workday HCM Payroll and determines whether accrued PTO/sick time is substituted for unpaid FMLA leave.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act); State Paid Family Leave laws; Workday HCM - Payroll

attributes.name: pay_continuation_type
attributes.description: Specifies the pay treatment applied during the leave period. Determines how payroll processes the absence and which accrual balances are drawn down. Aligns with company leave policy and applicable state paid leave mandates.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Payroll; State Paid Family Leave laws; FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act)

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the employee formally submitted the leave request in Workday HCM. Used to calculate notice period compliance and FMLA eligibility timelines.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) - 30-day advance notice requirement; Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request within the Workday HCM approval process. Drives downstream payroll processing, scheduling adjustments in Kronos, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: requested_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the employee originally requested for the leave. Compared against approved_hours to identify partial approvals or adjustments made during the review process.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The actual or anticipated date on which the employee is expected to or did return to active work status. May differ from leave_end_date if early return or extension occurs. Critical for workforce scheduling and FMLA reinstatement rights tracking.
attributes.references: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) - reinstatement rights; ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act); Workday HCM - Absence Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this leave request originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: workday_leave_request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by Workday HCM to uniquely identify the leave request across HR systems and employee-facing portals. Used for cross-system reconciliation and employee communications.

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: The Workday-assigned worker identifier for the employee, used as the cross-system reference key between Workday HCM and downstream analytics platforms. Confidential as it is a system-level personal identifier.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; OSHA recordkeeping requirements

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: The workers' compensation claim number associated with this leave request when the absence is due to a work-related injury or illness. Links leave management to the workers' compensation insurance claim for coordinated benefits administration.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration); State Workers Compensation laws; Workday HCM - Absence Management

products.name: safety_incident
products.description: OSHA recordable and non-recordable workplace safety incidents and associated workers compensation claim tracking for store, DC, pharmacy, and fuel center associates. Captures incident date/time, location (store/DC/department), incident type (slip-and-fall/equipment injury/chemical exposure/robbery/near-miss), body part affected, injury severity, OSHA recordability determination, days away from work, restricted duty days, workers comp claim number, claim status, claim type (medical only/lost time), insurance carrier, total incurred cost, root cause, corrective actions, and return-to-work date. Required for OSHA 300/301 log compliance and workers compensation management.

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each workplace safety incident record. Primary key for the safety_incident data product.

attributes.name: primary_safety_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate involved in the safety incident. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM. Used for OSHA 300/301 log reporting and workers compensation claim association.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store, distribution center, pharmacy, or fuel center location where the incident occurred. Used for location-based safety trend analysis and OSHA establishment-level reporting.

attributes.name: body_part_affected
attributes.description: The specific body part injured or affected by the workplace incident (e.g., lower back, right hand, left knee, eye, shoulder). Required field on OSHA Form 301 and used for ergonomic risk analysis and targeted safety training programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lower_back|hand|knee|eye|shoulder|foot|head|neck|wrist|ankle — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current status of the workers compensation claim associated with this incident. Drives financial reserve management, claim closure workflows, and insurance carrier reporting. Values: not_filed (no claim opened), open (active claim), closed (claim resolved), denied (carrier denied compensability), appealed (denial under appeal), settled (lump-sum settlement reached).
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Statutes; NCCI Workers Compensation Classification

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workers compensation claim by benefit type. Medical_only claims involve only medical treatment costs with no wage replacement. Lost_time claims include wage replacement benefits for days away from work. No_claim indicates no workers compensation claim was filed (e.g., first-aid-only incidents). Drives premium calculation and experience modification rate (EMR) impact.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification; State Workers Compensation Statutes

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date the corrective and preventive actions were fully implemented and verified. Used to close out incident investigations, measure corrective action cycle time, and confirm OSHA compliance program completion.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the corrective and preventive actions taken or planned to address the root cause and prevent recurrence of the incident. Required for OSHA 300/301 compliance documentation and safety management system audits.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; ANSI/ASSP Z10; OSHA VPP

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the corrective and preventive actions identified during the incident investigation. Used to track open action items, escalate overdue corrective actions, and demonstrate OSHA compliance program effectiveness.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety incident record was first created in the system of record (Workday HCM or Kronos Workforce Central). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the associate was away from work due to the injury or illness, excluding the day of injury. Required for OSHA 300 Log Column K and used to calculate Days Away, Restricted, or Transferred (DART) rate for safety benchmarking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; OSHA 300 Log Column K

attributes.name: days_restricted_duty
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the associate was on restricted work or job transfer due to the injury or illness, excluding the day of injury. Required for OSHA 300 Log Column L and used in DART rate calculation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; OSHA 300 Log Column L

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Name of the store or DC department where the incident occurred (e.g., Produce, Deli, Backroom, Receiving Dock, Pharmacy, Fuel Center Forecourt). Used for department-level safety trend analysis and targeted corrective action programs.

attributes.name: emergency_services_called
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency services (911, ambulance, fire department) were called in response to the incident. True = emergency services were dispatched. Used to identify high-severity incidents requiring OSHA severe injury reporting and for insurance carrier notification protocols.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.39; State Emergency Response Regulations

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the workplace safety incident occurred, including the sequence of events, environmental conditions, and equipment involved. Required for OSHA 301 Incident Report (Form 301) and workers compensation first notice of loss documentation.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the safety incident at the time of reporting. Used for cross-referencing with OSHA 300/301 logs, workers compensation carriers, and insurance documentation. Format: INC-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the safety incident record. Drives case management actions, OSHA log finalization, and workers compensation claim lifecycle. Values: open (newly reported), under_investigation (root cause analysis in progress), closed (fully resolved), pending_review (awaiting OSHA recordability determination), appealed (recordability determination under appeal).

attributes.name: incident_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the workplace safety incident occurred. This is the principal real-world event timestamp used for OSHA 300 log entry, workers compensation first notice of loss, and regulatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the workplace safety incident. Drives OSHA recordability rules, root cause analysis categories, and corrective action protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: slip_and_fall|equipment_injury|chemical_exposure|robbery|near_miss|struck_by_object|overexertion|repetitive_motion|vehicle_accident|fire_or_explosion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.5; OSHA 300 Log Column F-J

attributes.name: indemnity_cost
attributes.description: Total wage replacement (indemnity) payments made to the associate for days away from work under the workers compensation claim. Subset of total_incurred_cost. Used for lost-time cost analysis and return-to-work program financial justification.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; State Workers Compensation Statutes

attributes.name: injury_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the injury or illness outcome. Determines OSHA recordability, workers compensation claim type, and return-to-work program eligibility. Values align with OSHA 300 Log column classifications: first_aid_only (non-recordable), medical_treatment (recordable, no lost time), restricted_duty (recordable, restricted work), days_away (recordable, days away from work), hospitalization (OSHA severe injury — 24-hour reporting required), fatality (OSHA fatality — 8-hour reporting required).

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of injury or illness sustained (e.g., laceration, sprain/strain, fracture, burn, contusion, chemical burn, hearing loss, COVID-19). Populates OSHA 300 Log Column M and OSHA 301 Form field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: laceration|sprain_strain|fracture|burn|contusion|chemical_burn|hearing_loss|illness|puncture|amputation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; OSHA 300 Log Column M

attributes.name: insurance_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the workers compensation insurance carrier or third-party administrator (TPA) handling the claim. Used for carrier performance tracking, claim routing, and financial reconciliation of incurred costs.

attributes.name: is_near_miss
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident was a near-miss event (an unplanned event that did not result in injury, illness, or damage but had the potential to do so). Near-miss tracking is a leading safety indicator used in proactive hazard identification programs. Near-miss events are not OSHA recordable.
attributes.references: OSHA Voluntary Protection Programs (VPP); ANSI/ASSP Z10

attributes.name: is_osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR 1904.7 (i.e., results in days away from work, restricted duty, medical treatment beyond first aid, loss of consciousness, or diagnosis of a significant injury). True = must be entered on OSHA 300 Log. False = first-aid-only or non-recordable near-miss.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.business_glossary_term: Job Title at Time of Incident
attributes.description: Job title or position of the associate at the time the incident occurred. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot since the associate's role may change after the incident. Used for job-classification-based safety risk analysis and OSHA 300 Log documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA Form 301; OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; Workday HCM

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Type of Grocery facility where the incident occurred. Used to segment safety performance by operational environment (store floor, DC warehouse, pharmacy dispensing area, fuel center forecourt, or corporate office). Supports OSHA establishment-level reporting.

attributes.name: medical_cost
attributes.description: Total medical treatment costs incurred for the injury or illness, including emergency care, physician visits, physical therapy, and prescription medications. Subset of total_incurred_cost. Used for medical cost benchmarking and managed care program effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; State Workers Compensation Statutes

attributes.name: medical_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the physician, clinic, hospital, or medical facility that provided treatment for the injury or illness. Required for OSHA Form 301 completion and workers compensation managed care network compliance tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA Form 301; OSHA 29 CFR 1904.29; State Workers Compensation Statutes

attributes.name: osha_300_log_entry_date
attributes.description: Date the recordable incident was entered onto the OSHA 300 Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses. OSHA requires recordable incidents to be logged within 7 calendar days of receiving information that a recordable case occurred. Used for OSHA compliance audit tracking.

attributes.name: osha_301_form_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OSHA Form 301 (Injury and Illness Incident Report) has been completed for this recordable incident. OSHA requires Form 301 to be completed within 7 calendar days of receiving information that a recordable case occurred. True = Form 301 completed and on file.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the incident was formally reported by the associate or supervisor. Used to measure reporting lag compliance and supports OSHA 24-hour severe injury reporting requirements.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Date the associate returned to full or modified duty following the injury or illness. Used to calculate total lost-time duration, close workers compensation lost-time claims, and track return-to-work program effectiveness.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7; Workers Compensation State Regulations

attributes.name: return_to_work_type
attributes.description: Classification of the return-to-work status when the associate resumed employment. Distinguishes between full duty (no restrictions), modified duty (temporary accommodations), restricted duty (permanent or long-term limitations), or not returned (still on leave or separated). Supports return-to-work program management and workers compensation claim closure.
attributes.references: Workers Compensation State Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1904.7

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the safety incident based on investigation findings. Captures the underlying systemic or behavioral factor that allowed the incident to occur (e.g., inadequate training, equipment malfunction, wet floor not marked, improper lifting technique, inadequate PPE). Used to drive corrective action programs and prevent recurrence.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; ANSI/ASSP Z10; HACCP Principles

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category of the root cause to enable trend analysis across incidents. Supports safety program prioritization and corrective action resource allocation. Values align with ANSI/ASSP Z10 safety management system categories. Note: 7 values — borderline for enum; retained as inline enum given closed, stable set. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_error|equipment_failure|environmental_hazard|process_deficiency|inadequate_training|inadequate_ppe|management_system — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ANSI/ASSP Z10; OSHA Voluntary Protection Programs (VPP)

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The work shift during which the incident occurred. Used for shift-based safety trend analysis to identify higher-risk shift patterns (e.g., overnight stocking shifts with reduced supervision). Sourced from Kronos Workforce Central scheduling data.

attributes.name: tenure_days_at_incident
attributes.description: Number of days the associate had been employed at Grocery at the time of the incident. Used to analyze the relationship between associate tenure and injury risk, supporting new-hire safety orientation program effectiveness measurement.
attributes.references: OSHA VPP; ANSI/ASSP Z10; Workday HCM

attributes.name: total_incurred_cost
attributes.description: Total incurred cost of the workers compensation claim in USD, including medical payments, indemnity (wage replacement) payments, and reserves for future payments. Used for financial reporting, experience modification rate (EMR) calculation, and safety program ROI analysis. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NCCI Workers Compensation Classification; State Workers Compensation Statutes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety incident record was most recently modified. Tracks updates to OSHA recordability determination, claim status changes, corrective action completion, and return-to-work dates.

attributes.name: witness_names
attributes.description: Names of associates or individuals who witnessed the safety incident. Stored as a delimited string for OSHA 301 Form documentation and incident investigation purposes. Confidential as it identifies individuals involved in a workplace incident.

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned claim number issued by the workers compensation insurance carrier for this incident. Used to cross-reference claim records with the insurance carrier, track claim status, and reconcile incurred costs. Confidential business financial data.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Statutes; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

products.name: certification
products.description: Associate professional certifications, licenses, compliance training completions, and recurring training records required for specific roles. Tracks certification/training type (pharmacy license, food handler card, forklift operator, ServSafe, DEA handler, HACCP, alcohol sales, anti-harassment, PCI DSS, HIPAA), issuing authority or training provider, completion/issue date, expiration date, status (active/expired/suspended), score/pass-fail for training, delivery method (in-person/LMS/on-the-job), renewal reminder flag, and state jurisdiction. Critical for pharmacy DEA compliance, food safety HACCP requirements, and mandatory compliance training evidence.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each associate certification, license, or compliance training record. Primary key for the certification data product.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate (store, pharmacy, DC, or corporate) who holds this certification or completed this training. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the department (e.g., Pharmacy, Deli, Produce, DC Operations) associated with this certification requirement. Supports department-level compliance tracking and ensures certifications are mapped to the correct operational unit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Organization; Kronos Workforce Central - Department

attributes.name: job_profile_id
