attributes.description: Reference to the job profile or role for which this certification is required or associated (e.g., Pharmacist, Pharmacy Technician, Forklift Operator, Food Handler). Enables role-based certification compliance gap analysis across the workforce.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Job Profile; Kronos Workforce Central - Job Code

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store or facility location where this certification is applicable or where the associate was working when the certification was obtained. Supports location-based compliance reporting and store-level certification gap analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Location; Kronos Workforce Central - Location

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the certification or training type reference record (e.g., pharmacy license, food handler card, forklift operator, ServSafe, DEA handler, HACCP, alcohol sales, anti-harassment, PCI DSS, HIPAA). Links to the certification type reference product.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Certification Type; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Type

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this certification examination or training assessment (e.g., 1 = first attempt, 2 = retake). Tracks retake history for associates who did not pass on the first attempt. Supports training effectiveness and compliance risk analytics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Attempt; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Attempt

attributes.name: certification_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the certification or training record. 'license' = state/federal professional license; 'compliance_training' = mandatory regulatory training (HIPAA, PCI DSS, anti-harassment); 'food_safety' = HACCP, ServSafe, food handler; 'safety_operations' = forklift, OSHA, equipment; 'professional_certification' = industry credential. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: license|compliance_training|food_safety|safety_operations|professional_certification|pharmacy|alcohol_sales — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR; FDA HACCP; HIPAA; PCI DSS; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the certification, license, or training program (e.g., 'Pharmacist License - State of California', 'ServSafe Food Handler', 'HACCP Certification', 'Forklift Operator Safety', 'DEA Controlled Substance Handler').
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Certification Name; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Name

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued certificate or license number assigned by the issuing authority or training provider (e.g., state pharmacy board license number, ServSafe certificate number, DEA registration number). Used for regulatory verification and audit purposes.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; FDA; USDA

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification or license. 'active' = valid and in good standing; 'expired' = past expiration date; 'suspended' = temporarily invalidated by issuing authority; 'revoked' = permanently cancelled; 'pending' = submitted/in-progress awaiting issuance. Drives compliance dashboards and workforce eligibility checks.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; OSHA; Workday HCM - Certification Status

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date the associate completed the training course or examination. Applicable primarily to training-based certifications (e.g., ServSafe, HIPAA, PCI DSS, anti-harassment). May differ from issue_date if there is a processing delay before the credential is formally issued.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Training Completion; Workday HCM - Learning Completion

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion). Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance for workforce data.

attributes.name: credit_hours
attributes.description: Number of continuing education (CE) credit hours awarded upon completion of this certification or training. Relevant for pharmacists (state CE requirements), pharmacy technicians, and other licensed professionals who must accumulate CE hours for license renewal.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy - CE Requirements; ACPE (Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education)

attributes.name: dea_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: DEA (Drug Enforcement Administration) Controlled Substance Schedule
attributes.description: DEA controlled substance schedule authorization level associated with this certification (CI through CV). Applicable only to DEA handler certifications and pharmacy licenses that authorize handling of controlled substances. Null for non-pharmacy certifications. Critical for DEA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1308; Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training or certification was delivered or obtained. 'in_person' = classroom/instructor-led at store or DC; 'lms' = Learning Management System (e.g., Workday Learning); 'on_the_job' = supervised practical training; 'virtual_instructor_led' = live online session; 'external_provider' = third-party training organization. Supports training program analytics and compliance evidence.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Delivery Method; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Delivery

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL path to the scanned certificate, license document, or training completion record stored in the document management system. Enables retrieval of physical evidence for regulatory audits and inspections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Document Storage; OSHA Recordkeeping; DEA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification, license, or training record expires and must be renewed. Null for non-expiring credentials. Used to trigger renewal reminders and flag associates with lapsed compliance requirements. Critical for DEA, pharmacy license, and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; FDA HACCP; OSHA; Workday HCM - Certification Expiration

attributes.name: governing_regulation
attributes.description: Name or citation of the primary regulatory framework or law that mandates or governs this certification (e.g., 'DEA 21 CFR Part 1301', 'FDA 21 CFR Part 110', 'OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178', 'HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164', 'State Pharmacy Practice Act'). Supports regulatory audit evidence and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA; DEA; OSHA; HIPAA; State Boards of Pharmacy; USDA

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date the certification, license, or training completion was officially issued or awarded by the issuing authority or training provider. Represents the effective start of the credential's validity period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Certification Issue Date; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, government agency, or accredited training provider that issued or awarded the certification (e.g., 'California State Board of Pharmacy', 'National Restaurant Association - ServSafe', 'DEA', 'OSHA', 'NSF International'). Critical for regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; FDA; USDA; OSHA

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country under which the certification was issued. Defaults to 'USA' for domestic certifications. Relevant for associates with internationally-issued professional credentials.

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction under which the certification or license was issued. Critical for pharmacy licenses and alcohol sales permits which are state-specific. Null for federal or non-jurisdictional certifications.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; FTC; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, conditions, restrictions, or remarks associated with the certification record (e.g., 'License restricted to non-controlled substances', 'Renewal pending state board review', 'Completed as part of new hire onboarding'). Supports case-by-case compliance documentation.

attributes.name: passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate passed the certification examination or training assessment (True = passed, False = failed). For attendance-based certifications with no exam, this is set to True upon completion. Drives compliance eligibility and role assignment rules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Pass/Fail; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Pass/Fail

attributes.name: passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the certification examination or training assessment (e.g., 75.00). Used to determine pass/fail outcome and validate compliance with training standards. Null for attendance-based or non-scored certifications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Passing Score; FDA HACCP Training Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is mandated by a federal or state regulatory body (True = regulatory mandate, False = internal/voluntary). Distinguishes legally required credentials (DEA handler, pharmacy license, HACCP, food handler card) from internal training programs (customer service, product knowledge).
attributes.references: FDA; DEA; USDA; OSHA; State Boards of Pharmacy; HIPAA; PCI DSS

attributes.name: reminder_days_before_expiry
attributes.description: Number of days before the expiration_date that the renewal reminder notification should be triggered (e.g., 90, 60, 30 days). Configurable per certification type to allow adequate lead time for renewal processing, especially for state pharmacy licenses requiring advance application.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Certification Reminder Configuration; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the associate last renewed this certification or license. Tracks the renewal history cycle and supports compliance audit trails showing continuous credential maintenance.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; Workday HCM - Certification Renewal

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated renewal reminder notifications are enabled for this certification record (True = reminders active, False = reminders suppressed). Drives the renewal notification workflow in Workday HCM to alert associates and managers before expiration.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Certification Reminder; State Boards of Pharmacy

attributes.name: role_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is a mandatory requirement for the associate's current job role (True = required for role, False = voluntary or supplemental). Used in workforce compliance reporting to identify associates who are non-compliant with role-based certification requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR; State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; Workday HCM - Job Profile Requirements

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the associate on the certification examination or training assessment (e.g., 85.50 out of 100). Null for pass/fail-only or attendance-based certifications. Used for training effectiveness analytics and minimum score compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Assessment Score; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Score

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this certification record originated. 'workday' = Workday HCM; 'kronos' = Kronos Workforce Central; 'mckesson' = McKesson Pharmacy Systems; 'manual' = manually entered by HR/compliance team; 'external' = imported from external training provider. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Kronos Workforce Central; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the originating operational system (e.g., Workday Worker Certification ID, Kronos Training Record ID, McKesson License Record ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Kronos Workforce Central; McKesson Pharmacy Systems

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the external or internal organization that delivered the training program (e.g., 'National Restaurant Association', 'OSHA Training Institute', 'Grocery Internal L&D', 'McKesson Pharmacy Training'). Distinct from issuing_authority — the provider delivers the training while the authority issues the credential.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Learning Provider; Kronos Workforce Central - Training Provider

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was last modified in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks changes to certification status, expiration dates, and verification outcomes for compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; Workday HCM - Audit Trail; OSHA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification was last verified against the issuing authority's primary source records. Supports audit trails for regulatory compliance and demonstrates due diligence in credential verification for pharmacy and DEA-regulated roles.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy - Primary Source Verification; DEA; HIPAA

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: Name of the system, database, or method used to verify the certification (e.g., 'State Board of Pharmacy Online Lookup', 'DEA Diversion Control Division', 'NABP e-Profile', 'Manual Document Review'). Provides audit evidence for primary source verification processes.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy; DEA; NABP (National Association of Boards of Pharmacy)

attributes.name: verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification has been independently verified against the issuing authority's records (True = verified, False = self-reported or pending verification). Critical for pharmacy licenses and DEA registrations where primary source verification is required.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy - Primary Source Verification; DEA; HIPAA

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Formal associate performance evaluations conducted through Workday HCM Talent Management. Captures review period, review type (annual/mid-year/90-day/probationary), overall performance rating, individual goal ratings, competency ratings, manager comments, associate self-assessment, calibration status, merit increase recommendation, promotion recommendation, and review completion date. Drives compensation planning and talent development decisions.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each formal associate performance evaluation record in Workday HCM Talent Management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job position held by the associate at the time of the review, capturing role context for the evaluation period.

attributes.name: primary_performance_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associate (store, pharmacy, DC, or corporate) whose performance is being evaluated. Sourced from Workday HCM Core HR.

attributes.name: quaternary_performance_second_level_manager_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the skip-level manager who reviewed and approved the performance evaluation, providing an additional layer of oversight for rating consistency.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store, distribution center, pharmacy, or corporate location where the associate was assigned during the review period.

attributes.name: tertiary_performance_hr_business_partner_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HR Business Partner responsible for overseeing the calibration and approval of this performance review, ensuring process compliance and consistency.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the associate electronically acknowledged their performance review in Workday HCM. Null if associate_acknowledged is false.

attributes.name: associate_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate has electronically acknowledged receipt and review of their completed performance evaluation in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: calibrated_rating
attributes.description: The final overall rating assigned after the HR calibration session, which may differ from the manager's initial overall_rating. This is the authoritative rating used for compensation and talent decisions.

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of the HR calibration process for this review, ensuring rating consistency and fairness across the associate population. Overridden status indicates a post-calibration rating adjustment by HR leadership.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; EEOC Uniform Guidelines

attributes.name: competency_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate rating reflecting the associate's demonstration of required behavioral competencies (e.g., customer focus, teamwork, safety compliance) as defined in the Workday competency framework.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: competency_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for competency assessment on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00), used in weighted overall rating calculations.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the performance review was finalized, acknowledged by the associate, and marked as completed in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was first created in Workday HCM, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The organizational department code (from SAP CO or Workday HCM) to which the associate belonged during the review period, used for departmental performance analytics and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: development_plan_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing agreed-upon development actions, training recommendations, and career growth objectives for the associate following the review. Drives talent development decisions.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: The associate's employment classification at the time of the review, used to apply appropriate review templates and merit eligibility rules.

attributes.name: flight_risk
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associate has been identified as a retention risk during the calibration or review process, triggering targeted retention actions by HR and management.

attributes.name: goal_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate rating reflecting the associate's performance against individually assigned business goals and objectives for the review period, as evaluated in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: goal_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for goal achievement on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00), used in weighted overall rating calculations and compensation planning.

attributes.name: job_classification
attributes.description: The FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) job classification of the associate at the time of review: exempt (salaried) or non-exempt (hourly). Impacts merit increase calculation methodology and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); OSHA 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the performance review record was most recently updated in Workday HCM, in ISO 8601 format. Tracks the latest change for audit and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the manager summarizing the associate's performance, strengths, development areas, and behavioral observations during the review period. Classified confidential as it contains sensitive HR evaluation content.

attributes.name: merit_increase_pct
attributes.description: Recommended merit salary increase expressed as a percentage of the associate's current base pay, as proposed by the manager during the review. Subject to HR and finance approval in the compensation planning cycle.

attributes.name: merit_increase_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manager has recommended a merit-based salary increase for the associate based on the performance review outcome. Feeds into the annual compensation planning cycle.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: The final holistic performance rating assigned to the associate for the review period, reflecting the manager's assessment of overall contribution. Drives merit increase eligibility and talent calibration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exceptional|exceeds_expectations|meets_expectations|needs_improvement|unsatisfactory — promote to reference product if rating scale changes]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score corresponding to the overall performance rating on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00), enabling quantitative ranking and calibration analytics across the associate population.

attributes.name: pip_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) has been initiated or is required as a result of this performance review, typically for associates rated needs_improvement or unsatisfactory.

attributes.name: promotion_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manager has recommended the associate for a promotion to a higher job level or position as an outcome of the performance review.

attributes.name: promotion_target_position
attributes.description: The job title or position name being recommended for promotion, if promotion_recommended is true. Used in succession planning and talent pipeline management.

attributes.name: review_cycle_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year of the performance review cycle (e.g., 2024), used for year-over-year performance trending and compensation planning alignment.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: The target completion date by which the manager must finalize and submit the performance review, as set by HR policy or the Workday review cycle configuration.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the performance review record, used in HR correspondence, calibration sessions, and compensation planning workflows. Format: PR-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the performance evaluation period being assessed. Defines the boundary of performance data considered in the review.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date

attributes.name: review_status

attributes.name: review_template_name

attributes.name: review_type

attributes.name: self_assessment_comments

attributes.name: talent_segment

attributes.name: tenure_at_review_months

attributes.description: Date and time when the labor budget was formally approved by the authorized manager or finance controller. Critical for SOX audit trail and budget lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: average_wage_rate
attributes.description: Blended average hourly wage rate (USD) used to calculate budgeted labor dollars from budgeted hours. Reflects the expected mix of full-time, part-time, and department-specific pay grades for the period.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP Retail CO (Controlling)

attributes.name: benefits_load_percent
attributes.description: Percentage applied to base wage costs to account for employer-paid benefits (health insurance, retirement contributions, FICA, etc.) when calculating total budgeted labor dollars. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25%).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Administration; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: budget_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the labor budget period. For weekly budgets, this is typically the end of the work week as configured in Kronos Workforce Central.

attributes.name: budget_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or justification comments entered by the budget preparer or approver, documenting assumptions, special events (e.g., holiday week, store remodel), or reasons for revision. Supports audit trail and SOX documentation requirements.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the labor budget record, used for cross-system reference between Kronos Workforce Central and Workday HCM (e.g., LB-2024-STR001-WK01). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.

attributes.name: budget_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the labor budget period. Weekly budgets drive Kronos schedule generation guardrails; quarterly and annual budgets support financial planning and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; Workday HCM; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: budget_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the labor budget period. For weekly budgets, this is typically the start of the work week as configured in Kronos Workforce Central.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; OSHA (recordkeeping period alignment)

attributes.name: budget_version_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the original approved budget, a mid-period revision, a rolling forecast, or a reforecast. Enables budget vs. actual variance analysis across versions.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI (Financial Accounting); Workday HCM

attributes.name: budgeted_fte_count
attributes.description: Approved Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) count for the budget period, calculated as total budgeted hours divided by standard full-time hours. Distinct from headcount as it normalizes part-time associates into FTE units for financial planning.

attributes.name: budgeted_headcount
attributes.description: Approved number of full-time equivalent (FTE) and part-time associates budgeted for the store/department during the budget period. Drives hiring targets and workforce planning in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_friday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Friday within the budget period. Enables day-of-week labor distribution planning and daily schedule generation targets in Kronos.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_monday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Monday within the budget period. Enables day-of-week labor distribution planning and daily schedule generation targets in Kronos.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_saturday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Saturday within the budget period. Weekend days typically carry higher traffic and labor demand in retail-grocery operations.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_sunday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Sunday within the budget period. Weekend days typically carry higher traffic and labor demand in retail-grocery operations.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_thursday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Thursday within the budget period. Enables day-of-week labor distribution planning and daily schedule generation targets in Kronos.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_total
attributes.description: Total approved labor hours for the budget period across all days for the store/department combination. Used as the primary guardrail for Kronos schedule generation and labor cost control.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; OSHA (labor hour tracking)

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_tuesday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Tuesday within the budget period. Enables day-of-week labor distribution planning and daily schedule generation targets in Kronos.

attributes.name: budgeted_hours_wednesday
attributes.description: Approved labor hours allocated for Wednesday within the budget period. Enables day-of-week labor distribution planning and daily schedule generation targets in Kronos.

attributes.name: budgeted_labor_dollars
attributes.description: Total approved labor cost in USD for the budget period, inclusive of regular wages, overtime estimates, and applicable benefits load. Used for EBITDA and COGS labor cost reporting. Classified confidential as it reflects internal financial planning data.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI (Financial Accounting); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: budgeted_overtime_hours
attributes.description: Portion of total budgeted labor hours designated as overtime (hours exceeding 40 per week per FLSA). Enables overtime cost projection and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); OSHA

attributes.name: budgeted_regular_hours
attributes.description: Portion of total budgeted labor hours designated as straight-time (non-overtime) hours. Used to separate regular pay from overtime cost projections in labor analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: comp_sales_assumption
attributes.description: Projected comparable store sales (Comp Sales) in USD used as the demand driver assumption when building this labor budget. Comp Sales represent revenue comparison for existing store locations year-over-year, linking labor investment to expected sales volume.
attributes.references: SAP Retail SD (Sales and Distribution); Oracle Retail Merchandising System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this labor budget record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter number) within the fiscal year to which this labor budget belongs. Supports period-level budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI (Financial Accounting); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: The fiscal week number within the fiscal year (1–52 or 1–53 for 53-week years) to which this labor budget applies. Aligns with Kronos weekly scheduling cycles and retail fiscal calendar conventions.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this labor budget belongs, aligned with the company's retail fiscal calendar (typically a 52/53-week year). Used for annual budget rollup and Same-Store Sales (comp sales) year-over-year comparisons.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI (Financial Accounting); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: gmroi_labor_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Labor Target
attributes.description: Target Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) metric used to optimize labor allocation relative to gross margin contribution for the department/store. Drives GMROI-driven labor optimization analytics.
attributes.references: SAP Retail CO (Controlling); SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record is the active/current version of the labor budget for the store/department/period combination. Only one record per store/department/period should have this flag set to True at any time.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; SAP Retail FI

attributes.name: kronos_schedule_group_code
attributes.description: Kronos Workforce Central schedule group code that this labor budget is associated with, used to push approved budget guardrails directly into Kronos scheduling engine for automated schedule generation.

attributes.name: labor_cost_percent_target
attributes.description: Target labor cost as a percentage of net sales for the budget period (e.g., 0.1250 = 12.50%). A primary KPI for store operations and financial performance management. Classified confidential as it reflects internal margin strategy.
attributes.references: SAP Retail FI (Financial Accounting); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: sales_per_labor_hour_target
attributes.description: Target sales revenue generated per labor hour for the budget period, a key labor productivity metric in retail-grocery. Used for GMROI-driven labor optimization and schedule generation guardrails in Kronos.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central; SAP Retail CO (Controlling)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this labor budget record was last modified. Tracks revisions and reforecasts throughout the budget lifecycle.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this budget record within the same store/department/period combination. Version 1 is the original budget; subsequent versions represent revisions or reforecasts. Enables version history tracking.

attributes.name: workday_budget_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier from Workday HCM corresponding to this labor budget record, enabling cross-system reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and Workday HCM financial planning modules.
attributes.references: Workday HCM (Core HR; Payroll; Benefits Administration)

products.name: union_contract
products.description: Collective bargaining agreement (CBA) records governing union-represented associates across store, DC, and pharmacy bargaining units. Tracks union name, local number, contract effective date, contract expiration date, bargaining unit description, covered job classifications, wage scale provisions, seniority rules, grievance procedure reference, and ratification date. Drives union-specific scheduling rules, pay rates, and benefit eligibility in Kronos and Workday.

attributes.name: union_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the union collective bargaining agreement (CBA) record in the Grocery workforce data platform. Primary key for the union_contract entity.

attributes.name: primary_successor_contract_union_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the union_contract_id of the successor collective bargaining agreement that replaced this contract upon expiration or renegotiation. Enables contract lineage tracking and historical analysis of CBA evolution over time.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM - Labor Relations

attributes.name: arbitration_provider
attributes.description: Name of the arbitration organization or panel designated in the CBA to resolve unresolved grievances (e.g., 'American Arbitration Association (AAA)', 'Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (FMCS)'). Used by labor relations for dispute escalation.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Federal Arbitration Act

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the bargaining unit covered by the collective bargaining agreement, defining the scope of employees included (e.g., 'All full-time and part-time store associates employed at retail locations in the greater Washington DC metro area, excluding pharmacists, managers, and supervisors').
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); NLRB Certification

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational segment covered by the bargaining unit. Drives routing of labor rules to the appropriate workforce management system configuration in Kronos and Workday. 'store' covers retail store associates; 'distribution_center' covers DC workers; 'pharmacy' covers licensed pharmacy staff; 'corporate' covers office-based union employees; 'fuel_center' covers fuel center attendants.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Rules

attributes.name: base_wage_rate
attributes.description: The minimum or entry-level hourly wage rate established by the collective bargaining agreement for covered associates, expressed in USD per hour. Used as the floor for pay rate configuration in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cba_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number assigned to the collective bargaining agreement by the union or labor relations department. Used for cross-referencing with Workday HCM and Kronos Workforce Central labor rule configurations.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM - Labor Relations Module

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference path, URL, or document management system identifier pointing to the full executed collective bargaining agreement document (e.g., SharePoint path, Workday document ID). Enables direct access to the authoritative contract text.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Workday HCM - Document Management

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collective bargaining agreement. 'active' indicates the contract is in force; 'expired' indicates the term has lapsed; 'pending_ratification' indicates the agreement has been reached but not yet ratified by members; 'under_negotiation' indicates active bargaining is in progress; 'terminated' indicates the contract was ended prior to expiration.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM - Labor Relations Module

attributes.name: contract_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the collective bargaining agreement, typically including the union name, local number, and bargaining unit (e.g., 'UFCW Local 400 Store Associates CBA 2023-2026'). Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: covered_job_classifications
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or narrative description of the job titles and classifications explicitly covered under this collective bargaining agreement (e.g., 'Cashier, Grocery Clerk, Deli Associate, Bakery Associate, Night Crew'). Used to determine which Workday HCM positions are subject to CBA terms.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Workday HCM - Position Management

attributes.name: dues_checkoff_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collective bargaining agreement authorizes the employer to deduct union dues directly from covered associates' paychecks and remit to the union (dues checkoff). Drives payroll deduction configuration in Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) Section 302; Workday HCM - Payroll

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collective bargaining agreement becomes legally binding and operative. Drives activation of union-specific scheduling rules, pay rates, and benefit eligibility in Kronos Workforce Central and Workday HCM.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); OSHA 29 CFR

attributes.name: excluded_job_classifications
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or narrative description of job titles and classifications explicitly excluded from coverage under this collective bargaining agreement (e.g., 'Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager, Department Manager, Pharmacist-in-Charge'). Ensures correct application of union vs. non-union pay and scheduling rules.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); NLRB Certification

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collective bargaining agreement expires and is no longer in force unless extended or renegotiated. Used to trigger renegotiation workflows and alert labor relations teams in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic region or list of states/markets covered by this collective bargaining agreement (e.g., 'Virginia, Maryland, Washington DC'). Used to associate the contract with specific store locations and distribution centers in the workforce system.

attributes.name: grievance_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document citation for the grievance and arbitration procedure defined in the collective bargaining agreement (e.g., 'Article 12 - Grievance and Arbitration Procedure'). Used by labor relations teams to locate and apply the correct dispute resolution process.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Federal Arbitration Act

attributes.name: health_benefit_plan_description
attributes.description: Description of the health insurance and medical benefit provisions negotiated in the CBA, including plan type, employer contribution rates, eligibility waiting periods, and any union-administered trust fund arrangements. Drives benefit eligibility configuration in Workday HCM Benefits.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA); HIPAA; Workday HCM - Benefits

attributes.name: kronos_labor_rule_group
attributes.description: The labor rule group identifier in Kronos Workforce Central that corresponds to this collective bargaining agreement. Associates the CBA with the specific scheduling, overtime, and break rules configured in Kronos for covered associates.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Rules Configuration

attributes.name: management_rights_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collective bargaining agreement contains a management rights clause explicitly reserving certain operational decisions (e.g., scheduling, staffing levels, technology adoption) to management discretion. Relevant for store operations and DC management.

attributes.name: maximum_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours per week that covered associates may be scheduled under the CBA before overtime provisions are triggered, expressed as a decimal. Used to enforce scheduling caps in Kronos Workforce Central.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling

attributes.name: minimum_hours_guarantee
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours per week guaranteed to covered associates under the CBA, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 24.00 hours). Used to enforce scheduling minimums in Kronos Workforce Central and protect associate eligibility for benefits.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which formal collective bargaining negotiations commenced for this contract cycle. Used to track negotiation timelines and labor relations planning.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (FMCS)

attributes.name: no_strike_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collective bargaining agreement contains a no-strike/no-lockout clause prohibiting work stoppages during the contract term. Critical for labor relations risk assessment and business continuity planning.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service (FMCS)

attributes.name: overtime_rule_description
attributes.description: Description of overtime eligibility and calculation rules as defined in the CBA, including daily and weekly overtime thresholds, premium pay multipliers, and any union-specific overtime provisions that differ from FLSA minimums. Drives Kronos Workforce Central overtime rule configuration.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Kronos Workforce Central - Labor Rules

attributes.name: paid_time_off_provisions
attributes.description: Description of paid time off entitlements defined in the CBA, including vacation accrual schedules by seniority, sick leave provisions, personal days, and holiday pay eligibility. Drives PTO accrual rule configuration in Kronos Workforce Central and Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Kronos Workforce Central - Accruals

attributes.name: pension_plan_description
attributes.description: Description of the retirement and pension benefit provisions in the CBA, including defined benefit or defined contribution plan type, employer contribution rates, vesting schedules, and any multi-employer pension fund participation (e.g., UFCW Industry Pension Fund). Drives retirement benefit configuration in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA); Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC); SOX

attributes.name: ratification_date
attributes.description: The date on which union members voted to ratify and formally approve the collective bargaining agreement. Marks the transition from 'pending_ratification' to 'active' status.

attributes.name: reopener_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collective bargaining agreement contains a reopener clause allowing either party to renegotiate specific provisions (typically wages or benefits) during the contract term without full renegotiation. Used to flag contracts requiring mid-term attention.

attributes.name: reopener_trigger_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which a reopener clause becomes eligible to be invoked, if applicable. Null if no reopener clause exists. Used by labor relations teams to plan mid-term negotiation timelines.

attributes.name: rest_period_rule_description
attributes.description: Description of mandatory rest and break period requirements defined in the CBA, including minimum time between shifts, paid rest breaks, and meal period provisions. Drives break rule configuration in Kronos Workforce Central to ensure compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Kronos Workforce Central - Break Rules

attributes.name: seniority_rule_description
attributes.description: Description of seniority-based rules governing scheduling preference, shift bidding, layoff order, recall rights, and promotion eligibility as defined in the collective bargaining agreement. Drives seniority-based scheduling logic in Kronos Workforce Central.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Kronos Workforce Central - Scheduling

attributes.name: shift_differential_description
attributes.description: Description of shift differential pay provisions in the CBA, including premium pay rates for evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday shifts. Drives shift premium configuration in Kronos Workforce Central and Workday HCM Payroll.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Workday HCM - Payroll; Kronos Workforce Central

attributes.name: top_of_scale_wage_rate
attributes.description: The maximum hourly wage rate achievable under the CBA wage progression schedule for covered associates, expressed in USD per hour. Used for labor cost modeling and budget planning.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: The local chapter number of the union representing the bargaining unit (e.g., 'Local 400', 'Local 1776'). Identifies the specific regional or functional union local that negotiated and administers the contract.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Department of Labor (DOL) LMRDA

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the labor union that is party to the collective bargaining agreement (e.g., 'United Food and Commercial Workers International Union', 'International Brotherhood of Teamsters'). Used for labor relations reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Department of Labor (DOL) LMRDA

attributes.name: union_security_clause
attributes.description: Type of union security provision in the CBA governing membership requirements for covered associates. 'union_shop' requires all employees to join the union; 'agency_shop' requires payment of dues but not membership; 'open_shop' has no membership requirement; 'maintenance_of_membership' requires members to remain members; 'none' indicates no union security clause.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) Section 8(a)(3); State Right-to-Work Laws

attributes.name: wage_progression_steps
attributes.description: Total number of wage progression steps defined in the CBA wage scale from entry-level to top-of-scale pay rate. Used to configure step-based compensation progression in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Workday HCM - Compensation

attributes.name: wage_scale_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the wage scale provisions defined in the collective bargaining agreement, including step progression schedules, longevity increases, and classification-based pay differentials. Drives pay rate configuration in Workday HCM Payroll and Kronos Workforce Central.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Workday HCM - Compensation

attributes.name: workday_cba_code
attributes.description: The system-generated identifier for this collective bargaining agreement record in Workday HCM, used for integration and reconciliation between the Grocery data lakehouse and the Workday HCM source system.

products.name: talent_acquisition
products.description: Recruiting pipeline management from job requisition creation through candidate offer acceptance. Tracks requisitions (position requested, department, store/DC location, hiring manager, requisition status, approval date, target start date), candidate applications (source channel, application date, screening status, interview stage, assessment scores, background check status, offer details, offer acceptance/decline, start date). Supports time-to-fill metrics, requisition aging, source effectiveness analysis, and OFCCP/EEO compliance reporting for affirmative action plans. Sourced from Workday HCM Recruiting.

attributes.name: talent_acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each talent acquisition record.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager responsible for the requisition.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the candidate.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department requesting the hire.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the position being filled.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store or distribution center where the position is located.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate submitted the application.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Score from candidate assessment tests.

attributes.name: background_check_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check was completed.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the candidate's background check.

attributes.name: candidate_certifications
attributes.description: List of relevant certifications held by the candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_disability_status
attributes.description: Disability status of the candidate for EEO reporting.

attributes.name: candidate_education_level
attributes.description: Highest education level attained by the candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_ethnicity
attributes.description: Ethnicity of the candidate for EEO reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Hispanic|Non-Hispanic|Asian|Black|White|Other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: candidate_gender
attributes.description: Gender of the candidate for EEO reporting.

attributes.name: candidate_name
attributes.description: Legal full name of the candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the candidate.

attributes.name: candidate_source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the candidate applied.

attributes.name: candidate_veteran_status
attributes.description: Veteran status of the candidate for EEO reporting.

attributes.name: candidate_years_experience
attributes.description: Total years of relevant work experience reported by the candidate.

attributes.name: interview_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the interview process.

attributes.name: ofccp_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the requisition is subject to OFCCP reporting requirements.

attributes.name: offer_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the candidate accepted the offer.

attributes.name: offer_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the salary or compensation offer.

attributes.name: offer_currency
attributes.description: Currency code (ISO 4217) for the offer amount.

attributes.name: offer_decline_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the candidate for declining the offer.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current status of the job offer.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this talent acquisition record was first created in the data lake.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.

attributes.name: requisition_age_days
attributes.description: Number of days the requisition has been open.

attributes.name: requisition_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition was approved.

attributes.name: requisition_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the requisition was created in the system.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: External identifier for the job requisition.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the requisition.

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Result of the initial screening process.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Actual start date of the employee after acceptance.

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the hired employee.

attributes.name: time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: Number of days between requisition creation and candidate start date.

attributes.name: reposted_from_talent_acquisition_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on talent_acquisition (reposted_from_talent_acquisition_id)

products.name: associate_availability
products.description: Associate work availability windows, scheduling preferences, and constraint declarations used by Kronos Workforce Central for automated schedule generation. Tracks available days of week, available time windows (earliest start, latest end), maximum hours per week preference, unavailable dates, recurring unavailability patterns, preferred departments, cross-training availability flags, minor work-hour restrictions (for associates under 18), and effective date ranges. Critical input for Kronos auto-scheduler and union seniority-based shift bidding processes.

attributes.name: associate_availability_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for each associate availability record.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the associate to whom this availability applies.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the availability record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the availability record was initially created.

attributes.name: cross_training_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the associate is willing to work in cross‑trained roles.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week the availability window applies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Monday|Tuesday|Wednesday|Thursday|Friday|Saturday|Sunday — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Last date the availability record is valid; null indicates open-ended.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: First date the availability record becomes effective for scheduling.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Latest end time (HH:mm) the associate is willing to work on the specified day.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the availability record.

attributes.name: max_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Maximum total hours the associate prefers to work in a week.

attributes.name: minor_work_restriction_flag
attributes.description: True if the associate is under 18 and subject to minor work‑hour limits.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form comments or special instructions related to the associate's availability.

attributes.name: overtime_preference_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the associate is willing to accept overtime assignments.

attributes.name: preferred_department_code
attributes.description: Department code(s) where the associate prefers to be scheduled.

attributes.name: recurring_unavailability_pattern
attributes.description: Textual pattern describing recurring unavailability (e.g., every first Monday of month).

attributes.name: shift_preference
attributes.description: Preferred shift timing category for the associate.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that supplied the availability data (e.g., Kronos, Workday).

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Earliest start time (HH:mm) the associate is willing to work on the specified day.

attributes.name: unavailable_date
attributes.description: A calendar date on which the associate is unavailable (e.g., vacation, personal day).

attributes.name: union_seniority_preference_flag
attributes.description: True if the associate prefers shifts based on union seniority rules.

attributes.name: superseded_associate_availability_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on associate_availability (superseded_associate_availability_id)

products.name: certification_type
products.description: Master reference table for certification_type. Referenced by type_id.

attributes.name: certification_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for certification_type

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the certification type.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to reference the certification in systems.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the certification type within the organization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the certification type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the certification purpose, scope, and requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification type becomes effective for new hires.

attributes.name: expiration_date
