attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the invoice record. Tracks changes to status, amounts, or payment application.

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the bank lockbox service used for automated payment processing. Relevant for high-volume check and remittance processing.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice amount due after applying all discounts, taxes, and freight charges. This is the amount the customer is expected to pay (gross + tax + freight - discount).

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice after applying all cash receipts, credit memos, and adjustments. Zero when invoice is fully paid.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount received and applied against this invoice across all payment transactions. Sum of all cash receipts allocated to this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was received and applied to this invoice. Null if invoice is unpaid. Used for cash flow analysis and DSO calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument or mechanism used (or expected) for this invoice: ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, check, credit card, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer), lockbox processing, or cash. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ach|wire_transfer|check|credit_card|eft|lockbox|cash — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment reference provided by the customer (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number, or remittance advice reference). Used for cash application matching.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the negotiated payment terms (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Determines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer purchase order number provided for this invoice. Used for customer reconciliation and three-way matching in customer accounts payable systems.

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or delivery document that generated this invoice. Links AR invoice back to the order fulfillment transaction.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes charged on the invoice. Calculated based on customer tax jurisdiction and product taxability.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the invoice written off as uncollectible bad debt. Recorded when collection efforts are exhausted and the receivable is deemed unrecoverable.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice (or portion thereof) was written off as bad debt. Triggers bad debt expense recognition in the general ledger.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code for the write-off: customer bankruptcy, deemed uncollectible after collection efforts, small balance not worth pursuing, dispute settlement, goodwill adjustment, or other.

products.name: budget
products.description: Financial budget master and period-level allocation detail for Grocery, managed in SAP CO. Captures budget header (version — original/revised/forecast, budget type — operating/capital/labor, responsible cost center or profit center, GL account scope, fiscal year, approval status) and period-level line detail (fiscal period, planned amount, revised amount, committed amount, actuals-to-date, available balance). Supports variance analysis (plan vs actual vs forecast), EBITDA target tracking, store-level operating expense budgeting, category-level COGS planning, capital expenditure governance, and real-time budget consumption monitoring with threshold alerts.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Primary key for budget

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for this budget. Cost centers represent organizational units that incur costs (e.g., store, department, distribution center).

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: budget should reference the GL account master; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code.

attributes.name: owner_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Budget ownership is assigned to a specific associate for financial planning responsibility and audit traceability.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center responsible for this budget. Profit centers represent organizational units that generate revenue and incur costs (e.g., store, region, business unit).

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Compliance Program budgeting requires linking each program to its financial budget for cost planning and reporting.

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount spent or incurred to date for this budget line, as recorded in the general ledger. Used for variance analysis (actual vs plan).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget was formally approved by the authorized approver or budget committee.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved this budget (e.g., CFO, Budget Committee Chair, Regional Director).

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this budget record to the audit trail or change log for compliance and SOX reporting. Tracks all modifications to budget amounts and approvals.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The remaining budget balance available for spending, calculated as revised_amount minus (committed_amount plus actual_amount). Used for budget consumption monitoring.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Hierarchical category or grouping for the budget line (e.g., Store Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, IT Infrastructure). Used for rollup reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget, typically formatted as BUD-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is fiscal year and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget: draft (in preparation), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (authorized), active (in use), frozen (locked for changes), closed (period ended), or rejected (not approved). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|active|frozen|closed|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by functional category: operating expenses, capital expenditures (CapEx), labor costs, marketing spend, administrative overhead, or Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount of budget that has been committed through purchase orders, contracts, or other obligations but not yet expensed. Used for encumbrance accounting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget expires or is no longer active. Typically the last day of the fiscal period or fiscal year.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget becomes effective and active for spending authorization and monitoring.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year, typically 1-12 for monthly budgets or 1-52 for weekly budgets.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget applies, represented as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this budget, including justification for revisions, special instructions, or context for variance explanations.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role responsible for managing and monitoring this budget (e.g., Store Manager, Regional VP, CFO).

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The original planned budget amount for the fiscal period, as approved during the annual budgeting process. Represents the baseline target.

attributes.name: revised_amount
attributes.description: The revised budget amount after adjustments, reforecasts, or supplemental allocations. Reflects the current authorized budget target.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit trails (True = SOX-controlled, False = not SOX-controlled).

attributes.name: threshold_critical_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of budget consumption at which a critical alert is triggered and spending may be blocked (e.g., 95.00 means critical alert when 95% of budget is consumed).

attributes.name: threshold_warning_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of budget consumption at which a warning alert is triggered (e.g., 80.00 means alert when 80% of budget is consumed). Used for proactive budget monitoring.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between planned and actual amounts (actual_amount minus planned_amount). Positive values indicate overspend; negative values indicate underspend.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the planned amount ((actual_amount - planned_amount) / planned_amount * 100). Used for threshold alerts and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version type of the budget indicating whether it is the original plan, a revised plan, a forecast, reforecast, supplemental allocation, or final approved version.

products.name: internal_order
products.description: SAP CO internal order master used to track costs for specific projects, capital investments, store remodels, marketing campaigns, and temporary cost collection objects. Captures order type, responsible cost center, settlement rule, budget, actual costs, and order status (created, released, technically complete, settled). Supports CAPEX tracking and project-level profitability.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SAP CO internal order. Primary key for the internal order master data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for managing and approving costs on this internal order. The cost center owner is accountable for budget adherence and project completion.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center to which costs and revenues from this internal order are allocated. Used for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: requestor_associate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.associate. Business justification: Internal orders are initiated by an associate; linking enables approval workflow and cost accountability.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail store location if this internal order is store-specific (e.g., store remodel, store opening, store equipment upgrade). Used for store-level CAPEX tracking and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to this internal order to date, in the company code currency. Includes direct costs, allocations, and internal activity charges. Updated in real-time as costs are posted.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the project or activity was completed and the order was set to technically complete status. Triggers settlement eligibility.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work began on this internal order, typically when the first cost was posted or the order status changed to released.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the internal order budget was approved by the authorized approver. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the internal order budget request. Orders must be approved before they can be released for cost posting. Workflow-driven based on budget thresholds and organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved the internal order budget. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: SAP FI asset class code if this internal order will be settled to a fixed asset. Determines depreciation rules, useful life, and GL account assignments for the resulting asset.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP FI fixed asset master number to which this internal order will be settled upon completion. Populated for CAPEX orders that create or enhance fixed assets.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget for this internal order in the company code currency. Used for budget control and variance reporting. Budget may be original, supplemental, or revised.

attributes.name: budget_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount. Typically matches the company code currency but may differ for multi-currency projects.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether costs on this internal order are capitalized (True) or expensed (False). True for capital investments that will be settled to fixed assets; False for operating expenses settled to cost centers or GL accounts.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total committed costs (purchase requisitions and purchase orders) against this internal order. Used for funds availability checking and budget consumption reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP FI company code representing the legal entity to which this internal order belongs. Used for financial consolidation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Four-character SAP CO controlling area code. Represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal management reporting. Multiple company codes may share a controlling area.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order master record was first created in SAP CO. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this internal order has been marked for deletion. True indicates the order is logically deleted but retained for audit purposes; False indicates an active or closed order.
attributes.references: SAP CO Master Data Deletion Policy

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this internal order was created or is active. Used for multi-year project tracking and budget period assignment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who last modified this internal order master record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order master record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the internal order purpose, scope, and business justification. Provides context for financial analysts and auditors reviewing project costs.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the internal order, externally visible and used in financial reporting and project tracking. Typically a 10-12 character alphanumeric code assigned by SAP CO.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the internal order. Controls whether costs can be posted, whether the order can be settled, and whether it appears in active project reports. Status progression: created → released → technically_complete → settled → closed.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the internal order by business purpose. Determines cost collection rules, settlement targets, and reporting hierarchy. Common types include capital investments, store remodels, marketing campaigns, maintenance projects, and IT initiatives.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the project or activity. Used to determine when the order should be technically complete and ready for settlement.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the project or activity tracked by this internal order. Used for project scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: project_manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the project manager for communication and escalation purposes. Used for automated budget alerts and approval workflows.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual responsible for managing this internal order project. Accountable for budget adherence, timeline, and deliverables.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the business department that requested this internal order. Used for chargeback and accountability reporting.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when costs accumulated on this internal order were settled to the final receiver cost object. Marks the financial close of the order.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific cost object (asset number, cost center code, GL account number) to which costs will be settled. Format varies by receiver type.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object to which this internal order will be settled upon completion. Common receivers include fixed assets (for CAPEX), cost centers (for OPEX), or GL accounts (for period costs).

attributes.name: settlement_rule_profile
attributes.description: Configuration key defining how costs accumulated on this internal order are settled to final cost objects (e.g., asset under construction, cost center, GL account). Determines settlement percentage, receiver type, and settlement period rules.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Calculated variance between budget and actual plus committed costs. Positive values indicate under-budget, negative values indicate over-budget. Used for exception reporting and project controls.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the WBS element if this internal order is part of a larger project structure. Links the order to a project hierarchy for integrated project and cost management.
attributes.references: SAP PS Project System - WBS Master

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who created this internal order master record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master and full depreciation lifecycle record from SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) covering store equipment, refrigeration units, fuel pumps, POS terminals, MFC automation systems, delivery vehicles, and leasehold improvements. Captures asset master data (asset class, sub-number, serial number, acquisition date/cost, vendor, PO reference, useful life, location/cost center assignment) and periodic depreciation detail (depreciation method/key, depreciation area — book/tax/group, fiscal period amounts, accumulated depreciation, net book value, impairment, disposal proceeds and gain/loss). Supports EBITDA reconciliation (depreciation add-back), CAPEX reporting, tax depreciation vs book variance tracking, asset physical inventory, and SOX fixed asset audit.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Record

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: fixed_asset needs a foreign key to GL account for asset accounting; gl_account_id replaces gl_account_code.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Vendor Master

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since acquisition. This is the cumulative contra-asset amount reducing the net book value.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or capitalized cost of the asset in USD. This is the gross base amount for depreciation calculations.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Valuation

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was acquired or placed in service. This is the principal business event timestamp for the asset lifecycle and determines when depreciation begins.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Acquisition

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the asset type (e.g., store equipment, refrigeration units, fuel pumps, POS terminals, MFC automation systems, delivery vehicles, leasehold improvements). Determines depreciation rules and account assignments.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Class Configuration

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset, including make, model, and specific characteristics.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The main asset number assigned in SAP FI Asset Accounting. This is the externally-known unique identifier for the asset across the enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Active assets are in service and depreciating; under construction assets are capitalized but not yet depreciating; retired/disposed assets are no longer in use.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Status Management

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-number for assets that are part of a larger asset group or complex asset. Used when a main asset has multiple components tracked separately for depreciation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical tag or barcode identifier affixed to the asset for inventory tracking and physical verification during SOX audits.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was capitalized in the general ledger. For assets under construction, this may differ from the acquisition date.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Capitalization

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the asset is assigned for expense allocation and budgeting. Typically represents a store, distribution center, or corporate department.
attributes.references: SAP CO - Controlling Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost and all monetary amounts (typically USD for US operations).

attributes.name: current_period_depreciation
attributes.description: Depreciation expense recognized in the current fiscal period (month or quarter). Used for EBITDA reconciliation and P&L reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: The valuation view for depreciation calculation: book (GAAP financial reporting), tax (IRS tax depreciation), group (consolidated reporting), or IFRS (international standards).
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Depreciation Areas; GAAP ASC 360; IRS Publication 946; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: SAP-specific depreciation key that defines the calculation rules, useful life, and period control for depreciation posting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Depreciation Key Configuration

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense (e.g., straight-line, declining balance). Aligns with GAAP and tax regulations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was retired, sold, or otherwise disposed of, marking the end of its service life.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Retirement

attributes.name: disposal_gain_loss
attributes.description: Gain or loss recognized on disposal, calculated as disposal proceeds minus net book value at disposal date. Positive values indicate gain; negative values indicate loss.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair value received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for the current depreciation posting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the current period depreciation and accumulated depreciation are reported.

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Total impairment loss recognized when the asset's recoverable amount falls below its net book value, per GAAP impairment testing requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10 - Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets

attributes.name: impairment_date
attributes.description: The date on which an impairment loss was recognized for the asset.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360-10 - Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets

attributes.name: is_leased_asset
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset is leased rather than owned. Leased assets follow ASC 842 lease accounting rules.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the asset record. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fixed asset record was last updated. Critical for change tracking and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent physical inventory verification of the asset, required for SOX compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: lease_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement contract number if the asset is leased. Links to lease liability and right-of-use asset records.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location code where the asset is deployed (store number, DC identifier, or facility code).
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Location

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining capitalized value on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 - Property, Plant, and Equipment

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order used to acquire the asset, linking to procurement records.
attributes.references: SAP MM - Materials Management Purchase Order

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique equipment identifier for physical tracking and warranty management.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

attributes.name: tax_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation recognized for tax purposes to date. Used to track book-tax differences for deferred tax calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property; GAAP ASC 740 - Income Taxes

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: The IRS-approved depreciation method used for tax reporting, which may differ from book depreciation (e.g., MACRS, Section 179 expensing, bonus depreciation).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property; IRC Section 168 (MACRS); IRC Section 179

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years, used to calculate depreciation rates. Determined by asset class and IRS guidelines.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 - How to Depreciate Property

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manufacturer or vendor warranty expires, used for maintenance planning and cost forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Asset Accounting (AA) - Asset Master Data

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record capturing cross-entity postings between Grocery legal entities — store-to-DC cost allocations, shared service charges, intercompany loans, and management fee billings. Records sending and receiving company codes, transaction type, elimination flag, netting amount, and reconciliation status. Critical for financial consolidation and intercompany elimination under GAAP.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction should reference the cost center master; cost_center_id replaces the free‑text cost_center field.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: intercompany_transaction must reference GL account, cost center, and profit center masters for proper posting and allocation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: intercompany_transaction should reference the profit center master; profit_center_id replaces the free‑text profit_center field.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for the intercompany transaction: pending (awaiting finance approval), approved (authorized for posting), rejected (not authorized, requires correction). Critical for SOX segregation of duties controls.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the finance manager or controller who approved the intercompany transaction for posting. Null if approval is pending or not required. Part of SOX approval control audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction was approved. Null if approval is pending or not required. Supports SOX audit trail for authorization controls.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The SAP business area classification for segment reporting, such as Retail, Pharmacy, Fuel, or eCommerce. Enables intercompany analysis by line of business.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance and financial controls.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The business date of the underlying transaction or invoice that triggered the intercompany posting. May differ from posting_date due to processing lag.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for settlement between entities. Calculated based on posting_date and payment_terms.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this intercompany transaction requires elimination during financial consolidation to prevent double-counting of revenue, expenses, or assets across legal entities.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: Current status of the elimination process for this intercompany transaction: pending (awaiting consolidation run), eliminated (successfully removed in consolidated financials), not_required (no elimination needed), manual_review (requires finance team intervention).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction_amount to functional or group currency. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate table at posting_date.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the transaction was posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, used for period-end close and consolidation.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction was posted, following Grocery's fiscal calendar. Used for year-end consolidation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the functional currency of the sending company code for local statutory reporting. Conversion uses the exchange rate at posting_date.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the group reporting currency (typically USD) for consolidated financial statements. Critical for intercompany elimination at the corporate level.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the intercompany transaction providing business context, such as 'DC to Store 1234 inventory allocation for Q1' or 'Corporate IT shared service charge for January'. Supports audit trail and user understanding.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or system process that last modified the intercompany transaction record. Tracks changes for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under SOX.

attributes.name: netting_amount
attributes.description: The net amount after offsetting reciprocal intercompany balances between sending and receiving entities. Used for intercompany settlement and cash pooling arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for settlement of the intercompany transaction, such as Net 30, Net 60, or Due on Receipt. Governs intercompany cash flow and working capital management.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in both sending and receiving entities. Critical for period-end close and financial consolidation timing.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction (e.g., distribution center, shared service center, subsidiary). Four-character alphanumeric identifier per SAP FI configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was successfully reconciled and matched between sending and receiving entities. Null if reconciliation is pending or unmatched.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the intercompany reconciliation process indicating whether the transaction has been confirmed and matched between sending and receiving entities: matched (both sides agree), unmatched (discrepancy exists), partially_matched (amount variance), disputed (under investigation), resolved (discrepancy corrected).

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: The source document number that triggered the intercompany transaction, such as an invoice number, purchase order, transfer order, or allocation run ID. Provides audit trail back to originating transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this intercompany transaction is a reversal of a previously posted transaction. Used for error correction and period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The transaction_number of the original intercompany transaction that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is True, providing audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code of the legal entity originating the intercompany transaction (e.g., store, distribution center, corporate entity). Four-character alphanumeric identifier per SAP FI configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the intercompany transaction was settled through cash transfer, netting, or other payment mechanism. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method used to settle the intercompany transaction: cash_transfer (actual funds moved), netting (offset against reciprocal balances), offset (applied against other intercompany transactions), accrual_only (no cash settlement, accounting entry only).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount calculated on the intercompany transaction based on applicable tax_code and jurisdiction rules. May be zero for tax-exempt intercompany transfers.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to the intercompany transaction for VAT, GST, or sales tax purposes. Some intercompany transactions may be tax-exempt depending on jurisdiction and transaction type.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency, before any adjustments or eliminations. Represents the amount posted to both sending and receiving entities.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN for North American operations).

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number for intercompany postings, typically following format IC-XXXXXXXXXX for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the cross-entity posting: cost_allocation (store-to-DC allocations), shared_service_charge (corporate overhead), intercompany_loan (financing arrangements), management_fee (corporate services), inventory_transfer (goods movement), royalty (brand/IP licensing).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or system process that created the intercompany transaction record. Critical for SOX audit trail and accountability.

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: SAP CO periodic cost allocation and assessment cycle record distributing shared costs (utilities, corporate overhead, DC operating costs) from sender cost centers to receiver cost centers or profit centers. Captures allocation cycle name, fiscal period, sender/receiver objects, allocation method (percentage, quantity, fixed), allocated amount, and cycle run date. Enables accurate store-level and department-level P&L.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original cost_allocation_id that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables tracing of reversal chains for audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP CO Reversal Traceability Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: space_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation record. Primary key for the cost allocation transaction.

attributes.name: cost_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost element (expense category) being allocated. Cost elements represent the nature of the expense (utilities, rent, depreciation, IT services, HR services) and map to general ledger accounts.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Element Master Data; Chart of Accounts Standards

attributes.name: primary_sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center from which costs are being allocated. Sender cost centers typically represent shared service functions (IT, HR, facilities, corporate overhead, distribution center operations) whose costs are distributed to benefiting units.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Master Data; Management Accounting Cost Center Standards

attributes.name: receiver_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center receiving the allocated costs. Used when costs are allocated directly to profit centers for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Nullable if allocation targets cost centers only.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Master Data; Segment Reporting Standards

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount allocated from the sender cost center to the receiver cost center or profit center. Represents the share of shared costs assigned to the receiver based on the allocation method and driver quantities. Positive values indicate cost transfers; negative values may represent reversals or corrections.
attributes.references: GAAP Cost Allocation Standards; SAP CO Allocation Posting Rules

attributes.name: allocation_cycle_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the periodic cost allocation cycle run in SAP CO (Controlling). Examples include monthly overhead allocation, quarterly shared services distribution, or annual corporate cost assessment cycles.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate costs from sender to receiver objects. Percentage allocates based on proportional shares, quantity uses driver volumes (e.g., square footage, headcount), fixed uses predetermined amounts, assessment distributes full sender balance, distribution splits based on statistical key figures, direct assigns costs one-to-one, step_down cascades costs sequentially, reciprocal handles mutual service relationships. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percentage|quantity|fixed|assessment|distribution|direct|step_down|reciprocal — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP CO Allocation Method Standards; Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the allocation. May include explanations for manual adjustments, special allocation rules, or business justifications for allocation method changes.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sender cost center total costs allocated to this receiver. Used when allocation_method is percentage. Sum of all allocation_percentage values for a given sender and cycle should equal 100.00. Nullable if allocation method is not percentage-based.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Allocation Standards; SAP CO Percentage Allocation Rules

attributes.name: allocation_rate
attributes.description: Rate per unit of driver quantity used to calculate the allocated amount. Calculated as total sender costs divided by total driver quantity across all receivers. allocated_amount = driver_quantity × allocation_rate. Nullable if allocation method is fixed or percentage.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Rate Calculation Standards; SAP CO Allocation Rate Logic

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cost allocation record. Posted indicates the allocation has been successfully posted to CO and FI documents. Reversed indicates the allocation was reversed due to error or period-end adjustment. Pending indicates the cycle has run but posting is not yet complete. Error indicates a posting failure. Cancelled indicates the allocation was voided before posting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Document Status Standards; Financial Posting Workflow Standards

attributes.name: co_document_number
attributes.description: SAP CO document number generated when the allocation was posted. Links this allocation record to the controlling document for audit trail and drill-down analysis.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity for which the allocation was posted. Used for multi-entity consolidation and legal entity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Standards; GAAP Legal Entity Reporting

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP controlling area representing the organizational unit for cost accounting. Controlling areas may span multiple company codes for consolidated management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling Area Configuration Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the allocation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Standards; GAAP Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Typically USD for US-based grocery operations, but may vary for international subsidiaries.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP Multi-Currency Standards

attributes.name: cycle_run_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation cycle was executed in SAP CO. May differ from posting_date if the cycle was run in advance and posted later.
attributes.references: SAP CO Allocation Cycle Execution Standards

attributes.name: driver_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the allocation driver (statistical key figure) used to calculate the allocated amount. Examples: square footage, headcount, transaction volume, sales revenue, labor hours. Used when allocation_method is quantity-based. Nullable if allocation method is fixed or percentage.
attributes.references: SAP CO Statistical Key Figure Standards; Management Accounting Driver Standards

attributes.name: driver_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the driver quantity. Examples: square_feet, headcount, transactions, dollars, hours. Provides context for interpreting driver_quantity values.
attributes.references: SAP CO Unit of Measure Standards; ISO Unit Standards

attributes.name: fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI document number generated when the allocation was posted to the general ledger. Links this allocation record to the financial accounting document for SOX compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Numbering Standards; SOX Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the allocation was posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, may include special periods 13-16 for year-end adjustments.
attributes.references: GAAP Fiscal Period Standards; SAP FI Period Variant

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the cost allocation was executed. Aligns with the company's financial reporting calendar.
attributes.references: GAAP Fiscal Period Standards; SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person or system process that last modified the allocation record. Supports SOX compliance and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX User Accountability Standards; SAP Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the allocation record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for SOX compliance and financial reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Standards; GAAP Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the cost allocation transaction was posted to the general ledger and controlling documents. Determines the fiscal period assignment and financial statement impact.
attributes.references: GAAP Posting Date Standards; SAP FI/CO Document Date Rules

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this allocation record is a reversal of a previous allocation. True if this is a reversal transaction, False if this is an original allocation posting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person or system process that created the allocation record. Supports SOX compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX User Accountability Standards; SAP Audit Trail Standards

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Bank account master and electronic bank statement record for all Grocery operating, payroll, concentration, and zero-balance accounts across legal entities. Captures account master data (bank name, masked account number, routing number, account type, currency, SAP house bank ID, signatory authorities) and full statement lifecycle (MT940/BAI2 imports, statement date/sequence, opening/closing balances, individual transaction lines — deposits/withdrawals/fees/lockbox items, bank transaction codes, value date, clearing status against open AR/AP items). Supports cash management, AP payment run bank selection, AR lockbox processing, daily cash position reporting, bank reconciliation, and SOX treasury controls.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: concentration_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the master concentration account if this is a zero-balance account. Null for non-ZBA accounts.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Grocery legal entity that owns this bank account. Links to legal entity master for consolidation and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Must match legal entity name for corporate accounts.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Full bank account number. Stored in encrypted form for PCI compliance.

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose of the account: operating (AP/AR), payroll (employee payments), tax (remittances), investment (short-term cash), debt_service (loan payments), escrow (restricted funds).

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account. Active: normal operations. Inactive: temporarily not in use. Closed: permanently closed. Frozen: blocked by bank or legal order. Restricted: limited transaction types allowed.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account by operational purpose: checking (operating accounts), savings (reserve accounts), money_market (short-term investment), zero_balance (subsidiary accounts swept daily), concentration (master cash pooling), payroll (dedicated payroll disbursement), lockbox (AR collection). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: checking|savings|money_market|zero_balance|concentration|payroll|lockbox — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: Current balance minus outstanding checks and holds. Represents funds available for immediate disbursement.

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: Country-specific bank identifier. In US: ABA routing number (9 digits). In EU: Bank Identifier Code (BIC/SWIFT). Maps to SAP bank key (BNKA-BANKL).

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the financial institution holding the account.

attributes.name: branch_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the bank branch.

attributes.name: branch_city
attributes.description: City where the bank branch is located.

attributes.name: branch_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the bank branch location.

attributes.name: branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the bank branch where the account is domiciled.

attributes.name: branch_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the bank branch.

attributes.name: branch_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the bank branch location.

attributes.name: closing_date
attributes.description: Date the bank account was closed. Null for active accounts.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP FI company code to which this bank account is assigned. Used for GL posting and financial statement consolidation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Most recent closing balance from the last processed bank statement. Used for daily cash position reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account number in the chart of accounts to which bank transactions are posted. Typically a cash or cash-equivalent account.

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: SAP-assigned identifier for the house bank configuration. Links to SAP FI bank master (T012).

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for SEPA and cross-border payments in Europe and other IBAN-participating countries.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate earned on positive balances or charged on overdrafts, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%).

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent completed bank reconciliation. Used for SOX compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bank statement received and processed for this account.

attributes.name: lockbox_indicator
attributes.description: True if this account is a lockbox account used for automated AR collection processing. False otherwise.

attributes.name: masked_account_number
attributes.description: Masked account number showing only last 4 digits for display purposes (e.g., XXXXXX1234).

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date the bank account was opened with the financial institution.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: Maximum negative balance allowed by the bank under overdraft protection agreement. Zero if no overdraft facility exists.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number for US domestic wire and ACH transactions.

attributes.name: signatory_authority_1
attributes.description: Name of the primary authorized signatory for the account. Required for SOX treasury controls and audit trail.

attributes.name: signatory_authority_2
attributes.description: Name of the secondary authorized signatory. Used for dual-control requirements on high-value transactions.

attributes.name: signatory_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount that can be authorized by a single signatory. Amounts above this require dual approval.

attributes.name: statement_format
attributes.description: Electronic format in which bank statements are received: MT940 (SWIFT standard), BAI2 (US cash management), CAMT053 (ISO 20022 XML), PDF, CSV.

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: How often bank statements are issued: daily (for high-volume accounts), weekly, monthly.

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.description: Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for international wire transfers. 8 or 11 character ISO 9362 code.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was last modified.

attributes.name: zero_balance_indicator
attributes.description: True if this is a zero-balance account that is automatically swept to/from a concentration account daily. False otherwise.

products.name: sox_control
products.description: SOX internal control master record documenting financial reporting controls across Grocery's key business processes — revenue recognition, inventory valuation, AP/AR, payroll, and financial close. Captures control ID, control objective, control type (preventive/detective), frequency, control owner, testing status, deficiency classification (significant deficiency, material weakness), and remediation plan. Supports external auditor reliance and SEC disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SOX internal control record. Primary key for the sox_control data product.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: SOX controls are defined per GL account; adding gl_account_id links control to the account it governs.

attributes.name: primary_sox_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate responsible for the design, execution, and monitoring of this control. Typically a manager or director in Finance, Operations, or IT.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 - Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports

attributes.name: sox_performer_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate who actually executes the control activity. May differ from the control owner (e.g., staff accountant performs, manager owns).
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: assertion_category
attributes.description: The financial statement assertion this control addresses per audit standards: existence (transactions occurred), completeness (all transactions recorded), accuracy (amounts correct), valuation (proper measurement), rights and obligations (entity owns/owes), presentation and disclosure (proper classification and disclosure).

attributes.name: auditor_reliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether external auditors plan to rely on this control for their financial statement audit, which requires more extensive testing and documentation.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: business_process
attributes.description: The core business process or cycle this control supports (e.g., 'Revenue Recognition', 'Inventory Valuation', 'Accounts Payable', 'Payroll Processing', 'Financial Close', 'Fixed Assets').
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Information and Communication Component

attributes.name: company_level_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a company-level (entity-level) control that operates across the entire organization (e.g., code of conduct, whistleblower hotline, board oversight) versus a process-level control.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Environment Component

attributes.name: compensating_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control serves as a compensating control to mitigate risk when a primary control is deficient or not operating effectively.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: control_activity_detail
attributes.description: Step-by-step procedures or specific actions performed as part of the control execution (e.g., 'Compare system-generated inventory report to physical count sheets; investigate variances exceeding $5,000 or 2%; document resolution in variance log').
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing how the control is performed, what evidence is reviewed, what thresholds or criteria are applied, and what actions are taken when exceptions are identified.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is performed or executed (e.g., daily reconciliations, monthly close reviews, quarterly management certifications, event-driven approvals). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annually|event_driven|continuous — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: control_nature
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is performed manually by personnel, fully automated by system, or a hybrid where manual steps depend on IT-generated reports or system configurations.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique control identifier used in audit documentation and control testing workpapers. Typically follows a pattern like FIN-001, INV-025, REV-100.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: The specific financial reporting assertion or business objective this control is designed to achieve (e.g., 'Ensure completeness and accuracy of accounts payable balances', 'Prevent unauthorized inventory adjustments').
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: control_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the control owner for reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 - Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports

attributes.name: control_performer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the associate who performs the control for audit documentation and segregation of duties analysis.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: control_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the control activity (e.g., 'Monthly Bank Reconciliation Review', 'Inventory Valuation Approval', 'Revenue Recognition Cut-off Verification').

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of control based on its timing and purpose: preventive (stops errors before they occur), detective (identifies errors after occurrence), or corrective (remediates identified errors).
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Control Activities Component

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was first created in the SOX control repository system.

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Severity classification of any identified control deficiency: none (control operating effectively), control deficiency (minor issue not rising to significant deficiency), significant deficiency (important enough to merit attention by those charged with governance), material weakness (reasonable possibility of material misstatement not prevented or detected).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the control deficiency identified during testing, including root cause analysis, impact assessment, and specific instances where the control failed to operate as designed.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: deficiency_identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the control deficiency was first identified through testing, self-assessment, or audit procedures.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this control became effective and operational. Used for tracking control lifecycle and determining when testing should begin.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this control was retired, superseded, or no longer applicable. Null for active controls.

attributes.name: evidence_of_performance
attributes.description: Description of the documentation or artifacts that demonstrate the control was performed (e.g., 'Signed reconciliation workpaper with preparer and reviewer signatures and dates', 'System-generated approval workflow log', 'Email confirmation from manager').
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: financial_statement_line_item
attributes.description: The specific financial statement account or line item this control impacts (e.g., 'Revenue', 'Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)', 'Inventory', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Accrued Liabilities').

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this control record and testing results apply. SOX compliance is assessed annually.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: it_general_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an IT general control (ITGC) covering system access, change management, backup/recovery, or operations versus an application control embedded in business processes.
attributes.references: COBIT Framework - Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies

attributes.name: key_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a key control that external auditors rely upon for their financial statement audit opinion. Key controls are subject to more rigorous testing and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this control record. Critical for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control record was most recently updated, including changes to control design, ownership, testing results, or deficiency status.

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the control was most recently tested by internal audit, external auditors, or control owners as part of ongoing monitoring or annual SOX compliance testing.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next control test based on control frequency and testing plan. Used for test scheduling and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Monitoring Activities Component

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when remediation activities were completed and the control was redesigned or enhanced to address the identified deficiency.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Monitoring Activities Component

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed action plan to address and remediate the identified control deficiency, including specific steps, responsible parties, resources required, and interim compensating controls.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Monitoring Activities Component

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts: not started (plan approved but work not begun), in progress (remediation underway), completed (remediation actions finished), validated (control retested and operating effectively), closed (deficiency fully resolved and documented).
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework - Monitoring Activities Component

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for remediation activities. Material weaknesses typically require remediation within the fiscal year to avoid adverse audit opinion.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the inherent risk level associated with the business process or account balance this control mitigates. Critical and high-risk controls receive more frequent testing.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deficiencies in this control must be disclosed in SEC filings (Form 10-K, Form 10-Q) per SOX Section 302 and 404 requirements. Typically true for material weaknesses and significant deficiencies.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404 - Management Certifications and Internal Control Reports

attributes.name: sox_control_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the control: active (in operation and being tested), inactive (temporarily suspended), under review (being evaluated for design effectiveness), retired (no longer in use).

attributes.name: test_sample_size
attributes.description: Number of control instances or transactions selected for testing during the most recent test cycle. Sample size is determined based on control frequency and risk rating.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: testing_status
attributes.description: Current status of control testing for the fiscal period: not tested (testing not yet started), in progress (testing underway), passed (no deficiencies identified), failed (deficiency identified), not applicable (control not in scope for current period).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201 - Audit of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

attributes.name: total_fees_amount

attributes.name: total_gross_amount

attributes.name: total_net_amount

attributes.name: total_tax_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the payment run record.

attributes.name: reversed_payment_run_id

products.name: cost_element
products.description: Master reference table for cost_element. Referenced by cost_element_id.

attributes.name: cost_element_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cost_element

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate costs from this element to cost objects.

attributes.name: category

attributes.name: code

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the cost center primarily associated with this cost element.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: default_rate

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: gl_account_number

attributes.name: is_deprecated

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: status
