attributes.name: tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates if taxes are applicable to this cost element.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Default tax rate percentage applied to this cost element when tax_applicable is true.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category indicating the nature of the cost element.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the cost element record.

attributes.name: parent_cost_element_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cost_element (parent_cost_element_id)

domains.name: fulfillment
domains.description: Physical execution of order fulfillment across DCs, MFCs, and store backrooms. Manages pick-pack-ship workflows, wave planning, WMS task management, putaway and slotting logic, carrier selection and assignment, last-mile delivery dispatch, and SLA compliance. Tracks fill rates and cold chain integrity during shipment.
domains.references: GS1 Logistics Label Standards, ARTS Fulfillment Standards

products.name: wave
products.description: Wave planning record representing a batch of pick tasks grouped for coordinated execution within a DC, MFC, or store backroom. Captures wave number, planned start/end times, wave type (replenishment, e-commerce, DSD), facility zone, total units, total orders, wave status (planned, released, in-progress, completed, cancelled), priority tier, and WMS wave identifier. Waves are the primary unit of work orchestration in fulfillment — all picking activity flows through wave release.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wave planning record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse supervisor responsible for overseeing this wave execution. Used for accountability and escalation.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier assigned to ship orders from this wave. Used for carrier coordination and last-mile delivery dispatch.

attributes.name: created_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that created this wave record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility (DC, MFC, or store backroom) where this wave is executed.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system process that last modified this wave record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: promo_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_calendar. Business justification: Wave scheduling uses the promotional calendar to align wave start/end dates with campaign calendars.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Promotion‑driven wave planning report requires linking each wave to the active promo_campaign to allocate inventory.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the delivery route assigned to this wave. Used for route optimization and last-mile delivery planning.

attributes.name: sla_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.sla_policy. Business justification: Associating a wave with its SLA policy provides clear policy enforcement per wave and introduces needed inbound relationship for sla_policy.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when wave picking was completed. Used for cycle time analysis and SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when wave picking began. Used for performance analysis and variance tracking against planned start time.

attributes.name: cancelled_line_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines cancelled during wave execution due to inventory issues, quality problems, or customer cancellations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and wave planning analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Primary material handling equipment type used for this wave: pallet jack, forklift, order picker, reach truck, cart, or automated system (AS/RS, AMR).

attributes.name: facility_zone
attributes.description: Physical zone or area within the facility where this wave is executed (e.g., ambient zone, refrigerated zone, freezer zone, backroom section).

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of order lines successfully picked and fulfilled in this wave. Calculated as (lines picked / total lines) × 100. Key metric for inventory availability and fulfillment performance.

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this wave maintained required temperature controls throughout execution per HACCP standards. True if compliant, False if temperature excursions occurred.

attributes.name: is_rush_wave
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is an expedited rush wave requiring immediate processing outside of normal wave planning cycles. True for rush waves, False for standard waves.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this wave record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments about this wave execution, including special handling instructions, issues encountered, or process deviations.

attributes.name: pick_method
attributes.description: Picking methodology used for this wave: discrete (single order at a time), batch (multiple orders picked together), zone (pickers assigned to zones), wave (coordinated multi-zone), or cluster (cart-based multi-order).

attributes.name: picker_count
attributes.description: Number of warehouse pickers assigned to execute this wave. Used for labor productivity analysis and staffing optimization.

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when wave picking is planned to be completed. Used for SLA tracking and downstream process coordination.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when wave picking is planned to begin. Used for labor scheduling and capacity planning.

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this wave for resource allocation and sequencing. Urgent waves are processed first, followed by high, normal, and low priority waves.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wave was released to the warehouse floor for execution. Marks the transition from planned to active status.

attributes.name: short_pick_count
attributes.description: Number of order lines that could not be fully picked due to insufficient inventory (out-of-stock or OOS). Used for inventory accuracy and replenishment analysis.

attributes.name: sla_cutoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Service level agreement deadline by which this wave must be completed to meet customer delivery commitments. Used for on-time performance tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for this wave: ambient (room temperature), refrigerated (cold chain 0-4°C), frozen (below 0°C), or multi-temp (mixed temperature requirements). Critical for cold chain integrity tracking.

attributes.name: total_lines
attributes.description: Total number of order lines (SKU-level picks) across all orders in this wave. Used for pick task generation and labor allocation.

attributes.name: total_orders
attributes.description: Total number of distinct orders included in this wave. Used for batch size optimization and order fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of individual units (eaches) to be picked in this wave across all orders and SKUs. Used for workload estimation and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume in cubic meters of all items to be picked in this wave. Used for container and vehicle capacity planning.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of all items to be picked in this wave. Used for equipment planning (forklifts, pallet jacks) and carrier capacity allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

attributes.name: wave_number
attributes.description: Business-facing wave identifier used for operational tracking and communication. Externally-known unique code for this wave.

attributes.name: wave_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wave: planned (created but not released), released (active for picking), in-progress (picking underway), completed (all tasks finished), cancelled (aborted), or on-hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: wave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wave based on fulfillment purpose: replenishment (store restocking), ecommerce (online order fulfillment), DSD (Direct Store Delivery), store transfer, bulk pick, or cross-dock operations.

attributes.name: wms_wave_identifier
attributes.description: Native wave identifier from the source WMS system (Manhattan Associates, SAP WM, or other). Used for system integration and cross-reference.

products.name: wms_task
products.description: Unified warehouse management system task representing any directed work assignment within a DC, MFC, or store backroom — including picking, putaway, replenishment, and cycle count tasks. For pick tasks: tracks task type (single, batch, cluster, zone), assigned associate, pick location (aisle, bay, level, bin), target quantity, actual quantity picked, pick method (voice, RF, paper), start and completion timestamps, exception reason (OOS, damaged, substituted), and WMS task ID. For putaway tasks: tracks task type (directed, random, cross-dock), source location (dock door, staging area), target slot location, SKU/UPC, quantity, lot number, expiration date, putaway method (FIFO, LIFO, FEFO), assigned associate, and exception code (location full, damaged goods, wrong item). All task types share common attributes: task status, priority, wave reference, facility zone, and completion metrics.

attributes.name: wms_task_id
attributes.description: Primary key for wms_task

attributes.name: assigned_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse associate assigned to execute this task. Used for labor tracking and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, or store backroom where this task is executed.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.planogram. Business justification: PICK TASK PLANNING: WMS pick tasks use the store's planogram to locate items; linking enables task generation and audit of planogram adherence.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_item. Business justification: Traceability reports link each pick task to the underlying product item for allergen, temperature, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or replenishment order that originated this task. Links warehouse execution back to order fulfillment.

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Needed for Pick Task Detail Report; ties each WMS pick task to the exact order line it fulfills.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Pick task execution requires the exact SKU to locate inventory; the WMS picking process uses SKU for routing and allocation.

attributes.name: slot_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.slot_location. Business justification: Linking each WMS task to its exact slot location enables precise location tracking and removes redundant location attributes from wms_task.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Pick task must reference the exact stock position to locate items for picking, required for the 'Pick Execution' process and inventory accuracy reports.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wave planning batch that grouped this task with other tasks for optimized execution. Wave planning consolidates orders by shipping window, carrier, or zone.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity actually picked, put away, or counted by the warehouse associate. Variance from target quantity triggers exception handling.

attributes.name: cold_chain_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this task involves temperature-controlled inventory requiring cold chain integrity monitoring. True for frozen, refrigerated, or temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products.

attributes.name: cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from task start to completion. Key performance indicator for labor productivity and process efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: damage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether damaged goods were encountered during task execution. True when product damage was identified, triggering shrink recording and disposition workflows.

attributes.name: equipment_code
attributes.description: Reference to the material handling equipment used for task execution, such as forklift, pallet jack, or RF scanner device.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for task exception or variance. Examples include location full, damaged goods, wrong item, out of stock, quantity mismatch, or label discrepancy.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the exception or variance encountered during task execution. Provides context for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or consumed. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) putaway and picking logic to minimize shrink from spoilage.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer batch or lot identifier for traceability and recall management. Critical for perishable goods and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: pick_method
attributes.description: Strategy used for pick task execution. Single pick processes one order at a time; batch pick consolidates multiple orders; cluster pick uses carts for multiple orders simultaneously; zone pick assigns associates to specific warehouse zones; wave pick groups tasks by time window.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for task execution sequencing, with lower numbers indicating higher priority. Used by WMS to optimize task assignment and ensure time-sensitive orders are processed first.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Logic used to determine target location for putaway tasks. Directed assigns specific slots; random uses any available location; FIFO (First In First Out) prioritizes oldest inventory; LIFO (Last In First Out) prioritizes newest; FEFO (First Expired First Out) prioritizes by expiration date; fixed location assigns dedicated slots per SKU.

attributes.name: sla_target_completion_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Time
attributes.description: Target timestamp by which the task must be completed to meet service level commitments. Used for on-time fulfillment tracking and carrier cutoff management.

attributes.name: source_location
attributes.description: Origin location for putaway and replenishment tasks. For putaway, this is the receiving dock door or staging area. For replenishment, this is the reserve storage location.

attributes.name: substituted_sku
attributes.description: SKU of the substitute product picked when the original item was out of stock. Used for order fulfillment accuracy tracking and customer communication.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System Item Management

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product substitution was made during picking due to out-of-stock conditions. True when a substitute item was picked instead of the originally requested SKU.

attributes.name: target_location
attributes.description: Destination location for putaway and replenishment tasks. For putaway, this is the assigned storage slot. For replenishment, this is the forward pick location.

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Expected quantity to be picked, put away, or counted as specified by the WMS. Measured in the item's unit of measure.

attributes.name: task_assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the task was assigned to a warehouse associate. Used to measure queue time and assignment efficiency.

attributes.name: task_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the task was successfully completed by the associate. Used for productivity measurement and SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: task_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the WMS task was generated by the system. Marks the beginning of the task lifecycle for cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: task_method
attributes.description: Technology or interface used by the associate to receive and complete the task. Voice uses voice-directed picking; RF scanner uses handheld terminals; paper uses printed pick lists; mobile app uses smartphone applications; automated uses robotics or conveyor systems.

attributes.name: task_started_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the associate began actively working on the task. Marks the transition from assigned to in-progress status.

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the WMS task. Pending tasks await assignment; assigned tasks have been allocated to an associate; in-progress tasks are actively being worked; completed tasks are finished; cancelled tasks were aborted; exception tasks encountered issues; suspended tasks are temporarily paused. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|assigned|in_progress|completed|cancelled|exception|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse task indicating the primary operation to be performed. Pick tasks retrieve inventory for orders; putaway tasks store received goods; replenishment tasks move inventory to forward pick locations; cycle count tasks verify inventory accuracy; cross-dock tasks transfer goods without storage; returns processing tasks handle customer returns.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the task location and product. Ambient for room temperature; refrigerated for 32-40°F; frozen for below 0°F; pharmacy controlled for prescription medications requiring specific temperature ranges.

attributes.name: travel_distance_feet
attributes.description: Total distance traveled by the associate in feet during task execution. Used for warehouse layout optimization and labor standards development.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the quantity is expressed. Each represents individual items; case represents manufacturer cases; pallet represents full pallet quantities; inner pack represents intermediate packaging; display unit represents shelf-ready packaging.

attributes.name: wms_task_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the WMS task, used for tracking and reference across systems and by warehouse associates.

products.name: pack_task
products.description: Pack task record capturing the packing of picked items into containers or bags for a specific order or tote. Tracks pack station ID, packer associate, container type (bag, box, tote, cooler bag), cold chain flag (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), packed item count, pack start and end timestamps, label printed flag, pack exception codes, and QC check status. Linked to the originating wave and order.

attributes.name: pack_task_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pack task record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, or store backroom where packing occurred. Used for location-based performance analysis.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order being packed. Links to the originating order for traceability and fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: primary_packer_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse associate who performed the packing task. Used for labor tracking and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Supports Packing Accuracy Audit by linking each pack task to the specific order line being packed.

attributes.name: tote_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the tote or container used during picking that is now being packed. Tracks the physical container through the fulfillment workflow.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment wave that generated this pack task. Links to the wave planning and batch orchestration process.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to transport this packed order. Links to carrier master data for routing and delivery management.

attributes.name: cold_chain_flag
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the packed items. Critical for maintaining food safety and quality during fulfillment and delivery.

attributes.name: container_dimensions
attributes.description: Physical dimensions of the packed container in format length x width x height (cm). Used for carrier selection and vehicle load optimization.

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of container or packaging used for packing the order items. Determines handling requirements and shipping method compatibility.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Container Type Master

attributes.name: container_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the packed container in kilograms including items and packaging. Used for carrier selection, freight calculation, and load planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pack task record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: gift_message_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a gift message was included in this packed order. Requires special handling during packing process.

attributes.name: label_print_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipping label was printed. Used for tracking label generation and shipment preparation timing.

attributes.name: label_printed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipping label was successfully printed for this pack task. Required for shipment readiness verification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pack task record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: pack_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds taken to complete the pack task. Key performance indicator for labor efficiency and process optimization.

attributes.name: pack_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the packing task was completed. Used to calculate pack duration and throughput metrics.

attributes.name: pack_exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any exception or issue encountered during packing (e.g., damaged item, missing item, wrong item). Used for exception management and root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damaged_item|missing_item|wrong_item|quantity_mismatch|container_shortage|label_error|system_error — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pack_exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the pack exception or special handling instructions. Provides context for exception resolution and quality improvement.

attributes.name: pack_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the packing task was started by the associate. Used for labor productivity analysis and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: pack_station_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical pack station or workstation where the packing activity occurred. Used for capacity planning and performance tracking.

attributes.name: pack_task_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the pack task. Used for operational tracking and communication.

attributes.name: pack_task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pack task. Tracks progression through the packing workflow from assignment to completion or exception handling.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Task Status Management

attributes.name: packed_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual items packed into the container for this task. Used for quality control verification and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: packed_unit_count
attributes.description: Total number of units (quantity) packed across all items. Distinguishes between line count and total quantity for bulk items.

attributes.name: qc_check_status
attributes.description: Status of quality control inspection for this pack task. Indicates whether the packed order passed quality verification before shipment.

attributes.name: qc_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the quality control check was performed. Used for compliance reporting and process timing analysis.

attributes.name: service_level_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping service level (e.g., same-day, next-day, standard). Determines delivery speed and cost.
attributes.references: JDA Transportation Management - Service Level Master

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pack task was completed within the SLA target time. Key metric for operational performance and customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: sla_target_pack_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Pack Time
attributes.description: Target completion timestamp for this pack task based on order SLA and delivery commitments. Used for on-time performance tracking.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any special handling requirements for this pack task (e.g., fragile, hazmat, gift wrap, alcohol verification). Ensures proper handling and compliance.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS - Special Handling Master

attributes.name: substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any items in this pack task were substituted due to out-of-stock conditions. Impacts customer satisfaction and requires communication.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the packed shipment. Enables end-to-end shipment visibility and customer communication.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Outbound shipment record representing the complete lifecycle of a physical dispatch of goods from a DC, MFC, or store to a customer or store location. Header: shipment type (last-mile, store replenishment, inter-DC transfer), carrier SCAC, tracking number, BOL, ship/delivery dates, weight, volume, cold chain requirements, temperature range, and status. Line detail: each SKU in the shipment with GTIN/UPC, quantities (ordered vs shipped), lot number, expiration date, temperature zone, FIFO flag, unit of measure, and exception codes (short-shipped, substituted, damaged). Last-mile dispatch: driver ID, vehicle ID, delivery route reference, ETA, actual delivery timestamp, delivery attempt count, outcome (delivered, failed, returned), proof-of-delivery (signature, photo, PIN), customer signature captured flag, and LMD carrier name (Instacart, DoorDash, internal fleet). Consolidates the full shipment lifecycle from creation through line-level fulfillment and last-mile delivery completion.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver assigned to deliver this shipment for last-mile delivery or internal fleet operations.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: FK to fulfillment.carrier

attributes.name: destination_location_fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility or customer address to which the shipment is being delivered.

attributes.name: food_safety_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_violation. Business justification: Food safety incident reporting requires each shipment that triggers a violation to be linked to the violation record for traceability, recall, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the optimized delivery route that includes this shipment, used for last-mile delivery planning and driver dispatch.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating order that this shipment fulfills. Links shipment to customer order or replenishment order.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Shipment cost allocation and reporting need the promo_campaign that generated the shipment for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: shipment_fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility (DC, MFC, or store) from which the shipment originates.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Needed for Store Receiving and Inventory Reconciliation report, associating each inbound shipment with the destination store for receiving, inventory updates, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle (truck, van, or delivery vehicle) used to transport this shipment.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse wave planning batch that this shipment was assigned to for picking and packing optimization.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment was successfully delivered to the destination and accepted by the recipient.

attributes.name: actual_ship_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the shipment departed the origin facility and was handed to the carrier.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Legal document number issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment. Required for freight shipments.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment contains temperature-sensitive perishable goods requiring refrigerated or frozen transportation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was first created in the system, marking the start of the fulfillment lifecycle.

attributes.name: delivery_attempt_count
attributes.description: Number of delivery attempts made by the carrier before successful delivery or final failure. Used for last-mile delivery performance analysis.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions provided by the customer or receiving location for delivery (e.g., gate code, leave at door, call upon arrival).

attributes.name: delivery_outcome
attributes.description: Final result of the delivery attempt. Delivered indicates successful handoff, failed outcomes require follow-up, returned indicates shipment sent back to origin. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivered|failed_no_access|failed_refused|failed_damaged|returned_to_sender|left_at_door|left_with_neighbor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: destination_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination type. Customer address for last-mile delivery, store for replenishment, DC for inter-facility transfer.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Carrier-provided estimated time of arrival at the destination, updated in real-time during transit.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total transportation cost charged by the carrier for this shipment, used for freight audit and cost allocation.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and carrier certification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shipment record was last updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: max_temperature_f
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain shipments. Violations trigger quality alerts and potential product rejection.

attributes.name: min_temperature_f
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Fahrenheit for cold chain shipments. Violations trigger quality alerts and potential product rejection.

attributes.name: origin_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the origin facility type. DC is large regional distribution center, MFC is micro-fulfillment center for rapid local delivery, store is retail location fulfilling online orders.

attributes.name: package_count

products.name: pickup_staging
products.description: Curbside and click-and-collect pickup staging record tracking the readiness and handoff of a customer order at a store pickup location. Captures order ready timestamp, staging bay number, tote count, cold chain tote count, customer arrival timestamp, staging associate, customer check-in method (app, text, kiosk), handoff timestamp, handoff associate, and staging exception (missing item, wrong order, late staging). Pickup staging is the final fulfillment touchpoint for BOPIS/curbside orders — staging time and handoff speed directly impact customer NPS.

attributes.name: pickup_staging_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pickup staging record. Primary key for the pickup staging entity.

attributes.name: member_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member_offer. Business justification: Supports In‑Store Pickup Offer Redemption tracking, a business rule that records which member offer was applied at the pickup stage.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order being staged for pickup. Links to the omnichannel order that is being fulfilled via BOPIS (Buy Online Pickup In Store) or curbside pickup.

attributes.name: pickup_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate who staged the order for pickup. Used for performance tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_pickup_handoff_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate who delivered the order to the customer. Used for performance tracking and customer service quality measurement.

attributes.name: rx_patient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.rx_patient. Business justification: Supports in‑store prescription pickup audit: linking the staged order to the patient record for verification, HIPAA compliance, and refill eligibility checks.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the pickup order. Links to the shopper profile for loyalty and personalization.

attributes.name: store_location_id

attributes.name: age_verified_flag

attributes.name: alcohol_verification_required_flag

attributes.name: check_in_method

attributes.name: cold_chain_tote_count

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_arrival_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer signature or digital acknowledgment was captured at handoff. Used for proof of delivery and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: customer_wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: Calculated time in minutes between customer arrival and order handoff. Key performance indicator for curbside and BOPIS service quality and NPS impact.

attributes.name: handoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was physically handed off to the customer. Marks completion of the pickup fulfillment process and is a key NPS (Net Promoter Score) driver.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS - Order Management System

attributes.name: loyalty_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is an active loyalty program member. Used for personalized service and loyalty point accrual.

attributes.name: order_ready_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was fully staged and marked ready for customer pickup. Critical SLA (Service Level Agreement) metric for BOPIS fulfillment speed.
attributes.references: Salesforce Commerce Cloud OMS - Order Management System

attributes.name: parking_spot_number
attributes.description: Designated curbside parking spot number where the customer is waiting. Used for efficient order delivery to the correct vehicle.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used for the pickup order. Tracks payment type for financial reconciliation and tender mix analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_card|debit_card|ebt|snap|wic|gift_card|store_credit|cash — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: prescription_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order includes pharmacy prescription items. Requires special handling and HIPAA compliance for patient privacy.
attributes.references: HIPAA - Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staging SLA target was achieved. Key metric for operational performance and customer experience.

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for order staging completion from the time the order is assigned. Defines the service level commitment for pickup readiness.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for staging or handoff (e.g., fragile items, customer accessibility needs, contactless delivery). Ensures proper care and customer accommodation.

attributes.name: staging_bay_number
attributes.description: Physical staging bay or holding area identifier where the order is placed for customer pickup. Used for curbside parking spot or in-store pickup zone designation.

attributes.name: staging_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Calculated time in minutes from staging start to order ready. Measures staging efficiency and associate productivity.

attributes.name: staging_exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the staging exception or issue. Provides context for operational review and customer service follow-up.

attributes.name: staging_exception_type
attributes.description: Type of exception or issue encountered during the staging or handoff process. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: staging_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the staging associate began preparing the order for pickup. Marks the beginning of the staging workflow.

attributes.name: staging_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pickup staging process. Tracks progression from initial staging through customer handoff.

attributes.name: substitution_count

attributes.name: temperature_compliance_flag

attributes.name: tote_count

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pickup staging record was last modified. Audit trail for record changes and status updates.

attributes.name: vehicle_description
attributes.description: Description of the customer vehicle for curbside pickup identification (make, model, color). Helps associates quickly locate the customer in the parking lot.

products.name: fulfillment_order
products.description: Fulfillment-domain representation of an order released for physical execution, distinct from the commercial order in the order domain. Captures fulfillment order number, source order reference, fulfillment channel (DC, MFC, store backroom, DSD), fulfillment node (facility ID), fulfillment type (delivery, pickup, ship-to-store), SLA due timestamp, fulfillment status (received, waving, picking, packing, staged, dispatched, completed, cancelled), substitution count, and OMS release timestamp. Fill rate is computed from order_line picked vs ordered quantities rather than stored as a static attribute.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment order. This is the primary key for the fulfillment domain representation of an order released for physical execution.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transportation carrier assigned to deliver this fulfillment order for home delivery or ship-to-store scenarios. Maps to the carrier master data in the transportation management system.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific facility (distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, or store) responsible for executing this fulfillment order. Maps to the facility master data.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial order in the order domain that originated this fulfillment order. Links the fulfillment execution back to the customer-facing order.

attributes.name: prescription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.prescription. Business justification: Required for Prescription Order Fulfillment process: each fulfillment order must reference the originating prescription for compliance and patient tracking.

attributes.name: primary_fulfillment_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse associate who performed the picking operations for this fulfillment order. Used for productivity tracking and quality accountability.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Order‑level promotion attribution is required for margin analysis and rebate calculations.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to store.store_location. Business justification: Required for Store Pickup Fulfillment Order Assignment report, linking each fulfillment order to the store that fulfills the in‑store pickup, enabling inventory allocation and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pick wave to which this fulfillment order has been assigned. Wave planning groups orders for efficient batch picking and resource optimization in the warehouse.

attributes.name: alcohol_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order contains alcoholic beverages requiring age verification at delivery and compliance with state alcohol shipping regulations. True if alcohol is present, false otherwise.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason why this fulfillment order was cancelled. Customer request for customer-initiated cancellation, inventory unavailable for stockout after release, address issue for undeliverable address, payment failure for payment authorization problems, fraud detected for suspected fraudulent orders, system error for technical failures.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order was cancelled. Applicable when the order is cancelled after release to fulfillment but before completion.

attributes.name: carrier_service_level
attributes.description: The transportation service level selected for this fulfillment order delivery. Same-day for ultra-fast delivery, next-day for overnight service, two-day for expedited service, standard for 3-5 day ground, economy for 5-7 day low-cost delivery.

attributes.name: cold_chain_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order contains temperature-sensitive perishable items requiring cold chain integrity throughout pick, pack, and delivery. True if cold chain handling is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order record was first created in the fulfillment system. Represents the initial receipt of the order from the order management system.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order was successfully delivered to the customer or confirmed as picked up by the customer. Marks the completion of the end-to-end fulfillment process.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order was dispatched from the fulfillment node and handed over to the carrier or made available for customer pickup. Marks the completion of warehouse operations.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of fulfillment exception or issue encountered during order execution. Examples include damaged inventory, address validation failure, delivery attempt failure, or customer unavailable. Used for exception management and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the fulfillment exception or issue in detail. Provides context for exception resolution and customer service follow-up.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channel
attributes.description: The physical fulfillment channel through which this order is being executed. DC (Distribution Center) for traditional warehouse fulfillment, MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center) for automated urban fulfillment, store backroom for in-store pickup or local delivery, DSD (Direct Store Delivery) for vendor-managed delivery, cross-dock for transfer without storage, or vendor direct for drop-ship scenarios.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the fulfillment order, used for tracking and operational reference across warehouse management systems and transportation systems.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment order in the warehouse management system workflow. Received indicates order accepted by WMS, waving indicates wave planning in progress, picking indicates active pick task execution, packing indicates items being packed, staged indicates ready for dispatch, dispatched indicates handed to carrier, in-transit indicates en route to customer, delivered indicates successful delivery, completed indicates fulfillment closed, cancelled indicates order cancelled, exception indicates fulfillment issue requiring intervention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|waving|picking|packing|staged|dispatched|in_transit|delivered|completed|cancelled|exception — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fulfillment_type
attributes.description: The method by which the order will be delivered to the customer. Home delivery for last-mile delivery to customer address, curbside pickup for click-and-collect at store parking, in-store pickup for customer collection inside store, ship-to-store for transfer to another location, or locker pickup for automated pickup point.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, packaging, labeling, and transportation compliance. True if hazmat items are present, false otherwise.

attributes.name: oms_release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the order management system released this order to the fulfillment domain for physical execution. Marks the handoff from order orchestration to warehouse operations.

attributes.name: pack_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when packing operations were completed for this fulfillment order. Marks the order as ready for staging and dispatch.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: The number of physical packages or parcels into which this fulfillment order was packed for shipment. Used for shipping cost calculation and carrier manifest generation.

attributes.name: pick_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when all picking tasks for this fulfillment order were completed. Used for pick cycle time calculation and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when picking operations began for this fulfillment order in the warehouse. Used for cycle time analysis and picker productivity measurement.

attributes.name: prescription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order contains prescription medications requiring pharmacy fulfillment, HIPAA-compliant handling, and controlled substance tracking. True if prescriptions are included, false otherwise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule, DEA Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: The fulfillment priority level assigned to this order based on SLA requirements, customer tier, order value, or business rules. Urgent for same-day or critical orders, high for premium customers or tight SLAs, standard for regular fulfillment, low for backorders or flexible delivery windows.

attributes.name: short_pick_count
attributes.description: The number of line items in this fulfillment order where the picked quantity was less than the ordered quantity due to inventory discrepancies or stockouts. Used for fill rate calculation and inventory accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: sla_due_timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this fulfillment order must be completed to meet the customer promise and service level agreement. Used for SLA compliance tracking and priority sequencing in wave planning.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Customer-provided or system-generated special handling instructions for this fulfillment order. Examples include delivery instructions, gift wrapping requests, or handling precautions.

attributes.name: substitution_count
attributes.description: The number of line items in this fulfillment order where a substitute product was picked due to out-of-stock conditions on the originally ordered item. Used for substitution rate analytics and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The temperature control requirement for this fulfillment order. Ambient for shelf-stable products, chilled for refrigerated items (0-4°C), frozen for frozen products (-18°C or below), multi-temp for orders containing items across multiple temperature zones requiring specialized handling.

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: The total number of distinct line items (SKUs) in this fulfillment order. Used for complexity assessment, wave planning, and picker productivity analysis.

attributes.name: total_unit_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual units (eaches) across all line items in this fulfillment order. Represents the total pick quantity for the order.

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: The total cubic volume of all items in this fulfillment order measured in cubic meters. Used for capacity planning, vehicle loading optimization, and dimensional weight calculations.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: The total weight of all items in this fulfillment order measured in kilograms. Used for carrier selection, freight cost calculation, and load planning.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-provided tracking number for this fulfillment order shipment. Used for customer shipment visibility and delivery status tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

products.name: fulfillment_order_line
products.description: Line-level detail of a fulfillment order representing each SKU to be picked and packed. Tracks UPC, GTIN, PLU (for produce), item description, ordered quantity, allocated quantity, picked quantity, packed quantity, unit of measure, substitution flag, substitute UPC, cold chain zone (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), line status (open, picked, substituted, cancelled, OOS), and pick location assigned.
products.reference: OMS Order Line / WMS Pick Line

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fulfillment order line. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.assortment_item. Business justification: ASSORTMENT VERIFICATION: Order‑line fulfillment is validated against the specific assortment item (SKU, store cluster, planogram) to ensure correct placement and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: CATEGORY COMPLIANCE: Picking and packing must verify perishable/organic category rules; reports require linking each order line to its category for temperature and handling compliance.

attributes.name: drug_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pharmacy.drug. Business justification: Needed for Inventory Reconciliation and regulatory reporting: line items must link to the master drug record to verify NDC, dosage, and controlled‑substance status.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order header. Links this line to the overall order being fulfilled.

attributes.name: primary_fulfillment_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or store associate assigned to pick this line. Used for labor tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: product_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Required for Fulfillment Line Allocation Report linking each order line to its fulfillment order line for pick/pack tracking.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Line‑level offer redemption tracking enables detailed discount impact and GMROI reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Order‑line fulfillment must reference the SKU to drive picking, pricing, and inventory deduction in the fulfillment workflow.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Order line allocation uses a specific stock position to fulfill items, essential for the 'Order Allocation' process and audit of pick locations.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the picking wave this line is assigned to. Groups lines for efficient batch picking operations.

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity allocated from inventory for this line. May differ from ordered quantity based on inventory availability.

attributes.name: cancel_reason_code
attributes.description: Reason code if this line was cancelled during fulfillment. OOS indicates out of stock condition.

attributes.name: carton_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the shipping carton or tote this line was packed into. Links line to physical container for tracking.

attributes.name: cold_chain_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control zone required for this item during fulfillment and delivery. Critical for food safety and quality.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment order line record was created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-by date of the picked item. Ensures FIFO compliance and food safety for perishable goods.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, USDA Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling and shipping compliance.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the item being fulfilled. Includes brand, size, and key product attributes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment order line record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking changes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the fulfillment order. Used for ordering and referencing specific lines.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fulfillment order line in the pick-pack-ship workflow. OOS indicates out of stock condition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|allocated|picking|picked|packing|packed|staged|shipped|delivered|cancelled|oos|substituted|short_picked — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount for this line calculated as picked quantity times unit price. Excludes taxes and fees.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the picked item. Critical for traceability and recall management.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11, FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the item originally ordered by the customer. Represents the customer demand for this line.

attributes.name: pack_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this line was packed into shipping containers. Marks completion of fulfillment processing.

attributes.name: packed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity packed into shipping containers or bags. Final quantity prepared for delivery or pickup.

attributes.name: pick_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when picking was completed for this line. Used to calculate pick time and throughput metrics.

attributes.name: pick_location
attributes.description: Warehouse or store location where the item should be picked from. Includes aisle, bay, shelf, and bin coordinates from WMS.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when picking began for this line. Used for labor productivity analysis and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: pick_zone
attributes.description: Logical zone within the fulfillment facility assigned for picking this item. Used for wave planning and task assignment.

attributes.name: picked_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity picked by warehouse or store associate. Reflects what was physically retrieved from inventory.

attributes.name: short_pick_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the picked quantity was less than the allocated quantity. Used for inventory accuracy analysis.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for picking, packing, or handling this item. May include fragile, keep upright, or temperature requirements.

attributes.name: substitute_sku
attributes.description: SKU of the substitute item picked when the original item was out of stock. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: substitute_upc
attributes.description: UPC of the substitute item picked. Null if no substitution occurred.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has allowed product substitutions for this line if the original item is out of stock.

attributes.name: substitution_made_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product substitution was actually made during fulfillment due to out of stock condition.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the item quantity. Defines how the item is counted or weighed during fulfillment.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit for this line item at the time of fulfillment. Used for order pricing and invoicing.

attributes.name: weight_actual
attributes.description: Actual weight of the picked item in pounds. Captured for variable-weight items like produce and meat.

products.name: carrier

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Primary key for carrier

attributes.name: program_id

attributes.name: api_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides API connectivity for real-time rate quotes, shipment booking, and tracking.

attributes.name: average_transit_time_days
attributes.description: Mean number of days from shipment pickup to delivery across all service levels for this carrier.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Legal business name of the carrier or delivery service provider.

attributes.name: carrier_status

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of carrier based on service model: parcel (small package), LTL (Less Than Truckload), FTL (Full Truckload), last-mile (final delivery leg), gig-economy (on-demand platform), or courier (express delivery).

attributes.name: cold_chain_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is certified to handle temperature-controlled shipments for perishable goods and pharmacy products, maintaining cold chain integrity per HACCP standards.

attributes.name: damage_claim_rate_percent

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the carrier's corporate headquarters street address (suite, floor, building).

attributes.name: headquarters_city

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the carrier's corporate headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the carrier's corporate headquarters is located.

attributes.name: insurance_limit_amount

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the carrier record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date

attributes.name: mc_number

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percent

attributes.name: payment_terms

products.name: transit_temp_event

products.name: sla_policy
products.description: Unified SLA management product encompassing policy definitions and breach event tracking for all fulfillment time commitments. Policy side: SLA name, fulfillment channel (delivery, pickup, ship-to-store), order type (standard, express, same-day, next-day), customer tier, pick/pack/dispatch SLA minutes, total fulfillment SLA hours, effective date range, and active flag. Breach side: individual breach event records where fulfillment orders, tasks, or deliveries failed to meet committed service levels — capturing breach ID, breach type (pick SLA, pack SLA, dispatch SLA, delivery SLA), breach timestamp, minutes overdue, root cause category (OOS, staffing, carrier delay, system outage, weather), impacted order count, customer notification sent flag, escalation level, resolution timestamp, and corrective action. Enables SLA compliance reporting, real-time breach alerting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
