attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The reason why the original item was substituted (OOS, damaged, expired, recalled, discontinued, quality issue).

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The amount refunded to the customer if the substitution was rejected or if the substitute was cheaper.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific substitution rule configuration that was applied.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: The type of substitution rule that was applied (auto-approved by system, associate-selected, customer-approved, system-recommended).

attributes.name: size_match_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute item has the same size or quantity as the original item.

attributes.name: substitute_item_description
attributes.description: Full product description of the substitute item provided.

attributes.name: substitute_quantity_provided
attributes.description: The quantity of the substitute item that was provided to the customer.

attributes.name: substitute_sku
attributes.description: The SKU of the substitute product that was provided to the customer.

attributes.name: substitute_unit_price
attributes.description: The unit price of the substitute item at the time of substitution.

attributes.name: substitute_upc
attributes.description: The UPC of the substitute product that was provided to the customer.

attributes.name: substitution_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the substitution (proposed, approved, rejected, fulfilled, refunded).

attributes.name: substitution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the substitution was performed during the picking process.

products.name: node
products.description: Master record of physical fulfillment nodes including DCs, MFCs, and store backrooms authorized to execute order fulfillment. Captures node name, node type (DC, MFC, store backroom, dark store), address, facility square footage, fulfillment channels supported (delivery, pickup, ship-to-store), daily order capacity, cold chain capability (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), WMS system instance, operating hours, and active status. Distinct from the store master in the store domain — focused on fulfillment operational attributes.

attributes.name: node_id
attributes.description: Primary key for node

attributes.name: dc_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent distribution center that supplies this fulfillment node. Null for top-level DCs.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Each fulfillment node (store or DC) participates in one or more compliance programs; linking enables program‑specific audit, reporting, and certification tracking per node.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated store master record if this fulfillment node is a store backroom or dark store. Null for standalone DCs and MFCs.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment node became operational and started accepting orders.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment node ceased operations. Null for currently active nodes.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the fulfillment node facility.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, building, floor) for the fulfillment node.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation in the fulfillment node operations: manual (human-only), semi_automated (mix of human and automation), fully_automated (automated systems with human oversight), robotic (advanced robotics and AI).

attributes.name: average_pick_time_minutes
attributes.description: Average time in minutes to pick a standard order at this fulfillment node, used for capacity planning and SLA estimation.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the fulfillment node is located.

attributes.name: cold_chain_capability
attributes.description: Temperature control capabilities of the fulfillment node: ambient_only (no refrigeration), refrigerated (chilled products), frozen (frozen products), multi_temp (all temperature zones).

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the fulfillment node operations team.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fulfillment node operations team.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the fulfillment node location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment node record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the fulfillment node can process per day under normal operating conditions.

attributes.name: facility_square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the fulfillment node facility, used for capacity planning and space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: fulfillment_channels_supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fulfillment channels this node supports (e.g., 'delivery,pickup,ship_to_store'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery|pickup|ship_to_store|curbside|locker|same_day|next_day — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment node is certified to handle hazardous materials per DOT and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fulfillment node for routing and distance calculations.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fulfillment node for routing and distance calculations.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the operations manager responsible for this fulfillment node.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment node record was last modified.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the fulfillment node, used in WMS and OMS integrations.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the fulfillment node (e.g., 'Atlanta Regional DC', 'Store 1234 Backroom', 'Brooklyn MFC').

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment node: DC (Distribution Center), MFC (Micro-Fulfillment Center), store_backroom (store backroom authorized for fulfillment), dark_store (dedicated fulfillment-only location), cross_dock (transfer without storage), vendor_direct (DSD fulfillment point).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special operational considerations, constraints, or configuration details for this fulfillment node.

attributes.name: operates_holidays_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment node operates on recognized holidays.

attributes.name: operates_weekends_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment node operates on weekends (Saturday and Sunday).

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily operating end time for the fulfillment node in HH:MM format (24-hour clock).

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily operating start time for the fulfillment node in HH:MM format (24-hour clock).

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the fulfillment node in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment node is certified for organic product handling and storage per USDA National Organic Program standards.

attributes.name: pharmacy_licensed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment node holds a pharmacy license and can fulfill prescription orders.
attributes.references: State Boards of Pharmacy Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code for the fulfillment node address.

attributes.name: service_area_radius_miles
attributes.description: Maximum delivery radius in miles that this fulfillment node serves for last-mile delivery.

attributes.name: sla_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Daily cutoff time in HH:MM format (24-hour clock) for same-day fulfillment orders at this node.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the fulfillment node location.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the fulfillment node measured in cubic feet, used for inventory planning.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the fulfillment node location (e.g., 'America/New_York'), used for scheduling and SLA calculations.

attributes.name: wms_system_instance
attributes.description: Identifier of the WMS system instance managing this fulfillment node, used for system integration and troubleshooting.

products.name: tote
products.description: Physical tote or container used to consolidate picked items for a specific order or batch during fulfillment. Captures tote barcode, tote type (ambient, refrigerated, frozen, insulated bag), tote capacity (liters), current assignment (order, wave), tote status (available, in-use, staged, dispatched, returned, damaged), last scanned location, last scanned timestamp, and tote condition (clean, soiled, damaged). Totes are the primary unit of physical custody transfer between pick, pack, stage, and dispatch — critical for cold chain segregation in grocery.

attributes.name: tote_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tote container. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse associate or picker currently assigned to this tote for order fulfillment. Null when tote is not actively being picked.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or delivery service provider responsible for transporting this tote. Null for in-store pickup orders.

attributes.name: created_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that created this tote record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delivery route this tote is assigned to for last-mile delivery. Links tote to carrier and route optimization.

attributes.name: fulfillment_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution center, micro-fulfillment center, or store backroom where the tote is currently located.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that last modified this tote record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order currently assigned to this tote. Null when tote is available or not assigned to a specific order.

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment wave this tote is assigned to. Enables batch processing and wave-based pick optimization.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the tote was first acquired and entered into inventory. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Scannable barcode identifier printed on the tote for tracking and identification during pick, pack, stage, and dispatch operations.

attributes.name: capacity_liters
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity of the tote measured in liters. Used for load planning and space optimization.

attributes.name: color_code
attributes.description: Color identifier used for visual sorting and temperature zone identification (e.g., blue for frozen, green for ambient, red for pharmacy).

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Physical condition assessment of the tote. Determines whether the tote is suitable for reuse or requires cleaning, repair, or disposal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tote record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: current_weight_kg
attributes.description: Current actual weight of the tote and its contents in kilograms. Updated during picking and packing operations.

attributes.name: dispatched_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was loaded onto a delivery vehicle and dispatched for last-mile delivery. Marks the start of the delivery phase.

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tote has maintained required temperature controls throughout the fulfillment process. Critical for food safety and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: is_insulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tote has insulation for temperature-sensitive items. Used for cold chain segregation and routing decisions.

attributes.name: is_reusable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tote is designed for multiple uses and must be returned to the facility. False for single-use disposable bags.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual items currently contained in the tote. Updated during picking operations and used for accuracy verification.

attributes.name: last_cleaned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was last cleaned and sanitized. Critical for food safety compliance and HACCP requirements.

attributes.name: last_inspected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was last inspected for damage or wear. Ensures tote quality and safety standards are maintained.

attributes.name: last_scanned_location
attributes.description: Physical location identifier where the tote was last scanned. Provides real-time tracking of tote movement through the fulfillment process.

attributes.name: last_scanned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was last scanned at a location checkpoint. Critical for tracking tote movement and dwell time.

attributes.name: line_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct order lines or Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) contained in the tote. Used for pick complexity assessment.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Material composition of the tote. Impacts durability, cleaning requirements, and environmental sustainability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tote record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special handling instructions, or incident documentation related to the tote.

attributes.name: pack_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when packing operations were completed for this tote. Indicates the tote is ready for staging or dispatch.

attributes.name: pack_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when packing operations began for this tote. Tracks the transition from pick to pack workflow stage.

attributes.name: pick_complete_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all items were successfully picked into this tote. Marks completion of the picking phase.

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when picking operations began for this tote. Used to calculate pick cycle time and labor productivity.

attributes.name: returned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was returned to the facility after delivery completion or failed delivery attempt. Enables tote reuse cycle tracking.

attributes.name: staged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the tote was moved to the staging area awaiting dispatch. Critical for tracking Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control zone classification for the tote. Aligns with cold chain requirements and ensures proper storage conditions for perishable items.

attributes.name: total_use_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of times the tote has been used for order fulfillment. Tracks tote utilization and helps predict replacement needs.

attributes.name: tote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tote in the fulfillment workflow. Tracks tote availability and location in the pick-pack-ship process.

attributes.name: tote_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tote based on temperature control requirements. Critical for cold chain segregation in grocery fulfillment.

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the tote in kilograms. Ensures safe handling and prevents overloading during fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific zone or area within the facility where the tote is currently located (e.g., pick zone, staging zone, loading dock).

products.name: vehicle

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vehicle

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the driver currently assigned to the vehicle.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_cubic_meters
attributes.description: Maximum cargo volume the vehicle can hold.

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum cargo weight the vehicle can carry.

attributes.name: compliance_certification
attributes.description: Regulatory certification(s) applicable to the vehicle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: decommission_date

attributes.name: depreciation_method

attributes.name: depreciation_rate

attributes.name: emission_standard

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_l_per_100km
attributes.description: Average fuel consumption measured in liters per 100 kilometers.

attributes.name: fuel_type

attributes.name: gps_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the GPS tracking unit installed on the vehicle.

attributes.name: gps_last_update_timestamp

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_capable

attributes.name: maintenance_status

attributes.name: make

attributes.name: max_cold_temp_celsius

attributes.name: operational_region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary geographic region where the vehicle operates.

attributes.name: payload_weight_limit_kg

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date the vehicle was acquired by Grocery.

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle's registration expires.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration identifier assigned by the motor vehicle authority.

attributes.name: registration_state
attributes.description: State or province that issued the vehicle registration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vehicle.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the vehicle record.

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Category of vehicle used for fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: Manufacturer‑assigned unique vehicle identifier.

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: Year the vehicle was manufactured.

attributes.name: replaced_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vehicle (replaced_vehicle_id)

domains.name: pricing
domains.description: Price management across all channels including SRP, competitive pricing, zone pricing, markdown strategies, and dynamic fuel pricing. Manages price changes, promotional pricing linkages, ASP analytics, and price optimization algorithms. Supports competitive intelligence integration and ensures FTC pricing compliance.

products.name: retail_price
products.description: Authoritative master record of the current shelf price (SRP) for every SKU within a specific price zone and channel. Captures base retail price, effective and expiration dates, price zone assignment, unit of measure, price tier, and price-ending convention. Serves as the single source of truth for item-level retail pricing and the foundation for all price change, markdown, TPR, and promotional pricing workflows.

attributes.name: retail_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retail price record. Primary key for the retail price entity.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this retail price. Supports audit trails and SOX compliance for pricing governance.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Category‑Level Price Optimization report requires linking each retail_price to its category for margin analysis and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: order_channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the sales channel (in-store, online, mobile app, curbside pickup) where this price applies. Enables omnichannel pricing differentiation.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the geographic or market-based price zone where this retail price is effective. Supports zone-based pricing strategies.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the SKU to which this retail price applies. Links to the product master.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Business process: Supplier Suggested Retail Price (SRP) is used as a baseline in retail_price; linking SRP to supplier supports price‑setting and supplier performance analysis.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price was approved for activation. Part of the pricing workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: competitor_price_reference
attributes.description: The most recent competitive price benchmark for this SKU from competitive intelligence sources. Used for price positioning and competitive response strategies.

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: The unit cost of goods sold (COGS) used to calculate margin for this SKU. Confidential business data used for GMROI and profitability analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for price lifecycle management.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the retail price amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this retail price becomes active and available for sale transactions. Part of the price lifecycle management.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this retail price is no longer valid and must be replaced. Nullable for open-ended pricing. Supports automated price change workflows.

attributes.name: external_price_code
attributes.description: The unique price identifier from the source system of record (e.g., Oracle Retail price ID, SAP condition record number). Used for cross-system reconciliation and EDI integration.

attributes.name: last_price_change_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent price change for this SKU in this zone and channel. Used for price volatility analysis and change frequency tracking.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this retail price record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: loyalty_member_price
attributes.description: The special retail price available exclusively to loyalty program members. Nullable if no loyalty pricing exists. Supports customer loyalty and personalized pricing strategies.

attributes.name: margin_percentage
attributes.description: The gross margin percentage calculated as (SRP - Cost) / SRP * 100. Confidential metric used for category management and pricing optimization.

attributes.name: minimum_advertised_price
attributes.description: The minimum price at which this SKU can be advertised, as stipulated by the vendor or manufacturer. Nullable if no MAP restriction exists. Ensures vendor compliance.

attributes.name: multi_buy_price
attributes.description: The total price for the multi-buy quantity (e.g., $5.00 for 3-for-$5). Nullable if not a multi-buy price. Used in POS promotional pricing calculations.

attributes.name: multi_buy_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity threshold for multi-buy pricing (e.g., 2 for Buy One Get One, 3 for 3-for-$5 deals). Nullable if not a multi-buy price. Supports promotional pricing logic.

attributes.name: price_change_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of price changes for this SKU in this zone and channel since initial pricing. Supports price stability metrics.

attributes.name: price_change_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason code for the most recent price change. Supports audit trails and price change analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cost_increase|competitive_response|markdown|promotion_end|seasonal_adjustment|new_item|clearance|vendor_funded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: price_display_text
attributes.description: The formatted text string for displaying the price on shelf tags, digital signage, and e-commerce (e.g., '$3.99 ea', '2 for $5', '$1.99/lb'). Supports omnichannel price presentation consistency.

attributes.name: price_ending_convention
attributes.description: The two-digit ending convention applied to the price (e.g., 99, 95, 49, 00). Used for psychological pricing strategies and brand positioning.

attributes.name: price_lock_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the price lock expires and normal pricing governance resumes. Nullable if no lock is in place.

attributes.name: price_lock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price is locked and cannot be changed without executive approval. Used for contract pricing, vendor agreements, and strategic items.

attributes.name: price_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price was set by an automated price optimization algorithm (true) or manually by a pricing analyst (false). Supports AI/ML pricing governance.

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the retail price record. Active prices are used in POS transactions; pending prices await activation; expired prices are historical.

attributes.name: price_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy tier for this SKU (e.g., standard, premium, value, promotional, clearance, everyday low price). Supports price positioning and markdown analytics.

attributes.name: price_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the price type distinguishing base prices from temporary price reductions (TPR), promotional prices, clearance prices, and dynamic prices. Critical for price hierarchy and promotional linkage.

attributes.name: rounding_rule_code
attributes.description: The rounding rule applied to the calculated price (e.g., round to nearest nickel, dime, dollar, or no rounding). Supports cash handling and price presentation standards.

attributes.name: snap_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for purchase using SNAP/EBT benefits. Required for government assistance program compliance and POS transaction processing.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The operational system or process that originated this retail price record (e.g., Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP Retail, manual entry, price optimization engine). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: srp_amount
attributes.description: The base shelf price for the SKU in this zone and channel, excluding any promotional or temporary price reductions. This is the single source of truth for item-level retail pricing.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for which the retail price is defined (e.g., each, pound, kilogram). Critical for produce and bulk items sold by weight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|case|pack|dozen — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wic_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is eligible for purchase using WIC benefits. Required for government assistance program compliance and POS transaction processing.

products.name: price_zone
products.description: Defines geographic or competitive pricing zones used to differentiate retail prices across store clusters. Each zone groups stores with similar competitive environments, cost structures, or market demographics. Supports zone-based pricing strategies where the same SKU carries different shelf prices in different zones. Referenced by retail_price, price_change, and competitive_price records as the geographic pricing boundary.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Primary key for price_zone

attributes.name: competitive_intensity
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure within this zone based on number and strength of competitors. Drives pricing aggressiveness.

attributes.name: competitive_price_match_policy
attributes.description: Policy for matching competitor prices in this zone: none (no matching), manual (case-by-case approval), automated (system-driven matching), or selective (specific categories only).

attributes.name: cost_index
attributes.description: Relative cost index for this zone compared to a baseline (e.g., 1.00 = baseline, 1.15 = 15% higher costs). Reflects distribution, labor, and occupancy cost differences.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price zone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone ceases to be active. Null for open-ended zones.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone becomes active and begins to govern pricing for assigned stores.

attributes.name: fuel_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price zone applies to fuel center pricing. True if zone governs fuel prices; false if zone is retail-only.

attributes.name: income_profile
attributes.description: Predominant household income level within the zone, used to calibrate price sensitivity and product mix.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this price zone configuration was last reviewed and validated by pricing management. Used to ensure zones remain aligned with market conditions.

attributes.name: markdown_strategy
attributes.description: Approach to markdown and clearance pricing within this zone: aggressive (deep discounts), moderate (standard clearance), conservative (minimal markdowns), or none (no markdowns allowed).

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Geographic market segment classification for the zone, used to align pricing with local market characteristics.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing analyst or system that last modified this price zone record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price zone record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this price zone. Ensures periodic reassessment of zone boundaries and strategies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or context about this price zone. Used by pricing analysts for documentation.

attributes.name: pharmacy_pricing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price zone applies to pharmacy prescription pricing. True if zone governs pharmacy prices; false if zone is retail-only.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base prices to derive zone-specific retail prices. For example, 1.0500 means 5% uplift over base.

attributes.name: price_change_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether price changes in this zone require managerial approval before execution. True if approval workflow is enforced; false if automated.

attributes.name: price_optimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether algorithmic price optimization is active for this zone. True if AI/ML pricing algorithms are used; false if manual pricing rules apply.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The overarching pricing strategy applied to this zone: everyday_low (EDLP), high_low (frequent promotions), premium (higher margin), discount (low margin high volume), market_match (competitive parity), or penetration (aggressive entry pricing).

attributes.name: private_label_strategy
attributes.description: Pricing approach for private-label (store-owned brand) products in this zone: standard (parity with national brands), premium (higher margin), value (aggressive discount), or mixed (varies by category).

attributes.name: promotional_frequency
attributes.description: Typical cadence of promotional pricing events in this zone, aligned with ad circular schedules and competitive response.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the broader geographic region or division that this price zone belongs to, for hierarchical rollup and reporting.

attributes.name: snap_ebt_volume_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) / EBT (Electronic Benefits Transfer) Volume Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of transaction volume in this zone paid via SNAP/EBT benefits. Influences pricing sensitivity and product mix decisions.

attributes.name: store_count
attributes.description: Number of stores currently assigned to this price zone. Updated as stores are added or removed.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the price zone, used in pricing systems and reports. Typically alphanumeric and unique across the enterprise.

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the price zone, including the rationale for grouping stores (e.g., competitive environment, demographics, cost structure).

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the price zone, such as 'Metro East', 'Rural Southwest', or 'High Competition Urban'.

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price zone. Active zones are in use for pricing; inactive zones are temporarily disabled; pending zones are under review; archived zones are historical.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price zone strategy: competitive (based on competitor density), geographic (regional boundaries), demographic (customer income/profile), cost_based (distribution cost), hybrid (multiple factors), or promotional (special event-driven).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing analyst or system that created this price zone record.

products.name: price_change
products.description: Transactional record of every approved retail price change event for a SKU in a given price zone. Captures old price, new price, effective date, expiration date, change reason code (cost increase, competitive response, seasonal, vendor-funded), initiating buyer, approval status, and batch reference. Supports FTC pricing compliance audit trails, comp-sales impact analysis, and price change velocity reporting.

attributes.name: price_change_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price change event. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or pricing authority who approved the price change.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Price Change Impact Dashboard aggregates changes by category to assess competitive response and margin effect.

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.cost_price. Business justification: Price changes often depend on the underlying cost basis; linking to cost_price captures the cost record driving the price change and provides a direct relationship.

attributes.name: price_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the batch or group of price changes processed together, used for bulk price updates.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic or competitive price zone where this price change applies.

attributes.name: primary_price_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the buyer or category manager who initiated the price change request.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this price change to a promotional campaign if the change is promotion-driven. Nullable for non-promotional changes.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU for which the price is being changed.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific store location if this price change applies to a single store rather than a zone. Nullable for zone-level changes.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier associated with this price change, particularly for vendor-funded price reductions or cost-driven increases.

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was activated and became effective in Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between new price and old price (new_price minus old_price). Positive for increases, negative for decreases.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the price change request.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change was approved by the pricing authority.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the price change event, often used in approval workflows and audit trails.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the business reason for the price change: cost increase, competitive response, seasonal adjustment, vendor-funded promotion, markdown, or clearance.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price change: regular price adjustment, promotional pricing, temporary price reduction (TPR), permanent price change, or markdown.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The sales channel to which this price change applies: in-store, online eCommerce, mobile app, curbside pickup, or home delivery.

attributes.name: competitive_price_reference
attributes.description: The competitor price that influenced this change, captured from competitive intelligence systems.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competitor whose pricing influenced this change, used for competitive response tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance considerations, regulatory review outcomes, or audit trail details for FTC pricing compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change required Federal Trade Commission (FTC) pricing compliance review due to regulatory sensitivity (True) or was routine (False).

attributes.name: cost_change_amount
attributes.description: The change in product cost from the vendor that triggered this retail price change. Used for margin analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the new price becomes active and is applied at Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: elasticity_coefficient
attributes.description: The price elasticity of demand coefficient used in the pricing decision, representing the expected percentage change in quantity demanded for a 1% price change.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this price change expires and reverts or transitions to another price. Nullable for permanent changes.

attributes.name: forecasted_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The projected change in revenue resulting from this price change, calculated from volume and price elasticity models.

attributes.name: forecasted_volume_impact
attributes.description: The projected change in sales volume (units) resulting from this price change, based on demand forecasting models.

attributes.name: margin_impact_percent
attributes.description: The projected impact on Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) resulting from this price change, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: new_price
attributes.description: The new retail price effective after this change event.

attributes.name: old_price
attributes.description: The previous retail price before this change event.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: The percentage change in price calculated as ((new_price - old_price) / old_price) * 100.

attributes.name: price_optimization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price change was generated by an automated price optimization algorithm (True) or manually initiated (False).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system that originated this price change record (e.g., Oracle Retail Price Management, SAP Retail SD).

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the price change request was submitted into the pricing system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price change record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer.

products.name: markdown
products.description: Records planned and executed markdown events for clearance, seasonal rotation, or perishable shrink reduction. Captures markdown type (permanent, temporary, clearance), markdown percentage or absolute amount, start and end dates, triggering condition (e.g., days-on-shelf threshold, sell-through rate), and store or zone scope. Distinct from TPR promotional pricing — markdowns are inventory-driven price reductions managed by category managers.

attributes.name: markdown_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the markdown event. Primary key.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Markdown Planning process uses category to set markdown thresholds and evaluate sell‑through per category.

attributes.name: markdown_approved_by_associate_id
attributes.description: The pricing team member or manager who approved this markdown. Null if not yet approved or if auto-approved by system rules.

attributes.name: markdown_associate_id
attributes.description: The category manager who proposed or authorized this markdown event.

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the automated markdown rule that triggered this event. Null if manually created.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: The pricing zone to which this markdown applies. Null if markdown is store-specific or enterprise-wide.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: The SKU subject to this markdown event.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: The store where this markdown is applied. Null if markdown applies to a zone or all stores.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Business process: Supplier‑funded markdowns (allowances) are tracked per markdown record; linking to supplier captures funding source for margin and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_margin_impact
attributes.description: The actual gross margin impact realized from this markdown event, calculated after completion.

attributes.name: actual_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The actual revenue impact realized from this markdown event, calculated after completion by comparing markdown revenue to baseline revenue projection.

attributes.name: actual_units_sold
attributes.description: The actual number of units sold during the markdown period. Populated after markdown completion for performance analysis.

attributes.name: ad_circular_featured
attributes.description: Indicates whether this markdown is featured in the weekly ad circular or promotional flyer (True) or is an in-store-only markdown (False).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The absolute dollar amount by which the price is reduced. Null if markdown is expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown was approved by the pricing team.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason this markdown was cancelled before activation (e.g., 'inventory sold out', 'pricing error', 'vendor credit received', 'competitive intelligence changed'). Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_on_shelf_threshold
attributes.description: The number of days an item has been on the shelf that triggered this markdown (e.g., 30 days for slow movers). Null if not applicable to this markdown type.

attributes.name: days_to_expiration_threshold
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until product expiration that triggered this markdown for perishables. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the markdown expires and pricing reverts to the original or a new price. Null for permanent markdowns.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the markdown becomes active and the reduced price takes effect.

attributes.name: estimated_margin_impact
attributes.description: The estimated gross margin impact (in dollars) from this markdown, calculated at planning time using COGS and markdown price.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_impact
attributes.description: The estimated revenue loss or gain from this markdown event, calculated at planning time. Negative values indicate revenue reduction; positive values indicate incremental revenue from volume lift.

attributes.name: ftc_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any FTC pricing compliance considerations for this markdown, such as comparative pricing claims, former price disclosures, or advertising restrictions.

attributes.name: inventory_units_threshold
attributes.description: The inventory unit count threshold that triggered this markdown due to overstock. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: is_automated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this markdown was triggered automatically by a system rule (True) or manually created by a category manager (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this markdown record was last updated.

attributes.name: markdown_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the markdown event, used in reporting and communication with category managers.

attributes.name: markdown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the markdown event: planned (proposed by category manager), approved (authorized by pricing team), active (currently in effect), completed (end date reached), cancelled (revoked before activation).

attributes.name: markdown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the markdown: permanent (ongoing price reduction), temporary (time-bound markdown), clearance (end-of-life inventory liquidation), seasonal (seasonal rotation), or perishable (shrink reduction for fresh items nearing expiration).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the category manager or pricing analyst providing additional context, rationale, or instructions for this markdown event.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The regular retail price (SRP) before the markdown is applied, in local currency.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the original price (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off). Null if markdown is expressed as an absolute amount.

attributes.name: planned_units_to_clear
attributes.description: The target number of inventory units the category manager intends to sell through with this markdown. Used for clearance and overstock scenarios.

attributes.name: pos_signage_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Signage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether in-store signage or shelf tags must be updated to reflect the markdown price (True) or if the price change is system-only (False).

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The final retail price after the markdown is applied, in local currency.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The business reason triggering the markdown: slow_mover (low sell-through rate), overstock (excess inventory), damage (product quality issue), expiration (approaching best-by date), seasonal_rotation (end of season), discontinued (product phase-out).

attributes.name: sell_through_rate_threshold
attributes.description: The sell-through rate percentage threshold that triggered this markdown (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: triggering_condition
attributes.description: The business rule or threshold that triggered this markdown event (e.g., 'days on shelf > 30', 'sell-through rate < 20%', 'inventory units > 500', 'days to expiration < 7'). Free-text field capturing the logic used by the category manager or automated system.

products.name: tpr
products.description: Temporary Price Reduction (TPR) record linking a SKU to a short-term shelf price reduction that is NOT tied to a formal promotion campaign. Captures the TPR price, regular price, discount amount, start and end dates, store or zone scope, and vendor funding flag (indicating whether a CPG vendor is subsidizing the reduction via a trade deal). Distinct from markdown (clearance) and from promotion-driven pricing.

attributes.name: tpr_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the temporary price reduction record.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Temporary Price Reduction analysis reports performance by category, requiring a FK from tpr to category.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic pricing zone for the TPR. Null if store‑specific.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the stock keeping unit to which the TPR applies.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store where the TPR is scoped. Null if the TPR is zone‑wide.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor providing funding for the TPR, if applicable.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the price values.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary discount applied (regular_price - tpr_price).

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount relative to the regular price.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the temporary price reduction expires.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form text for additional comments or justification of the TPR.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Shelf price of the SKU during the TPR period.

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: Origin of the TPR price entry: system‑generated, manually entered, or supplied by vendor.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price change; for this entity it will be 'tpr'.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code representing the business reason for the temporary price reduction (e.g., competitor match, inventory clearance).

attributes.name: record_audit_created
attributes.description: Timestamp when the TPR record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_audit_updated
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the TPR record.

attributes.name: regular_price
attributes.description: Standard shelf price of the SKU before any temporary reduction.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the temporary price reduction becomes effective.

attributes.name: tpr_number
attributes.description: Business identifier assigned to the TPR event, often used in reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: tpr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the TPR record.

attributes.name: vendor_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount is subsidized by the vendor (True) or absorbed by the retailer (False).

products.name: competitive_price
products.description: Stores competitive intelligence price observations for key SKUs and PLUs captured from competitor stores, third-party price intelligence feeds (e.g., Numerator, Datasembly), or manual audits. Captures competitor store identifier, competitor chain name, observed price, observed date, data source, and price gap versus Grocery's current shelf price. Feeds competitive pricing response workflows and price optimization algorithms.

attributes.name: competitive_price_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for each competitive price observation record.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.price_zone. Business justification: Competitive price observations are zone‑specific; linking to price_zone provides a canonical zone reference and removes redundant store_zone and region columns.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific competitor store where the price was observed.

attributes.name: competitive_price_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the observation record.

attributes.name: competitor_name
attributes.description: Name of the competing retailer or chain providing the price observation.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: System‑generated confidence level (0‑1) indicating reliability of the observation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the observed price.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin of the price observation data.

attributes.name: observation_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture the price (e.g., in‑store scan, manual entry, API feed).

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the competitor price was observed or recorded.

attributes.name: observed_price
attributes.description: Price quoted by the competitor for the SKU at the observation time.

attributes.name: our_price
attributes.description: Current shelf price of the same SKU at Grocery stores.

attributes.name: plu
attributes.description: Code used primarily for fresh produce items to identify pricing.

attributes.name: price_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the observed price differs from the previous observation for the same SKU and competitor.

attributes.name: price_gap
attributes.description: Difference between competitor price and Grocery's price (competitor - ours).

attributes.name: price_gap_percentage
attributes.description: Relative price gap expressed as a percentage of Grocery's price.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the observed price (e.g., regular shelf, promotional, clearance).

attributes.name: record_audit_created
attributes.description: Timestamp when this competitive price record was first loaded into the lakehouse.

attributes.name: record_audit_updated
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this competitive price record.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal SKU of the product for which the competitive price is captured.

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: Standardized 12‑digit barcode identifier for the product.

products.name: price_rule
products.description: Business-managed pricing rules and guardrails that govern automated and manual price-setting decisions. Captures rule type (margin floor, competitive index cap, EDLP vs. Hi-Lo strategy flag, price-ending convention), applicable category or department, minimum and maximum price bounds, GMROI threshold, and rule priority. Used by price optimization algorithms and CAO systems to constrain price recommendations within acceptable business parameters.

attributes.name: price_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the pricing rule.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the rule.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assortment.category. Business justification: Pricing rules are often scoped to specific categories; linking enables rule‑to‑category enforcement and audit.

attributes.name: price_zone_id
attributes.description: Geographic or store zone identifier where the rule applies.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Pricing rules are scoped to profit centers to enable profit‑center profitability analysis and budgeting.

attributes.name: promo_campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_campaign. Business justification: Price rule activation tied to promotion campaigns for automated price adjustments during campaign periods.

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promo_offer. Business justification: Price rule may be triggered by specific promo offers, enabling dynamic pricing based on offer conditions.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Business process: Supplier‑specific pricing rules (margin floors, discounts) are defined in price_rule for price optimization. Retail‑grocery pricing teams need to link each rule to its supplier.

attributes.name: applicable_category_code
attributes.description: Category (e.g., grocery, produce) to which the rule applies.

attributes.name: applicable_department_code
attributes.description: Department identifier (e.g., dairy, pharmacy) for rule scope.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rule was approved.

attributes.name: competitive_index_cap
attributes.description: Maximum allowed price relative to a competitive index.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rule record was created.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rule expires; null if open‑ended.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rule becomes effective.

attributes.name: gmroi_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum GMROI value required for rule applicability.

attributes.name: is_system_rule
attributes.description: True if the rule is system‑defined; false if user‑defined.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the rule.

attributes.name: margin_floor_percent
attributes.description: Minimum gross margin percentage required by the rule.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑text comments or rationale for the rule.

attributes.name: price_ceiling
attributes.description: Maximum allowable price for items governed by this rule.

attributes.name: price_ending_convention
attributes.description: Standard price ending pattern (e.g., .99, .95).

attributes.name: price_floor
attributes.description: Minimum allowable price for items governed by this rule.

attributes.name: price_rule_name
attributes.description: Human readable name of the pricing rule.

attributes.name: price_rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rule.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Integer indicating rule precedence; lower numbers have higher priority.

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rule indicating its purpose and calculation method.

products.name: cost_price
products.description: Authoritative record of the vendor invoice cost (COGS basis) for each SKU, including base cost, allowances, deal costs, freight, and landed cost components. Captures effective date, expiration date, vendor agreement reference, cost type (standard, actual, replacement, forward-buy), and currency code supporting multi-currency operations. Includes vendor-initiated cost change tracking with old cost, new cost, change effective date, vendor justification (commodity index, freight surcharge, tariff, packaging), buyer acknowledgment status, and resulting retail price action flag. Serves as the cost basis for margin calculation, GMROI analysis, price change justification, and gross profit reporting. Temporal versioning maintains full cost history for audit and trend analysis.
products.reference: COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) / Landed Cost

attributes.name: cost_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cost price record.
attributes.references: Primary key for cost price record

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for Cost of Goods Sold reporting: each SKU cost record must be charged to a cost center for internal accounting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product (SKU) to which this cost applies.
attributes.references: SKU identifier linked to product master

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor supplying the product.

attributes.name: allowance_cost
attributes.description: Cost reductions such as trade discounts, promotional allowances, or rebates.
attributes.references: Allowances, rebates, or discounts applied by vendor

attributes.name: base_cost
attributes.description: Core purchase price before any allowances, freight, or other adjustments.
attributes.references: Base cost component from vendor invoice

attributes.name: buyer_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchasing buyer has reviewed and accepted the cost change.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Comments related to FTC pricing compliance or other regulatory considerations.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm used to allocate cost when multiple cost layers exist.
attributes.references: Method used to allocate cost across SKUs

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Logical grouping of the cost (e.g., raw material, packaging, duty).

attributes.name: cost_change_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the cost change request.
attributes.references: Approval status of the cost change request

attributes.name: cost_change_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cost change takes effect; mirrors effective_start_date for reporting.
attributes.references: Effective date of the cost change (duplicate of start date for clarity)

attributes.name: cost_change_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the cost was adjusted (e.g., commodity index, tariff, packaging change).

attributes.name: cost_change_source
attributes.description: Source that initiated the cost change: vendor‑initiated, internal procurement, or system‑generated.
attributes.references: Origin of the cost change request

attributes.name: cost_reference
attributes.description: Business‑visible reference number for the cost price record.

attributes.name: cost_status
attributes.description: Operational status indicating if the cost is active, pending approval, or archived.
attributes.references: Current lifecycle status of the cost record

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost (e.g., standard, actual, replacement, forward‑buy).
attributes.references: Type of cost as defined by finance policy

attributes.name: cost_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier for audit and trend analysis.
attributes.references: Version number for cost record history

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the cost record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter code representing the currency of the cost values.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which the cost is no longer applicable.
attributes.references: Date when cost expires or is superseded

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: First date the cost is valid for pricing and margin calculations.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Rate used to convert foreign‑currency cost components to the base reporting currency.
attributes.references: Exchange rate to convert foreign currency to base currency

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Transportation cost incurred to move the product from vendor to distribution center.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account number to which the cost is posted for financial reporting.
attributes.references: General Ledger account associated with the cost

attributes.name: is_freight_included
attributes.description: True if freight cost is already rolled into the total cost.
attributes.references: Indicates whether freight is already included in total cost

attributes.name: is_tax_included
attributes.description: True if applicable taxes are included in the total cost.
attributes.references: Indicates whether tax is already included in total cost

attributes.name: landed_cost
attributes.description: Total cost after adding freight, duties, taxes, and other landed‑cost items.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or process that last updated the cost record.
attributes.references: User who performed the last update

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the cost record.

attributes.name: margin_impact_flag
attributes.description: True if the cost change is expected to affect gross margin reporting.
attributes.references: Flag indicating impact on gross margin calculations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments or observations about the cost record.
attributes.references: Free‑form notes from finance or procurement

attributes.name: original_cost
attributes.description: Cost value prior to the most recent change, retained for audit trail.
attributes.references: Previous cost before the current change

attributes.name: price_optimization_flag
attributes.description: True if this cost record should be considered by automated price‑optimization algorithms.
attributes.references: Flag indicating inclusion in price optimization runs

attributes.name: retail_price_action_flag
attributes.description: True if the cost change triggers an automatic retail price update.
attributes.references: Flag indicating downstream retail price action

attributes.name: source_document_date
attributes.description: Date of the vendor invoice or contract that provided the cost data.
attributes.references: Date on the source vendor document

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor invoice or contract supporting the cost.
attributes.references: Vendor invoice number that sourced the cost

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Aggregated cost (base + allowances + freight + landed) that serves as the cost basis for GMROI and margin analysis.
attributes.references: Total cost used for margin calculations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or process that created the cost record.

products.name: optimization_run
products.description: Operational record of each price optimization algorithm execution, its configuration, and its resulting SKU-level price recommendations. Captures run date, model version, category or department scope, constraint set applied (referencing price_rule), number of SKUs evaluated, acceptance rate, estimated revenue and margin impact, and run status. Contains line-item recommendations per SKU including recommended price, current price, expected margin impact, expected unit velocity change, confidence score, recommendation status (pending, accepted, rejected, overridden), reviewer ID, and override reason. domains.name: assortment
domains.description: Merchandise planning, category management, product assortment optimization, and planogram execution. Manages space allocation, facings, new item introductions, SKU rationalization, and localized assortments by store cluster. Supports seasonal planning and category captain collaboration.

products.name: category
products.description: Master hierarchy of merchandise categories used for assortment planning and category management. Represents the full category tree from department down to sub-category level (e.g., Grocery > Dairy > Yogurt). Owned by the assortment domain as the SSOT for category structure. Includes category captain designation, GMROI targets, space allocation norms, and seasonal planning flags. Aligns with Oracle Retail Merchandising System item hierarchy.

attributes.name: parent_category_id

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Hierarchy

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: average_shelf_life_days

attributes.name: category_code

attributes.name: category_description

attributes.name: category_type

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Hierarchy

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: dsd_eligible_flag

attributes.name: temperature_zone
