products.name: planogram
products.description: Visual merchandise display plan defining the exact placement, facings, and shelf positions of SKUs within a store fixture or gondola section. Captures planogram version, effective dates, fixture type, total shelf capacity, and compliance status. Includes position-level detail: individual SKU slots with shelf number, bay number, facing count, capacity, and display orientation for each product placement. Source of truth for space planning and shelf execution. Derived from Oracle Retail and space planning tools (e.g., Blue Yonder, JDA).

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the planogram. Primary key for the planogram data product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category this planogram represents. Links to the product category hierarchy for assortment planning and category management.

attributes.name: planogram_approved_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or category manager who approved this planogram for deployment. Supports governance and approval workflow tracking.

attributes.name: planogram_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or space planner who created this planogram. Supports accountability and workflow tracking.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster or format group this planogram is designed for. Enables localized assortments by store type, size, or demographic profile.

attributes.name: subcategory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise subcategory within the broader category. Provides finer-grained classification for space allocation and assortment optimization.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this planogram was approved. Captures approval event in the planogram lifecycle for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether strict compliance to this planogram is mandatory. True for corporate-mandated sets, false for suggested guidelines. Drives store execution accountability.

attributes.name: compliance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable variance percentage from the planogram specification before a store is considered non-compliant. Used for compliance scoring and audit thresholds.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this planogram record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this planogram is scheduled to be replaced or retired. Nullable for open-ended planograms. Supports lifecycle management and reset planning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this planogram becomes active and should be implemented in stores. Supports seasonal resets and promotional timing.

attributes.name: estimated_weekly_sales_amount
attributes.description: Projected weekly sales revenue in dollars for all SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) in this planogram. Supports space-to-sales ratio analysis and fixture ROI evaluation.

attributes.name: estimated_weekly_sales_units
attributes.description: Projected weekly sales volume in units for all SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) in this planogram. Used for space productivity forecasting and GMROI (Gross Margin Return on Investment) analysis.

attributes.name: fixture_depth_inches
attributes.description: Total depth of the fixture in inches. Constrains product depth and facing orientation for shelf placement.

attributes.name: fixture_height_inches
attributes.description: Total height of the fixture in inches. Determines vertical space available for product placement and shelf allocation.

attributes.name: fixture_type
attributes.description: Type of physical store fixture or display unit this planogram is designed for. Gondola for standard aisle shelving units, cooler for refrigerated cases, freezer for frozen food cases, pallet for floor stacks, display rack for specialty merchandisers, pegboard for hanging items, shelf for general shelving. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gondola|endcap|cooler|freezer|pallet|display_rack|pegboard|shelf — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fixture_width_inches
attributes.description: Total width of the fixture in inches. Critical dimension for space planning and ensuring planogram fits physical store layout.

attributes.name: image_url
attributes.description: URL (Uniform Resource Locator) or file path to the visual rendering or photograph of the planogram. Provides reference image for store teams during reset execution.

attributes.name: layout_orientation
attributes.description: Primary orientation of product placement within the planogram. Horizontal for side-by-side shelf arrangements, vertical for top-to-bottom brand blocking, mixed for combination layouts.

attributes.name: merchandising_strategy
attributes.description: Primary merchandising strategy applied in this planogram. Brand blocking groups products by manufacturer, price point arranges by cost tiers, size progression orders by package size, color blocking groups by visual appeal, cross merchandising combines complementary categories.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this planogram record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and version control.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions for store execution teams. May include setup guidance, display requirements, or merchandising tips for implementing the planogram.

attributes.name: planogram_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the planogram, typically describing the category, fixture, or section it represents (e.g., 'Cereal Aisle Endcap Q1 2024').

attributes.name: planogram_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the planogram, typically used in space planning systems and store communications. Externally-known unique code for this visual merchandise display plan.

attributes.name: planogram_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planogram. Draft indicates work-in-progress, approved indicates ready for deployment, active indicates currently in use in stores, inactive indicates temporarily suspended, archived indicates historical record.

attributes.name: planogram_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planogram by merchandising purpose. Standard for regular shelf sets, promotional for temporary displays, seasonal for holiday or seasonal merchandise, endcap for end-of-aisle displays, power aisle for high-traffic promotional zones, checkout for point-of-sale impulse areas.

attributes.name: private_label_facing_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total facings allocated to private label or store-owned brand products. Key metric for private label penetration and margin optimization strategy.

attributes.name: space_planning_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier or code from the source space planning system (e.g., Blue Yonder, JDA, Oracle Retail) where this planogram was designed. Supports system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: total_capacity_units
attributes.description: Total product capacity of the fixture in units, summing all SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) positions and depths. Represents maximum inventory that can be displayed on the fixture at full stock.

attributes.name: total_facing_count
attributes.description: Total number of product facings (product fronts visible to shoppers) across all shelves in this planogram. Key metric for space productivity and SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) representation.

attributes.name: total_shelf_count
attributes.description: Total number of shelves or levels within the fixture. Used for vertical space allocation and capacity planning.

attributes.name: total_sku_count
attributes.description: Total number of unique SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) included in this planogram. Measures assortment breadth and variety for the fixture.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the planogram, incremented with each revision. Supports change tracking and rollback capabilities for space planning iterations.

products.name: assortment_plan
products.description: Merchandise assortment plan defining the approved set of SKUs for a category within a store cluster or banner for a planning period. Captures plan name, planning horizon (season/quarter/year), target SKU count, space allocation in linear feet, GMROI target, sales plan, and approval status. Created during merchandise planning cycles in Oracle Retail Merchandising System.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchandise assortment plan. Primary key for the assortment plan entity.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the merchandise category this assortment plan covers (e.g., Fresh Produce, Dairy, Bakery, Private Label Snacks).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the visual merchandise display plan (planogram) that defines shelf layout and product placement for this assortment plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Planogram Management

attributes.name: primary_assortment_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the merchandise planning manager or director who approved this assortment plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - User Management

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the store cluster or banner this assortment plan applies to. Store clusters group locations with similar demographics, size, and customer preferences for localized assortment optimization.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Allocation Module

attributes.name: tertiary_assortment_buyer_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the buyer responsible for procurement and vendor negotiations for SKUs in this assortment plan.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - User Management

attributes.name: actual_sku_count
attributes.description: Actual number of unique SKUs approved and included in the final assortment plan after merchandise planning review.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the assortment plan was approved by merchandise planning leadership and authorized for execution.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: assortment_strategy
attributes.description: Strategic approach for this assortment plan: broad (wide variety), focused (narrow depth), premium (high-end), value (price-focused), seasonal (time-limited), or promotional (event-driven).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: cost_plan_amount
attributes.description: Planned cost of goods sold (COGS) for this assortment plan during the planning period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment plan record was first created in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Audit Trail

attributes.name: discontinued_item_count
attributes.description: Number of SKUs being discontinued or removed from the assortment compared to the previous planning period.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment plan expires and transitions to the next planning period. Nullable for open-ended plans.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment plan becomes active and the approved SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) set should be available in stores.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter within the fiscal year for quarterly assortment plans (1, 2, 3, or 4).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this assortment plan is effective.

attributes.name: gmroi_target

attributes.name: inventory_investment_plan

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment plan record was last updated in the Oracle Retail Merchandising System.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Audit Trail

attributes.name: localization_level
attributes.description: Geographic granularity of this assortment plan: national (all stores), regional (multi-state), cluster (store groups), or store (individual location).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: margin_plan_amount
attributes.description: Planned gross margin (sales minus cost) for this assortment plan during the planning period.

attributes.name: margin_plan_percent
attributes.description: Planned gross margin percentage (margin divided by sales) target for this assortment plan.

attributes.name: new_item_count
attributes.description: Number of new SKUs being introduced in this assortment plan that were not in the previous period's assortment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the assortment plan, including strategic rationale, market conditions, competitive considerations, and special instructions.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the assortment plan used for external reference and reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning Module

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for the assortment plan, typically including category and season identifiers (e.g., 'Spring 2024 Fresh Produce Assortment').

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assortment plan: draft (being created), in_review (under merchandise planning review), approved (ready for execution), active (currently in effect), completed (planning period ended), or cancelled (plan abandoned).

attributes.name: planning_period_type

attributes.name: planning_season

attributes.name: private_label_sales_plan_percent

attributes.name: private_label_sku_count

attributes.name: sales_plan_amount

attributes.name: space_allocation_linear_feet
attributes.description: Total shelf space allocated to this assortment plan measured in linear feet. Used for planogram execution and space productivity analysis.

attributes.name: target_sku_count
attributes.description: Planned number of unique SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) to be carried in this assortment plan. Used for SKU rationalization and space planning.

attributes.name: total_facings

attributes.name: turn_rate_target

products.name: assortment_item
products.description: Individual SKU included in an approved assortment plan, representing both standard plan items and localized overrides at the store-cluster or individual-store level. Captures SKU/GTIN, inclusion status (active, discontinued, new, localized-add, localized-remove), merchandising role (core, seasonal, local, ethnic, private-label), minimum facings, recommended shelf position, effective date range, override justification, and localization source (demographic demand, local supplier, store format). Serves as the single line-level detail record for all assortment decisions including hyper-local merchandising strategies, SKU rationalization outputs, and new item introduction placements.

attributes.name: assortment_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the assortment item record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assortment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent assortment plan that this item belongs to. Links this SKU inclusion decision to the broader merchandise planning strategy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise category this item belongs to. Links assortment decisions to category management strategies and category captain collaboration.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planogram that defines the physical shelf layout for this assortment item. Links assortment strategy to visual merchandising execution.

attributes.name: product_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product record in the product domain. Links assortment decisions to full product master data including descriptions, attributes, and hierarchy.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store cluster for which this assortment item is defined. Enables localized assortment strategies by grouping stores with similar demographics, format, or demand patterns.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to an individual store for store-specific assortment overrides. Null when the item applies to the entire cluster; populated for hyper-local exceptions.

attributes.name: subcategory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchandise subcategory for finer-grained assortment segmentation. Enables detailed space allocation and assortment breadth analysis within categories.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Category Hierarchy

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor or supplier for this SKU. Supports vendor assortment analysis, category captain collaboration, and DSD item management.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment item was approved for inclusion in the plan. Tracks decision timing and supports audit trails for assortment changes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the merchandising manager or category manager who approved this assortment item inclusion. Supports governance and accountability for assortment decisions.

attributes.name: assortment_tier
attributes.description: Strategic importance tier of this SKU within the assortment. Defines priority for space allocation, inventory investment, and promotional support.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name of the product included in the assortment. Enables brand-level assortment analysis, private-label vs national-brand mix reporting, and brand performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment item record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment item is discontinued or removed from the plan. Null for ongoing items. Enables SKU rationalization, seasonal exits, and planned discontinuations.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment item becomes active and should be carried in stores. Supports phased rollouts, seasonal transitions, and new item introduction timing.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Effective Dating

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global trade item number (UPC, EAN, or GTIN-14) for the product. Enables cross-enterprise product identification and EDI transactions with suppliers.

attributes.name: inclusion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this SKU within the assortment plan. Indicates whether the item is actively carried, newly introduced, discontinued, or represents a localized override decision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|discontinued|new|localized_add|localized_remove|pending|seasonal_inactive — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Lifecycle

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first introduced into the assortment. Enables new item maturity analysis and time-to-productivity measurement.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this assortment item was last reviewed for performance and continued inclusion. Supports ongoing assortment optimization and ensures regular evaluation cycles.

attributes.name: localization_source
attributes.description: Primary driver for localized assortment decision. Identifies the business factor that triggered inclusion or exclusion of this SKU at the local level. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: demographic_demand|local_supplier|store_format|competitive_response|customer_request|test_market|ethnic_community — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: merchandising_role
attributes.description: Strategic role this SKU plays in the assortment. Defines whether the item is a core year-round offering, seasonal rotation, localized for demographic demand, ethnic specialty, private-label brand, promotional driver, or test item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|seasonal|local|ethnic|private_label|promotional|test — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: minimum_facings
attributes.description: Minimum number of product facings (front-facing units on shelf) required for this SKU. Drives planogram execution and ensures adequate shelf presence for sales velocity and customer visibility.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assortment item record was last modified. Tracks changes to assortment decisions and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: new_item_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a new item introduction within the current planning cycle. Supports new item performance tracking and innovation pipeline management.

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assortment item represents a localized override to the standard cluster plan. True when a store or sub-cluster has deviated from the base assortment strategy.

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale for localized assortment override. Captures the reason for deviation from standard plan such as demographic demand, competitive response, local supplier availability, or store format requirements.

attributes.name: private_label_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a store-owned private-label brand product. Supports private-label penetration analysis and margin optimization strategies.

attributes.name: rationalization_candidate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU has been identified as a candidate for removal during SKU rationalization analysis. Flags underperforming items for review and potential discontinuation.

attributes.name: rationalization_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason this SKU is flagged for rationalization. Captures the business driver for potential discontinuation such as poor sales velocity, margin erosion, or assortment duplication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: low_sales|low_margin|duplication|supplier_exit|quality_issues|regulatory|space_optimization — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recommended_facings
attributes.description: Optimal number of facings recommended by space planning algorithms based on sales velocity, margin, and shelf capacity. Guides planogram design and space allocation decisions.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Seasonal period or event this SKU is associated with. Enables seasonal assortment transitions, promotional calendar alignment, and year-over-year seasonal performance comparison. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spring|summer|fall|winter|holiday|back_to_school|easter|fourth_of_july — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a seasonal item with recurring annual availability windows. Supports seasonal planning, space resets, and inventory flow management.

attributes.name: shelf_position_code
attributes.description: Recommended shelf position or merchandising location for this SKU. Indicates optimal vertical and horizontal placement to maximize visibility, accessibility, and sales performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eye_level|reach_level|stoop_level|endcap|gondola_end|power_aisle|checkout — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Internal stock keeping unit identifier for the product included in this assortment. The unique item-level identifier used across merchandising, inventory, and POS systems.

attributes.name: space_allocation_linear_feet
attributes.description: Allocated shelf space for this SKU measured in linear feet. Drives planogram design and ensures space allocation aligns with sales velocity and strategic importance.

products.name: store_cluster
products.description: Grouping of stores with similar demographic, geographic, volume, or format characteristics used to define localized assortments and targeted planogram assignments. Captures cluster name, cluster type (demographic, volume, format, geographic, competitive), number of member stores, store membership list with effective dating, clustering methodology version, refresh frequency, and effective date range. Enables differentiated assortment strategies by market segment. Managed within Oracle Retail and Blue Yonder category management tools.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the store cluster. Primary key.

attributes.name: assortment_depth_strategy
attributes.description: Strategic approach to SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) selection and variety within categories for this cluster. Narrow-deep offers fewer brands with more sizes/flavors; broad-shallow offers many brands with limited variety per brand.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Assortment Planning

attributes.name: average_store_size_sqft
attributes.description: Mean selling square footage of stores in this cluster. Used for space planning and planogram capacity estimation.

attributes.name: average_weekly_sales
attributes.description: Mean weekly sales volume across stores in this cluster. Used for volume-based assortment planning and inventory allocation. Business-sensitive financial metric.

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Predominant climate classification for the cluster geography. Influences seasonal assortment planning for weather-dependent categories such as beverages, apparel, and outdoor products.

attributes.name: cluster_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the store cluster used in merchandising and planning systems. Externally visible identifier used in Oracle Retail and Blue Yonder systems.

attributes.name: cluster_manager_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the cluster manager for operational communication and escalation. Business-confidential contact information.

attributes.name: cluster_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the category manager or merchandising leader responsible for assortment strategy and performance for this cluster.

attributes.name: cluster_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the store cluster for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: cluster_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the store cluster. Active clusters are in use for assortment planning, inactive clusters are temporarily disabled, pending clusters are under review, and archived clusters are historical.

attributes.name: cluster_type
attributes.description: Classification of the clustering methodology used to group stores. Demographic clusters group by customer profile, volume clusters by sales tier, format clusters by store size/layout, geographic clusters by region, competitive clusters by market dynamics, and hybrid clusters use multiple factors.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Cluster Management

attributes.name: clustering_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the analytical approach and business rules used to define cluster membership. May reference statistical models, business criteria, or hybrid approaches.

attributes.name: competitive_intensity
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure in the markets served by this cluster. High-intensity clusters may require more aggressive promotional assortments and pricing strategies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store cluster record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this cluster definition was retired or superseded. Null for currently active clusters. Enables historical cluster analysis and transition tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this cluster definition became active and available for assortment planning and planogram assignment. Supports temporal analysis and historical reporting.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or market area covered by stores in this cluster. Supports regional assortment localization and distribution planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this store cluster record was most recently updated. Enables change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: last_refresh_date
attributes.description: Date when the cluster definition and membership were last recalculated or reviewed. Used to track data freshness and trigger next refresh cycle.

attributes.name: localization_level
attributes.description: Degree of assortment customization applied to this cluster. National clusters use standard assortments; hyper-local clusters have highly tailored selections reflecting unique community preferences.

attributes.name: member_store_count
attributes.description: Total number of stores currently assigned to this cluster. Used for assortment scale planning and distribution allocation.

attributes.name: methodology_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the clustering algorithm or business rules applied. Enables tracking of methodology changes over time and impact analysis.

attributes.name: new_item_introduction_priority
attributes.description: Sequencing priority for rolling out new SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) to stores in this cluster. First-wave clusters receive new items earliest; test-only clusters are used for market testing before broader rollout.

attributes.name: next_refresh_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next cluster review and update cycle. Supports proactive planning and resource allocation for cluster maintenance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special considerations, or strategic rationale for cluster definition and management. Supports knowledge transfer and decision documentation.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification based on sales productivity, profitability, and strategic importance. Platinum and gold tiers receive priority for new item introductions and promotional support.

attributes.name: planogram_template_set
attributes.description: Reference to the collection of planogram (visual merchandise display plan) templates assigned to this cluster. Links cluster to specific shelf layout and facing strategies.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Category Management - Planogram Management

attributes.name: primary_category_focus
attributes.description: Dominant merchandise categories or departments emphasized in this cluster's assortment strategy, such as fresh produce, organic, ethnic foods, or premium selections.

attributes.name: primary_demographic_profile
attributes.description: Dominant customer demographic characteristics of stores in this cluster, such as income level, household composition, age distribution, or ethnicity mix. Used for targeted assortment selection.

attributes.name: private_label_penetration_target
attributes.description: Target percentage of sales from private-label (store-owned brand) products for this cluster. Used to guide assortment mix and shelf space allocation decisions.

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which cluster membership and definitions are reviewed and updated. Aligns with merchandise planning cycles and seasonal resets.

attributes.name: seasonal_reset_schedule
attributes.description: Timing and frequency of major seasonal assortment resets and planogram changes for this cluster. Aligns with holiday periods, weather transitions, and promotional calendars.

attributes.name: sku_rationalization_score
attributes.description: Metric indicating the degree of SKU optimization and elimination of low-performing items in this cluster. Higher scores indicate more streamlined, efficient assortments.

attributes.name: store_format_mix
attributes.description: Distribution of store formats within the cluster, such as supermarket, hypermarket, convenience, or specialty formats. Informs format-specific assortment strategies.

products.name: new_item_intro
products.description: New item introduction record tracking the lifecycle of a new SKU from vendor submission through category review, buyer approval, planogram slotting, and first store receipt. Captures item name, UPC/GTIN, vendor, category, slotting fee amount, target launch date, first ship date, initial order quantity, and introduction status. Supports private-label and CPG new item workflows.

attributes.name: new_item_intro_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the new item introduction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the category buyer responsible for reviewing and approving the new item introduction.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise category to which the new item belongs.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planogram where the new item has been assigned shelf space and facings.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store cluster or group where the new item will be introduced, supporting localized assortment strategies.

attributes.name: subcategory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise subcategory for more granular classification of the new item.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier submitting the new item for introduction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the category buyer or category captain approved the new item for introduction.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name of the new item, which may be a national brand or private label.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of individual units contained in one case for distribution center handling.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The wholesale cost per unit that the retailer will pay to the vendor for the new item.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the new item introduction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: expected_annual_sales_units
attributes.description: Forecasted number of units expected to be sold annually for the new item, used for planning and performance tracking.

attributes.name: expected_gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Projected gross margin percentage for the new item, calculated as (retail price - cost) / retail price * 100.

attributes.name: first_receipt_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the first shipment of the new item was received at a store or distribution center.

attributes.name: first_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the first shipment of the new item was sent from the vendor or distribution center.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: 14-digit Global Trade Item Number for global supply chain identification of the new item.

attributes.name: initial_order_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units ordered for the initial stocking of the new item across the distribution network.

attributes.name: introduction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the new item introduction process from vendor submission through store activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|planogram_assigned|in_transit|received|active — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new item has USDA organic certification (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new item is a store-owned private label brand (True) or a national/CPG brand (False).

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new item is a seasonal product (True) or a year-round item (False).

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the new item including features, ingredients, or specifications.

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: The marketing name or product title of the new item being introduced.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the new item introduction record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: number_of_facings
attributes.description: The number of product fronts allocated to the new item on the shelf for visibility and inventory capacity.

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The size or quantity of the item package (e.g., 16 oz, 500 ml, 12 count).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a new item introduction is rejected, including business rationale.

attributes.name: requires_refrigeration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the new item requires cold chain temperature-controlled storage and handling (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the category review process was completed and a decision was made on the new item.

attributes.name: review_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the category review process began for the new item introduction.

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: The seasonal period or event associated with the new item introduction if it is a seasonal product.

attributes.name: shelf_position
attributes.description: Specific shelf location assigned to the new item within the planogram (e.g., aisle, shelf level, position).

attributes.name: slotting_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee paid by the vendor to secure shelf space and distribution for the new item.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor submitted the new item introduction request to the retailer for review.

attributes.name: suggested_retail_price
attributes.description: Vendor-recommended retail price for the new item at point of sale.

attributes.name: target_launch_date
attributes.description: Planned date when the new item should be available for sale in stores.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for ordering and inventory management of the new item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|pack — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code assigned to the new item for point-of-sale scanning.

products.name: sku_rationalization
products.description: SKU rationalization event record capturing the business decision to discontinue, consolidate, or replace a SKU within a category. Captures the rationalization reason (low velocity, duplication, space optimization, vendor change), affected SKU list, replacement SKU, effective discontinuation date, and disposition instructions (markdown, return to vendor, donate). Supports category captain collaboration and space reallocation.

attributes.name: sku_rationalization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU rationalization event record.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product category within which this SKU rationalization is occurring.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: primary_affected_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary SKU being discontinued, consolidated, or replaced in this rationalization event.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: primary_sku_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or role who provided final approval for the rationalization decision, supporting audit and accountability requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: subcategory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product subcategory for more granular classification of the rationalization scope.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: tertiary_sku_last_modified_by_user_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who most recently updated the rationalization event record.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: affected_sku_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SKU being rationalized for business user reference.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: affected_sku_upc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Universal Product Code (UPC)
attributes.description: The UPC barcode of the SKU being rationalized, used for cross-reference and validation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the rationalization decision within the governance workflow: draft (initial proposal), pending_review (awaiting stakeholder review), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (not approved), implemented (executed in systems), or cancelled (decision reversed).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the rationalization decision was formally approved, marking the transition to implementation phase.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rationalization event record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: disposition_instruction
attributes.description: The prescribed method for handling remaining inventory of the affected SKU: markdown (price reduction for clearance sale), return_to_vendor (send back to supplier), donate (charitable contribution), destroy (disposal for safety or quality reasons), transfer (move to other locations), or liquidate (sell through third-party channels).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: effective_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the affected SKU will be officially discontinued from the assortment and removed from active ordering and replenishment.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: estimated_inventory_units
attributes.description: The estimated total number of units of the affected SKU remaining in inventory across all locations at the time of rationalization decision.

attributes.name: estimated_inventory_value_amount
attributes.description: The estimated total dollar value of remaining inventory for the affected SKU at cost, used for financial impact analysis.

attributes.name: facings_released
attributes.description: The number of product facings (front-facing positions on shelf) being released by the discontinuation of the affected SKU, available for reallocation to other items.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated financial impact of the rationalization decision, including potential write-offs, markdown costs, or savings from improved space productivity.

attributes.name: implementation_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rationalization was fully implemented across all affected systems, stores, and processes.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: The current status of rationalization implementation across systems and stores: not_started (approved but not yet begun), in_progress (actively executing), completed (fully implemented), on_hold (temporarily paused), or failed (implementation encountered errors).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: last_delivery_date
attributes.description: The final date by which deliveries of the affected SKU will be accepted at stores or distribution centers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rationalization event record was most recently updated.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The final date by which stores or distribution centers can place orders for the affected SKU before it is removed from ordering systems.

attributes.name: markdown_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage price reduction to be applied if the disposition instruction is markdown, used to accelerate sell-through of remaining inventory.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Price Management

attributes.name: planogram_update_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether planogram updates are required as a result of this rationalization to reflect the removal of the affected SKU and any space reallocation.

attributes.name: planogram_version_number
attributes.description: The version number of the planogram that will incorporate this rationalization change, used for tracking and implementation coordination.

attributes.name: rationalization_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the rationalization event, used for tracking and reference in category management systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: rationalization_reason
attributes.description: The primary business reason driving the SKU rationalization decision: low sales velocity, product duplication, shelf space optimization needs, vendor relationship changes, margin improvement initiatives, quality or safety issues, regulatory compliance requirements, end of seasonal period, introduction of private label alternative, or broader category reset strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: low_velocity|duplication|space_optimization|vendor_change|margin_improvement|quality_issue|regulatory_compliance|seasonal_end|private_label_introduction|category_reset — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: rationalization_reason_detail
attributes.description: Additional narrative detail explaining the specific circumstances and business justification for the rationalization decision.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: rationalization_type
attributes.description: The type of rationalization action being taken: discontinue (remove without replacement), consolidate (merge with another SKU), replace (substitute with new SKU), phase_out (gradual removal), or delist (remove from assortment).
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: replacement_sku_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the replacement SKU for business user reference and communication.
attributes.references: Oracle Retail Merchandising System - Item Management

attributes.name: replacement_sku_upc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Replacement Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Universal Product Code (UPC)
attributes.description: The UPC barcode of the replacement SKU for cross-reference and planogram updates.

attributes.name: space_reallocation_plan
attributes.description: Description of how the shelf space previously occupied by the affected SKU will be reallocated, including which SKUs will receive additional facings or whether the space will be used for new item introductions.

attributes.name: store_cluster_scope
attributes.description: The store cluster or grouping to which this rationalization applies, enabling localized assortment decisions based on store demographics and performance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all_stores|cluster_a|cluster_b|cluster_c|cluster_d|regional|test_stores — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the affected SKU vendor was formally notified of the rationalization decision, important for vendor relationship management and contractual obligations.

products.name: space_allocation
products.description: Space allocation record defining the approved linear footage, shelf count, square footage, and display assignments for a category or sub-category within a store or store cluster. Covers all fixture types including gondola sections, endcaps (end-of-aisle displays), coolers, freezer cases, and promotional displays. Captures allocated linear feet, number of shelves, gondola sections, endcap position assignments (featured SKU/category, assignment dates, promotional tie-in), fixture type, seasonal space adjustments, vendor-funded indicators, and effective date ranges. Drives planogram development, category space productivity (GMROI per linear foot) analysis, and high-visibility promotional display management including endcap rotation scheduling.

attributes.name: space_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the space allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the space allocation. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planogram (visual merchandise display plan) that implements this space allocation. Links to the planogram master data.

attributes.name: primary_space_category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the product category for which space is allocated. Links to the product category hierarchy.

attributes.name: store_cluster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store cluster (group of stores with similar characteristics) to which this space allocation applies. Used for localized assortment planning.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store to which this space allocation applies. Links to the store master data.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor funding or sponsoring the space allocation. Applicable when vendor_funded_flag is true. Links to vendor master data.

attributes.name: aisle_number
attributes.description: Aisle number within the store where the space allocation is located. Used for store navigation, planogram execution, and space mapping.

attributes.name: allocation_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the space allocation record. Used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the space allocation. High-priority allocations receive preferential space and visibility (e.g., high-margin categories, promotional items). Used for space optimization and conflict resolution.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the space allocation. Indicates whether the allocation is in planning, approved for execution, actively in use, temporarily suspended, expired, or cancelled.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the space allocation was approved. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: bay_number
attributes.description: Bay or section number within the aisle where the space allocation is located. Provides precise fixture location for planogram execution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the space allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the space allocation expires or is scheduled to be replaced. Nullable for open-ended allocations. Used for endcap rotation scheduling and seasonal space adjustments.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the space allocation becomes active and effective. Used for planogram execution scheduling and space transition planning.

attributes.name: endcap_position
attributes.description: Physical position of the endcap display within the store. Endcaps are high-visibility promotional displays at the end of aisles. Position affects traffic flow and sales lift. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: front_left|front_right|mid_left|mid_right|back_left|back_right|not_applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: facing_count
attributes.description: Total number of product facings (product fronts visible on shelf) allocated to the category or sub-category. Determines SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) capacity and visual merchandising impact.

attributes.name: featured_sku
attributes.description: Primary SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) featured in the endcap or promotional display. Used for endcap rotation scheduling and promotional tie-in tracking.

attributes.name: fixture_type
attributes.description: Type of store fixture to which space is allocated. Includes gondola sections (standard shelving units in store aisles), endcaps (end-of-aisle displays), coolers, freezer cases, promotional displays, pallet displays, power aisles, and checkout lanes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gondola|endcap|cooler|freezer|promotional_display|pallet_display|power_aisle|checkout_lane — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gondola_section_count
attributes.description: Number of gondola sections (standard 4-foot shelving units) allocated to the category or sub-category. Used for planogram development and space planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

products.name: planogram_compliance
products.description: Planogram execution and compliance lifecycle record capturing the full cycle from reset scheduling through execution to compliance audit at the store level. For resets: records scheduled reset date, store, category, planogram version being implemented, assigned reset crew, estimated labor hours, completion status, and post-reset verification. For compliance audits: records audit date, auditor (associate or automated image-recognition scan), compliance score percentage, out-of-position items, missing facings, unauthorized substitutions, and corrective action requirements. Supports store operations scheduling, planogram version control, labor planning for resets, and accountability for shelf execution standards.

attributes.name: assigned_crew_associate_id

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the associate or system that performed the compliance audit.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the merchandise category covered by this planogram reset or audit.

attributes.name: fixture_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the gondola (shelving unit) where the planogram reset or audit occurred.

attributes.name: planogram_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the planogram version being implemented or audited.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: REQUIRED: Planogram compliance audits are executed according to a defined compliance program; linking enables program‑based compliance score aggregation.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store where the planogram reset or compliance audit occurred.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours

attributes.name: aisle_number

attributes.name: compliance_score_percentage

attributes.name: corrective_action_description

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planogram compliance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: endcap_flag

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours

attributes.name: event_date

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of planogram compliance event: reset (initial implementation), audit (scheduled compliance check), or verification (post-reset validation).

attributes.name: missing_facing_count
attributes.description: Number of facings that were specified in the planogram but not present on the shelf during the audit.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, observations, or issues encountered during the reset or audit.

attributes.name: out_of_position_count
attributes.description: Number of SKUs (Stock Keeping Units) found in incorrect shelf positions during the audit.

attributes.name: planogram_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planogram compliance event.

attributes.name: planogram_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the planogram being implemented or audited, supporting version control and change tracking.

attributes.name: reset_type
attributes.description: Type of planogram reset: full (complete category reset), partial (minor adjustments), seasonal (seasonal merchandise change), or promotional (temporary promotional display).

attributes.name: section_number

attributes.name: verification_status

products.name: assortment_category_captain

Captures vendor name, category, appointment start and end dates, collaboration scope, slotting fee arrangement, and performance review schedule. Owned by the assortment domain (not vendor domain) because the captain relationship is defined by and serves the retailer's category management process — the vendor domain owns vendor master data, while this domain owns the strategic partnership assignment that drives assortment decisions.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days

products.name: slotting_fee
products.description: Slotting fee agreement record capturing the payment made by a vendor for shelf space allocation for a new or existing SKU. Captures vendor, SKU/GTIN, fee amount, payment terms, effective date range, store or cluster scope, and fee type (new item, reset, endcap, promotional display). Owned by the assortment domain (not vendor or finance domain) because slotting fees are a space-management instrument — they fund and justify shelf placement decisions within category management. Supports vendor financial reconciliation and category profitability tracking.
products.reference: Slotting Fee (Vendor Payment for Shelf Space)
