attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the settlement batch record. Primary key for the settlement batch entity.

attributes.name: gateway_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment gateway or processor that handled the transactions in this batch. Used for gateway-specific reconciliation and fee analysis.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the payment transactions in this batch originated. Links to the store master for location-based settlement analysis.

attributes.name: acquirer_batch_reference
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the acquiring bank to this settlement batch. Used for cross-referencing with bank statements and acquirer reports.

attributes.name: batch_close_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch was closed and no additional transactions were accepted. Triggers batch submission workflow.

attributes.name: batch_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the settlement batch was created and transactions were grouped for submission to the acquiring bank.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the settlement batch assigned by the payment gateway or acquiring bank. Used for reconciliation and reference in financial systems.

attributes.name: batch_open_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch was opened and began accepting transactions for grouping.

attributes.name: batch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the settlement batch indicating its position in the settlement workflow from creation through funding.

attributes.name: batch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement batch based on processing priority and submission method. Impacts funding timeline and processing fees.

attributes.name: chargeback_count
attributes.description: Number of chargeback transactions included in this settlement batch that reduce the net settlement amount due to disputed charges.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch record was first created in the payment system.

attributes.name: ecommerce_transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of online digital commerce transactions included in this settlement batch. Used for channel-specific settlement analysis.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of transactions in this batch that were flagged with exceptions, disputes, or exclusions from settlement. Used for exception management and quality monitoring.

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of fuel center payment transactions included in this settlement batch. Used for fuel operations settlement analysis.

attributes.name: funding_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the net settlement amount is expected to be deposited into the merchant bank account. Critical for cash flow forecasting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number assigned to the journal entry created for this settlement batch. Used for financial audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the settlement batch financial entries are posted to the general ledger in SAP FI for financial reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch record was last updated. Used for tracking batch lifecycle changes and audit trail.

attributes.name: merchant_account_number
attributes.description: The merchant bank account number to which the net settlement amount will be deposited. Used for bank reconciliation and funding verification.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Net amount to be funded to the merchant account after deduction of all interchange fees, assessment fees, and gateway processing fees from the total batch amount.

attributes.name: pharmacy_transaction_count
attributes.description: Number of pharmacy prescription payment transactions included in this settlement batch. Used for pharmacy operations settlement analysis.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct POS terminals that contributed transactions to this settlement batch. Used for terminal-level settlement analysis.

attributes.name: processor_response_code
attributes.description: Response code returned by the payment processor or acquiring bank indicating acceptance or rejection of the settlement batch.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process comparing the settlement batch totals with bank statement deposits and SAP FI postings.

attributes.name: refund_count
attributes.description: Number of refund transactions included in this settlement batch that reduce the net settlement amount due to returned merchandise or cancelled orders.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the acquiring bank or processor when a settlement batch is rejected. Used for issue resolution and resubmission.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the settlement batch will be funded to the merchant bank account.

attributes.name: settlement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch was accepted and processed by the acquiring bank, confirming the batch for funding.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the settlement batch was submitted to the acquiring bank or payment processor for funding.

attributes.name: total_assessment_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total assessment fees charged by card networks (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) for all transactions in this batch. Used for network fee reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_batch_amount
attributes.description: Total gross transaction amount for all payments included in this settlement batch before deduction of interchange fees and assessments.

attributes.name: total_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of chargebacks processed in this settlement batch. Reduces the net settlement amount and indicates dispute activity.

attributes.name: total_interchange_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total interchange fees charged by card-issuing banks for all transactions in this batch. Key component of payment processing cost analysis.

attributes.name: total_refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of refunds processed in this settlement batch. Reduces the net settlement amount and impacts cash flow analysis.

attributes.name: total_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of payment transactions included in this settlement batch. Used for batch validation and reconciliation control totals.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between expected net settlement amount and actual funded amount. Non-zero values trigger variance investigation and resolution workflows.

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Master record for payment chargebacks and disputes initiated by cardholders or issuing banks against Grocery transactions, including supporting evidence submitted during representment. Captures chargeback lifecycle (reference_number, reason_code, dispute_amount, status through received/review/representment/resolution), card and issuer details, key dates (received, response_due, representment_deadline, resolution), financial impact, and evidence records (evidence_type, file_reference, submission_timestamp, evidence_status). Supports PCI DSS compliance, chargeback win-rate optimization, and financial loss management.

attributes.name: chargeback_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment chargeback record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or user responsible for managing and resolving this chargeback case.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment transaction that is being disputed.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order associated with the disputed payment transaction.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the disputed transaction occurred.

attributes.name: vendor_chargeback_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_chargeback. Business justification: Chargeback alignment: link payment‑side chargeback records to supplier‑side chargebacks for unified dispute tracking.

attributes.name: acquirer_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the acquiring bank or payment processor for tracking the chargeback.

attributes.name: card_last_four_digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card number for identification purposes, compliant with PCI DSS masking requirements.

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Type of payment card involved in the disputed transaction.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Internal case tracking number assigned by Grocery for chargeback management and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chargeback case through the dispute resolution process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|representment_submitted|won|lost|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was first created in the Grocery system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the dispute amount and fees.

attributes.name: customer_contacted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Grocery attempted to contact the cardholder to resolve the dispute before representment.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount being disputed by the cardholder, typically matching the original transaction amount.

attributes.name: dispute_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the chargeback type for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.name: evidence_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting evidence has been submitted to contest the chargeback.

attributes.name: fee
attributes.description: Administrative fee charged by the payment processor or card network for processing the chargeback.

attributes.name: fraud_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chargeback is classified as a fraud-related dispute.

attributes.name: issuing_bank_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the issuing bank, typically the Bank Identification Number (BIN) or Issuer Identification Number (IIN).

attributes.name: issuing_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution that issued the payment card and initiated the chargeback.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chargeback record was last updated, tracking the most recent change to case status or details.

attributes.name: net_financial_impact
attributes.description: Total financial impact to Grocery including dispute amount, fees, and any recovery, calculated as (dispute_amount + chargeback_fee - recovery_amount).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from chargeback analysts regarding case investigation, evidence, and resolution strategy.

attributes.name: original_authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code from the original payment transaction, used to match and validate the chargeback claim.

attributes.name: original_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the original payment transaction that is being disputed occurred.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code provided by the card network indicating the reason for the chargeback (e.g., fraud, authorization issue, processing error, cardholder dispute).
attributes.references: Visa Chargeback Reason Codes, Mastercard Chargeback Reason Codes

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the chargeback reason provided by the cardholder or issuing bank.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when Grocery was notified of the chargeback by the payment processor or acquiring bank.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the chargeback notification was received in Grocery systems.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered by Grocery if the chargeback was won or partially reversed.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the card issuer or payment network to identify this chargeback case.

attributes.name: representment_count
attributes.description: Number of times Grocery has submitted representment evidence for this chargeback case.

attributes.name: representment_deadline
attributes.description: Final deadline for submitting representment evidence as specified by the card network rules.

attributes.name: representment_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when Grocery submitted representment evidence to contest the chargeback.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the chargeback case was resolved with a final decision (won, lost, or withdrawn).

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the chargeback dispute indicating whether Grocery successfully defended the transaction.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the chargeback case reached final resolution.

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which Grocery must submit a response or representment to contest the chargeback.

products.name: refund
products.description: Transactional record of payment refunds issued to shoppers across all channels including in-store POS returns, eCommerce order cancellations, and pharmacy prescription reversals. Captures refund_type (full, partial, exchange), refund_status (pending, approved, processed, failed), original_transaction_id reference, refund_amount, refund_tender_type, refund_reason_code, refund_reason_description, initiated_by_channel, initiated_by_associate_id, approved_by_associate_id, refund_timestamp, return_to_original_tender_flag, store_credit_issued_flag, and store_credit_amount. Sourced from NCR POS returns workflow and Salesforce Commerce Cloud order management.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment refund transaction. Primary key for the payment_refund product.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order_line. Business justification: Supports line‑level refund tracking, tying each refund to the exact order line for inventory and financial adjustments.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures refund amounts are recorded against the appropriate GL account, needed for net revenue reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment transaction that is being refunded. Links to the source payment record in the payment transaction system.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order associated with this refund for in-store Point of Sale (POS) returns and eCommerce order cancellations.

attributes.name: refund_approved_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who approved the refund transaction when approval is required based on amount thresholds or policy rules. Null for auto-approved refunds. Links to workforce employee record.

attributes.name: refund_initiated_by_associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store associate or customer service representative who initiated the refund transaction. Null for customer self-service refunds. Links to workforce employee record.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the payment processor settlement batch that included this refund transaction. Used for reconciliation with payment gateway and bank settlement reports.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shopper receiving the refund. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the refund was initiated for in-store returns. Null for eCommerce refunds.

attributes.name: tender_type_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment tender type used for issuing the refund (credit card, debit card, Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT), store credit, cash, gift card). Links to tender_type reference table.

attributes.name: vendor_return_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_return. Business justification: Refund tracking: associate refunds issued to suppliers with the original vendor return for credit reconciliation.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount being refunded to the customer in the transaction currency, including product cost and applicable taxes. Does not include fees retained by the business.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by authorized personnel. Null for auto-approved refunds. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the payment processor or card network approving the refund transaction. Null for cash or store credit refunds.

attributes.name: chargeback_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund was issued in response to or in anticipation of a payment chargeback dispute. True if chargeback-related, False for standard customer-initiated returns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was first created in the data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the refund transaction. Typically USD for United States operations, CAD for Canada, MXN for Mexico.

attributes.name: ebt_snap_reversal_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Reversal Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund involves reversal of a Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) payment. True for SNAP EBT refunds which require special handling per USDA regulations, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fuel_rewards_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of fuel rewards points or discounts that were reversed or adjusted as part of this refund. Null if no fuel rewards impact. Used when refunded purchase had earned fuel center loyalty discounts.

attributes.name: gift_card_reissue_number
attributes.description: Gift card number issued to the customer as the refund method when original payment was gift card or when customer opted for gift card refund. Null if refund not issued as gift card.

attributes.name: initiated_by_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the refund was initiated. Point of Sale (POS) for in-store returns, ecommerce for online order cancellations, mobile_app for app-based returns, customer_service for call center initiated refunds, pharmacy for prescription reversals.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund request was first created in the system, before approval or processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this refund record was last updated in the data system. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_reversed
attributes.description: Number of customer loyalty program points that were deducted from the customers account due to this refund. Null if no loyalty points impact. Negative value indicates points removed.

attributes.name: payment_gateway_transaction_reference
attributes.description: External transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor for this refund. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution with payment networks.

attributes.name: prescription_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund represents a pharmacy prescription transaction reversal. True for pharmacy prescription refunds, False for retail merchandise refunds. Pharmacy refunds have additional Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance requirements.

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by payment processor or card network for processing the refund transaction. Represents cost to the business, not charged to customer. Null if no processing fee.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the business reason for the refund. DEFECTIVE indicates product quality issue, WRONG_ITEM indicates fulfillment error, NOT_AS_DESCRIBED indicates product mismatch with listing, CUSTOMER_REMORSE indicates buyer changed mind, DUPLICATE_ORDER indicates accidental repeat purchase, PRICING_ERROR indicates incorrect charge.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the refund reason provided by the associate or customer. Supplements the refund_reason_code with specific context.

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique refund transaction number displayed on customer receipts and used for customer service inquiries. Format: RFN followed by 10 digits.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction. Pending indicates awaiting approval, approved indicates authorized but not yet processed, processed indicates funds returned to customer, failed indicates processing error, cancelled indicates refund voided before processing, reversed indicates refund was clawed back.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund transaction was processed and funds were released back to the customer. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification of refund scope. Full indicates complete order/transaction refund, partial indicates refund of selected items or amount, exchange indicates refund paired with replacement purchase.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee deducted from the refund amount charged to the customer for restocking returned merchandise. Null if no restocking fee applied. Used for certain product categories per return policy.

attributes.name: return_to_original_tender_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refund was issued back to the original payment method used in the source transaction. True if refunded to original tender, False if refunded via alternative method such as store credit.

attributes.name: store_credit_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of store credit issued to the customer as part of this refund. Null if no store credit issued. Used when customer opts for store credit instead of original tender refund or when original payment method is unavailable.

attributes.name: store_credit_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether store credit was issued as part of this refund transaction instead of or in addition to monetary refund. True if store credit issued, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the refund amount representing sales tax being returned to the customer. Subset of refund_amount.

attributes.name: wic_reversal_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Women Infants and Children (WIC) Reversal Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this refund involves reversal of a Women Infants and Children (WIC) program payment. True for WIC refunds which require special handling per USDA regulations, False otherwise.

products.name: gift_card
products.description: Master record for Grocery-issued gift cards and store credit instruments. Captures gift_card_number_token, gift_card_type (physical, digital, e-gift), initial_load_amount, current_balance, currency_code, issue_date, expiration_date, is_expired flag, is_active flag, is_reloadable flag, purchase_channel, activation_status, activation_timestamp, last_transaction_timestamp, and program_name (e.g., Grocery Gift Card, Holiday Gift Card). Supports gift card issuance, activation, balance inquiry, and redemption workflows across POS and eCommerce channels.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gift card record. Primary key.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who processed the gift card issuance or activation. Used for audit trail and fraud investigation.

attributes.name: primary_gift_shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who purchased the gift card. Nullable for anonymous purchases or third-party bulk orders.

attributes.name: replacement_for_gift_card_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the original gift card that this card replaces, in cases of lost, stolen, or damaged cards. Nullable for original issuances.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the gift card was issued or purchased. Nullable for online or bulk purchases.

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current activation lifecycle status of the gift card: pending (issued but not yet activated), activated (ready for use), suspended (temporarily blocked), or closed (permanently deactivated).

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card was activated and became available for redemption. Nullable for cards that have not yet been activated.

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or UPC (Universal Product Code) printed on physical gift cards for POS scanning. Nullable for digital cards.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for physical gift cards, used for inventory tracking and recall management. Nullable for digital cards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the gift card monetary value (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current available balance on the gift card after all redemptions, reloads, and adjustments. Updated in real-time with each transaction.

attributes.name: escheatment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the gift card balance was escheated to state authorities due to dormancy. Nullable for non-escheated cards.

attributes.name: escheatment_status
attributes.description: Status of the gift card balance with respect to state escheatment (unclaimed property) laws. Not_applicable for active cards, pending for dormant cards approaching escheatment, escheated for balances transferred to state authorities.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the gift card expires and can no longer be used for purchases. Nullable for non-expiring cards. Subject to state and federal gift card regulations.
attributes.references: Credit CARD Act of 2009, State Gift Card Laws

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity. True if fraud is suspected, False otherwise.

attributes.name: fraud_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason the gift card was flagged for fraud (e.g., stolen card, unauthorized use, suspicious transaction pattern). Nullable if no fraud flag is set.

attributes.name: gift_card_type
attributes.description: Type of gift card instrument: physical (plastic card issued in-store or mailed), digital (mobile wallet or app-based), or e-gift (email delivery).

attributes.name: initial_load_amount
attributes.description: The original monetary value loaded onto the gift card at the time of issuance or first activation. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card is currently active and available for use. False if the card has been deactivated, suspended, or closed.

attributes.name: is_expired
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card has passed its expiration date and is no longer valid for redemption. True if expired, False if still valid.

attributes.name: is_reloadable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card supports reloading of additional funds after initial issuance. True for reloadable cards, False for single-load cards.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the gift card was issued or created in the system. Distinct from activation date.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the gift card record was last updated. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent transaction (redemption, reload, or balance inquiry) on this gift card. Used for dormancy tracking and fraud detection.

attributes.name: number_token
attributes.description: Tokenized gift card number for PCI DSS compliance. The actual card number is stored securely in the payment gateway; this token is used for transaction processing and balance inquiries.

attributes.name: personalized_message
attributes.description: Custom message from the purchaser to the recipient, displayed on e-gift cards or included with physical card delivery. Limited to 250 characters.

attributes.name: pin_hash
attributes.description: One-way cryptographic hash of the gift card PIN for secure validation. The actual PIN is never stored in plaintext.

attributes.name: pin_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required for gift card transactions. True for cards requiring PIN entry at POS or online checkout, False for swipe-only cards.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the gift card program or campaign (e.g., Grocery Gift Card, Holiday Gift Card, Employee Appreciation Card). Used for marketing segmentation and program performance tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the gift card was originally purchased: POS (in-store point of sale), ecommerce (online storefront), mobile_app (mobile application), customer_service (phone or chat), bulk_order (corporate or wholesale), or third_party (external retailer or marketplace).

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Email address of the gift card recipient for e-gift delivery and balance notifications. Required for digital and e-gift card types.

attributes.name: recipient_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the gift card recipient for SMS delivery and balance inquiry notifications. Optional field for digital card delivery.

products.name: gift_card_transaction
products.description: Transactional ledger of all gift card activity including activations, loads, redemptions, balance inquiries, and voids. Captures gift_card_id reference, transaction_type (activation, load, redemption, void, balance_inquiry, expiration), transaction_amount, balance_before, balance_after, pos_terminal_id, store_id, channel, transaction_timestamp, and associated_payment_transaction_id reference. Provides complete gift card activity history for balance reconciliation and liability reporting.

attributes.name: gift_card_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gift card transaction record. Primary key for the gift card transaction ledger.

attributes.name: associate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who processed the gift card transaction at POS. Used for audit trail and training purposes. Null for self-service channels.

attributes.name: gift_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gift card involved in this transaction. Links to the gift card master record for balance tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: original_transaction_gift_card_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original gift card transaction being reversed or voided. Null for original transactions, populated for reversals to maintain audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment transaction when this gift card activity is part of a larger purchase or load transaction. Null for standalone balance inquiries.

attributes.name: product_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order when the gift card was used as payment tender for a purchase. Null for activations, loads, and balance inquiries.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the settlement batch in which this gift card transaction was reconciled. Used for financial close and liability reporting.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who initiated the gift card transaction. Links to customer master for loyalty integration and purchase history.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the store location where the gift card transaction occurred. Links to store master for location-based reporting and liability allocation.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code returned by the gift card processing system confirming the transaction was approved. Used for dispute resolution and reconciliation.

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: Gift card balance immediately after this transaction was applied. Represents the new available balance for future redemptions.

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: Gift card balance immediately before this transaction was applied. Used for audit trail and balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the gift card transaction was initiated. Distinguishes in-store POS, online, mobile app, customer service, and self-service kiosk transactions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card transaction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for domestic operations.

attributes.name: decline_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the gift card transaction was declined. Examples include insufficient balance, expired card, inactive card, or system error. Null for approved transactions.

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device used for the gift card transaction. Used for fraud detection and multi-device tracking. Captured for digital channels.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card balance expires per regulatory and business policy. Null for non-expiring gift cards or transactions before expiration policy was applied.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Service fee charged for the gift card transaction. Examples include activation fees, dormancy fees, or reload fees. Zero for most redemption transactions.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gift card transaction was flagged as potentially fraudulent by automated or manual review. True for flagged transactions requiring investigation.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Fraud risk score assigned to the gift card transaction by the fraud detection system. Higher scores indicate higher risk. Used for transaction review and blocking decisions.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the gift card transaction was initiated. Used for fraud detection and security analysis. Captured for ecommerce and mobile app channels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gift card transaction record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Updated when status changes or corrections are applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the gift card transaction. Used by customer service and operations teams to document exceptions, issues, or special handling.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the POS terminal or device where the gift card transaction was processed. Used for terminal-level reconciliation and fraud detection.

attributes.name: processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or gateway that handled the gift card transaction. Used for reconciliation and processor performance analysis.

attributes.name: processor_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dispute resolution with the processor.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction is a reversal of a previous gift card transaction. True for voids and refunds, false for original transactions.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the gift card transaction was settled and posted to the general ledger. May differ from transaction date for end-of-day batch processing.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of gift card transaction activity. Activation creates new card, load adds funds, redemption deducts funds, void reverses prior transaction, balance_inquiry checks current balance, expiration removes unused balance.

products.name: fraud_case
products.description: Operational record of confirmed or suspected payment fraud cases including real-time detection alerts that triggered investigation. Captures case lifecycle (case_number, fraud_type, case_status, opened/closed dates), financial impact (suspected and confirmed amounts), detection context (alert_type, alert_severity, triggering_transaction, detection_source), investigation details (investigator_id, disposition_notes), and law enforcement referral. Supports PCI DSS fraud management, real-time fraud intervention at POS, and loss prevention operations.
products.reference: Payment Fraud Case / Loss Prevention Case

attributes.name: fraud_case_id

attributes.name: associate_id

attributes.name: chargeback_id

attributes.name: method_id

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Obligation tracking: each fraud case fulfills a specific compliance obligation to investigate and remediate fraud, supporting obligation‑based reporting.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payment transaction that triggered the fraud alert. May be null if case originated from pattern analysis.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_program. Business justification: Required for Fraud Case Compliance Program Reporting: links each fraud case to the compliance program governing anti‑fraud policies, enabling program‑level metrics.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer or shopper account associated with the suspected fraud activity.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location where the fraudulent transaction occurred. Null for ecommerce or mobile transactions.

attributes.name: account_blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account or payment method was blocked as a result of this fraud case.

attributes.name: alert_severity
attributes.description: Severity level assigned to the fraud alert based on risk scoring and detection confidence.

attributes.name: alert_type
attributes.description: Type of real-time fraud detection alert that triggered the case investigation.

attributes.name: case_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud case was closed or resolved. Null if case is still open.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique case number assigned to the fraud investigation for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: case_opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fraud case was first opened and investigation initiated.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fraud case investigation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the fraudulent transaction was attempted or completed.

attributes.name: chargeback_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a chargeback was filed with the card issuer or payment processor related to this fraud case.

attributes.name: confirmed_fraud_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of confirmed fraudulent transactions after investigation completion. Null if investigation is ongoing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this fraud case record was first created in the database.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fraud amounts.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: System or channel that originated the fraud detection alert or case.

attributes.name: device_fingerprint
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device used for the transaction, generated by device fingerprinting technology.

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final determination or outcome classification of the fraud investigation.

attributes.name: disposition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed investigator notes documenting findings, evidence reviewed, and rationale for the case disposition.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score (0-100) assigned by the fraud detection system at the time of alert generation.

attributes.name: fraud_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fraud incident based on the method or pattern detected.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the transaction location based on IP geolocation or device GPS.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the transaction location based on IP geolocation or device GPS.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the case based on financial impact, risk, and resource availability.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Internet Protocol address from which the suspicious transaction originated. Applicable to digital channels.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this fraud case record was last updated.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency

attributes.name: law_enforcement_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the case was referred to law enforcement authorities for criminal investigation.

attributes.name: loss_amount
attributes.description: Net financial loss to the business after recovery efforts, calculated as confirmed fraud amount minus recovery amount.

attributes.name: pci_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fraud case constitutes a PCI DSS security incident requiring formal reporting to payment brands and acquirers.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount recovered from the fraudulent transaction through chargebacks, insurance claims, or other recovery mechanisms.

attributes.description: Number of other fraud cases linked to this case through common patterns, accounts, or devices.

attributes.name: suspected_fraud_amount

products.name: reconciliation
products.description: Daily payment reconciliation record comparing Grocery's internal payment transaction totals against bank settlement reports and gateway confirmations, including individual exception records for discrepancies requiring resolution. Captures reconciliation header (reconciliation_date, store_id, reconciliation_type, internal_total_amount vs external_total_amount, variance_amount, match_status) and exception details (exception_type such as missing_in_bank/missing_in_pos/amount_mismatch, exception_amount, transaction_reference, root_cause_code, resolution_status, resolved_by, resolution_notes, resolution_timestamp). Supports daily cash office reconciliation, systematic exception management, financial variance resolution, and SAP FI financial close processes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment reconciliation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Associates each reconciliation batch with its fiscal period, enabling period‑based variance analysis and SOX control reporting.

attributes.name: gateway_id

attributes.name: reconciliation_approved_by_user_associate_id

attributes.name: reconciliation_associate_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cash office employee or finance user who performed or reviewed this reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_batch_id
attributes.description: External batch identifier from the payment gateway or bank settlement report used to match transactions for this reconciliation.

attributes.name: store_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the store location for which this reconciliation applies. Links to store master data.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reconciliation was formally approved by a supervisor or manager, authorizing financial close progression.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reconciliation process was completed and all exceptions were resolved or escalated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation record.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual exception records identified during this reconciliation requiring detailed investigation and resolution.

attributes.name: external_report_filename
attributes.description: Filename or reference identifier of the external bank settlement report or gateway confirmation file used as the reconciliation source.

attributes.name: external_report_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the external settlement report or gateway confirmation was received from the bank or payment processor.

attributes.name: external_total_amount
attributes.description: Total payment amount reported by the external payment gateway, bank, or processor settlement report for this reconciliation scope.

attributes.name: external_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of payment transactions reported by the external payment gateway, bank settlement report, or processor for this reconciliation scope.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period identifier (YYYYMM or YYYYPP format) to which this reconciliation belongs for financial reporting and close processes.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI General Ledger (GL) document number generated when reconciliation variances or adjustments are posted to the financial ledger.

attributes.name: gl_posting_status
attributes.description: Status of the General Ledger (GL) journal entry posting in SAP FI for this reconciliation, tracking financial close integration.

attributes.name: internal_total_amount
attributes.description: Total payment amount recorded in Grocery's internal systems (POS, OMS) for this reconciliation scope, representing the merchant's view of transactions.

attributes.name: internal_transaction_count
attributes.description: Total number of payment transactions recorded in Grocery's internal Point of Sale (POS) and Order Management System (OMS) for this reconciliation scope.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reconciliation record was last updated, tracking audit trail for changes to reconciliation status or resolution.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Overall reconciliation outcome status indicating whether internal and external totals match within acceptable tolerance levels.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting reconciliation findings, variance explanations, and resolution actions taken by cash office or finance team.

attributes.name: pci_audit_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) Audit Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record was selected for Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance audit review.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Business date for which this reconciliation was performed, representing the transaction date being reconciled.

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform this reconciliation, indicating level of automation versus manual cash office review.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reconciliation process, tracking progress from initiation through exception resolution to closure.

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Category of reconciliation being performed, indicating the payment processing scope and settlement method.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) internal control testing for financial reporting accuracy.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reconciliation process was initiated, either automatically by batch job or manually by cash office user.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable variance amount for this reconciliation type before escalation is required, supporting materiality-based exception management.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable variance percentage for this reconciliation type before escalation is required.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Calculated difference between internal_total_amount and external_total_amount, representing the reconciliation discrepancy requiring investigation.

attributes.name: variance_transaction_count
attributes.description: Calculated difference between internal_transaction_count and external_transaction_count, indicating missing or extra transactions.

products.name: payment_plan
products.description: Master record for installment payment plans and deferred payment arrangements offered by Grocery, with embedded installment schedule tracking. Captures plan_type (layaway, pharmacy payment assistance, B2B net terms), plan_status (active, completed, defaulted, cancelled), total_plan_amount, number_of_installments, payment_frequency (weekly, biweekly, monthly), interest_rate, origination_date, originating_channel, and customer_reference. Includes installment-level tracking: scheduled_date, scheduled_amount, actual_payment_date, actual_amount_paid, installment_status (scheduled, paid, overdue, waived), late_fee_applied, and days_past_due. Supports pharmacy patient payment assistance programs, B2B wholesale account net terms, and collections management.

attributes.description: Total amount financed under the payment plan, including principal and any fees.

products.name: promotion_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of a promotional offer to a payment transaction. It captures the discount amount and coupon code that are specific to each transaction‑offer pair.. Existence Justification: In Grocery, promotional offers are applied to payment transactions at the point of sale or online. A single payment transaction can have multiple promo offers applied, and each promo offer can be applied to many payment transactions across stores and channels. The application of an offer is tracked with specific data such as the discount amount and coupon code, which belong to the transaction‑offer relationship itself.

domains.name: analytics
domains.description: Enterprise analytics and reporting domain managing KPI definitions, metric calculations, dashboards, data quality rules, and business intelligence artifacts for comp sales, same-store sales, basket analysis, and category performance.

products.name: kpi_definition
products.description: Master catalog of all Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) defined and governed by the enterprise analytics team at Grocery. Captures KPI name, business owner, calculation methodology, unit of measure, target thresholds, reporting frequency, and alignment to strategic objectives. Serves as the authoritative reference for all KPI metadata used across dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting. products.name: metric_definition

products.name: report_definition
products.description: Master catalog of all scheduled and on-demand business reports produced by the Grocery analytics platform. Captures report name, report type (operational, financial, regulatory, ad-hoc), owning domain, delivery format (PDF, Excel, CSV, email, SFTP), schedule expression (cron), recipient list, and data freshness SLA. products.name: comp_sales_period
products.description: Reference master defining the comparable sales (comp sales) period pairs used in same-store sales (SSS) analysis at Grocery. Captures current period start/end dates, prior-year comparable period start/end dates, period type (week, 4-week, quarter, fiscal year), comp eligibility criteria (store must be open 52+ weeks), and exclusion flags for remodeled or relocated stores. This is the authoritative reference that governs which periods are used in all comp sales KPI calculations across the enterprise, ensuring consistent year-over-year comparisons.

products.name: dq_rule
products.description: Master catalog of all data quality rules defined and enforced across the Grocery Lakehouse Silver Layer. Captures rule name, rule type (completeness, uniqueness, validity, referential integrity, timeliness, consistency), target domain, target product, target column, rule expression (SQL or Great Expectations syntax), severity level (critical/warning/info), expected pass threshold percentage, and remediation owner. products.name: dq_issue
products.description: Operational record tracking active and resolved data quality issues identified through DQ rule execution or manual discovery at Grocery. Captures issue title, severity, affected domain and product, root cause category (source system, ETL, business rule change, schema drift), assigned remediation owner, target resolution date, current status (open/in-progress/resolved/waived), and resolution notes. Distinct from dq_result in that it represents the managed lifecycle of a DQ problem, not just a single rule execution outcome. Enables DQ incident management and SLA tracking.

products.name: store_sales_fact
products.description: Core Silver Layer sales fact record at the store-day grain for Grocery, serving as the primary analytical foundation for store operations reporting. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `grocery_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_basket_summary`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Basket level performance and promotion impact"
  source: "`grocery_ecm`.`analytics`.`basket_summary`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "store_location_id"
      expr: store_location_id
      comment: "Store location identifier"
    - name: "basket_date"
      expr: basket_date
      comment: "Date of the basket"
    - name: "store_region"
      expr: store_region
      comment: "Geographic region of the store"

      expr: store_format
      comment: "Store format (e.g., Urban, Suburban)"
    - name: "basket_size_tier"
      expr: basket_size_tier
      comment: "Tier classification of basket size"
  measures:
    - name: "total_basket_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(basket_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total number of baskets"
    - name: "total_net_sales_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_sales_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net sales amount from baskets"
    - name: "average_basket_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(average_basket_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average monetary value per basket"
    - name: "average_items_per_basket"
      expr: AVG(CAST(average_items_per_basket AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of items per basket"
    - name: "promotional_basket_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN promotional_basket_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of baskets that included promotional items"
$$
metric_views.description: Basket level performance and promotion impact

  dimensions:
    - name: "department_code"
      expr: department_code
      comment: "Department code"

    - name: "employment_status"
      expr: employment_status

    - name: "termination_count"
